comments: PERFECT PERFECT PERFECT!!!! Anytime again. Great location, lovely place, nice guy......everything you want for a Paris trip.

Yann's Studio was perfection: Super accessible in a most favorite Paris neighborhood. *Anything* you might look for is 5 min away or under. Two of the finest of all neighborhood bakeries are *down* the street and great little joints are all around too! Yann's thoughtfulness shows in every detail of his set up and communications and his studio is super clean, efficiently laid out and full of light. Get this apt and have a blast in Paris,and, if you do get up early early one morning, take a stroll up the stairs to the foot of Sacre Coeur and catch a glimpse of the incredible city waking up all around you, you will love it!
Very easy going, Yann is a great host, with a great little apartment. The most perfect 22m2 I have seen in my life. Thanks a lot. See you next time!

Our stay at Yann's place was great. The studio is beautiful, comfortable, and Yann has thought of everything you'd need--coffee, tea, dishes, etc. I feel like I personally can attest to what a great place this is to be, because I had the flu for several days while I was there. Being sick abroad would be a total nightmare, but Yann's place is so clean and comfortable. I was so thankful to have such a nice place to stay. The apartment is located literally 2 blocks away from the Sacre Coeur basilica, which has an amazing view that is a beautiful walk. Definitely would stay here again!
Apartment was exactly as the pictures show, it was excellent & host communication was brilliant. Had a terrific stay with everything we needed. Thank you

My Wife and I loved this place! We definitely felt a part of true Parisian life in this apartment. Set in a bustling neighbourhood with plenty of shops and Bars and some local character. A high recommendation for those with a sense of adventure!

Everything was just as Yann stated in the description. Location was perfect!! Restaurant across the street was wonderful - and easy access to all. My stay in Paris could not have been better. Thank you Yann.

The apartment was fantastic! Great proximity to several metro lines and in the heart of a vibrant neighborhood. The Louvre, Notre Dame, and the Marais are all within walking distance, and the boulangerie on the ground floor makes excellent eclairs!

Nicholas and Jean-Yves' welcome and preparation for our family visit was exceptional, including providing all the basic items and instructions for our comfort, and programming their appliances in English to accommodate us. Their house was well beyond our expectations in layout, location and cleanliness. Our family members who stayed here with us for the holidays were equally complimentary about the accommodations and enjoyed the privacy and quietness of this hidden gem. They enjoyed the sauna, gym and entertainment readily available for our use. The love and personal care that Nicolas and Jean-Yves have put into their house was evident from the entrance through to every room. A truly exceptional house and hosts.

I would highly recommend this apartment for any single or couple traveling to Paris! Although small (bigger than it appears in the photos!), this apartment is everything you need for your stay, it is light, modern, clean and very comfortable. You couldn't ask for a better location, very close to train stations and only a 5min walk to Notre Damn. It is a great street with lots of restaurants and delis. Great kitchen and bathroom with all appliances (washing machine especially good), both very nice and modern. I was worried by the size of the shower/bath by previous reviews but there was no need it is a very decent size bath with the shower in it, no complaints at all. The balcony is great even in the middle of winter, gets a lot of sun and has a great view. Chokri greeted us at the apartment with the keys, which made the process very easy. I would again highly recommend this apartment to anyone!
It was excellent – check in and out super easy. Clean, secure. Would definitley stay again and recommend.

Fantastic location, felt very at home and safe, with plenty of things to do and nice restaurants. Great apartment, very clean and just like the photos. The neighbours were all very friendly if we ever ran into them in the hall/front door. We did have to buy some soap and toilet paper, no hassle as there's a small shop a few doors down, but good to keep in mind. Had an amazing stay, this trip has inspired me to move to Paris and study French! The location was second to none definitely my best trip to Paris yet. Yann was very good with communication and replied quickly to any questions. Would definitely recommend, and would stay here again!

We wanted to stay in an apartment close to the Marais, so chose Sophie's which is a 10 minute walk. What we hadn't realised is how close the apartment is to Rue Oberkampf and the St Martin Canal which were two of the areas of North East Paris that we were keen to visit, so the apartment was in a perfect location to see the Marais and to experience the less touristy, more bohemian side of Paris. The apartment itself is quite small, but perfectly adequate as a base for exploring. We had a very enjoyable weekend.
Chorki Kchao was a great host who gave us a varm welcome to Paris and ensured a pleasant stay. The apt was great and perfect located in the center of Marais with a nice balcony.
Great place on the top floor, charming balcony with fantastic view, ideal location near shops, stores and cafés and restaurants. Highly recommend!

Marie-Anne's apartment was lovely, light and airy. Her description & pictures of the apartment was very true and accurate. It is in a great location, a short walk from the beautiful Sacre Coeur, a metro line, nice bars and eateries. The apartment comfortably slept 4 (with room for more if needs be) and had all the necessary amenities for a comfortable and pleasant stay. We would definitely book to stay here again!

The apartment is great, clean, comfortable, quiet and we felt like at home. We found in the apartment not only all the necessary things but a lot of more. Great location, close to bus, subway, shops. The hosts are charming and very helpful. They prepared all the information you need during your stay, guides, maps, information about current exhibitions and communications. Katherine and Jean Paul - thank you again for everything. All the best. Kate, Darek & Margaret.

Tiphaine's apartment is absolutely perfect. Beautiful, light filled space. Lovely fixtures and furniture without being cluttered. Great location, central to everything. Best apartment we have stayed in Paris. Tiphaine is a gracious host and happy to help if you need anything.

We had a lovely time at Sophie's apartment. She couldn't be there to meet us but lovely Angelina let us in and settled us. The place is in a fab location, and we walked everywhere in the main. It's a real home and we had fun feeling like we were Parisian's for 6 glorious days. I recommend staying at Sophie's place.
sophie's flat is a wonderful little place in a great location, and Sophie herself is a very helpful and reliable host. We loved being there. Thank you Sophie. Highly recommended.

We loved our stay in Marie Anne's apartment in Montmatre. She was very welcoming and everything we needed was there- beautiful Parisian apartment , comfortable beds, clean , in a fantastic location. Highly recommend this apartment .

Yann's apartment was lovely, in a great location, literally a stone's throw from Sacre Coeur, and the bed was super comfortable. He was wonderful to deal with and super helpful with booking my very early morning taxi as well as great directions for getting around. I only had a couple nights in Paris and this was a great base at an inexpensive price.

Marie-Anne met us on time, explained everything to us and provided us with the essential information before leaving us to enjoy Montmartre. The apartment is roomy with two bedrooms and in a quiet street just off the main street, close to cafes, restaurants and the metro lines. Thanks Marie-Anne!
Perfect location, cosy apartment and a very nice host. The perfect place to stay for a city trip to Paris.

Apartment was perfect. Catherine had thought of everything. Neighborhood was greet also. We were two blocks from the metro, grocery store and bakery around the corner. This was my first experience with airbnb and I couldn't have asked for any different.
It was great to be at the Catherine et Jean Pascal's apartament. All was very clean and perfect! Thank you very much.

The apartment has a wonderful location in the centre of Montmartre. When you leave the apartment, you are nearby many good restaurants, bars and metro stations (Abesses and Anvers). The Sacre Coeur is only a 5 minute walk away. It was a pity there is no elevator in the building. The apartment is on the 4th floor and you have to carry your luggage. We thought the apartment is big enough for two people. It had a very good bed. We slept very well, although there was often a bit of noise in the hallway. The bathroom was small and wasn't clean.

Catherine's apartment is clean, perfectly located in Montmartre and fully equipped with everything you will need for your stay. It is tastefully furnished, with a fantastic kitchen, and was ideal for the 3 of us (adults) to stay for 5 days in Paris. The wifi is extremely fast and didn't drop once in 5 days - most hotels cant offer that reliability. The balcony is great to sit and eat dinner on in the sun and all the essentials can be picked up from a Carrefour, just a stone's throw away. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Paris.

The apartment is quiet, light and original, we loved staying here. Stairs were no problem with small bags.Very close to Metro (though we walked everywhere) and lots of bars & restaurants. Sephora was very helpful & welcoming.

The apartment was really nice and had a good location. The host Yann was helpfull and we had a good communication. The only thing, which has been mentioned in the other comments, is that the apartment has really thin walls so its a bit noisy from neighbors.

Our stay at Catherine and Pascal's apartment in the beautiful Montmarte area was an amazing experience. The apartment was so clean and beautiful and only a few minutes of walking away from all of the trendy spots in Montmarte. The train and bus stops were also very close and we had no trouble at all getting around in Paris. We would definitely do it all again!
All 2 people could want!! Good spot, good size room & nice & quiet. Hop on hop off bus, metro, buses within 100 metres. Good communication, good stay! Thank you!!!

We just got back from a week in Paris and were thrilled with this Marais apartment. It was perfectly situated to walk everywhere you'd want to go or to hop on the metro. Lots of great shops and restaurants close by. The apartment was comfortable and even had a balcony which is rare.

The hosts were fantastic. Gave great rundown of the apartment and the surrounding areas. The apartment was exactly as seen in the photos - it was great. If there is one downside it would be that I would not stay in the apartment during summer. It did get hot whist we were there and a lack of zircon was a slight problem. The apartment is in a great location. Right near Sacre Couer. Easy access to central Paris - cab - 7 Euro - Bus right out the door - 1.20 Euro and three metro stations close by. Great to live as part of Montmatre.

I had a wonderful experience at Rita's apartment! I can only recommend it! You ll find everything needed for living a smooth journey. I went there with my girlfriend and I think its ideal for a couple like us (even if I think it can suits 4 person with the sofa-bed) The location is excellent as well! You ll live in the 17th (one of the most "parisian" neighbourhood). We loved the rue de levi and rue des dames which are just 2 minutes from the apartment and the restaurant Gladines located downstairs and offers great typical south french food at very inexpensive price. you can also reach all the main parisian monument very easily (bus station and metro very close) So, if I had to come back i ll probably choose this apartment again. Thanks!

We had a great time in this apartment. It's located within walking distance from Montmartre and has to metro stops nearby. The apartment had everything we needed, and the terrace (and the view) was fantastic.

Great place in a great location. Claire was always reachable and everything was clear. The apartment is clean. The building is modern and close to many underground station. I strongly recommend Claire's place !
This apartment is a win on every level! The hosts were fantastic at accommodating our check in and check out, and the location is perfection! We loved staying here!!

This apartment is just wonderful and is particularly wonderfully situated in the middle of Montmartre. Just around the corner are many little shops; it is possible to buy very delicious french food as well as cafes and little restaurants. The metro station is easy to get to and very central for all other lines. We were together with our teenager-kids and they just loved the experience. Marie-Ann was a big help in finding our way round. Everything was very good organized. So we just can really recommend Marie-Ann and her beautiful apartment.

Staying with Isa was a great experience! She is very welcoming and helpful, eager to make her guests feel comfortable in her home. The apartment is in the BEST location, walking distance from most important sights and has easy access to public transportation(metro 5 mins. Walking). The room is cozy and provides everything needed for a visit to Paris The house is very clean, organized and well kept. I would definitely recommend staying here.
we arrived5 hours late. it was no problem for them. it was appreciated. We really enjoyed the terrass. it was a little bit dusty. A very nice shower.

So lucky to have found this place - right in the centre of town with everything walking distance - both Bernadette and Jean were really helpful. The apartment is exactly as it says and for our family worked really well. We would recommend to any of our family and friends. Thank you
Francois was great, very accommodating. The best location, very convenient. I would highly recommend this apartment. It is small, but very worth it.
Great place in an excellent location - very comfortable apartment with good amenities. No problems at all with key pickup and stay in the apartment. Very convenient to metro and shopping.

A charming apartment in the best possible location in Paris. The terrace is wonderful when it is sunny - fantastic views and a great place to spend an afternoon or have breakfast purchased from one of the great shops on the street. Chokri was very friendly. All around a very positive experience.
Wonderful host, wonderful room, wonderful place! I would like to go there once again in the future!

Great place all around. Gracious hosts met with us and took us for a tour. Everything you would want in Paris at your front door. Real Paris experience away from all the tourist areas. No pressure from owners and were very accommodating.

Very nice flat! Its located in a good place, very easy and near for metro and transport. Very close to Sacre Coeur. The apartament was very clean and organized. The host was very simpatic and cool, my fiance asked him to help to do a surprise and he helped, very friendly! The apartment is very quiet. I liked a lot!

We loved Marie-Anne's apartment. It was very big, light, and airy with a large refrigerator and washing machine. The neighborhood was not very touristy which we also appreciated. It was a short walk to Sacre Couer and many restaurants and also to the metro to quickly get anywhere within Paris.

Everything said below paid truth. Bathroom smelled disinfection and if you ask me, I prefer this much rather than mold and other crap I use to see in hotels. We liked the place, church, shops and metro nearby.
The room is so pretty, bathroom is clean. Isa and her sons are very nice and kind. They all talk English. Thanks to them, my first stay in Paris was wonderful<3

I had a great staying at Isabelle's house. She is a wonderful host. She offered me many information about transport and helped me look for a train ticket to Marseille. The apartment is situated near the metro. It is very close to Neuf Pont and Louvre Museum. Thank you so much, Isabelle, for welcoming me in you lovely Parisian flat!

Our host was welcoming and took time to show us round the appartment giving us all the useful information required for our stay. The flat was quite spacious, modern and very well equipped with everything you might need. The 95 bus stopping nearby was very handy for accessing most of the main attractions and also very convenient for transferring to the Roissy bus at the Opera to CDG airport. There are shops and eating places nearby and the appartment and the area felt very safe.
It was very nice to stay at this flat. Very clean, and got all the things you need for visit.

The apartment was amazing and Sophie was incredibly kind and welcoming. She made sure to greet us on arrival, showed us around the apartment and made sure we felt comfortable and settled. Location wise, it was perfect - just few minutes walk from the heart of the Marais, close to a ton of shops and restaurants and very near Canal St. Martin. All we had to do was walk out the door and within blocks we found great food and drinks. The place is beautiful - well-decorated, spacious, great light and equipped with everything we needed. 3 of us stayed here very comfortably. I'd definitely recommend staying here and would absolutely come back. Merci Sophie!
Pascal is a great host and the apartment is very nice in a lively area with great views as promised

Very nice flat , great location!! Apartment was clean and organized. Overall we were very pleased with everything. Host was available if we needed anything or if we had any question he was there to answer them. Thank You

Chokri greeted us at the apartment, he left us a bottle of wine, and let us know we could contact him if we needed anything. The neighborhood was charming and it was easy to get to and from the metro. I would definitely stay there again.

The apartment is in a great location within few steps (~2 mins) from the subway/metro (#9) as well as some nice cafes, restaurants and local stores. The room is nice, clean and has tons of natural sun lights. It's with a good size and accommodates five of us without any issue. Natsumi is very friendly and responsible for prompt communications. Overall we had a great stay in Paris.

We could not have been happier staying at Thomas's place! The balcony is amazing and the flat is just as the pictures show/described. Thomas was very accommodating and welcoming and it made our Paris experience very pleasant. The area is very funky with a lot to do and we felt very safe. Thanks for having us Thomas!

Catherine was waiting for us when we arrived and gave us very thorough run down of the apartment. She gave us lots of tips on what to see and even booked us a table at a local restaurant which served excellent food. The location is very good, quiet but only 5 minutes from lots of restaurants and 10 minutes from the busier part of Montmartre. The apartment is very well equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. We will definitely look at staying here again next time in Paris.
Mireille was a great host. The apartment was very spacious, clean, confortable and very well located. I would definitely stay there when I go back to Paris.

Thomas' friend Daisy met us for check-in and was nice enough to let us come early and offer us to leave a couple of hours later than usual. The apartment was very clean and had great facilities though the dishwasher wasn't working at the time we stayed there. The view from the terrace is fantastic, we stayed out there for hours one night. The metro is pretty close by and it was a short walk to a supermarket and cafes. The neighborhood is heavily African-influenced with a large number of African restaurants and shops. This may or may not be your cup of tea.

The host was so pleasant with us, especially after we arrived much later than we said we would, and sent follow up questions after they left. The location was wonderful, had an amazing view, and was conveniently located near a grocery store. We never could get the access code to let us in the building without the keyfob, which unfortunately put our group at a pretty bad disadvantage. There were a lot of things we had to cut short on our stay because we had to meet back and let half of our group in. But overall, the place was amazing, and I would definitely recommend it to any group looking to stick together for the duration of their stay!

I trully recommend staying in that appartement. The neighborhood is nice, clean and safe and metro is very close. But above all appartement is very nice and comfortable and clean, it is exactly as on the pictures. We only met Emmanuel, who is the friendliest host I could imagine. He responds very fast on the email and helps with the tips about Paris, directions how to get somewhere, etc. Thank you for everything, when I come back to Paris I will definitly contact you if the rooms are available :) Wish you all the best, Ana

We had a fantastic experience! We couldn't have felt more welcome (including bottle of wine!) in this beautiful flat which has recently been restored with love and care. Also, a great location (close to shops and metro). Overall, I'd be amazed if you could find a nicer flat (and I say that having previously lived in Paris)! Merci Mireille

We had a wonderful time in the flat. Its very close to metro stations, supermarket, market. In 20-25 minutes we could reach every spot in Paris with metro. The building is very nice and safe, the flat is clean, looks exactly like in the picture. Definetly would go back anytime.

Julien was great, he met me, showed me the apartment, recommended restaurants and things to do in the area. Apartment was great, and much bigger than expected, lot's to do in the area as well. Would recommend to couples and would stay there again.

We stayed in Yanns Studio for three nights and it was very pleasant. The appartment is small, but very cozy and comfortable.. it had the perfect size for the two of us. We didn't meet Yann in person, but we wrote several messages via email and he was very helpful and everything was prepared when we arrived! I definitely recommend this place!

Exceptionally efficient and comfortable apartment in the thick of things. The balcony was absolutely lovely, as was the tub. Super comfy bed. Nicely decorated. It felt like home. We were very happy with the apartment - even if we were winded a few times after the stairs! :-) . Would definitely consider staying here again.

Benoit's apartment was absolutely fantastic - we were welcomed by his friend Kathrin and have absolutely no complaints at all. What an amazing view of the Sacre Coeur and an amazing loft apartment with loads of light, space and features. Highly recommended to all!

Our trip to Paris was made complete by renting this apartment. A home away from home was exactly what we needed after long days of sightseeing. The apartment was clean and provided more than the amenities we needed for a wonderful stay. The neighborhood this apartment is in was very quiet, close to shopping, restaurants, and Metro stops. Gwen and Marie are very generous hosts and I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone who is traveling to Paris and wants to experience Parisian living ALONG with seeing all the wonderful monuments and famous sightseeing locations!

Francine was a wonderful host, gave us lots of local information and places to visit. The apartment itself was beautiful, classy, pretty and clean. It was located in the center, few steps to the Eiffel Tower. Certainly recommend this apartment. We really enjoyed our stay. Thanks to Francine and her lovely apartment!!

Highly recommend this apartment. We stayed 5 days in December. Perfect for a couple looking for a nice renovated apartment with luxury finishes. Great location close to many trains, cafes, restaurants, bakeries, etc. Pictures are accurate. The apartment is very clean. Bed was really comfortable. We were able to cook a nice meal in the kitchen. It was nice to have an nespresso machine and the massive rain shower bath was awesome. We found ourselves needing to extend our stay unexpectedly over the holidays and Emmanuel was really helpful in every way and extremely responsive. Thanks for making our trip great!

Sophie was there to greet us when we arrived and she could not have been nicer. The apartment worked well for me, my wife and son. My wife and I slept on the sofa bed, which was great, and my son slept on the loft bed. The apartment is in a great location that is safe, fun and super for walking, shopping and seeing the sights. We would definitely go back to the area.

Alexis was great! I truly enjoyed my stay at his place and will not consider on staying anywhere else in the future. Alexis was very accessible and everything in his apartment was impeccably done. Thank you for everything and I look forward to my next trip there.

Arriving at Alexis's apt was like arriving at the apt of a relative or an old friend; He was a perfect host. The apt was fantastic and the location was perfect. My wife and I had an amazing time and will definitely stay here on our next visit to Paris. Thanks again Alexis for letting us use your home.

The apartment is just like you see in the photos. It is beautiful, bright and exceptionally clean. It is also spacious and all of the appliances are new and easy to use. Everything that we needed for our stay was there, with a fully equipped kitchen. Perhaps the best part though was the warm welcome we received from Catherine and Jean-Pascal. There is a book that has all the information you could need to explore the area. There is also a map in the kitchen with all of the local highlights. They explained everything we would need to know about the neighbourhood and the apartment. Overall a wonderful experience.

Alexis was a great host. Thank him for extraordinary experience. He explained every detail about his house when we checked in.We all feel Paris atmosphere in his house. The house is very modern and clean. The view of the house is very beautiful. It is also very close to metro station. If we go to Paris again, we definately would like to stay in his house.
Very comfortable apartment, well situated in Montparnasse with easy access to all tourist attractions. Communication with Marina is smooth, fast and pleasant. Definitely recommended.
Great flat, great location and a great host. Alexis replied to all our questions quickly before and during our stay. Highly recommend it.

The appartement is located perfectly in Montmartre. It is not noisy, but there are a lot of nice cafés, restaurants, shops around. The next Metro station and Sacré-Coeur is only a 2 minutes walk away. The appartement is big enough for 2 people and has almost everything you need for a weekend trip to Paris. We have not found a coffee or water heating machine which would have been nice. The bathroom is very small and the wash basin is too small for the tap. But a hair dryer is available and towels too. We have not met the host, but the information exchange in advance and the hand-over of the keys worked perfectly.

The apartament is great. Best located. Very clean and charmy. We webt 5 people and was perfect. It is true it is a little bit noisy at night but that means there is lots of life arround. We would defitely repeat!!
Actually the flat is quite nice, cozy and clean. Also, it's very convenient and just 1 minute walk from the Rome metro station. Just some miscommunication, otherwise is good experience from Airbnb.
Thomas was a perfect host. He made everything perfect and easy to access. We loved the apartment, it was perfect for us. We would definitely stay here again.

Listing description was accurate. We had a great time! The apartment is amazing-- super clean and inviting! We appreciated the step by step guidebook to the apartment, which made us feel very comfortable. Alexis was very helpful in communicating with us through check in and check out. I would highly recommend!

The place was perfect for a 2 days stay. Clean, quiet and just the comfort one needs (I was happy to find a wifi connection too, as I always have to follow up work). 2 blocks away, direction Abesses, you find (loads of) great bakeries and pastry shops and metro connection is at walking distance.

This was a phenomenal experience from start to finish. The apartment itself is just as described, with everything needed for a comfortable stay and at an excellent location - while the apartment itself is in a rather quiet residential area, the it is only minutes walking from local attractions. The host, Catherine, was incredible - she really took her time and provided all the information a visitor may need, from local shops and bistros to getting around. Overall, an excellent experience, thank you!

Francois is very hospitable and nice, he was very willing to help and always in touch. The place is very much the same as in photos, perfect place for a company like ours (there were two families of us). One small minus is stairs, but we already knew about it and were ready. Also the place is very quiet, which is important for families with kids.

Great location and wonderful hostess! Christine was very responsive and welcoming. Apartment was near three metro stations, but we spent most time walking to major attractions (Louvre, D'Orsay, Notre Dame, etc). Single bedroom had two beds - twin on the ground and double in the loft. Living room also had two large couches that were perfect beds for teenage kids. Apartment is on the third floor of building with spiral staircase (no elevator), but it is manageable if you pack accordingly. Overall...fantastic apartment in a great location with a wonderful hostess! Thanks!
I like Rita and Rita's home. I feel full of warmth! I love so much!Thank you:)

Alexis is a very warm and welcoming host. He was really helpful, both before and during our stay, and was very keen to ensure we had a great stay in Paris. The location is amazing and the apartment is stunning - just like in the photos and my boys described it as Gadget Man's house! I highly recommend.

Sophie was a lovely host. She took the time to explain things very clearly, despite the language barrier, and her place was very nice and clean. Very convenient location, with trains and restaurants very close by.
The appartement was perfect for our stay in Paris- clean, cosy and very well situated next to beautiful Sacre Coeur. We would recommend this stay to everyone!

Wonderful apartment in a fantastic location. The Bastille is an exciting area of Paris with lots to see, places to eat /drink and it is also a reasonably short walk into the centre of town through Le Marais. The apartment is large, stylish, well equiped and was ideal for our group of 4 friends over a weekend. Would certainly like to stay here on future visits.
We were met by Leo who was very friendly and helpful. The flat was clean and the terrace is superb! We went as a group of four and for three days, it was a perfect pied a terre.

Dear Clarisse, thank you very much for your extraordinary hospitality. We really enjoyed our stay in your lovely appartement. Everything was exactly like described in the internet and our expectations have been more than met. We especially liked the central location and the perfect access to the public transportations like Metro and RER. Being in Paris next time we will definitively stay with you again. Merci beaucoup et a bientot Katja

Charlotte was a wonderful host, welcoming, friendly and accommodating. The apartment is absolutely lovely, quiet & comfortable and we felt very much at home. The location is not touristy which suited us perfectly. If you are looking for an authentic Parisian experience, I would highly recommend staying here. Thank you Charlotte & Alex for your generous hospitality.

We had a great time staying at Mai's flat in Paris. It was exactly as described and located a short walk to a metro station, which we used extensively to get around the city. Mai helped booked our shuttle service to the airport. We will definitely consider staying at Mai's flat again.
Fantastic flat and Nicolas was super helpful! The space is clean, modern and in a great location to access all of Paris. Would definitely stay here again!

Spacious apartment with incredible light. Very central, and half a block from the subway. It's on the border of Montmartre so convenient if you want to be in that neighborhood as well. Hosts very accommodating about check in and check out time.

The room was very clean, and the fridge was filled with a good rose which was good after the stairs! Was a great view and nice to be there. A grreat park that gives you immediate nature and relax feeling.I would go back and can say yes for next time

Kathleen is a great host. She provided with me all the necessary information upon arrival. As I had a limited time in Paris, she was quick to respond to arrange my arrival so that I managed to do all I wished. The location is really great and the room just perfect for a single person. Highly recommend ! Thanks again Kathleen.
Great flat, well located close to bustling neighbourhoods and pretty quiet especially as it is located in a quiet yard. Would come back anytime

we [husband and 3 adult children] had a wonderful stay in clarisses apt. The apt is beautifully done up and very comfortable, it had everything we needed.Unfortunately we could not meet Clarisse but her lovely daughter was at the apt to meet us and full of useful information about places to go to. The apt is very well located with lots of cafes and shops close by. It was thoughtful of Clarisse to leave wine and chocolates for us we really appreciate the kind gesture, will certainly recommend to friends n family.

Francine was absolutely delightful, she is prompt, courteous and as nice as they come. The apartment is in an unbelievable location, literally minutes from the Eiffel Tower and at a doorstep of a metro. The garden is a gem with this apartment, it's nice to have a coffee and relax after a long day of walking. The apartment is clean, modern and just like the pictures. If you asked us what I would change about it, would be a little bit more space in the bedroom and the bathroom. Thanks Francine, we will be seeing you again on our next trip.
Splendid appartment in the best location of Paris. We felt well taken care of during our entire stay. Perfect organisation. We would be happy to stay with Alexis again.

Perfect location to explore the city. Plenty of pictures for an accurate description of the property. Space for a family of four. Owner very quick to respond to messages and accommodative. Great to have an elevator for the luggage. If traveling with children, Luxembourg Gardens, nearby, is a perfect place for a playground break and play boats on the water.

Clarisse's apartment is great! We had a wonderful time in her apartment. I could not meet her but her daughter was there and explained everything we needed. The place is really cosy and the decoration is so nice! The underground is just 5 minutes walking distance. Clarisse left us some delicious welcome fruits, sweets and beverages. Besides that, she left maps and a god description of the region: underground, restaurants, supermarket. We had a great time in Paris :) Obrigada!!

The flat was lovely and easy to get to. Comfy bed, good shower, GREAT location. I mean, there's a boulangerie downstairs and you're a 10 minute walk from the Jardain du Luxembourg - what's not to love? The few times we had questions, Marina was extremely accessible. Would recommend.
We have a great time in Paris and this apartment was good for us. Very convenient and in central Paris. We arrived late the first night and Aurelie was waiting for us, thank you.

Marina is a super nice host! We felt so lucky to meet Marina. She waited for us with patience and prepared everything we need for us. The apartment is spacious and well equipped. The beds were comfortable. Most importantly, it's in great location, which is close to the metro, easy to go to everywhere, has a quiet and safe neighborhood. We had a good stay at the apartment. I will absolutely recommend her apartment!

Ana had a friendly approach even though I did not meet her in person she made me feel very welcome. She was very helpful The apartment was great location and convenience in all aspects. Check in and check out are smooth and easy. The room was clean, tidy and comfortable. I really enjoyed my stay there. Recommend it.
We did two separate bookings so just read the review I wrote a few days ago to find out how outstanding we thought this apartment and host were. Thanks Emmanuel!

Pascal was a lovely host. Everything was exactly as described and the view was breathtaking. The location was perfect! Just far enough out of the hustle and bustle of Paris, but not too far out to get around with ease. Thank you for everything!

Yann's place was in the perfect location - right near the Sacre Coeur and metro! On the same street there was a supermarket which was helpful. We stayed in summer (early July) and it was quiet hot inside. Yann was very easy to communicate with and when one of the blinds broke he was very willing to come and fix it asap. Apartment is basically one room but perfect if you don't plan on spending much time inside.

I definitely enjoyed my stay, and Chokri was a good host. The place is clean and looks like it does in the pictures. The balcony was great, we always ate our meals and drank wine on it. Paris was very hot when I was there, high 90s low 100s, but Chokri provided a fan and with the apartment being on the top floor there was a good breeze through it which made the heat bearable. I would recommend staying at this place.

I had the most wonderful time at Isabelle's apartment. Such a stunning apartment and a beautiful cosy room for one. I felt a had a true Parisian experience here! Isabelle is a lovely woman and her two sons were very polite and friendly. The location is excellent - Metro stop is a two minute walk and you can walk easily to some of the main attractions (Louvre is only a 15min walk max!). Thank you Isabelle, if I'm ever is Paris again I will definitely stay again!
We had a very nice stay. The appartement fits the pictures. Its a very nice area. No noise from the Street.

Yan was great with communication via text to find his place.The apartment had everything we needed and was close to shops,trains .Monmarte was hilly ...but interesting.The four flights of stairs kept you fit for walking in Paris. Thank You Yan.

Gwen and Marie have a lovely home. They (and their wonderful neighbour Sylvie) are perfect hosts and very helpful and welcoming. The apartment is in a beautiful area of the city, with metro stations connecting to most lines in short walking distance. There is no noise in the evenings, and even though it was hot out the apartment was cool and ventilated.

Jean-Francois was incredibly helpful and kind. Organizing the accommodation and getting the key was very straightforward and he was willing and able to work around our arrival schedule. The place was exactly as described on the website and was an awesome place to stay in Paris. We loved it! It is a great location! The bed (and sofa bed) were very comfortable and the place was very clean. I would highly recommend staying here!

Sophie went out of her way to make sure everything was good for us even though we were uncertain of our arrival time and she was leaving for her vacation. The listing was accurate and we loved the location. Great spot for a short 3 day visit to Paris.

My stay at Isabelle's was really great! She is a absolutely sympathatic person, uncomplicated and in a good mood al the time. I received a lot of help for orientation in the city. The room was very nice. Tidy, cool and very quiet. From the appartment everything is close to reach. Le Louvre, the river Seine, Sacre Coeur, Centre Pompidou. Metro and bus are also near by and down the street there is a very nice area with bars and restaurants. I can just recommend to stay at Isabelle's!
Great appartment. Great hosts. Paris is outside, but inside it was very quiet. Lot's of nice places to eat, supermarkets nearby. We had a great stay!

Yann's exquisite and tranquil apartment is the ideal place to stay while in Paris. We experienced the city like true Parisians within the most romantic neighbourhood - Montmartre. It is centrally located and the Abbesses métro station nearby makes the entire city easily accessible. The bed is extremely comfortable and the apartment, though cozy, possessed all that anyone could require. It was immaculately clean and welcoming. Although we did not have the privilege of meeting Yann in person, he was a courteous and professional host. He helped us immensely when we forgot a substantial amount of euros in the apartment prior to boarding our train to Belgium by sending us the sum amount through PayPal. We cannot thank him enough! Should we return to Paris, we hope to stay here again.
Isabelle is a nice host. The house is small but very cute, and it is very convenient to visit the museums from it.
Really lovely apartment - as described. Amazing location and very well equipped, it had everything we needed and more. Would love to stay again!

Amazing views overlooking Paris including all the main monuments; all closer than appears in the photos. Spent our last night of our France holiday here reflecting over the beautiful Paris lights. There are many stairs to get to the apartment but absolutely understandable when you witness the view for the first time. Pascal was there to meet us and help us with anything that we needed to know.

Excellent location close to metro. Very nice neighbourhood. Flat was not clean and several things broken or not working. Items like soap and shampoo, umbrellas that were in the listing were not provided. Good maps and travel guides available.

DO NOT HESITATE to rent this property, the view is crazy incredible, the Eiffel Tower is way, way closer than it appears in the images. Forget about it not being "close" to main attraction, as taking a taxi was easy, subway minutes away, and a 15 minute walk gets you to Republic Square, which splits in several directions (2 towards sorta tourist directions)... if the weather's nice, you can walk all the way to Opera, shopping, eating, etc. along the way. We did this with my 5 year old son in toe with absolutely not complaints from him. All was super convenient and enjoyable to the point where we extended our stay. If I'm ever in Paris again, I will call this property home!

François was very kind and helpful. The apartments had a really nice position, just minutes away from the Sacre Coeur and really close to the subway. They weren't very big, but still really nice and comfortable. Having a washing machine and a dishwasher was very useful. The other people in the building were also very kind and helpful. We would definitely reconsider the apartments for the future!

Christine was very nice, friendly and attentive. Place was very tidy, good access to where ever you want to go, metro or by foot. A lot of shops and resturant around. Overall we had great time. Thank you

We stayed in Chokri´s apartment for one week in the beginning of August and it was perfect. The apartment looks like it does in the pictures and it is situated very well in a "hip" part of Paris with many small boutiques - but still close to tourist attractions like Notre Dame and Centre Pompidou. The balcony is very nice - we had our breakfast there every morning. Chokri was very helpful. On the day we arrived, he let us check in earlier in the morning. Similarly, we left very late on our last day (nine hours after check-out) and Chokri let us keep our luggage in one of his other apartments which basically gave us one more day in Paris. Overall, we were very happy with our stay.

Great flat vis a vis the Louvre. We didn't meet Alexis (just had good contact with him via phone and mail) but his housekeeper Moorthy took great care of us. The Flat is very well equipped and they take great care about all the details (free Nespresso, there is Milk in the fridge when you arrive etc...). Perfect location for a Paris short trip with your spouse or your little family.

Great apartment - secure, modern, well- equipped and only five minutes walk to the restaurants of Montmartre. Catherine,our terrific host, met us on our arrival and explained how everything worked, provided information for sight seeing, local shops, restaurants and transport. She even booked our Moulin Rouge tickets for us! This apartment is truly 'your home in Paris'. I would certainly stay here again.

Christine was a fantastic host leaving us her utterly charming apartment. We felt like true Parisians ! The apartment had everything we needed and was the perfect base for our family of four to explore Paris. Christine was available at any time if we needed her ...but we didn't everything was perfect.

We had a wonderful experience at the flat. Everything was exactly as described and our host personally showed us through the different parts of the flat before handing the keys to us. While we were there, she also made herself available to answer questions (about the flat and Paris in general) to make our stay as comfortable as possible. Thank you!
Agnes very patient, nice and helpful! She did everything to make my stay as at home. Apartment in good location - near the metro and shops. Room small but have everything for stay.

This is a gem of a place. Amazingly for Paris here is a house, with garden, in which you can relax in peace and quiet and yet still be extremely close to 2 different metros and surrounded by cafes and restaurants. Jeanne, her house and her cats, were all lovely.
Clara was very welcoming and helpful. The rooms were comfortable and had good views over the Paris rooftops. I would stsy here again.

What an absolutely brilliant apartment. Simply the most incredible, all-encompassing view of Paris which words cannot describe. The apartment itself is lovely too – exposed wooden floor, bookshelves overflowing with books, a comfortable bed – you'll feel like it's your home. Book!

So central...I've been to Paris many times and needed something convenient for work. Picked up groceries at Monop had so many nice meals in the place with the windows open listening to the bar chatter below.

Apartment was exactly as advertised and very comfortable and clean. Location was great with plenty of dinning options right at your front door. Bernadette was a perfect host and provided much needed local advice. Would certainly stay here again and a fantastic cost effective option for a family of four.
It's a very good trip of having such nice house,and also so convinent ,we will have stay next time surely.
The apartment was very nice. shower was good. Very near to a great road full of cafes and restaurants. Would recommend.

Rita's apartment was a great place to stay in Paris. Her brother welcomed us on our arrival and left some food for our breakfast and a guide of the neighbourhood and the rest of paris. The apartment was clean and central

Clarisse and Eugenie made us feel entirely at home with a warm welcome in person from Eugenie, a lovely note from Clarisse and some wine and chocs. The apartment was exactly as had been described. It is clean and comfortable, well equipped and very conveniently located between two Metro stations. There is a boulangerie downstairs and a small grocery store about 100m walk away. We also enjoyed the fresh food market in the street. This is a fantastic apartment for a family of four and Clarisse truly made us feel a little bit Parisian,

The apartment is in an absolutely fantastic location - walking distance to practically everything in Paris. Carlo was very responsive and we were met late in the evening and shown around the building. The rooftop view is amazing - we enjoyed a dinner and some wine watching the sunset and Eifel Tower sparkle over the rooftops one evening. The apartment is a good size - it was me, my wife, and our infant son, and there was plenty of room for us. Carlo even provided a baby bed and changing mat! The elevator was also extremely helpful. This place is perfect for young, intrepid travelers and families alike. We highly recommend it and would stay here again!
Yes, we found the place just fine and the listing was accurate. It was better than we imagined, and super clean. We had a brilliant time. It was hard to leave because of being so comfortable.
Perfect location for Paris next to Chatelet metro and RER. Very clean and tidy. A little noisy on the weekend evenings but did not impact us too much. Highly recommend.
charming neighborhood uphill. A bit rough downhill. absolutely very nice and QUIET apartment with easy access to Metro. I would happily use it again.

Loved the apartment. Nice and clean. Excellent location, walking distance to all the central attraction. Very nice and lively neighborhood. Carlo's mom greeted us and showed everything around the apartment including an amazing terrace. A welcome bottle of wine was a nice treat. Two elevators were extremely because I was with my mom and although she can walk quite a bit in the city, using the stairs to high floors can be a challenge.

A very lovely and clean place with a very nice host! It is perfectly located in a rather quiete small street. Up in the fith floor there is hardly any noise for the street and the bars around. The next velib-station (almost free city of Paris bikes) is only a few steps away. The bar on the opposite side serves everthing you need after a journey the car/plane/TGV. And if you want to enjoy sunset or sunrise have a coffee of the small balkony. We will try to book this place again. Cheers, les petites suisses
Host was there when needed, offered guides of Paris, Nice neighbourhood, shorts distance of interesting musea
We had a great time at Clementine's place. The appartment is lovely and the area very beautiful!!! Thanks a lot!

Chokri's apartment is well located on one of the nicest streets, very close to Metro, please take under consideration that it is on a high floor so get in shape or.. The apartment is lovely and looks more like hotel room than apartment, the room is quite small (as most apartments in Paris) but very comfortable. Since our flight was in evening Chocri let us stay longer and make a late checkout. I would recommend this lovely apartment to any couple looking for a romantic vacation in Paris!

Beautiful apartment with all amenities in one of the best neighborhoods in Paris. Marie is one of the kindest people I have met in Paris. She did everything possible to ensure that I am comfortable and I feel like home in the apartment. She was always available to answer questions or to provide assistance with something I needed. Noone could wish for a better host. I will gladly stay in this apartment when I am in Paris again.

Lovely unique place with personalized touches and a beautiful view in a fun neighbourhood. Benoit was very on top of communication and provided very useful information. Thank you for allowing us to stay at your place :)

Sophie's apartment is fantastic, an excellent place to stay for a short or extended visit to Paris. The apartment is clean, spacious and in a very good location. It's a short walk to the Terne metro station and not too far from a number of good restaurants, shopping and bars. Sophie is an excellent host, checking in and out was very easy and she was always available to any questions or help with any issues that came up. Overall I would highly recommend this listing.

We spend 3 days in this cute apartment. Good location, close to the restaurant area and the famous Sacre Cour is 2 minutes walking. Very well ventilated - 2 big windows - the place have everything for make you feels welcome. The bed is super conformable. No lift, but we don't mind the cardio moment on the stairs =) We cook breakfast every morning with french delicious things from the store right in the front of the building. Lunch on different areas and dinner was on the Rue des Abbesses, so many good choices... We meet Yann on our way out, very nice guy. We highly recommend his flat for your stay in Paris.
5 starts appartment. BRAND NEW and equipped with everything you may need. Centraly located close to public transportation. Very friendly and welcoming host.

It was a very cute little apartment with the best location. Also can easily find nice place to eat just downstairs! Specially recommend the small Vietnam restaurant on the rue malar:) the host was very kind and helpful.

My friends and I stayed at Francois' apartments in Paris during the weekend of the Terrorist Attacks. This was a very chaotic weekend to be in Paris and Francois was absolutely amazing with us: he kept checking in to ensure we were safe, he even proposed that we could stay one day longer if need be, and just made the whole stay better than we could have expected given the situation On top of that, the apartments were absolutely great and clean. Thank you very much Francois! Recommended

Pascal is a friendly and accommodating host. The apartment is very nice and has a great view. The only downside is that the immediate area around the apartment is not that great. However, it is less than a 5 minute walk to the nearest metro station. Great value for the price.

Yohann was very friendly and accommodate us nice and quickly. It was a very clean, modern place with many restaurants and pubs nearby. Highly recommended for friends/families travelling the beautiful city!

Chokri was incredibly welcoming. We text once we arrived and straight away Chokri replied with instructions on how to get to the apartment by metro/train. When we got to the apartment which is literally a 2 minute walk from the metro we were welcomed by Chokri who carried our bags to the room. Once we got inside he ran through everything we might need including the best direction to head in for shops/restaurants/galleries. He made sure everything was in working order and that we were totally comfortable before he left. The apartment itself had everything you need; a fully functional kitchen, as well as a hair drier, iron, towels etc.... While it is small, I didn't feel like I needed any more space. I unfortunately fell sick while there so ended up being stuck in doors for a while but found it comfortable with a box of DVDs and plenty of heat. I would highly recommend it for both location and apartment.

We were five girls. The place was really clean and very close to the Eiffel tower as well as a bus stop and 5 mins walk for a metro station, Invalides. The spot was very safe. And François stayed in touch with us all through our stay. I would definitely recommend it and will stay there again if I went to Paris. Thanks François.

Beautiful apartment in a great neighborhood in Paris. Very easy to travel around using the metro. 3 different metro lines are very close to the apartment. We enjoyed the stay very well and the host on our arrival was very accommodating. Best restaurant we went to is on the bottom floor called Le Patio, must try the Pizza there :)

Mai was a superb host and me and my wife really enjoyed our stay. Mai was very flexible and got up at 7am to let us in. The apartment was in a great location in a lovely local area with some amazing places to eat and buy food. The apartment was warm, clean and had everything we needed. An excellent host and thank you very much, Mai. Definitely recommend to anyone visiting Paris.

We were two families staying at François' accommodation for four nights. Everything was just perfect - great location (very close to the Sacre Coeur, Moulin Rouge, public transportation and lots of good shops and restaurants), very comfortable, cozy, well equipped and quiet apartments (exactly as described), François was very kind and helpful. Our flight arrived early in the morning and Francois offered us to come to the apartment at 7am despite the fact that the time of check in is only at 1pm (free of charge). It was very nice of him and really helped us. Thank you very much, Francois. Also thanks to Sue.
The host was very kind and diligent. Location was great, but a little noisy at night, except for that, everything was perfect!

The listing was entirely accurate and the apartment was ideally suited within close walking distance of all the art galleries and Sacre Coeur on Montmartre. A quiet street made for a secure and safe comfortable place to stay. Catherine welcomed us on arrival, gave us a grand tour and was always helpful in answering further questions. This is a wonderful Airbnb.

Alexandra's lovely apartment is located close to the metro and in walking-distance to Place de la République and to many other sights. The surrounding area has lots of restaurants, bakeries, cafes etc. The charming and well decorated apartment had everything we needed like towels, hairdryer etc. and the kitchen is fully equipped. The apartment has a good size and is spotlessly clean.The beds are super comfy. Communicating with Alexandra was convenient and efficient. We had a wonderful stay and will certainly recommend friends to stay there if they visit Paris.

Unfortunately I could not visit Paris because of some personal problems at the last minute. However, my host Agnes was very helpful. She constantly reminded me of my travel dates and gave me detailed descriptions of the address. When I travel for the next time, I would definitely like to choose her again.

Wonderful flat, stylish and well equipped. The situation is amazing with a view that is just great. Everything was simple including the reception of the keys and the handover. An address I will return back to.

Check in was a breeze. Whilst Celine wasn't there to great us, she arranged for a smooth check in anyway. The apartment was beautiful and suited the 4 of us quite well. The view was very French and listening to the church bells was a real treat. There are many good supermarkets close by and walking distance to a metro.

Marina's apartment was simple and perfect for our stay. It was conveniently located near the metro and in such a wonderful neighborhood of paris to walk around. Marina as a host is very nice, helpful and readily available. We felt comfortable in her home.
It was a nice stay at Paris :) The appartement was as nice as on the pictures. Thank you very much Isabelle that we had such a nice stay at Paris

Mandana place was lovely and she very kindly left us a few treats for our arrival. the area was great and we were big fans of the local organic shop and the market. A really perfect spot if you want to see all of Paris.
Great location, beautifully decorated and we received some great local tips from our host. The perfect, cozy apartment to explore Paris from.
Mirelle is a great hoste. She arranged well the keys pick up. Her place is clean and nice as the pictures. Convenient, close to several stores and the mtr. I would definitely recommend her place.
As per my last review, Chokri is an excellent host. We had no problems. I am very happy
Our stay at Nicola's appartment was great. The flat is lovely, it looks exactly like on the pictures and we had everything we needed. Nicolas was also very responsive. Thanks a lot !!
Do not hesitate to stay at Natsumi's appartment, it's very cosy, central and well organized ! she's really nice and will help you settle down perfectly ! A perfect stay ! Many thanks !

Ana was very attentive and communicative prior arrival, as well as flexible with our check-in and check-out times. The apartment is nice, simple and was very clean. Nation is a good spot with surprisingly nice restaurants and facilities around, and a very good public transportation hub. It is not as nice as other quarters but not as busy either! Couple of buts are that we only got information (including the door code) half an hour prior check-in time and that the bathtub had no plug (we bought one), since the shower cable was not long enough for me (189cm). We had a nice time at the apartment and enjoyed Ana´s hospitality and our time in Paris.
5 stars! Had a great experience, and Benoit was quite helpful and responsive. Great neighborhood and view as advertized!

Aurielle was lovely and went through every detail about the apartment. Listing description was very accurate, we thought the place was actually bigger than the photos show! Very close to public transport and bars, restaurants.

This apartment was right the smack of all the shopping districts! The louvre is right opposite, rue de Saint honore was behind, and there are so many restaurants around too. The house was spacious and immaculately clean with amazing showers and comfortable bed! I would recommend this to my friends and also would to anyone who's looking for a perfect location!

This is a fantastic apartment in a great central location! The apartment looks true to the pictures- it is very clean, modern and spacious and we loved everything about it! It is a few minutes walk from the station and surrounded by numerous bars and restaurants. It can get a bit noisy in the evenings, but with Windows and shutters down it isn't too disturbing. We were able to walk to many locations including the Lourve, Notre Dame and Saint Germain within 10-15 minutes. Jean and Bernadette were great and always responded promptly to any questions and requests. We would love to return to stay in their place in the future!

We really enjoyed our time here. Not only was it very comfortable but Emmanuel offered suggestions for restaurants, how to travel to different points of interest and helped us make the most of each day of sight-seeing.

The flat is quite nice. Its location is almost perfect. The Metro-station and supermarkets are about 5 minutes away and you can get to many sights (Louvre, Opera, Sacre Coeur/Montmartre, Centre Pompidou) in 20-30 minutes by feet. The flat itself is kinda cute and perfect for a short stay, if you're supposed to spend your days in the city. It was clean, and beside the noises the bed makes, when you turn over, there's absolutly nothing to complain about. The communication with the host was on a very friendly level and worked smoothly.

When we arrived, Alexis had an assistant who explained the details of the apartment. Some of the mechanical are difficult for me since I'm a baby boomer, but this was a wonderful apartment close to all the attractions, restaurants, shops, museums, etc. We loved it, and my children told me it was a "home away from home". I highly recommend future renters to use this apartment. Alexis was very prompt whenever we had questions, and we would definitely stay there again in a heart beat!

Nathalie's flat was fantastic for my parents to stay for a week. It has a nice living area which has a lot of light and a nice bedroom as well. It's in a interesting part of Paris, with the flowered promenade, the Bastille and the famous Marche D'Aligre food market within walking distance. It also is very close to many transport options to take you everywhere in the city. The shower room is indeed very small but posed no problem. Thanks Nathalie!!
Perfect location to explore Paris on foot. Apartment quirky, basic and just what is needed for a short stay in Paris. We all had a fab time and Francois is a great host.
The flat was great! Small but with all you need for short stays. Julien was super helpful with all we need for the stay! We will totally come back!

The apartment was perfect for our quick visit to Paris and located in a great area with wonderful patisserie and other great shops just outside. The view from the small deck is really nice and the weather was good enough that we had dinner on there one night. I would absolutely stay there again.

We could not have asked for a better host or a better flat, thank you Nicolas. Perfect location for our needs and easy walk to everything we needed or wanted. If a repeat customer is the best rating, you have that from us Nicolas and we will do it again if you're not booked on next trip there.

Thierry met our family and showed us around the apartment. He took the time to show us the neighborhood and followed up with us on ideas for us for the week. The apartment was centrally located and perfect for our family. Quiet building inside yet neighborhood is quiet busy.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Emmanuel's apartment. Although we didn't meet him , Estelle was there to greet us and show us around. Communication with both Emmanuel and Estelle was excellent and the apartment was exactly as it appears in the photographs. The apartment is very well equipped and full of light. Emmanuel left a bottle of wine in the fridge for us - a nice welcome treat. Location is great & it is quiet at night- close to the Metro, many small grocery stores and Canal St. Martin. On the warmer days we enjoyed the terrasse. I hope we can return to stay another time. :)
We had a great time in this appartment that is close to a lot if interesting places ranging from culture and good restaurants. The welcome was great and we got good information.

We had a great experience at this apartment in Paris! We walked everywhere (at least 10 miles a day) so we were so happy to be located in the area. We felt like we were in such a great local spot and close to everything.

We had a fantastic stay here. Clarisse is attentive and speaks English and French; the apartment is lovely (and just as pictured). This is a great neighborhood for anyone who wants a less touristy area. It's a quick walk to the key train ride. (If you're a foodie, you'll probably dine largely in other areas.) All in all, one of my favorite places I've stayed with AirBNB.

I had great time in Luka's house. It was very clean, neat and cosy house!! All beddings and kitchen ware was perfect. Lights in the all room was also very good. At night it made me very comfortable mind, so I can take care of my tired body. Luka's house is next to Louvre museum. I think Louvre is center of paris. So it was very easy to use transportation. Many station(including metro, bus, train) is close at Luka's house, and I can go anywhere in paris sights at walking distance. + Luka's house is much better than picture :-) Just visit!

We were very satisfied with the apartment: it was reasonably priced; it was equipped with everything we needed; it was well located; Francois was there to explain everything we needed to know about the facility and he made us feel welcome. We would stay there again and would recommend Franco's apartment to others.
Julien is a brilliant host and welcomes me warmly. The room is very nice, cosy and clean. It was a nice stay, thanks a lot!

The listing description was very accurate and the pictures are exactly as experienced. This was the perfect location for our visit to Paris. I would recommend this location! It was perfect for the four of us and we really enjoyed our stay. Very safe and secure and clean, with all the comforts of home! The market on the main floor was also very convenient. We were warmly greeted upon our arrival and given a tour of the unit. A perfect place to stay.

Our stay at Luka and Adrien's place was nothing short of AMAZING. Luka was a saint - He was waiting at the apartment to greet us even though we arrived 8 hours after our planned arrival. The apartment far exceeded our expectations. The decor was wonderful. The mattresses were devine as were the linens. The kitchen was very well equipped - the cappuccino maker was a nice surprise. The apartment is VERY WELL located, with so much nearby. All the sites were within walking distance. The area is also filled with great places to dine and shop. Without any reservation or hesitation we highly recommend a stay at this fabulous apartment!!

We loved this place! It is spacious, clean, comfortable and in a great location. Walking distance to plenty of good restaurants, bars, cafes, and a lovely wine and cheese shop at the end of the street. The metro is also a block away so easy access to the entire city. Jean-Francois was a gracious host and always quick with any communication. He welcomed us kindly, gave us local recommendations, and even made us a dinner reservation and a great little restaurant nearby! Highly recommend and would come stay here again in a second. Thanks Jean!
It is a great place! Quiet, clean and so friendly. Olivier gave me a warm welcome. I enjoyed staying there. He was helpful and open. Thank you!

We had the greatest time in Paris and we stayed at the perfect location. Jean-Francois was awesome in helping us with any questions we had regarding our stay in Paris. He welcomed us at the apartment and even assisted in lugging our suitcases up the stairs. The apartment as in a great location and very near bus and metro stops. You could go in any direction and find lots of great restaurants and bars. Very near Moulin Rouge and Montmarte. Loved sitting on the balcony in the evening enjoying a beer and loved having the convience of an entire apartment for our stay. You'll get lots of excercise climbing the stairs each day, but we loved the feeling of living in Paris for a week. Thanks Jean-Francois!

Well located flat with a vey nice terrace in a quiet street. The living room and the kitchen are luminous and spacious. The flat is equipped with modern appliances and the WiFi works really fine. Nice bedroom and large bathroom. The perfect place for a romantic escapade in Paris. The metro station is nearby and the Saint Martin Canal just at the corner of the Street with its typical Parisian bistros. Fine experience, the owner is very professional and has everything well organized, he even left us a nice bottle of wine as a welcoming present. A strong recommendation.

I really enjoied our stay at Ana! The appartment has a very good location, it is modern, clean and nicely decorated. I recommend Ana's place! The only thing is that it doesn't have 'blind' curtains to keep the sun away in the morning :p

The apartment is wonderfully decorated and very well-equipped, I have zero complaints. None whatsoever. Great bathroom, even better bedroom, perfect kitchen/living room. Very friendly and attentive host. A great experience.

The apartment was perfect for 2 people, exactly as depicted in the photos. Very clean, well-equipped, and very nice French balcony doors that open fully from the living room and bedroom. Nice view of the street below, fairly quiet, and it was great that there were markets and stores close by for wine, cheese, fresh bread, fruit and other necessities.

The host was very welcoming and met us at the apartment after we followed his very accurate directions. The main feature of this place was the location as it was a 5 minute walk to the eiffel tower, whilst also being withing walking distance in the opposite direction to the champs-elysses, and within a 5 minute walk of the nearest metro station also. The apartment itself was clean but also quite small. The loft (where one double-bed is situated) has a very low ceiling so not great for tall people, plus the stairs leading up to it are very narrow. Unfortunately the only bathroom is upstairs so you will have a challenge if you need to go during the night.

This is a nice apartment, very small bathroom, good location. Nice view of rooftops, not a view of streets though. We did not meet the hosts, they were very accommodating. Even when we forgot the code to get in late at night, had to call them,they were very nice.
Unique apartment in great location. Host was wonderful. Walk up 5 flights of stairs a little tiring but doable, even at end of day.

we loved our apartment and stay with marina,we will be back for sure, marina is lovely,The area is perfect to visit and absorb into pariessenne life,close to two metros,they are equal distance either direction from the appt. so easy to get around on the metro. there are numerous restaurants, shops and brasseries around,perfect to experience french life.

Mary was a very warm and welcoming hostess. The apartment was the perfect size for the three of us and we loved it. Everything was in great condition. Wonderful location- only a block from Odeon metro and numerous resturants, bakeries and shops. Apartment was simply adorable and decorated beautifully. My only issue was the five flights of stairs- I thought I was in better shape than I really am as climbing up those at the end of a long day of walking through Paris was exhausting! I highly recommend this apartment and Mary. She checked in with us throughout our trip to make sure everything was ok.

It was really nice! Francois prepared us with a lot of information about the arrival, appartement and the neighbourhood before our stay. During our stay everything worked fine - the appartement has everything you need and is well equipped. When help was needed Francois responded within minutes. Finally, the area around the appartement is just perfect - probably one of the most beautiful districts of Paris. If you leave the appartement you are immediately enjoying the typical french way of life with a lot of excellent restaurants, bars, coffes and shops.

Marina is a great host - very friendly, helpful and understanding when I requested to make some changes to my plans! (Thank you Marina!) It was lovely to stay in her apartment for the week. It is spacious and comfortable and in a fantastic location.
Everything is perfect expect one neighbor put VERY loud rock music at 3am to 5am at the second night which made us cant sleep at all.
My best Airbnb experience !!Isabelle is nice and warm-heart,she's house is lovely and convenient ,definitely recommend !!

Jean met us at the apartment when we arrived. The apartment was just as described and absolutely beautiful! The apartment sits above a busy, noisy restaurant area. While you can hear much noise in the evening, we had no problems sleeping through it--and we were there during Eurocup! It is very close to the Metro station and many areas of Paris are easily walkable. We felt safe day and night in the area. We would definitely stay at Jean and Bernadettes if we were to return.

Great Host show us all the nieghborhood when we arrive! The apartment was terriffic al is new and is so near a lot of museums, eiffel tour and invalides. It has 3 metro stations near and a lot of restaurants, crepes and boulangeries that make your stay really comfortable.

You could not ask for a more perfect host than Denis. We arrived in Paris by train and Denis happened to be catching a train out a little later so he meet us at the train station, provided us with tickets for the metro and gave us directions on how to get to the apartment where his friend meet us. He was also always very responsive before and during our stay. The apartment is exactly as described and looks in the pictures. It is in a perfect location to explore Paris with only a very short walk to the St Paul metro stop and is surrounded by restaurants and shops. I would highly recommend this apartment and would gladly stay and book again with Denis.

The house is quite wonderful. It's convenient to Montmartre and in a busy tourist district, but the house itself is quiet due to being inside a courtyard. The courtyard space is very pleasant; it's a nice contrast from urban Paris right outside. The house is rather small, but convenient and pretty. It includes the amenities you expect. If you sleep in the downstairs bedroom, it can be a little annoying climbing two flights to the bathroom, but this is minor. The kitchen is serviceable but very small. The cats are cute.
She was really nice. I had little problem to find the apartment but the room was clean and nice

Sweet little one room flat with a lovely view of the Eiffel Tower, perfect pied a terre for one, or for two happy to share a smallish double bed. In a quiet residential area with plenty of shops, restaurants and transport possibilities. Serious black out shutters make for a good night's sleep, and host welcoming and helpful. Late check out time was a particular bonus for us. Thank you Wolfwolf!

A small yet charming and clean apartment on a quiet and peaceful street minutes from the Porte De Versaille metro station. Sheraaz was quick to respond when we arrived and her mother was very helpful in showing the apartment around. It was a very comfortable stay and would recommend to anyone looking for a quiet and cozy place to stay.

Absolutely nothing to complain about, everything was as advertised. Thomas was there in person to show us around, literally waiting for us at the door. Apartment is as advertised, fully equipped, and the location is great with many bars and public transportation within walking distance. Recommended.

Had a very pleasant stay at Ben's apartment. Nice location with good metro access, and not too far of a walk from shops and restaurants. Ben was an excellent communicator and made sure that I had everything I needed. He was kind enough to meet me at the train station upon my arrival and walk me to the apartment. First floor access was great, and I felt very safe.

Marina is a lovely & warm host, and constantly kept us updated before and during our stay there. The room we stayed in was comfortable with a very cozy bed. There is also a separate kitchen containing utensils, groceries etc. to get you started and a bathroom. There are very good connection to the metro and a bakery downstairs just made our mornings !! The only thing that would have made our stay even better would have been if there were thick dark curtains / shades on the windows which would have blocked much of the light. Overall a lovely stay in Paris and we hope to be back again :)

The apartment is a lovely private studio in the Montmartre area which is a really great part of Paris with a lot of restaurants, shops, bars right nearby. It's also only a couple minutes from a metro stop for getting to central destinations throughout Paris. I had no trouble getting into the apartment using Yann's instructions and Yann was flexible and responded quickly regarding arrival and departure time. Would highly recommend!

We stayed with our family of 5 and had a great time. The apartment is compact for 5 people but had all the facilities you would need. There is a major train station close by and restaurants, bakery and supermarket within walking distance. Communication was excellent and Clarisse was great to deal with.
The appartment is very good in location, it's very new and harmful, nice place to go. Really enjoy the stay in Paris

The apartment is small with steep and narrow stairs, but very good location and has everything you need. Like other reviewers have mentioned, the bathroom location is rather unique. The apartment in general looks a bit run down, but clean. Would stay there again if we want to be near Eiffle Tower.

The check-in and check-out was very smooth. The host is amazing and very accommodating. She responds timely to messages and inquiries. The apartment was clean except there were some tiny bugs in the bathroom. I'm not sure about the other tenants in the building. I wouldn't leave my luggage unattended for one second in that building.
