great location and apartment layout, perfect for 4 people. the check-in was easy and the house looked better in real life than in photos, which was a nice surprise. :) the only thing I'd upgrade would be new bedsheets, as one set was a bit old and stained. the other one looked new. other than that it was perfect, thank you!

Every thing was just perfect. The apartment is very confortable and very well equipped. Location is great, very closed to attractions , restaurants and public transportation. We would recommend this to family and friends

Bad value for the money. Shower is difficult to climb out of, not suitable for anyone bigger or taller. Room is very small, so not recommended for more than 1 person. Ps. This is a hotel, so check-in was very smooth. Host was very nice and communicative though!
This is a very nice location, with easy access to many sites in Paris. It is modern, clean, and very comfortable.

Had a great stay. Checking in felt a bit like solving a puzzle but after I got done with I had no problems with anything. The location is really nice with metro being close and the room was clean and quiet.

This flat was brilliant for our weekend in Paris. Great location for wandering around Monmatre, a good amount of space and a comfortable sofa bed. Fun bars and restaurants within 5 minutes, just a walk from Sacre Coeur and easy to get into central Paris - we walked to get down to the Seine and the main tourist attractions but also noticed that public transport is nearby. All in all, a fab city break basis for a great price.

This place is great, clean, pictures are accurate and the location is great, very close to two metro lines taking you to city centre very quickly. You can book this place with closed eyes, you will not be disappointed!

Wonderful location. Quiet but in the heart of Paris. Wonderful walking neighborhood. Comfy beds, good kitchen and like others have said good showers. No elevator and some stairs so if you’re older or have a big suitcase, take note. Very safe building with nice restaurants around. Would stay again!
What an amazing place. The location, the all-day great light, the homey decor. If you always wanted to know what it is like to live like a Parisian, this is a great offer.

Sabine's place is the cutest paris apartment, ideally located in the Marais on a quiet street close to everything. The apartment is beautifully decorated and incredibly bright. Sabine was a great host, super communicative and flexible. I would definitely stay again at her place, recommended. Thank you Sabine x

I really appreciate you helping us navigate through a difficult trip cancellation due to the war in Ukraine. It highlights the the true benefit of staying, adding on of course to the magnificent look of the apartment. You are in good hands staying here in Paris.

It was our second time staying at the apartment and once again really enjoyed our stay. Great location, quick response and very accommodating host. Would definitely recommend and hope to come back next time we’re in Paris!
Good for 4. Great location. Quiet apartment. There is a Chinese restaurant we can take away called Traiteur Asie Prestige. I Really really recommend!

This apartment is a must if you are traveling to Paris. The place is exquisite, detailed and full of beautifull art objects. It has everything and more of what you may need to have an extraordinary time in Paris. To top everything of it has a spectacular views from three balconies. Alexis vas a superb host in everyway. He is very attentive, warm, and helpfull, always reachable withing few minutes. He made me feel welcome and comfortable in his one of a kind place. I will definetly be back soon!
The apartment was wonderful and superbly clean. The location was amazing and really was the cherry on top of an already amazing trip. Thank you Sophie!
Place is great, but be aware until the construction is complete it will be noisy during the day.

An excellent stay in March 2022. Communication was fast and helpful throughout. Check-in was perfect. The space is exactly as described and was ideal for our group of five adults. The apartment is well appointed, very clean and there is plenty of storage space. Location is great with La Fourche metro station a few minutes walk, Montmartre's cafés and restaurants within 10 minutes and an excellent supermarket / boulangerie just around the corner. Thanks Jean-Daniel - we loved it!
The location of the apartment is amazing! We walked everywhere and there is a lot of bars, restaurants and supermarkets near the apartment. I would really recommend booking a stay :)

This was a perfect apartment, clean and exactly as advertised on Airbnb. The apartment offers all the comforts of luxury hotel with the privacy of a home. The communication with the team went fairly smooth. I would stay here again and again
Great location and very comfortable flat with elevator. Perfect for two travelers and having a kitchen was very convenient. Highly recommended!

Great location with close to 10 restaurants/ bars with in 100 ft, train station is 4 mins away. Perfect spot for families Rahim is a gentleman and would certainly love to visit back London and stay at his apartments !!

We stayed for 3 nights and absolutely loved it. The place was clean, had everything we needed, and was in a great location. The kitchen was very well stocked and included a washer to do laundry. The washing machine was broken during our stay but it was not the fault of the owner. We were given a heads up before we arrived and the owner offered to help make arrangements if we were needing to wash clothes during our stay. Luckily we didn’t need to use it but we thought that was very kind to offer. The apartment was a very close walk to the Louvre and a few metro stations which made it convenient. I even walked to the Orsay Museum from here. You could go the other direction and walk to Notre Dame. The apartment is accessed by entering a courtyard area which makes it quiet at night. We had a car and there was an excellent parking garage one street over (1 minute walk) which was very convenient. We highly recommend staying here.
Great apartment, clean, literary next to everything. Metro, bakery ,very easy to find. Definitely I'm going to prefere it again!

The accommodation is in a beautiful location with a wonderful window view, short walking distance to the Pantheon and Rue Mouffetard restaurants and Luxembourg Palace. We did not realize until after booking that the apartment is shared by the hosts, and it is not explicit in the description of the accommodation. However, Monique and her husband are very kind and did their best to not intrude on our visit, so it was not a problem in the end but something to consider if you want a completely private stay or free roam of the apartment/common living spaces. Would recommend for a pair of students who are traveling and want to visit Paris (such as my visit) or a couple who wants to visit in a good area and plan on spending most of their day out and about. We were lucky for such a great experience and we highly recommend this space for those who to visit Paris for several days.
It was great stay by Helene, everything is very nice and cosy. She and her family is very kind and friendly. It was the best!

Host was excellent. She provided a tour of the apartment as well as a booklet with all of the local useful relevant information. The apartment itself is a Parisian dream. Quiet yet in the busy Marais and steps from one of the best markets in the city, best dining establishments, and shopping.

BOOK IT! This place is great and so close to many restaurants and cafes. It's very walkable, only about 10 minutes to Notre Dame, but it's also very close to subway stations. For a week stay the washer truly came in handy. There are stairs to get up to the apartment, but not difficult. I would definitely stay here again if I traveled to Paris!

One of the most fantastic Airbnb experiences. The place faces the Louvres and the Tuileries gardens, the view is outstanding and the details of this bespoke apartment are really unique. Alexis was very welcoming, connected and helpful. We travelled with 2 children, but given the art pieces and the fine furniture and the high-tech features of the apartment, I'd recommend the place for adults only. We (couple) will come back!

Convenient location, everything new and clean in the apartment. Communication very well, just wish we would automatically receive the check in details at 4 pm, and not have to ask for details ourselves. Ideal for 2-3 people. Bedroom is quiet despite being just steps from Moulin Rouge.
Great location, super easy check in and out. Apartment was clean but the bathrooms could use some updating, peeling paint and just a bit worn out.

Thank you so much for such a great opportunity to be in this place. The apartment is wonderful, beautiful, clean and you can really feel Parisian atmosphere. Bed is extremely comfortable and presence of cats only added to charm of this place. The location was really very good, everything was close enough that you could walk. Shops, restaurants, metro stations, the Arc de Triomphe just 5 minutes walk. It couldn't have been better. I hope I will have opportunity to come back there again.

Little, but cozy and warm, it is well decorated, and there's some sugar cubes for coffee and tea. There's only one room, the bed-sofa is in the living room so there's no privacy for the people sleeping there.
Chachou and his wife were great hosts!! Easy check-in, nice home, and amazing location. Thanks!

Wonderful location! Easy to get on the metro and go to all of the big sights. There were also plenty of food places near by. Great walking distance from the Louvre. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable.

Exceptional location and wonderful hosts. The apartment features three bedrooms, two of which have king-size beds (main level and upper level) and one is a full-size bed (lower level). Limited hanging and shelving for clothes but apartment has excellent upgraded bathrooms with great showers.
Fantastic location and host was easy to communicate with. Would highly recommend. The value is hard to beat in Paris!

The apartment was absolutely gorgeous. Within walking distance to most sightseeing and all if you're willing to put in 40 min walks. Ideal location, spotlessly clean and a nice quiet area for being a ground floor apartment our sleep was never disrupted. Paul was an absolute gentlemen to deal with, so friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay here again!!

Clean and comfortable home. The Metro station is accross the street (which connects you to tourist sights in about 25-30 min) and Gare du Nord is about a 15 min walk from the home. Unlimited eating options near the home as well as different stores/shops. Walking distance to Sacre Coeur, and if you REALLY want to get a feel for Paris you can walk to the mains sights/attractions (*only if you have a pair of comfortable shoes and like to walk and explore!). The host is quick to respond via WhatsApp and was very accommodating to my travel plans. I definitely recommend this listing.

A very lovely, clean apartment in an amazing location that was close to everything, but also felt very safe which was important as I was travelling alone. Jordan was a very attentive host who was very accommodating and generous - would recommend!
Gilbert is very kind and helpful with anything you need. The flat is comfortable and welcoming. A perfect stay in Paris.
Very nice decor and modern appliances including a very good shower. Marie made us feel very welcome and provided good information about our location.
Great airbnb, it is super well located and the apartment itself has anything you need for a short or long stay. I absolutely recommend this apartment .

We had a perfect stay in Clarisse's apartment near Nation. The location was ideal, the apartment was exactly what we needed and had everything we wanted, and we felt immediately comfortable. Clarisse was extremely helpful with communication and flexibility with check-in. We will definitely be back to visit again!

Great apartment for two, really convenient location if you’re coming in the Eurostar only 10 minute walk from the station. Really easy to walk or get the metro into central Paris and the apartment is in a a very cute neighbourhood along the canal Saint-Martin with lots of local bars/restaurants and bistrots. Check in and out really easy and Guillaume accommodated us on short notice, met us for check in and allowed us to stay till our train left, would come back for sure

Denis is such a wonderful and thoughtful host. Very accommodating and helpful with small sweet touches around the apartment. The location is fantastic. Very close to the boutiques, amazing bakeries and restaurants. Very close to the metro too so it is easy to get around Paris. Loved that the apartment is also well stocked with the basics so you won’t have to buy it yourself. Highly recommended!
Location was great, no problems during my stay except the wifi sucked. But you’re in Paris, enjoy the city not your phone I guess
The apartment is great. The beds and the sofa bed are super comfortable. There is everything you need and the location is amazing

The value of this place is incredible - real bang for your buck. A great size for a solo traveler or couple, incredible neighborhood, easy check-in/entry, and very communicative host. I extended my trip because I loved it so much!

I am glad to have stumbled on this listing, the location and lodging itself was fantastic. The host operates the property with polite and precise communication which is always a hope when traveling out of the country. As far as the location, there were many fantastic restaurant options for every meal of the day as well as coffee of course. The distance to other great locales is easily walkable. The apartment was kitted out well and left little required when it came to multiple days of a stay. I would be happy to visit again.

Mon Petit Fare was absolutely perfect in every way: style, cleanliness, communication, and location, location, location...everything was wonderful. For sure, it was the coolest airbnb we've stayed in and we couldn't get over how conveniently located it was. Grocery stores, small markets, specialty shops, restaurants, and public transportation seemed only minutes on foot from this location. Our hosts were also incredibly helpful with suggestions for sightseeing, transportation, and food! We simply couldn't have been happier with our stay. If/when we go back to Paris, we will absolutely look into booking here.

Our trip to Paris was better because of this place. Localization was so good , only 3 minutes to metro. There is also many wonderfull bakery and auchan near to apartament. Place was beautifull and u can find there anything u need on short trip. The host was helpfull and responses quickly. Highly recomend.
gilbert is very hospitable. his home is warm, quiet and centrally located. very comfy bed with little patio. he provides all you'll need for a good rest and stay.
A stylishly finished apartment in a superbly well-located quarter of Paris, Alexis' property made for the perfect weekend bolt-hole (despite the snow!).
Great apartment very clean and has two metro stations within 5mins that both run towards the centre. Local market and bakery around the corner

Located in a great neighborhood. Near to plenty of restaurants and shops. The metro is about 4 minutes away. Keep in mind that there are two sets of stairs. Overall, we had a great time and recommend this flat.

Julien was amazing, with fantastic suggestions about the area! From places to eat, to things to do, he provided us with every bit of information we could have wanted. As for the apartment, it was beautiful, and the balcony is a once in a lifetime view! I would highly recommend Julien's place when looking for a stay in Montmartre.

Great stay all around. Very nice, clean and perfectly located apartment. We were able to walk most places from it. Jean-Daniel was proactive and very responsive in communicating with us - and helped make our stay an amazing one. Plus he had some excellent recommendations for food, things to do, etc. Definitely recommend staying here.

Corinne was easy to communicate with and the apartment was incredibly clean (have never seen such clean windows). The apartment is close to two subway stations and on Sunday there was a beautiful food market set up along the street nearby. The check-in was contactless and it was helpful that there was an elevator in the building. Pull-out couch was comfortable. The apartment was equipped with basics like coffee, tea, etc. Would recommend!
Great location! Noisy bar next door, but couldn’t beat the value. Natalie was responsive with requests.
The most beautiful room ever, very close the the metro station. We’ve had an amazing stay 🤩

This was by far the most spacious Airbnb in Paris that I’ve stayed in, especially for the price point. Upon arrival we were greeted by the building manager. It seems as if Edgar Suites manages a few Airbnb properties throughout Paris. Check-in was seamless despite my late arrival after a delayed flight! One of the members traveling with me ran in the Paris Marathon and this apartment was conveniently located for catching the back half of the course. This is also a prime location for those looking to watch a PSG match over at Parc des Princes. It’s less than a 5 min walk.

Very nice apartment well located between a few major metro stations, or alternately within a medium distance walk to all the tourist attractions along the Seine. Cristina was very communicative during our stay, and Bruno was very helpful during our check-in. No complaints, loved everything about the place!
Absolutely fantastic stay! Beautifully decorated Parisian apartment- a very calm and peaceful space. Very clean, excellent communication from Cristina, fantastic location. Thoroughly recommend!

Loved the apartment, everything is nicely updated with quality materials. It is in a great location, close to restaurants, shopping, and tourist attractions. I will look for availability at this apartment the next time I am in Paris!
We really enjoyed our stay at Ana‘s apartment. It was very clean and cozy. The location is perfect! :)
A great place to rent, quiet but centrally located to most places to see with close access to many metro lines . The concierge is super lovely too . Highly recommend.

This flat is perfect! Immaculate and charming with a gorgeous view! Communication was easy and Mirielle’s husband welcomed us to their lovely flat. The location is good for transportation and shopping is on one of the best market streets of Paris.
Great apartment for our stay in Paris! The neighborhood has many options and it was walking distance from the city center. Guillaume was good at communicating throughout our trip.
This is a beautifully furnished, authentic Parisien apartment in a fantastic location just 5 minute walk to The Louvre! We had a great time!

We’ve had an amazing time at Nicolas’ place. It’s situated very conveniently in St. George, a vibrant neighborhood with lots of cute cafes and shops. The apartment itself is very quiet, as it faces a courtyard, and offers everything you need. We hope to come back soon.
Absolutely great location. Very clean. Be aware that a couple of the bedrooms have very steep stairs, making it a challenge for anyone who may need to get up at night,

We had a really nice and comfort stay at Blessing’s lovely apartment. It has an amazing view of the city and nearby are many decent Asian cuisine restaurants located and it takes only 5 minutes’ walk to the metro that takes you to city center. Blessing and Rosemary are really nice people and always willing to help. I’d absolutely recommend this apartment to everyone.

The house is perfect located, it is near to a lot of services like the subway or bus station, it is also near to supermarkets. The house has everything that you need, it’s very clean, and Sophie is awesome. The communication was perfect, Sophie and her friend helped us with everything, giving us some advices on what to do, or where the subway was located. If I return to Paris, I want definitely return here.
Great location. Nice and friendly. One of the showers didn’t work, some of the furniture were broken.
Nice studio in center, very close to les halles. Clean and with towels, shampoo, … Sofabed was not very comfy, normal bed was good.

Really large space for Paris with good security and easy to access. Louardi was very flexible with our late check-in time which we really appreciated. I had no issues with the noise but we slept with the window shut. Wifi worked well as well. We would book again!

We had a wonderful stay at Eric and Laure’s home. The apartment is very large, charming, and very well equipped. It is a warm and welcoming home filled with great art and books. The kitchen has all you could possibly need to prepare a feast. It is an oasis to return to after a day exploring Paris. Numerous bus and metro stations are close by. There is a supermarket, bakery, and pharmacy within a block. The building and neighborhood are very classy. Highly recommended!

The apartment was in a great location and was just what we needed! Perfect for walking or taking the metro anywhere you’d like to go in Paris. Plenty of sun in the space which I appreciated. Marie was quick to respond to messages and we enjoyed our stay!

great host: super friendly and helpful. went the extra mile when we forgot something in the apartment (thanks again!). apartment is really nice and in a good location, and overall a very good deal compared to staying in a hotel.
Francine was so kind, her apartment was beautiful! In a wonderful location, clean, and decorated so lovely. Would love to come back

Everything was good, the apartment is well connected (although for the metro you will need to walk quite a bit). if you are planning to stay for a couple of days in Paris, this is a good spot. Bea was amazing.

The location was great and the communication as well (very welcoming and efficient). However the shower and the sink were clogged. The bed was uncomfortable (even for a sofa bed). There were also some details not on point. If you are not too picky go ahead.

The apartment Is just as others have said, quiet, good location and a responsive host. There are several good restaurants on the same street, a bakery, a pizza place, a Vietnamese sandwich place, and a Korean BBQ. There is a monoprix a few minutes walk away. The metro, line 8, is very close. Most destinations are 15-30 minutes away. The Coulee Verte is less than 5 minutes walk, and it is delightful. I was concerned that there was no clothes dryer, but everything dried quickly on the provided clothes line. Nathalie is an interesting, caring, person, and an excellent host. She’s not just collecting payment, she does want you to enjoy the flat and Paris.

A nice but small appartement equipped with everything that‘s necessary. Great location close to the City Center. Good communication with Julien. Only big disadvantage for us was loud music from the flat below during several nights up to 5 a.m.. Apart from that, totally recommended.

Fantastic place in the heart of Paris. Close to metro stations, you can get anywhere in the city super quick. The location is unbeatable! The apartment itself was clean and brightly decorated, has all the amenities you’d need. Host was easily contactable, super friendly and accommodating. We had the best long weekend in Paris! Fully recommend to anyone interested
Great location but overall the hotel was very basic and dull. Shower wasn’t working properly (fixture broken) and hair dryer only worked for 10 seconds at a time.

Monique and Jean are very accommodating and helpful. They welcome us in their nice and warm home with a friendly and respectful way. We really appreciate them giving us a ride in a train station early in the morning. Highly recommended and all the best for them…..
A superb apartment. Well equipped and very comfortable. Great location on a quiet street. Vitalina is lovely and made sure we were settled in on arrival. Perfect for exploring Paris.
The apartment was spotlessly clean. Very convent to the metro. Well equipped kitchen. A home away from home.
Amazing apartment! The pictures don’t do the view and location justice. What an incredible way to wake up and say goodnight to the city. Going to be hard to beat it.

This was the perfect place for our family to stay while in Paris. It comfortably accommodated all eight of us in lovely decorated rooms with adjoining bathrooms. We thoroughly enjoyed happy hours in the quaint outdoor courtyard in the center of the home. Despite being within a lively neighborhood, the house was very quiet. The home located in the 11th arrondisement is very close to good restaurants, cafes and boulangeries. The Voltaire metro station is a convenient short block away. We would definitely stay there again!
This place is a great little gem. Just a few train stops away from the Eiffel tower. The only problem we had was the neighbors upstairs who can be a bit loud early in the morning.

Wonderful comfortable flat is a great area of Paris. Bedroom window faces a quiet courtyard which was great for a good nights sleep. Nicolas is quick to respond to any questions and easy to work with. There is a small elevator which makes it easy to bring suitcases and bags up to the 4th floor. I would stay here again on my next trip to this beautiful city.
Antoine’s place is great! Close to shops and restaurants and in a less touristy part of the city.
The apartment was very conveniently located near the metro, clean, and with plenty of space for our party of 5.
We had a nice stay! The welcome was warm, location good near a metro station and in a well atmosphered neighborhood.
Fantastic stay! A beautiful and kind family who went above and beyond. They make you feel very comfortable. The space is beautiful and really clean. No complaints.

The area is amazing. we love to go back. and we would ask for the same place. only minus was there is a supermarket across the street and when they get delivery in the middle if the night, you will hear it. but again. the place and the area is great

Great location, daily room cleaning, having a lift (though small) was a bonus, balcony lovely to sit on and watch the world. Only downside is room is very small- no place to put bags apart from on the bed or on the floor and then not be able to move around the room. The photos are accurate, but taken from an angle that makes it appear bigger.
Amazing apartment with everything you need in genuine old Parisian village with great views of Paris, delicious food spots and beautiful parks. Just a short hop from Paris centre.

Muriel is warm, charming, generous and an excellent host! We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is peaceful and quiet, and everything was very clean. Great location, near cafes, shops and metro. The view from the apartment was lovely and we enjoyed the patio a great deal.

Olivier is a great host, really friendly and always help as possible. His place is really comfortable, in a great location and I sure that you will enjoy the stay if you select his place. I will definitely return there sometime.
Amazing, parisienne appartment! Perfect for a weekend stay in Paris. Nation metro is located 5 minutes away from the apartment and has lines that takes you to all parts of the city
I just stayed for 5 days. The flat is very nice, calm, very well located, well equiped including washer and dryer.

Quintessential Parisian apartment of our dreams....every aspect of it was so thoughtfully curated and steeped in history of the wonderful host family dating back generations. Absolutely spectacular, and very spacious. And the neighborhood! What a perfect location for exploring the Latin Quarter and all central, iconic neighborhoods of Paris. Strolling La Seine just minutes away. When we return to Paris, this will be the very first place we seek out. Thank you so much Anne and Jean-Luc for your warm, Parisian hospitality.
This is a wonderful place Catherine our host was great and had great recommendations for us we stayed at many Airbnb's in the past and it's great when your host is so attentive and helpful

Very nice accommodation and a very lovely and helpful host. The neighboorhoud is very nice and you can reach the public transportation within just a few minutes of walking. I would definitly recommend it. 4/5 stars for the checkin due to the fact that the ckeck in was quite late (after 7pm) which can be a bit burdensome as you have to carry your stuff around the whole day if you arrive in the morning. However this was communicated beforehand - nethertheless I would stay here again when I get to Paris the next time.

Hannalore is one of the best Airbnb hosts I’ve ever stayed with. My wife and I stayed at her place for 5 days and really appreciated that Hannalore was kind and laid back but also always eager to be helpful. She gave us tips for enjoying our time in Paris and we definitely enjoyed our trip more because of her and her advice! The location is great because it’s just a few minutes walk from different metro stations so we were able to easily get around on the metro for the entire trip. Thanks Hannalore!

Emmanuel is very friendly. Making sure we are doing good. His apartment is in a great location. Quiet neighborhood. Near to the metro and some great restaurants. View from the balcony is beautiful. Apartment is very clean and has everything that you would need. Would definitely stay again!
Thanks for the stay. The location is perfect for a stay in Paris so close to public transport. The apartment has many amenities. Great choice!

This is a beautiful and elegantly appointed apartment, with enormous windows letting in natural light. Located in a bustling area with many shops and restaurants, yet tucked away amid courtyards, the apartment is very serene and comfortable. Highly recommended.
Highly recommend this location. There were a total of 5 of us and it fit all of our needs. Great location and really enjoyed.

Fabien was an excellent host. Although we didn’t meet him in person, communications went very smoothly. During our stay, Fabian was always available for our questions. We had pleasant conversations via WhatsApp.

We really enjoyed our stay at Eric and Laure’s apartment. It was bright, very spacious, and had everything that business travellers would want (eg, fully equipped kitchen). Wi-Fi worked perfectly for video calls and streaming. The neighbourhood is charming. Highly recommend!

Paul’s space was just what we were looking for after having to make some last minute accommodation changes. Paul was very responsive and super helpful when getting us check in and into the apartment. The place was extremely clean and had everything you would need for your stay. It is also quite spacious, especially being in a hotel room for 3 nights! We were able to find plenty of cafes, bakeries and shopping nearby and it’s location to the Eiffel Tower was wonderful as well. Highly recommend!

Gilbert was such a hospitable and warm host! Although I didn't have the best French, we were still able to communicate well using Google translate and his knowledge of English. His place was beautiful and the room was quite spacious as well. The bathroom, bedroom and common areas were all clean and had great character. Check in was a breeze as he let me in. The biggest plus factor for me was the location. It was right by the beautiful park and just felt very peaceful and an escape from the busy side of Paris. I'd recommend this place to anyone!
Very nice apartment in quiet street in Paris, but still in a lively area. The apartment is clean and comfortable, and suits 5 p easily. Vitaline is very kind and helpful. Recommended!

I highly recommend Kathleen‘s rooms! We felt very welcome and the location of her beautiful flat is perfect for exploring Paris! There are bistros, bakeries and supermarkets nearby and it is a 30 minute walk to Eiffel Tower and 10 minutes to Arc de Triomphe. The two adorable cats were just the icing on the cake! We’d definitely love to come back!

Lovely, quiet and very private room. Has all you need for short to longer stays. It is very well located and you can get anywhere from there by using the metro (5 to 10 min). Julien is very responsive and kind! I was received with a lovely welcome kit and all kind of instructions to make my stay the best (which it was!). I will definitely come back.

A superb monsieur and fantastic host. Easy to communicate with and allowed me to check in early given my commute from overseas. This is in a central location, spitting distance from the Metro (Victor Hugo), but many near by depending on which direction around the city you would like to do. While the fridge seemed small, it was perfect for keeping 2-3 days worth of produce or leftovers. I highly recommend this place for short or long term stays.

The location is fantastic. In Saint Germain neighbourhood, but off if the busy streets and on a quiet street 1/2 black to the main road. There is a FABULOUS bakery, Polaine down the block. A fabulous grocery store around the corner that sells food, drink, household supplies, beauty supplies, fresh squeezed orange juice. There is also a metro stop around the corner. There is great shopping, many luxury boutiques and Louis Vuitton is a 5 minute walk. There are many lovely restaurants in the area. The unit itself is quaint and lovely and great for families with young kids. I had a pre school aged child, a kindergarten partner and a tween and it was perfect for them. The hostess we lovely to communicate with. No issues what so ever. Would stay again. It really does feel like living like a local. 🇫🇷❤️

We had an amazing stay at Denka’s place. Really good location for exploring Paris. The WiFi was great, so I was able to work from the apartment. It was quite at night, despite being on a buzzy road. So clean and great communication. The stairs to the bed might be hard if you have mobility difficulties.

Super location with the Seine river just a short walk away. The local restaurants near the Apartment were very good for breakfast choices and the famous late afternoon Happy Hour. The apartment itself was great. Really bright light during the day time with shutters that will allow you to close out the light if you wish. The washing machine was a nice extra to have in the space. The bed was very comfortable and the big sofa cushion were great to lean up against when you were reading or using your computer.

Fred was an amazing host! The apartment was beautiful, well designed, clean and in an amazing location! Fred was very welcoming and nice and provided some great recommendations! We will definitely come back on our next trip to Paris! One thing to note when in Paris, as the buildings are quite old, sometimes you will hear the noise from the neighbors, so although the bed is very soft and comfortable, something to note if you’re a light sleeper.

Paul did not provide detailed information to check in, leaving us stranded outside the apartment for over an hour. There was no way to contact him and we had to wait for him to call me unexpectedly with the correct info.
Great apartment - it was super comfy and clean! Ana always replied super fast! Absolutely recommendable.
The apartment is as you see it on the the listing. The kitchen, bedroom and bathroom are great. The living room is nice. Wonderful place for short time for two people.
Their two twin beds in a single room are pretty much 1 inch away from each other, so I highly recommend two rooms if you don't plan on sleeping in the same bed as someone else.

The host was great, explained everything to us and helped with everything we needed. The room is small but cozy. The shower in the corner of the room is more for slim figures, stronger figures may have a problem. The toilet is private, it is in the hallway, since the room is on the top floor, it is not very likely that you will meet someone on the way to the toilet. The place is beautiful, a short walk from the Eiffel Tower and invites to nice walks in the historic streets. We will be happy to return.

Jean Daniel's apartment in Paris was fantastic! Lots of room- 3 bedrooms for a family . It is street level so the front room is a little noisy from Paris at night but the other two rooms are quiet. Updated kitchen and bathrooms. JeanDaniel was very friendly and communicative and was there to greet us and show us the property and answer questions and suggestions on things to do in the area. Wonderful stay!

Absolutely beautiful apartment, and deceivingly large; the photos don't do it justice. The location is fantastic too with incredible views, loads of amazing restaurants nearby, and you can easily walk to the key attractions Paris has to offer. The host Sandra is lovely and has excellent communication. Would 100% recommend staying here, especially for a romantic trip away.

Great stay! My family and I met up in Paris, a total of 8 of us, and had a great and comfortable stay. The back patio is lovely and a great place for a family or group to relax. Airbnb is a very short walk to the M4 metro, though the location is just a little bit outside the main Paris attractions, if that’s what you’re interested in. (About 25 -30 mins ride to Latin Quarter, Notre Dame, Louvre, etc…) Jean-François was very kind and communicative with all of us. Highly recommend!
Wonderful appartment - the location is great and the view from the appartment amazing. We felt very welcome and enjoyed spending time there
The location could not have been better for sightseeing in Paris! The space was bigger than we needed, including the basement. We would definitely stay here again!
Amazing location, great Airbnb. Pull out was large and perfect. Very clean! Adrien was so helpful.

I really liked my days here, I felt very welcomed and safe as solo traveler. The room is very well equipped with its own bathroom. You are close to a subway station as well. Breakfast included, delicious! Thanks Cedric and family for everything :)
Very nice apartment. Right near the metro so that was convenient. Stores nearby and places to eat or drink.

I highly recommend this place. Easy walking distance to the metro. It is in a great location, very nice AirBnB. My sister and I were very comfortable in the apartment. Has AC (rare in Paris) and was wonderful as it was unseasonably hot in Paris. You will not be disappointed.

Beautiful apartment. Great location. The apartment is quiet, clean, and well equipped. Safe neighborhood within walking distance to shops restaurants and tourist sites. Jean-Luc is very responsive. He really is a super host! Highly recommend this place. We will definitely stay there again next time we’re in Paris.

Cristina's apartment is lovely and perfect. The apartment is spotlessly clean, comfortable, and feels like home. It's interesting and tastefully decorated. The neighborhood has everything you could wish for and while we walked to many of the museums and iconic buildings and wildly busy areas, it felt great to come home to this charming neighborhood and apartment. We hope to go back and stay much longer.

Wonderful apartment with lots of space and light. 3 bedrooms separated from the living room giving lots of privacy. Very quiet at night because bedrooms are not on the street side. Best neighborhood in Paris with lots of restaurants and stores. We loved it!

I liked the place very much, it was cosy and quiet and had everything what I need. The location was great, close to centre of Montmartre, Sacre Coeur; cafe and supermarket were nearby. I would highly recommend it.
The street noise was annoying, people out on the street at very late hours. Garbage trucks every morning were quite loud. I suppose that is what to expect in Paris.

We had an incredible experience staying at Alexis’ home. The home itself was beautiful and well cared for and the view is breathtaking. But, the best part of the experience was Alexis himself. He was such a thoughtful and helpful host and was always easily reachable. His suggestions and assistance made our first time in Paris better than what we had imagined.

Our host was great and accommodated all of our needs. We were told prior to our stay about what to expect and we’rent left with nasty surprises. It is in a great location with a 2 min walk to the closest metro station and a 5 min walk to the parc de princess (ideal as a football fan) really recommend this place, thank you

Mathieu’s place was clean, comfortable, and convenient. All three bedrooms were spacious and had comfortable beds. The living room was also nicely decorated and had room to fit 6 adults. The apartment was about 1.2 miles from the Eiffel Tower and .2 of a mile to the metro. There was no view of the Eiffel Tower. Mathieu was also very responsive to our questions and was flexible with check in/out. The bathroom situation was a little odd though. There was only 1 full bathroom. There were then 2 other shower “closets”.These showers were small (not even enough room to get changed). There was also another toilet in a “closet” and another sink in the third bedroom. It worked out for us but may be a little more difficult if staying with people you don’t know as well. Overall we enjoyed our stay.

Perfect location in the Montmartre area with amazing cafes, bars and restaurants at the top of the street with the metro a 5min walk away. Apartment is beautiful, perfect for a long weekend. We were met by Vlad who helped us carry out bags up to the apartment and allowed us to keep our bags in the apartment for a few hours after we checked out. I would recommend Alex’s apartment to anyone wanting to visit Paris.

The place is perfect for a single or couple who's looking to be close to restaurants, bars, cafes, and tourist attractions. Julien's communication was wonderful. The flat was clean and had everything we needed.

A high-value studio near Stade Roland Garros, very convienent to watch the tennis games. Less than 10 minutes walk to the stade. Notice that the floor is a bit high (8th floor), and the toilet is shared, the bed is only a sofa. I think suitable if you come only yourself!
The communication exceeded my expectations. Vinicius and Diego responded right away to answer my questions. I would recommend this stay to my friends and family.

Denis is the epitome of a wonderful host! He GENUINELY wants you to have a good experience...from check-in to check-out. His communication was thorough, thoughtful and timely. He was very kind and accommodating when we arrived early and helped us settle in. We love this place AND the LOCATION of this place. Highly recommend!

Great allocation and Airbnb! Beautiful windows and view of the street in Paris. Tony was extremely helpful and kind throughout our entire stay. There are four flights of stairs you have to climb up, but still highly recommend!

This is a lovely, airy apartment in the heart of the Marais. It was great that we could easily walk to the Seine and Notre Dame. Yohann was an excellent host, responding quickly to our messages. The street below can be a bit noisy at times, but we did enjoy hearing the church bells and school children walking by.
This Montmartre apartment offers everything needed for a lovely stay. Quiet at night and we would wake up to bird songs. We would return here if available.

The stay at Adrien’s was so lovely. He’s a great communicator and helped with each aspect of my stay. The apartment was gorgeous and I could not get enough of the view. The location was perfect for walking around Paris all day. I also really enjoyed the surprise towel warmer in the bathroom! Would stay again and would recommend to others.
This is such a charming apartment in a great location in Paris. Close to several metro stops, bistros, and stores. The hosts were very communicative and flexible. Highly recommend.
This flat is in a great neighborhood and is pretty quite ,for Paris,in the evenings. The flat is older but clean and beds were comfortable. Great value local markets are fantastic
Josephine’s appartment was one of the best things about Paris. The location couldn’t be better, a few steps away from Chatelet station. I’ll definetely come back soon. It was all perfect.
Very cool apartment, very clean, everything you need and a perfect communication! We would definitely come back :)

I booked this for my mum and my brother and they thought the place was lovely, very good location, very clean, very comfy beds and that Giovanni was very nice and helpful, giving recommendations for restaurants in the local area and always being contactable if they needed anything, they couldn't have asked for more !

Delphine was a super friendly and helpful host. She was away for the weekend so I got the apartment to myself and it felt like home! Everything was very clean and cozy. We met the Sunday night she came home and I felt totally comfortable sharing the apartment as well!
Very stylish and cosy apartment, super friendly and helpful host, GREAT location. I would always come back!
Ideal location on a beautiful square It’s clean, modern and fresh with everything you’ll need for a delightful stay in Paris. Excellent communication with the owner. Definitely recommend.

I had a super time in this place. Very comfortable. Beautiful decorations. It’s very individual and fully recommended if coming to paris. The hosts were very understanding and helpful. Thank you for everything!

The apartment is in an excellent location -- quiet, but close to public transportation, groceries, shopping, cafes, the Sorbonne, and the Pantheon. The apartment is spacious with bright colors, intriguing art, and all the amenities we could want. My sisters slept in the bedroom, and my daughter and I shared the two sofa beds in the living room. Linens were provided, and the bed and sofas were very comfortable.
Spacious flat. Quiet. Great location. Easy communication with host. We had a great stay!

Alexi’s place is absolutely beautiful and is in the perfect location for touring Paris! Lots of cafes all around, even the world famous Angelina is just a very short walk away! Alexi responded almost immediately anytime we had a question. I would highly recommend this place if you are searching for somewhere to stay in Paris!

Alain's apartment is very comfortable. The presentation fits the reality. We found in the apartment all the necessary to spend a comfortable period in Paris. The apartment is in a very good position, well-served both by Metro/RER and Buses. I very much recommend it, also with a child. 🙂
Location was great, recommendation would be to update linens and the bathrooms had mold in the shower.

Cristina's place is a home away from home. Tucked in a nice quiet street, just right round the corner is EVERYTHING - amazing cafes? restaurants, a supermarket, 2 Metro Stations etc etc. The house is well-kept and very accessible. Also very safe with good WiFi and all sorts of amenities. This is truly a gem

This air bnb was perfect for me and my three friends. It was much bigger than expected and had two full bathrooms! It was around a 20 to 30 minute drive to all the major sites in Paris mostly because of traffic, but I would absolutely stay here again!!
Great location and nice apartment. Short walk from many big tourist locations and restaurants! Anthony is a good host and communicator. Would recommend!
Great location and beautiful apartment that is equipped with everything this family of 5 needed. 2 minute walk to the Metro and RER. Great communication and no issues at all. Would highly recommend.
It’s was a really nice apartment. Super clean and great location. The surroundings where quiet so no noice from traffic etc. The host was super friendly.

Benoit and Eléanore are amazing and kind hosts! They were always quick and kind in answering our questions, and they genuinely care that you gave a great experience with them. I’m especially grateful to them for extending my stay at the last minute due to an illness, even though they were expecting family to visit and use the space. Not everyone would do that for a stranger, and I think it says so many positive things about their character! The space itself is beautiful. The light at sunset and the breeze through the windows make you feel so at peace and comfortable! It’s very clean, with a great kitchen for those who want to have a quiet meal alone now and then. It’s just as amazing as it looks in the photographs! It’s exactly as promised in the descriptions they provide. The next time we come to Paris, this is the first place we’ll look to stay!
The apartment was clean and had lots of room. The location made it convenient to tons of restaurants and shopping locales. This will be a place we would stay again while in Paris.
Great place , Corrine was always quick to answer if I had a problem or a question. Right around the corner is a Boulangerie Lorette. We went there too many times!

Denis’ apartment is a fantastic option if you’re looking for a place to stay in Le Marais. It’s a great location, near to many interesting, historic eateries as well as on of Paris’ best shopping districts. The apartment itself is spacious and comfortable, with a large couch and dining room table, which is rare to find in Paris apartments, especially at this price. Denis was also extremely helpful in orienting us before check in and making sure we had an easy time of it. Hands down my best Airbnb experience to date!
thomas is a lovely host, the apartment is perfect for a solo traveller. great location too :)

Spacious, clean, comfy and with a great location. If you are traveling with a kid - look no further. The apartment is very well equipped: bathroom & kitchen have everything you need. Also, its interior design is very tasteful, you feel like you are truly living in the Marais. If we travel back to Paris and it’s available, we would love to come back.

Amazing flat to stay for your trip to Paris. Great location, only a few minutes walk to the metro station. The apartment itself was very clean with a great decoration. Really cozy. Communication with Hendrik was great, he sent a message before the arrival with all the info needed to access the flat. A good option for your trip to Paris 👍🏼

Frédérique's place is in a great location, with loads of great bars and restaurants nearby and easy accessibility to all the main sites. It's a really nice, spacious, art-filled apartment, quiet and comfortable. I would definitely recommend it.

Password did not work for wifi. I contacted host but he got back to me after I left airbnb. I was there for a week. Location is great but no elevator and it's 4 long levels up steep staircase. Good price though.

Ilana place is immaculate and in a great location. We used the metro for everything, the kitchen was great and there are lovely cafe's around. Ilana's housekeeper Aminatta was super sweet and when we wanted a fan she immediately took care of it for us. I would definitely stay again, highly recommended.
The listing is just what you get! No hidden Bad parts of the of the apartment, the neighborhood the you're a hood the ambiance anything it's just as advertised and even better than that!

The location of this apartment is absolutely amazing! So close to Notre Dame and all the shops on Saint Germaine. The check in process was so easy, both bathrooms look brand new, and the bedrooms had large fans to keep it cool in the evenings. We loved every minute of our stay!

The appartment has a great location, close to Brochant metro station and the restaurants, bars and shops of ave. Clichy. Surprisingly the appartment was created from a shop which opens directly to a street, and because of it, its windows are opaque. Unfortunately there is a bar next door, which guests were extremely noisy until 2 am. The owner, Peggy is absolute correct, kind and communicates really well and gives detailed information. The appartment is comfortable, nice and well equiped.
Hélène and Alain are wonderful, welcoming hosts!! My stay was short but couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Beautiful home in a great location, very cool room and set up😊

Within walking distance of Gare du Nord station and Eurostar no costly taxi needed to get there and with the metro and train nearby to all attractions in Paris and Disneyland it makes it ideal for a base. The apartment is just beautiful and very up to date with a bit of French flair thrown in it has a large sunny balcony a fantastic view to relax or dine on and after a long day sight seeing it was very welcome. There’s a supermarket literally just around the corner that sells everything you could need for your stay from food to suntan lotion. The owner is only a text away if needed and went out of his way to make sure we had everything we needed he also has a restaurant not far away so well worth asking about it on arrival.
This was a great air bnb and very central! It is good for 4 people. We had a good stay!
Great location and everything as described. There’s street noise but we were running the fan so it didn’t bother us. We would stay here again.

Georges is a very helpful host for the entire stay. We locked ourselves outside once and he called the concierge to come help us right away. Though Georges wasn't here himself, he was super responsive to the questions that we had. The people at the apartment were all helpful: the concierge is also a big help to us as he always offers to help with anything. Everything inside the apartment was neat and clean. The ambience in the apartment was calm, cozy, and peaceful because of the paintings and the interior. The location was also convenient to travel around with metro (with a little bit of walking). There's a slight issue on wifi as it doesn't reach the other parts of the house and is only available in the living room which is totally fine . All in all, everything went by perfectly and we couldn't ask for a better apartment and host! We'll definitely recommend this place to others and would come back if we have any chance.

What a fantastic find! Highly recommend you book this flat. The level of service was phenomenal. From the point of booking to checking out the team took care of us. We were met at the apartment and given a tour. The best location ever - steps from the Eiffel Tower and wonderful restaurants. The Italian restaurant next door (veramente ) is so so good and the owners treat you like you’re the most important guests! Don’t miss out !!

There is a lot to do in this area and you can get around quickly to all the main attractions of Paris. Jean-Francois is a gracious host and will offer you recommendations to fully enjoy the neighbourhood!
The AirBnB is in a great location with only a short walk to the Eiffel Tower. The place was cozy and clean. Venus was a nice host with great communication skills.
Love the place and location. Comfortable and clean. Well located, quiet and safe area. Olivier was very respectful and friendly. Hope I’ll be back soon.
Lovely apartment in a great neighbourhood! We especially loved the art in the apartment, the place really has so much character. Vincent was very friendly and responsive.
Great location. Large apartment with beautiful views from 5th floor. Enjoyed our stay with our teenage children.

We had a fabulous stay! It is a great apartment in a wonderful location. It was nice to have a kitchen and a washing machine. It is a very comfortable apartment, and there is no street noise since it is in a courtyard. Jean-Luc is great about communicating. Overall, a great family experience in Paris.
Great location, amazing place! The check in process was not as smooth as expected. Otherwise would definitely come back!
Laurent was very attentive to any of our needs and checked in often to see how we were doing. We had a good experience at her place.

Had a wonderful stay at this Paris flat in the 16th arrondisement. The apartment was really charming with good space for 6 people. It is very centrally located, safe and close to the metro for easy access to the rest of the city, if not in an especially fun neighborhood. The kitchen is a bit cramped so not the best for cooking big meals. Matthieu was an excellent: friendly and responsive. All this for a pretty good price. I would stay here again!

We enjoyed our stay in Ilana’s apartment. Perfect placement near shops, food, train line, and park. Ilana was very helpful and clear in her communication throughout our stay. It was an excellent amount of space for our group of 4 with two school-age kids.
Great place. Some city and construction noise in the morning. Nothing beyond big city living. Louardi was great!
Overall great stay besides that Paris was in the middle of a heat wave. There were two fans but they did not help much.
We had a great stay in Paris at Jean-Luc's place. Very comfortable, stylish, and a great location to explore, all while feeling more a part of the city than if we had stayed in a hotel. Recommended!

Loved my time at Venus’ studio! It’s the perfect size for a solo traveled and has everything you need. It’s a bit tricky climbing up onto the bed, so keep that in mind if you are older or injured. The location is absolutely amazing!!
Excellent location. Good size apartment for four. The problem is that although has two bathrooms, it only has one toilet seat. otherwise, a very charming place.

Perfect for single travelers! The location can't be better. The apartment was fancy and safe. Even though the room was small and old, it had everything I needed. Jordan was a great host, replies fast and was very helpful.
The apartment is very well located, close to a few metro stations. It has a neighbourhood feel. The washer comes in handy for a longer stay. I feel at home in this apartment.

Great location, perfect for our family of four (2 teens), quiet location, easy metro access, lots of local access to cafes, groceries etc. Very clean apartment with great air conditioning, our host provided coffee pods, shopping bag and city map for our convenience. The nice extra touches were convenient USB outlets near beds and couch and hair dryer and large bath towels.
Excellent apartment, ticked all the boxes; location, decor, facilities, cleanliness etc. Our host was very professional and generous with towels, even bathrobes. Will be back!

Not only was the flat clean, cute, great location, comfortable, Marie was an exceptional host! She went above and beyond for me, and I cannot thank her enough for her Parisienne hospitality. She made my stay in Paris so much less stressful due to an emergency situation, and for this I will always be grateful! HUGE thank you to Marie and her friends!
Jean-Luc was very communicative and we appreciated his attentiveness. The apartment is beautiful and in a wonderful location! We appreciated everything about it!
Great place to stay in the middle of Paris, very close to a supermarket and to the Eiffel Tower. Françoise is a very nice host! Would recommend!
The apartment is large. Perfect for 5 people. Very close to the subway, bakery and shop, cafe. I recommend

A darling little house with a sweet, flower filled garden in an amazing neighborhood. The family lives there when not renting it, so if you want a pristine, empty place, this is not for you. But if you like art and books and a true Parisian experience, highly recommended.

What wonderful hosts in a lovely area! Yohann and Helene arranged a beautiful apartment and were so kind to allow us to check in when we arrived. Quick replies to our questions, very helpful welcome guide to the apartment and area (loved Camille and Pierre Hermé food recommendations!) in a fine residential building with interior courtyard on a charming street.

One of the best Airbnbs I’ve stayed in. Modern apartment that retains the charm of Montmartre. I strongly recommend it. Everything went smoothly. Do note that the bed is in a loft/mezzanine under the roof (as advertised), so be prepared to crouch. But the rooftop opening makes it well worth it and adds to the charm. The couch is also very comfortable.

Abel's room is great(especially the Eiffel Tower view!)! This room have a nice location for Metro and Bus stop also safety. There are no lift, so it's hard to go up the stairs, but will get used to it soon. The communication with Abel is very smoothly, he always help you. It may be a little inconvenient because you will be to use the public restroom.

Perfect communication with Harim. Appartement very clean and perfectly situated , very safe area . Everything is close by , bakery, convenient store, pharmacy, stores, restaurants. An amazing stay, we will come back.

We had a wonderful stay at Georges’ apartment which has lot of charm, is beautifully furnished and decorated and is in a very nice neigbourhood. Georges was contacting us during our stay in order to ask if everything was fine which we appreciated greatly. We recommend this place very warmly. It made us feel very much at home!

Avoid this host at all costs. This host stole every article we mistakenly left behind including a Louis Vuitton bag. A mysterious additional charge for $400 was added to my bill for a stain I never saw, nor a receipt that was every produced. The apartment was missing one bed, which made for some awkward sleeping situations. All in all, I would characterize this host as a thief and a fraud. Stay far away if you can.
Perfect location, nice apartment, you have everything you need. Easy access with a code, and in a nice area.

We had a delightful stay at this wonderful apartment. It was super clean, bright, and cheery. The beds were comfortable and the kitchen was fully functional. It is also incredibly well located with easy access to Paris Metro. Most importantly, Mathieu was easy to reach, and very prompt when we had a small issue needing his input. I highly recommend it and hope to be back soon!

Cozy, clean, renovated apartment. Very well located, out of the touristic circuit but very close to metro. Nice neighborhood, perfect if you want to experience how parisians live, without tourists all around. Ilana and her husband are very friendly, helpful hosts. Considering the space and the available beds, I’d recommend this flat for a couple with maximum 2 children. We had a very good time there!
Lovely loft apartment, very spacious and the high ceilings ensured it stayed cool. Lively neighborhood with a diverse immigrant comnunity and tasty bakery around the corner

A beautifully and thoughtfully designed apartment with an unbeatable view of Paris. You can see the Louvre, the obelisk at Concorde, the Grand Palais, and the Eiffel Tower all from the same window. Centrally located and close to a few subway stations, this is a great base for exploring the city.
Perfect location!! , The place is spacious and the host is fantastic.The balcony view is quite charming .

5* ! Location is perfect, apartment is very spacious and very modern vs the majority of Parisian accommodations I have ever stayed at. Emmanuel was very welcoming and accommodating. Will definitely look to stay here again when I next visit in a few months!
Good location with some nice restaurants close by. Perfect for a short city break. As some of the other reviews said, a slight musty smell but it didn’t impact our stay.
Beautiful spot in a lively and fun part of Paris. I was sad to go! Highly recommend.
Great location. Fun neighborhood and the apartment is near a lovely park, fun cafes and two metro stops. The apartment is as advertised.. A great place if you plan to be out and about!

Gilbert's touch at making guest have a nice stay are evident. The baguette in the morning with butter and jam is helpful to get the mind going all while enjoying a cup of coffee. The bedroom is very nice and Gilbert leaves his guest to their own...something appreciated. Great location...felt safe and nice neighborhood; easy access to Gard Nord and East train stations and multiple metro and bus stops.
A lovely and modern apartment in a beautiful, safe, and walkable neighborhood with many nice cafés. We had a great stay. I would recommend this place. I did not feel like a tourist here.

Marie was the best host! Super communicative and flexible with timing, I wasn't sure when I would be able to check in and she went out of her way to make it a smooth process. The spot is perfect walking distance to the Lourve and it's surrounding neighborhoods, and the street itself is a beautiful quiet street. Highly reccomend!

Terrific apartment in an excellent location. The unit was exceptionally clean, quiet, the air conditioning worked great, and overall the amenities - full kitchen, dishwasher, etc. - were fantastic. Perfect for families or anyone who wants to be in a central location in the 9 arr. Adrien was helpful throughout our stay with recommendations and support with logistics. Highly recommend. Would stay again.

Quiet neighborhood, walkable to many things. Public transportation nearby. Checkin with Elias was great. He was prompt, courteous and friendly. He showed me around and explained checkout before leaving. The space was comfortable and it was conveniently located to many things. I would definitely stay again and recommend.
The best Airbnb we have ever experienced! Anne you are an amazing host, you made this short stay an unforgettable experience for us! Thank you!

Great location near the Eiffel Tower and transportation options. Super market a few doors down which made shopping for food a breeze. We had a plumbing issue upon arrival which was handled quickly by Vanessa. Read other reviews and bring silverware as there was only one set of silverware in the kitchen which required us to purchase silverware.
Nice location. You can find easily supermarket, restaurants and so on! There are lovely 2 cats welcoming you~! Kathleen made a booklet to introduce all around the area! Very nice place to stay!

Such a beautiful space. Quietly perched above a lively part of paris. Plenty to do and see, or simply relax and enjoy the city at your leisure. Responsive and helpful with questions and recommendations. Thank you Julien, it was a perfect stay.

Positives: easy check-in process, excellent communication, great location, spacious, clean, great proximity to restaurants, metro, groceries, etc. Cons: no hot water in the upstairs main shower head, no top sheets, burnt out lights in dark downstairs hallway, not enough toilet paper for the duration of our stay, only received one key. A few things to note: 1) I didn't realize when booking the downstairs bedroom has no windows and I wish I would have as it feels a bit gloomy with no daylight or fresh air, 2) it's a commercial space with few windows that open; in the summer with no AC it got quite hot and it would have been so wonderful to open windows to get some fresh air circulating and feel the cool nights breeze.
Loved our stay right in the middle of it all in Paris. A charming, very clean place to come back to after exploring the city. The little terrace for morning coffee was the cherry on top!

Loved our stay here in Paris! The neighborhood is incredible with great cafes, shopping, bars and live music. The stairs are a good little workout after loading up on wine and frites. I’d absolutely stay here again.

We recommend this host. Everything was great, i.e. location, communication, space size, cleaness and supplies (keep windows closed to avoid noise from the streets). Book it fast before you loose the opportunity.

Gorges’ flat was a great home base for our family of four to visit and explore Paris. The apartment is in a beautiful building in a good location with restaurants, shops and access to the metro a short walk away. The layout is good, a large front entry, living room and dining room separated from the bedrooms from a long hallway. The small but very functional kitchen and water closet are off the hallway and the whole apartment gets good light on account of a light well and very large courtyard in the middle of the building. The best part was gorges responsiveness and friendly communications. We never met in person, but he was very responsive and he orchestrated someone to let us in and get situated. We felt well cared for.

Everything about this apartment exceeded our expectations. It is located in a great location (great walking/metro accessibility). The apartment itself was very clean, comfortable, and Jean really made us feel welcomed. He took the time to give us a tour of the apartment, explain amenities/functionalities of items, provided recommendations of things to see/do/eat in Paris that we truly appreciated. Jean was also always available for communication/quick to respond to questions and updates. Our overall experience was wonderful. We would definitely recommend and stay again!

Fantastic location, but extremely loud (even with ear plugs). I am big city girl, who grew up near the subway, and I found the sound level excessive. We stayed for 5 days and the shower broke on the first day. I hear they put in a new one after we left. All said, you can’t beat the price and location. If you can handle lively street noise this place is a winner for you.

We had an amazing stay at this apartment! It is located in a great location - close to a major metro station - with lots of nearby cafes and restaurants. The apartment is beautifully decorated, clean, and cozy, and Denka was very quick to respond to any questions we had!
Alex’s apartment was amazing - a great location and was so cool! And Vladimir was super helpful and nice with our check-in/out.

My stay was absolutely lovely. I felt safe and looked after. They provided me with a delicious breakfast each morning and were so patient with my very beginning grasp of their beautiful language. To top it off they have a.delightful cat.

Absolutely wonderful apartment! The location is perfect. The building is very nice, my daughter and I felt very safe and secure. Even though the area is very lively, the apartment faces the back street and is quiet. Yohann has supplied everything you could need. We really felt like we were staying in a friend’s home. I would definitely recommend Yohann’s apartment and we look forward to coming back.

The apartment ia really nice~ And the host is heavenly kind ~ He's like Budda in Paris~He treats me really really good so i could have a best moment in Paris~ After i moved to hotel than I realized the apartment is heaven~ The place would be the best choice if you want to stay in Paris.

Great place, grate location, train station very close, lots of places to eat, shopping around.. there is a pretty decent pizza place right a cross the street.. I definitely recommend Paul’s place in Paris.
Justin is an attentive and responsive host. We had a very nice stay in the apartment and especially appreciated the space and how cool it was even in the summer!

Great location. It is near to any kind of bars and restaurants, and going on walk to Louvre, or Notre Dame. Very cozzy apartment with al the acomodations for a brief stay. Marie was very helpfull and she have a excelente comunication. I really recomend it!

The view from this apartment was so spectacular! We had a wonderful week staying here. It was the perfect size for two people and the location is really ideal for people who want to prioritize sightseeing.

We LOVED our stay at Maria’s place. It was clean and spacious and beautiful. Better than hotels we have stayed at in Paris before. It was perfectly located as we were running to events at the Louvre and it was only a 6 minute walk. The wifi worked well, the shower is incredible, and the host is wonderful and helpful. We would love to stay here again! It was perfect. Thank you Maria!
Central location 3 mins walk from two Metro Stations. Nice Parisian style apartment. Nightlife can continue till late in near vicinity. Balcony was great to enjoy the street views.
Well decorated and spacious. Amazing location, just a few steps from the metro. Always lively in this area. Stocked with everything we could need. Arianne was responsive and easy to communicate with.

Gilbert is an excellent host, a very warming gentleman who’s always happy to help but allows enough distance to make your stay feel private. We had a late flight but got delayed, arrived really late but no problem. Accommodation all as described and very clean, really liked the private use of the little seated courtyard leading from the bedroom; breakfast every morning, nightcap every night. Very well located, only a few minutes walk to the local bars, restaurants and park but far enough not to be affected by any noise (some places are open until 2am). These places are far cheaper than the central city area and the neighbourhood felt very safe and clean. The metro and bus stops were also very close for exploring the rest of the city. I would definitely recommend staying here and will hopefully return in the future, cheers
Friendly and communicative host, very convenient location and everything you need for a short stay in Paris!
The place is spacious for Paris including all the amenities that one would need. The location is also very good and close to central Paris. Hendrick is very courteous and communicative.

Clean space perfect for 2 guests. A bit of a trek to the main sights in Paris, but using the metro is pretty straightforward. Paul was easy to communicate with and we didn’t have any trouble during our stay.
It was good stay in their apartment! Quickly reply, good location and nice view balcony….etc…. All perfect for me. I highly recommend;-) Thank you so much !

I visited with my partner and we had a wonderful stay at Sofia´s! It's a wonderful place and she a caring host. The Apartment is located close to a Metro station and several bus stops, has a small kitchen and shower. The bedroom has a tiny balcony and opens towards a side street. It can be noisy at nights, as there is a bistro just downstairs. Another positive aspect we found was that the quarter is not as touristic as some others, so there is more classic Parisian lifestyle instead of souvenir shops :)
Amazing! Clean and well located, the bed was extremely comfortable. Fernanda is a perfect host. Definitely stay here.

We cannot fault Muriel's place. It will facilitate the perfect Paris trip. It's location is excellent: close to Nation (metro), bars, cafes, boulangeries, and many Velib (bike) stations. It lets in beautiful light and we enjoyed having meals on the balcony when we decided to eat in. Muriel was warm, quick to respond to communication and gave us excellent local suggestions. Muriel is a wonderful host and this is an excellent AirBnb. Merci beaucoup Muriel!
Came here with my friend for 5 days and was very pleased with our stay. Hugues helped us figure out the metro and told us places to visit. It was a cute studio with the perfect location!

A lovely, sunny apartment in a perfect location in Montmartre. Half a block from Rue des Abbesses, which has dozens of restaurants, boulangeries, markets (and lots more on other streets in the neighborhood as well) and close by Metro stations. The apartment is a very comfortable and pleasant pad to relax in when you need a break from running around town. Marie the manager was very friendly and helpful.

We had a lovely time exploring Paris for the first time, and this apartment made a wonderful home base. Vinicius and Diego were very good communicators, and were even able to accommodate an early check in. The apartment is very well sized for Parisian standards. The bedroom on the loft allows for high ceilings and tall windows which overlook the building courtyard. There was a closet with hangers and a shower/tub with fantastic water pressure. Although the building was in the middle of some construction, Vinicius informed us about this weeks prior to our stay and the roof repair did not burden our holiday in any way. Would recommend to friends!

As fellow super hosts, we have to say we had a fantastic time in this lovely Airbnb! Alexis was very accommodating, answered all our questions and the property was just stunning!! Of note, it is one bedroom, with no walls and a sofa sleeper, but the accommodations were perfect for us. When back in Paris, we would love to stay here again! Thank you

The apartment is absolutely beautiful and the hosts are super friendly. Through the courtyard you are protected from the hustle of the streets and surrounded by beautiful plants and flowers. All neighbors were accommodating and nice and our arrival uncomplicated. In the neighborhood is everything you need and the metro right across the street. If you want to have a really nice time in Paris - this is the place. We hope to come back soon.
A lovely flat in a cool area of Paris. Lots of local good bars and restaurants to choose from with a great vibe on every corner.

A comfortable apartment for a family of five, well equipped. Very close to main attractions by metro, or even by foot. Great market close by, where you can buy groceries and there are plenty options to eat food, too.
Clean, easy, and a great host. This unit is a wonderful and vibrant spot of Paris. Off and away from all of the tourists but close enough to everything. I highly recommend this place.

Staying at Cristina’s place feels like your artistic & stylish friends gave you the keys to their apartment for the weekend. Every detail is well done and adds to the comfort. The location is fantastic, so close to Rue de Bretagne and many, many fantastic restaurants and cafes. The apartment has lots of personal items as it is her family’s residence, in case that is an issue for you. It wasn’t for us. We had plenty of space for our things and much preferred it to a sterile hotel or rental. Would love to stay here again in the future.

The location was amazing, if one needs to be centrally located. Unfortunately the noise from the street throughout the night is quite a lot, as it is a ground floor studio. One just needs to be mindful of the noise.

Jean -Philippe was the most kind host. The studio is located in a very central and easily accessible part of Paris. The studio apartment is cozy and has stunning views of the city. We enjoyed our stay!

Paul was a great host and his apartment was fantastic! The location is super close to all the attractions and great restaurants. We were worried it would be really hot as the temp got to 38 degrees Celsius but the apartment was really naturally cool and the fan was all we needed. Highly recommend staying here!

The hotel staff are very friendly and welcoming. My room was clean and well prepared. The location of the hotel is very convenient for going to tourist sites. Around the hotel, there are many delicious and diverse restaurants that you can choose.

Can't beat this location! How wonderful to be staying on an island in the middle of the Seine! Close to everything with excellent bars and restaurants on the doorstep and Metro either side of the island. Apartment is very homely, comfortable and welcoming with afternoon (summer) sun pouring through the big windows - a lovely place to relax after a hard day of walking and tourist activities! Seriously lovely.

Hélène is a very nice host and the location is perfect if you want to go to the AccorArena for an event. The neighborhood is pleasant, too. (Although I would not recommend the room in midsummer because its getting very hot up there.)
Mariana set up the place beautifully and was such a wonderful host. She made sure we had everything we needed and set up the sofa bed before we got there!
