Since our flight was in evening Chocri let us stay longer and make a late checkout. I would recommend this lovely apartment to any couple looking for a romantic vacation in Paris!

Beautiful apartment with all amenities in one of the best neighborhoods in Paris. Marie is one of the kindest people I have met in Paris. She did everything possible to ensure that I am comfortable and I feel like home in the apartment. She was always available to answer questions or to provide assistance with something I needed. Noone could wish for a better host. I will gladly stay in this apartment when I am in Paris again.

Lovely unique place with personalized touches and a beautiful view in a fun neighbourhood. Benoit was very on top of communication and provided very useful information. Thank you for allowing us to stay at your place :)

Sophie's apartment is fantastic, an excellent place to stay for a short or extended visit to Paris. The apartment is clean, spacious and in a very good location. It's a short walk to the Terne metro station and not too far from a number of good restaurants, shopping and bars. Sophie is an excellent host, checking in and out was very easy and she was always available to any questions or help with any issues that came up. Overall I would highly recommend this listing.

We spend 3 days in this cute apartment. Good location, close to the restaurant area and the famous Sacre Cour is 2 minutes walking. Very well ventilated - 2 big windows - the place have everything for make you feels welcome. The bed is super conformable. No lift, but we don't mind the cardio moment on the stairs =) We cook breakfast every morning with french delicious things from the store right in the front of the building. Lunch on different areas and dinner was on the Rue des Abbesses, so many good choices... We meet Yann on our way out, very nice guy. We highly recommend his flat for your stay in Paris.
5 starts appartment. BRAND NEW and equipped with everything you may need. Centraly located close to public transportation. Very friendly and welcoming host.

It was a very cute little apartment with the best location. Also can easily find nice place to eat just downstairs! Specially recommend the small Vietnam restaurant on the rue malar:) the host was very kind and helpful.

My friends and I stayed at Francois' apartments in Paris during the weekend of the Terrorist Attacks. This was a very chaotic weekend to be in Paris and Francois was absolutely amazing with us: he kept checking in to ensure we were safe, he even proposed that we could stay one day longer if need be, and just made the whole stay better than we could have expected given the situation On top of that, the apartments were absolutely great and clean. Thank you very much Francois! Recommended

Pascal is a friendly and accommodating host. The apartment is very nice and has a great view. The only downside is that the immediate area around the apartment is not that great. However, it is less than a 5 minute walk to the nearest metro station. Great value for the price.

Yohann was very friendly and accommodate us nice and quickly. It was a very clean, modern place with many restaurants and pubs nearby. Highly recommended for friends/families travelling the beautiful city!

Chokri was incredibly welcoming. We text once we arrived and straight away Chokri replied with instructions on how to get to the apartment by metro/train. When we got to the apartment which is literally a 2 minute walk from the metro we were welcomed by Chokri who carried our bags to the room. Once we got inside he ran through everything we might need including the best direction to head in for shops/restaurants/galleries. He made sure everything was in working order and that we were totally comfortable before he left. The apartment itself had everything you need; a fully functional kitchen, as well as a hair drier, iron, towels etc.... While it is small, I didn't feel like I needed any more space. I unfortunately fell sick while there so ended up being stuck in doors for a while but found it comfortable with a box of DVDs and plenty of heat. I would highly recommend it for both location and apartment.

We were five girls. The place was really clean and very close to the Eiffel tower as well as a bus stop and 5 mins walk for a metro station, Invalides. The spot was very safe. And François stayed in touch with us all through our stay. I would definitely recommend it and will stay there again if I went to Paris. Thanks François.

Beautiful apartment in a great neighborhood in Paris. Very easy to travel around using the metro. 3 different metro lines are very close to the apartment. We enjoyed the stay very well and the host on our arrival was very accommodating. Best restaurant we went to is on the bottom floor called Le Patio, must try the Pizza there :)

Mai was a superb host and me and my wife really enjoyed our stay. Mai was very flexible and got up at 7am to let us in. The apartment was in a great location in a lovely local area with some amazing places to eat and buy food. The apartment was warm, clean and had everything we needed. An excellent host and thank you very much, Mai. Definitely recommend to anyone visiting Paris.

We were two families staying at François' accommodation for four nights. Everything was just perfect - great location (very close to the Sacre Coeur, Moulin Rouge, public transportation and lots of good shops and restaurants), very comfortable, cozy, well equipped and quiet apartments (exactly as described), François was very kind and helpful. Our flight arrived early in the morning and Francois offered us to come to the apartment at 7am despite the fact that the time of check in is only at 1pm (free of charge). It was very nice of him and really helped us. Thank you very much, Francois. Also thanks to Sue.
The host was very kind and diligent. Location was great, but a little noisy at night, except for that, everything was perfect!

The listing was entirely accurate and the apartment was ideally suited within close walking distance of all the art galleries and Sacre Coeur on Montmartre. A quiet street made for a secure and safe comfortable place to stay. Catherine welcomed us on arrival, gave us a grand tour and was always helpful in answering further questions. This is a wonderful Airbnb.

Alexandra's lovely apartment is located close to the metro and in walking-distance to Place de la République and to many other sights. The surrounding area has lots of restaurants, bakeries, cafes etc. The charming and well decorated apartment had everything we needed like towels, hairdryer etc. and the kitchen is fully equipped. The apartment has a good size and is spotlessly clean.The beds are super comfy. Communicating with Alexandra was convenient and efficient. We had a wonderful stay and will certainly recommend friends to stay there if they visit Paris.

Unfortunately I could not visit Paris because of some personal problems at the last minute. However, my host Agnes was very helpful. She constantly reminded me of my travel dates and gave me detailed descriptions of the address. When I travel for the next time, I would definitely like to choose her again.

Wonderful flat, stylish and well equipped. The situation is amazing with a view that is just great. Everything was simple including the reception of the keys and the handover. An address I will return back to.

Check in was a breeze. Whilst Celine wasn't there to great us, she arranged for a smooth check in anyway. The apartment was beautiful and suited the 4 of us quite well. The view was very French and listening to the church bells was a real treat. There are many good supermarkets close by and walking distance to a metro.

Marina's apartment was simple and perfect for our stay. It was conveniently located near the metro and in such a wonderful neighborhood of paris to walk around. Marina as a host is very nice, helpful and readily available. We felt comfortable in her home.
It was a nice stay at Paris :) The appartement was as nice as on the pictures. Thank you very much Isabelle that we had such a nice stay at Paris

Sara's apartment was perfect. It's clean, comfortable (at least for a solo traveler or a couple), easy check-in/check-out and in an amazing location - you can just walk to Le Marais, Republique, Bastille and Canal St-Martin. Metro stations, cafés and a supermarket are nearby, too. We definitely recommend her place to anyone visiting Paris!

Mandana place was lovely and she very kindly left us a few treats for our arrival. the area was great and we were big fans of the local organic shop and the market. A really perfect spot if you want to see all of Paris.
Great location, beautifully decorated and we received some great local tips from our host. The perfect, cozy apartment to explore Paris from.
Mirelle is a great hoste. She arranged well the keys pick up. Her place is clean and nice as the pictures. Convenient, close to several stores and the mtr. I would definitely recommend her place.
As per my last review, Chokri is an excellent host. We had no problems. I am very happy
Our stay at Nicola's appartment was great. The flat is lovely, it looks exactly like on the pictures and we had everything we needed. Nicolas was also very responsive. Thanks a lot !!
Do not hesitate to stay at Natsumi's appartment, it's very cosy, central and well organized ! she's really nice and will help you settle down perfectly ! A perfect stay ! Many thanks !

Ana was very attentive and communicative prior arrival, as well as flexible with our check-in and check-out times. The apartment is nice, simple and was very clean. Nation is a good spot with surprisingly nice restaurants and facilities around, and a very good public transportation hub. It is not as nice as other quarters but not as busy either! Couple of buts are that we only got information (including the door code) half an hour prior check-in time and that the bathtub had no plug (we bought one), since the shower cable was not long enough for me (189cm). We had a nice time at the apartment and enjoyed Ana´s hospitality and our time in Paris.
5 stars! Had a great experience, and Benoit was quite helpful and responsive. Great neighborhood and view as advertized!

Aurielle was lovely and went through every detail about the apartment. Listing description was very accurate, we thought the place was actually bigger than the photos show! Very close to public transport and bars, restaurants.

This apartment was right the smack of all the shopping districts! The louvre is right opposite, rue de Saint honore was behind, and there are so many restaurants around too. The house was spacious and immaculately clean with amazing showers and comfortable bed! I would recommend this to my friends and also would to anyone who's looking for a perfect location!

This is a fantastic apartment in a great central location! The apartment looks true to the pictures- it is very clean, modern and spacious and we loved everything about it! It is a few minutes walk from the station and surrounded by numerous bars and restaurants. It can get a bit noisy in the evenings, but with Windows and shutters down it isn't too disturbing. We were able to walk to many locations including the Lourve, Notre Dame and Saint Germain within 10-15 minutes. Jean and Bernadette were great and always responded promptly to any questions and requests. We would love to return to stay in their place in the future!

We really enjoyed our time here. Not only was it very comfortable but Emmanuel offered suggestions for restaurants, how to travel to different points of interest and helped us make the most of each day of sight-seeing.

The flat is quite nice. Its location is almost perfect. The Metro-station and supermarkets are about 5 minutes away and you can get to many sights (Louvre, Opera, Sacre Coeur/Montmartre, Centre Pompidou) in 20-30 minutes by feet. The flat itself is kinda cute and perfect for a short stay, if you're supposed to spend your days in the city. It was clean, and beside the noises the bed makes, when you turn over, there's absolutly nothing to complain about. The communication with the host was on a very friendly level and worked smoothly.
The appartement is as described: small, but at a good location. However there is a night club downstairs so it's pretty noisy during the night. We had to use ear plugs:(

When we arrived, Alexis had an assistant who explained the details of the apartment. Some of the mechanical are difficult for me since I'm a baby boomer, but this was a wonderful apartment close to all the attractions, restaurants, shops, museums, etc. We loved it, and my children told me it was a "home away from home". I highly recommend future renters to use this apartment. Alexis was very prompt whenever we had questions, and we would definitely stay there again in a heart beat!

Nathalie's flat was fantastic for my parents to stay for a week. It has a nice living area which has a lot of light and a nice bedroom as well. It's in a interesting part of Paris, with the flowered promenade, the Bastille and the famous Marche D'Aligre food market within walking distance. It also is very close to many transport options to take you everywhere in the city. The shower room is indeed very small but posed no problem. Thanks Nathalie!!
Perfect location to explore Paris on foot. Apartment quirky, basic and just what is needed for a short stay in Paris. We all had a fab time and Francois is a great host.
The flat was great! Small but with all you need for short stays. Julien was super helpful with all we need for the stay! We will totally come back!

The apartment was perfect for our quick visit to Paris and located in a great area with wonderful patisserie and other great shops just outside. The view from the small deck is really nice and the weather was good enough that we had dinner on there one night. I would absolutely stay there again.

We could not have asked for a better host or a better flat, thank you Nicolas. Perfect location for our needs and easy walk to everything we needed or wanted. If a repeat customer is the best rating, you have that from us Nicolas and we will do it again if you're not booked on next trip there.

Thierry met our family and showed us around the apartment. He took the time to show us the neighborhood and followed up with us on ideas for us for the week. The apartment was centrally located and perfect for our family. Quiet building inside yet neighborhood is quiet busy.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Emmanuel's apartment. Although we didn't meet him , Estelle was there to greet us and show us around. Communication with both Emmanuel and Estelle was excellent and the apartment was exactly as it appears in the photographs. The apartment is very well equipped and full of light. Emmanuel left a bottle of wine in the fridge for us - a nice welcome treat. Location is great & it is quiet at night- close to the Metro, many small grocery stores and Canal St. Martin. On the warmer days we enjoyed the terrasse. I hope we can return to stay another time. :)
We had a great time in this appartment that is close to a lot if interesting places ranging from culture and good restaurants. The welcome was great and we got good information.

We had a great experience at this apartment in Paris! We walked everywhere (at least 10 miles a day) so we were so happy to be located in the area. We felt like we were in such a great local spot and close to everything.

We had a fantastic stay here. Clarisse is attentive and speaks English and French; the apartment is lovely (and just as pictured). This is a great neighborhood for anyone who wants a less touristy area. It's a quick walk to the key train ride. (If you're a foodie, you'll probably dine largely in other areas.) All in all, one of my favorite places I've stayed with AirBNB.

I had great time in Luka's house. It was very clean, neat and cosy house!! All beddings and kitchen ware was perfect. Lights in the all room was also very good. At night it made me very comfortable mind, so I can take care of my tired body. Luka's house is next to Louvre museum. I think Louvre is center of paris. So it was very easy to use transportation. Many station(including metro, bus, train) is close at Luka's house, and I can go anywhere in paris sights at walking distance. + Luka's house is much better than picture :-) Just visit!

It was lovley! Alexandre was very informativ and a fast responder! The Place was at a good location and we could easiley take the metro to go turisting around paris! The apartment was smal but big enough for the two of us! very charming Place and very cosy with the rufe bed! The only downside with the apartment was that it was a Little bit smokey in the begining but after we opned a window it was fine :) We could definitivt come back and rent this apartment again!

We were very satisfied with the apartment: it was reasonably priced; it was equipped with everything we needed; it was well located; Francois was there to explain everything we needed to know about the facility and he made us feel welcome. We would stay there again and would recommend Franco's apartment to others.
Julien is a brilliant host and welcomes me warmly. The room is very nice, cosy and clean. It was a nice stay, thanks a lot!

The listing description was very accurate and the pictures are exactly as experienced. This was the perfect location for our visit to Paris. I would recommend this location! It was perfect for the four of us and we really enjoyed our stay. Very safe and secure and clean, with all the comforts of home! The market on the main floor was also very convenient. We were warmly greeted upon our arrival and given a tour of the unit. A perfect place to stay.

Our stay at Luka and Adrien's place was nothing short of AMAZING. Luka was a saint - He was waiting at the apartment to greet us even though we arrived 8 hours after our planned arrival. The apartment far exceeded our expectations. The decor was wonderful. The mattresses were devine as were the linens. The kitchen was very well equipped - the cappuccino maker was a nice surprise. The apartment is VERY WELL located, with so much nearby. All the sites were within walking distance. The area is also filled with great places to dine and shop. Without any reservation or hesitation we highly recommend a stay at this fabulous apartment!!

We loved this place! It is spacious, clean, comfortable and in a great location. Walking distance to plenty of good restaurants, bars, cafes, and a lovely wine and cheese shop at the end of the street. The metro is also a block away so easy access to the entire city. Jean-Francois was a gracious host and always quick with any communication. He welcomed us kindly, gave us local recommendations, and even made us a dinner reservation and a great little restaurant nearby! Highly recommend and would come stay here again in a second. Thanks Jean!
It is a great place! Quiet, clean and so friendly. Olivier gave me a warm welcome. I enjoyed staying there. He was helpful and open. Thank you!

We had the greatest time in Paris and we stayed at the perfect location. Jean-Francois was awesome in helping us with any questions we had regarding our stay in Paris. He welcomed us at the apartment and even assisted in lugging our suitcases up the stairs. The apartment as in a great location and very near bus and metro stops. You could go in any direction and find lots of great restaurants and bars. Very near Moulin Rouge and Montmarte. Loved sitting on the balcony in the evening enjoying a beer and loved having the convience of an entire apartment for our stay. You'll get lots of excercise climbing the stairs each day, but we loved the feeling of living in Paris for a week. Thanks Jean-Francois!

Well located flat with a vey nice terrace in a quiet street. The living room and the kitchen are luminous and spacious. The flat is equipped with modern appliances and the WiFi works really fine. Nice bedroom and large bathroom. The perfect place for a romantic escapade in Paris. The metro station is nearby and the Saint Martin Canal just at the corner of the Street with its typical Parisian bistros. Fine experience, the owner is very professional and has everything well organized, he even left us a nice bottle of wine as a welcoming present. A strong recommendation.

I really enjoied our stay at Ana! The appartment has a very good location, it is modern, clean and nicely decorated. I recommend Ana's place! The only thing is that it doesn't have 'blind' curtains to keep the sun away in the morning :p

The apartment is wonderfully decorated and very well-equipped, I have zero complaints. None whatsoever. Great bathroom, even better bedroom, perfect kitchen/living room. Very friendly and attentive host. A great experience.

The apartment was perfect for 2 people, exactly as depicted in the photos. Very clean, well-equipped, and very nice French balcony doors that open fully from the living room and bedroom. Nice view of the street below, fairly quiet, and it was great that there were markets and stores close by for wine, cheese, fresh bread, fruit and other necessities.

The host was very welcoming and met us at the apartment after we followed his very accurate directions. The main feature of this place was the location as it was a 5 minute walk to the eiffel tower, whilst also being withing walking distance in the opposite direction to the champs-elysses, and within a 5 minute walk of the nearest metro station also. The apartment itself was clean but also quite small. The loft (where one double-bed is situated) has a very low ceiling so not great for tall people, plus the stairs leading up to it are very narrow. Unfortunately the only bathroom is upstairs so you will have a challenge if you need to go during the night.

This is a nice apartment, very small bathroom, good location. Nice view of rooftops, not a view of streets though. We did not meet the hosts, they were very accommodating. Even when we forgot the code to get in late at night, had to call them,they were very nice.
Unique apartment in great location. Host was wonderful. Walk up 5 flights of stairs a little tiring but doable, even at end of day.

we loved our apartment and stay with marina,we will be back for sure, marina is lovely,The area is perfect to visit and absorb into pariessenne life,close to two metros,they are equal distance either direction from the appt. so easy to get around on the metro. there are numerous restaurants, shops and brasseries around,perfect to experience french life.

Mary was a very warm and welcoming hostess. The apartment was the perfect size for the three of us and we loved it. Everything was in great condition. Wonderful location- only a block from Odeon metro and numerous resturants, bakeries and shops. Apartment was simply adorable and decorated beautifully. My only issue was the five flights of stairs- I thought I was in better shape than I really am as climbing up those at the end of a long day of walking through Paris was exhausting! I highly recommend this apartment and Mary. She checked in with us throughout our trip to make sure everything was ok.

It was really nice! Francois prepared us with a lot of information about the arrival, appartement and the neighbourhood before our stay. During our stay everything worked fine - the appartement has everything you need and is well equipped. When help was needed Francois responded within minutes. Finally, the area around the appartement is just perfect - probably one of the most beautiful districts of Paris. If you leave the appartement you are immediately enjoying the typical french way of life with a lot of excellent restaurants, bars, coffes and shops.

Marina is a great host - very friendly, helpful and understanding when I requested to make some changes to my plans! (Thank you Marina!) It was lovely to stay in her apartment for the week. It is spacious and comfortable and in a fantastic location.
Everything is perfect expect one neighbor put VERY loud rock music at 3am to 5am at the second night which made us cant sleep at all.
My best Airbnb experience !!Isabelle is nice and warm-heart,she's house is lovely and convenient ,definitely recommend !!

Jean met us at the apartment when we arrived. The apartment was just as described and absolutely beautiful! The apartment sits above a busy, noisy restaurant area. While you can hear much noise in the evening, we had no problems sleeping through it--and we were there during Eurocup! It is very close to the Metro station and many areas of Paris are easily walkable. We felt safe day and night in the area. We would definitely stay at Jean and Bernadettes if we were to return.

Great Host show us all the nieghborhood when we arrive! The apartment was terriffic al is new and is so near a lot of museums, eiffel tour and invalides. It has 3 metro stations near and a lot of restaurants, crepes and boulangeries that make your stay really comfortable.

You could not ask for a more perfect host than Denis. We arrived in Paris by train and Denis happened to be catching a train out a little later so he meet us at the train station, provided us with tickets for the metro and gave us directions on how to get to the apartment where his friend meet us. He was also always very responsive before and during our stay. The apartment is exactly as described and looks in the pictures. It is in a perfect location to explore Paris with only a very short walk to the St Paul metro stop and is surrounded by restaurants and shops. I would highly recommend this apartment and would gladly stay and book again with Denis.

The house is quite wonderful. It's convenient to Montmartre and in a busy tourist district, but the house itself is quiet due to being inside a courtyard. The courtyard space is very pleasant; it's a nice contrast from urban Paris right outside. The house is rather small, but convenient and pretty. It includes the amenities you expect. If you sleep in the downstairs bedroom, it can be a little annoying climbing two flights to the bathroom, but this is minor. The kitchen is serviceable but very small. The cats are cute.
She was really nice. I had little problem to find the apartment but the room was clean and nice

Sweet little one room flat with a lovely view of the Eiffel Tower, perfect pied a terre for one, or for two happy to share a smallish double bed. In a quiet residential area with plenty of shops, restaurants and transport possibilities. Serious black out shutters make for a good night's sleep, and host welcoming and helpful. Late check out time was a particular bonus for us. Thank you Wolfwolf!

A small yet charming and clean apartment on a quiet and peaceful street minutes from the Porte De Versaille metro station. Sheraaz was quick to respond when we arrived and her mother was very helpful in showing the apartment around. It was a very comfortable stay and would recommend to anyone looking for a quiet and cozy place to stay.

Absolutely nothing to complain about, everything was as advertised. Thomas was there in person to show us around, literally waiting for us at the door. Apartment is as advertised, fully equipped, and the location is great with many bars and public transportation within walking distance. Recommended.

Had a very pleasant stay at Ben's apartment. Nice location with good metro access, and not too far of a walk from shops and restaurants. Ben was an excellent communicator and made sure that I had everything I needed. He was kind enough to meet me at the train station upon my arrival and walk me to the apartment. First floor access was great, and I felt very safe.

Marina is a lovely & warm host, and constantly kept us updated before and during our stay there. The room we stayed in was comfortable with a very cozy bed. There is also a separate kitchen containing utensils, groceries etc. to get you started and a bathroom. There are very good connection to the metro and a bakery downstairs just made our mornings !! The only thing that would have made our stay even better would have been if there were thick dark curtains / shades on the windows which would have blocked much of the light. Overall a lovely stay in Paris and we hope to be back again :)

The apartment is a lovely private studio in the Montmartre area which is a really great part of Paris with a lot of restaurants, shops, bars right nearby. It's also only a couple minutes from a metro stop for getting to central destinations throughout Paris. I had no trouble getting into the apartment using Yann's instructions and Yann was flexible and responded quickly regarding arrival and departure time. Would highly recommend!

My friend and I had a great time at Sarah's studio! It was very clean, bright, and in a great location (the metro is right outside of the front door) with nice and affordable cafes. Sarah was very welcoming and flexible about the check in time, which I really appreciated.

We stayed with our family of 5 and had a great time. The apartment is compact for 5 people but had all the facilities you would need. There is a major train station close by and restaurants, bakery and supermarket within walking distance. Communication was excellent and Clarisse was great to deal with.
The appartment is very good in location, it's very new and harmful, nice place to go. Really enjoy the stay in Paris

The apartment is small with steep and narrow stairs, but very good location and has everything you need. Like other reviewers have mentioned, the bathroom location is rather unique. The apartment in general looks a bit run down, but clean. Would stay there again if we want to be near Eiffle Tower.

The check-in and check-out was very smooth. The host is amazing and very accommodating. She responds timely to messages and inquiries. The apartment was clean except there were some tiny bugs in the bathroom. I'm not sure about the other tenants in the building. I wouldn't leave my luggage unattended for one second in that building.

This was my second stay in the room. It is conveniently located next to 3 metro stations (Alexandre Dumas, Charonne and especially Nation), buses and in a dynamic neighborhood. The room is clean, well arranged and is equipped with a nice big shower. Sophie and Joan are a great couple. They are very friendly and always made sure that I had everything I needed. It was a great experience!

We experienced a wonderful trip to Paris staying at Jean & Bernadette apartment. It is perfectly located at the heart of the city and it has great functionality and amenities to make the stay amazing.

The location of this place is amazing. The amenities are top notch. It has the best sleeper sofa I have ever slept on- you'd never know it was a pull out couch. The place is gorgeous and we appreciated the stocked wine fridge after a long day of travel. We will certainly stay here again and would recommend it to anyone!

Great place, close to Effiel Tower, very safe and friendly neighborhood with good places to eat and very close to the metro station. Awesome host, took us around the area to get a good idea of where we were, showed us places to eat and the metro. Would recommend staying here while in Paris, great experience!
Was very close to the city center and all the places we wanted to visit. Easy to get Uber from this location and was a great place!

The apartment was great for us. I was with my twin teenage daughters and we were very comfortable. The location is pretty festive and happening, as well, but served as an excellent base from which to explore Paris. The AC worked well, which also was important. Very comfortable!

This was our first experience with Air BnB. Once we arrived to the apartment we were warmly welcomed. We really appreciate how he took us around the area and recommended places to buy food/to eat out, things to do/see. He was very thorough, professional but at the same time very friendly. when we come back to Paris we will certainly be staying under your host again, we had a wonderful time! Thank you for making our stay so special.

This apartment had everything we needed for us and our teenagers. Amanda is a great host. Short walk to metro and then a few stops into the centre. Great fresh fruit and veg market on street, yummy poulet roti.

Monique communicated very well before arriving and her daughter graciously greeted us upon our arrival. Very comfortable and clean apartment containing everything essential to us. The quiet neighborhood with it's own cafes was nice after being a tourist all day. And very convenient to be right in front of Metro Vaugirard. We liked the close by boulangerie, and Carrefour market to pack for our day trips. The available bikes were a nice touch, we hope to come back to Paris and we would gladly stay here again. Next time we'll make more use of the bikes, Paris is surprisingly a very bike-able city, and nice that the host recognizes this.

This is really an amazing apartment! Super central location, close to Canal St. Martin as well as Marais and easy to reach by public transport. The apartment was very modern and spacious, beautifully decorated. Three comfortable bedrooms and two bathrooms, and a nice livingroom (which can be turned into additional sofa beds). We used it during a business trip, and the apartment was perfect for that with large enough separate "private space" for three people. And upon entering a nice bottle of red wine was waiting for us, so literally a warm welcome!

This place is amazing and Alexandre was a great host! He gave us recommendations for awesome places to walk around and look at as well as areas to eat during our trip. He also had specific recommendations for restaurants/bakeries that were nearby. Also, he was very responsive and very caring to the quality of our stay and made sure we had everything we need. Also great was that along the street were many really cool and had many places to eat, drink, and grab delicious pastries and espresso for a cheap price.
Probably the best city-centre Airbnb I've stayed in. Brilliant location, lovely apartment, responsive and very accommodating host. Can't fault it in any way. Would highly recommend.

The host made me feel comfortable as they possibly could they provided towels, wi-fi passcode and directions to complete my objectives. The apartment was very clean and a great location. I think this location is ideal to visit Paris its in walking distance from the metro with plenty of restaurant options close by. Rita was very accomodating with our early arrival and late check out. Thank you very much for a great stay!

All I have to say is, simply amazing. This is my first time using Airbnb and it was truly an amazing experience. The house is clean, and all the things that Sarah stated in the website were there. But I found it hard to find the place as the address is a bit confusing. Sarah is very attentive whenever we need help. I will most definitely return back to this beautiful home whenever I'm back in Paris. This stay recommended by my friend, Liz and Amin.
Love the area, love the house. An oasis of calm in a fun neighbourhood. We walked everywhere and didn't need the metro at all.

Kathleen was an amazing host! So welcoming, gracious, and willing to do anything to make sure that I was as comfortable as possible. The room was perfect--it was exactly as pictured--and I could not have asked for a better place to spend the summer. I highly recommend Kathleen as a host to anyone visiting Paris!

Such a great place to stay! Fantastic location, a beautiful apartment and Alexis is a great host. Really great communication and went over and above what you would expect. On arrival we had a full tour of the apartment with instructions on how everything worked, which was great as there is a plethora of high-end equipment. Would happily recommend this to anyone looking for a chilled out place to stay in a lovely area. We'll definitely be back next time we're in Paris!

the house is really clean and is correctly discribed.Francois is really helpful and i arrived at a really late time but he is still there to help me. And the location is really awesome that we can enjoy the night view of Paris and walk back safely.I recommend this house very much!

Our stay at George and Silvie's appartment in late August was great. George arranged for us to be welcomed at the appartment and provides a nice booklet explaining all practicalities for the appartment. The appartment was beautiful, very clean and well taken care off. It is located just near two metro stations (sentier and bonne nouvelle) and near many restaurants and shops. It is also in walking distance to centre Pompidou, Ile de la cite and les halles - for those who want to shop. Only low point: If you come in summer expect it to be hot ;)

Most wonderful and safe location we could have chosen in Paris! Luca also sends over an intro PDF which was very helpful. It was in walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go or a very quick metro ride. There were a ton of restaurants, cafes, bars within a 5 minute walk. There is also a grocery store within 2 blocks. The apartment was very clean, both bedrooms were spacious. The bathrooms were very new and showers had wonderful pressure. The kitchen had everything in case you needed to cook- we went out each afternoon/night. Would highly recommend for another stay in Paris with a friend!
Kathleen was a great host. She was friendly and helpful but you still get plenty of privacy during the stay. I had a great time in paris. It was so perfect for me.

We had a great stay at Gilbert's place. He is a very kind and friendly host. The room is situated at the garden of the building so it's really quiet. We slept very well. Everything you need is there. Just around the corner is a beautiful park. We'll come back for sure!
We loved this apartment! François was very helpful and gave us clear instructions. I would definitely stay here again! Being in walking distance to everything was so great, too.
Greeted warmly, very nice area, walking distance to metro and dining establishments! Super comfortable and we felt very welcomed.

We feel very happy for our stay in Mireille's apartment & very appreciate her warmly hospitality! Mireille responded to my requests & questions in a short time every time, we feel very reliable and helpful! We were arrival late on the first day, however she were waiting for us with a nice breakfast & warmly welcome! Moreover, she went with us to where we want to explore on the first day, show us the nearby bus stations, supermarkets, restaurants are located. We feel very nice & friendly! The apartment is exactly the same as the pictures, feels sunshine & cozy! And the location is very convenience, in between two metro stations and RER B line and few buses line. We would feel happy to come back if we go to Paris again in the future! =)

Kathleen is a greet host, she is very kind to helpful and attentive to make sure everything is ok. the location is perfect and safe you can connect to everywhere in Paris the room is clean and comfortable.

Gilbert is a very good person. He helped us out with our living. It was a great place to stay with all the amenities. Metro is close by so good connectivity. Its a faire deal to stay at his place. Thanks a lot Gilbert!

Alexis was a wonderful host. He responded quickly to my emails and was very attentive. My parents had a wonderful stay in his absolutely gorgeous apartment. The apartment exceeded their expectations. Location was incredible and it was immaculate.
Françoise is a very kind lady and the room has good location, very near to Eiffel Tower. The house is comfortable. Me and my friend had a great time in Françoise's house.

Nothing but a fantastic flat, location and host. I'm sure if we've asked Mary if she could arrange to close the Eiffel Tower to all other guests than us, then she would have tried to help us out (we didn't). The flat is perfect for a weekend getaway and waking up with the view over the St. Germain rooftops is just brilliant. Mary was in constant contact if we needed anything and also came with good recommendations of the local area. We'll be back.

Great quiet neighborhood, nice clean apartment with all necessary amenities, Tatiana was a very good host, made sure we had everything we needed. Will stay again and recommend to friends visiting Paris.

The apartment was perfect, very comfortable, and the area exceeded our expectations. It is a quiet neighborhood, very close to Metro, and plenty of restaurants and shopping close by. We had a wonderful experience. While the host was not there to meet us, as she was away, she went out of her way to ensure our arrival arrangements were in order and would frequently check in by email to ensure everything was fine. I would definitely return, and I cannot thank Mireille enough for providing an excellent place for us stay to enjoy Paris.
Great location, the apartment is small, francois is great host, really helpful and nice

This place is a hidden gem. It was ideal for my wife and three kids (10-15). The location is ideal for exploring Paris via the metro, though it's very easy to walk to several sites like the Eiffel tower… Which you can see from the upstairs bedroom. Great grocery stores and pastry shops are right around the corner, as well as a Starbucks. The host was very responsive and met us at the apartment at our agreed-upon time. He gave us the rundown of everything we needed to know, and then left us to relax and enjoy the amazing city of Paris. The apartment is quirky and unique, which just adds to its Parisian flair. Two big thumbs up!

Apartment was clean and organized. We were met by the owners friend who let us in and showed us the basics. Personally I feel this was not good, as I had to then contact the owner for more details and still could not get things to work right. I feel he should have been there to show us how to work the stove, the tv, the dishwasher, the A/C. The stay was great, I would potentially stay there again. The shower seems to flood the bathroom floor a little, so just be careful of that.

Loved the place! Cute studio, fairly new and well thought out with everything that was needed: nice quality appliances, countertop hangout, fixtures with a big tub, a nice big comfortable bed and a sunny balcony with rooftop view that makes up for having to walk up 5 floors with no elevator. Great location. Close to subway, supermarkets, restaurants and shops in a very nice neighborhood centrally located in Paris. Chokri is a very welcoming host, easy to communicate with. Would stay again!
Nice place, very goog location - very near Metro and RER stations. Supermarket at the entrence to the building, very convenient

This airbnb had a great location. The place was very clean and easy to find. The host was great. Thy were able to let us check in a little early. I would recommend this place to anyone visiting Paris.
Responsive host. The place is quite smaller than the description, great for 2 people. We were 4 and it felt like we all slept in the same room. The building is a bit noisy and old.

We stayed at Annabel's for a week and really enjoyed the flat. The location is amazing. Close to everything. The flat is large and quiet and very Parisian. Down pillows on the bed. Annabel was great to deal with. Check in was seamless. The bathrooms are dated but everything works. Good value.

The apartment is exactly how it looks in the pictures, it is very big, on two levels, with 2 big bedrooms with plenty of space for my husband and I and our 2 little girls, and it has one bathroom and a half. Bernadette was very accommodating with our arrival time (early evening, she wasn't home but left us all the indications to get into the apartment) and let us leave her place late afternoon (despite the morning check out), we really appreciated her kindness. She was always ready to answer our questions. The location is so central that it could be a little bit noisy at bedtime, but you are in the center of the "Paris movida" and walking distance from most of the best attractions (we actually walked to everything, Notre Dame, le Louvre, Musee d'Orsay, Place de la Concorde, le Marais, St. Germain). Thank you Bernadette our visit to Paris was perfect!

Very happy staying at Georges apartment, very convenient location that we are enable to walk to most places those willing to go in Paris, and it is also very clean, the host kind to put some drinks in frige, everything is smooth for a nice holiday in Paris.
Fantastic studio right in the middle of the 7th. Close to metro, shopping, and restaurants! Host was very attentive and communicated very well. Made for a fantastic stay in Paris.
Natsumi is very helpful and attentive. Two comfortable beds. The couch is not great to sleep on but we hardly spent any time inside because the neighborhood offers so much.

We loved staying at Jean and Bernadette's flat. It is located very centrally and one of my favourite AirBnb's so far. Also, Bernadette was very supportive and proactive in communication. The flat is very clean - exactly how i like. Would recommend staying there to anyone, who wants to do a Paris tour, without loosing time using the public transports.

First, a kind and helpful owner. Thanks Agnes. House is very clean, contains pretty much everything (even your own fridge in your own room). Nice location; very close to metro station (Crimee), about 10 minutes to Eiffel with metro. Around there is a nice bakery, a few nice restaurants and a live neighbourhood.

The apartment is great! The pictures don't do it justice. It was very recently renovated, the bathrooms were especially well done. We were two single travelers and so having two showers helped us get out the door earlier in the mornings. We did not cook, but I peeked in the drawers and it seemed the kitchen is decently stocked to do basic cooking. The beds were comfortable and the bedding was soft to the touch. The location is amazing. We walked almost everywhere, but the metro was just outside the apartment about a block away. Checking in was easy, Luka met us at the apartment, let us in, and gave us a tour. It was a great experience all around. I would absolutely stay again or recommend it to friends.

It was an amazing trip in Paris! The house was near the best places, I loved running every morning near the Eiffel Tower! I just realized there, the meaning: "clean" it's not the same meaning for everybody.
This place is magic. Hands down the best we have seen in Paris and we go twice a year! Can't wait to return.
Great location and lovely apartment. Would love to stay there again. Only problem - there is only one toilet for three bedrooms. Apart from that, good value for money.

Joan and his partner Sophie were absolutely amazing as hosts! They went above and beyond in terms of communication and assistance. The apartment is most suited to a solo traveller, however the bed does expand to the double size if needed. The room is clean with a mini fridge, tv and microwave. The bathroom is also seperate from the main area of the house which is handy, and especially good for the value of the stay. The unit is very close to public transport and plenty of restaurants and shops. The area is safe and easily accessible. Right outside the apartment you will find laundry services and Franprix (super market). I would highly recommend future travellers to stay here. Joan and Sophie made me feel very welcome and taught me a lot about french customs and their way of life.
The place is conveniently located down the street from a main metro station that can take you all over Paris in 15-30 minutes. Lovely inside as well!
Merci. The place was lovely as was the location. Great communication, accurate description, a lovely host and a lovely Airbnb stay.

Host was very communicative. Items in kitchen for use was thoughtful. It was too small for our family, 5 people and bags, coats & boots we weren't comfortable. It would be lovely for smaller group. I wouldn't recommend for children, as there is no space so of course they want to be in the courtyard which is strictly forbidden. Not for light sleepers as you hear everything upstairs and everyone coming home (including light switching on if you are sleeping on the couch). All of this is out of Francois control and no reflection on him, just informing. Location was great, lovely walk to places to eat, local shops and Metro, you feel like a local which is fabulous. Would be happy to stay again without the kids. My sister & 2 kids were in the other apartment so been together was a lucky find, and they were comfortable in their apartment.
Perfection all around. With 2 adults and 5 teenagers, this was super. Good to have 2 separate apartments within such close proximity. Overall a solid place!

It was really terrific. Pefect location, clean, especially clean toillet, well equipped kitchen, quite clean and comfortable beds, high quality kitchen goods. We were five and the space was enough. It might be good upto six members. It was very central in Paris but very quiet. Luka was very nice and punctual. If we visit Paris again, definately we will use it again.

Pascal was extremely helpful throughout our stay and even before we got into Paris. Clear directions to where the metro stops were and a few gems in the neighbourhood. Definitely worth the stay if you don't mind the stairs.

Great stay - would absolutely recommend. Agnes was incredible helpful in communicating how to get to her apartment, as well as quickly responsive to any questions I had while I was there. The price for this location is amazing! You are around the corner from a subway stop, and a ride into the heart of the city is only a few minutes. That being said, it is also great because you are in a neighborhood that feels more local and less touristy, which is always nice.
Georges apartment is an ideal place to start loving the Paris! It's very cozy, practical and comfortable. Great location near lovely Montorguel area with best fromageries and wineries! 10/10
Close to metro and monoprix supermarket and places to eat. Natsumi is very helpful and her flat lovely
Great apartment in a great location. I stayed for business reasons and much more comfortable than staying in a hotel. Excellent coffee machine too - merci Irène

This apartment is amazing, a true gem on airbnb. Pictures do not do justice to the location (overlooking the Louvre and Tuileries from the Balcony), comfort (it absolutely feels like a luxury hotel and has all the amenities one would want expect from a hotel), beauty (every detail of the place is thought through in a very smart way - all windows are controlled via remote, music as well etc.). It feels like home immediately especially since there are no personal things from the owners, just their art - so we very quickly forgot it was not our home. This was fantastic in all aspect and much better than a hotel (and we have stayed to some pretty nice ones in paris - Shangrila/meurice - we actually preferred this experience). Alexis is as responsive and nice as can be. I highly recommend the apartment!

Clarisse was an amazing host! The apartment was as pictured--clean, spacious, and with everything one would need for a longer stay (washer, fully-equipped kitchen). Clarisse was very welcoming and easy to reach the entire time. The location is great--it's away from the tourist center but everything is very easily reachable from Place de la Nation. I would definitely recommend the neighborhood and most certainly the apartment and Clarisse!

This could be the best home in Paris. As other reviewers have mentioned, the photos do not do this place justice. Nicolas and Jean-Yves have an amazing attention to detail, which manifests itself in every part of the house. We enjoyed the most memorable trip of our lives, thanks in large part to this home, and cannot wait to return! Thank you Nicolas and Jean-Yves!!

Chokri was a great host, incredibly accommodating and easy to reach. The appartment is perfect, lovely decoration, modern and warm at the same time. Excellent location. Walking distance to pretty much anything your heart desires. Simply perfect.
We had a lovely stay in your small, but well equiped, appartment. Public transportation is easy to reach and the neighbourhood is pretty calm.

We had a wonderful stay at Alexandra's place for our Parisian experience! It was everything I hoped it would be and more. This place is so many things: lovely, welcoming, cozy, comfortable, roomy, well-equipped; quiet; perfectly located; and uniquely cool! Alexandra was fantastic in terms of communications and accommodations. I would highly recommend this place!!

The location of the house is very good, very close to the Eiffel Tower from the subway station, downstairs is the supermarket, and near a shopping center, life is very convenient. Is a good choice for a vacation in Paris. The apartment is very quiet and safe. Next to Paris, will choose

Alexis is a very gracious, easy to communicate with host. This is the second time I stayed at his wonderful flat, and have one more trip coming up in March - to which I look forward to meeting and staying there again! Everything is very well maintained, the pictures accurately reflect the apartment, and Alexis is always ready to accommodate any requests and make you feel at home!

Gilbert have been really welcoming to us. He was flexible for check-in and check-out. Everything was like described and the accomodation has really nice furniture. Gilbert introduced us in everything and was friendly. All in all i can recommend thhis accomodation to everybody for a really nice stay in Paris.
Sophie & Stephane's apartment was perfect for our trip,was excellent location ,absolutely lovely please and would very much like to go back.
Adrien & Luka are very nice hosts. The apartment location is great, close to Louvre and very convenient. Definitely will come again next time :)

I had a lovely stay in Marvin's apartment which is modern, well equipt, clean and quiet. It's in more of a residential area but it's very close to various metro stations so getting around Paris was easy. The area around Pyrenées is lively with little shops and bars. Marvin and his son David are very pleasant.

Olivier is very nice, quiet and accommodating when possible. The place is very clean and provided everything I needed with the exception of laundry facilities. However there are commercial facilities nearby. I wasn't interested in cooking, so just having fridge space and a microwave was sufficient for me. Have the separate/en-suite (attached) bath was great. Space in France is very small, so the space provided was more than adequate - bed was very comfortable, small shower, sink and toilet, small space for clothes, comfy bed. Note: It is 3 flights of stairs up (curved) and there is no elevator. I knew that from his write up, but just wanted to bring it up for those that might be mobility challenged.
Our stay here was very enjoyable. Lovely appartment which met our groups needs. Location was brilliant and communication with the host was great. No problems and would happily stay here again!

This place was perfect for what I was looking for during our week in Paris. Adam was so easy to talk to before and during our trip. The apartment is in a great location for restaurants as well as the metro for getting around the city.

Charming apartment close to transport, and with a great view in Paris. Great small rooms, quiet when you want to sleep and close to great restraints and supermarkets. Use of the kitchen is available too if you need.
This is a great place to stay! The apartment is very modern with all the conveniences you need.

We had a group of 7 and found François's apartments to be perfect for our needs. The building is old with historic charm. Great location with the Metro, Sacre Coeur, Moulin Rouge, shops, restaurants, and more all within just a few minutes walk. The units were clean and comfortable. The wifi worked well, the showers have plenty of water pressure and hot water. We would stay again.
Amazing communication, not the first time and not the last time I'll be staying at his wonderful place. Home away from home.

We were 3 girls in this apartment. Very good location, few minutes to highlights (Eiffel, Champ-Elysee, Arc de Trioumph..) Adam answered all our questions, even more he organized also our transfer from/to AirPort. Apartment is nice, clean, dishwasher, washing machine, Coffee. We are really satisfied and will use also next tíme. Thank you!
The flat was in a perfect location within walking distance to so much. Additionally it was very quiet and safe. Luka was extremely nice and checked in on us multiple times.

Joan and Sophie were amiable and easygoing hosts who made my stay in Paris really pleasant. All the facilities were clean and well managed. The place is located in a nice and safe area and has easy access to metro and bus. Highly recommended!

The place is in a great location, looks exactly like the pictures and Alexandre was great with all communication. The two things I wish we'd known before - the flat smells of smoke, despite being listed as a non-smoking property. All our things smelt by the time we left. And the flat is the top floor of 5 steep flights of stairs, which was fine for us but worth knowing in case this is an issue. Overall, it was a great stay.

One of the most incredible Airbnb's I've ever stayed in. A true gem in the heart of Paris. Wake up and sip coffee on one of the many balconies. Treat yourself to a sauna or hammam after a long day of exploring the city. Nicolas and Jean-Yves could not be better hosts; communicative, receptive and helpful. This is a gem of a home and has everything you need!
We had a great time in Paris. The apartment is close to the metro which is a necessity when you have two younger children.

The owner of this place is very rude. I called to ask for extra instructions on how to get in and instead of instructions she insults me on the phone and I ended up finding the place without her help. After I left and followed the drop off key instructions as the instructions said, I get another rude message later how I didn't do something I was supposed to that wasn't specified in the instructions. She should not be hosting an Airbnb!
Adam was a helpful host. He was very flexible regarding our arrival time. The place has a great location!!! Enjoy!
Great location, close to Metro stop and was exactly as described. Definitely would stay here again while in Paris.
Everything is perfect. It would be my luck to be in this place. If you see any vacancy here, you have to get the chance like me.

Gilbert is very friendly and flexible. When i said last minute I would arrive earlier that was not a problem. As there where no guests the day after us, Gilbert let us stay during the day to be able to take a shower after the marathon. Merci Gilbert!
Very clean and nice studio, with nice equipments and handy facilities & supplies. We enjoyed the Eiffel tour view, every diner became a festival!

THE VIEW, the view, the view. This place has an awesome view, is breath taking. Words can't describe the view of the tower blinking at night. It is very close to the metro about one block. Stores and restaurants right around the corner. Bus stop right on the corner. Very safe and quiet. comfortable bed.

The apartment was charming, spacious and updated with modern appliances and fixtures. The bathroom was heavenly with a large walk-in shower. The bedroom was quiet for a good night's rest. The living room was filled with light with the sun shining in most of the day. Finally the Internet was super-fast. I would highly recommend the apartment to anyone.

Very speedy, accurate communication. Location is very close to Trocadero. Wonderful well equipped kitchen with nice view of the tip of the Eiffel Tower. Very modern commercial grade plumbing with two WCs - rare in France. Good mattress and bedding. Bedroom faces street - not especially busy, but this is the centre of Paris so earplugs recommended.

We loved this apartment. I wish all our vacation rentals were this beautifully appointed. The location is so close many of Paris historic landmarks, excellent dining, and Metro stops! Made for a lot of time enjoying our vacation and not wasting it in transit.

The house was well located, we loved being in the 20th as we were out of the touristy part of Paris. The apartment is close to good public transport which got us into the center of Paris very quickly. The house was clean and had everything we needed. We enjoyed our stay.
A beautiful and charming house, hidden quietly in Montmartre. Unbelievable that it is right in the middle of Paris. Jeanne was very helpful and friendly, was a lovely, relaxing vacation.
Agnes is very nice and warm, the internet didn't work that day, but everything is great!
Great location and wonderful flat that is close to lots of amenities and transit stations. We enjoyed our trip and will look to come back to the same place the next time we are in Paris
Great host, everything well taken care of. Lively area with restaurants and supermarket, short walk to notre dame and the centre in general.
Natsumi was super friendly, easy to deal with and the apartment was great. Would definitely stay here again next time I'm in Paris.

The apartment is very tastefully done and with great intelligence: in a relatively small space the living area is spacious, the bed-loft is ample, and the bathing area below feels like a spa. The neighbourhood is wonderfully central and very Parisian without being overtaken by tourists; the street is lined with wonderful small shops though a handy supermarket is also nearby. Really great place, grab it if it's available.
great location and nice place....too bad the one room did not have 2 twin beds, would have made sleeping arrangements easier. also needed a few more towels

Perfect location. A whole street of bars, cafes and restaurants just in 4 min of walk + 2 subway stations nearby 👍🏻 Hosts are very friendly and kind. Really liked the electric stove - super fast)) The apartment is equipped with everything you might need during your stay.

This place was prefect for what we needed, just wanted a place To leave our stuff and spend the night. We were given a key to the room so we could come and go and lock up our stuff. Everyone was very nice and the place was super close to the train.
Thanks Vincent for allowing us to stay at his beautiful apartment! He was very helpful and suggested real good restaurants and other hidden gems in Paris

Didn't actually stay at this studio but another of Veriko's flats. The studio needed work and I was upgraded to a larger apartment, which was beautiful and very comfortable. Lucas was very helpful upon check in and check out. Would recommend to any friend.

Location is great, close to everything. Apartment was beautiful, clean and felt very safe. Adrien & Luka were very responsive and flexible with all of our requests, they were great to work with. Highly recommend this apartment.
Had a nice stay for one night at Alexis' studio. Nice and quiet neighborhood with little balcony that oversees Eiffel Tower. Hosts were responsive and very flexible with check-in/out times.

Excellent location. Excellent apartment. Excellent host. The experience is on par and even better than how it is advertised. It is a stylish apartment in a very central location. Alexis, the host, was helpful at every stage of the stay. Can not recommend highly enough.
Agnes is a very good host. She had communicated all the necessary information before my travel and was also helpful when I reached her home. Recommended for travellers.

This apartment was perfect for our short stay in Paris. The view of the Eiffel Tower is breathtaking and the location is perfect to walk to all of the major tourist destinations. This apartment comfortably fits two people and has everything you need for your stay. Alexis is a fantastic host who made sure we had everything we needed and even offered to arrange parking for us!

The apartment is true to the pictures and it is literally steps from everything you need! It is however very noisy ALL night, a problem for my husband and me but not for our 25 year old daughter, so it really depends on what your preferences are. Jean and Bernadette were lovely hosts waiting for us when we arrived to show us all of the particulars of the apartment. Metro and RER 1 block away, but you can walk to the Louvre and Notre Dame in 10 minutes! This was our first air bnb but it will not be our last!
Had a great stay with Agnes! She was great at communicating and helping us get where we needed to go. The apartment is also right by a metro station so we could be anywhere very fast. Wonderful stay!

Loved our stay here! Absolutely phenomenal Eiffel Tower view and we just loved the location with fresh baked croissants nearby and quick access to the Metro. The unit is small but exactly as portrayed in photos and was perfect for my wife and I. Check-in instructions were clear and WolfWolf did everything they could to accommodate our arrival and departure times. Highly recommend this lovely flat.

Muriel's place is amazing , exactly how it is described on the listing. It's bright, extremely clean and the view from the balcony is very special. We had a wonderful time and felt very comfortable. The area was perfect for us, walking distance from the vibrant rue Oberkampf with a lot of great restaurants. Muriel is wonderful and one of the best host I ever met and she made sure we had everything we needed. She truly loves the Airbnb experience :) We hope to come back soon!

This is truly a perfect Parisian space. Stay here if you can. It's been designed with careful attention to the detail of what it means to travel in comfort & elegance. And satisfyingly the apartment is maintained and the roof-terrace garden tended to its original purpose.

This place was amazing and I highly recommend anyone travelling to Paris to book this apartment! Really quite yet located in the best part of Paris. Close to everything. Very secure and just beautifully decorated. We were so comfortable and absolutely loved staying there.

My stay at Oliver's place was very pleasant. He went out of his way to be helpful and orient me about the area. The bedroom and new bathroom were spotless. Mattress was comfortable. WIFI was strong and there was even a nice TV in the room. Definitely exceeded my expectations. Highly recommended!

If you're looking for the perfect Paris pad, this amazing apartment won't disappoint. It is immaculately appointed, with modern furnishings, appliances and a balcony with a gorgeous view - we felt right at home from the get go. Check in/out was a total breeze. Stephane was kind enough to help us settle in and answer all the questions we had. Plus, everything you need is just a stone's throw away, with various public transport options available and a grocery store just across the road. Thank you, Stephane and Sophie. Your hospitality made our trip truly unforgettable.

The entire experience was fantastic. Justin was a great help and kept in contact from the day before our arrival until we left. We were greeted and shown through the apartment which was beautiful and fully equipt with everything we could have needed. The apartment was spacious and unique, and gave us a wonderful space to relax in when we didn't want to go out. The neighborhood was great, filled with restaurants, bars and shops and was easy to walk around and access taxis and public transport. Would highly recommend this property for anyone visiting Paris.

Nathalie's place is in a great position in Paris, easy for travelers to get around and a lovely vibe to the area. Comfortable with a relaxing environment all you need to enjoy Paris in a truly Parisienne way. Loved it

We arrived in Paris quite late and Adam was super nice which constantly checked on our status. The Apartment is as described and is located really close to one of the metros. This eases our travelling plan. I definitely recommend it.!!!

The location is perfect. You're right in the middle of everything. Isabelle is very personable and called to make sure I could get to her place alright. Her two sons are very polite and helpful. Would stay again!

I enjoyed my stay here, lovely view! But, the bed was not my favorite. The home was pretty central, good for a solo traveler. I appreciated the wide-range for check in/out times. However, I wish it was more set in stone as I would have made plans ahead of time if I knew exact times in advance. Wolfwolf was lovely to communicate with, thank you!
Very clean. Close to subway. The building is a little hard to find but Agnes provided many direcions

This place is lovely. My family of 4 stayed for 2 nights as we speed visited Paris. It is very close to the train stop, near the Louvre, and situated in the quaintest building. So many cafes and restaurants around. Would absolutely stay here again!

Great place in a great location. The attention of the owner is great, you wont be disappointed. She welcome us with delicius bread and wine. Two minute walk to luxemburg gardens... A great place, just for young couples because of the stairs, but it wasn´t a deal for us.
Ana was a great host - her flat is the right size (not too big not too small for two / three adults), clean and at a very convenient location! We had a pleasant stay !
Yann's place is in a great location, on a quiet street, a stone's throw away from Sacre Coeur. Lots of great shops and restaurants close by to chose from as well.
Was a lovely staying in Muriel apartment. Comfort apartment near to public transport. I would recommend to everyone. Perfect for couples without kids.
Would recommend to anyone staying in Paris , very secure & safe , well equipped , great amenities , close to all attractions
We always enjoy staying at Mireille's apartment. It's very convenient, clean, and near shops, restaurants, and transportation.
Gilbert's place is great. The room is as described and the bed is comfortable. Gilbert is very friendly and helpful. The neighbourhood is lovely also.
Perfect location, super close to Montmartre and to metro stations. Is a really cozy place and everything looks like in the pictures.

The room is great, the private shower and exclusive bathroom are awesome features, and so is the refrigerator with drinks and the snacks provided. Julien is a great host, he even agreed to allow me to check it at midnight. Totally recommended.
Nice place to stay a short period whit your family, Ana was very nice and she try to help you whit ever question that you have

The flat is in an excellent location. You really can't do much better if you like the shopping offered on Saint Germain, plus an easy 20 mi mute walk to Notre Dame and the Louvre. The host was a very timely and accurate communicator which isn't always the case with other hosts I've dealt with in the past so that's a big plus. The only reason this isn't a 5 star review is that the apartment did tended to hear up a bit and it was noisy enough on the street that opening the window got a bit noisy. But I would certainly stay here again.
It is very homey apartment, near to public transport, shops and cafe. You will feel Paris in it, I recomьend to stay here.
Place was nice, just as described. We would stay there again. Chokri recommended local places for us. Steve

Gilbert was a great host, greeted us at door with a smile even though it was midnight when we arrived. Provided us with all that was needed and was very accommodating. House is very clean and organized, room is comfortable, with black out blinds and ensuite shares bathroom. Gilbert is very respectful, feels like you are alone in the apartment; however he is always available if needed. Location is close to metro and a beautiful park for picnics. Gilbert also provided us with light breakfast for our convenience. Highly recommended!

Hannelore and Gerhart were very kind and thoughtful hosts. Their place was comfortable and within walking range of the metro. Breakfast was amazing and the bed, shower, and room was very nice. The flowers on the balcony were so gorgeous! I highly recommend their adorable flat. Thank you for the lovely stay!

The apartment is quite large- we are a family of four adults and there was plenty of room. It is very upscale and the location is ideal. One can walk easily to Notre Dame or the Louvre. The metro is quite close. There are many restaurants close by as well as a grocery store. Don't hesitate to stay here!

The apartment was fabulous! The location could not have been better! You walk out and there are lots of restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, local people walking through the streets, even live music on some corners. We had everything we needed in the apartment, is was clean, well kept, the communication with the owner was very good and there was even a manual with instructions about the property and the surrounding area. We had a great vacation!

Christine's place is in a great location! Near main attractions in Paris, grocery stores, and good places to eat! It was great to have a washer and a nice kitchen to cook in as well :-) My only suggestion is be careful climbing up to top bunk, ladder is unstable and slips easily!

Emmanuel is an exceptional host and welcomes you into his lovely home, which is perfectly located in the hip 10er. The apartment was extremely comfortable and perfect for our stay in Paris. Would definitely stay here again

This was our first Airbnb ever and we were very happy with our experience. Communication with the owner was easy and prompt. The location was wonderful in the 7th arrondissement within easy walking to metro and restaurants. The people we experienced were friendly and helpful. The apartment was as advertised. We stayed with 2 kids (aged 12 & 9) and they easily fit on the convertible sleeper. The fold down bed was comfortable and clean. We felt at ease and comfortable the entire time in the apartment. The air conditioning was an exceptional bonus as our entire time in Paris was during a heat wave. I would highly recommend this rental to anyone.

Very good location. The small studio is in a quiet part of the street, quite close to everything. The kind host very good with communication and answering questions. The bed is not the most comfortable, but ok for a short stay.
We enjoyed s comfortable stay here. The apartment was well equipped and close to Gare du Nord and even closer to Poissoniere Metro stop. Vitalina was a pleasant an accommodating host.
Arthur's place was great, nice location next to the metro and easily accessed via an elevator.

Thomas is your dream host. Apartment is very clean, cozy and have everything you need. The area has a big variety of restaurants, cafes, little shops. The communication with Thomas was very easy. Highly recommending his place and will come back again!

Alexandre's apartment is perfectly located in a roaring area. We arrived at Gare de l'Est, which is only a few minutes walk away. The neighborhood is quite lively, there are lots of bars, restaurants and down the street you can find a tiny supermarket where you can buy everything you need at almost every time of day or night. As soon as you're in the apartment you don't hear anything that's going on on the streets. Although the place is very small itself, we didn't miss anything. The existing space is used optimally and well appointed with tasteful furnishings. Everything was perfectly clean and Alexandre himself was a great host. He welcomed us warmly, recommended us wonderful places to go and even explained us where to find the next Vélib station to rent bicycles - which is the best way to discover the city. We'd love to come back whenever we visit Paris!

We would highly recommend Mai's beautiful apartment. Situated in a quiet street off Rue Mouffetard (a gorgeous market street in Paris filled with artisan food and wine stalls), the apartment is a convenient, light filled, quiet place to rest and explore Paris from. The location seems to offer a feel of the "real" Paris and is also incredibly central, making it easy to visit Jardin du Luxembourg and many a wonderful bar, restaurant or cafe! The metro is a 2 minute walk away and connects to convenient lines for both the right and left banks. We had a fantastic stay here and would happily visit again (hopefully soon)!

Alexis was so hospitable and thoughtful. He always answered texts/emails and checked up on our well being during our stay. Besides that he had everything you need including a binder with what to see and do in the city. The apartment could not be better located. My only regret is that our stay was far too short!
Beautiful property - very well maintained. The location is perfect; near the subway, trains, monoprix (massive supermarket), Sacre Couer and lots of restaurants.

Amazing house, our family(6 adults and 1 kid)all loved the house, 2 mins walking to metro line 9, even located in the centre(close to Bastille), the house is quiet and clean. Nicole is a nice host and always ready to help. We will come back for sure.
Great place. Amazing location to bars and beautiful restaurants. Cute space. Would recommend if you want something that's walkable to main attractions but also a bit out of the touristy areas

Julien is very kind and friendly that he introduce every detail about his place for us. The room is very clean and tidy. The location is very close to the central and different metro station. There are many restaurants nearby as well. We had a good time in Julien' place:)

Cute little quaint place in very sought after St-Germain Des Pres. Location, location, location. Beware of no A/C and street can be loud at night with the windows open Otherwise has all the necessities
Beautiful apartment! Gilbert is the sweetest! The park is one of the prettiest I've been to. I would absolutely stay here again. We slept so peacefully! We didn't want to leave!

We had a wonderful stay here. There is a great market close by and restaurants. The Metro is down the street and made getting around Paris so very easy. Vitalina helped us arrive and get situated making our arrival so easy. The apartment was a great fit for our family of four and we would stay here again if we return to Paris.

Our family of 5 just stayed at Christine's apt. She was a wonderful host, she helped me and the little girls get into the apt with all our luggage because my husband had to keep going and return our car. The place was big enough for all of us and it had exactly what we needed. The kids loved the top bunk and the games. I loved the location, it is very central with a bakery right next door and walking distance to Sainte Chapelle and the other sites near by. It was great for our first visit to Paris.
Stephan is a great person, very kind and warm...he´s apartment is wonderful, well decorated and ubicated in a very nice neiborghood, near the principal points of interest in Paris.

We love the place and the location its close to restaurants and metro stations. It's kinda tight for a family of 5 grown adults but was manageable and and it worked for us. It was our first time to use airbnb and I can say that we had a very pleasant experience adding to that having Thierry as our host.

Such tremendous accommodations near absolutely everything. The apartment was even better than described and all of the main attractions are within walking distance. As well as your choice of bakery. Merci Chachou for a wonderful experience!
