Apartment was bijou but perfect for our short stay - everything we needed and nice and quiet area too. Thank you!

Had an amazing stay! Gilbert was very thoughtful and amazing host. I’m thankful for allowing us to check in early after an 11 hour flight and for having his home clean and making us feel welcome. If we’re ever in France again we will definitely be staying there again!
Gilbert’s place is in a prime location, especially if you are flying in or out of CDG airport. It is steps from a beautiful park. Gilbert’s home is beautiful and the room was lovely and comfortable.

This place was full of Parisienne charm. It had everything we needed, lots of space and easy to get everywhere from. Very peaceful and quiet in the mornings so getting a good sleep at night was easy. On top if it all the place is kept incredibly clean!

Really five star place! Clean, comfortable, close to bus station, a beautiful park outside and everything you need are provided, he even prepared us the breakfast, the best experience during our whole journey, thank you, we enjoyed the stay a lot!

Yang's apartment was perfect for our stay in Paris. It is situated in a great location with lots of amenities. Yang was a lovely host and kept in touch with us throughout our stay. He was also really kind when I realised that I had lost the spare key on the morning we left! I would thoroughly recommend Yang's comfortable and stylish apartment.

This is the only place I will ever stay when I visit Paris. Bertrand responded quickly to all of my injuries. At the last minute, my check in time changed but he was able to accommodate us with no problem. If you are used to using washcloths to shower, you may want to bring your own since only the large bath towels are provided. No biggie, just a heads up. Other than that, this place is perfect and great value for the costs!

Fantastic place. You can find the metro station as you come out of the main door and there are plenty of local amenities. Few bakeries and supermarkets within walking distance and the Tuesday morning market is amazing. Really nice and lively neighbourhood, where we felt really safe. Highly recommend this place to everyone. We were on our honeymoon and it was a great find. Arthur and his team were really efficient at communicating and very helpful. Thank you very much.

We had a great stay in Paris at Eleanor’s apartment. The place was clean and tidy on arrival and ideally located for all Paris has to offer. A busy little area, but quiet at night. Eleanor was great at communicating with us, we would happily stay again.
Absolutely wonderful stay in Paris! This place had so much Parisian charm and personality. A lot of thoughtful touches and the location in the Marais district was perfect.

Jean-Daniel's apartment is in a great location of Paris - easy to get everywhere and super clean! He greets you every morning with the most delicious croussiants you can imagine. He is helpful and available to give recommendations if you need them. We had 6 people staying at his apartment and it was super spacious.

François was a great host and very helpful whenever we had any questions. He always responded immediately. The apartment was very nice and located centrally on Montmartre with close access to metro stations. I highly recommend this apartment.

This is the most amazing accommodation right in the heart of everything. Phillipe met and welcomed us at 11:30 pm and showed us through and provided great local tips. The place is cosy but spacious enough to not feel cramped (we stayed 5 nights). Cooking facilities were great and beds very comfortable. The best aspect is the location. Great produce stores and markets right outside your front door. Definitely recommended if you’re considering this.

My third time to stay & each time just as perfect. The accommodation is really comfortable & private, separated from the family apartment. Julien is a well-deserved 'superhost'. A lovely area of Paris too, easy walking distance to metro lines 3, 2 & 13 & lots of cafes, restaurants, shops (incl. convenience stores) right on your doorstep! Looking forward to visit no. 4! Highly recommended. Thank you.

Isabelle and her sons were very nice and welcoming. They live in a very good location with close access to metros and restaurants and grocery stores. The place is super clean including the bathroom :). The room is cozy probably better for solo travelers. It is very well lit and I liked all the different lighting options. She also offered me Nespresso coffee and bread with jam each morning which was great!. Overall highly recommended to stay.
Place is pretty much as pictured. Very spacious and clean. Location is great as its near a shopping mall, alot of restaurants, and public transportation.
Really nice apartment, in a quiet residencial area and really close to the tube and many other amenities
great location. very easy to get by foot, bus or metro almost anywhere. stylish flat near supermarket, restaurants, cafes, amarino icecream.... carlo was available for any question.
The room was very good. The condition of the room was a new house. However it was uncomfortable to sleep because of the roof. Except that, the apt was perfect.
I had a great stay at Isabelle's. She was very welcoming and informative about the area, I'm very grateful for her opening her home to me, it made my stay in Paris very comfortable.
I had an excellent stay at Anne et Alain’s apartment. It’s a beautiful apartment - better than the photos. If this was a hotel room, it would be a 5-star suite.

Wolfwolf’s place was great for our few nights in Paris. The view was absolutely incredible from the window. Live music from locals could be heard during the evening. The space was small but perfect for two people. Bed was comfy! And easy walk to the metro. Thanks so much! Would definitely recommend! :)

Alexandre has a charming apartment that's centrally located with a great rooftop view. Communication was effortless & he went out of his way to accommodate a change in arrival. We were provided with an extensive list of neighborhood gems & wish we could've stayed a bit p

Cedric and his wife are both incredibly kind and welcoming. My stay was quite short (just an overnight before my flight), but it was very comfortable. The home is in a quiet, residential neighborhood. It takes 6-7 minutes to walk to the metro station. Breakfast was great. Communication was very easy.

Comfortable and everything you need in this studio! Ana was quick to respond and we had a great experience. The apartment is near the Nation metro which connects to everything and there's a supermarket down the street. Very convenient!

This apartment is in a great location! The neighborhood is safe and has great shops and restaurants within walking distance. The apartment is a great, comfortable space to retreat to after a day of sightseeing in Paris.

Love staying here when I come to Paris. Nice quiet building and neighborhood but still lively enough to enjoy everything Paris offers. Very nice sized flat with a great bathroom/shower. Nicolas is great and super accommodating.

Wonderful place, wonderful host! Host was very welcoming and even took the trouble to came say goodbye when we left. The home was very clean and very well maintained. Location is also very ideal with supermarts nearby and very good restaurants. It's safe and very near the train station. Recommend everyone to not hesitate. This is a treasure! Thank you!
This is a safe and comfortable house, walking to the central area of dalion, and the garage is a great highlight, recommended for occupancy.

This apartment was great! We loved the area and the market down the street. We ate there and shopped many time. The apartment was perfect for the two of us and we even cooked dinner one night. The communication with Mireille was easy and quick. Would 10/10 recommend to stay here!

Great location for a solo traveller. Isabelle went out of the way and let me use her washing machine and provided breakfast etc. She was so welcoming. The room has storage space, hangers, bright (and soft) light that makes it a good fit for a solo traveller.
Fantastic place!!! Very impressed. Clean and had everything you needed. Great communication with the host and would recommend to anyone!

Arianne's place is great! It's a perfect central location for exploring Paris, with easy access to the subway as well as great shopping and food within walking distance. She was really easy to communicate with, and easily accommodated our somewhat odd check-in and check-out hours. I would definitely recommend Arianne's place to anyone looking to visit Paris!
Great location near transport lines. Host was nice and assisted with routes to travel. The apartment is comfortable and has everything you need, quite safe. Wifi was a great benefit.
Great apartment with beautiful light! contemporary bathroom. Strong wifi connection. Comfy bed. And very close to Metro! I would definitely stay here again!
Great, central location and accommodating host. The apartment was clean and looked like the photos in the listing. Would definitely stay here again.

Alexis should be awarded a Superhost plus award! A fabulous stay from start to finish. Excellent communication and nothing too much trouble. Early check in and late check out really did make all the difference! The apartment is beautiful and the balcony was perfect for morning and afternoon drinks. Nespresso machine meant we felt very at home. The bed was super comfortable, the best sleep I’ve had in months. Alexis is lovely and warm and nothing was too much trouble. Thank you again.
Sweet, quiet apartment with great access to Metro and local markets. Lots of local restaurants to chose. Loved the diversity in the neighborhood. I didn't feel like a tourist while there.

Bruno's apartment couldn't have been more accommodating. Unlike so many prior rentals, it's spacious and invites relaxation and comfort. The location is close to several Metro lines and walkable to many sites. Bruno is super responsive and accommodating. Highly recommend.
Great location near to Marais and Bastille station. My friend and I traveled with many luggages, so we decided to look for a room on ground floor. The room was just like I expected.:)
Very nice flat and perfect located. Very good explanation and documentation from host. Also the answers are quick and friendly.

This was an excellent location to stay in Paris. Jean Daniel was a great host. We were a group of 6. The apartment was clean and comfortable. I think the croissants that were delivered in the morning are the best I've eaten. I would definitely stay here again..

The apartment was perfectly clean, functional and comfortable. It is also very quiet as it is overlooking a beautifully planted courtyard. All in all this would have been an almost perfect stay if it wasn't for some glitches at check-in: the second bed had not been prepared and despite signaling it right away to Jean-Charles during check-in as well as to Alain by message, the missing bed linen was provided only on the next day, without making the bed. We were also very surprised to find out that only one bath towel per person was provided.
Thank you for a great stay. We did have a little trouble with the hot water some mornings where we had to leave shower running for 5 minutes to get hot. Also the sonos system did not work. Thank you
This apartment is in a great location. We were able to safely and quickly get around Paris and loved coming home to relax to a clean and comfortable apartment. I would recommend!

Sébastien’s cosy apartment was perfect for our stay in Paris. Sébastien welcomed us in person, provided us with very detailed house manual and helpful information on local restaurants, public transportation and so on. His place was sparkling clean, and had everything we needed including awesome bed! Highly recommend.

Location was great and the metro was easy to use A great efficiency apartment for an at home atmosphere even though you will be out exploring most of the time. Bakeries,groceries and bottle shops as well as restaurants within 5 minutes or less

You can expect a clean and well appointed apartment. The area is full of restaurants, local shops, delis, and close to the metro. Michel was very accomadating and communicated quickly with us. It is on the first floor, with no elevator, so you must be able to climb one flight of stairs.
Great place and fantastic location. We would definitely recommend Maria’s place. Communication was easy before and during our stay. Lovely place.
Peggy’s apartment was beautifully furnished and very clean. Great location!! Would definitely stay again.

We enjoyed a beautiful stay in Arthur's place on our first trip to Paris. It seemed like the picture of the Paris we had imagined, in the kind of ancient building that could tell so many tales - with the courtyard, and the French doors, and the old wood and iron work. Each day when we left to explore we exited the quiet sanctity of the courtyard through the giant door to very busy and active neighbourhood. There was a market and a street festival across the street at various times, we took the metro or walked down to the Seine, and started each day by watching people from the cafe across the street.
An amazing location. So near a subway in an amazing neighborhood. Would love to return to this apartment and neighborhood again.

Super nice apartment and so central. Alexis is incredibly responsive and very friendly, was really understand when we had to check in much later than planned due to delayed Eurostars! Would definitely rent again!
This place is perfect for a stay in Paris. Location is great, with lots of cafes and restaurants in the area. The apartment is beautiful and in top condition. Highly recommend.

Jacques' apartment is beautiful. The space is compact and very neat. It was so extremely clean. The bed was very comfortable with beautiful white linen. The bathroom was actually very spacious with an amazing shower. The kitchen had everything that we needed. The location is good too. Just a few minutes walk to Sacre Coeur. I got on a hop on hop off tour bus so easily from the Sacre Coeur stop just a minutes walk from the apartment. We also got around Paris on foot so easily from the apartment. We really enjoyed wandering around Montmartre too. I would definitely recommend Jacques' apartment. He was a good host.

A great value for your time in Paris! Emmanuel provided an amazing breakfast for us and was an awesome overall host during our stay. This space is ideal for a family of 3, it is a bit small for a family of 4 but we managed okay for a 2 night stay. It’s an easy direct bus ride or cheap Uber to all of the main tourist sites in Paris. Thanks Emmanuel!
This is a great place and Jean-Daniel is a great host. Is super conveniently located and the apartment is great for large groups!
Terrible place to stay right now. very loud construction across street from apt. Unresponsive host, they promise he’ll be banned from AirBnB, but we’ll see. Lot’s of better options in Paris.

Although I didn't spent much time there as I was always in a hurry due to the purpose of my visit ,all I can say is that Isabelle is a wonderful and warm person and I would definitely reccomend this host.
The landlord is very enthusiastic, the location of the house is very good, the traffic is very convenient, there are Chinese restaurants and subway entrance nearby

This is a cozy efficiency in a charming neighborhood - and you can't beat coming home to a view of the Eiffel Tower lit up at night! Wolfwolf was very responsive and even replied quickly when I was confused about the gate entry my first night. I didn't spend much time in the apartment other than to sleep and shower, but I would stay there again based on the location. Close to the metro, shops, bistros...everything you need.

Very clean apartment with three full sized bedrooms in a good location, close to the metro. Breakfast was delivered daily - a lovely touch. Jean-Daniel is an excellent host who responds very quickly to any questions.
A great location, and a very clean and quiet place. We love the doors to the terraces to have fresh air. We also loved having the spacious apartment and exploring the local neighborhood.

This location is close to the Metro Line and close to the grocery stores as well. We woke up and would normally grab some food at the nearby bakeries or the grocery store in the mornings before heading down the Metro.

Very well situated. Very well appointed apartment. It is important to know that this apartment is Celine's home, it is not a rental unit. Guests should be prepared to be careful in the use of all amenities, such as cookware, knives, plates. Some people may not be ready for this.
Amazing view of the Eiffel Tower- extremely special to see it out the window at night time.

I've stayed in more than 30 Paris apartments and this one has by far the best shower with great water pressure in addition to a fabulous bath tub in addition. The rest of the apartment is fine too in addition to a great location next Rue Mouffetard, a classic market street.

Marianne’s home is absolutely lovely. The room is clean, comfortable and has a beautiful balcony view. Her home is about a 5 minute walk from the metro so it was very easy to get around Paris. Marianne’s breakfast every morning was delicious and she always made us feel comfortable. She had plenty of amenities available to us and gave us excellent restaurant and museum recommendations. I absolutely loved my stay there and would recommend her as a host to everyone traveling to Paris! Thank you so much for everything Marianne! Staying at your place made our trip all the more enjoyable!
Great place in a great location, with a good plaza down the street for food and drinks. Ultra modern loft.

The apartment is exactly as shown in pictures, super clean and very well located in Montmartre. The kitchen is very well equipped so we could prepare food. The sofa bed is as comfortable as a normal bed, we slept super well. The apartment is well decorated and luminous with a really nice view! Sandra is a super nice host, quick and clear communication. She was always smiling and wiling to help. We’ll be back and I definitely recommend this Airbnb!!!
nice surrounding, easy to reach, pretty quiet at the 7th stock. Entrance via her own place, but that was ok as well. I can recommend the place
Nice apartment for a short stay in Paris. Perfect location in the center of Paris and very good communication with the host.

Very nice pictures on this site but in reality apartment is extremely small and the building itself is old and dirty and doesn't look safe. Very noisy at night, you can hear people speaking in other apartments.

A great place to stay. In a colourful, vibrant area, and at the same time wonderfully tranquil in the apartment. All the necessities were there, and the hosts made everything eru easy. Highly recommend!

The apartment is nice and well located. Close to public transport. It’s quiet but if you have some pubs to enjoy a good beer also close. Clementine is available and worried about any need you might have
This place is awesome, very confortable and the location is perfect. We'd stay there again for sure. Highly recommend.

The apartment was as comfortable as expected. The sofa bed was more comfortable than any other I've ever slept on. Everything was sparkling clean and looked like it had never been touched. The location was absolutely ideal, 2 mins walk to Jarin de Tuileries and really easy to walk to other areas such as Champs Elysees, Louvre etc. We picked up breakfast from Eric Kaysayer just around the corner - which I would highly recommend.
Flat was in a great location, walkable to most attractions and close to metro. I would stay here again and recommend to others!

Our stay at Ulysee's place was fantastic. Anne was very accomodating allowing us to leave our bag with them so as we could get to an exhibition early of our check in time. When we checked in the flat really did have the wow factor, a really beautifully decorated and cool flat. Locationwise its a 5 minute walk from Notre Damm Cathedral, it has a little market just down the road which was great. If you come out the flat and head left up the road towards the church Saint Etienne Du Mont there are some really cool bars, we really liked one called Le Piano Vache. We really enjoyed our stay at Ulysee's flat and would definatley like to stay here again one day for longer.

Nice little apartment in a great location. Walking distance from Gare Du Nord and into the city centre. Very clean and all amenities there. Julien was a great host and really easy to contact. Would definitely recommend!

Great stay, location close to public transport, very clean, approachable host and would reccomend without hesitation! (even offered us tickets to Kylie Minogue, but we aren’t that type of music fans, but the thought was nice all the same)

This was a perfect stay, we were 3 couples doing a weekend of cultural and gastronomic pleasures. All the three rooms were spacious and clean. Everything was clean in fact! Jean-Daniel the host was warm and informative! Highly recommended!

Philippe was very responsive from the beginning. He answered all our special requests and was very attentive to our needs. His nice assistant received us upon arrival and gave us time to refresh after the flight even though we came before agreed. The place was clean and spotless. Large two rooms with a separate bathroom. Plenty of extra beddings and towels. The neighborhood is fantastic - the chicest part of Paris, with small boulongeries and the most famous ice cream. The island itself is very quiet but just a walk to all the bars and cafes. Our vacation was marvelous. Thank you, Philippe!!!

This has to be one of the best airbnb's I have stayed in! Beautifully decorated and very clean space that has everything you need. The location could not be better with countless restaurants and shops just outside your door. Stephane was a great host! Very helpful, responsive, and attentive. He made us feel right at home. I will make sure to stay here again next time I travel to Paris!

Françoise has a lovely apartment that is very conveniently located. The room is spacious and comfortable, everything is spotless, and she was very helpful in giving advice on transport. Strongly recommend this for a base to easily see Paris!
Very spacious, clean appartement. Everything was exactly like in the description. Jean-Daniel is very helpful and answers really quickly. I can highly recommend this appartement!

Emmanuel's place is fantastic. It is clean, modern, and has great amenities. Emmanuel and Ronald were both super responsive and helpful both before and during our stay. We also enjoyed the Republique area that is adjacent to - excellent location for bars, nightlife, and mass transportation! Would absolutely stay here again.

Denis was wonderful to work with. His apartment was very clean and nicely decorated with an updated bathroom. The location was great! We loved the vibrant neighborhood with nearby groceries, cafes and shops.

Tidy apartment in an excellent location. Close to a metro stop, and in an excellent neighborhood of Paris. Rita was really fast to respond and answered all of our questions. I would absolutely stay here again.

What a great stay we had here. The location is great and sits right in the middle of the 9th, close to Sacre Coeur and an easy and interesting walk into the centre of town. The apartment is really comfortable and has everything you need.
Excellent value. It’s in a great location. The apartment was clean and comfortable. Thomas was an excellent and communicative host.

Great apartment, spacious with a nicely equipped kitchen. It’s a great location with the metro close by as well as shops, restaurants, pharmacies and everything one might need. Our communication with Clara was great. She was responsive, flexible and hospitable. Would definitely recommend staying here!

This flat was way above our expectations. Peggy is a very generous and welcoming host. The flat is in a great lively location, right next to the tube and shops. Brochant 13 is a brilliant metro line, with quick access to all the best tourist spots. Next to the flat are some good & affordable restaurants. The property has been thoughtfully designed so it all works and flows perfectly. The two fully accessible bedrooms at entrance level were good sizes, had nice design touches with plenty of storage space. The basement bedroom is huge with an interesting loft style appearance. Peggy left food and lots of refreshments for our arrival. The flat was lovely and warm with very adjustable heating. We will definitely return again. A+++
very good place with very nice hosts. excellent location, very close to metro and nice restaurants. the terrace is good even under the rain..

The location is fantastic! So close to a metro station, restaurants, a supermarket, and the Eiffel Tower. The apartment is in great condition, clean, cozy, and has everything you need for a confortable stay.

Location, location, location! Awesome space that had enough room for 6 of us. The location was the best part. It's located right in the Latin Quarters, just step outside and grab a crepe or whatever food you are feeling right out the door. The only downside was that the place is on the 5th floor but after eating so much food, I thought of it as a way to offset (haha).
Location is everything!!! Place is clean just as described. Lots to eat in the area and close to all attractions. Definitely would stay there again
Very nice, cosy, stylish apartment in one of the trendiest areas , close to bars & restaurants. Close to metro & bus lines , well communicated. Really enjoyed the stay.

Peggy's place is a fabulous apartment, close to the metro with plenty of shopping nearby. We really enjoyed our stay there and wouldn't hesitate in recommending it to others. Peggy was an awesome host and was very helpful. We were there when there was trouble in central Paris and she let us know where not to go and provided good suggestions for alternative activities. Very happy with the experience.

Struck gold with this wonderful find! The apartment is beautifully Parisian with convenient transport links and much to see and do right on the doorstep. The hospitality was incredible, couldn’t have asked for a better and more attentive host!

Gorgeous apartment, very clean, fantastic location. Paul (the caretaker) is helpful and friendly. The apartment is very quiet and has lots of modern touches built in to what appears to be a quite old-fashioned aesthetic. But note that it is definitely squeezed into the eaves, and I found that crouching to avoid low beams and slanted ceilings became irritating. For communication: Note that the person who answers your emails is neither on site or even in Paris; so make sure to check in in advance of your visit with Paul, the caretaker, by phone.

This place is convinent to metro and RER station, have supermarket, barkey, and restaurant around, specially some Chinese restaurant. Agnes is a easygoing host, and gived very detailed introduction for me to get to apartment and be familiar with enviroment.

The place looks exactly as described, building in brand new, although it was on the first floor, you can still use elevator for heavy luggage. It’s close (5 minutes) to at least 3 metro stations. Marvin and David are great hosts. I would stay there again for sure.
We were warm and comfortable while we were there. We were able to move easily anywhere in Paris city center, and quick reply to inquiry was good too ~
Nice place with a great view, and the apartment is so beautiful as the photo. But there is one thing awful, the lift is broken this time and the apartment is in sixth floor.

Denis' place is in the heart of Le Marais and the location is perfect. Our stay could not have been better! Denis is a very quick communicator, and check in/check out was super easy. Our flight was cancelled and we had to catch a later non-stop flight and Denis even provided us with a nice bottle of wine to welcome us after a stressful flight. We definitely recommend!
Lovely apartment filled in with all you need. Rooms are nice and comfortable, heating is excellent.

We rent many apartments via AirBnB each year and this one is perhaps our favorite. It is located in a perfect location in Paris and is a penthouse that allows you a 180 degree view from the Eiffel Tower across the Champs Elisee facing East. It is a glorious view. The apartment itself is very stylish, yet comfortable, with nice beds, plenty of storage, and two charming places to enjoy the evening. The kitchen is very functional and has a washer and dryer that are quick and efficient. The owner is obviously interested in lighting and the lights and sconces are all amazing. There is an art deco piano that is a delight to look at (we don't play). Windows are covered with automatic shutters if you want to block out the sights of Paris, but who would? It was lovely watching the sun come up in the morning. In sum: gracious apartment and gracious host.

Very lovely and cozy space, you enter a beautiful patio or courtyard and the feel of the place is soo nice and inviting, the rooms, bathrooms, kitchen felt very comfortable, only the stairs made it a bit complicated.

We had a lovely time at Sébastien’s place! The apartment's location is excellent - both the Latin Quarter and the Marais (across the river) are very accessible by foot. Sebastian greeted us on check-in, and was very helpful. The apartment was very clean and well equipped. As described, the ceiling in the gallery bedroom is quite low. However, as short people, we got used to it quickly. Good value.

The place is very well situated in a lively area, it is nevertheless very calm as the windows do not face the Bd Montparnasse. The self check in and out is a plus for busy travellers. It was tidy and clean, the main room is larger than it looks on the pictures. The kitchen is well equipped and the bathroom recently renovated. I would come back, no hesitation.

My girlfriend and i stayed in Emmanuel’s place and it was perfect. In a great area that is away from the touristy side of Paris, but still near a busier square that has lots of restaurants and coffee places. The place was very clean, the kitchen was awesome to cook in, bed was comfortable. Everything was perfect for us.
We loved the space and everything was very clean. friendly hosts. would stay there again and highly recommend to friends and family. suggest to have more pillows 😊
Perfect spot to stay in a great neighborhood. Apartment has all the amenities you could want for a comfortable stay. Highly recommend.
Great location, and great directions on how to get into the apartment. Everything we expected and more.

Agnes was really nice, she was very considerate with us. We had a really good communication. The apartment was comfortable and really cute. It has a very good location in Paris. Restaurants, metro, etc, are near to the apartment. 100% recommended.

the room is quite clean and tidy, equipments are easy to use. The bed sleeps well . The location is very good, it is very convenient to go anywhere, there are a few steps from the subway station, there are many shops downstairs, the restaurant is still at 10 o'clock in the evening, and the convenience store is also 24 hours. Totally, a perfect place to live in Paris. I want to live again in the future !

Wonderful host with great insight into the neighborhood and city. Great apartment, newly Renovated, clean with great appliances and great kitchen. Location is amazing for what we were looking for just removed from high density tourist areas, and public transportation all near by or directly out side. Next block has great butcher, salumaria, cheese shop and one of the best pastry shops in the city. Great coffee shop as well, we struggled to find non-dairy options for coffee and the two guys on the next block are making beautiful coffee with non-dairy options
Great apartment, it was lovely to have space to open two big suitcases. you have to climb 4 flights of stairs with your luggage tho.

Muriel's cozy home was very charming, spotless, convenient, and comfortable with a large bathroom, sweet balcony, and view. The 6th floor apartment, with a nice-sized elevator, was well-equipped and there were no traffic noises or vis a vis neighbors. Muriel is an outstanding host who welcomed me warmly and is a pleasure to know. Communication was extremely easy and check-in and out a breeze.

I want to keep this place a secret! I was ready (and maybe still am) ready to give up on Airbnb because of so many terrible experiences before we stayed here in Paris. Everything at Parc Royal was wonderful! As a designer, I really appreciated all the attention to details. We loved, loved, loved this place! I still have my doubts about Airbnb for future travel but this is a good one. More people should be completely honest when rating their experiences so others don't have to suffer.

We really enjoyed the beautifull and well-maintained appartment. The appartment is centrally located in one of the nicest neighbourhoods of Paris. The host was very welcoming and solved the problems we had with the alarm and heating super adequately. Would highly recommend staying here.
Excellent apartment, Excellent stay & Excellent host! The place is exactly what is in the descriptive and even better.
We went to Paris for the weekend and had a lovely stay at the apartment. Everything was well taken care off and the communication with Alexis was great. Would 100% recommend.

다른데 볼 필요 없다. 하루빨리 여길 선택하라. She is professional host. Everything is perfect as I expected. Location is perfect and safe. And, I was little sick , but I cleary recovered becasue of advil,cold pills they gived to me very quickly.
Peggy was so nice. She even check up with us from time to time since we arrived quite late due to immigration checking. And the place was AMAZING!

Lovely, stylish and spacious apartment in a perfect location. Our party of six adults, had plenty of space and were able to socialise, eat and drink in the space, as well as sleep. Jean-Daniel was the perfect host, always present and in communication and extremely accommodating. We'll be back. Thank you.
A very attentive host who responds very quickly. The location is wonderful. And one of the most social cats I've ever met 😊

Flat is so close to metro station and transport to insteresting places is so easy.Alexandre told ususso so much good information about traveling and nice places in Paris.Perfect bakery is near the flat.

The apartment was a joy to stay in with its modern facilities. They bed was comfortable, the kitchen easy to use and the bathroom was spacious. The host is quick to respond to any messages and the check-in and check-out was without any problems.
As advertised. Sebastien was very quick to respond. In a quiet area, but very accessible to the center by foot or metro.

Alexandra’s place is simply charming, very authentic & thoughtful, incredibly well situated. I felt at home the minute I walked in and the appartement is certainly appointed to bring ease and comfort. A little gem.

Emmanuel's place was lovely. Easy check-in with Ronald, super clean, well located, comfortable in every respect and a few lovely touches to make you feel immediately at home. We enjoyed it. I'd recommend to anyone, Phil
Sandrine is a great host. The pictures are exactly what you find at her place, and the location is perfect.

Julien was a wonderful host who answered all my questions in a very timely manner! The apartment is in a great location near many shops, cafes and museums. I would highly recommend this apartment for anyone looking to experience the beauty of Le Marais!

Mr.Jean-François is so nice! He is very friendly! He carefully prepared all the things what you need in daily life. His house is clean and beautiful. His room's deco is so cool and so Paris. Everything is perfect. I think that it is a really good choice to live in his house. : )

I had a great few days in Clara's beautifully furnished and tastefully decorated apartment. The views were stunning, and it had everything I could have wanted for my long weekend. I hope I get a chance to visit again soon!
My stay was good, thanks for host ans his helpers. If you choose this apartment, you won't have any problems)

Anna’s home is nice and clean. There are many rooms inside the house. There are a lot of plants and flowers. I am sure that you will love it very much. There are many shops and markets nearby. There is a small elevator too. I love. that cute little elevator.

The flat is located in a very good place for tourists, the metro is close (6-7 minutes by walk). The room is well taken care off and elegant, you will see that there are several details that makes it appealing. we had no problems and Gilbert is a kind person, if you have questions he will be available. Merci!
The apartmenet is nice, warm and very stilish. Perfect for a couple, in the heart of montmatre. Comfortable bed. I would reccomened this place.

Wonderful apartment in such a fab location - really close to Montmartre /Sacre Ceur. Really easy access to the metro line to explore the sights The apartment is huge with three proper sized double bedrooms - it is spotless and has everything you could possibly want - home from home Can’t praise it highly enough - Thank you so much
Very modern and practical. Thank you for hosting us. We had a great time. Xx

Convenient geographical location, there are nearby Metro Line 12 and Line 6, to the relevant attractions are generally less than half an hour; downstairs, there are many supermarkets, restaurants, convenient living; the area is well-ordered, very safe; the room is very artistic, romantic French style.
What a pleasant stay! Great apartment, perfectly located and well equipped! So much better than a hotel room.
Wonderfully located place, nice bedrooms, gorgeous building! Ed was also very helpful when we needed to book an extra night last minute!

It was an exceptional experience. I found exactly what I was looking for a short stay in Paris. A cozy space with everything i needed, very clean and with an excellent location. Giovanni happen to be an exceptional host, always available, concerned and above all, willing to help... I would say a friend i did not know i had.... This space will always be my favorite choice everytime i have to come to Paris. Thank youvGiovanni and i hope to see you soon

The apartment is really incredible, we had a great time there It was very comfortable for 4 couples to stay in the apartment with 3 bathrooms, privacy in one end and grate sitting area to be together The neighborhood is wonderful from a great market street to very good restaurant and museums
We enjoyed out stay at Gilbert's apartment. He is a very nice host and the apartment is beautiful. It has everything you need for a short stay.

Very nice place to stay. The owner is very friendly. The location is amazing close to the Champ elysees. The appartment is very big en comfortable and clean. Higly recommended. Thank you it was all good.

In Peggy‘s apartment you will be greeted with a modern style, comfortable beds not too far from the city center and all it’s attractions and sights. Make sure to ask Peggy, who is one of the nicest hosts I have ever experienced, for tips and tricks on what to see and how to get there. We had an absolutely amazing stay at this apartment!
The house is like small museum to know the home life in Paris. Anne and Ulysee is friendly and communicative. Highly recommended.

The room is great as well as the apartment itself. The area is very safe and classy, there’s many cafes and shops. It’s easy to get anywhere by public transport or just walking. Kathleen is a brilliant host, she helped me a lot! Oh, and The cats are adorable. Totally recommend.

My husband and I stayed for a week and this place was great. Fantastic location, clean and modern. It’s less than 2 blocks away from the metro so it’s easy to get around the city. The location felt safe at all hours. The bed was comfy, the bathroom was very modern and had a towel warmer and the kitchen was fully equipped. This was my husbands first air bnb experience and he really enjoyed it. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Amazing stay at Marianne’s - if you’re coming to Paris, STAY HERE! She is so sweet and kind and serves the most awesome breakfast. Marianne was so inviting and fun to talk to, and was really caring to help us navigate the Yellow Vest protests while we were there. We would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat if we return to Paris!
The place was very clean and cozy. The breakfast every morning was luxurious! We definitely recommend it.

As a party of six, the apartment was more than adequate for our needs. It was also clean, inviting and centrally located. Peggy was very helpful to us in explaining the immediate area and how to steer clear of any potential problems with the recent protests. The listing is highly worth the price.

We enjoyed a wonderful week in Vitalina's french apartment. We had everything we required. Vitalina allowed us to check out late on the last day of our stay in Paris, which was so very kind of her. We will seek to stay again in the future.
It’s a little bit cute apartment, near the metro, the toilet is very small, the owner is a really nice person

This is a fantastic apartment in a great location. The apartment was bright, modern and spotlessly clean. Overlooking a lovely small courtyard, we couldn’t have asked for a nicer introduction to Paris. With one double bedroom and one single, it was perfect for a family of 3. It was only a few minutes walk to the Metro and there were numerous places to eat and drink within walking distance. A walk to the Sacre Coeur is a must and is especially good at night when Paris is lit up below.

the place was very spacious and cozy, and location was superb. You will have everything needed in the place. Kathleen is an amazing host. She let me to check in earlier, and also let me to leave my luggage even after checkout time. I really want to stay again. Definitely recommend.
The location of this airbnb is fantastic! There is a g-20 a couple of steps away to stock up on necessitites, and the metro is also very close and convenient to the location.

PERFECT location. Extremely safe area; tiny space but with all the extra amenities; including a towel warmer:):) ideal for a couple and small children; but two couples would be sleeping in the same open space. Keep it in mind. Host is great:):)
Agnes's place is a great deal if you need a place to crash but you might have a better time at a hostel? I wouldn't know what that's like. Check-in instructions were complicated.
Best location you could ask for. Walking distance to everything you need. Can’t wait to go back. Vincent was an unbelievably gracious host. Ty

We had a great time staying with Gilbert. With my limited amount of French and his limited amount of English we made it work. He was kind enough to leave our bags in the apartment the whole day after we checked out and was always available for suggestions
Having been staying in this apartment for several times. It is definitely my favorite apartment in Paris so far. Everything is perfect and lovely in the apartment, as well as the neighborhood.
It’s a great place, awesome location, lots of books and all equipped! Everything was working and you could feel like home =)
Wonderful, authentic apartment, just steps from Gare du Nord, and metro. Lovely restaurants near by! Vitalina was a great host!

Apartment was centrally located. The apartment was comfortable with daily cleaning service. It was also equipped with a nespresso coffee machine, oven, kettle, washer (also a dryer),fridge and a less commonly seen freezer! Remember to have a chat with the cleaning lady to confirm your cleaning slot! (especially if you prefer to start the day later in the morning.) Do also note that the apartment is located in a street with parallel parking at the sides.

Fabulous location right around the corner from Sacre Coeur and close to three different metro lines which provided a lot of flexibility in transportation through Paris. The room is simple but we didn’t need anything more than that, since we were touring Paris during the day and only staying there at night. Don’t expect any frills but for the price we paid it was decent. Would recommend to those traveling on a budget who are okay with the bare minimum.

We highly recommend this apartment to everyone! Very clean, has everything you need for a comfortable stay! A few towels, iron, hair dryer, shampoo and shower gels. The kitchen also has everything for comfortable use. Very convenient location! Near metro station, shops, cafes. Our favorite cafe is on the corner) Life is real Parisian around, not touristic. Brad was very hospitable! Our flight was delayed, but he was waiting for us and immediately settled! No problems with eviction! Thank you for the wonderful reception!

What can I say... Great apartment! Great location! 10 minute walk from Gare du Nord. Metro station (Poissonnière) basically right in front of the apartment! Also, bakeries and supermarkets are right around the corner. Vitalina is a great host. Kind and friendly. She even let us check-in early (12 am) although the listing said 3 pm. I highly recommend Vitalina and her apartment :)
Quite delightful! A little less spacious than expected, but really great location and fully supports five people!
Good location to museums and Paris center. Quiet building for sleeping but lots of comings and goings during the day. In shopping high end district.

Our family of 4 (with 2 elementary school she kids) had a wonderful week. Great location!! 2 blocks to metro and RER. Lots of places to eat close by. Noise from street below was not too bad, we were able to sleep without an issue. Clean apartment and easy check-in. Having a washer and dishwasher was a huge plus. Dryer didn’t work perfectly and we needed to run it several times before our clothes were dry, but this was a very minor issue that did not detract from a great week.
Our experience at the apartment was excellent. The strongest recommendation we can give is that we would book again without hesitation.

I enjoy Paris very much and the place is very close to where my daughter lives, but it is not a very nice street, the cleaning of the apartment is not very good the bathroom smells bad. The bedroom bed is very good but the second bed is terrible, the host doesn't take the time to explain anything, when we arrive the towels were not ready. I would definitely not repeat the experience at this place.
Wonderful experience; very gentle host. I’m an opera singer and I was able to sing and prepare for my audition in the room. I recommend Gilbert warm heartedly!
This was a great apartment, centrally located along the subway. It is furnished nicely and very comfortable when you come back from touring the city!

Convenient location to get around Paris, very close to the Passy metro. Guy was very helpful, communication and organisation were great. Apartment was so so. Not comfortable for 3 unless 2 share a bed.

Sophie's apartment is beautiful and is situated in a great location. The apartment had everything we needed and we enjoyed a very comfortable stay. I'd be happy to stay here again and would highly recommend it to anyone.

An excellent flat, very accurately listed. We (2 adults, 12 year-old son) loved the place. Everything we needed was included and the washer/dryer allowed us to pack less for the vacation. The espresso machine was the hardest thing to part with when we left. Close to a metro line that made getting around all of Paris very easy. The Rue Mouffetard was great as well - fresh fruit, veggies, pastries, etc. If we ever come back to Paris, we would definitely stay here again. Thanks, Mai!

This apartment is in a superb location close to the centre, river, buses, shops, restaurants, etc. Being on the ground floor in an inner courtyard means that it lacks daylight a bit, but there are plenty of lights inside, and the apartment is secure behind two gates and a front door. It is very quiet. The bed was very comfortable and the kitchen well equipped.

Alexis’ apartment was wonderful. My wife and our 18 and 16 year old rented for the weekend. The apartment was very clean with numerous contemporary amenities. It’s location and description are consistent with its advertisement. The view from the balcony was wonderful and the location was next to the Louvre with plenty of things to do and places to eat. We were comfortable as a party of Four while in the apartment. We would rent Alexis apartment again.
Yann was very responsive and communicative. The location was excellent, close to many metro stops. Check in was super smooth. Only flaw was the shower head was not mounted to the wall.
Sophie's welcome and Sophie's place is 5-star all the way. I feel very comfortable in the apartment. It was beautiful, spacious with high ceiling and tons of natural light. Highly recommend.

What a great find! This apartment is modern, clean, and has a one of a kind location! The host was very easy to communicate with and was very hospitable. When trying the corner around the flat, there are close views of the rider tower as well as plenty of cafes and grocery stores. I would definitely recommend!
The best location!! So close to the Eiffel Tower and cafes! A very cool flat but be sure to take toiletries with you.

This apartment is a wonderful space and located very centrally in Paris to the sights. There is lots of room for guests and two bedrooms that are well placed. There are many restaurants and shops in the area. It is also within easy walking distance of the Louvre and Notre Dame. There are good transportation options nearby including the Metro and bus. We were greeted in person and shown around the apartment. Would recommend staying here!
The flat was stylish and clean exactly as in the photos. It is located close to the metro and ideal for sightseeing.
Place was very clean and is in a great walkable location. Not noisy at all. Our family of 6 stayed comfortably. Would recommend. Note..,one toilet, 2 bathrooms.
Adams Paris apartment is a gem ,everything you need in the way of amenities to feel like home. Steps away to all the sites and metro line close by. Perfect location!
Fantastic location. Ronny was a very nice man. Place is small which is typical in Europe. Has a mini-fridge and new appliances. Elevator was tiny.

A quaint little apartment in a good location. Up to scratch facilities providing everything you may need! Five minute walk to metro which is a short distance to the centre despite being further from city. Also supermarket five minutes away! Would definitely recommend for a short stay in the city of love.
Nice apartment for a family stay, two full baths are a great advantage. Location is amazing. Host is very responsive and accommodating

Wonderful apartments! I was very pleased with everything. Apartments in very good condition, located in one of the best areas of Paris! Very safe, quiet and peaceful. Near many cafes, restaurants, shops and supermarkets. All within walking distance and most importantly 1 minute walk to the subway. The apartments are located in a beautiful building with a good security system! Apartments have everything you need for a comfortable stay. Fully equipped kitchen, bathroom, comfortable bed. Very cozy and clean. From the windows a beautiful view of the roofs of the houses of Paris. Jordan was very kind and always kept in touch. I would like to return to these apartments again!

Peggy is an absolute great host, always quick response, very stylish apartment, close to the Metro, very clean and... We absolutely enjoyed the few days with our family and highly recommend this accommodation.

Great flat in a quite backyard, close to montmartre and good connected by metro. Clean & well equipped. We would definitely come back! Alain was super friendly, answered within 5 minutes and had helpful recommendations.

The location is ideal, 5 - 10 minutes walk to the Eiffel Tower. Quiet neighbourhood. The only problem that we encountered is the issue with the boiler. The host was prompt in responding and trying to fix the problem by telling us to reboot the boiler but we are apprehensive as we don’t want to make the issue worst, unfortunately we had to endure showering with cold water because the problem was not fixed until we left Paris. Hopefully this issue has been dealt with for future renters.

We really enjoyed at stay at Thomas's flat. The location is fab, very close to the tube and to loads of lively bars and restaurants. A short walk to Place de la Republique. Thomas was a great host and communicated well and quickly. Would recommend.

Sebastian's place is so comfortable and is in a GREAT location very close to Notre Dame, Saint Michel, the Louvre and other attractions. But, it is out of the tourist fray and in a quiet neighborhood. Sebastian was so wonderful and clearly explained everything. This is a great value for the price and you should def stay here!

Alice's space is lovely - so well decorated and comfortable, and in a really adorable neighborhood. Do keep in mind that it's a bit far from central Paris, but it was really nice to come back to after a day out in the business of the city. There's an adorable bar across the street that does have chatter into the night especially on weekends, but we actually really enjoyed the sound, and kept the windows open as much as possible to take in the neighborhood. Alice provided really nice teas and lots of great recommendations for restaurants and sight-seeing. Be mindful that you have to be comfortable with climbing up a ladder to the bedroom and crawling into the loft bed, but you can see that in the photos! It was a wonderful place to stay. We were also very thankful for how communicative Alice was - she was a great hostess.
This place is the perfect Paris flat in a wonderful location. Our host, Denis, provided immediate responses to our questions about the area. I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Emmanuel was a great host, super helpful and made check in and out very convenient for us. The apartment is in a fantastic area, we loved it and loved having the terrace as well! It was a perfect place to spend the weekend and would definitely stay again if we get the chance! Thank you

The apartment is well appointed with most of what is needed. The main bed (queen) is very comfortable although the sofa bed less so. There was plenty of ice and cold water available which was wonderful on the very warm days we had. The apartment is close to great restaurants, some shops, cafes and the Metro. Melody was very helpful and responds quickly. 😀

Amazing, modern, clean and very secure apartment with everything you could need and more !! Sophie & Stephane are great hosts and always willing to help you. Location couldn't be better: supermarket just accross the boulevard, restaurants and boulangerie half block from the apartment. Near the most important attraccions and one block from the subway station. I enjoy my stay very much and I'm planning to return to Paris and book this apartment again. Highly reccomended !!
The apartment is clean, quiet, stylish and comfortable. It’s perfectly situated in the Marais and the metro and surrounding shops and restaurants are wonderful.
Charming place, great location and lovely host! Thank you for being a lovely host, Chokri!
Living in this apartment you can expect to be well taken care of, in a gorgeous place with an amazing view from the balconies! No disappointments what so ever.

This beautiful Parisian apartment is perfectly located in the north part of the famous Latin Quarter, just a short walk from the Notre Dam, Rue Mouftard and the Sorbonne. Indeed it is with good reason that Woody Allen chose this street to shoot the time-travelling car picking up Owen Wilson in 'Midnight in Paris'. The apartment itself is decorated with real vintage - all in good french taste. Every morning you'll have to choose between to superb boulangeries conveniently located 2 min away and every evening between 10's of restaurants - all within a 10 min walk. Finally it is with great pleasure that I'm writing this recommendation to Anna and Ulysses - both prefect hosts, kind warm and always happy to help.
This space is perfect for 2 people and in the middle of so many great restaurants and shops. I would definitely visit again!

The accommodation is very nice and typically Parisian. It has a lovely view of Montmartre from the living room and from a bedroom. The house is very quiet and no noise can be heard from the streets. It is on the fifth floor without a lift. There is a bathroom with sink and shower. In another space there is a bathtub and a sink. In the house there is a single toilet in a dedicated room. The location is convenient: you can reach two metro lines (2 and 4) and the Gare du Nord in a few minutes on foot. The neighborhood is very lively and popular, not much beaten by tourists. Nearby there are many shops and places to try food from all over the world. Flore was not present during our stay but she prepared the house very well and was very clear and responsive in the explanations via mail / mobile. Very positive experience, recommended accommodation!

Yann's place is great to stay in; it's close to the metro, in a very nice neighborhood with cafe's and bakeries all around, and the bed is very comfortable! If you plan to stay here during a holiday we highly recommend bringing ear plugs; we stayed over the Labour Day holiday and I think the bar below the apartment didn't quiet down until around 5am --- I believe this is normal, but if you sleep with the windows open and don't have ear plugs you might not get much shut eye (we came prepared though). Overall, it was a great stay! Thanks Yann

FANTASTIC place in a GREAT and CENTRAL LOCATION! Very spacious and clean and actually completely new – I think we were among the very first guests after the renovation. The furniture is beautiful and the bed so comfortable! I loved the paintings and the Parisian look and vibe. The location is just amazing, walking distance to Opera and the Louvre! Denka answered my messages swiftly even if we did not meet her in person but a very kind concierge was there to help us with check-in and our luggage. All just perfect :)
Chachou’s was great to communicate with and very helpful . If the Eiffel Tower is your thing, this is the place for you!
Fantastic stay at Louise's place. Safe location, nice cafe's and restaurants in walking distance. Highly recommend!
Apartment was a perfect ending to our month-long trip to France! Super location, gorgeous views, everything we hoped for and more! Loved it!!

Colette's place is very nice, she is a very sweet and welcoming lady, a Parisian artist. The bedroom is big, very luminous, with its enclosed nice bathroom. The house is in a very nice enclosed court, really beautiful and very quiet. From here it is really nice to enjoy one of the few arrondissement not full of tourists, but still very close to the center. Overall my staying was good, however I did not appreciate the fact that one night, while I was away in my hometown for few days, her daughter slept in my bed where all my belongings where kept, and she did not tell me in advance, but had to find out and did not apologise for it either.

Benoit’s place is in a quiet and lovely neighborhood - near many things we wanted to see and other amenities like restaurants, cheese shops, and train stations. We would definitely stay here again. Benoit is an attentive host.

Thank you for everything, Guy! Thanks to your place we really enjoyed our stay in Paris. The flat is in great area, it takes only ten minutes to eiffel tower, metro is 2 minutes away, so the location is perfect! You will find in the apartment everything what you need, it’s very cosy and clean.

Staying here was great, Hannelore made us breakfast every morning and was so nice to us. It wasn’t too far of a walk from the tourist attractions and she gave us great tips for the city. We had a great time staying here.

Fabulous location, next to metro, grocery etc. Husy street w tons of restaurant, but quiet at night. Very cool building with histofic charm. For those that need an elevator..its halfway up on a landing from first floor so not practical use. There are nice baths, but only 1 toilet

Lovely apartment with the best location. Very stylish and modern and clean. Checking in to check out was a breeze and any interaction with the host was very promptly replied to. Secure premises. Only downside, the bathroom sink area was quite tight . It has a nice kitchen with all amenities and the best was a second guest bathroom. Would definitely stay here again and have recommended to family and friends who are already planning a visit.

My wife and I both had a wonderful experience. Suzie was very helpful with many local tips, and her husband provided us with two custom dinner recommendations and the one we chose was excellent. We would never have found it without his insights and would have fallen into a typical tourist trap without his guidance. All of Suzie's insights were very helpful and we had a great time. The location is excellent, with easy walking to Eiffel Tower overlooks, Metro connection to the city, and train connection to Chateau Versailles and elsewhere. I cannot speak more highly of Suzie or her location.

The location is great and really close to the metro, in a really fun neighborhood. The place is stylish, clean, and well kept. Ronny is an attentive host and explains everything well. Would love to stay there again next time we are in Paris!
Chokri was very accommodating and the space was exactly as advertised and then some. The views were amazing and the location was central to everything. Will stay here again I’m sure.
This flat is the perfect place to be in Paris. Clean and modern. Alexis also gave us some valuable tips. Is one of the best hosts I've had.

Georges's place was perfect. Much bigger than we thought it would be and the location is perfect. We walked from the train station and walked to the Seine, and plenty of cafes right around the corner. You will love staying here!
Marianne is the best hostess I have ever met. It was like to be at home. Thanks for all Marianne. The room is really confortable and paceful.
Fantastic location. Very nice host with excellent communication. The apartment was extremely clean, quite modern with all the necessary amenities.

This apartment is a charming, clean, quiet place from which to enjoy all that Paris has to offer. Just a short walk to the Denfert Rochereau Metro stop, with several nearby grocery stores, bakeries, cafes and so on. We ate a number of meals in the apartment and found the kitchen to be well-equipped with pots/pans, utensils etc. as well as basics such as oil, vinegar, spices and so on. Mireille is a wonderful host - she kept in regular communication as needed, and even offered to show us around the city. A great choice - highly recommended.
Location is great. Quiet even though it's on a main road. Bathroom is clean (though needs more toilet paper). Place is smaller than photos may suggest.

A gorgeous apartment, with lovely amenities, a bottle of wine upon arrival and a gorgeous flower filled terrace to drink it on. Clean and a wonderful shower!!! The neighborhood is great and close to two metro stops. Emmanuel answered every email quickly. We’d definitely stay at Emmanuel’s apartment again.
Francis was very cool & efficient for my stay. The place has everything you need for a solo traveler. Refrigerator/stove was a plus for me.

My perfect place to stay in Paris! I love this location and can really recommend the apartment, exactly as advertised, very comfortable, clean and private. Julien and his family are excellent hosts, I hope to see them again soon!

Big for Paris standards. Exactly how it looks in the pictures. The distribution is very good, they took advantage of every space. I just wouldn’t recommend for old people since the bed is in a mezzanine but super confortable, top quality bed linen. Communication was perfect, great recommendations from the host. People who help her with check in were also very nice and helpful. The location is very safe, in a nice area. I love walking so for me it was perfect, around 2km from louvre
The house is exact the same as its pictures. Tidy place and better atmosphere during night times. Benoit is pretty detailed and he introduced us to a decent restaurant around.
Great little flat with excellent design touches. Host was very nice, prompt, and gave excellent review of all the details of the place on check-in. Very comfortable. Recommended.

What a great apartment! Just as described and even better! Walking distance from 2 metro lines and several bus stops. Restaurants and supermarkets are also walking distance. I would definitely recommend !

Excellent value for the money. Great accessibility to all the landmarks and the street the flat was on was peaceful and quiet at night. The flat itself is spacey, well-equipped, and comfortable. Rebecca was very friendly, hospitable and willing to quickly help us with any inquiries.

Very nice, small apartment. The apartment entrance is in a very busy commercial section of the street but the neighborhood all around is wonderful and the apartment is quiet with no street noise. We would definitely stay here again!

Amazing place, easy check-in, great communication, sparkling clean, and such a great location. What more could anyone ask for?! Everything was planned with great care and made my stay in Paris unforgettable. I will come back to this place again and again!

Francine’s apartment was so beautiful and ideally located. Her private garden is immaculate and adds so much more. She has a love or art and architecture which shows beautifully in her apartment. It was a wonderful treat to stay there.

Staying in montmarte was great. Less hustle and bustlenthan downtown, but still lots of amenities and sites right there in the neighborhood. Easy access to metro to go everywhere. Just need to be able to do lots of steep stairs! But flat was totally equipped. Including windows opening out to here and enjoy the courtyard?
Wonderful place with a very nice french charm. remote controlled bed, modern bathroom and wireless shutters made for a luxurious experience. well worth the price

I spent 1 week here. Julien was a great host. I felt very safe and well looked after. Julien made good restaurant suggestions and there were some welcome extra touches in the room such as a Nespresso machine with pods and milk in the mini fridge. The neighbourhood was safe, close to 2 metro stations and several supermarkets and restaurants. It was an easy walk to Palais des Congres and Champs Élysées. My only criticism is that the room was not “quiet” most mornings and in the evenings, as expected when there are kids in the main apartment. However, great value for money overall.

The apartment is very clean and comfortable, a lot of space and the shower flow is excellent!! Nicolas is very responsive and kind, our flight landed late at night and he met us at the apartment to give us the keys and show the place. Definitely recommended for couples!

This apartment is in the perfect location to see most of Paris on foot ! Local area has plenty of pubs and restaurants ! The apartment had everything we needed for our 4 day stay. Our hosts were very quick to respond, check in and check out was easy.
I highly recommended it. Everything was fine. 5 stars no doubt. Gilbert doesn't speak English very well, but that wasn't a big issue for us.
We loved Alexis’ place so much! The space was modern, clean, and beautiful. Location was great and Alexis was such a cool host!

Nice loft, well designed with a modern feel. Place is bigger than the pictures show. Bedroom is cozy and very quiet at night despite being in a relatively central location (though on a side st). Kitchen is fantastic. Would very much recommend for couples.

It was a very nice room and Sandra san was a very good person. Her partner came to the room immediately when there was a problem. There was a slope and stairs from the station but it was very good. Many thx 😊

Adrien’s apartment was everything that we expected based on the listing. It was very clean,comfortable and spacious. Also, the location was awesome!! We walked most places but when we chose to take the metro it was very close by. I highly recommend this apartment and would love to return in the future. Thank you Adrien and Luka.
it was a great stay and location was good too. Apart was clean with basic amenities.
A charming space perfect for a stopover in Paris. The high ceilings and chic decor make this a wonderful choice for anyone desiring a centrally located apartment.

Seb's flat is great. We had a late arrival, but he kindly waited outside the building to meet us. He explained the space, gave us some tips and responded to messages quickly. The location is very convenient, quiet, and safe. It had everything we needed and being able to do laundry on our last day was a nice plus. If we come back to Paris we'll definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

The perfect place to enjoy the Paris experience! Sophie is a wonderful hostess and made sure we were comfortable in the apartment and in the neighborhood. no thoughts of staying anywhere else if we get back to Paris!

Francine is very nice and she introduced everything in details! The room is stylish and comfortable. It is very close to the metro station. Every time we go out, we can see the effiel tower! The view is very good! We have a very good time here. :)

Best AirBnb I’ve ever stayed in...the decorations / decor made it feel like a real home with a very bohemian vibe to it. It’s 2 stories so it’s unique and lots of space. Would definitely love to stay here again when I come back to Paris. Highly recommend...

Five stars! Merci beaucoup to Denis for being such a great host! Denis was very accommodating with check in time and great with communication. The apartment is in a great location within walking distance to Notre Dame and many local restaurants and shops.
Very friendly and prompt check-in agent. Apartment was well furnished for a rental. Very stylish with everything you’d need for a stay in the city of lights. We would rent again with our family of 5.

The apt is lovely and these hosts offer very excellent devices. They helped us with everything from booking cars to accessing the building earlier than planned. Highly recommend their place. Apt was stunning, it is back facing so quiet but not sunny or bright. Also the neighbors upstairs were very loud, but not in the evening hours.
Everythigs was perfect! It is close to the Eiffel Tower, the Champs Elysees and markets. This area is very safe. Also Jordan has fast feedback. I'd like to stay again:)

Kathleen was super responsive and very helpful whenever I had questions or requests. The Airbnb was in a great location right next to majors sites and metro stations. I was nervous to be traveling in Paris alone but I felt very comfortable here. The two cats were a great added bonus!

I stay in apartments in the Marais to live away from the tourist crowds and get closer to a "local" experience. Likewise, it gives me a chance to sample local living conditions and not hotels. Alexandra’s place has all the ingredients of that goal: 18th-19th century building with an early retrofit of plumbing and electrical work and personal decorating representing the owner. If I was dropped into Alexandra’s apartment I would know that I was in France...no doubt. If I stepped onto the street, I would know I was in Paris and if I walked around the block I would know I was in the Marais. This trip I introduced my grand-daughters (13-15) to their first foreign exposure. If I could show you their daily faces, this review would be complete.

This flat is in an ideal location - close to shopping, restaurants, metro and the Louvre. It was also clean and well appointed. The kitchen and bathrooms are modern. Our host was gracious and quick to answer all our questions. Would highly recommend.
Great studio near multiple metro stops on west side for short stay in Paris. Ground floor so access was easy.

Place was in an excellent location for exploring Paris. Supermarket, patisserie and fromage within easy walking distance. Clara was a good with communication and easy checkin. Only downside is that despite the accommodation being seperate there was no lock and other guests were accessing the dryer and storage cupboard. Just wanted to mention as some people might like to know this.

First of all, Super-excellent location. Spacious interior and full furnished equipment include laundry machine, dry machine, coffee machine, dish wash machine, etc. so, very comfortable to use like a house. Also, Nathalie is very kind and timely hopitality. Really enjoy time in Paris at this house. Strongly recommend!

Loved it here! Clean, beautiful, perfect location & nice amenities. The lower level is accessible by a steep spiral staircase - perfect for my children, but not for anyone who may be a bit frail (my parents - aged 75/77 did not even try to go down). I highly recommend!

Everything was great, Jordan was very responsive and sociable. I was delayed in arriving from the airport, but he waited until I arrived. The apartment has everything you need. The location is excellent, metro and other transport is very convenient, grocery stores nearby. Jordan was always in touch and answered all requests quickly. Thanks, Jordan! Paris is my love!!!

Cedric is so friendly and helpful. The reviews are true. He is a super host. The area of his home is very quiet and so easy to use bus 21 to center of Paris, or metro. He made our first trip to Paris so nice!
A cute room in a nice, calm arrondissement that's connected to everything even though it's not right in the centre. I really enjoyed my stay!

This home is spectacular and a worthy splurge for a trip to the fabulous capital city of Paris. It was a wonderful retreat from areas packed with tourists and an easy commute to all the desired sights. This incredibly stylish home enhanced our visit!

Nice place to stay. The apartment has elevator is very convenient and there’s many shops around also. The apartment is very clean and very comfortable . The host is very nice and give any information you need.
Nice apartment in great location (minus the immediate view). Pleasant hosts and overall as described. Compared with other places I’ve rented in Paris, perhaps a bit on the pricey side, but cute.
It's a nice and cosy place, good Location. A supermarket is 250m away and it's really close to the Eiffel Tower and the Seine. All in all, I'd book it again.
Thank you so much for letting us stay in your beautiful home! We will definitely be back again sometime soon :)

We had a wonderful stay at Jeanne's place. Jeanne was very responsive to us, really lovely, and had lots of great local tips. The house is incredibly cool and comfortable for 4 people. My husband and I visited with my parents, and there was plenty of room and privacy for both couples. The neighborhood is a fantastic jumping off point for seeing Paris, very close to a good metro stop, and lots of cafes are within walking distance. The house is very quiet, clean, with many unique touches. You will feel like a local! Can't recommend Jeanne's place highly enough!

It's a very good choice. Close to the Louvre. And a lot of restaurants nearby. I love the high ceiling. The only caveat is that you have to take 1 flight of stairs. A bit difficult when you have big luggages.
Highly recommend - Great location and apartment is as pictured. A/C units throughout the entire apartment. HighStay was quick to respond to all of my questions. Would stay here again!
Vitalina was an excellent host and the apartment was lovely and homely, great location. Would definitely recommend this gem of a property.

Justin’s place was amazing. Wonderfully designed in a super cool neighborhood close enough to museums and other points of touristic interest, yet also tucked away so that you feel you like you are having a true Parisian experience. Fantastic cafes and restaurants nearby. Justin checked in often and was an excellent host. Highly recommended!

Our stay was lovely. The home is massive with beautiful architectural details around every corner. While the location is busy, it is quiet and off of the bustling street. We would definitely stay here again!
Jordan was a great host. Very helpful and very friendly. The pictures are a good representation of the place. Great area. I would definitely recommend!

Peggy's place was great! The rooms were very stylish and the apartment had everything we needed. Six guests fit comfortably and the 1.5 bathrooms were very useful. The apartment is located right near a metro stop so traveling around Paris was very simple.

Good location and great hospitality from Agnes. Metro is very close. It will be specially great for solo travelers. Her home is an interesting place filled with artworks and books. Thank you Agnes for everything. :)
Location is amazing. Super close to the metro and you can be anywhere in Paris in 30 to 40 minutes. The little town is super cute and has lots of places to visit.
What a great house, location and garden -we really felt Parisian! Jeanne is a great host and made us feel really welcome. Merci beaucoup!

Great stay. Location and apartment are fantastic. View from the balcony is a bit blocked off but it’s a big space for breakfast nonetheless. Lots of supplies for cooking and eating in if you plan for longer stays. Nice touches from Emmanuel, including local tips and food/snacks to come home to. Great host and would stay again.
Jacques flat was very modern and clean, just as pictured. Itś a great, central location. We had an excellent stay.

Nice classic Paris apartment in a great, lively location half a block from the Champs-Elysées. The apartment building is old, but charming. It was perfectly comfortable but we did come during a heat wave and there is no AC. You need to manage the windows properly and utilize fans. It was fine for our family, but be aware that open windows in this location can be loud at night. I personally enjoyed the location and the liveliness, but others may have an issue. The apartment could use some minor repairs, but it was perfectly livable and we had a nice stay. I would stay again, and Nathalie was a great host and responded very quickly to all of my queries.

The place was very compact and nice. Furniture and everything was in good condition. Only downside is the temperature, she informed us after we arrived that AC isn’t allowed. She did have around 5 fans but they didn’t help much. We would wake up sweating all through the night and couldn’t bear to be in the apartment during the day because of how hot it would get inside.
A beautifully appointed apartment, oozing with style in an awesome part of town. Great size and perfect for 3-4people. I'm sure Gabrielle won't allow the same thing to happen to us again ......
Had an awesome stay! Great hosts, the view is amazing! Really quick walk to Eiffel Tower, very close to everything.
