NOT A SECURE BUILDING. Every door is accessible with a keycode, my room was robbed during my stay. Host never replied to my messages or reached out like they initially claimed they would. Do not book if you value safety!
hannelore and her husband were lovely hosts and we can recommend them to anybody who wants to visit paris! the room was nice and perfectly clean.

A superbly designed, modern, chic flat in the heart of trendy Saint Denis. Surrounded by great restaurants, bars, shops and boulangeries, everything is close by, the location and quality of accommodation is fantastic.
Chokri is polite, answers really quickly, flexible, … He meets up with his guests to pass on the key and to give some explanation about the apartment, about the environment, about Paris,…
The flat is beautiful designed, amazing location and view, everything is top class and comfortable. Alexis welcomed us warmly although we arrived two hours late. Highly recommend staying here.
We had a lovely stay with Gerard and Hannelore. The room was nice, the breakfast tasty and plenty and the area super. Paris felt like home

I loved the appartment, location is great and it’s quite luminous and spacious for Paris standards. The bed is not super comfortable though. I also had a problem with the Wifi password, but they manage to send me the right ones within the same day of the check-in. I would recommend the place!

Accommodation has everything what’s needed for comfortable stay. It was a little dirty but still I love the place and especially the area - it’s just perfect ! I had a really great time at this place and will stay here next time in Paris.
Very very lovley appartment with amazing balkony. Good small size and has all what you need around. Chokri is a very kind and gentil host. Many thanks to him! :)
Amazing views, quiet building, convenient layout and well equipped place for a little family. The host was very helpful throughout the check-in process.
We had a great stay here! Really nice Paris apartment in a great location, and good helpful communication from the hosts, would recommend!
Lovely flat, very well located and secure. Perfect for a girls trip! Also great communication.
A amazing location, close to a lot of metro stations. A neighborhood that's really living but not to crowded. Had a nice stay!
We’ve had the most wonderful time at the appartment! It was very clean and it had everything you needed. The location was also perfect!! I would really recommend it!

Great place to stay that was super central to everything. For the price, definitely can’t complain. It was a very small little apartment, but had everything we needed for our short trip. Host was great and communicative as well!
It was a wonderful place to stay. The metro is always nearby and sebastien is a good host and every time available!

We had a good time here. The place was comfortable with a well equipped kitchen. Very quiet at night. It was a convenient location for getting around with shops supermarket and cafes along the street.
Pros Located right beside Gare Austerlitz and the lovely Jardin des Plantes. I stayed as a solo female traveller and felt safe. The kitchen is excellent Cons The bathroom needs updating

The best thing about it - its location. But bedrooms are really small and inconvenient, we were unable to light family room - switches did not work, and Brigitte, that met us at apartment, did not know how to operate a/c ( she said that apartment does not have a/c), did not explain anything about our stay other then how we need to clean apartment and take trash out. We stayed only 3 nights and tolerated all these inconveniences but would not stay in this place next time.

Cristina is very responsive, attentive and helpful. Her apartment is beautiful and looks even better than the pictures. It is equipped with everything you may need. She provided a baby cot for our son, and there was even a little play area for him with lots of toys, which he loved. We highly recommend this place.
The apartment is really nice and the location cannot be better. The owner is always available for a chat. Highly recommended.

The apartment was absolutely amazing. Even better than what you see in the pictures. Anne was very sweet and even had a bottle of rose on ice for us when we arrived as a welcome gift. We look forward to coming back. Merci Anne!

Elise's apartment is wonderfully located among 4 metro stations, next to shops, grocery stores and tons of restaurants, not to mention just a step away from beatiful Marais. The apartment itself is really big and comfortable, beautifully decorated and sparkling clean. Elise was great in communicating and check in was really easy. Will definitely stay again when visiting Paris!
Great apartment, well located, great service, and very thorough daily cleaning. I will definitely use Highstay again in the future.
The appartment was super clean, from the terrasse you can see the Eiffeltower and Emmanuel is really nice. Everything was Perfect and we can really recommend it.

The only problem with this flat is you won’t want to leave and explore Paris. It’s super cozy and extremely well equipped. Great location and proximity to everything. Wonderful AC and great shower for weary travelers. Seb was great to communicate with as well.

Alexander is a great host! Very accommodating and will even offer tips on what to see/do in Paris. The location is great, minutes away from metro, train and bus. The apartment is super cute and stylish. You'll have all you need to make it a memorable stay.
This apartment is amazing. Every detail was considered and it shows. Don't hesitate to book this place. Loved it!
A rather small room but for a reasonable price and in a good location. If you want to stay just a few nights in Paris, this is a perfect choice.

Beautiful apartment in a wonderful location in Paris. We fell in love with Montorgueil and hope to stay in this rental again next time. The place was clean, comfortable and had all the amenities we could want. Alex was thorough in his communication. My only suggestion would be to bring earplugs as the bar downstairs is quite loud until 2am each day. And often there is shouting on the street. No fault of the host, but for a light sleeper, earplugs are a necessity.

Éric and Laure were fabulous, accomodative hosts. The appartment is a great size with lots of natural light, in a very nice, safe part of Paris. I can highly recommend staying at their place. Thank you for having us!
We had a very good time staying here! The appartment was super clean, cozy and pretty. Would definitely stay here again in the future.
Overall this is good for staying. If you have luck, you can see Eiffel 🗼 but I didn't. It depends on floor you stay. A little noisy but recommendable.

This place is situated in a very nice area. You can easily go around Paris from here. This place is clean and well equipped. Jordan has been quite helpful and accommodating. I had a great stay here :)

Very nice apartment, and the location is perfect. Would stay here again. One note: be aware there is only 1 toilet, 2 bathrooms, but only 1 toilet. We were 4 in the apartment, so it's okay, but if you were 8, then 1 toilet is not enough.

This apartment is clean, decorated perfectly for an Airbnb, and the location in the 15th is amazing. The value is unparalleled in Paris, and we will happily stay there again. Definitely have dinner at the la casse noix a few doors down; this unpretentious Michelin star restaurant was the best meal we had in Paris. Merci Vanessa ♥️ à la prochaine

This lovely flat is in the best possible location in Paris. It is in a very picturesque area peppered with many little tree shaded squares covered with café tables or even a roundabout, lots of restaurants and little shops (Rue des Martyrs in particular is not to be missed). The tube station is a few minutes walk though a truly lovely little park with a bandstand, children playing, a wilderness area, and along it a small fruit and vegetable market on Fridays. The area is lively yet not busy or noisy feels very genteel and civilised. Being within walking distance of the Sacré Coeur and Montmartre beyond is of course an added bonus. The flat itself is spacious and quiet, full of traditionally parisien character with a balcony and a truly exceptional view. Overall a total delight, highly recommended.
Alex was a great, fast communicator. Security was great at the apartment and was perfect for me.
Even though I wasn’t at this hotel, I was relocated ! Their customer service is really good and I am really happy of my stay anyway.

Just WOW! Brilliant sunset views from the balcony in an incredibly central and peaceful location. Perfect for a long weekend romantic getaway in Paris, in an elegant and luxurious apartment. Alexis was extremely helpful and always available throughout our trip, and offered us some great tips to help us enjoy our stay! Would highly recommend.

Clean and functional apartment. No A/C but some good cross-ventilation is created with the many windows available. It's nicely located on a quiet side street but within easy access to all the Marais has to offer and beyond.
This is a great place near Eiffel tower, very walkable and quiet. Francine was very attentive, she has a very nice apartment with a comfy bed and living room. Very nice place to stay.

It was a pleasure to stay here! This place is beautiful and in a fantastic location! Julien was very accommodating throughout my stay and was especially understanding when I got my check out date wrong! This will definitely be my 'go to' place for my monthly trips to the office.

Beautiful apartment in a central area of ​​Paris. Sophie welcomed us in a wonderful way making us feel at home. Everything can be reached on foot or by public transport. Safe and well served area. The hosts are friendly and helpful. Thanks for everything!

Extremely cozy flat, located in the very heart of Montparnasse. Within 5 minutes range from the RER & with a grocery store right next door – super convinient. I have enjoyed my stay a lot, many thanks to Clara's hospitality.
It’s an awesome experience and in an great location where you can go many places. We love the place and had a great time during our stay.

Anne & Jean-Luc are the best hosts. They gave us a quick tour to ensure we have everything we need for our stay. Jean-Luc went above and beyond from helping us take our luggages to/from the apartment to getting us a taxi to take us to the airport. The place has so much character and is centrally located. We felt very welcomed and delighted to be in their hands/apartment. Thank you, Anne & Jean-Luc! Wish all hosts are like you.
Great location and host! Our flight was early, and we were able to drop off our bags before check-in. Location is ideal for seeing the sites, and highly recommend the scooter rentals nearby.
This place is in a great location and it is a really good value. The owner was very responsive.
Great place to stay, close to the Eiffel tower and near some restaurants. The place has a balcony with a great view and a wonderful host who had great communication with us.

Very nice stay. The flat was clean, with a wonderfull view on Paris. We found there all we needed for our stay and the host gave us all the info to check in even after midnight. I’ll come back there with pleasure in the future ☺️
Great communication, great location, great space. We had everything we needed for the stay and appreciate your help!
Great location and really nice and clean apartment! This was probably the best airbnb we ever stayed in.

Sandrine's apartment worked very well for us and we loved the comfortable bed and good shower especially. It was in a great location right near both the RER and the metro with a very nice grocery store right downstairs! Less than 30 minutes to Versailles on the RER. Outdoor cafes are everywhere. It had everything we needed.

Location is great to move around in Paris, Clara responded very fast and the apartment is exactly as described. Two bedrooms, one bath, and a kitchen + livingroom. We were four adults and it felt comfortable. The place was clean. We had breakfast and (often) dinner at the apartment.

10/10 would recommend. Aude has a lovely apartment in the best area in Paris perfect for a couples getaway. Great communication, nice and clean, great balcony, easy check in and check out, the list never ends! We loved staying there, it completely made our trip, we would love to come back. Thank you Aude!

The flat is located very well - next to a cosy quarter with many cool local cafes and restaurants, but also within walking distance to the center. Cedric was a great host - very friendly and helpful. I will remember this place for my next stays in Paris.
Beautiful apartment with a fantastic view in the heart of Paris. Responsive host. Would happily stay again.
Excellent hôtel for this price. The wifi is bad, just good for basic browsing

Clara is a very nice host. The communication with her was very smooth. The flat has very French atmosphere and beautiful light and views. And it's full of books about art :) The address is very convenient as it has good connection to everywhere.

The apartment is one of the most beautiful places I have seen with so much attention given to detail. It is a real joy to stay there and everything needed is available. Benoit is great! He provides lots of suggestions and helpful guidelines to make you feel at home at all times! The Montmartre surrounding is attractive with great links to transportation and supermarkets close by. A real treasure to recommend!

anne and jean-luc are incredible hosts and very responsive. the apartment has been in the family for multiple generations and the building has amazing history. that said, if you are looking for a more typical, minimalist / modern listing, this is probably not your place. the location is very central and hard to find better especially at this price point in paris. within minutes of the metro 7 line and the seine. close by is the sorbonne so plenty of bars, restaurants and even the neighborhood farmer’s market on saturdays.

Great apartment in Central Paris! Close to 2 metro stations with good access to lines on both RER and metro as well as walkable to many popular sites. Several good restaurants nearby and places to buy groceries. Showers work well with plenty of hot water. Host was responsive and friendly. it was great size for 3 or 4 people. Quiet at night, secure building. Would stay here again.

Wonderful centrally located apartment in a safe & secure building. This was our second time staying and we can’t imagine anywhere else when we visit. It is walkable to several major sights including the Louvre, Opera Garnier, Palais Royal, Tuileries Gardens and more! There are multiple Metro stations nearby which makes the address well-connected to get around the city with ease. The host, Sophie, is a joy to work with and available to provide recommendations and assistance. Looking forward to our next visit!
Great place, absolutely as being described with an amazing view on the city. Even though after having stayed in Paris so often in the past this place was very special. Thank you Ygal
Vanessa was an awesome host. The location is awesome, walking distance to the Eiffel Tower, a market and great restaurants. Beware of the taxis on bikes....huge scammers.

Great stay! The apartment is renovated, it has nice windows, very clean, very well stocked kitchen, comfortable, quiet and close to metro station. Would not hesitate to rent again for a stay in 18ème.
The apartment is absolutely perfect. Great location. Right in the heart of everything but the apartment itself is lovely and quiet.
Location is very comfortable. Place is quite and clean. It was easy to get in and communication along the way was amazing.
The apartment is great, very charming in person. The location is very trendy at the moment with lots of great spots to eat and drink nearby. Lovely stay!
Was very Good organization for meet me. Flat it’s extra big and clean. I recommend this flat and owner was all the time friendly and very fast answer)))

Aurélien’ s apartment was a perfect place to stay in Paris — bright, clean, quiet, and centrally located. Check-in and check-out were simple and the flat is walking distance from the marais, with lots of shops and restaurants nearby. I enjoyed my time there.

A nice apartment in a lovely little neighbourhood and near a wonderfull park. Public transport is nearby. The apartment has all the basic needs for a pleasant stay. The beds and the shower are good. Communication with Giovanni is quick.

It was a very nice appartment perfect for two people. Clean and spacious. You could go anywhere in Paris very fast. The only problems was that the building outside of the appartment was in a bad state and the neighborhood was a little bit dangerous late at night but it had lots of option for good cheap food for paris standards. The host was polite helpful and organized. He could answer anything about paris monument, transportation, option for food in the 10th paris appartment. All in all its close to the centre cheap and nice inside.
Nice, clean, modern apartment in the center of the of the Paris! I had nice experience! Highly recommended!

As many have already communicated, Anne & Jean-Luc are exceptional hosts. They really go above and beyond to make you feel welcomed and comfortable. Their apartment is very spacious with everything you could need for an enjoyable stay. The location couldn’t be better. It’s in a central location yet it’s quiet at night. I highly recommend this Airbnb!
It was a normal stay. The beds and amenities were appropriate. It seems like the place is in need of a renovation. However, it is very well located, right in the middle of Paris.

One of the best places I’ve ever been. Close to everything, easy to check in, in a very nice neighborhood, comfy bed. We didn’t have the chance to meet Sandrina but she was always answering my questions and offering help. 100% recommended.

We had a great weekend in October here with our 10 year old and 7 year old. The location was great in many ways - just round the corner from super street of food shops and lovely rue des abbesses which was very buzzy and lively - transport is also great and its a nice walk (30 mins or so) from Louvre etc. It was noisy on Friday and Saturday nights if sleeping in the living room (which will be necessary if more than 2 of you) but the windows are double glazed and when close properly they keep out most of the noise. Was fun to be in such a busy, buzzy part of town though - especially after the boredom of lock down!! Julian is great, very quick to respond to questions and feels like you are in his home enjoying his hospitality. Highly recommend.
Unfortunately we had to cancel due to illness in the family but communication with Élise & Sébastien was great during the entire process - hope to visit some other time!

Location of the accommodation is perfect, but we found the overall experience not so perfect. Small rooms are to be expected in Paris, however without proper ventilation it becomes ‘airless’ quickly. Place would benefit from a proper make over. Communication is quick and straightforward.
The views out the windows were amazing. It was very centrally located and close to everything. Climbing all those stairs was quite the workout.

THIS STAY WAS PERFECT!! Can't recommend it enough. Remarkably quiet, so spacious, incredible decor and design, but most of all the location is incredible. Very short walking distance to great restaurants, coffee shops, bars, groceries - EVERYTHING. The host was so kind, great communication. We stayed for a month, and it was a perfect landing place to work, and also come back to and land after adventures.
Great location and communication. Beautiful, light-filled afternoons, and Julien was very flexible around check-in and check-out.

A well located, cosy apartment close to a metro station and the many bars and restaurants of Montmartre. The area is vibrant and lively and the apartment is perfectly located to take advantage of all Paris has to offer.
Thank you very much. We had a perfect stay in Paris. The apartment could not have been nicer. It was clean, the hosts mega accommodating and friendly. Perfect!

I ended up not staying at Charlotte’s since I booked without seeing clearly I could not come with my pet. I've contacted Charlotte several times but I was never reimbursed. She insisted that the “no pet” rule is well indicated on the site, which I still have not seen Overall, I'm incredibly disappointed! My number +41793916818 Nadia Charlier

This apartment is so charming and cozy and in a central area with access to everything! Cafes, patisseries and the Marche des Enfants Rouge (Paris’ oldest market) around the corner. The apartment itself has everything we needed for our week’s stay. The beds were comfortable with fluffy pillows and duvets and we loved all the art, books and cds that Alexandra has available. We enjoyed our stay and can recommend it for others who want to stay in Le Marais.
Great apartment. Everything you need is there. Very clean. The communication and arrival/departure with the lockers is superb

The place is fantastic. Perfect location, nice size, clean and well furnished. Check-in and communication was flawless and super convenient. It's a perfect place for a family or a small group. Can highly recommend and looking forward to coming back.

Great apartment that had everything my partner and I needed for a weeklong stay in Paris. Amazing, walkable location in the heart of the Marais. The apartment is on the fifth floor with no elevator/lift, but the private terrace overlooking Parisian rooftops is more than worth the hike. Super easy check-in and checkout + a responsive and kind host made for an exceptional experience. Thank you, Chokri!

Sandrine's place is located in very cool "foodie" neighbourhood in Paris, near by Sienna river and very close to Eiffel tower. App.is well connected to public transportation (metro and train stations just arround the corner) as well as rent-a-car company literally in front of the building. 24-h gym and 2 swimming-pools are in 100 m radius from the appartment. It's also great value to have a food-market situated in the building. The app.is fully equiped as presented in the picture, cery clean and well-maintained. We appriciated free coffee, tea bags and bottles of water upon our arrival. Would for sure reccomend this place, especially for its lovely location in regards to eating out -variety of international cousines (restaurants&street food corners, pasteries, etc)..

We stayed there with my family for 2 weeks and it was great. The amenities were super convenient, especially the dryer which is rare is Parisian apartment. The neighborhood is great with lots of great shops for food. If I had the complain about one thing is the size of the bathroom sink.

Alexandre’s appartement is a great place to discover Paris. It spotless clean and the location is great. If you’ve packed your running or light hiking shoes you can discover most of Paris on foot. The district is very lively and great restaurants and supermarkets are around the corner. In short: Would come back any time.

lovely little apartment. It has everything you need for a nice vacation. The location ist nice as well, just a few minutes walk from two subway stations and there is a supermarket and several bakeries nearby.

The apartment is small, but big enough for 1-2 person and very cozy. The apartment has everything you need for a lovely stay. Top location near metro station. Several cafes and bars in the neighbourhood. Check in was easy, also the communication with Anthony. Highly recommend

Alexandra’s place was a quiet and relaxing delight in the middle of the busy city. Beautiful cozy place filled with artful details. Check in and communication were smooth. We absolutely hope to come back and stay here again soon. Thanks again, Alexandra!

Great location, beautiful apartment, comfy beds with nice duvets and pillows. Very friendly staff when leaving the keys and showing the apartment. The only remark I have is that it should be more clearly stated that there is only one toilett eventhough there are two showers. We we’re 2 couples, one with three teenagers - we managed but info beforehand would have been good. Still, I strongly recommend the apartment and area - five star!

Really pleasant place and amazing location. Sébastien was great with communication and giving recommendations. So nice to have the washing machine. Really nice neighborhood with wonderful restaurants. Had some smoke coming in front the restaurant downstairs one night.

Gorgeous location which gave us perfect launching point to explore. Laurent wasn't in the country so we liased with his contact. She was lovely but minimal communication could be had with her. But everything still worked out really well. Apartment is cozy and although on a busy walking street, it was still quite chill and quiet. It isn't a silent apartment by any means, however. It did have everything we (a couple) needed and was perfect for our needs. Thank you Laurent.

Wow! This is probably the best apartment you can get in Paris. It was just perfect - there is nothing you could have done better. I would highly recommend staying in this apartment during your Paris holidays! You can reach always reach Alexis, he also is very flexible regarding check-in and check-out times and to be honest, I’ve never seen an apartment being as good equipped as this one.

This place is an excellent central location to explore the Parisian life. Placed in a quiet area walking distance to 3 metros with plenty of restaurants and bakeries around. Dominique is a most gracious host that walked us through the flat and was available anytime we needed something even as small as an electric cord.

Very nice apartment close to the Eiffel tower, situated in a very nice neighborhood with a lot of shops and good restaurants. The only issue we had was that there is a smoking area just outside the apartment.

Benoit is the most exceptional host one would expect. My review could never do this justice. Not only do you get the most magnificent view, but his apartment his extremely cozy and filled with so much soul - you can tell that the host has great taste in culture from different parts of the world. I’ve recommended it to my family and friends, and I highly recommend it to you - dear reader. The streets below are incredibly vibrant and filled with culture - you will never be bored! I would also like to highlight Benoit’s great care and communication throughout our entire stay. He always asked for feedback and made sure our stay was lovely and comfortable. 10/10 we will do our best to visit again! Thank you for everything, Benoit!

The four of us were in Paris from Friday to Sunday. We hit it very well with Jean-Luc's apartment. The apartment is very centrally located - in the middle of the action. It has many shops and restaurants nearby - also to buy a good meal. The apartment is nice and practically furnished and it has everything you need. I suppose we weren't there for the last time.
our stay was great. this place is stylish and bright, location is amazing and host is very nice to talk to!

The place was nice and very close to the train station that takes you right to the airport, that was convenient for us. It was clean and the location is great. The pictures make it look bigger that it actually is and it was a little tight for 4 people. Overall I was happy with the place and I recommend it.
everything runs very good, Agnes is a nice person, you feel very privacy and good location.
A lovely place to stay :) The bed was very comfortable and it was in a great location. Sophie was so very kind and made the check in and out very easy.

Lovely apartment in a fantastic location very close to sacre couer, perfect for two people to relax. There were a few odd looking marks on the wall and the cleaners have obviously not cleaned behind the taps for some time but otherwise the apartment was in very nice condition.
Impeccable, faultless stay. Flat is spotless with a comfortable, spacious room and a central location. Quiet at night. Monique was a fantastic, welcoming and friendly host. Highly recommend
Apartment is in a perfect location, clean and has everything that you need. Alex was very flexible and allowed us to leave our bags which was much appreciated. Would recommend

Jordan's place is very conveniently located in the posh 16th arrondissement. The building in which the "chambre de bonne" (former maid's room on a 6th floor with a great view) is located is very pretty. The metro stop Victor Hugo is 2 minutes away. I very much enjoyed in the studio because it provides you with an authentic experience of what it must have been like to live above your employers' quarters on the top floor of an imposing building. The space as such is clean, it is exactly as depicted in the pictures, there was ample storage space and the WiFi connection was very good. I recommend it! The host was very responsive. Overall, a very good experience.
Host is friendly and helpful. Her place is well decorated, clean and convenient. Strongly recommend for family of 4 or for 2 couples .

Nice apartment for a short stay (2-3 days). Comfortable bed and shower facilities. Top location right next to everything. On the minus side, the internet is very slow and not much space to put clothes/suitcases.

The penthouse is in an amazing location with stunning views. The layout is ideal for two couples. Our only complaint is that there was no response from the host regarding a hot water issue in the second bathroom. Other than that, a great stay.
A great location the best The apartment space is very well organized. 3 levels with all the facilities
Excellent location. We had a little issue regarding the blankets but it was easily solved and the communication was very positive. Thank you

Lola’s apartment is very cozy and spacious. I was in town for work and really appreciated good wi-fi speed, comfortable workplace and stylish decor. The kitchen has everything you might need when cooking, there is also a washing machine. Everything is as described in the listing. Lola was always helpful and in touch. The location is also good: there are caffès and grocery stores right next to the building. I didn’t have any problems while staying at Lola’s place. I highly recommend this apartment :)

This room is very close to everything. Very nice area and the host were very nice and helpful. For the location and price, you can’t beat it. Bed was a bit small for me (I’m 6ft2/1.88m) but it didn’t bother me much. Overall excellent experience! I would stay with them again the next time I’m in Paris!

A perfect place for my son and I in an otherwise hectic schedule, Cristina's apartment was bright and light and airy and perfectly comfortable and quiet. It's also extremely well situated, which meant getting out and picking up bits and pieces and going around seeing Paris was easy… but we spent very lazy mornings totally happy to sit and look out over the rooftops. Really lovely being met by Bruno in the street outside the apartment block and shown everything, Cristina was also extremely good at communicating before — and during — our stay. I couldn't have asked for a better place to be honest. I hope we can stay the next time we come (and the time after, and the time after that…).

Wondering apartment with a big elevator, no worries about your luggages. Great communication with the host. They are being so helpful and welcome. Very quiet at night and with the motorized curtain, we slept very well in the morning. highly Recommend.

Best place in Paris! Spacious, well equipped and clean. This apartment is magnificent, located in a treasure of Paris full of shops, cafes and locals. Book now and it will be the best decision of your trip : )

Just a lovely, cozy stay! Very close to great cafés and restaurants, groceries, and metro stations. The communication was terrific and it was perfect. I would stay there again, and recommend without hesitation!
Llana was a perfect host , with clear and careful communication The place was very clean, stylish and had all one needs Truly recommended

First off, Jean Philippe is great! I came with a dear friend and we both enjoyed our stay. The bed is comfortable, and the space is intimate. The city view is charming Parisian. There is a pleasant cafe below the apartment with great food. I recommend this place for great memories. Thanks!
Everything was perfect and clean! Very well communicated, there was a metro station super close (nation).
Really nice cozy room for that price. The street is laude so I recommend war plugs. The host are really friendly and welcoming.

I was extremely impressed by Jordan. His kindness and generosity was second to none. I like ... He went above and beyond with his generosity to help facilitate my requests (early drop off lugages and LOTS of other stuff) and showed genuine interest and support in my experience in Paris. He was very accommodating and very quick to respond with any questions. The place was very clean and had all of the necessities for a few night stay. I felt safe, like home away from home ! I will definitely come back for sure
The most amazing Parisian apartment! Everything was so well kept and beautifully decorated. Can’t wait to come back to Paris to stay here again!

My friends and I loved the place. We were a party of 5 and fit perfectly! The apartment is well located and easy to access. It is really cosy and clean. Vanessa was a great host and I would definitely recommend and come back

Very nice short term stay here! The secluded room with own exit and bathroom was very convenient to come and go. Place is right near multiple metro stations to get into the main part of the city quickly. Joan and Sophie are very kind and helpful! Would stay here again!
Giovanni was a nice host and gave great tips to explore the quiet and green neighbourhood. He was very relaxed and helpful. We would recommend his air bnb! :)

Josephine's Airbnb was amazing. The property is homey and cozy and makes you feel like you're a local. Place is super clean, kitchen and bathroom are modern, and the wifi was great. If I moved to Paris I would want my apartment to be like Josephine's! It's also in a great location - 5 minute walk to the Louvre, the subway is literally right outside the door, lots of bars and restaurants around. My particular favorite was Motors Coffee across the street (Great coffee and their cookies are to die for!). I will 100% be staying in Josephine's place the next time I am in Paris!
everything was OK ! a bit noisy area! everything is well organized, the apartment is very beautiful! there was not enough washing machine, but I read about it when I booked)

This apartment is a great find—spacious, chic, quiet, a lift! It is located very close to buses and the metro, shopping, and tourist destinations. The host is gracious and check in was very easy. We had to work a little and there’s a wonderfully large table in the living room near the windows. We would stay again.
Do yourself a favor and book this place! The Airbnb was absolutely incredible. Centrally located with amazing views and beautiful decor. Everything was perfect and made Paris so much better!

This Airbnb felt more like a hotel room than an apartment, but lacked the necessary essentials and cleaning protocol. The shower had hair from a previous renter, and there was no hand soap in the apartment! The apartment is smaller than it looks in the photos and the neighborhood is quite loud at night, and we were woken up by construction every morning.
The landlord is very friendly and this apartment is not far from the subway station .It's very convenient.

The apartment is fully equipped and very good located, in a quiet area close to a lot of restaurants, bakery, supermarkets and public transport. Communication with Nicolas is very easy, he helped us to enjoy our stay. Highly recommended!
Great location with easy access to all location and the area is beautiful! Thank you for everything and for been such a great host.
Perfect location to visit the city. Great spot to stay, very clear communication by the host. Not a single problem of issue. Top

The location was central and it was clean, but the check in process was not smooth. Nobody was there to meet me and the entry to the building and the apartment were both complex and frustrating. Also, small things were just annoying. For example, there was only 1 roll of toilet paper, toaster didn’t work, stove was challenging to figure out and there was no sugar for coffee or salt or pepper for meals. It just missed the mark for me. I expected more for the amount of money I paid. It could have been so much better, if there was a personal touch. I would not stay here again.
Nice, bright, comfortable apartment and a very helpful owner. We had a great time! Very close to the subway, restaurants, shops. I recommend this place for a holidays.
It was a great stay. Very good communication, the guide was helpful read it and it will not disappoint. Very clean and had everything we needed.

Cristina was a fantastic host and really made this our best Paris stay! She was very helpful and had a great communication style. Very prompt and understanding and accommodating to our slightly later check in. Her apartment was just the best you can picture for a Paris apartment - centrally located, with great taste and everything you’d need. The most comfortable beds we had for our whole trip (across five stays) and we enjoyed those lovely view in a lazy mode sitting in her living room looking out of the window. Would def recommend!

We enjoyed our stay. The apartment was clean and quiet, with an excellent location. We found the online pictures a bit misleading, as they didn't indicate that the toilet was separate from the bathroom, on two different floors, and that the steps to the bedroom were very tricky.

Very convenient location, just next to Grands Boulevards subway exit. Walking distance (within 20-30min) to most sightseeing spots and shopping areas. Functional kitchen allows you to cook simple stuff if you are staying longer, which I did. There are supermarkets nearby (3-5 min walk). Lots of restaurants in the area. Recommend to try Accents and Bistrot Kinzo, both serve great lunches. Pleasurable stay :)

Great apartment with a wonderful view of many sights in Paris. Small elevator up to the seventh floor, but great access with public transport. Close to many good restaurants and some grocery stores at hand. Overall a great place to stay in Paris.
Our stay was wonderful, great location and the apartment is just as it looks in the pictures! It had everything we needed and the communication with Paul was great!

cozy place in the heart of Montparnasse. very well connected with all the city, it's easy to walk to almost every point of interest. Jean is available for every need and the check in procedure is perfectly explained in every detail.

We had a very nice stay at Luke’s apartment. It has everything you need, and is located in a nice neighborhood close to shops, restaurants and metro. Luke was always available on text, and was very helpful if we needed anything. Would stay here again, and definitely recommend.
Apartment perfectly located near the famous Arc de Triomphe! A few metro stations located nearby. Very clean and Jordan was extremely accommodating and communicative.

Cosy, well-furnished studio, modern appliances, close to transportation and to many cultural attractions. Nice restaurants, markets in the area. Very reasonably priced. Hostess is very easy to communicate with.
Alexis place is a gem. I have never stayed anywhere better in the world. I look forward to returning soon and have already recommended his place to a number of friends

I really enjoyed my stay with Hélène. My room and bathroom were clean, cozy, and comfortable. The location was amazing, very close to everything - close enough to walk to the Seine. I loved having the chance to talk with Hélène and Alain who were so friendly and hospitable. It could not have been better!
Loved staying here. Loved that I had my private entrance! Nice and cozy! Clean! Very sweet people! Thank you so much for everything!
Lovely studio, very well located and equipped. I had a great stay and Rita has been very helpful & responsive. I would definitely book again.
Great location and clean apartment. Definitely nice place to stay in while in Paris. Would recommend.
Great stay and location! They even helped my friend carry her bag up 5 flights of stairs. The neighbours were noisy which was the only issue but would recommend this as a place to stay.

The place was very comfortable, near to the metro and bus stations, there are supermarkets, restaurants around. The place was nice and clean. We extended our stay as we were very happy to be there. Very recommended!
This is a really nice place. Wonderful apartment. I have a very good time in here. The internet is so good and the best location. I hope I can live here next time.

The location is excellent, and we were very grateful for Chokri’s quick communication and flexibility with check-in time. The apartment needed a deep clean (lots of dust and cobwebs in corners, but bedding and bathroom were clean) and some easy repairs (especially to the bathroom door), but overall was a comfortable little studio. We spent a lot of time out on the little balcony watching the vibrant street below. Stairs are no joke, but the view is well worth it.

Amazing location, very clean, and VERY quiet which is a true rarity. The beds were exceptionally comfortable as was the bedding. All the basics were ready for us (soap, bathroom items, kitchen). Jean-Luc provided clear entry directions and contacted me before the trip to organize logistics. Perfect for travelling alone, with a friend/partner, or a small family of 3.

A wonderful light filled apartment. Surrounded by books and paintings and a full kitchen you are in a cared for home. If you want a more sterile, un-lived in apartment, new rental apartment, this is not for you. This is a home. The location is perfect. Plenty of cafes, boulangeries, petits magasins, all you could need. Convenient to metro, and great walking streets. Loved it.

Convenient & safe/Quiet building/3 floors up/Not luxurious but great casual apartment & Alex communicated very well. I was working for two weeks in the area. It is very close to Mount Marte but also to the more seedy Moulin Rouge area-it has everything-like any city you have to be careful but the building is gated & safe & close to the metro & several great restaurants.

We were not greated at arrival. The owner expected us to call him though no phone number was given. I had given mine, but he did not bother to check: we waited 40 minutes in the pourring rain!! Not a good start: We had to have Air b&b call him.The appartement is very confy, though. Because it’ s a ground floor there is less light and more noise from outside than a top floor.
The apartment is perfect. Clean, comfortable and spacious, it is in an ideal central location and because it’s situated on a courtyard, it’s very quiet. I very much recommend this place.
A beautiful apartment in a perfect location. The hosts were so accommodating and helpful. We’ll be back!
Amazing stay, Elise and Bastien were very attentive and communicative. Home is exactly as the pictures and impeccably cleaned. Also close to the metro and bar areas. Highly recommended.
Really nice apartment. As a family of four (with two boys aged 8 and 10), we enjoyed our stay here very much. A spacious apartment in a good location with attentive hosts.

This place is brilliant!!! The location is literally a 7 minute walk to the river and Norte Dame. A great bakery around the corner and lots of cafes and restaurants and little shops. Anne was just lovely. She met us at the flat and even had a nice bottle of wine when we arrived. The house is gorgeous and just really beautifully decorated. We ate out every night but the kitchen did looked stocked if you wanted a night in. But honestly the massive lounge was just prefect to unwind and have a glass of wine (plus there was a stocked wine rack with prices on the bottles if needed) before heading out or a night cap when you got back. Was perfect.
Splendid apartment with modern equipment in kitchen and bathroom John is a great host Very enjoyable stay
Great place. Nice and central! Would stay again, big enough, elevator is a huge plus!

This apartment is in a cute neighborhood where you feel right at home. Metro, shops and restaurants are close by. The apartment is clean, beds are fine, and the big bathroom is very nice! 10/10 for communication

I rented the apartment for two weeks and had a great time in Paris. Super well located!! The apartment has everything you need to stay for a long time. The neighbour can be noisy but Eleanor takes care of it. She has been a marvellous host ! If I need to go back to Paris for a long stay I would definitely try to book it again !

Paul was an amazing host with above and beyond communication, and immaculate studio, and this particular location is within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower, great shops, and cafes. A particular highlight is the family owned Italian Neapolitan pizza place within steps from the BnB - the best pizza I’ve ever had!

The place is excelent in terms of location and has all you may need. We loved the view and decoration. However, the bed is not comfortable and it is really really noisy (for the price, we expected a lot more of it) . It is very close to the Eiffel Tower and to many restaurants.
Location, location, location - couldn’t be better. Great size. We took our 5 year old and 5 month old and it was perfect. Had everything you need. Would happily stay again.

The apartment is located right in the heart of Le Marais! It is very cozy, and has all the things for a comfortable stay. It was super clean when we arrived. Chokri was very responsive and accommodating when we needed to check in a bit early!

great location and apartment layout, perfect for 4 people. the check-in was easy and the house looked better in real life than in photos, which was a nice surprise. :) the only thing I'd upgrade would be new bedsheets, as one set was a bit old and stained. the other one looked new. other than that it was perfect, thank you!

Every thing was just perfect. The apartment is very confortable and very well equipped. Location is great, very closed to attractions , restaurants and public transportation. We would recommend this to family and friends

Bad value for the money. Shower is difficult to climb out of, not suitable for anyone bigger or taller. Room is very small, so not recommended for more than 1 person. Ps. This is a hotel, so check-in was very smooth. Host was very nice and communicative though!
This is a very nice location, with easy access to many sites in Paris. It is modern, clean, and very comfortable.

Had a great stay. Checking in felt a bit like solving a puzzle but after I got done with I had no problems with anything. The location is really nice with metro being close and the room was clean and quiet.

This flat was brilliant for our weekend in Paris. Great location for wandering around Monmatre, a good amount of space and a comfortable sofa bed. Fun bars and restaurants within 5 minutes, just a walk from Sacre Coeur and easy to get into central Paris - we walked to get down to the Seine and the main tourist attractions but also noticed that public transport is nearby. All in all, a fab city break basis for a great price.

This place is great, clean, pictures are accurate and the location is great, very close to two metro lines taking you to city centre very quickly. You can book this place with closed eyes, you will not be disappointed!

Wonderful location. Quiet but in the heart of Paris. Wonderful walking neighborhood. Comfy beds, good kitchen and like others have said good showers. No elevator and some stairs so if you’re older or have a big suitcase, take note. Very safe building with nice restaurants around. Would stay again!
What an amazing place. The location, the all-day great light, the homey decor. If you always wanted to know what it is like to live like a Parisian, this is a great offer.

Sabine's place is the cutest paris apartment, ideally located in the Marais on a quiet street close to everything. The apartment is beautifully decorated and incredibly bright. Sabine was a great host, super communicative and flexible. I would definitely stay again at her place, recommended. Thank you Sabine x

I really appreciate you helping us navigate through a difficult trip cancellation due to the war in Ukraine. It highlights the the true benefit of staying, adding on of course to the magnificent look of the apartment. You are in good hands staying here in Paris.

Great place for a short stay in Paris. Alexandre welcomed us in person and gave us some tips to explore Paris. He suggested some excellent places for dinner as well. We appreciated his guide to exploring Paris using his personally marked maps.

Great spacious apartment and fantastic location. Very comfortable for 6 of us. Check in was very smooth and we could contact our hosts easily with any questions we had. We’ll definitely stay here again

It was our second time staying at the apartment and once again really enjoyed our stay. Great location, quick response and very accommodating host. Would definitely recommend and hope to come back next time we’re in Paris!
Good for 4. Great location. Quiet apartment. There is a Chinese restaurant we can take away called Traiteur Asie Prestige. I Really really recommend!

This apartment is a must if you are traveling to Paris. The place is exquisite, detailed and full of beautifull art objects. It has everything and more of what you may need to have an extraordinary time in Paris. To top everything of it has a spectacular views from three balconies. Alexis vas a superb host in everyway. He is very attentive, warm, and helpfull, always reachable withing few minutes. He made me feel welcome and comfortable in his one of a kind place. I will definetly be back soon!
The apartment was wonderful and superbly clean. The location was amazing and really was the cherry on top of an already amazing trip. Thank you Sophie!
Place is great, but be aware until the construction is complete it will be noisy during the day.

An excellent stay in March 2022. Communication was fast and helpful throughout. Check-in was perfect. The space is exactly as described and was ideal for our group of five adults. The apartment is well appointed, very clean and there is plenty of storage space. Location is great with La Fourche metro station a few minutes walk, Montmartre's cafés and restaurants within 10 minutes and an excellent supermarket / boulangerie just around the corner. Thanks Jean-Daniel - we loved it!
The location of the apartment is amazing! We walked everywhere and there is a lot of bars, restaurants and supermarkets near the apartment. I would really recommend booking a stay :)

This was a perfect apartment, clean and exactly as advertised on Airbnb. The apartment offers all the comforts of luxury hotel with the privacy of a home. The communication with the team went fairly smooth. I would stay here again and again
Great location and very comfortable flat with elevator. Perfect for two travelers and having a kitchen was very convenient. Highly recommended!

Great location with close to 10 restaurants/ bars with in 100 ft, train station is 4 mins away. Perfect spot for families Rahim is a gentleman and would certainly love to visit back London and stay at his apartments !!

We stayed for 3 nights and absolutely loved it. The place was clean, had everything we needed, and was in a great location. The kitchen was very well stocked and included a washer to do laundry. The washing machine was broken during our stay but it was not the fault of the owner. We were given a heads up before we arrived and the owner offered to help make arrangements if we were needing to wash clothes during our stay. Luckily we didn’t need to use it but we thought that was very kind to offer. The apartment was a very close walk to the Louvre and a few metro stations which made it convenient. I even walked to the Orsay Museum from here. You could go the other direction and walk to Notre Dame. The apartment is accessed by entering a courtyard area which makes it quiet at night. We had a car and there was an excellent parking garage one street over (1 minute walk) which was very convenient. We highly recommend staying here.
Great apartment, clean, literary next to everything. Metro, bakery ,very easy to find. Definitely I'm going to prefere it again!

The accommodation is in a beautiful location with a wonderful window view, short walking distance to the Pantheon and Rue Mouffetard restaurants and Luxembourg Palace. We did not realize until after booking that the apartment is shared by the hosts, and it is not explicit in the description of the accommodation. However, Monique and her husband are very kind and did their best to not intrude on our visit, so it was not a problem in the end but something to consider if you want a completely private stay or free roam of the apartment/common living spaces. Would recommend for a pair of students who are traveling and want to visit Paris (such as my visit) or a couple who wants to visit in a good area and plan on spending most of their day out and about. We were lucky for such a great experience and we highly recommend this space for those who to visit Paris for several days.
It was great stay by Helene, everything is very nice and cosy. She and her family is very kind and friendly. It was the best!

Host was excellent. She provided a tour of the apartment as well as a booklet with all of the local useful relevant information. The apartment itself is a Parisian dream. Quiet yet in the busy Marais and steps from one of the best markets in the city, best dining establishments, and shopping.

BOOK IT! This place is great and so close to many restaurants and cafes. It's very walkable, only about 10 minutes to Notre Dame, but it's also very close to subway stations. For a week stay the washer truly came in handy. There are stairs to get up to the apartment, but not difficult. I would definitely stay here again if I traveled to Paris!

One of the most fantastic Airbnb experiences. The place faces the Louvres and the Tuileries gardens, the view is outstanding and the details of this bespoke apartment are really unique. Alexis was very welcoming, connected and helpful. We travelled with 2 children, but given the art pieces and the fine furniture and the high-tech features of the apartment, I'd recommend the place for adults only. We (couple) will come back!

Convenient location, everything new and clean in the apartment. Communication very well, just wish we would automatically receive the check in details at 4 pm, and not have to ask for details ourselves. Ideal for 2-3 people. Bedroom is quiet despite being just steps from Moulin Rouge.
Great location, super easy check in and out. Apartment was clean but the bathrooms could use some updating, peeling paint and just a bit worn out.

Thank you so much for such a great opportunity to be in this place. The apartment is wonderful, beautiful, clean and you can really feel Parisian atmosphere. Bed is extremely comfortable and presence of cats only added to charm of this place. The location was really very good, everything was close enough that you could walk. Shops, restaurants, metro stations, the Arc de Triomphe just 5 minutes walk. It couldn't have been better. I hope I will have opportunity to come back there again.

Little, but cozy and warm, it is well decorated, and there's some sugar cubes for coffee and tea. There's only one room, the bed-sofa is in the living room so there's no privacy for the people sleeping there.
Chachou and his wife were great hosts!! Easy check-in, nice home, and amazing location. Thanks!

Wonderful location! Easy to get on the metro and go to all of the big sights. There were also plenty of food places near by. Great walking distance from the Louvre. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable.

Exceptional location and wonderful hosts. The apartment features three bedrooms, two of which have king-size beds (main level and upper level) and one is a full-size bed (lower level). Limited hanging and shelving for clothes but apartment has excellent upgraded bathrooms with great showers.
Fantastic location and host was easy to communicate with. Would highly recommend. The value is hard to beat in Paris!

The apartment was absolutely gorgeous. Within walking distance to most sightseeing and all if you're willing to put in 40 min walks. Ideal location, spotlessly clean and a nice quiet area for being a ground floor apartment our sleep was never disrupted. Paul was an absolute gentlemen to deal with, so friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay here again!!

Clean and comfortable home. The Metro station is accross the street (which connects you to tourist sights in about 25-30 min) and Gare du Nord is about a 15 min walk from the home. Unlimited eating options near the home as well as different stores/shops. Walking distance to Sacre Coeur, and if you REALLY want to get a feel for Paris you can walk to the mains sights/attractions (*only if you have a pair of comfortable shoes and like to walk and explore!). The host is quick to respond via WhatsApp and was very accommodating to my travel plans. I definitely recommend this listing.

A very lovely, clean apartment in an amazing location that was close to everything, but also felt very safe which was important as I was travelling alone. Jordan was a very attentive host who was very accommodating and generous - would recommend!
Everything was perfect and the location great. 10 Walk minutes to the moulin rouge and the metro was 1 Minute away. I would stay there again!!
Gilbert is very kind and helpful with anything you need. The flat is comfortable and welcoming. A perfect stay in Paris.
Very nice decor and modern appliances including a very good shower. Marie made us feel very welcome and provided good information about our location.
Great airbnb, it is super well located and the apartment itself has anything you need for a short or long stay. I absolutely recommend this apartment .

We had a perfect stay in Clarisse's apartment near Nation. The location was ideal, the apartment was exactly what we needed and had everything we wanted, and we felt immediately comfortable. Clarisse was extremely helpful with communication and flexibility with check-in. We will definitely be back to visit again!

Great apartment for two, really convenient location if you’re coming in the Eurostar only 10 minute walk from the station. Really easy to walk or get the metro into central Paris and the apartment is in a a very cute neighbourhood along the canal Saint-Martin with lots of local bars/restaurants and bistrots. Check in and out really easy and Guillaume accommodated us on short notice, met us for check in and allowed us to stay till our train left, would come back for sure

Denis is such a wonderful and thoughtful host. Very accommodating and helpful with small sweet touches around the apartment. The location is fantastic. Very close to the boutiques, amazing bakeries and restaurants. Very close to the metro too so it is easy to get around Paris. Loved that the apartment is also well stocked with the basics so you won’t have to buy it yourself. Highly recommended!
Location was great, no problems during my stay except the wifi sucked. But you’re in Paris, enjoy the city not your phone I guess
The apartment is great. The beds and the sofa bed are super comfortable. There is everything you need and the location is amazing

The value of this place is incredible - real bang for your buck. A great size for a solo traveler or couple, incredible neighborhood, easy check-in/entry, and very communicative host. I extended my trip because I loved it so much!

I am glad to have stumbled on this listing, the location and lodging itself was fantastic. The host operates the property with polite and precise communication which is always a hope when traveling out of the country. As far as the location, there were many fantastic restaurant options for every meal of the day as well as coffee of course. The distance to other great locales is easily walkable. The apartment was kitted out well and left little required when it came to multiple days of a stay. I would be happy to visit again.

Mon Petit Fare was absolutely perfect in every way: style, cleanliness, communication, and location, location, location...everything was wonderful. For sure, it was the coolest airbnb we've stayed in and we couldn't get over how conveniently located it was. Grocery stores, small markets, specialty shops, restaurants, and public transportation seemed only minutes on foot from this location. Our hosts were also incredibly helpful with suggestions for sightseeing, transportation, and food! We simply couldn't have been happier with our stay. If/when we go back to Paris, we will absolutely look into booking here.

Our trip to Paris was better because of this place. Localization was so good , only 3 minutes to metro. There is also many wonderfull bakery and auchan near to apartament. Place was beautifull and u can find there anything u need on short trip. The host was helpfull and responses quickly. Highly recomend.
gilbert is very hospitable. his home is warm, quiet and centrally located. very comfy bed with little patio. he provides all you'll need for a good rest and stay.
A stylishly finished apartment in a superbly well-located quarter of Paris, Alexis' property made for the perfect weekend bolt-hole (despite the snow!).
Great apartment very clean and has two metro stations within 5mins that both run towards the centre. Local market and bakery around the corner

Located in a great neighborhood. Near to plenty of restaurants and shops. The metro is about 4 minutes away. Keep in mind that there are two sets of stairs. Overall, we had a great time and recommend this flat.

Julien was amazing, with fantastic suggestions about the area! From places to eat, to things to do, he provided us with every bit of information we could have wanted. As for the apartment, it was beautiful, and the balcony is a once in a lifetime view! I would highly recommend Julien's place when looking for a stay in Montmartre.

Great stay all around. Very nice, clean and perfectly located apartment. We were able to walk most places from it. Jean-Daniel was proactive and very responsive in communicating with us - and helped make our stay an amazing one. Plus he had some excellent recommendations for food, things to do, etc. Definitely recommend staying here.

Corinne was easy to communicate with and the apartment was incredibly clean (have never seen such clean windows). The apartment is close to two subway stations and on Sunday there was a beautiful food market set up along the street nearby. The check-in was contactless and it was helpful that there was an elevator in the building. Pull-out couch was comfortable. The apartment was equipped with basics like coffee, tea, etc. Would recommend!
Great location! Noisy bar next door, but couldn’t beat the value. Natalie was responsive with requests.
The most beautiful room ever, very close the the metro station. We’ve had an amazing stay 🤩

This was by far the most spacious Airbnb in Paris that I’ve stayed in, especially for the price point. Upon arrival we were greeted by the building manager. It seems as if Edgar Suites manages a few Airbnb properties throughout Paris. Check-in was seamless despite my late arrival after a delayed flight! One of the members traveling with me ran in the Paris Marathon and this apartment was conveniently located for catching the back half of the course. This is also a prime location for those looking to watch a PSG match over at Parc des Princes. It’s less than a 5 min walk.

Very nice apartment well located between a few major metro stations, or alternately within a medium distance walk to all the tourist attractions along the Seine. Cristina was very communicative during our stay, and Bruno was very helpful during our check-in. No complaints, loved everything about the place!
Absolutely fantastic stay! Beautifully decorated Parisian apartment- a very calm and peaceful space. Very clean, excellent communication from Cristina, fantastic location. Thoroughly recommend!

Loved the apartment, everything is nicely updated with quality materials. It is in a great location, close to restaurants, shopping, and tourist attractions. I will look for availability at this apartment the next time I am in Paris!
We really enjoyed our stay at Ana‘s apartment. It was very clean and cozy. The location is perfect! :)
A great place to rent, quiet but centrally located to most places to see with close access to many metro lines . The concierge is super lovely too . Highly recommend.

This flat is perfect! Immaculate and charming with a gorgeous view! Communication was easy and Mirielle’s husband welcomed us to their lovely flat. The location is good for transportation and shopping is on one of the best market streets of Paris.
Great apartment for our stay in Paris! The neighborhood has many options and it was walking distance from the city center. Guillaume was good at communicating throughout our trip.
This is a beautifully furnished, authentic Parisien apartment in a fantastic location just 5 minute walk to The Louvre! We had a great time!

We’ve had an amazing time at Nicolas’ place. It’s situated very conveniently in St. George, a vibrant neighborhood with lots of cute cafes and shops. The apartment itself is very quiet, as it faces a courtyard, and offers everything you need. We hope to come back soon.
Absolutely great location. Very clean. Be aware that a couple of the bedrooms have very steep stairs, making it a challenge for anyone who may need to get up at night,

We had a really nice and comfort stay at Blessing’s lovely apartment. It has an amazing view of the city and nearby are many decent Asian cuisine restaurants located and it takes only 5 minutes’ walk to the metro that takes you to city center. Blessing and Rosemary are really nice people and always willing to help. I’d absolutely recommend this apartment to everyone.

The house is perfect located, it is near to a lot of services like the subway or bus station, it is also near to supermarkets. The house has everything that you need, it’s very clean, and Sophie is awesome. The communication was perfect, Sophie and her friend helped us with everything, giving us some advices on what to do, or where the subway was located. If I return to Paris, I want definitely return here.
Great location. Nice and friendly. One of the showers didn’t work, some of the furniture were broken.
Nice studio in center, very close to les halles. Clean and with towels, shampoo, … Sofabed was not very comfy, normal bed was good.

Really large space for Paris with good security and easy to access. Louardi was very flexible with our late check-in time which we really appreciated. I had no issues with the noise but we slept with the window shut. Wifi worked well as well. We would book again!

We had a wonderful stay at Eric and Laure’s home. The apartment is very large, charming, and very well equipped. It is a warm and welcoming home filled with great art and books. The kitchen has all you could possibly need to prepare a feast. It is an oasis to return to after a day exploring Paris. Numerous bus and metro stations are close by. There is a supermarket, bakery, and pharmacy within a block. The building and neighborhood are very classy. Highly recommended!

The apartment was in a great location and was just what we needed! Perfect for walking or taking the metro anywhere you’d like to go in Paris. Plenty of sun in the space which I appreciated. Marie was quick to respond to messages and we enjoyed our stay!

great host: super friendly and helpful. went the extra mile when we forgot something in the apartment (thanks again!). apartment is really nice and in a good location, and overall a very good deal compared to staying in a hotel.
Francine was so kind, her apartment was beautiful! In a wonderful location, clean, and decorated so lovely. Would love to come back

Everything was good, the apartment is well connected (although for the metro you will need to walk quite a bit). if you are planning to stay for a couple of days in Paris, this is a good spot. Bea was amazing.

The location was great and the communication as well (very welcoming and efficient). However the shower and the sink were clogged. The bed was uncomfortable (even for a sofa bed). There were also some details not on point. If you are not too picky go ahead.

The apartment Is just as others have said, quiet, good location and a responsive host. There are several good restaurants on the same street, a bakery, a pizza place, a Vietnamese sandwich place, and a Korean BBQ. There is a monoprix a few minutes walk away. The metro, line 8, is very close. Most destinations are 15-30 minutes away. The Coulee Verte is less than 5 minutes walk, and it is delightful. I was concerned that there was no clothes dryer, but everything dried quickly on the provided clothes line. Nathalie is an interesting, caring, person, and an excellent host. She’s not just collecting payment, she does want you to enjoy the flat and Paris.

A nice but small appartement equipped with everything that‘s necessary. Great location close to the City Center. Good communication with Julien. Only big disadvantage for us was loud music from the flat below during several nights up to 5 a.m.. Apart from that, totally recommended.

Fantastic place in the heart of Paris. Close to metro stations, you can get anywhere in the city super quick. The location is unbeatable! The apartment itself was clean and brightly decorated, has all the amenities you’d need. Host was easily contactable, super friendly and accommodating. We had the best long weekend in Paris! Fully recommend to anyone interested
Great location but overall the hotel was very basic and dull. Shower wasn’t working properly (fixture broken) and hair dryer only worked for 10 seconds at a time.

Monique and Jean are very accommodating and helpful. They welcome us in their nice and warm home with a friendly and respectful way. We really appreciate them giving us a ride in a train station early in the morning. Highly recommended and all the best for them…..
A superb apartment. Well equipped and very comfortable. Great location on a quiet street. Vitalina is lovely and made sure we were settled in on arrival. Perfect for exploring Paris.
The apartment was spotlessly clean. Very convent to the metro. Well equipped kitchen. A home away from home.
Amazing apartment! The pictures don’t do the view and location justice. What an incredible way to wake up and say goodnight to the city. Going to be hard to beat it.

This was the perfect place for our family to stay while in Paris. It comfortably accommodated all eight of us in lovely decorated rooms with adjoining bathrooms. We thoroughly enjoyed happy hours in the quaint outdoor courtyard in the center of the home. Despite being within a lively neighborhood, the house was very quiet. The home located in the 11th arrondisement is very close to good restaurants, cafes and boulangeries. The Voltaire metro station is a convenient short block away. We would definitely stay there again!
This place is a great little gem. Just a few train stops away from the Eiffel tower. The only problem we had was the neighbors upstairs who can be a bit loud early in the morning.

Wonderful comfortable flat is a great area of Paris. Bedroom window faces a quiet courtyard which was great for a good nights sleep. Nicolas is quick to respond to any questions and easy to work with. There is a small elevator which makes it easy to bring suitcases and bags up to the 4th floor. I would stay here again on my next trip to this beautiful city.
Antoine’s place is great! Close to shops and restaurants and in a less touristy part of the city.
The apartment was very conveniently located near the metro, clean, and with plenty of space for our party of 5.
We had a nice stay! The welcome was warm, location good near a metro station and in a well atmosphered neighborhood.
Fantastic stay! A beautiful and kind family who went above and beyond. They make you feel very comfortable. The space is beautiful and really clean. No complaints.

The area is amazing. we love to go back. and we would ask for the same place. only minus was there is a supermarket across the street and when they get delivery in the middle if the night, you will hear it. but again. the place and the area is great

Great location, daily room cleaning, having a lift (though small) was a bonus, balcony lovely to sit on and watch the world. Only downside is room is very small- no place to put bags apart from on the bed or on the floor and then not be able to move around the room. The photos are accurate, but taken from an angle that makes it appear bigger.
Amazing apartment with everything you need in genuine old Parisian village with great views of Paris, delicious food spots and beautiful parks. Just a short hop from Paris centre.

Muriel is warm, charming, generous and an excellent host! We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is peaceful and quiet, and everything was very clean. Great location, near cafes, shops and metro. The view from the apartment was lovely and we enjoyed the patio a great deal.

Olivier is a great host, really friendly and always help as possible. His place is really comfortable, in a great location and I sure that you will enjoy the stay if you select his place. I will definitely return there sometime.
Amazing, parisienne appartment! Perfect for a weekend stay in Paris. Nation metro is located 5 minutes away from the apartment and has lines that takes you to all parts of the city
I just stayed for 5 days. The flat is very nice, calm, very well located, well equiped including washer and dryer.

Quintessential Parisian apartment of our dreams....every aspect of it was so thoughtfully curated and steeped in history of the wonderful host family dating back generations. Absolutely spectacular, and very spacious. And the neighborhood! What a perfect location for exploring the Latin Quarter and all central, iconic neighborhoods of Paris. Strolling La Seine just minutes away. When we return to Paris, this will be the very first place we seek out. Thank you so much Anne and Jean-Luc for your warm, Parisian hospitality.
This is a wonderful place Catherine our host was great and had great recommendations for us we stayed at many Airbnb's in the past and it's great when your host is so attentive and helpful
This apartment is exactly as described/pictured. I was in Paris for a short work trip and this worked very well for me. The host is very proactive with communication, and the location is very good.

Very nice accommodation and a very lovely and helpful host. The neighboorhoud is very nice and you can reach the public transportation within just a few minutes of walking. I would definitly recommend it. 4/5 stars for the checkin due to the fact that the ckeck in was quite late (after 7pm) which can be a bit burdensome as you have to carry your stuff around the whole day if you arrive in the morning. However this was communicated beforehand - nethertheless I would stay here again when I get to Paris the next time.

Hannalore is one of the best Airbnb hosts I’ve ever stayed with. My wife and I stayed at her place for 5 days and really appreciated that Hannalore was kind and laid back but also always eager to be helpful. She gave us tips for enjoying our time in Paris and we definitely enjoyed our trip more because of her and her advice! The location is great because it’s just a few minutes walk from different metro stations so we were able to easily get around on the metro for the entire trip. Thanks Hannalore!

Emmanuel is very friendly. Making sure we are doing good. His apartment is in a great location. Quiet neighborhood. Near to the metro and some great restaurants. View from the balcony is beautiful. Apartment is very clean and has everything that you would need. Would definitely stay again!
Thanks for the stay. The location is perfect for a stay in Paris so close to public transport. The apartment has many amenities. Great choice!

This is a beautiful and elegantly appointed apartment, with enormous windows letting in natural light. Located in a bustling area with many shops and restaurants, yet tucked away amid courtyards, the apartment is very serene and comfortable. Highly recommended.
Highly recommend this location. There were a total of 5 of us and it fit all of our needs. Great location and really enjoyed.

Fabien was an excellent host. Although we didn’t meet him in person, communications went very smoothly. During our stay, Fabian was always available for our questions. We had pleasant conversations via WhatsApp.

We really enjoyed our stay at Eric and Laure’s apartment. It was bright, very spacious, and had everything that business travellers would want (eg, fully equipped kitchen). Wi-Fi worked perfectly for video calls and streaming. The neighbourhood is charming. Highly recommend!

Paul’s space was just what we were looking for after having to make some last minute accommodation changes. Paul was very responsive and super helpful when getting us check in and into the apartment. The place was extremely clean and had everything you would need for your stay. It is also quite spacious, especially being in a hotel room for 3 nights! We were able to find plenty of cafes, bakeries and shopping nearby and it’s location to the Eiffel Tower was wonderful as well. Highly recommend!

Gilbert was such a hospitable and warm host! Although I didn't have the best French, we were still able to communicate well using Google translate and his knowledge of English. His place was beautiful and the room was quite spacious as well. The bathroom, bedroom and common areas were all clean and had great character. Check in was a breeze as he let me in. The biggest plus factor for me was the location. It was right by the beautiful park and just felt very peaceful and an escape from the busy side of Paris. I'd recommend this place to anyone!
Very nice apartment in quiet street in Paris, but still in a lively area. The apartment is clean and comfortable, and suits 5 p easily. Vitaline is very kind and helpful. Recommended!

I highly recommend Kathleen‘s rooms! We felt very welcome and the location of her beautiful flat is perfect for exploring Paris! There are bistros, bakeries and supermarkets nearby and it is a 30 minute walk to Eiffel Tower and 10 minutes to Arc de Triomphe. The two adorable cats were just the icing on the cake! We’d definitely love to come back!

Lovely, quiet and very private room. Has all you need for short to longer stays. It is very well located and you can get anywhere from there by using the metro (5 to 10 min). Julien is very responsive and kind! I was received with a lovely welcome kit and all kind of instructions to make my stay the best (which it was!). I will definitely come back.
