The location is excellent, just a few minutes’ walk from numerous beautiful attractions. We stayed here with our 8-year-old daughter and found it to be a pleasant experience. However, families with younger children may find it a bit challenging, as the stairs are quite steep.

The listing was perfect for our needs! It's conveniently close to restaurants, stores, and a nearby metro station. The house is clean, well-furnished, and cozy despite being a bit small. Communication with Brijid was prompt, and she shared helpful tips about the area. Check-in was easy, and the location made navigating the city by metro hassle-free. Overall, highly recommended!

We Stayed with 3 couples, for a weekend in Elodie's and Alexis apartment. We loved the apartment, the location. We found with the help of our hosts some very nice restaurants. Mensae is really worth the visit... Also the big park in front of the building is a real plus. Metro is on 5 minutes walk so very easy also... We loved our stay in paris, I really want to recommend Elodie and Alexis as hosts...
Great space with plenty of room. Very close to a few different metro stations. Easy to find and felt safe. Close to lots of shops and cafes as well.
Great place! Was like the way it was described and matched the photos. Emma is very communicative. 20 mins drive to Paris center.
Great location. Super hosts. Perfect place to use as a base to explore Paris. Would definitely recommend

The host was very responsive and helpful. The apartment was beautiful and very comfortable for our group of 3. It was also in a great location and extremely walkable. Would definitely stay here again!
Manon is a great host, she was really supportive all the time. The apartment is perfect for a couple. I really enjoy it. Thanks
Everything here was fantastic! The apartment, the location and most of all Ines. She was very helpful and responsive!

Gabrielle’s home was the perfect place to stay. It was exceptionally comfortable and beautiful. Access to all of the wonderful sights in Paris was easy. Communication with our host was outstanding. A great place to stay!!
Loved staying here, lot’s of room. Very accommodating, very responsive and overall a very very good experience. Clean everything. Thank you for having us🙏🏻
Our stay here was lovely. The apartment is well appointed and located in a quiet, but walkable area. I'd definitely stay here again.
The place was very nice, clean, perfect. We enjoyed our stay a lot. Emerald was very helpful and kind. Will stay here again when I come back next year.
The place was amazing for staying in Paris. Monique and her family were great. We definitely will come back. Merci beaucoup.
Perfect place . Nice placement and metro near the apartment. Pascal was very helpful and great. I’ll be back hopefully soon

Really fantastic place! The apartment is beautifully appointed and in a great location, so close to the train station but it’s also peaceful inside. Great restaurants nearby and Denka provided a lot of welcome suggestions. Check in was easy. Beds are really comfortable. Can’t recommend enough!
Very responsive and helpful host, easy to get in and everything in the apartment was as described and worked well.

A very comfortable apartment with wonderful views. Excellent location with stores, malls, restaurants, supermarket and pharmacy within a short walking distance. Train station and bus stop to the city and to the Eiffel Tower are only a few minutes walk away.

Christophe is a wonderful host, quick to respond. This was our second stay and everything was perfect! Comfortable bed, nice towels, soft sheets, love that it has a water closet with a sink. And the amazing views, not sure we will stay anywhere else again in Paris. Thank you, Christophe.
Great host! Quick response! In 30 Min i had the apartment from when i wanted it. It was a last minute thing and it was incredible how helpful he was!

Apartment was nice and cozy! I really enjoyed coming back to it each night after a day out in the city. It just felt like the perfect little Parisian studio! The area is amazing and close to so many restaurants and bars! Milan was great and very accommodating to my late arrival time and early departure times. Will absolutely be looking to stay here again on my next Paris visit.
Comfortable and big apartment in a nice area close to many restaurants and tourist attractions. It has everything needed for a long stay. The host was always responsive and easy to communicate with.

Ines' place was lovely and homey, great location and very nice space. Ines was great with communication, her responses were fast, she was supportive and provided clear information We loved our stay, it was our first time in Paris and we would rebook with Ines :)
Very nice, small apartment in a good location. It was clean and easy to find. Noémie was very quick to respond to my messages. I enjoyed my stay!

This neighborhood is my favorite in Paris. Within blocks of a number of killer music venues and a number of the top fun restaurants in Paris. Yet very quiet since the two windows aren’t over streets. Beyond the neighborhood, the place is right on one of the key Metro lines and is on a road that’s terrific for east/west travel on the Vélib or Line rental bikes since the road has protected bike lines. And Colette is great.

Great location and beautiful big windows and view. Nice to have an elevator to get up to the place! Also loved having the ability to do my laundry. As other reviewers said, it’s on a busy, noisy street, but I went in with that expectation and used white noise to sleep at night which was essential.

Such a beautiful apartment in a lovely location. 5 minute walk away from stunning cafes and restaurants. Patrick & Nathalie were super responsive and gave us such an in depth guide of the local area. Would stay here again in a heartbeat!
The place is really well located, quiet, and great to stay at with a couple. The bathroom is a bit small, but that's usual in Paris. I would highly recommend Elise's place!
Beautifully positioned between two Metro stations, covering lines 2&4. Great food, drinks and bakeries very close by. Would happily recommend this apartment.

A nice apartment in a very quiet small street, but just a few steps from a lively neighborhood. There is everything you need for a comfortable stay. The self check-in gave us the opportunity to arrive at a later hour with no necessity of an arrangement.

Our stay was fantastic. Hugo was such a gracious and kind host. Our arrival to Paris was early and Hugo and allowed us to drop off our luggage before check-in time so we did not have lug around our bags while exploring. We felt very comfortable staying in this apartment and will most definitely book with his listings again in the future.
Lovely and homey stay close to the train station and many attractions. Nathalie was also very responsive and helped us with all our questions in a timely manner
Had a great stay. Place was perfect for me my husband and toddler. First floor made it easy with our luggage and stroller. It was very walkable with lots around! Definitely recommend.
Thiabut was a very good host, was always available and gave clear instructions beforehand Ill definitely stay there again

Great place if you want to stay near the Effie Tower! And great area! The only thing was the stairs, that got to me at times. Overall great stay and my first trip to Paris was lovely staying with her. Would definitely stay with her again!!!

Morgan’s place is well located, she was very helpful with questions. I think maybe a Manual on how things work in the apartment will be a little more efficient. The sheets are quite old and have some stains. The bathroom is clean and the apartment too. Is a nice place to stay in general for two persons, just renovate the bed sheets, but everything else is lovely. Thanks Morgan!
We had a great time and would definitely stay there again. Great apartment, and great location. Wonderful!
Yohann, was extremely responsive during our whole stay. The apartment is exactly as described in one Paris's best neighborhoods. We would love to return to the apartment one day.
We really enjoyed the quiet and comfortable apartment at Helene’s. The location was perfect for an extended stay in Paris; very walkable and oh so lovely. Will definitely be back.

5 stars. This was my second time staying at Axel’s place and it was once again fantastic. They are so responsive, so kind, so caring, so flexible, and very quick to respond. The house is cleaned frequently and in great condition. The decoration is fantastic, you have everything you need and more, and the view and amount of space are unlike any other place you’ll find in Paris on this platform. Also some new places in the neighbourhood for coffee and pastries I really enjoyed.
Such a perfect spot to stay - near by transport and the canal but very quiet. Was bigger than expected too! Loved this space.
The place was really nice! Great location, walkable to important sites like the Louvre. We would definitely come back.

This was my very first time staying and spending time at the Pigalle location. It was a great experience overall. I was able to tour the neighborhood and realize that once move past the main strip of "Clichy", Pigalle has a whole other world of great Resturants, Great People and things to see/do. A totally different experience compared to my previous stays being in the 7th but I enjoyed this new adventure.
Cozy and nice apartment. Might be too small for more than 2 people. Great location and a very responsive host

Loved the Lander! Very spacious for Paris and loved the comfortable bed and decorating. We (perhaps our issue) had trouble figuring out the self check in but someone helped us quickly. Thank you for a wonderful stay in your beautiful city!
Marie’s place is in a great location so many restaurants and shopping super close. Very charming neighborhood.

This place is a beautiful gem right in the middle of the Paris city centre. The metro and restaurants are all nearby. The host Patrick & Nathalie is very proactive and friendly. The check-in and check out processes are flawless. The apartment is exactly as in the pictures. It has all the basic amenities and the place is well maintained. I would 100% recommend this place who is looking to have an amazing time in Paris. Made our trip to Paris, a memorable one.

Ai was the most welcoming, kind, and generous host! Her place was perfect for our stay. She greeted us upon our arrival and was available for anything we needed, and even stocked the kitchen with staples for us. The neighborhood was lovely and it was easy to get around the city. Would stay here again in a heartbeat!
A really good place to stay when in Paris! The area felt very safe and was very well connected to public transport. The apartment has everything you might need.
Navas is a great host. She was very flexible for my check-in and communicated very well. The place is exactly as described and in a prime location. I highly recommend.
Great accomodation, very good location, we were very pleased:) The restaurant kitchen next the apartment was very noisy every night:(

We had a wonderful stay. The location was perfectly central but whisper quiet. Jean Luc was responsive and helpful with every question. The beds super comfortable and the shower hot ! Definitely would stay again.

Location is excellent and Yan is friendly and very helpful He was very responsive. Note this is a second floor apartment (2 flights of stairs) without a lift. Its a steep uphill climb to get to the front door especially if carrying luggage. There is no microwave. The bachelor pad kitchen is adequate. If you are young, without physical limitations and care most about location then this is your spot.

had a great stay at Hélène’s place, i didn’t get to meet her until i was leaving unfortunately but she was still lovely and her husband was so nice and helpful throughout my time there. felt at home :)

Quentin was an excellent host. He went beyond expectations when we couldn’t figure out how to operate a few things. Actually came over and walked us through all our questions. I highly recommend their Airbnb.There’s a local cafe on the corner and small grocery right below the unit. Notre Dame is a15 minute walk and everything is all so close. I recommend a day on the Big Bus (hop on hop off). You’ll see so much of the city. Our time there was perfect. Thank you both for your hospitality!
Very nice and very optimized little apartment. There is all you need. The location is great and the communication with the host was smooth.
The apartment is cozy, with good location, well connectioned with public transport, near the artists 🎨 area, good pastries/coffee shops, and a very international mix 🌐 of people.

Great apartment in Les Halles close to restaurants, bars, transport and walking distance to some of the key sights around Paris. We were a family of four (2 young children) and the apartment was spacious and had a great little balcony off the main room with chairs and a small table where you could relax with a glass of wine with a treetop view over the surrounding area. Highly recommend. An added bonus is. Bakery literally next door which has fresh baguettes and delicious treats every morning 🙂

I recently stayed at this apartment, and I had a wonderful experience. The comfort level was excellent, with all the amenities I needed for a relaxing stay. The location was perfect, conveniently situated near major attractions and public transportation, making it easy to explore Paris. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and provided a cozy atmosphere. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and conveniently located place to stay in the city. Thank you for a great stay!
Thank you so much Paul. You have a lovely place and next time we’re in Paris we will be booking with you! Such a responsive host and helped us with the heater situation.
Ludovic’s apartment is very very nice. Very near to a major Metro station so going around is convenient. We highly recommend his apartment. The host is also very kind.
The apartment is simple, but the location is excellent! It's perfect for visiting Paris for a few days.

Vincent’s place is amazing. Right off the canal, you’re close to so many great cafes and restaurants with super easy access to other great neighborhoods. The apartment itself is very nice, very quiet, and well appointed

We loved the location of Elsa’s apartment. We walked to most museums and all restaurants and cafes. Two metro lines were very close as was a Franprix grocery store. Living along the Seinecwas awesome. The apartment was cozy and typical European small kitchen and bathroom. Living room was comfortable. We had a bit of trouble with the internet and Elsa helped quickly highly recommend this place

I had an absolutely wonderful stay at this Airbnb condo in Paris! The apartment is beautifully decorated, with stunning windows that bring in plenty of natural light, creating a charming and cozy atmosphere. The location couldn’t be more convenient—just steps away from the George V metro station, making it incredibly easy to get anywhere in the city. The space itself is much larger than most hotel rooms in Paris, which was a pleasant surprise and great value for the money. The owner was incredibly responsive, helpful, and friendly throughout my stay, making everything smooth and hassle-free. If I return to Paris, I will definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
Great location, nice building, bathroom is a little small but the apartment works for one person. Jordan was responsive and very helpful with check in and check out. Would stay again !

Our stay was great though due to sudden temperature drop and rain, we had a really hard time getting everything dry even with the radiator in the apartment. Also there was construction right in front of the window, which made it harder to relax inbetween tourist activities during the day. Otherwise, this is a very good stay for a short trip, especially for one person. With two people it feels a tad small. The host is very nice as well.
This was a beautiful and centrally located apartment, stroll like a local in the bustling neighborhood. Thanks Louise for our stay.

I wanted a comfortable place to stay in Paris since I was traveling with my busy baby and spouse and Alexis had everything to make our stay easy. We had a lovely, magical trip. Alexis was very accommodating and quick to communicate. His home was very clean with no issues. My baby had his own nursery with toys and books. He had fun playing with the ball and car. The crib, high chair, and bath were amazing to have. Washing machine was nice too. The elevator was very convenient for our stroller. Quiet street, beautiful views, and near a wonderful park. Walking distance to the metro, grocery store, cafes, restaurants. Excellent location! We went everywhere in Paris. We will stay again the next time we visit. Thank you Alexis.

We moved our stay! This apartment is remarkably beautiful, and it feels like a comfortable, well appointed home (which it is) rather than a sterile AirBNB. This apartment sits above a bustling street (that quiets at night) with bakeries and restaurants. It’s a short walk to the metro. The area really couldn’t have been better.

The reviews don’t lie. While the place is on the smaller side, it’s worth it. Metro at your feet, Bastille a 6 min walk with some great food and drinks. This place had everything we needed for our time in Paris.

I had a wonderful stay at the apartment in Paris. The apartment itself is well-structured with all the necessary amenities. The location is excellent, making it easy to explore the city. The host was very attentive and made sure everything was perfect.
It was really good, only one bad thing , The curtains must be dark so that light does not enter at night, after that everything was really good and we are very happy. Thanks

Great stay! Took a few tries figuring out the lock and getting into the backyard, but it was beautiful and a great location for walking around! Host was extremely friendly and responsive, appreciated him being so helpful!

The charming apartment has a character. If you like it's pictures you will love the apartment. It's spacious, subway is close. Neighbourhood is calm, there are shops nearby (check out Rue d'Auteuil). Host was friendly and responsive.
Seb’s guide is clear and comprehensive, the room is really clean and all appliances work well. I visited the bakery Seb suggested almost everyday.
Wonderful host and location. I couldn’t ask for anything more as it being my first time in Paris.
We loved our stay at Elsa’s place. The location is perfect for a first time Paris visit. Elsa was so helpful during our stay and made sure we had everything we needed. Thank you Elsa!
Caroline is a great host , who respond quickly. We felt at home in this place in a very friendly familiar neighborhood.
Beautiful apartment with an amazing view. Lafkir was very communicative and helped us whenever we asked any questions. Definitely would recommend for anyone who wishes to have a great day in Paris.

Helene was a very helpful host! She responded within a day and kindly provided my wife and I with helpful suggestions on places to dine like a local. She has a cozy apartment and you will love the neighborhood!

The apartment was lovely, clean and homey. The location was brilliant and the metro station was just a few steps away. Below the apartment was a restaurant, which was a bit noisy, but the it didn’t bother us much. All and all, really spacious, light and lovely apartment, which I highly can recommend.
Beautiful, creative space in fantastic location! Aurélie was very friendly and attentive, comfortable and secure. Would love to stay again in the future!
Great location, liked the key code check in, Room extremely comfy with everything feeling new. Clean, comfy bed, nice touch to have unlimited coffees and teas. Would stay again.
comfy bed, well appointed, a little on the dirty side , great location, could use a little maintenance
Nicolas place was great and has every thing one would need . the communcation was super and Nicolas is a great host .I will sure come back again

Marine’s apartment is spacious and in a great location in Le Marais. There are many shops and restaurants nearby. Unfortunately, we had to leave our stay early because of multiple concerns. We found a lot of bugs crawling on the kitchen ceiling and outside the front door. One bug landed in food we were preparing in the kitchen. Marine offered to clean it for us but we did not feel comfortable staying. The shower also was clogging and we had to cut showers short to prevent flooding. There was no soap in any of the sinks. Locks were very difficult to open. All of this should be fully fixed before considering staying again.

Highly recommend! Family of five had plenty of space and the flat was well equipped. We absolutely loved the location, very vibrant with unlimited food options, unique and funky stores, and well connected to the rest of the city. The area didn’t feel overrun by tourists, but it didn’t feel out of the way. We would definitely stay again.

This was by far my favorite place in Paris I’ve stayed! The location is amazing and is right in the heart of Marais. There are local shops and restaurants right outside the door. The place looked as good as the pictures and was extremely spacious and modern. We loved sitting on the patio every night and taking it in. I would highly recommend it to anyone considering staying!
Great apartment in a lovely area with lots going on within walking distance. Only negative was it was very noisy due to the location on a busy main road.

Stylish and modern appartement on top floor of high rise with view over Paris. The place is spacious, large living area, comfortable bedroom, bathroom was also roomy. Exactly like in the photos. Dan is incredibly communicative, gives good instructions and us extremely responsive. Neighborhood is great with tons of shopping, restaurants, entertainment. Also, very quite inside the appartement and you could not hear anything happening outside. Fantastic!
Nice place. The location is perfect. Just cross the street you find the train. Easy to do whatever you want. The place is big with all the services and amenities.

This was my second stay at Mylene's this year and just like the first time I was very happy with it. The flat was comfortable and Mylene was very helpful and responsive. I liked the neighbourhood. It's a very short walk to the Charonne metro station as well as a couple of bus stops. The flat was mostly very quiet as it looks onto an interior courtyard. As somebody has mentioned before, from the bedroom you can hear people walking on the staircase in the morning (going to work I imagine), but I found that ear plugs helped sufficiently. There are a couple of supermarkets nearby (Super U, Carrefour ).
Wonderful view of the Eiffel tower and a beautiful apartment no complaints at all! Would 1000% recommend to anyone

Denis's apartment is centrally located in the Le Marais neighborhood. The apartment is safe and quiet. Denis was a great host and very responsive to any questions we had. Denis was very polite and decent. I would highly recommend Denis's apartment.

This place was really amazing. So comfortable. Very walkable to all metro stations. Directly across the street from the most beautiful park and a lot of grocery stores and restaurants within 100-400m. I would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to everyone.

Good location for what I needed. Tricky check in. When you arrive at one location you must go and look for the key pick up point that is at different address. It felt that the place needs some fixing , care and love. Some of the lights didnt work. It would be nice to have some glasses in the kitchen. It has only one bathroom but it's inside in one of the bedrooms which makes is awkward when you with a group of friends. The walls of the apartment are paper thin so we couldnt sleep in one of the bedrooms since the neighbors had long night talks. Also, having only one key and fob for the second door made it difficult to do something on your own. Always sombody had to stay and go down to open the second door to the building and then of course stay inside just to open the apartment. On the positive note it was clean, had a hot water and very warm with heating on.
Was great, only small minus was the sheets smelled like cigarettes, but the location was great and everything was as we expected.

The apartment is very well located and looks even better than in the pictures! The neighborhood is very nice with a lot of restaurants and cafes! I would definitely recommend to stay here and will come back for future stays in Paris

Excellent place for two guests needing separate beds. Irune provides so many extrasL milk, oil, coffee, honey, etc. Very bountiful. Beds are comfortable. (a little more hot-water for showers would be nice if possible. Excellent location. Good value for price. The walk-up to the 5th floor is significant. We struggled with the check-in. Hopefully Irune will provide an extra set of keys so lock box is not longer crucial. Overall, highly recommend.

Great place for the solo traveller. Too small for a couple (bed and room). Bed and “wardrobe “ not easily accessible. Housekeeper didn’t understand a word of English or French thankfully hosts very responsive. Missing a corkscrew (!!! In France) and tea towels. Shower doesn’t drain well so fills up quickly. Lots of work going on in building not good to be woken up at 8am every day with drilling and hammering. This should have been compensated in price and/or warned about.
Eloise is a lovely person, very kind and helpful. Always gave us the best recommendations and the apartment is exactly like the photos. We highly recommend this place.

Vincent was a great host. He was extremely responsive and helpful. His apartment was able to easily accommodate the 6 of us, plus it is in a great location, walking distance to many sites and restaurants.
Wonderful place to stay in Paris! In a great central location we walked all around the city to see the sights! Loved this air bnb
Very cozy apartments and big space for living one or two guests! Owner is always online. Location is brilliant, you have lots of restaurants and magazines around. Perfect choice for visiting Paris
The Airbnb is in a central location with lots of bars and restaurants but is still quiet from the apartment itself. The room is very well kept, and instruction from the host are very useful.

A great flat, spotlessly clean and a perfect size for a few days in Paris. The space is used cleverly and the area is peaceful and felt very safe. I couldn't fault anything. I would happily return and recommend.

Great central location for visiting for a few days! Enjoyed having the option to cook breakfasts and have al fresco space with the iconic rooftop views of Paris. Plenty of stairs to the studio apartment so be prepared for fitness. Totally recommend this apartment, was quieter than expected at night as the location was so central! Would return. Thank you.

I had an absolutely fantastic stay at this Airbnb! From the moment I booked, the host was incredibly responsive, answering all my questions promptly and making the check-in process seamless. The space itself was perfect—immaculately clean, beautifully decorated, and surprisingly quiet, allowing for a truly restful experience. The location couldn't have been better, with easy access to local attractions, restaurants, and parks. I loved being able to explore the area without any hassle. Overall, I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient getaway. I can’t wait to return! Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Alex’s place was perfect for me! I was solo traveling and stayed in Paris for two nights. I was looking for something in my budget and in a great location and this was it. As soon as you walked outside, there were plenty of restaurants and convenience stores. Metro was only a few blocks away. This place is perfect for a single person to drop their bags off and sleep before exploring the city. It is as pictured. Alex was very responsive and provided clear instructions for check in. I would recommend!

Absolutely great location, despite being right in the action at Montmartre the apartment was so quiet and peaceful. It was very small but it’s appointed so beautifully it’s still very comfortable. We were 2 adults and 2 kids; our kids shared the fold out sofa and told us repeatedly it was so comfortable they want one in their room! The hosts are lovely, friendly and helpful. The linens and towels are beautiful quality. We had such a wonderful couple of nights - would have happily stayed longer!

Pascal’s place was really good. Really easy to get around, close to 3 metro stations, lots of restaurants and convenience stores. Pascal was so helpful and really quick to answer all our questions. I really recommend this place!

Hélène is an amazing host! She and her husband are really kind, the communication with them were really good. Regarding the room, it’s well located in Paris, it has a private bathroom and it’s really comfortable. I highly recommend it! Mercí Hélène for your attention!
everything was great very clean nice location. but the pillows were a little bit uncomfortable and there were no big mirrors. but other that these two issues everything was as described
Had a lovely few days at Manon’s, was able to see all the sights of Paris using the nearby metro. Nice quiet part of Paris.
the perfect spot for me, my wife, and daughter. next time we are in Paris we will be looking to stay here again!
Great location, Elsa was very helpful and accommodating, beds were very comfortable and the appointment had everything we needed. The only thing to note is the shower is quite snug.

There are so many positive things to say about this apartment. The location is absolutely perfect. There were so many things we could walk to. The neighborhood is adorable and full of restaurants and shopping, but the apartment was very quiet! The beds were very soft, the place was clean and just as described. We had everything we needed and more. Communication with Catherine was easy and clear and she went out of her way to be very generous. It is up some stairs and Catherine made sure we were aware of that, but we didn't find the stairs especially bothersome. This is really just a perfect spot!
This is a great appartment, very well Located. Ideal for 1 guest but maybe tight for two…perhaps in the pictures looks a little bigger David was always supporting. Recomended

Patrick was very kind and his home is very welcoming. There are a ton of things to do around the property, and it is a short walk/metro trip away from many activities and events. The apartment is clean and comes with basic amenities like bath/shower/toilet/coffee/tea maker. Patrick is also very inviting and is open to giving you advice on what to do while in the city.
Very much enjoyed our stay at Stephane's place. Will definitely stay here again in the future!

Steps (okay, more like a few blocks away) from the Eiffel Tower. We loved this neighborhood, as it was very walkable with plenty of shops and cafes, but just outside the hustle and bustle of some major tourist stops. It felt peaceful, yet close to everything we wanted to see on our first trip to Paris.

Washing machine and dryer was a bit challenging to figure out and we ended up using a local laundromat to clean clothes more quickly efficiently. The terrace is so unique for Paris and really makes this place stand out! So amazing to sit out and enjoy Paris from this perspective. This neighborhood is lively and comes alive at night so if that’s your vibe you’ll love this place! Perfect for a group of friends. Would definitely stay here again.
we liked the area, our hosts were great. we think of staying in their house again in the future.

This is a quiet and lovely place to stay in Paris. Everything looks same as picture. Paul is a friendly and kind person. He answer question quickly and help solve problem in active. Highly recommend everyone to choose here to stay in Paris.

This apartment was a home away from home in Paris! So beautiful, clean and an amazing location. Bars and restaurants around the corner and easy to take metro. We have such an amazing time and looking forward to staying at Tatiana’s beautiful place again.
Location is amazing. The host was very easy to communicate with. The instructions were clear. However, the accommodation was smaller than expected

We had a nice stay for two nights in this studio. The studio is cozy and pretty, and the neighborhood is nice, quiet and close to the metro and pleasant cafés (and the view is great!). However, check-in was a bit late, and have been asked to remove bedsheets and clean the place ourselves. I would not recommend it to people with sensitive sleep (as the water tubes make some noise once in a while), or to those who plan to cook or spend much time in the studio as it's not very spacious, but it's nice for a short stay.

Learning to close and lock the door was a challenge. I think ours had something wrong with the lock. Our AC was spewing hot air but with the window open it was okay. Other than that the place was great.
A cozy and clean apartment in a quiet area. Multiple metro stations nearby the apartment and a grocery store 2 minutes away. Marie was very helpful and answered all of our questions. I recommend!☺️

What a wonderful time we had. The apartment was so stylish and even larger than the photos depict. Communication with Soline was very easy and they were so kind and responsive to all of our questions and needs. The neighborhood was easily accessible to all of Paris. Excellent experience all around. Can’t wait to come back!

If I could give Pascal and his Airbnb 100 stars, I would in a heartbeat. My husband and I were blown away by the views and style of the apartment. We have traveled a lot, and Pascal’s place blew our minds. We felt right at home in our little oasis above the city. We spent hours on the balcony talking and taking everything in. It is absolutely magical watching the sun set and Eiffel Tower sparkle at night. There are so many amazing food places around. The kabob sandwiches from Basic and the burgers from Avec Amour- le burger were some of our favorites! The train station is very accessible! The app Pascal recommended (Bonjour RAPT) was incredible. We could not have imagined a better stay. Whenever we are back in Paris, we hope to stay at Pascals.

Both Tessa and Evangelos were kind, warm and friendly, we felt welcomed and at home from the moment we stepped inside the place! Everything was tidy, we had all the things we needed including a hairdryer, an iron, soap, shampoo and shower gel. There was even a coffee machine and tea in the room as well as guides to help us explore Paris. The location of the place was absolutely amazing - wonderful neighborhood with many restaurants and small shops around and within a walking distance from the Eiffel Tower. Many means of transportation were available which made it easy to travel around fast and secure. Me and my friend had a truly great time and would love to come back again! We would also recommend the place to friends!
Daniel was an extremely friendly and responsive host. The apartment is a nice size. It was a short walk along the canal to the metro. There are restaurants around and supermarkets nearby.
We had a wonderful experience in this beautiful apartment. It was large and relaxing. We walked everywhere and were so happy.
Great place to stay, great location with the mall and Monoprix within walking distance. Perfect place to stay with a little one, lots of room for them to crawl/play

Great communication with Mao! He reached out a few days before arrival to ask about arrival time. The apartment was ready when we arrived and we were able to check in early. The apartment was clean, spacious, comfortable bed (memory foam), and a nice view over the Seine and Notre Dame. We loved opening the windows for fresh air and listening to the bustling sounds of Paris.The kitchen and bath were great! Great shower, water pressure and hot! We enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay there again.
This place is perfect. It’s beautiful, clean, quiet, with an amazing view, in the best location. You’ll love strolling around the streets of Paris as much as staying inside at Benoit’s place.
Very nice and confortable place. Also very peaceful. Old house but no hot water problem and Wifi was fast. Maison colorée was the right pick! We shall come back.
Excellent location in the 19th with a lift! And two bedrooms and great views of the park. Felt like being at a friend’s home.

Louis was very friendly. We needed to park our rental car in his garage spot and he was willing to wait for us to help us navigate how to get in and out. Place is clean and the washer/dryer was a huge help to us since we have been traveling for over three weeks. Having an elevator is a huge plus after a lot of walking around Paris. Neighborhood is quiet, had no issues with noise. Metro is very convenient.

Clean, sleek, minimalist space in an excellent location. The added convenience of a washer/dryer was very helpful. The apartment is small but very strategically laid out so you have access to everything you need. I would say this space is best for a single traveler or a couple/close friends who don't mind the lack of privacy (ex the shower area is exposed). Great communication with host we appreciated the flexibility in checking in.
We enjoyed the location and the room in general. It was just a bit dirty and the shower was clogged.

What a lovely appartment. Accessible via very quiet court yard in a lovely neighborhood. The appartment has curved ceilings and low beams so as a long Dutchman like myself you have to remember to bend down. But that's a small price to pay for a perfect, authentic family home.
Everything was perfect. The place is very spacious with everything we needed. We came later than expected and Florent did everything to accommodate us. I highly recommend this place.
Had a lovely stay in Paris, great apartment with very good location to visit the city. Clarisse made everything very easy to check in and out!
Great location, very clean, exactly as described. The restaurant downstairs can be noisy so bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper. Will definitely stay again next time.
Nice place, very private and accommodating for a solo traveler. Did not get a chance to meet the host but everything was as described. Very close to metro and Gare du Nord.

Perfect place to stay in Paris! It’s in walking distance to many great restaurants and a variety of great spots in the city. The apartment was perfectly clean and our communication with Marine very easy! We are definitely coming back!
Great location , close to center and restaurants. Place was well decorated and clean . Spacious and had everything you need. We enjoyed our stay and communication with host was great

Me and mij daughter had a amazing time in Parijs. The apartment was small but clean, nice, cosy and on a perfect spot to visit Paris. The sleepingsofa was very comfortable. Perfect for 2 persons. The Metro to al the toeristische spots are nearby. Stéphane gave us a lot of tips, nice restaurants and was very flexible with the arriving time. Don’t forget to go to Bo&Mie to eat a very delicious croissant 🥐 Thank you for the pleasant stay!
Quiet and central flat in Paris. Flat was cute and very clean. Host was friendly and responsive.
Francis is a very kind and helpful host, peaceful and safe neighborhood with metro stations within 5 minutes walking distance.

We loved our stay at Bruno’s place! The apartment was cozy, clean and fully stocked with everything we needed. The location was perfect for our time in Paris and Bruno was a great host, super accommodating and friendly. Definitely recommend booking!

The apartment is in a perfect location. It is clean, tidy and has everything you could need for a weekend or even longer stay. It is in a historic building which adds to the charm, we will definitely return if in Paris!

I had an amazing time in Paris! The apartment is beautiful, the room spacious and the neighbourhood is perfect for exploring Paris and getting to the main sights. The dog and the cats are absolutely adorable <3

Absolutely loved my stay at this flat. It was quiet yet conveniently located close to attractions and amenities. During the days and evenings, I could walk and see all Paris had to offer. My host Jordan was very pleasant and responsive. He was a wonderful host. I would love to return.

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Paris! The apartment was exceptionally clean, which made it feel welcoming and comfortable from the moment we arrived. The host clearly pays attention to detail, and everything was well-maintained and thoughtfully arranged. The location was perfect for exploring the city, with easy access to public transportation, cafes, and shops. We would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a spotless, cozy spot to experience Paris

Fantastic location, right next to the Datadog office. The door is quite annoying to open until you learn exactly how it works, and it's fairly easy to lock yourself out since the door can lock itself without the key, and only 1 key is provided.
Great place. Clean. Location was fantastic. Jean-Luc was a great host, communicated with us and gave great check in and location instructions. Would recommend to anyone.
It was a great stay at the place of Agnes. I felt safe in the residency and liked the location of the flat. Communication with Agnes was easy :-) I would recommend! Thank you, Agnes!

We had to leave after the first night. Significant Mold in both bathrooms, dusty and not clean/stained elsewhere. No working space as advertised. No closet where to hand your shirts, small and doubles as cleaning tools storage area. Should not be listed on Airbnb

We had a nice 3-day trip to Paris. The AirBnB was small but had everything you needed and was very comfortable and cozy. The Location is just perfect, 10-20 minutes by bike to reach basically everything you want to see in Paris, you have amazing Restaurants and Bars nearby. Overall we experienced a nice stay in Paris and the AirBnB had to offer everything we could’ve asked for.
We had a lovely stay and chat with the very friendly host. The room and apartment are beautiful. 5 star rating for sure!

Delphine’s house was lovely!! Very clean and homey with great decoration, the place was spacious and the kitchen perfect for cooking meals if you’re looking to save money during your stay. Delphine as a host was responsive, kind and passionate about her space, would love to visit Paris again and If so would definitely choose Delphine’s airbnb!!!
Outstanding location, flat decorated with beautiful chic decor, was roomy and comfortable for 2 travelers sleeping in separate bedrooms. Would stay there again!

Spacious room with a private bathroom and toilet, in a great location. The bed and pillows were very comfortable. Pierre was very friendly, responsive, flexible and offered a lovely free breakfast - many thanks!
Very comfortable, well-designed, quiet, excellent sleep, nice bathrooms, very responsive host. Nice touches. We had one issue and Vincent addressed it immediately. We will be back!

It was very conveniently located although there was a nightlong party on the road below do keep that in mind. Quarters are cramped as is perhaps to be expected in Paris. The good: mattresses comfortable, water for shower hot and plentiful, two (!!) refrigerators, location “in the middle of everywhere”. The not so good: pretty cheap furniture with some broken stuff, noisy from street below, quite cramped quarters.

The apartment was just as described. Tucked back in a beautiful courtyard. Quiet at night and felt very safe. Was in the perfect location next to many iconic sites, restaurants and amenities. Julien was a great host, very responsive and accommodating. Would definitely stay here again!
Eléonore's apartment was lovely! Very clean and comfortable. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend.
Good location, on arrival host said to not check in until he said so even though it stated check in was at 3. Which caused us to enter late. Bathroom and kitchen clean, bed sheets clean.
Yohann was a wonderfully responsive host. He and his team very helpful checking in and out. The apartment is nicely furnished and very comfortable.

Overall, this is a great rental. The apartment is spacious and in a great location, and Yannis was very responsive. The apartment is a home, rather than exclusively a rental, and it was generally very clean. I took one star off for cleanliness only because some areas were not as clean as other rentals I’ve stayed at that get professionally cleaned. Overall, we had a great stay here.
A beautiful and well located place to see Paris. Tony was great in solving a small problem with the espresso machine, on a Sunday morning. Highly recommend ❤️
Had a great experience. Sébastien was always alert and responded when required even though there was not much to ask him for since he hands out a link with intructions and places he recommends.

Solid host and Happy was really nice! Be prepared to make a few furry friends cause they are really clingy and cute. If you’re a light sleeper, might want to bring earplugs cause you’ll hear everything in the building. The walls are pretty thin - likely because of the age of the building. Other than that its a nice stay in Paris
Great location, secure, near to Eiffel Tower, Nicolas was always resonding all doubts, I would definitely come back again.

This is the perfect spot for a small group weekend. Comfy beds, including the couch futon. Clean, homey, and cozy. The place isn't big but fits five close people well. The location was great for traveling to and from, nearby two metro lines and many bus stops. Also surrounded by a handful of bars, restaurants, and bakeries. Hosts communicated relatively well and check-in was smooth and accommodating.
Location was great, very easy check in and check out! Matthieu was very accommodating and responsive! Shower was great, everything worked well, I recommend!!! Thank you so much :)
had a great time here! it was close to arc the triomph and the eiffeltower.
We had a great stay! Clean and everything we needed. So easy to get all around Paris and lots of fun bars and restaurants nearby.
We enjoyed our stay in Paris! Great location and many things to see near the area. So many wonderful restaurants and cafes as well! The hosts were very helpful in all aspects of our stay. Merci!
It’s a cute apartment. But the wall is so thin I could hear my neighbour’s conversation on the phone. Or whatever they were doing in their apartment. Bit small but very well kept.

The place was clean and cozy. A tram station is located just outside of the apartment. 5-10 minutes walk to the nearest metro station. To centre of city around 20-30 minutes on metro, or 30-40 minutes by bus. Restaurant and supermarket nearby. Host promptly responded to our questions and provided local tips. Recommended.
We really enjoyed our stay here. The neighborhood is fabulous and very safe, near tons of great restaurants and close to transit. I would definitely stay here again next time I’m in Paris!
The home was just as described. The street is quiet and quaint. Marlène was quick to respond to prior to check in and made sure everything was as expected after. Can’t wait to visit again.

My girlfriend and I had an amazing time at Gary's apartment. Gary's proactive communication and clear instructions made for an effortless stay. We loved being able to explore all of St. Germain from a central starting point. The apartment was spacious and cozy and made us feel like locals. Really appreciated the building's lift, too!

Didier is a fantastic host!! Very responsive and friendly. What really set Didier apart, is his kindness and generosity. Didier truly cares about their guests and takes the time to make sure everything is perfect for their stay. I felt very well taken care of throughout the entire experience. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a wonderful, stress-free stay with a host who genuinely makes you feel like part of their home. Thank you so much, Didier, for everything!

Good: The apartment is centrally located. A lot of things to do and we feel safe in our surroundings. Bad: Communications and Cleanliness Upon checking in, we were greeted with the apartment not anywhere ready (I will not go into detail here.) I sent a message to Maroussia immediately letting her know the apartment was not ready for us. She did not get back to me until the next day after everything was resolved. The floor in the small toilet room filled with urine so we had to place the kitchen mat in the toilet room to use the toilet.
Miguel was a fantastic host. The apartment was comfortable, cosy and spotlessly clean. There was a little noise from other apartments and the street but I would 100% stay there again.

A great place to stay in Paris, in a neighborhood that was a bit of a walk to more touristy things but we knew that going in. The hosts son greeted us and was super sweet and welcoming but not very responsive about amenities. They also had a party on a Monday night so just be mindful that there isn’t much sound insulation. It was a great place to stay for the price!

Everything was as we expected, super easy access to the train stations, happy with cleanliness and ease of communication. The place is quite small and the shower might be a problem for anyone with mobility issues or of a larger size, but we had no problems.

I had a great time at Ben's place. The check in was easy and Ben gave us very good instructions and advices. We had a problem with the shower drain and Ben was very helpful and helped solve the problem quickly.

I really liked this apartment🩵🩵🩵. It was very clean, comfortable mattress, no street noise and you can sleep well at night. The apartment has a pleasant atmosphere and absolutely everything for a comfortable stay, lots of closets. I also highly appreciate the communication with the owner. Thank you very much!!!💎💎💎
Great location, good host. Very close to St Lazare is a plus. Good area, felt safe, access to both metro and RER. The place was as advertised, good value.

Belleville is a great neighbourhood to be out of the crowds of the tourist centre of Paris. It has a Great diverse vibe and restaurants. Pascal’s apartment is right in the center of Belleville and the view from the apartment is crazy. It looks over all of Paris.

Had a lovely stay here, Hugo was very responsive and helpful. It was better than we imagined. You could see the tip of the Effiel tower out of the window and it was in very reasonable walking distance to see. This place was perfect for our short stay in Paris, would recommend!

Great hosts, cannot say enough of how easy Anne was to communicate with about my travel delays the daybof check-in. Lovely home with alot of charm and all the amamenities one needs. Comfortable bed, good water pressure. Walkable to several different locations.

Jean-Christophe's place is perfect for a stay in Paris. It's very comfortable and clean and located in a very nice neighborhood as well. Jean-Christophe is also incredibly gracious and friendly and has lots of great recommendations for exploring Paris!

The loft was just what we wanted. In a great location an easy short trip from Gare du Nord. Close to lots of eateries and shops. The space was clean, warm and comfortable and had everything we needed. Ines was always helpful and responsive so everything was straightforward. Thank you!!

This place was great. It is very clean. The metro is right next to the place. It is a safe area. There are many restaurants nearby. The louvre is walking distance. Les Halle’s is nearby. There is a supermarket below the building. Also Catherine is a great host. The place was spotless and well decorated. Catherine explained everything well and gave us a nice tour of the place. The apt is also safe and there are elevators which is a huge plus. I was highly recommend this apt.
Beatrice was a wonderful, friendly host who communicated with us constantly and made us feel at home. Excellent location and easy access, highly recommend!

My family & I stayed in Clement’s beautiful apartment! The view of the Eiffel Tower is magnificent! It’s close to a market if you feel like picking on cheese & crackers! The metro is down the street! I would come back again & again! This is 10….

A great place amongst it, nice open plan studio with easy ground floor access. The studio is bright and airy with natural light from the courtyard. It feels like old Paris, and you wouldn’t know the city is right there. An urban retreat!
The apartment was very cozy and the place was a great area. The beds were big and super comfortable. We enjoyed our stay.

Great location, everything was clean and reliable/responsive hosts. 2 showers was a great move. We also felt super safe and very much enjoyed our stay. Not a ton of natural light but it didn’t matter because for us since we were out and about all day. It is small so our bags occupied the the living room and wish it had a full body mirror. I appreciate their flexibility good communication. Good choice overall I recommend this apartment, thank you so much!

Dan place was very nice, exactly how described on the pictures. Also, walkable and quiet the Eiffel tower is close by and also local transportation. Very responsive host as well and make sure we were good throughout our time there. I would recommend and come back again if it’s available!

This apartment is a gem near the Louvre. It felt spacious with 2 bedrooms and very private with the courtyard entrance. It was perfect for staying with kids. We were a quick walk to a Metro entrance, market for supplies, and countless cafe’s to grab food. We found ourselves walking home most nights because we were close to many of the attractions we wanted to see. Jean-Luc was very responsive and always quick to reply if we had a question. The coffee machine in the kitchen was amazing- great to have fresh ground coffee at the touch of a button every morning.

Loved our stay at Elsa’s apartment! The apartment was small but had everything we could want and need. She was very helpful in checking in. We enjoyed walking to the Marias area, so many delicious bakeries and restaurants near by!! We would definitely stay there again!

Very easy walk to the Arc de Triomphe. Fantastic location. Close to shops, restaurants and public transport. Very tranquil when you go back to the apartment after a long day of sightseeing. Would recommend to anyone travelling to Paris. Albert was helpful with some recommendations for local restaurants and had a very quick response time. Would not hesitate to stay here again.

Absolutely lovely host, very friendly and attentive. Was a little loud due to neighbours, but absolutely beautiful view of the Effiel Tower and really great heating for winter time. Note for anyone else staying: don't put hobs and grill on at the same time as the power will cut out, but is easy to fix. Overall, lovely stay and will happily return ◡̈
If you want to live near shops and restaurants, this is the place. The host is very communicative and responds all questions you have.

Anne & Jean-Luc provided a lovely stay for our trip to Paris! Anne was available whenever we reached out and was so welcoming to us. The home was perfectly situated on quieter block but still a close walk to cafes and the Metro. We felt safe and comfortable coming back each day and loved the cozy feel of the apartment! It was a great experience and offered the feeling of living like a local.

Our stay at 38 Quai Henry IV was absolutely exceptional! The location, right along the Seine with breathtaking views of the river and Île Saint-Louis, is unbeatable and perfectly captures the essence of Paris. The apartment was immaculate, beautifully designed, and equipped with all the comforts of home, making it both elegant and cozy. Its central location allowed us to easily walk to landmarks like Notre Dame and Le Marais, while still enjoying a peaceful and safe neighborhood. Our host was incredibly responsive and accommodating, ensuring a seamless experience from start to finish. We highly recommend this gem for an unforgettable Parisian stay!

The stay was good and Merveil was always responsive. The apartment is big and the rooms really match the pictures. The apartment is on the ground floor. The only problems were the bathroom being quite humid and the walls were moldy. The apartment smelled a bit humid and like a basement. Also there was construction on the same side of the street right infront of the bedroom windows - it was very loud from 8AM onwards.
Nice little hotel in the city center. Improving the airflow would be good as when the window is closed for a longer time there a humidity smell.

Great stay! Great location... it was so easy to walk everywhere. A bit noisy being on the first floor but that was expected. Patrick was great, he kept good communication and allowed us to drop the luggage early in the morning before check-in. Would definitely stay again.

I have stayed in many airbnbs in Paris and Catherine’s apartment was the best I’ve stayed at so far. She was communicative from the start and provided clear instructions for checkin and was able to greet us when we arrived earlier than expected. The apartment is a large size for Paris and plenty of space for a family although it was just two of us. The views from the top floor are amazing and felt very Parisian. There is everything you need in the apartment for a week or more stay but if you need anything it is literally right on top of a monoprix. Our favorite part is that it is also right next to the metro stop and wonderful streets like rue montorgueil. There are endless things to do and easily walkable neighborhoods nearby. Only a 15 minute walk to Le marais center and the louvre. I will definitely be staying here again!

Very close to the metro. Right next to a school, so lots of foot traffic noise during the day, but totally fine at night. Location is very close to everything you need, including shops and restaraunts.
Everything went very well. The communication was easy and we got quick replies. The apartment is beautiful.

Such a great spot! The view is the Eiffel Tower is just breathtaking & being able to see it nonstop is unbeatable. Host was super helpful & the location is central with shops & restaurants close by. 10/10 felt safe as a solo female

Maria is a great host, they met me at the house, introduced the house in detail. Apartment was so clean, everything is thought. She is lovely and very helpfull. I rented the apartment again for january. There was nothing unexpected and you can reach them any time you need. Location is great. Heating is great. I gelt like I am living in my own place.
Had a comfortable and nice stay there. Location is amazing with so many things to do, walkable distance to the attractions and many metro stations around.
Really beautiful apartment in a fantastic location! I would definitely stay again. Anne & Jean-Luc were brilliant hosts. Very helpful and welcoming. I would recommend this apartment to anyone!

It is located in a nice neighborhood, but far away from touristic attractions. It is smaller than expected, ideal for no more than one or two guests. Super clean, hot water available, small kitchen, wifi, TV, one bed and a sofa-bed.
Great location in Paris with easy access to the metro and shops/restaurants. The home is large, spacious, and well kept.
Helpful and accommodating, Ronan made me feel right at home. Good vibes and tasty soup. Highly recommended!
I really love this place. So clean and cozy and warm. There are many good restaurants. Thank you so much ◡̈

Very clean and spacious airbnb with nice bathrooms. There was no lift to the apartment which wasn’t necessarily an issue for us. The location is okay. The only minor issue we had was a strange warm musty smell, but otherwise, the Airbnb was very clean and nice.
Had a great time in Paris thanks to this Airbnb situated near many stations. The room was very clean as well.

This apartment was absolutely perfect for our family of 5. It was clean, spacious, and had every necessary amenity. The neighborhood was wonderful! So much to see and do. We had on-foot access to museums, historical sites, shopping, dining, and the Metro within minutes. The elevator was a nice feature, too. We would happily stay here again!
Great location just steps from Cathedral of Notre Dame and plenty of cozy bistros. Cute Parisian apartment. Spiral staircase was fun. Host was great and super helpful.

Blessing's place, is peaceful and located in a great area. A lot of accommodation are close to the apartment, great Vietnamese and Chineses restaurant, a gym 5min walk from the apartment. The view is really nice from every room. I definitely recommend, we were 3 and felt really confortable there. Thanks
A beautiful loft in a beautiful area! I would stay here again in a heartbeat. The hot bath was such a relief after my travels.
The apartment was in a great location with an amazing view of the Eiffel Tower!! Abel was a great host and was super responsive. Thank you for hosting us!
Nice airbnb for a short stay in Paris - great location and easy check-in and communication with the hosts!

Sirine was a great host! The communication with her was so clear and she responded super fast and friendly to every question and request we had. Her apartment was perfect for a couple, everything we needed was there. We quite enjoyed the area, there were some really nice restaurants and cafes close by. The location was also quite easy to reach. I would totally recommend her apartment for a cozy stay in Paris!
We enjoyed our stay at this property. The flat is lovely and perfectly situated for a short trip, if you’d like to be close to good shopping and restaurants.
Julia was a great person and the apartment has a good and safe location. I recommend this place.

Everything was perfect and match the description. Area is nice with easy access to public transport and many restaraunts (and many landmarks in a walking distance!). Apartment is spacious and very welcoming. Communication was perfect, we never had any problems. Would definitely recommend! Thank you!

We had an amazing a time staying at Anthony’s. The apartment was cute and cozy and provided us with everything that we need. It’s conveniently located not too far from a metro stop that allowed us to reach all parts of the city with ease. Overall a pleasurable stay.

Had a wonderful stay in Pascal’s lovely, cozy and clean apartment. Pascal is such a responsive, friendly and super helpful host! Great location - short walk to Le Bon Marche, grocery stores, wonderful restaurants and bakeries. Will definitely choose to stay here again. ❤️
Great location to metro, restaurants and bars. Bruno was helpful with late check in. Beds were comfortable. Space had all essentials needed.

Thoroughly enjoyed spending a week in Yannis' apartment. Very comfortable, spacious, warm and above all, QUIET. The apartment is set back from a very busy street and as a light sleeper, I didn't hear a thing at bedtime! Yannis is an excellent host. He reached out several times during our stay to check in and to see if there was anything we needed. Sincerely appreciated this communication. Merci beaucoup, Yannis!
Thank you Kathleen, I really enjoyed my stay. The location was brilliant (very close to the arc de triomphe), the apartment was lovely and there was even 3 cute pets!

Kathleen was a wonderful host. I really enjoyed my stay in her lovely home. It is well situated, with lots to do in the area. The room is clean and comfortable. Her adorable pets were the cherry on the cake.

We loved our stay as it was close to so many restaurants, cafes, bakery, cheese shop, wine shop, you name it! Not far from public transportation, but it was a bit difficult to acquire an Uber. You have to walk out 10 min or so to the bigger streets. Felt at home and the area was lively and safe!

This is one my favorite Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed in! We loved it so much we extended our stay here. The apartment is cozy and quiet, and the view from the windows looks out over the beautiful rooftops of Paris. The bed was super comfortable and the apartment was well stocked with extra pillows, blankets, towels etc. The location is perfect as well, very close to all that Paris has to offer! I would give this Airbnb 10/10 stars ⭐️

Amazing location with great restaurants on your doorstep and easy to access the great attractions of Paris. Very good communication from the host. Please travel with someone with whom you are very comfortable - there are large windows from the bedroom/lounge into the bathroom!

This Airbnb was so amazing we booked it for extra nights! The space is so cute and cozy, and very close to amazing little cafes and bistros. The Lourve is less than a 20 minute walk as well as other main attractions! This Airbnb was so perfect, I look forward to staying here on my next trip to Paris! 😊

Our hosts were very helpful and quick to respond with recommendations. The apartment was so charming and unique. We loved the area full of great restaurants and shopping. We definitely would recommend to anyone considering a stay here!

Amazing location and accommodation for the price!!! we had netflix, heating, and a killer view. the only issue we had was a lot of trouble with the lock and the bathroom smelled bad. but other than that it was so worth it, was super clean, and served us super well on our trip:) TY!

We loved our stay at Eloise’s place. The location is great because it’s near by a metro and it’s very easy to get by also the area the flat was in felt very safe. Speaking of the flat, the atmosphere in there was cozy and felt very homely, the pictures are true to reality. We also loved how quickly and efficiently Eloise would communicate with us, she would answer all of our questions and also provide extra information and in general she was a very sweet and friendly person. Overall we loved the experience and definitely wish to come back!
A great apartment. Easy enough to access all tourists spots from the metro that was about a 5 minute walk. Lovely decorated and clean. Thank you
Great location and an easy check-in process. Unfortunately, the bathroom was not as clean and there was mold in the shower.
The place and the host were great. Cozy studio that felt like home. I would recommend to anyone. Clean and safe space.

We really enjoyed our stay at Natsumi's place - the apartment is clean and cosy, and the neighborhood really nice with useful stores and bakeries within five minutes walk. We would definitely consider staying again with Natsumi.

HIGHLY recommend!!!! What a fantastic area to stay in, and walking distance from the metro, local shops and restaurants. Loved this area of Paris. We were a large group with ages ranging from baby to elderly parents of 70years old and the stay was comfortable for everyone. Other comments mentioned noises from the metro, you can hear the metro from the apartment but it was not loud and did not bother us one bit. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it for larger groups. The hosts were also fantastic. Fast to respond with any silly questions I had.

Great stay super central in Paris! Very affordable and amazing value for location. Place is great for two people and Hugues was very responsive and flexible for our check in and directions. Only downside was there was only enough hot water for one shower but overall would definitely stay again.
Everything was perfect and described in details . Couldn’t have wish for a better host and place to stay in Paris!
Very nice place to stay. Clean and very little checkout tasks. Quick to respond and professional. Was a little loud from the other people staying in different apartments, but overall very nice
Great spot, close to everything but tucked away. Felt safe in the area too. The staff were amazing super helpful
This was the perfect airbnb for our 8 day stay in Paris. It was the perfect cozy home when we were tired after a long day of exploring to unwind and still feel like an adventure.

I was visiting Paris with my 3 teen children and Kevin’s place was great. Super clean, beautiful light, the windows looking down on the street were wonderful. Everything was easy and perfect. Would come again!!

Very good location, close to the Moulin Rouge and close to the metro station and to walk around the Montmartre area. We had a great stay. Responsive host and very clean apartment. We had a great stay, would come back and recommend!

Honestly great location. Tons of food options. Felt it was located really well for tourist attractions. This was a quick trip for my mom’s first time in Paris and this listing was perfect! Highly recommend.

Denka's flat was awesome, beddings was spotless, location was walkable to nearby Printempes and Gallery Lafeyette. Nearest train is St Lazarre Exit 6 and turn left towards Rue de Llsly. Will definitely return here. Highly recommended.
It was a lovely stay, the apartment is amazing, great location in the 17th, lovely hosts who were super responsive and provided recommendations. Very much recommended.
Alex and his team were very nice and super helpful / responsive. The place was amazing, everything as described. The location was perfect. 10/10 would recommend staying here.
New, cosy and clean apartment, walkable to everywhere. Safe neighbourhood, and with a good working elevator. Can have a restful and peaceful sleep, away from noises. And a good washer and dryer.

Tessa’s place was absolutely wonderful. It’s just 20 minutes from major attractions, with part of that time being a short walk to the train. The area is convenient, with plenty of pharmacies and grocery stores nearby. Initially, I was skeptical about staying in a room so close to the hosts, but I had complete privacy and didn’t even see or hear them once. Do yourself a favor and book this stay—you won’t regret it. Tessa and her partner are fantastic hosts, responding quickly and ensuring a seamless experience. For the price and proximity to everything, this place is unbeatable. I visit Paris often and will definitely be staying here again. Thank you, Tessa!
Alexandra's place was beautiful and comfortable. We felt like we stepped into a beautiful home opened for our enjoyment.
The studio had good facilities. It was warm and comfortable. The location also was very good. Ben is very hospitable. He tries to fix any problems quickly and responds in a timely manner.

Geographical location: It is close to the North Train Station, which is very convenient for transportation. However, the area is not very safe at night. Fortunately, the house is located on a main street, so it is acceptable. Room facilities: Standard, and the actual items match the description. Communication with the host was easy, and the check-in process went smoothly.
We found Francine very responsive and helpful, even when small problems occurred. She is pleasant.

The property was clean and well organized! It was located close to the metro which made it easy to get around and see the whole city! The bed was comfortable. I would definitely visit again. Thank you so much for having us.

We had a great stay. Giovanni had some good tips of what to do and where to eat around the neighboorhood. The room is really nice, has all you need and in a charming street. Since it is not in the most touristy areas of Paris we got a nice impression of a different side of the city and there is loads to explore around.
We enjoyed every minute of our stay! The place was perfect, great location, and comfortable. Host was so helpful and kind! Thanks so much!!

It was a pleasure to stay at John’s place. From the moment we booked he was responsive and extremely helpful. John’s place has a great location for exploring Paris. It’s near a metro station and you can find a lot of good restaurants/bakeries around. He also gave us some tips/advices and was very flexible regarding our needs. Thank you, hope to meet again!
Polyna's accommodation was exactly like the pictures. It was clean and tidy and had everything we needed. Its close to everything easy to find. We would definitely stay again.
Great place! It’s the second time that I’m staying at Julia’s place. It’s always a pleasure. She’s reactive, flexible and communicate very well. Her place is warm and makes me feel like home.

very nice stay. we had a great time at the place. the apartment was clean and cost. the host was very helpful, clear with instructions and very friendly. lots of coffee shops, restaurants and supermarket very near by. would definitely stay again and would recommend the apartment. thank you so much!
Thanks Gary a wonderful location and creative environment you’ve created Loved it 🥰
The host was extremely responsive and helpful when we needed help or had questions. Place was in an amazing location. Would stay there again.
Claire was very helpful and the apartment was just as described. Location is close to metro line in nice neighborhood. Will definitely book again

The location was superb in walking distance to many attractions, restaurants and bars. The apartment was small but enough for 4 for 2 nights. It was renovated but there was a smell in the bathroom since the building was very old. It was clean and has enough amenities. Leo was very helpful and easy to communicate with. Definitely recommend the place.
Had great time staying at Ygal’s place. Flat was clean with all essentials in order. Definitely recommend the place if you are planning a trip to Paris. The view from the living room is stunning.
cozy room with a great open kitchen. toilet is spacious. very clean when arrived. owner was very helpful in check-in and offer the best possible experience for us.

This apartment was in a fantastic location close to the Louvre and metro stope so you can easily get anywhere in Paris. There were fantastic restaurants nearby. The apartment itself was spacious and clean. The bed was comfortable and the shower had great pressure and hot water. The apartment had all the comforts of home and was a nice place to relax after walking all day. It is up some flights of stairs but the apartment is very quiet and private. I would definitely stay here again when visiting Paris. Thanks for a great stay!

We LOVED staying at Camille’s place. Our two children were so excited about the bunk beds and the toys to borrow during our stay. Camille was friendly and helpful with recommendations in the area. We hope to return someday!

Great little studio apartment which is centrally located. We loved the location and the area seemed very safe. Our only negatives were the stairs were really steep and the place was very cold for a winter night.
Very kind owner, always responsive and accommodation was ready on time and perfectly clean. Very good location and high quality .

It is clean and cosy. The location is very convenient which is just few minutes walk to metro station and supermarkets. Thomas is nice and helpful, always give us prompt reply. I have no doubt to recommend others to stay here:)

Great little place centrally located - metro locations are close as well as some great restaurants/shopping. Pretty close walking to some attractions. The place is very small with limited amenities but good for a solo traveler.

Great apt in an excellent location. Rahim was an amazing host. He even help me talking to airbnb after i reserved by mistake another dates and even helped me avoid the extras fees. All well as described
Stay was very comfortable. Helene is a good host and would love to stay again when I visit Paris

The Marais is a lovely part of Paris and we enjoyed staying there, however the apartment unfortunately lacked a few essentials (soap, bedroom heating) and there was no local advice / instructions from our host.
Lovely 'historic meets modern' apartment on a quaint street, in a centrally located area of Paris. Quick to respond to inquiries. Fantastic stay!
The apartment is lovely, very comfortable and clean and fit the 5 of us perfectly. Great location. Very attentaive and responsive host. Would definitely stay there again and recommend to others.

Erwan is an impeccable and friendly host. Loved the detailed instructions and the personal touch of his reception card and amazing bottle of wine. He got in touch several times just to check what we needed. The place is a perfect location, and is super secure and cozy. I could’ve stayed another week!
Etienne is wonderful and his place is an outstanding find in the city. 4 minute walk to the train gets you anywhere in the city in under a half hour.

Didier’s space is amazing snd inspired me to fashion any future kitchen remodel I may do to be like his. The market street it’s on was perfect and we felt safe and part of everyday Paris life. And the master bedroom bed was exceptionally comfortable. Didier is a wonderful host!

Ugo was very responsive throughout the process. The apartment had everything we needed for our stay and the location for Eiffel Tower, Notre Dame etc was perfect. Whilst modern the flat had been tastefully refurbished to honour its french history with the original fireplace in situ.
This is definitely the best Airbnb I have ever stayed at! Sophie was absolutely amazing, so friendly and helpful, and I will definitely visit again! Thank you Sophie :)

Everything about our stay at Cristina’s home was top-notch from my very first communication at booking to our key drop off at checkout. The apartment is just as pictured and is incredibly welcoming and homey. There is everything you might need available to you during your stay and Cristina was particularly helpful with information about the home and the neighborhood. 10/10 would stay here again in a heartbeat.
Great place to be, superb host who is always helpful. The place could have been cleaner, but other than that quite perfect and location is best possible in the budget.

Mariana’s place was perfect for our family of four. The apartment was charming and very clean. The location is great since it was walking distance to the metro station and just steps away from restaurants, bakeries, markets and several stores. It is very close to Place de Vosges and walking distance to the Notre Dame and Latin Quarters. We enjoyed our visit and recommend to those wanting to stay at Le Marais area. Mariana always responded to my messages and had everything clearly detailed in her welcome notebook.

Great location near the Eiffel Tower and comfortable for our family of four. The apartment is ground floor with large windows in the living room, making it colder in the living room during winter months, something to keep in mind if you are planning on using the sofa bed.

We absolutely loved staying at the loft! ❤️ We will plan to be back anytime we come to Paris again. The loft itself is beautiful and roomy and staying at the loft has you feel like a local. It was very easy to access and use public transportation. Staying at the loft definitely enhanced our Paris experience! Highly recommend to other Paris guests!
