Armande is very responsive and easy to talk to. She takes great care for letting us feel at ease immediately. Her place is so convenient for restaurants, especially Asian cuisine, also for public transportation. The view from the flat is just like she describes - skyline in the southeastern Paris, amazing ! All in all, we had a very pleasant stay with her, inside Paris.
The place is as described. Public transport is really close by and the place is full of amenities. Paul is always responsive and provide some guidance around

The perfect airbnb for a family of 4. We stayed at Haiyan’s place over Christmas/New Year’s and we loved it. Walking distance to Arc du Triomphe and buses/metro, plenty of options to eat and close to the famous Lenôtre Patisserie. The apartment itself is spacious and beds comfortable. Kitchen has gas stove perfect for cooking which is essential when travelling with young kids. There is no baby cot however but we managed fine with the two comfortable beds. Highly recommend!
Lou was very nice, he was willing to answer any of our questions. The apartment was located in very good destination with a lot of grocery stores, restaurants etc. We recommend :)

The key needs to get picked up from a spot 15 min away and dropped off there as well which is very inconvenient. Furthermore, the apartment is up the 5th floor with no elevator and the smallest staircase ever. We were here in December and it was warmer outside than in the building. All that for the unreasonably high price

Paul’s apartment was a great choice and we had a lovely experience. Very peaceful and quiet neighborhood, yet extremely close to Tour Eiffel and well connected overall. Definitelly worth a 5-star rating.

Location was excellent.! at a walkable distance from Trocadero and eiffel tower. Very close to essential stores (bakery, restaurant, supermarket, etc) and metro stations. The apartment had everything to make our stay comfortable. Lin always quickly responded to any question and was very flexible with the check in which was really helpful.

We really appreciated all the care taken by Ethel for our stay in this lovely Airbnb! The neighborhood was wonderful and the apartment is just lovely. Well appointed, comfortable, and we had everything we needed. Thank you so much for an absolutely lovely time.
We loved the apartment-it was a fun place in Paris! We had a great time & it was easy to walk or take Uber around-thank you
Nice and quiet neighborhood close to subway stations and some nice bakeries and restaurants. The apartment was cozy and had everything necessary for our stay.
The hosts and owner were wonderful. Great location and very quiet for being in the heart of Paris! I would definitely stay here again.
Highly Recommended for families. The furnitures are great and it's a great place for antique lovers. A truly Parisian apartment that makes you feel like a Parisian. We love it!

We enjoyed our stay during the new years eve period. The house was very nice, small but well equipped and more than enough for a 4-5 days stay. We had some problems with the keys but apart from that everything was okay! I recommend this airbnb also for the location, the area is very calm, it has everything below and very well connected. For the cleaning we were very satisfied! If you are planning to visit during winter, note that it gets a bit cold inside the house. So at the end I recommend and I would definitely come back !!!
A beautiful apartment in a great location. Would highly recommend to all and will hopefully return one day.

Had a lovely stay in this true Parisian apartment - good amenities, transport links, all our favourite areas were walkable. Would stay again & was very grateful for the late check-out (knowing our bags were safe while we wandered Paris on our final day before heading home to London). Merci! 💛
We stayed there for a week. The location was great. The place matched the photos, really cozy apartment.

The bathroom should have a something like a heater to warm up the place especially for the winter , and also it needs a little carpet on the floor at the room for the winter , also the heater at the room it wasn’t really warming up ! A part from that all was ok ! Lovely place little for few days , Jonathan was very responsive and very friendly guy ! Definitely worth it for few couple of days

The room was just as pictured. The staff was welcoming and friendly. The bed was comfortable and the room was perfect for a night before catching the train the following morning. Train station was a short 5 minute walk away! It was smaller than expected with little room for moving around or luggage so not really appropriate for a longer stay, otherwise it was great!

Sophie is an amazing host and made us feel very welcome. She is attentive and quick to respond. Eddy (the dog) is calm and always ready to be petted. The place is fantastic, super clean, and in a great location close to restaurants and groceries. It’s near the metro (7 minutes on foot from Pereire station) and bus stops. I highly recommend staying at Sophie’s place. Thank you so much, and see you soon, Sophie :)
We stayed for one night with kids. The flat was clean and quiet. Tue location superb - Belleville is such an interesting place.

We loved our stay here! The apartment was very comfortable, secure, and we felt at home with everything we needed. We absolutely loved the location, with so many fun and bars and restaurants right outside the door. Just a few blocks from the canal as well, a really wonderful neighborhood to explore and easy access to the metro to get anywhere in Paris in minutes. The hosts were responsive and so helpful!! We highly recommend this spot for your next Paris trip!
It was a nice experience, host helped with all the requests we had and was very friendly. Strongly recommended.
What a beautiful place, a great location and lovely interior. Rudy was a wonderful host, very responsive and flexible. We look forward to visiting again (hopefully) soon.

My mom and sister visited me for the holidays and asked to visit Paris. Marina’s apartment was an ideal place to stay. The neighborhood was peaceful with only a short walking distance to the metro and dozens of restaurants and bars. We particularly enjoyed one morning where we got pastries and coffee at the nextdoor bakery and walked around the nearby Montparnasse cemetery, seeing the writers and philosophers that we have read. Overall it’s a very pleasant place to stay for a visit to Paris.

Fantastic place, super central and walkable to just about anywhere. Tony was an amazing host and such a great communicator! Flat was cozy and comfortable and had everything we needed. Would totally recommend for people who want to be in a lively central location!

Eleanor’s place was the perfect location to use as our base for exploring Paris for our 4 night stay. Easy access to public transportation, great food and drink options everywhere. Your quintessential Paris walk-up overlooking the surrounding rooftops.

Marie's place is truly beautiful - the pictures do it justice! And Marie, as a host, is wonderful - quick to respond to any queries and very flexible with our checkout. I would definitely recommend to anyone who wants to be within walking distance of the Sacré-Cœur with its bustling square just around the corner (for food/drinks/people watching). Or anyone who just wants to enjoy Paris!
Very kind and responsive host. However, the room is very small and the toilet is smelly. Great location though as it is near several supermarkets and restaurants.
Lovely stay at Ifraans place! Very quaint apartment in great location! little smaller than expected however still perfect for 2 people.

Our host was very responsive and friendly. We felt taken care of during our stay. In addition, the apartment was beautiful, super clean, and in a great location! The neighborhood felt safe and has many restaurants, coffee shops, and boutiques. It’s a perfect place for a Paris visit.
The location is excellent, and the cleanliness was top-notch. The studio looks exactly as shown in the pictures. The only downside was the uncomfortable bed, which also squeaked.
Cozy, Clean with White Linens and Towels, Quick and Responsive Host. Due to pouring rain, it was a bit of challenge to locate and unlock the key box but got it finally. Thank you!

Had an absolutely wonderful stay! Bernard was SO helpful and very responsive to any questions I had. The Airbnb was in a great location and had lots of places to eat just minutes away. It was very clean and looked exactly like photos.
It’s a really comfortable and adorable location! Very safe place, and also thanks to Leo cause an apartment was very cosy and clean

The apartment is lovely. We stayed in winter and didn’t get to enjoy the terrace but would definitely recommend anytime of year. It’s warm and cozy and clean and quiet. Building is pretty. Location is fantastic. Very close to metro station so easy to get everywhere. Would highly recommend.
Its nice they communicate amazing and very helpful! But the place is dusty and its above a restaurant so it was loud a lot. My allergies got very bad while I was staying there!
Alexis, place was awesome. Great location and super high tech. Would stay here again 100% next time I’m in Paris

Everything was perfect. The location is great and the appartment is perfect for a small stay in Paris. + is the view. Only point not good was the checkout at 10am which is very early. I recommend the appartment with a later checkout maybe...communication and instructions were perfect.

This was the PERFECT spot for our 2 night stay in Paris! We loved the easy walking to restaurants, shopping and museums. The apartment is cozy, clean and well equipped. It doesn’t have a kitchen but all we needed were the microwave and refrigerator for drinks and snacks. The bed and pillows were very comfortable. Oh was cheerful, quick to respond and super flexible with our requests. We look forward to staying here again!
Great studio, in the heart of the 2eme arrondissement to very conveniently located walking distance to a lot of nice restaurants. Enjoyed my stay!

The accommodations were exactly as described, right near the main street in Marais and near the metro station which was convenient. Getting into the unit was easy and they were very responsive when I needed additional items supplied. Apartment was very clean / neat and had everything you would need for a week.
We enjoyed our stay. The location is terrific. The apartment is close to the Louvre and the Petit Palais. Lots of fashionable shops nearby.
Good location ! Very small department. Bathroom smell bad, but maybe is because the building is old , but meet the expectations .
Great place to stay for a weekend in Paris. Very central and clean. We would gladly come back the next time.
A perfect stay. Centrally located and well appointed this is definitely an Airbnb we will return to. The host was beyond kind and anticipated our every need. Highly recommend
Tatiana’s apartment was incredibly beautiful, airy, and bright. It felt so much larger than its footprint, and smart design made living in the space easy and natural.
Enjoyed my stay here. Close to a lot of different spots that we wanted to hit. When I had a question, Denka was responsive.

Amazing stay at Pierre’s place! We had our own bathroom & the metro station is just in front of the door! We arrived early in the morning which was no problem for him. Also, enjoyed the nice breakfast at his kitchen. Very comfortable bed too :) Would 100% recommend🙏
Incredibly responsive and detailed in answering all our questions, making everything so easy to understand. The place was absolutely beautiful, and our stay was seamless. Highly recommend!

Very nice apartment vintage style. The neighborhood is great and you have everything near: metro, coffee shops, restaurants, fast food etc... Sofia is very responsive and welcoming. I probably will come back next year 😀

The apartment was beautiful and clean. Great location. I personally greatly appreciated the floor heating in the bathroom, considering we visited during a cold season. The host was very professional and helpful. I can definitely recommend this apartment.

Elsa home was as pictured in the listing. It was clean and we felt safe! The only issue was the heating as the home was cold at night. We did turn on the heat located behind the couch to 5 but it did not warm the place entirely . The shower was pretty small for a person on the wider side but the bathroom was a good size overall. I would definitely recommend the space to someone!! The location was pretty centralized which was easy for you to either take the train or catch a uber! Thanks

Really nice location and walkable from Gare Du Nord. A lot of shops, bars and restaurants around and really close to Sacre Coeur. Felt safe inside and out. Metro station really close too so very easy to get around!

We had an amazing time at Kaza Bella’s. From the moment we arrived in town, communication is proactive, responses were prompt and everyone we spoke with was very friendly. Check-in was extremely easy and the home was as it appeared in photos. We were celebrating a birthday and they were so sweet leaving a bottle of champagne! The home was comfortable, bright and cozy in a lovely neighborhood w many great restaurants and shops nearby. Extremely walkable and easy to navigate. The home is a gem - who would want to wake up and have a soak or sauna before starting there? Absolutely recommend and would stay again.

I have had horrible experiences in Paris with Airbnb’s and this was the exception! This place was cozy and small but everything else about this place was just more than perfect. The new technology in the house, the cleanness of the furniture aside from the house itself, the great neighborhood, the responsive owner, the thoughtful supply of some additional towels, hangers, kitchen supplies. All was above average and really a great experience overall. Thanks again!

We love Paris, so finding a place in the 2nd/3rd arrondisement was amazing. The place is a studio that has everything you need for a stay, with the great addition of a washer in case you are packing light. Easy to get in, great location, and a fun addition in having a TV with Netflix for the cold nights in. However, I must admit...you need earplugs and to bring shower cloths. The street had lots of noise at all hours and it was clearly heard. The shower is a little odd but you get used to it. Bed was clean but very firm, which is good for some but not for others. Overall a great place with that in mind and a location that is hard to beat!

Pictures don’t do this justice! Truly a remarkable home. The host was incredibly hospitable & helpful throughout the entire experience and as much as I’d love to experience another neighborhood of Paris next time we visit I can’t imagine staying anywhere else! Location is perfect.. it’s safe, clean, and fabulous. Thank you!
This is my second time stay here. Everything same as photo, highly recommended to whoever wants to stay near to gare du Nord.

Very nice and cozy private room close to all transport facilities. Delphine is a very welcoming and responsive, all the instructions were very clear and helpful. We had a comfortable conversation during my stay. Thanks again, Delphine! 🙂

1000/10 If you’re in Paris there is no better place to stay. Luxurious, great customer service, amazing attention to detail, and lovely maps + recommendations of all the sights and attractions in Paris. Very well communicated to get anywhere in Paris. Will definitely be staying here on my next trip to Paris.

Very cute room with a little bathroom and and own entrance next to his house. We were happy. the only thing to improve would be a mirror in the room. We missed that a little! :-) thank u giovanni for having us.

I would love to visit again if I return to Paris after a space full of inspiration, where very beautiful accommodation, beautiful furniture and art pieces reflecting Axel and Matt's great tastes coexist
Thanks for everything. We came very spontaneously and they got us covered. All in all a perfect experience.

Staying in the central area of Paris was truly a delightful experience. The neighborhood is filled with excellent French restaurants and charming bakeries, and there are supermarkets conveniently close by. The apartment itself is spacious and perfect for a stay of three to four people. Pascal was incredibly helpful and always willing to assist whenever needed.

Thank you for my stay it was ideal, close to Gare to Lyon which is perfect for me after my three night stay to get to the TGV and the mountains for skiing. I walked from the apartment to everywhere I needed or at the end of the day could get a metro/train near by to get home - perfect. I particularly liked opening the kitchen windows to see the courtyard garden opposite.

Delphine is very friendly and helpful, very easy communication. The appartement has everything you need for your stay. Very good location, 3 minutes away from the metro. Good price for what you receive. I would definitely recommend!

Anne was really welcoming and the apartment was very comfortable with a great location. Excellent market and patisserie across the street. Anne full of information and happy to hold our things both before and after the check in time. The only small negative was check in was at 5 pm. It wasn’t a problem for us, but could be if you are coming in on a US early morning flight.

The perfect stay in Paris! Tucked away on a quiet street but within a short walk-of everything you want to see & do in Paris. Very close to the Notre Dame and the Louvre. Many shops and restaurants within in walking distance. I would definitely stay here again.
Perfect place! So beautiful and peaceful. I very quiet, style and worm. Everything was beautiful and clean and comfortable

The place is very convenient to a lot of restaurants and small shops. Bertrand is a very incredible host. It was a terrific stay. My family is content. We tried the restaurant next door it’s pricey but they have great dish. Like I said, the place is very convenient to a lot of places. Thank you Bertrand!
The appartment was very good but the building and stairs very old. The elevator did not work for 9 of our 10 days there.

Stayed for a week while traveling for business. This place is brand new / recently renovated..everything new and clean. Very comfortable and spacious rooms. Ground floor, set back from the street so it’s very quiet and private. Keyless entry with codes so you’ll never have to worry about losing your key! Some of the best cafes and food on or very close by the Main Street. Would definitely stay here again without a second thought!
Communication was really nice and location is great. Bathroom doors were hard to open as there was no handle. But we enjoyed it nonetheless :)
Its an amazing clean and beautiful apartment! Lovely quiet building but very close to cute restaurants. The hosts were lovely too!

Very nice apartment, as described. Short walking distance to more than 2 metro stations. Near restaurants, grocery stores and cafes. Apartment confortable for a family of 3 or 4 people. Maybe a little bit noise when the apartment upstairs is busy. Recommend apartment to stay in Paris.

Honestly a great find. Perfect location, very private and in a great area. Host was so quick to respond and was really helpful, flexible and accommodating when it came to check in/out. Also the bath is huge! Will definitely stay here again.

The apartment was so lovely and bright! There were great windows that let in a lot of light. We loved the colorful decor and beautiful touches throughout. Loved the location and we had everything we needed for our quick trip!

This is a very good house, located in the center of the city, the subway and bus are within five minutes, the room is clean and tidy, my wife is a clean person, she is very satisfied with the cleanliness of the room, the public area is also very spacious and bright, facing the Paris city landscape. Monique and her husband Mr.Jean were the best hoster I've met. They gave us a lot of travel advice, food advice, and were careful enough not to disturb our personal space. Thank you very much for the help and care you gave us during our stay. I hope we can stay again next time
The place had everything I needed for a long weekend. Perfect location! Great value! Thank you Alex!
We were in Paris for a quick trip and this place was perfect! Amazing location, walkable everywhere and a nice clean and cute spot. Definitely would stay there again!
The place is pretty private and quiet among the center of city. The host prepared lots of drinks and coffee for us free to use. Overall good experience and helpful hosts.

We had an amazing stay! The security, transportation, and surrounding infrastructure were excellent, making it the perfect accommodation for a family trip. The location was convenient, with easy access to public transport, restaurants, and local attractions. The neighborhood felt safe and welcoming, allowing us to relax and fully enjoy our time. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the Paris!

Manon was extremely accommodating and sweet as she left us a treat upon arrival and letting us check in early. She was very friendly and provided us with local recommendations. She also always answered when we had questions. Her home was so cute and clean. It is walking distance from the stairs to Sacré Coeur. We didn’t spend much time there as we were out exploring but when we did, we found it to be very comfy and would highly recommend. Thank you!
Lovely host, great communication, the place is in a great location, and self-check in was very easy. Would stay again! Thanks Marie

Stayed at this apart-hotel many times. Great location. The building is safe and secure. Added bonus of the gym. The only issue I experienced was some rubbish left in the apartment but this was immediately rectified.

Best place to stay in Paris, comfortable to a couple with plenty space and private bathroom, near to metro station, walking to best Eiffel Tower photos spots! Suzie was such a great host, always kind and responsive 🙏thank you for everything!
Maria and Alan are very nice. They are flexible with my checking time. The place is very clean. Close to everything. Will go back again.

The location was great. The house was in the center of the market, restaurants and shopping areas. Only the house’s heating and air conditioning were not working, which was a bit of a problem, we had to use a small heater with it, if this problem had not happened, we could have had a better stay.
Great location in not an overly touristy neighborhood! Apartment was cozy and comfortable! Walkable to big transit centers but not too close to a major street, lots of good options right near you!

We really enjoyed our few days here, we felt right at home :) The location near the Nation metro made it so easy to explore Paris! We also really enjoyed going to the local boulangerie B & S Nation for our breakfasts and also would recommend L'églantine for an evening meal. Thanks for a lovely stay.

Our stay was wonderful, from the moment we met Bernard at check-in with his gracious hospitality! The apartment was spacious, clean, comfortable, and provided everything we needed for our week long stay. Not to mention the amazing view of the Eiffel Tower at night and proximity to train, metro, and bus stations. We loved it and will be back!

Our stay in Paris was an absolute dream. This little flat was a perfect place to rest and recharge after a day of exploring. The area was peaceful yet so close to everything we wanted to see. The Welkeys staff were friendly and responsive. We could not have asked for a better experience.

Location and flat was amazing, it’s well communicated with everything that you need to enjoy some holidays in Paris. Leo is always trying to help you and very faster in their responses. The apartments has everything necessary to stay very comfortable there. If you need to come to Paris and you don’t wnat to choose a hoyel this is a very good suitable option.
Clémence was so responsive and swiftly assisted me with my requests. The flat had everything one needed to enjoy a stay in Paris. Felt right at home!

We had a wonderful time at the property. It’s beautifully decorated throughout, very comfortable and exceptionally clean. Anne Charlotte was very responsive and attentive, and we really appreciated all the extra amenities throughout. It’s a great area too, would definitely recommend and return!
Gaelle’s house was very good, the location is perfect for 2. You can get to the center very easily by metro.

We had an amazing stay! From the moment we arrived, everything was perfect. The space was clean, cozy, and had all the amenities we needed. The host was incredibly kind and helpful. The location was ideal, and we felt right at home. We highly recommend this Airbnb and would love to stay here again!

Perfect apartment for a business trip. The bed was super comfortable and the bathroom was spot on! The hosts were really friendly and recommended some good places to eat/drink. Having a hair dryer and shampoo/body wash was a nice touch as meant I could pack light - thankyou guys, I will be back next year!

The place is lovely and well-maintained. The room’s windows are somewhat soundproof, which is great for me since I’m easily disturbed by noise. I’ll definitely book this room again as long as it’s still available on Airbnb in the future.

Great location (the top of the Eiffel tower is visible from the window), very walkable, lots of shops and restaurants nearby. Nice amenities and clear check-in process. Overall a great place for a few nights of stay.
We had a great stay in the apartment. Opposite there is a fantastic gourmet supermarket, which is definitely recommended!

This apartment is absolutely beautiful! A great space and location, especially if you want to enjoy Paris without being in the tourist-y area. Anne-Charlotte is a great host- super responsive and helpful explaining anything you have questions about. The apartment is set back in a courtyard, so it’s extremely peaceful and quiet. I’d definitely recommend!
Beautiful place in absolutely perfect location. A rare apt in Paris that has romantic rooftop views AND an elevator. Cristina was a very welcoming and responsive host.

Excellent stay and excellent host! The apartment is situated walking distance to great bars and restaurants. The apartment was clean and had everything you’d need. Jean-Phillipe was attentive and went above and beyond in terms of communication to ensure we were settled. My boyfriend and I had a great time! Would highly recommend for a couple’s city getaway!
We had a very enjoyable weekend at Théo’s apartment. It is a lovely space and surrounded by bars and boulangeries and pretty streets. Théo was a very helpful host and super communicative.
Wish we could have stayed longer! Perfect home base for us as we explored the City for a few days. Waking up to the smell of croissants can’t be beat!
Nice place! We were 5 friends and our stay was very pleasant. Perfect and fast communication. Clean apartment.
Great time in Paris! Would definitely book the same location! Only problem I had was the closets smelled a little old but besides that everything was great
Amazing flat! We really felt home there. It’s small but has everything it needs. Loved the neighbourhood, super close to nice places, restaurants and bars :) would come again!

This charming flat was perfect for our weeklong stay in Paris. We had everything we needed and the neighborhood was quiet and accessible by metro. Karine answers every question very promptly. Highly recommend!

We had one of the most wonderful experiences at Anne's flat. We traveled there as three people and the apartment is absolutely the most charming Paris apartment, with a ton of modern conveniences along with a classic touch. Anne was an incredible host, welcoming us with a wonderful champagne, and also was super helpful in helping us store luggage before our flight. My daughter loved all the little personal touches ( down to the bath slippers, toiletries and extra towels etc.). with its history and charm, its almost like a Parisian experience in itself. The main bed is a proper queen sized bed in a cute "pink" bedroom, and the other bed is a pull out queen in the living room, which worked for us. The location is a 5 -7 minute walk to the latin quarter tourist area with cafes, Shakespeare and co bookstore, and Notre Dame and surrounding areas.
Perfect place. Like staying in a hotel with the daily cleaning and basically online concierge that arranged transport to and from the airport for us and answered questions. 10 of 10 experience.
Beautiful place to stay in Paris! Close to Metro stations and walking distance to various cafes and restaurants.
Lovely location, space matched the advertisement and the Lander team were very professional and easy to deal with.
I had a great time staying at Pascal’s place. It is very centrally located and an ideal jumping off point for seeing central areas of Paris!
With the aforementioned things the stay was fine. Bathroom looks like it’s in the middle of a remodel and was not clean. The upstairs to get to your room makes a lot of noise when you walk

We had a great stay in a great neighborhood. Hosts were communicative, helpful with an internet issue and flexible with checkout when we needed to adjust due to travel times. Loved our trip and would stay there again!
while small, the apartment had what we needed. it is extremely well located next to Madeleine and not far from Opera and Galleries Lafayette.

Great location, and nice large, clean apartment. The host is very responsive and caring. Would be 5 stars, but for no washing up liquid/coffee/etc which to be honest, you would expect for the price per night. But on the whole very good.
Perfectly located apartment. Probably most spacious place I stayed in Paris. Amazing views. We would love to come again.

Lovely stay at Arthur's place. Very fast responses. Excellent location (5 minutes walk from Metro station and walkable distance to Montmartre) with very good facilities nearby (lovely bakeries and local supermarkets). The home itself is very well equipped and has all the requirements for a pleasant stay. Everything worked perfectly. Highly recommended host and place to stay.

I loved staying here & would totally stay here again! This was a great and easy spot which made my time in Paris so easy and convenient. As an American, I always forget to check for an elevator and boy was I glad to see i didn’t have to lug my 50 lb bag up the stairs. If you’re looking for a quiet and roomy spot, definitely recommend this one!
Beautiful, well located apartment. Perfect for 3 adults to get around Paris easily. Helena was very responsive and helpful! :) I would definitely recommend
Truly enjoyed this location. Louis’ is full of character and easily made us feel right at home. I wouldn’t hesitate to book at this location again.
I always appreciate how quiet and clean the apartment is ..🌺 This time it was even nicer with a brand-new bathroom and the renovated kitchen ✨( although in my case I never have time to cook there 😂)

This is a great location and well connected for exploring the city. We used the Vilib bikes and the Metro mostly and once figured out was a great way to get around. The apartment is cosy and you have to be organised in the space. All the essentials are here and Laurent was extremely helpful. Would have no issue with staying again, thank you.

This airbnb was perfect for 2 people! I honestly think the pictures don’t do the place justice. Everything was very nice and it had great amenities. The bed was really comfortable and the sheets were warm. The bathroom has great lighting for anyone wanting to do their makeup. The kitchen is well equipped to make whatever you need. Some things to keep in mind: The stairs to the loft bed are a little narrow, so if you have broader shoulders you’re going to have to walk up at a bit of an angle. Also Maybe I didn’t read the check in instructions correctly but we had a difficult time figuring out how to lock the door, all you have to do is lift the handle straight up and then you’ll be able to turn the key to lock the door. No complaints! Great location, lots of restaurants and metro stations nearby, a convenience store 3 doors down. We had a great stay!
The stairs are a little dangerous and the old building… was very easy to find and enter. The room is nice and has everything you need
Apartment was clean, comfy and in a nice location. Only flaw was problem with the door causing us to be locked outside but was quickly sorted. Other than that stay was perfect.
We had a great stay. The option to check in early for additional price is nice to have. Place was clean and they were very responsive with any issues we had. Thank you :)
I’m very happy with the place. Everything was perfect, except the shower. It’s right in the middle of all restaurant and everything. The location is very good.
Great location, lovely apartment, very easy to check in and had a great stay. Thank you!
Julien is a very attentive host. He gave very detailed check-in instructions as well as a warm welcome. The flat was a very cosy and stylish one which I loved!
lovely clean apartment in a nice area of Paris. Paul was a great host. thank you and we hope to return.
Francis was very friendly and always quick to answer. Whenever I’m back in Paris, I would definitely check his AirBnB again!

My husband, and two daughters(age 7 & 3) stayed here for 4 nights. Pro's: Cute apartment, excellent location - lots of popular spots that are very walkable even with kids in a stroller. Busy neighborhood with choices to eat. Leo was a great communicator if anything came up. (I very much appreciate this) Sunday there was am amazing vintage/artisan market right outside the door on the street. Try the strawberry croissant at Bo&Mie downstairs. Con's: There is quite a few codes & doors to get though to get to the apartment- so my advice is to be organized/ write codes down so your arrival is smooth. Can be overwhelming with kids/luggage etc. Its also a high tourist area - so expect that on the streets/restaurants etc. I would say it was too small of a space for us. Perfect spot for a couple staying IMO!

Great stay ! Thank you for having us. Spotless place. Would stay there again. There was a tiny smell from sewage but that’s not Jethros fault, something through the pipes. Really responsive and helpful. Note: this might not be the best for seniors. 4 flights of stairs Note: security requires 3 codes to entry

Super communication and personalized check in made the arrival so easy. The unit is clean with new appliances and an amazing shower. We also were the first users to cook with a new set of pans. Chachou is a local , very friendly, very communicative and a super host. We have permanently moved to the area and will not hesitate to highly recommend our friends and family stay here.

We visited Paris for a holiday with our family, and our stay was absolutely perfect! Julian was extremely responsive and regularly checked in to make sure everything was going well. The location was ideal, with major landmarks nearby, making it a perfect place to stay. Highly recommended!
Perfect place to stay during a citytrip; close to the subway and Eiffel Tower. Nicoals was extremely friendly and gave good instructions on how to self-check-in

The apartment was very nice and a good value. Great location. There were minor issues like the middle windows in the living room wouldn't stay shut, the radiator in the primary bedroom wouldn't turn off/on and couldn't be adjusted, and one day wifi went out. While the host responded quickly, the guest should be aware they need to be insistent that the host fix the issues.
Very clean and nice apartment. The host was so helpful and responds quick. We were very comfortable during our stay. Would highly recommend.
I enjoyed my stay at Dorin’s place. It was clean and cozy and a great location in the city! I’d highly recommend.

Wonderful apartment just as shown in pictures. Great, relaxing beds. Clean, equipped kitchen and bathroom including rain showerhead. Great dining and family room for meals and relaxing coffee break. Will definitely come here again!

This is a real gem fantastic area restaurant's all around and the apartment is of very high quality it's in very good condition with lots of extras thanks for a excellent sleep in a great area I have ased lots of Airs and this is a good one
What great to stay. Beautiful apartment in a beautiful city. Had everything we needed. The hosts were super accommodating and helpful. Had wonderful light throughout the day.

David was very responsive and gave very clear instructions to make checking in very smooth even at late hours of the night. We had a great stay in this Airbnb! The location was close to many things as well!

Great location, walking distance to many of the tourist sites and easy public transport. Loved being near Luxembourg Gardens. The space is quite small and a little noisy since ground-level but just as advertised.

Good place to stay if you are not for a long period, apartment is pretty small. But location is perfect, easy to visit any part of the city. Near is bus station and subway, also if you want you can walk around the city

We have spent a wonderful sunny spring weekend in Paris. Clarisse’s appartment was a great place to rest and get a good sleep before heading for a day full of activity! Clarisse was very flexible with checkin and checkout, something we appreciated a lot! Thanks again, we recommend without hesitation!
The apartment is small, but hey, this is the middle of Paris! Absolutely good to stay for two a few days.

We were quite thrilled with our stay at Nathaniel’s flat. The apartment is spacious, beautifully designed, and very comfortable. The two bedrooms on either side of the flat is well laid out and the master bedroom is particularly luxurious. We also appreciated the big kitchen that was easy to navigate. We will return. Thanks again.

This was the perfect place for our stay in Paris. The location was wonderful. Very walkable to shops and restaurants!! There is a metro station very near as well. The amenities were clean and there was room for us to unpack our things. There was a pharmacy very close and a grocery store as well (not to mention a wine shop!!). I would definitely stay here again
Great location! Patrick was friendly and very helpful arranging transportation from the airport and to the train station when leaving. It made it stress free and was greatly appreciated.
Very comfortable place! Super close to many popular sites in Paris—we walked everywhere. Would definitely recommend!
Nice apartment and great area. However, sofa bed is not too comfortable. Was okay to sleep in regardless.
Tessa and Evan were so helpful! Their communication was superb!!! They were also warm throughout my stay in Paris! 🫶🏻
This was the perfect spot for our groups quick stop in Paris. Hard to beat the location and the space is perfect for a larger group. Definitely recommend!
A charming and warm apartment, thoughtfully decorated with care and attention to detail. Pascal was incredibly helpful and responsive, making the stay seamless. Would return!

This location was perfect for a week of traveling around the city. Easy to use metro or order Ubers. This location is very private and quiet, near many restaurants and attractions. Catherine was such a great host and made everything so easy for us. Will definitely be saving for later!
As described in pictures and details Only issue was the shower which was fixed the same day very quickly which is appricated. Clean and good location Thank you

This was our second time staying at this amazing apartment, and we loved it just as much as the first! The place is beautiful, comfortable, and has everything we need for a perfect stay. The host is incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel right at home. We truly enjoy every moment here and can’t wait to come back again!

Great experience staying here. We were a party of 7 and all felt comfortable and right at home. Host was amazing and communicative. They were always available to provide instructions on where to dispose of trash and any other questions we had. The apartment is on the 4th floor but there is a small lift. Two of the bedrooms are upstairs and accessible only by a very narrow staircase, so it is difficult to take luggage up, but rooms are spacious. Apartment blends into a busy street with lots of retail and a Starbucks right on street level, very convenient. Also super close to the Bastille metro station which was very convenient from our ride in from London on Eurostar (note there is no lift from at this station). Great overall experience and would highly recommend.

Great property, very clean and well presented. Unfortunate that the main shower head tap was broken (reported in Jan according to previous reviews) and the bathroom door handle was hanging off (both issues reported). Would have been a higher rating otherwise, as it’s a lovely property in a quiet location.
lovely space! Very good location, Julien is really helpful, the room is perfect for solo traveler. Highly recommend!

We had a lovely time in Paris - quite surely also attributed to Claudes flat! The location with nearby public transport in lively Pigalle was just straight up perfect and the small apartment was quite sufficient for a short stay in the city - We’d for sure stay again!
Great location, very clean and host had excellent communication! Very walkable and close to fantastic restaurants. We would stay again!

We cannot recommend Pascal’s place enough. The location is wonderful-in a very safe and quiet spot yet just steps away from excellent bakeries, restaurant and the fantastic metro stop Vaneau. We walked to and from the Eiffel Tower multiple times and found the location to be very central. It was a perfect sized space for our family of 4. The apartment has been updated giving a perfect combination of charm and modern amenities. The pull out couch and bed were both very comfortable. Pascal was warm and welcoming and truly made our stay in Paris the best it could be. We would without a doubt choose to stay at Pascal’s and highly recommend it.

A wonderful home, extremely well stocked for a group that plans to cook or prep meals in the kitchen. The kitchen has everything you can possibly need from pots and pans to spices. Comfortable beds and wonderful bathrooms with hot showers. Karine was extremely communicative and helpful and we would highly recommend her place.
Was a nice first experience In Paris, very close to Eiffel Tower and the good restaurants in the area, and the atmosphere was great too.
Bruno was a great host. The apartment is perfect for two people. The view of the Eiffel Tower is amazing.

Excellent stay here with our two kids, enough space for everyone. Location was great, with the metro super close and lots of nearby shopping. Only minor issue was noise at night coming through the thin walls, but earplugs sorted that out.

Great place to stay! Looked just like the pictures! Fred came to meet us to give us the key and collect on the last day! We had a lovely time in Paris and Fred was very flexible which was a huge help to us! Thank you Fred!!! The place is also next to 2 stations!

A perfect apartment for a weekend stay in Paris. 10 minute walk from Chatalet des Halles station which is on the direct line from CDG; 40 mins from the terminal to the door. Great location for the sights and restaurants - 10 minutes to Notre Damme. The apartment was exceptionally clean and well equipped and safe. I would definitely recommend and stay again!
nice place, looks like in the pictures, good view of the street, only the shower is a little problem in this apartment

Cozy apartment on quiet inner yard with a great location close to subway and restaurants. Mold in the shower corner, you could smell the mold easily. More space what you could expect. Separate shower and toilet were practical.
Perfect place within walking distance of many great landmarks and close to the train. A great price for the location. Would highly recommend

Lovely host, was very helpful and met us on check in. Allowed us to have flexible check in and was responsive with anything we needed. Would reccomend to anyone for a stay close to central Paris but away from the chaos
Nice place, very convenient and close to a metro station. The host is very nice and responsive.
The apartment was exactly like the pictures. The space was clean and comfortable. Walking distance to great restaurants, neighbourhoods, and tourist attractions.
Weekends can get loud due to the restaurants below opened until 2am. Nothing earplugs didnt fix. 10 am check out is too early.
A very comfortable and convenient base for a multi-day work trip. I really appreciated how clean the apartment was, with a proper bathroom and very useful kitchenette.

Very happy with our stay at Julien’s apartment. Really great location near the Louvre and Pyramides Metro station. Near plenty of restaurants, short walk to the river down to Notre Dame. From a safety perspective, it’s great. 3 x security doors, plus door to the apartment. Perfect for a family of 3 or 4 people looking for somewhere to base themselves while seeing the sites of Paris. Julien was great - easy check in on time, great communication, apartment as described. Having a washing machine is a big bonus too. Thanks Julien, hope to stay with you again!

This apartment is perfect for a solo female traveler. I felt completely safe both in the apartment and in the surrounding area. Its convenient location offers easy access to the tube and you are just steps away from the Champs-Élysées and other central attractions. The apartment was impeccably clean and well-arranged, and Jordan is an incredibly kind and thoughtful host. I will definitely choose this place every time I return to Paris.
We had a nice one night stay with our family of 4. The location is excellent, and our host was helpful and responded quickly to our questions.

Claude’s apartment Chez Dan is a great place to stay for exploring Paris. It is a central location that is right there next to metro and suburban train station. The neighborhood is very walkable with lots of restaurants and shops. Finally the apartment was very neat and just the right place to relax after a busy day in town. Highly recommended

I now understand all the good reviews, Helene and Alain are very friendly, welcoming and intelligent people. Their apartment is very cozy, everything you need for a Parisian stay. Close to a metro station, bus stop just 2 min away. No noise at night, perfect location. Merci beaucoup, see you again next time! ☺️

Thanks James and Rita for allowing us to explore Paris from your lovely apartment. We had a super time discovering the local area and further afield. The beds were so comfy and we felt right at home. My son was very impressed with your Stanley Kubrick DVD collection!

This is great Airbnb for location and space in Paris for a small family. We had a great time in Paris and appreciated the ability to cook and do laundry and relax. The space was very nice and it was great to have two separate bedrooms.

We had a lovely stay in Mathilde’s apartment. Very short walk to Metro station, shop next door. Lots of really great restaurants a short walk away. The apartment is spacious and very comfortable. Great value. Mathilde kept in touch to check we were ok.

Nicolas was fantastic. He was always available to answer my questions and provided clear instructions on how to access the Airbnb room. The room was just a 15-minute walk from the Eiffel Tower, and nearby, there was a metro station, a market, a coffee shop, and all sorts of amenities.
Had a fantastic stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Great location, easy check-in, and a wonderful host. Would definitely stay again!
Francis was a really great host and replied almost immediately. The room was clean and had everything you might need during your visit. Its location is great, the neighborhood was calm.

We’re just back from a long weekend staying at Elise & Sebastien’s apartment on Rue Reaumur. The apartment was in a great location. There are plenty of local cafes and restaurants and there’s a fabulous vibe in the area. The apartment is within easy reach of public transport, both buses and metro, not too far from Gare du Nord, but it’s within walking distance of The Seine and other city attractions. The apartment is clean, comfortable and quiet. Beds were super-comfortable. The apartment is close to a number of boulangeries, supermarkets and fruit / veg shops. We were a part of 4 adults and one lively child and we felt we would have had plenty of space even if we’d had to stay in for a few hours. The Marche des Enfants Rouge was one of our favourite finds while we were there and well worth a visit. We’ll certainly come back!
Apartment was exactly as described, close to many restaurants and attractions. Leo was great to work with and very responsive.

Had a stay at Yacine's place for 4 nights for a family of 4. Place was as described in photos. it is clean, spacious enough and facilities are as described. Unfortunately, the tv is not working. You have to download and app to view the channels and it is too much of a hassle for me. Location is quite convenient. Close to Arc de Triumph, Champs Elysee and other tourist sites. Overall a good stay.

Anne’s place was small, cozy, and stocked with everything our group of 5 needed. Check in was easy, the neighborhood was lovely, bustling, with the metro right outside, yet our apartment was very quiet.

Great value for money!! Great location - central but not so touristic - with many lovely restaurants and coffee spots nearby. Room was pleasant, clean and very private - it’s not so frequent to find one with a separate entrance, bathroom and toilet. Very convenient! Jean-Michel was welcoming and always available on messenger and replied quickly - top-notch communication! We appreciated this stay, such a nice experience. Thank you!

We had a great stay at this Apartment. The extra sofa bed was larger than usual and comfortable for our kids and we were able to make breakfast in the kitchen in the mornings and wash our clothes in the laundry. The location is close to metro stations and is in a safe part of the city. The check-in was easy. We had a small issue trying to open the key lock and the host responded immediately to help.

The home is in a great location very close to the metro, pattiserries, grocery stores, and restaurants. We were minutes on the metro from most sights. The home was comfortable for us being 6 people. We were arriving on a Sunday afternoon but be aware that sometimes car access to the street is blocked for pedestrians and we have to walk in about 100m. Calling for an uber is also easier on the nearby big streets.

I had a great stay at this apartment. The room was spacious, clean, and the bed was very comfortable. The location is excellent — just a short walk to the subway, which made it easy to get to the city centre quickly. There’s also a supermarket nearby, which was super convenient. Would definitely recommend!
Great location, the subway is a few minutes away. The beds were quite firm so a bit uncomfortable but had everything we needed.
Very good location with plenty of restaurant and cafe options around. Super close to Eiffel Tower, and very close to a metro and a bus stop which made it easy to get around. Great deal for the price
Incredible place! I would definitely recommend, right in the heart of Paris and perfect size for a visiting couple!! 😍

Wonderful place to stay! Patrick & Nathalie's apartment was locates in the perfect area close to everything. They were such great hosts- quick to respond and extremely helpful with every question we had. They offered transportation, restaurant & activity recommendations and provided assistance with our itinerary which we appreciated since this was our first visit to Paris. We recommend staying here to anyone who is looking for a great accommodation! Also, they had amenities if you forgot your toothbrush, razor etc. & the shower was perfect.

I had an amazing stay in Paris with Nicolas! Very clean apartment, very well located (near the Eiffer Tower) and you had all the amenities necessary. Really recommend if you are visiting Paris and you are looking for a great place to stay.

Great little spot for a weekend trip. You do have to go down the road to collect/drop off keys - not a huge inconvenience but something to note especially if you have bags. Maria was great with comms etc. place was very clean.

Nice apartment, well located close to metro and bus. Small but with all the necessary amenities. Claude was an amazing host who provided us many tips on local restaurants, travel and other things to do around Paris.
Everything was perfect. Neriman, is a great host, she was very responsive and very helpful. Apartment is in a very good location, very close to Notre Dame and to the river. Overall a great experience

I would highly recommend this apartment! It is conveniently located a couple of minutes away from a metro, and has plenty of supermarkets, bakeries and restaurants nearby. The space itself was spotless when we arrived, it looked even better than the pictures and check in was simple courtesy of a lockbox. Marie was extremely helpful and responsive prior to and throughout the entirety of our stay.

Had a fantastic stay here. A great location, lots of eating places and shops nearby, very walkable, and metro very close too. Lovely space and well equipped kitchen. Bigger than I thought it was going to be which was a nice surprise. Would definitely book again.
Sofia is a very nice host. The Appartement has an outstanding location, bus/metro/train lines all come here from different directions. The stay was quite a wonderful memory.
Marie is a great host, very responsive and friendly - 0 complaints. Perfect for a few days in Paris. Great location in Montmartre close to the metro, bus stops and local restaurants and bakeries.

Brunos place has an amazing location and still calm, quiet and sunny. The 2 rooms are very cozy and nicely decorated. Bruno (and his family) are easy to talk to, very friendly and changed plans so they fitted us. The place is so much worth the money, for a short trip to Paris. There is no Kitchen or kicthenfacilities but we enjoyed the many cafes restaraurents and fast-food possibilities very close by. Coffee can be made, though. The center of Paris is in a short walking distance.

had the most amazing stay !! perfect and quick communication from anne, was able to check out early and drop bags off early as well which made life so easy !! the most beautiful place, felt so safe and comfortable, would stay 100x over 🤍🤍

Great location. There’s one flight of stairs but it wasn’t a problem with us. The water pressure in the bathrooms was great and washer and dryer in one was so useful for longer stay. Host was responsive when we needed them. Thank you so much.
Sophie’s apartment was absolutely gorgeous! Photos don’t do it justice. A beautiful gem in the neighbourhood. Sophie was a great host as well, very accommodating. Highly recommend!
This is our second time to stay at his place. The location is perfect and the apartment is clean and cozy. Highly recommend!

I highly recommend staying at this place for anyone looking for an excellent and comfortable stay in paris. It exceeded my expectations, and I'm already looking forward to staying here again in the future. Thank you, Majesti and David for every thing also for the quick response you make our staying very easy . Aslo we found everything which just we think near to us public transportation bakery supermarket and grand stores. Thank you guys again for the hospitality. Moemen

This little apartment was so perfect for a delightful short stay. Its design is so well done to make every square inch a delicious blend of functionality and beauty. Pauline is an excellent communicator: clear, polite and quick to respond. I cannot help but recommend this booking with the highest praise. This was my 36th Airbnb experience and it easily figures into my tippy top 7 best experiences. What are you waiting for?!?!
Thank you, I had a great weekend at Benjamin's apartment in Paris, everything was great, I'll definitely come back! 10/10🫶🏼

You can’t beat the location! The apartment is practically at the feet of Sacre Coeur, with easy access to public transport (we went to Disneyland for two days during our stay). Some of the cafes nearby were also exquisite. This apartment was a great place to lay our heads. The beds were comfortable, the bathroom was clean, and the simple pleasure of a coffee maker was appreciated. The instructions for check-in were spot on and simple—no issues. I would stay here again on another visit.

Vincent’s place was the perfect place for a girls trip celebrating my mother’s birthday. The flat was beautiful - very comfortable and clean and had everything we needed for our short stay. Vincent and team were very responsive and accommodating and even checked in to ensure we were settled. Thank you for a wonderful time in Paris!

Elsa is a wonderful host! The apartment was beautiful, in a great location with tons to do and very close to the metro or any public transportation you need. Elsa was very responsive and provided wonderful information. Great for my toddler and very quiet at night. We would absolutely stay here again.

Great location next to the Eiffel Tower. Host was super responsive. Ground floor access right off the street. The place smelled like a dirty mop walking in. The floors left black residue on the bottom of socks and feet. My baby who was crawling around had dirt all over his clothes and hands. There was a few things that were broken like the bar stool and a shelf in the bedroom. You could smell the sewer anytime you used the water (bathroom/shower). Overall, good location next to the Eiffel and restaurants!

The host has been very helpful, responsive, understandable, supportive and respectful of all our requests and inquiries. The apartment is more than adequate for my family of nine. The area has a lot of nice restaurants to pick from. We couldn’t ask for a better weather. Our experience is vet memorable and plan to rerun in the future. I highly recommend this place. Thank you so much for everything!!!!
We had a fantastic stay. The communication was great, perfect location and we were well accommodated for with our 7 month old baby. I would certainly stay here again.
beautiful apartment in a quiet location, it's close to public transportation and variety of different resturants.

This is a beautifully appointed apartment. It really was gorgeous, as well as spacious and practical. The host was always responsive and accommodating. It really was a lovely stay. It has a very central location but is in a busy, commercial area — not nestled among charming streets. We knew this going in and didn’t mind for this short trip. I would consider it perfect other than the location and the fact that the living room doesn’t have windows.

We loved our stay at this cute apartment! The location is excellent-in the heart of the Marais yet a close walk to Notre Dame, with easy metro access (St Paul) and bus routes which are fun for sightseeing. The apartment is delightful-a typical Parisian pied a terre Daphne is a thoughtful host and lovely person. Communication was excellent. We felt very at home and would definitely stay again on a return trip to Paris. Merci Daphne!

Beverly's place was a great stay! I had a little trouble getting into the place, getting the door open, but Beverly was incredibly responsive and proactive in helping me. After that, I had no trouble. The stairs are quite narrow and steep, so if you have large suitcases, it may be a bit more challenging to get them up. Although, the area is great. It's close distance to metro stops and easily walkable to other areas of Paris, but still quiet at night. As a solo, female traveler I felt completely safe, which is really important to me. The apartment was small, but perfect for one person and exactly as pictured/described. Everything was very clean and put together. I would definitely recommend Beverly's place.

We loved our stay in this cosy apartment. Perfect location and all we needed for 2 nights in Paris. Beautiful area and walkable to so many great food and drink spots etc. The only comment would be the apartment felt a little tired and in need of an update, and the cleanliness wasn’t amazing. Other than that, would highly recommend and stay again!

Small accommodation but very well organized and clean. Exactly as described. The location is very good. Excellent bistro on the corner of the street!! I am grateful to the owner for making flexible my check-in and check-out times.
Our stay was great. beautiful flat and great location. very friendly and responsive hosts. Thanks for everything definitely staying again on my next trip to Paris.
This place was perfect for the 2 of us. It was walkable near 2 metro stations and had a small kitchen we could use also. Shower is very small if you are used to an American shower but it works great.
Beautiful apartment in a fantastic location, very quiet but very close to a buzzing choice of bars, restaurants and bakeries.

We stayed for a long weekend, and it was perfect! Enough space for 4 people, a lot of bakeries and restaurants close by. Not too far away from Paris center, close to metro and city bikes right outside👐🏼

I was disappointed in the offerings it didn't match the description of a separate bedroom. When the bed was folded out it occupied nearly the entrie living space and needed to be climbed over to access any of the other amenities. As well; the équiped kitchen, did not have a stove or hot plate to cook with.

a beautifully unique apartment. Great location for bagpackers and on-the-go travellers who need a central location to stay while hitting the highlights of Paris. The host,Sebastian, is also proactive in preparing videos and how-to guides on getting into the apartment and a small guide on the surrounding and usage of applicance in the home.

Our recent stay in Paris was glorious. I have always stayed in a hotel in Le Marais but decided to try this magnificent Airbnb. It was perfectly situated and allowed my husband and me the extra space and ability to deal with our rather strange sleep habits….especially for Paris. I was able to get up every morning at 5 am , make some wonderful coffee and enjoy just being the magnificent setting. At 6:30 I headed out for long walks which always included a stop at a wonderful boulangerie. Walking in le Marais before the buzz begins is always a delight. We started out day early…..but often settled back to our apartment by 8 pm…..to relax, unwind and get ready for our next full day! I would highly recommend this location and this particular Airbnb to anyone that feels sometimes a bit confined in a hotel setting. Ironically my biggest concern was not having a hotel concierge to advise me…..but somehow I figured it out!

Thanks to Damien’s apartment I was at the perfect location to spend a few great days in Paris. Metro stations are really close by and you can explore montmartre by foot. It was small but cozy and clean and Damien gave me really good instructions so the check in was quite easy. I would come again - Thank you!

Amazing location! Very easy to take the metro from this place. We were also able to walk to places like the Louvre. The place was perfect for 2 people. I appreciate how clean it was. Couldn’t have asked for more.

We had a lovely stay at Harry’s place. The apartment was well appointed with all the things you can need in the kitchen. Traveling from the US it took us some time to get adjusted to time zone so I appreciated the black out curtains in the bedroom. Great location overall in La Marais close to shops, restaurants and several metro lines. We enjoyed our time as everything was walkable from the apartment. I would definitely stay here again.

Our family of 5 enjoyed our one week stay at Karine’s place. There was plenty of room to hang out and relax after busy days visiting the sites around Paris. It was nice to come home to a peaceful space. The courtyard/ walkway was lovely. Karine was very helpful and friendly. Her directions for getting there and into the house were easy to follow. The metro was very convenient and easy to use. We enjoyed several wonderful local restaurants, cafes, and boulangeries. We definitely would recommend Karine’s place!
The appartment is located in a good and vibrant neighborhood. Lots of cool places to explore, boutiques as well as food establishments. My daughters and I had great time in David’s apartment.

Absolutely loved staying here for a week. So accessible by walking or the metro but not too loud and busy. Great restaurant options in the area and the space was perfect for what we needed. Highly recommend!
Loved our stay at Anne and Jean-Luc's. Their place was warm and inviting and a great location for exploring Paris. We loved the markets, bakery and cafe at the end of the block as well.

While I did not have the chance to meet Ben in person, he was attentive and communicative. He made sure I had everything I needed to get into the apartment and checked in with me during the stay. The apartment is good for a budget-friendly, short stay. The amenities are basic but comfortable, and everything went smoothly. Thanks Ben!

Host Bertrand was very friendly and accommodated my family very well. It was a last minute booking and one of the best place I’ve stay in. Location was also great, close to attractions and food places. I will recommend this place to any one travelling to Paris! Thank you Bertrand!
the location was perfect, there i metro 2-3 minutes from house, there are many groceries and nice cafe-restaurants nearby. the house was very clean, there is everything what you need at home
The stay was perfect! We enjoyed it a lot. Emarald was super responsive and helpful.
Excellent Host!! It was so nice to see meet such an incredible host. Olivier was extremely attentive and helpful. 100% will stay with him the next time in Paris :)

Lovely appartement in a great location. Bright, with nice open views on a courtyard with trees. Nice design with modern furniture. Appreciated the small touches like a universal plug converter next to the bed, or an electrical cord extender connected to the iron. Host proactively checked that I was able to enter, which was easy (elevator and key box with code) Highly recommended. PS: I had seen some negative review mentioning that it was a room inside someone else’s apartment. This is not the case. This is your own studio apartment.

really wonderful stay here！everything is perfect！the Pierre’s family are so kind，the breakfast so considerate, the house so nice and clean, also so easy transportation! I definely would like to come back again if having chance in the future!

This is an incredibly unique apartment in a perfect location. Guillaume is a wonderful host - attentive and responsive. We definitely want to come back! There's not much privacy for the bathroom, so be aware if traveling with friends.

We had a great stay—everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect, and check-in was smooth. The only small issues were that the hot water ran out quickly and we would’ve appreciated a few more towels, but neither was a big deal. Overall, we loved our time here and would absolutely stay again!

The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos, felt very cosy and was a great base after a day out. There is a metro nearby and it's a nice area to take a stroll by the canal. The host was friendly and even left us a sweet little gift. All the instructions were clear so getting in was easy, we also really appreciated the suggestions for nearby restaurants! The only issues were less responsiveness at first and water slightly leaking on the floor during showering, but this could be managed with a towel and paled in comparison to all the good things :)

Amazing place to stay in Paris Quite neighborhood with many restaurants and cafe, close to Eiffel tour (15-20 minutes walk) The place is spotless, everything is new and looks exactly as on the pictures. Elena is great host, agreed to store our luggage and suggested help
We had a wonderful stay at Anna’s place. It’s great located, quiet place for good sleep, clean and nice.

Amazing location and a truly unique house, built in the best spirit of Le Corbusier. Everything was well organized — clear instructions, a bright and cozy room, and spotless cleanliness. I would definitely recommend staying here!

The Apartment was first class, very spacious and in a very safe area of Paris, it was walking distance to the Eiffel Tower...great traditional Parisian bistros all close by, we will definitely use this apartment again, thank you Kevin and the team.
had issues with water heating near midnight and could not take a shower for one night, but was refunded appropriately for the inconvenience.
We had a lovely time at Mariana's. The apartment was as described, the communication was fast and easy, and the location was perfect. We hope to be back one day.
Great location. Fourth floor apartment with malfunctioning elevator was the issue. The listing did indicate “elevator out of service” but it didn’t mention that the property was on the fourth floor.

The apartment was very private, well maintained and in a very secure location, especially for women travelers. Loved the location in Les Marais; very convenient for walking and to access other forms of city transportation.
Easy access to transit, lots of restaurants and shops close by, clean and comfortable. Only complaint would be the walls are very thin and there is lots of noise from street and neighbourhood.

Sylvie's apartment surpassed all our expectations - probably the best AirBnb we have stayed in! We stayed as a family of four with twin 12 year olds. The photos don't do justice to how beautiful the apartment is, in a classic Parisian style. The neighbourhood is fantastic with lots of amazing bars, restaurants, patisseries and shops. The beds were comfortable and the bathroom was spacious with two sinks and a decent shower. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend the apartment to anyone visiting Paris.
Incredible stay with Quentin: Location, convenience, clean and safe apartment, everything was 10/10. We will be back!!
Beautiful home close to lots of wonderful cafes and just a short trip to all the shops and sights we wanted to visit while there. Very clean and comfortable space.

While it was hard to locate at first, (just be sure to tell the taxi that it is Poissoniere with an E….not Poissoniern-) once there it was an ideal location and close to shops, sights and restaurants. Julien was responsive to our questions.

Such a nice place! The owner responds to messages and any needs in a timely manner. The bathroom and the whole apartment is very tidy and organized. Perfect site, different restaurants and shopping mall around the area, walking distance. Highly recommended for those who travel to Paris!

The flat was perfect! It has a lift, lovely shower space with rounded windows, clean floor and furniture and the stunning view!!!! And Corto was also sooo kind. I would definitely recommen and stay again soon at next visit to Paris. Merci :)

Perfect stay! Lorraine was easy to communicate with and picking up the keys was no problem. The apartment is beautifully located in the 11th arrondissement which is a lovely area and has very easy access to public transport to explore other parts of Paris. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Nice and clean apartment in a quiet and safe place close to the Eiffel Tower. 5 minutes walk from Metro and RER. Very easy and fast communication with the hostess. We can warmly recommend this place for a stay in Paris.

Very nice comfortable apartment in a great location. You are right in the centre of Le Marais a short walk to many attractions. The bedroom is wonderfully quiet. This is traditional Airbnb - it is the hosts home and you are surrounded by their personal things. The host was very kind and friendly. I would stay there again .

We loved our stay here,fantastic transportation on bus lines ( highly recommend as you see Paris on the way to your destination)and metro all a block or two away. The neighbourhood has wonderful boulangeries,pâtisseries ,cheese store,fish monger,butchers,and a street market on Tuesday ,all outside the front door!I cooked dinner everynight ,the kitchen is very well equipped . Laurent is a kind,thoughtful host,and made sure we were settled into the apartment. The apartment is chic and light filled,you can see the Eiffel Tower sparkle on the hour from the living room window! It is quiet for peaceful comfortable sleeps.All in all …Perfect! Thank you Laurent💗
Beautiful and Cosy space and an excellent base from which to explore the city. I would recommend highly :)
Perfect location, very kind and responsive host. Don't worry about any noise, despite a busy location it was very comfortable and quite to sleep.

after the first night I send Lionel a message that I believe he needs to stay himself a night and see if he likes the bed and the shower that was broke. the sofa sleeper is terrible to lay on. it broke my back. it's super hard and the iron structure popped through the mattress I weight 85kg. the shower head was dangling on the side and the temperature switched for out of nowhere to extremely hot. it's very small and too cosy, I was cheaper out with a hotelroom and a bed then in this airbnb. Lionel responded that the sleep sofa was very expensive and the shower was fixed. so he found my complaint not correct. I added pictures and I don't think the reviews are correct either.

Victoria’s apartment is lovely and in the perfect location to stay for a few nights in Paris, we really enjoyed our time. Check in is easy and the apartment was clean and comfortable.highly recommend!

Two of my friends and I stayed here for a Parisian girl’s trip. We loved the apartment. It was styled beautifully and Alexis and Elodie made us feel welcome upon arrival with a bottle of champagne and homemade Madeleines. The views from our rooms were stunning - the beautiful Butte Chaumont park on one side and the Sacre Coeur on the other. We enjoyed having breakfast each morning on the terrace and walking in the park. We would absolutely recommend this place for anyone who wants more space and wonderful views in Paris! The hosts were also very responsive and easy going.
This place was chic, but comfortable. Looked just like the photos. The host was responsive and helpful. We’ll stay here again next time we’re in Paris!

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as described and looked just like the pictures. The hosts were incredibly accommodating, allowing us to check in at a time that suited us, which we greatly appreciated. The location was perfect, and the amenities provided made our stay comfortable and enjoyable. Highly recommend!

A real oasis in the heart of Paris. Location is amazing, walkable to many places and only a short distance to the metro. Lots of cafes, restaurants and supermarket very close by. The apartment itself is spacious, clean, comfortable and has everything needed for a family vacation. Nathalie was very communicative, helpful and available before and throughout our stay. We highly recommend this Airbnb and definitely hope to visit again sometime.

Ygal’s space was great for our 4 day stay with my family. The view was spectacular, the garden overview and the Eiffel Tower as well. The space invited lots of sunlight with large windows, furniture matched the whole vibe of the place so well, and the elevator was a huge plus. The beds were comfortable, showers were clean and spacious, and the living room was very spacious and home-y. It’s very close to lots of main attractions, great to take walks as the neighborhood is safe, and restaurants and Boulanger everywhere as well. I would definitely recommend this place to others.

Extremely Beautiful Place!! The beds were very comfortable!! Everything we could need was provided. The instructions to enter and operate appliances were given and easy to follow. Great communication! I wish we had more time to stay there. Definitely a 5 star place to stay!!!
Clemence was a great host, very responsive and kind. Her apartment is quite nice and very organised. Would definitely stay again
Excellent welcome, the apartment is a gem. Interesting quartier. Cafe immediately downstairs is somewhat noisy, though not intolerably so, and closes late.
Very nice location with a nice rooftop view and walking distance to most tourist spots. The communication with Victoria was great and we really enjoyed our stay at her place!

We had a wonderful stay chez Monique and Jean-Noël. They were absolutely lovely hosts, very helpful and proactive, caring, and great to chat to. Nothing was too much trouble and they were easy to share a space with. The room was also very comfortable, especially the bed. Highly recommend this stay!

We were very satisfied with our stay in the apartment, which had good standards and allowed us to cook our own meals. It was great to have both a dishwasher and a washing machine, which made everyday life easier. Bed linen and towels were included, and it felt welcoming to have the beds already made upon our arrival. The apartment is well located, within walking distance of bakeries, restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacies, and several of the city's famous attractions. The area is calm, safe, and quiet during the nights. The host was very helpful and quick to respond to all our questions. An additional bonus was that the host arranged a private driver who was very friendly and drove us safely to and from the airport. We warmly recommend this apartment and would gladly return.

The apartment is beautiful and the service is great! The Lander is very communicative and helpful! The furnishings in the apartment were the comforts of home. We were grateful to call this our home away from home in Paris!

Lisa's apartment was absolutely perfect for our trip. It is exactly as described and in a fantastic location, close to everything. Everything is well maintained. Lisa sent us great reccommendations well in advance of our trip, and made it easy for us to plan our trip. She even provided 2 pack & plays for our toddlers to sleep in. We highly recommend this apartment!

My friends and I loved Paula’s apartment! She was very friendly and responsive and we felt right at home. It was clean and comfortable. The location was central and easy to get around. I highly recommend Paula’s place!
Nice location easy to find a lot to do in the neighborhood. Calm and pleasant stay Feel like home Beautiful decoration
We had a great weekend at Ines place. Everything was perfect! We met her shortly and she was so nice. The location is great we could walk everywhere and there are nice cafes and restaurants around.

Catherine was super-duper responsive. Responses are normally a few hours and she was normally just a few minutes. She is definitely five star on her responsiveness and attention to detail.
