it was a great stay and location was good too. Apart was clean with basic amenities.
A charming space perfect for a stopover in Paris. The high ceilings and chic decor make this a wonderful choice for anyone desiring a centrally located apartment.

Seb's flat is great. We had a late arrival, but he kindly waited outside the building to meet us. He explained the space, gave us some tips and responded to messages quickly. The location is very convenient, quiet, and safe. It had everything we needed and being able to do laundry on our last day was a nice plus. If we come back to Paris we'll definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

The perfect place to enjoy the Paris experience! Sophie is a wonderful hostess and made sure we were comfortable in the apartment and in the neighborhood. no thoughts of staying anywhere else if we get back to Paris!

Francine is very nice and she introduced everything in details! The room is stylish and comfortable. It is very close to the metro station. Every time we go out, we can see the effiel tower! The view is very good! We have a very good time here. :)

Best AirBnb I’ve ever stayed in...the decorations / decor made it feel like a real home with a very bohemian vibe to it. It’s 2 stories so it’s unique and lots of space. Would definitely love to stay here again when I come back to Paris. Highly recommend...

Five stars! Merci beaucoup to Denis for being such a great host! Denis was very accommodating with check in time and great with communication. The apartment is in a great location within walking distance to Notre Dame and many local restaurants and shops.
Very friendly and prompt check-in agent. Apartment was well furnished for a rental. Very stylish with everything you’d need for a stay in the city of lights. We would rent again with our family of 5.

The apt is lovely and these hosts offer very excellent devices. They helped us with everything from booking cars to accessing the building earlier than planned. Highly recommend their place. Apt was stunning, it is back facing so quiet but not sunny or bright. Also the neighbors upstairs were very loud, but not in the evening hours.
Everythigs was perfect! It is close to the Eiffel Tower, the Champs Elysees and markets. This area is very safe. Also Jordan has fast feedback. I'd like to stay again:)

Kathleen was super responsive and very helpful whenever I had questions or requests. The Airbnb was in a great location right next to majors sites and metro stations. I was nervous to be traveling in Paris alone but I felt very comfortable here. The two cats were a great added bonus!

I stay in apartments in the Marais to live away from the tourist crowds and get closer to a "local" experience. Likewise, it gives me a chance to sample local living conditions and not hotels. Alexandra’s place has all the ingredients of that goal: 18th-19th century building with an early retrofit of plumbing and electrical work and personal decorating representing the owner. If I was dropped into Alexandra’s apartment I would know that I was in France...no doubt. If I stepped onto the street, I would know I was in Paris and if I walked around the block I would know I was in the Marais. This trip I introduced my grand-daughters (13-15) to their first foreign exposure. If I could show you their daily faces, this review would be complete.

This flat is in an ideal location - close to shopping, restaurants, metro and the Louvre. It was also clean and well appointed. The kitchen and bathrooms are modern. Our host was gracious and quick to answer all our questions. Would highly recommend.
Great studio near multiple metro stops on west side for short stay in Paris. Ground floor so access was easy.

Place was in an excellent location for exploring Paris. Supermarket, patisserie and fromage within easy walking distance. Clara was a good with communication and easy checkin. Only downside is that despite the accommodation being seperate there was no lock and other guests were accessing the dryer and storage cupboard. Just wanted to mention as some people might like to know this.

First of all, Super-excellent location. Spacious interior and full furnished equipment include laundry machine, dry machine, coffee machine, dish wash machine, etc. so, very comfortable to use like a house. Also, Nathalie is very kind and timely hopitality. Really enjoy time in Paris at this house. Strongly recommend!

Loved it here! Clean, beautiful, perfect location & nice amenities. The lower level is accessible by a steep spiral staircase - perfect for my children, but not for anyone who may be a bit frail (my parents - aged 75/77 did not even try to go down). I highly recommend!

Everything was great, Jordan was very responsive and sociable. I was delayed in arriving from the airport, but he waited until I arrived. The apartment has everything you need. The location is excellent, metro and other transport is very convenient, grocery stores nearby. Jordan was always in touch and answered all requests quickly. Thanks, Jordan! Paris is my love!!!

Cedric is so friendly and helpful. The reviews are true. He is a super host. The area of his home is very quiet and so easy to use bus 21 to center of Paris, or metro. He made our first trip to Paris so nice!
A cute room in a nice, calm arrondissement that's connected to everything even though it's not right in the centre. I really enjoyed my stay!

This home is spectacular and a worthy splurge for a trip to the fabulous capital city of Paris. It was a wonderful retreat from areas packed with tourists and an easy commute to all the desired sights. This incredibly stylish home enhanced our visit!

Nice place to stay. The apartment has elevator is very convenient and there’s many shops around also. The apartment is very clean and very comfortable . The host is very nice and give any information you need.
Nice apartment in great location (minus the immediate view). Pleasant hosts and overall as described. Compared with other places I’ve rented in Paris, perhaps a bit on the pricey side, but cute.
It's a nice and cosy place, good Location. A supermarket is 250m away and it's really close to the Eiffel Tower and the Seine. All in all, I'd book it again.
Thank you so much for letting us stay in your beautiful home! We will definitely be back again sometime soon :)

We had a wonderful stay at Jeanne's place. Jeanne was very responsive to us, really lovely, and had lots of great local tips. The house is incredibly cool and comfortable for 4 people. My husband and I visited with my parents, and there was plenty of room and privacy for both couples. The neighborhood is a fantastic jumping off point for seeing Paris, very close to a good metro stop, and lots of cafes are within walking distance. The house is very quiet, clean, with many unique touches. You will feel like a local! Can't recommend Jeanne's place highly enough!

It's a very good choice. Close to the Louvre. And a lot of restaurants nearby. I love the high ceiling. The only caveat is that you have to take 1 flight of stairs. A bit difficult when you have big luggages.
Highly recommend - Great location and apartment is as pictured. A/C units throughout the entire apartment. HighStay was quick to respond to all of my questions. Would stay here again!
Vitalina was an excellent host and the apartment was lovely and homely, great location. Would definitely recommend this gem of a property.

Justin’s place was amazing. Wonderfully designed in a super cool neighborhood close enough to museums and other points of touristic interest, yet also tucked away so that you feel you like you are having a true Parisian experience. Fantastic cafes and restaurants nearby. Justin checked in often and was an excellent host. Highly recommended!

Our stay was lovely. The home is massive with beautiful architectural details around every corner. While the location is busy, it is quiet and off of the bustling street. We would definitely stay here again!
Jordan was a great host. Very helpful and very friendly. The pictures are a good representation of the place. Great area. I would definitely recommend!

Peggy's place was great! The rooms were very stylish and the apartment had everything we needed. Six guests fit comfortably and the 1.5 bathrooms were very useful. The apartment is located right near a metro stop so traveling around Paris was very simple.

Good location and great hospitality from Agnes. Metro is very close. It will be specially great for solo travelers. Her home is an interesting place filled with artworks and books. Thank you Agnes for everything. :)
Location is amazing. Super close to the metro and you can be anywhere in Paris in 30 to 40 minutes. The little town is super cute and has lots of places to visit.
What a great house, location and garden -we really felt Parisian! Jeanne is a great host and made us feel really welcome. Merci beaucoup!

Great stay. Location and apartment are fantastic. View from the balcony is a bit blocked off but it’s a big space for breakfast nonetheless. Lots of supplies for cooking and eating in if you plan for longer stays. Nice touches from Emmanuel, including local tips and food/snacks to come home to. Great host and would stay again.
Jacques flat was very modern and clean, just as pictured. Itś a great, central location. We had an excellent stay.

Nice classic Paris apartment in a great, lively location half a block from the Champs-Elysées. The apartment building is old, but charming. It was perfectly comfortable but we did come during a heat wave and there is no AC. You need to manage the windows properly and utilize fans. It was fine for our family, but be aware that open windows in this location can be loud at night. I personally enjoyed the location and the liveliness, but others may have an issue. The apartment could use some minor repairs, but it was perfectly livable and we had a nice stay. I would stay again, and Nathalie was a great host and responded very quickly to all of my queries.

The place was very compact and nice. Furniture and everything was in good condition. Only downside is the temperature, she informed us after we arrived that AC isn’t allowed. She did have around 5 fans but they didn’t help much. We would wake up sweating all through the night and couldn’t bear to be in the apartment during the day because of how hot it would get inside.
A beautifully appointed apartment, oozing with style in an awesome part of town. Great size and perfect for 3-4people. I'm sure Gabrielle won't allow the same thing to happen to us again ......
Had an awesome stay! Great hosts, the view is amazing! Really quick walk to Eiffel Tower, very close to everything.

Highly recommend this apartment- it’s on a quieter street just a block from jardin du Luxembourg and is within 5-10 min walking distance to several metro stops. Louise’s mother Sarah met us for check in and was lovely. It’s a small apartment (with AC and a fan) but the lofted bed and pull-out couch make it a nice space for relaxing and recharging.

This apartment was perfect for our party of 6. Mathieu was very responsive and easy to communicate with. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. There are two nearby Metro stops and it is possible to walk to the attractions. Mathieu was very thoughtful and brought an extra fan during the very hot week in Paris. There are nearby grocery stores that are convenient. We had a great stay.

Jean was very prompt in checking us in and showing us around. Not knowing much French wasn’t a problem. The apartment is very close to the metro which made is much easier for everything. Walking distance to Sacré-Cœur, and the area around it! Amazing restaurants and ice cream places!

The apartment is in an idea location for getting around Paris. A short walking distance from the Arc de Triumph, many restaurants & places to purchase anything you might need while on your stay. Kathleen is a great host and is ready to help with any questions you might have. She has informational books to review for idea's if you are looking for places to see. For anyone looking for a safe & comfortable place to call home while in Paris this is an ideal situation. Easy access to the metro makes it easy to get around the city. If you're into walking there are plenty of interesting places to get in a great workout. I would definitely stay here again.

We spent three evenings in Tristan’s apartment and had a great stay. The apartment was well located in the fun and funky Haute Marais neighbourhood near the Richard Lenoir metro stop. The apartment itself was a good size and was clean, charming and extremely kid friendly (it had a crib, a small bed and lots of toys in one room). Tristan was an accommodating host who was easy to communicate with and who gave us lots of good and kid friendly recommendations for our stay. We would happily recommend Tristan and his apartment to others.

Alice was a wonderful host. She left tips for places to visit in the neighborhood. We visited several and loved them all! The apartment had everything we needed and is in a wonderful location near lovely parks and access to the Metro. She also also answered any questions very quickly. We would definitely stay here again!
Incredibly awesome space! Perfect location. All the people I met told me this was the best neighbourhood in Paris. It was definitely worth it! Go for it!!!

A clean comfortable apartment, 2 bedrooms with a cot and high chair if travelling with a youngster. Overlooking a lovely boulevard, it is a nice area with restaurants, cafes and a supermarket nearby. A great location as it is only a short metro ride to the city centre

Great location, quiet, and having an AC was a real plus. The bed in the loft is comfortable but tricky to get in and out — but we had read the reviews so knew what to expect. Louise was responsive and it was really nice to have all the amenities and thoughtful hospitality items available to us.

Location, location, location. This is a wonderful apartment with lots of great amenities but the best thing was the location, just steps off Rue Mouffetard in the Latin Quarter (picture a windy, pedestrian-only, cobblestone street with lots of little shops and bistros). We loved being able to step out 20 feet to the amazing bakery, cheese shop, wine shop, and bistro right there! We also heard from locals that the pizza place next store is great but we never got to try it. The apartment itself was great! It had everything you needed, and the a/c and the washer and dryer were very much appreciated! The shower and bathtub were huge! It was also nice to have two toilets. Beds were comfortable as well. Mai was also very helpful and available via phone when we had an issue retrieving the key (it was no big deal and resolved quickly). Wish we could have stayed longer!
Great location for a business trip or travelers who like to be in the center of everything. The place was just perfect for a week-long stay!

We had a very pleasant stay here. Our host was very accommodating of our check in and check out times. The location is close to many things to do around Montmartre and within walking distance. Lots of restaurants around the apartment. The Airbnb was very clean and had everything we needed.
A beautiful calm wonderful apartment in a fantastic area of Paris. I would come again and would highly recommend Marie-Anne’s place to all my friends

Our family of four loved this spot and Christophe's helpful guidance. The boys slept upstairs in bunk beds, and we had breakfast each morning on the terrace overlooking the Tour Eiffel. A great boulangerie is within walking distance, as are all sorts of restaurants and shops, and two different metro lines. We would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was clean and beautiful. Perfect location. I loved the big balcony, bathroom and comfortable bed. It was exactly what I needed for my short weekend in Paris. FYI - there's no elevator and it's 5 flights up so pack light! (or get your workout in carrying all your luggage :))

Our only regret about Sandra’s place is that we weren’t there for long enough! We stayed in Paris for a quick stopover on a road trip, and her home was just amazing! It was wonderful to be able to do a load of laundry, and watch the sunset over a beautiful view of Paris. There are a lot of stairs leading up to the home, so just be prepared to walk a bit. But it’s totally worth it! You have an awesome view of Sacre Coeur, and the location couldn’t be more perfect. The pull out bed was comfortable for us, and we slept very well! Would definitely recommend!

We enjoyed our stay in Marais. The area is very central and easy to travel from. Metro station on the next corner and lovely restaurants nearby. The apartment was as depicted in the photo’s. Then bed was not as comfortable as expected, however very livable. The shower is incredibly tiny though, only big enough for one person. We had a pleasant stay and Sophie was incredibly helpful and quick to respond.

My fiancé and I stayed here for one night at the end of a long trip in France. Well worth the amazing view of the Eiffel Tower! The pictures don’t do it justice. Hosts were great and very thoughtful too.
Very nice and spacious apartment and excellent host. Sophie was just an unbelievable host. Thank you Sophie.
Good location close to the metro and the host was very accommodating in getting us a fan and a/c

Don’t hesitate. Just go ahead and book this place. It was absolutely amazing. The decor is amazing, the location is great, and the host is a delight. Anne really made us feel at home. From providing metro cards, to stocking the fridge with drinks, providing fresh chocolates....we really were blown away. My only regret is that we ever had to leave!

Beautiful and comfort.classical deco，let you feel yes you are in Frence！the host Marina are polite and kind also good to with！it's not very central Paris，but near have metro ，mostly I used to be by uber to everywhere in Paris，so it's not a really problem for me，overrall I would stay here again！

This was my second time staying at this apartment. Denis continues to be a fantastic host. It’s a stylish, full 1BR apartment in the heart of Le Marais. If you want to experience the true Parisian life, stay here! Right near the metro, market around the corner, and a ton of places to eat and shop close by. Highly recommend it!
A great place to stay while we were in Paris! It had everything we needed and was in an amazing location.

Excellent apartment. Close to all, that is required for a great stay...very cozy, amazing view. Celine welcomes you into her “personal life”... her apartment is filled with souvenirs, books... you can sit and read an amazing book with the St Ambroise church as your view...
Very stylish and comfortable apartment. Less than a 5 minute walk from the metro train station, which was plus for our family.
Great apartment in the perfect location to explore Paris. Beautiful views comfortable beds delicious pillows. Wifi worked well for my business calls
Clean and stylish apartment in a great location with responsive host. Squeaky floor was the only tiny complaint, but it’s more or less expected from an old building.
Very cool location with a bench at the end of the street with a great view of the city from above

The host is excellent and helpful. The place looks better than the photos. It’s large and comfortable. We have a very good stay and we will come back. It’s 3 mins walk from Goncourt; 10 mins to République which can connect you to most places.

Would highly recommend this place! Very close to the metro and located in a beautiful neighborhood that is not too touristy. Language barrier was an issue, but we managed! The flat is beautiful and Gilbert had breakfast ready every morning. Loved it!

We had a lovely stay here. While it is true the stairs are rough especially after a long day of sightseeing, the apartment is quiet and cozy. A lovely place to rest and the height means the street noise is not bad at all. The location was very convenient for all the sights we wished to see.
Louise's place has everything needed for a great stay in a beautiful location. It is super clean and with many thoughtful touches such as fresh croissants and coffee :-)

It was i great time with my family in Sylvie appartments. Very good location! Interesting design and a lot of space for family with kids. We spent a great time in Paris and will back to this place and Sylvie appartments for sure. I would recommend to stay there and feel real taste of Paris. Ivan
The place was fantastic and Benoit was an excellent host. I've spent a lot of time in Paris over the last 20 years and this was absolutely my favorite place to stay. 5 stars!!!

The apartment is very spacious, like really big. It is in old, well kept building with very high ceilings, I just adore them. The access is secured by two locked doors, from which we had a key. Metro 1 is just a few steps away. The apartment is having a unique character, very French. Around the corner is congress mall - where there is a really good upscale grocery shop and some nice clothing shops. It has all the needed amenities and more.We had a great stay!

Amazing location right next to Sacré Cœur in the heart of Montmartre. It’s within walking distance of many cafés, shops, and public transport. The apartment is located in a nice, quiet area. The apartment itself was homely and clean. We enjoyed our stay here.
Our family of four stayed here. Great location, nearby bakery and stores. Close to transportation by metro or bus.

Our group of 2 couples and 2 young children really enjoyed staying at Nathalie's place. The location is great - close to charming canals, delicious bakeries, and restaurants - with good nearby transport. The kitchen is excellently stocked with everything you need to feel at home (dishes, pots, spices, etc) and the top floor living space is beautiful and a good size for a family or two couples traveling together. The stairs between the 3 floors are a bit steep/narrow and might be a challenge for young children or people with mobility issues.
The location of Marie-Anne’s home is amazing and can’t be beat. It is a very lively neighborhood and we always felt safe.

The host was fantastic and very amicable. The apartment was much larger than we anticipated. Everything was clean and orderly. If I have one complaint, it was the street noise. Have to keep the windows open for air, and while not "busy", the street noise outside did not allow for great sleep.
Bertrand was a great host during my stay in Paris. The Airbnb location is very convenient and easy to get around. Overall, the Airbnb was clean and very spacious!

Peggy was an excellent hostess and the space was perfect for us. We were there during a heatwave and Peggy went out and bought a great fan to keep us cool. We had questions about swimming pools, among other things, and she researched it for us. I highly recommend this Airbnb.
It was a lovely stay with Hannelore. Good location, nice breakfast, and a very welcoming host. Thank you :)

Francine, is a caring and communicative host. Her home was beautiful and felt luxurious and Parisian. The kitchen came complete with everything one could need to prepare a full meal indoors or a snack to enjoy on her gorgeous terrace. As well, the location of the apartment is a fantastic home base from which to view the Eiffel Tour and Passy district. I would highly recommend staying with Francine!

Amazing place! Clean, tidy, very well located (next to brands like Moschino and Chloé), cafes and restaurants. Furthermore, there was someone to clean the apartment daily for us so we found the apartment clean at the end of each day. They were very thoughtful and included Clarins products in both bathrooms. Well equipped kitchen and very comfortable sofas. Amazing place to stay in Paris.

Florent's apartment was just perfect for my family, it felt like home at all times. Despite not being centric, the location had stores nearby that still allowed us to satisfy our needs (e.g. metro station). Florent was always aware of our stay and you can tell that he really cared for us. Overall, we enjoyed our stay at his home. Thank you Florent!
Tristan’s apartment is in a very good location and feel like home. We had a wonderful stay.

Thank you Jacques for the lovely time in Paris! Your flat was perfectly located for all of our sightseeing activities. The flat was clean. As a tip, I would make sure that guests know that all of the extra bedding and towels are under the main bed. The security was also very good to get into your flat, and we appreciated that. Thank you!
Aparment was nice, clean and cosy, close to metro, big enough for 6 people. Peggy was very kind and helpful.

Great place. Perfect location. Right in the middle of Le Marais with lovely cafes and shops. Had everything you need for a short stay. It’s very small but that’s to be expected for an apartment in the area.

Adrien’s place was perfect for our stay. The location is amazing. It was very clean and safe. Everything we needed was there. Communication was quick and helpful. We would highly recommend this Airbnb to others and would love to stay again one day.

I would highly recommend you stay at Alexandra’s apartment! It is in the heart of the Marais and has more character than any hotel you could ever find. The space is beautifully decorated and sparkling clean. There’s fantastic restaurants, shopping, and cafes at your doorstep.

Overall, Guy's place is great and we would recommend to anyone. It's a beautiful neighborhood and would highly recommend exploring even with the Eiffel Tower so close. It is about 15 minutes walk door to door, but there was an amazing view getting off the metro at Trocadero Station on the way to Guy's place and it's only about a 2 minute walk from the apartment to another amazing view from the bridge (also the bridge they filmed a scene in National Treasure 2 which was super cool for me). We had a great experience and Guy was very good about providing local information and tips and was responsive whenever we needed him. Super happy with our choice and our trip!

I stayed here with three other people and it was very comfortable and was in a great area. When I come back to Paris I would definitely stay here again! It was close to many cafes, grocery stores, and the river. The space itself was also great to be in and made our stay amazing.

Rita’s place is perfect for anyone who looks for a comfortable flat very close to the city centre. I had some troubles with the internet connection the first two days but Rita, who was abroad, immediately helped me with my problems.

Mai's place has a great location. The metro is very close and the flat is convenient for sight seeing in Paris. She is very easy to communicate with and well organized. Her directions were very helpful and she even had a French translation that we could give to the taxi driver.
This is an excellent place to stay! Conveniently located, clean and spacious! I would highly recommend staying here!

Sandrine's apartment is a perfect place for your stay in Paris. The apartment itself is cozy and is located in a great location. It's about a 20 minute walk from the Eiffel Tower and a 7-minute walk from the yellow line and the RER train station that takes you to Versailles. You cannot beat this location. Thank you Sandrine.

Anne and Ulysse's apartment was beautiful, spacious, and centrally located in the Latin Quarter. It was within walking distance to the Seine River, Notre Dame, Pantheon, Luxembourg Gardens, shopping, restaurants, and more. On top of that, the metro station was right there. Our stay was wonderful, and we would definitely return in the future!

Fantastic place. Very stylish with balcony ! Perfect location to move around Paris by metro. Quick and helpful communication via app. We requested some small shopping to be done due to late arrival on a Sunday and not only we got the shopping done but Clarisse paid for half of it. Will return on next trip to Paris.

5 stars. Fantastic location. Walkable to many sights--easy train rides to the ones a bit further out. Seb was great--there was a hot water issue that he found before we got in and fixed within hours. Very impressed with his responsiveness and he gave us a mini tour of the place pointing out important details to easily use appliances. The place is small as pictured, but we had everything we needed for a 5 day stay!

We fell in love with Paris and all because we stayed at Chachou’s place. This place had a comfortable bed and AC. THE LOCATION WAS EVERYTHING!!! The Eiffel Tower is 10-15 minute walk and there is everything you need from cafe to grocery store. I especially liked the towel warmers. Great stay! We will be back.
Very clean well decorated place close to central Paris. We had a family vacation and felt like we were living local.
It is a good place to stay with your family or friends, good price, accessible location, it is not next to Eiffel Tower but for the price is very fair.

The location of this apartment is fabulous- easy access to 3 metro lines, a quick walk to the Marais and Republique, and perfect running routes along the Seine within 10 minutes. The host was really responsive and the views of the Eiffel Tower and Sacre Coeur at sunset cannot be beat. One small note for those planning a long-ish stay- there isn’t space to unpack your suitcases or hang clothes, so keep that in mind as you pack!

Good and central location, very quiet at nights which I really enjoyed. Place is not throughly cleaned at all, a bit dusty. There were two problems which are the hygiene of the bedroom sheets and lack of cooking equipment. Sheets were a bit blood and yellow stained and the second bed didn't even have sheets. There is only one very small pan in the house, not even a single pot. I had to buy sponges, salt and soap. I was expecting more cleanliness and basic cooking equipment as they are fundamental for any airbnb property. Kirsten is a fast replier and helpful.

Peggy’s place is so great!! 3 bedrooms are hard to find in Paris and this was just so beautiful and sparkling clean. From the outside the building doesn’t look like much but don’t worry it’s great inside. The neighborhood has some really lovely hidden gems. Peggy’s recommendations are spot on, we also recommend Gaston’s as well. 😊 Next time I’m in Paris I would stay at Peggy’s again.

An amazing cozy apartment. The small space of the apartment is used really thoughtful. It has everything you need. A bathroom with a large bath, washer, microwave and a stove in the kitchen space , a tv in the room (very comfortable bed) and an amazing balcony. Chokri responds very fast and helped us resolve a small issue that we had immediately.
Outstanding place, perfectly set up in a great neighborhood. Was very clean and had everything you could need. 100% would stay again. Host responds very quickly and is very helpful.
The location is really close to metro station! The housekeeper helped me on the phone when I phoned. He spoke perfect English and was really nice.

This was our second stay with Gilbert and it was just as amazing as the first one. He allowed us to leave our bags early before check in so that we could be luggage free to explore the city. He is a kind and friendly host and I would highly recommend that you stay there!

Amanda’s apartment was clean, spacious and located quite close to the metro. It was also in walking distance to wonderful restaurants, cafes and pastry shops. We felt safe and comfortable in the neighborhood. We would go back again.
We had a great stay at Jacques’s place! It was very clean, convenient, and comfortable! The neighbourhood was also very central and lively on the weekend!

Fast and easy communication, met to get the keys at the exact time that we previously agreed upon, there are 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms (as described). The location to the Eiffel Tower and Siene was unbeatable, it felt so central to all the popular sightseeing places in Paris for a first time visit. There is a bakery around the corner that had fresh pastries every morning, we got bottled water from G20, and Indian food from Goa and New Jawad which was delicious.

Kirsten's flat is super stylish. It has a great living space - chic and comfy! We felt very at home and to have a piano in Paris was a huge bonus. The location is lovely. Great places to eat nearby, a very nice park a few minutes away and we enjoyed strolling along the canal. Thanks Kirsten!

My family and I stayed in Paris at Jacques apartment and had a great time. He was fantastic with communication before, during and after the stay. The apartment was perfect for the three of us with both beds being very comfortable. It’s in a convenient location and easy to get to the Metro and around Paris. He was a great host and I recommend staying with him.
Francis’s place is great, small but it has everything you need, I spent a great month there and if I go back to Paris I would love to stay there again.

Julien is a wonderful host! From his welcoming to the amazing accomodation, my stay was perfect. The room is lovely and very convenient as Julien put lots of useful equipment (towel, coffee, tea, hygiene and beauty products). The neighbourhood is quiet, well connected to public transportation and has many different options for dinner. I would definitely recommend a stay at Julien's.

There are so many great things about this place. We traveled with another family and it was great to be so close together. Francois even arranged an extra baby bed for us (traveling with twins is a challenge and he offered to help us out). Everything we needed was available and he even had extra outlet converters. Beds were very comfortable and the showers were great. We felt safe and loved exploring Montmartre during our visit.
Great location and wonderful terrace to enjoy your morning coffee. Chokri’s place has everything you need.
The place smell like cigarettes and dusty. In the bathroom, water squirts down from the overhead water tank when flushes the toilet. The host is nice and very responsive.

I really recommend the apartment of Giovanni! Not only the furniture is very tasteful also the house in total has a great style. The area is really nice and good located. Giovanni was very helpful with tips and recommendations for the city. On our next trip to Paris we will defiantly stay there again.

Vincent’s cozy but spacious apartment is in the very centre of Paris with easy access anywhere by cab, metro or on foot. The view out the window onto the rue de Buci was from a Paris postcard. It is on the 4th floor (I count the ground floor as the first) which could be a challenge for some dealing with heavy luggage but Vincent met us there and hauled up our gift laden new suitcase. Very close to any number of excellent restaurants which made sleeping with open windows difficult. Grocery store right across the street. Chez Isabelle for fantastic croissants was a 12 minute walk although Paul was 12 feet away . Big Bonus was the clothes washer dryer combo!!! The modern kitchen has all the amenities. Queen size bed was super comfortable with no motion transfer. We would definitely come back to this superb apartment and highly recommend it.

Staying with Joan and Sophie was an amazing experience. They and their kids are a very warm family that makes you feel like home. They are always concerned if everything was good. The room was very cosy, and was impeccably clean. It had a mini fridge, a kettle, a microwave, cutlery, dishes and glasses, so you have everything you need to buy some quick meal in the supermarket (there are several close by), if you want to save some money. It is extremely well located! With restaurants, bars, supermarkets, bakeries, metro and train stations close by. All in all it was an amazing experience, and it for sure made my trip to Paris even more unforgettable! Thank you Joan and Sophie

Sal was absolutely lovely! he stocked the fridge for me, had a wonderfully powerful hair dryer, gave me very clear instructions on how to use his washing machine and of course his apartment was was sparkling clean. I would definitely stay again!

Absolutely wonderful!! Everything about Mireille’s home was perfectly Parisian. This was our first visit to Paris and I’m so thankful that we stayed at Mireille’s home. It was spotless and in a great location. Close to bus lines and Metro. Great bakeries were only steps away. Excellent communication before and during our stay. We will most definitely stay there the next time we go to Paris!!
Jean Daniel's apartment is very convenient and is just as described and he is a gracious host and very accommodating.

Great location, close to shops and restaurant, and also in very quiet area. Giovanni is nice also, he showed us the area and how to go around, and recommended some places to visit. I will stay with him if I come to Paris in the future.
Had a great stay at Chokri's place! The terrace was a lovely addition for morning and night views. Perfect apartment for two!

The flat is small but very new, clean and comfortable, and has everything you might need. The area is lovely and easy to commute to. David, Marvin's son, was very easy to communicate with and fast to respond. I had a great stay, thank you!

Benjamin’s place is very well located, perfectly equipped, nice and clean. It is even better than it looks in pictures. We felt like at home there. Benjamin is wonderful host. He is very responsible and cares about his quests. It was easy to check in when Benjamin was waiting us on arrival. We would like to be back and book the place again next time in Paris. I recommend Benjamin’s apartment for all travellers.

The apartment is really nice and comfortable, location is very convenient. Julien was very kind and friendly, always ready to help and left nice tips about the local area. This room is definitely wonderful place to stay.

Jean-Daniels place is worth visiting! The space is very nice and you feel at home immediately. Everything looks great and well maintained. The rooms are exactly as shown on the picture. The best part is that if you have a question you can always text Jean-Daniel and he responses very quick. We had a very nice stay and would definitely visit again!
This flat is so well placed being 400m from the main square. The entrance is via spiral wooden staircase but opens into quite a large living space with great views and so close to the amenities.
Marie was very helpful and responded quickly to any questions I had. The apartment is really nice and very well located, I had no issues at all during my stay!

We loved our stay at Chokri’s elegant, cosy apartment! Its location in the Marais is excellent; it’s tastefully designed, quiet and private. The terrace is lovely, loved the bathtub & didn’t mind the flights of stairs. It was perfect for a long weekend! We also really appreciated Chokri’s quick response when we requested additional pillows. Without a doubt, we would stay there again!
Kathleen is so nice and warm hearted! The house has good location and lovely decorations:)

This was our first ever AirBNB experience and couldn't have been happier with our choice. Fantastic location walking distance to all we needed for our 3 week stay with shops and metro just down the end of the street. The apartment itself was in an older style building but immaculate with a large bedroom, living, bathroom and kitchen and best of all a balcony. Turkan was very thoughtful and despite the language barrier provided us with a thorough introduction and provided tips and ideas of what was available to us in the local area. She even supplied us with a bottle of wine, some nibbles to accompany it and breakfast items to get us started. I am happy to recommend and would return for any future trips. Frank & Michelle

The Metro, Monoprix, a Pharmacie and a great bakery are all within a quarter mile! The bus stop is, too. Close to Montmartre. There is construction there as of September 17, but they keep regular hours. Mme Pinsard is a gem! Even though it’s a one-way street all the taxis know where it is. Great value. Makes staying in Paris for two weeks very affordable!
It is a great place to stay, in the center of city and well facilities. Julie always gives quick respond Thank you
Good location. Though a little walk is required to reach the place. But it was OK for us.
This is a really beautiful, charming studio, feeling Paris in its best: unexpected silence to sleep, wonderful neighborhood and perfect tips from a really generous and helpful host.

The apartment is sparking clean with excellent WiFi and a strong hot shower. Lots of cafes and shops nearby and less than a 5 minute walk to the metro. Thomas was very nice and easy to get a hold of. Would definitely stay here again.
Very nice apartment with convenience address, and Chloe is petty and nice . French local style I like it . I recommend it.
We enjoyed our time in this lovely apartment! Beautiful and great for a little entertaining. Check in was flawless and the apartment, stylishly decorated!

Our stay at Gilbert’s was incredible. Fell in love with Paris, and the area that our room is in. Although far from the center of Paris the perks are cheaper places to eat around the flat including cafes, restaurants, and bakeries. Gilbert is kind and attentive, always having breakfast ready in the morning. The bathroom is fully equipped and he provides many thoughtful touches. The private garden area is perfect for mornings. If we have the privilege of returning to paris we would love to stay again.
Everything you need in an apartment while traveling but a bit out of central Paris; neighborhood seems a bit rough at night.
Very good apartment and super well located. We stayed in a group of 5 without problems. Supermarket cross the street, super convenient
Great location, very good communication. Bed was a bit saggy but bearable. Benoit speaks great English

Neli is a great host; very responsive and accommodating. The apartment is in a lovely neighborhood near Père Lachaise with beautiful views of the city. I would happily recommend this place to anyone visiting Paris.

Stayed here for 3 nights for my birthday. It was absolutely amazing and a dream come true. Pretty awesome seeing the eiffel tower right outside our window. The host was very lovely and replied quickly. Location is perfect and I recommend using the metro to travel around. Eiffel tower is a 20-30min walk from the apartment.
The apartment is very nice, the photos are accurate, is very chic and very parisian! The location is TOP, very close to Trocadéro or Arc de Triomphe. Salomé was very kind.

The location is great! Place was nice and clean. I was one person so space was more than enough for me. Metro station is only 100 meters away, very convenient! Nicolas was very responsive and his colleague was hospitable to greet me!

Isabelle was a friendly and pleasant host, easy to talk to. The location is unbeatable- I walked to all the places I wanted to visit. The place was very clean. Having a kitchen to use was very convenient.
Great location just off Champs d'Elyssees and right next to Franklin D Roosevelt Metro stop. The apartment has a lot of character. We enjoyed our stay very much.

Cedric was a really thoughtful and talkative host with good English, place itself is very clean and the bathroom had all the necessities. Breakfast was good and communication easy, would stay here again!

Amazing apartment in an amazing location. Far exceeded our expectations and made our trip to Paris easy and comfortable. Sophie is extremely responsive and the apartment is everything we could have hoped for. Location cannot be beat.
Super location with everything nearby and a neat little place to rest your weary feet at the end of the day

Jordan's appartment is perfect for a single traveler looking for a convenient location in Paris. The appartment is a great size for a single traveler with all the features you need to stay. It's so close to a metro station and is in walking distance of a couple more. Jordan was a great host! Would love to return to this stay!
It was ok but I think a Little bit to expensive, considering the room started to smell bad after we took a shower.
Amazing location and very safe. Close to metro and restaurants. Perfect space for 2-3 people.

Chokri was an excellent host. Quick to respond to our messages and helpful with tips for exploring the neighborhood. The apartment was clean, with a large soaking tub and shower. Rooftop views were amazing, and the neighborhood itself was vibrant with shops, cafes, and other amenities around every corner.
Lovely and clean space in an excellent location. Our hosts were very helpful and responded quickly to our queries.
This flat was in the perfect location with a lot to do. The place was clean and very cute. We had a great time.

Nicolas' flat is in a great location in South Pigalle, a fun neighborhood with amazing cafes, cocktail bars, and restaurants. Our favorites (within a ten minutes walk) were Dirty Dick (tiki bar), Lulu White, Pink Momma, South Pigalle, and Gegor. There's also a fun donut shop around the corner. Great location! Great accommodations! Thanks Nicolas!

Sophie's place was better than the photos posted. It was clean and well decorated and had no difficulty staying three people. It wasn't easy to climb the stairs to the third floor, but we had strong legs. Older people or those with a lot of luggage can be difficult. Sophie always cared during our stay. The major locations of Marais are ten minutes away and there are three subway stations nearby. I was lucky to be able to stay at Sophie's place. Thank you again, Sophie!

We had a wonderful stay in Mireille's beautiful, clean, light-filled and spacious apartment. Every need was provided for in the kitchen, bathroom and living area, with plenty of storage space. The bed was super comfortable. Being on the 6th floor we were very grateful for the cute little lift right outside the door of the apartment. The best croissants and pain aux chocolats are to be found at the boulangerie on the corner of Rue Daguerre and Rue Danville, also the cheapest. We loved the location of Montparnasse, and found the 14th a very vibrant district. Highly recommend the Antiques market Marches aux puces de Vanves in the south of the 14th held Saturday and Sunday mornings. Thank you Mirielle.

This is a sweet little apartment that is very clean and comfortable. It is in an old building with a charming courtyard and access to everything you need. Everyday we took a right on Rue Oberkampf and walked to all the sites. It was a fun week!
Staying at Gilbert's place was amazing. A beautiful apartment, super clean, comfortable bed. Gilbert goes way beyond the norm in being helpful in every way. Hope to come back soon!

Lovely stay. Super flexible check in. Place was clean and had all i needed. Good comfy bed. In quiet side street away from the busy Pigalle. Would stay again. Also thank you very much to your friend who did the check in. Very helpful.
Beautiful apartment, safe location and Perfect for restaurants, shopping and access to the Metro. We had a wonderful time and enjoyed our stay very much
Great flat for a family. Easy access to the tram/bus/taxi. Great restaurants in the area. Safe neighborhood.

Mathieu was a fantastic host and his home is simply perfect. It offered everything you Could possibly need/want.. close to train and dining. Very responsive to our text messages. Our family has an amazing trip. Thank you Mathieu.

This apartment is an absolute dream for two people, the sofa bed would be fine for kids. It’s quintessential Paris, just walk away from the traffic and you find hidden gems in a beautiful neighbourhood.

We stayed at this wonderful loft for a week and certainly would like to come back !! It s a big and comfortable loft, very very clean , has everything needed, situated in a very convenient area. Metro station is just near by and endless food shops and restaurants close by. We highly recommend the place !!!

I’ve been home from my trip for two days now and I can’t stop thinking about this beautiful apartment. Everything about it matched or even surpassed my expectations. It’s a beautiful place to stay and I hope the memories you make in it will be as special as the ones I was able to make.
Clementine is a wonderful host and her place is perfect to explore Paris! We plan on coming back.

The best value for money appartment I've rented. Decent location with metro within a two minutes walk. Only apt at that floor and elevator straight to the door. Felt secure. No problems with check in and -out. We were a family of four for three nights, and the space was no problem (mainly sleeping there, no eating). Nice bathroom facility. Would definitely recommend!
The place si fantastic and sparkly clean. The position is great because you can get to any museum in few minutes with the metro which is 3 minutes walk from the house.
Very good location. Nightclub in neighbor building, very loud on a friday Night. The studio is clean and Nice. Everything you need.

Vincent was a great host, the apartment was very nice, well equipped with everything even a welcome bottle of wine! He was very responsive, checked in on me several times. I will come back to 20 Rue de Buci.
A fabulous place to stay also with children, amazing location, clean and with all needed in and around.
Beautiful home, and perfect location walkable to everything you want in Paris. Lovely hosts, made us and our baby feel right at home with a pack & play and toys! Loved our stay!
Clean apartment that has fun style elements. Close to many areas of interest making it convenient. Excellent communication!

Alexandre's place is superb! Easy and effective communication with the host, the place is very conveniently located and it is really super clean. The host spent some time to give some tips about transportation and amenities and he gave me the opportunity to leave my bag at the apartment before leaving Paris. Recommended for sure!

A cozy apartment that has all the amenities you’d want for a Parisian stay. The location is hard to beat as it is both accessible to Metro stations and tourist trails while also feeling like a hidden gem in the city.

The views are spectacular of the city. You can see the Sacre couer from the window during the day and night. The location is fabulous as you are within 3 minutes from a subway station that gets you to the middle of Paris within half an hour. Montmarte itself is very fun and there are a lot of things to see and do around the apartment. Benoit gave us recommendations on the best bakeries, cheese shops and restaurants nearby and they were all AMAZING! The street is quiet for the most part and we felt safe the whole time. Overall we were completely satisfied with our stay here and plan on coming back!
The place was very clean and quite close to shopping centers and other site seeing spots. Would definitely love to stay here if I visit again.
Cracking location close to two metro stations and local shops. Enjoyed strolling into the Marais in twenty minutes.

Nicolas's flat was great, just as described. It's a good neighborhood - close to busy areas, metro and bus, but on a quiet street with almost no cars. Nicolas was very responsive and accommodating. Definitely will check availability for my next trip to Paris.

Julien reached out from the get-go and made all efforts to make sure we were accommodated. The process was so simple and the home was in a great location, very clean and stylish. Excellent stay, would come back again and would strongly recommend. The house manual also gave us alot of personal tips for Parisian etiquette that we found very helpful. You will enjoy your stay!
Less than ten minutes walk from Crimee station which is on metro line 7. Very clean. Agnes responded quite fast and she was really friendly. Love the place

Marc's place is a great place to explore the Marais and the rest of Paris from. It provides the weary traveler with a much needed place to lay his or her head at the end of a long day along the banks of the Seine.

Gabrielle was an incredibly lovely host and we really enjoyed our stay here. The location was amazing - so close to the Louvre! You can walk to Pont de Neuf and Ile de cite. The location even made getting to Disneyland easy because of being close to the RER!

This is a lovely jewel in Montmartre area of Paris. We loved staying here as our base to explore the city. Catherine has amazing recommendations on restaurants, places to visit, the best place to get cheeses and baguettes. We will definitely want to return here when visiting Paris.

Yang’s place is very tidy and comfortable, the location is pretty great and you can see the amazing night view of Paris just in walking distance. I’m glad that I chose Yang’s apartment for my first trip in Paris.
Good location, clean and safe! It missed a bit the French flair, but nothing that bothered us. The only "negative" thing, was the key at the door! Super difficult open

My toddler, husband and I stayed at Clarisse’s house. We all loved it! She had a cot, changing facilities for the little one as well as a bath. She left us chocolate, wine and lots of tourist information, as well as answered any questions we had throughout our stay. We loved the location and if we visit Paris again, we’ll be back. Thank you Clarisse

Joan and Sophie’s place was perfect for my stay in Paris, I would highly recommend it for single travellers. Sophie was so hospitable and welcoming. The location was great, very accessible to Le Marais and anywheres else via metro.
Excellent apartment in a best area in Paris. Very easy to navigate to visit attractions. Very clean and well laid out. Will recommend to anyone without any hesitation.
Good place to stay right next to metro. Hip neighborhood with a lot of commerce, bars and restaurants.

Nicolas' apartment is located on a quiet street in the 14th Arrondissement. The location is convenient and within 10 minutes walking to a major metro stop. The apartment itself was very clean and well laid out and Nicolas was a great host, providing good communication and travel tips. Would highly recommend.

Gilbert had been very professional on home stay. He used voice translation application to communicate with us in English as we don't understand French. He had been flexible with our check-in, and check-out times. Location is also great. The house seems to be historic building with big doors, and construction, but facilities are modern. Great place to stay. Gilbert is kind, friendly, and understanding.

Not worth this amount of money on my opinion: 1. Cleaning wasn't made before our arrival 2. It is not spacious as it seems from photos, 2 beds stand just in front of each other and separated with blind. So it won't be comfortable for 4 people. 3. It is 1 floor without any sun light But I must say it has also pros: good location, kitchen fully equipped

This three bedroom apartment is just perfect for a trip to Paris. Located in a very desirable location we were able to walk to all the main attractions. The apartment was spotless and very comfortable.
One of my best AirBNB experiences ever! Mai is awesome and this flat is perfect. And the location is second to none.
Anne & Ulysses place is wonderful and charming and they are incredible hosts! Would highly recommend!
Great location close to the metro and grocery right around the corner. Quiet place to rest your weary feet after taking in the Paris sites.

I’ve had a perfect stay at Julien’s place. The check-in and overall communication was perfectly easy. The room as well as the area provide everything that you need. Even though you live in the same flat, you have your own space and a lot of privacy. I would definitely come back, merci beaucoup!
This is a large, three bedroom suite with a very nice full bathroom, and a secondary water closet; a clean, modern and spacious suite, easily accommodating the five adults in our group.

The apartment is spacious, with lots of natural light and great views. The location is perfect, with shopping, restaurants, and tourists points of interest all within walking distance. My favorite thing was the bed!!! One of the most comfortable beds I have ever slept in. I would definitely stay here again next time I am in Paris.

My family (3 adults/2 children) stayed here for two nights. The apartment is very well located and within walking distance of many sights, as well as close to a metro stop. There was also a grocery store just across and down the street that was very convenient. Both bedrooms and the sofa bed were very comfortable and the apartment was very clean. As mentioned in the listing, the neighborhood is very safe and quiet at night. We would definitely stay here again!

The location of this apartment is really spectacular. Close to everything, and close to the metro if needed. We really enjoyed walking around the neighborhood. The apartment is cozy and charming. The many flights of stairs were a bit troublesome only with luggage or after a long day of walking. We had an issue with WiFi when we first arrived that was quickly resolved which we very much appreciated. The hosts were quick to communicate and offer help and tips. Overall a great place to stay in a great area of Paris!!!
The apartment was very beautiful and in an excellent location. It was also spacious. we loved our stay there.
Close to RER B, Metro and Catacomb. The room is clean and perfectly fit for 4 people.
The apartment is in a great location with lots of cafes and restaurants close by. Very comfortable apartment. Highly recommended.

Denis was very flexible with us and great at communicating everything we needed to know about his place including how to use the washer/dryer which was incredibly helpful! We had a wonderful stay, great location and clean spot :)

This place couldn’t have been cuter! I was in Paris for a super short visit after living here for three years and the view from this apartment was just perfect! The balcony was amazing, bed was super comfy, honestly couldn’t have asked for more.

The apartment location is great. Very convenient. However, a bit noisy neighborhood at night. The apartment was clean and well equipped though some furnitures are old and need to be fixed. During my stay the electricity went off for 10 times, may be due to over-usage but the apartment claim to be able to accommodate up to 8 people which is a large group so I think the host should be more prepared with the electricity power usage for large number of guests. The rest were all good, big kitchen. Friendly host.
This was our favorite place on our travels. Anne was lovely and everything was beautiful. It even smelled pretty. Our only regret is that we could not stay longer
The apartment is in an amazing location! Wonderful shops and eateries. Very close to the metro. Apartment is clean and spacious.

Good location and the room is so clear. Walking to subway is about 5mins that you can go to anywhere by train. The space is perfect for single traveler. Highly recommend if you are looking for a place with reasonable price and comfort room to stay.

The room was impeccable, the location was chic, safe and close to the center, there is absolutely nothing to say - I really enjoyed my stay. If you are lucky enough to be able to stay at Suzie's, please be respectful and kind to her, as much as she is with us - she is a gem. 200% recommend this place. Incredible bang for the buck in the heart of Paris.

The apartment looks exactly the same as on the pictures. It is very cute and cosy. The kitchen is fully equipped. The location of the flat is great. You have access to the metro. There are a lot of restaurants, shops, bars and clubs nearby. There was a lot of towels and shampoo provided. The communication with the host is very good. There are a little touches that could be made in the apartment but overall it was nice staying there.

The WiFi was very flaky, intermittently going in/out of service every 10-15 minutes but otherwise it was a great space in a great area of France at a reasonable price point. Would definitely stay here again!
Very central apartment and Julien was a great host. My only criticism is that the apartment wasn’t as clean as I would’ve liked.

Jean-Daniel's apartment is great! Jean-Daniel is helpful, responsive and very hospitable. Clean, hygienic and equipped with all amenities. We were four people and we had enough space. In addition, the location is also very good. I definitely recommend the apartment!
We had a really nice stay in this appartment in Paris. The only problem is the fourth floor without elevator... :-/
Exactly as it looks in the photos, clean lovely space. Only one loo, but actually for one night, really not a problem!

The place is a little far from the Center but shouldn’t restreint anyone from getting this AirBnb. Joan and Emilie are so really nice host, always there if you need anything. The place is really beautiful and really clean! I would go back anytime!
A great, modern, well-designed and clean studio! The location was perfect for me, check-in was easy, and communication was quick and clear. I hope to stay there again on my next trip to Paris!

I very much liked the air bnb experience at Suzies place. Suzie is very helpful, communicative and attentive. The neighbourhood is very nice and safe and I parked my car for free on a 10mins walk. Thanks a lot Suzie and best wishes for 2020, Ine x

Excellent place in Paris. Quiet, even with all the street noise outside. Toasty warm when we would return each evening. A great location, even with the transit strike causing you to walk most everywhere. Good restaurants in the 'hood.
We had a lovely stay in Tristan’s apartment. We were their during the strike, and Tristan did everything he could to make our trip to Paris a bit easier.
The apartment is wonderful! We loved it and we truly recommend it! Appart of that, France was really nice with us.

The place had a great location. It was close to many wonderful bakeries, shopping and markets. There was also a fun Christmas market close by. We were able to walk o many sights from the apartments which was good due to the transit strike. Each apartment was comfortable for three people, but when we combined the six of us into one space it was a little tight. Still, it was nice to have two separate apartments. Check in was clear and easy and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Anne and Ulysse made our family of 5 feel very welcome. Great location, homely, very Parisian decor and warm hosts.
Gilbert is an awesome host. I would definitely recommend this place to stay. Place is very near to bus stop which connects to other places.
Perfect! great location, easy access and check-in. It's small but it's works perfectly! thank you
We had great time in Paris, when we have some problems or questions, Kathleen always so kindly and friendly give us suggestions. Highly recommend this place to everyone!

The location is wonderful. Easy access to metro and Grandes Magasins. Apartment is up 3 floors with no lift so not good for low mobility or heavy luggage. In general apartment is a bit tired and needs a de-clutter and spring clean. Communication is good although basic and no information shared on local area amenity or things like how to dispose of garbage. Ok for a short 3 /4 day stay as location is excellent.

Nice Place near the city Center. We had a lot of problems to come to ritas place because of the strike of the trains and the Public transport. So it was nessesairy to change the Check in Time very offen - Rita was very flexible and kind. Good choice!

Aurélie's appartment is beautiful, comfortable, and in a great neighborhood! Close to the metro and surrounded by bars and cafes. 5 of us had a wonderful time and plenty of space. Aurélie met us at check-in and gave us a tour, was very responsive, and was overall a very gracious host.

Chokri’s apartment is in one of the best locations in Paris, from the easy access to shopping and the sites, to the ease of having everything you need in the apartment, it was a winner from start to finish. Chokri was super easy to deal with, and very prompt to reply, helping us out with our early arrival in the bitter cold. 10/10 recommend.

We had an amazing stay at Bruno’s place. It is an extraordinary apartment in the most typical Parisian style, with very ample space even as we travelled as four adults and an infant. The decor is unique and it felt like a very special experience to see all of Bruno’s art and yet it was a very homey place. We enjoyed the location too which was very convenient - a lot of attractions are accessible on foot, and there are good restaurants everywhere.

Location Location Location! Julien’s apartment is in such a fantastic location. Even though we had the misfortune of visiting during a transportation strike, we were still able to get around on foot relatively easily! There are tons of places to eat and drink nearby (do yourself a favor and make time to visit The Lockwood) and Julien provides a lot of recommendations. The bed was very comfortable and the apartment had all the amenities we needed for our stay.

Alex’s was a great host, responded quickly whenever I had any questions and was extremely accommodating. I was able to check in earlier than expected and out later as well. We had two couple staying and the space was big enough for all four of us. It place was very clean and neat with thoughtful touches throughout the apartment. Everything we needed for cooking was available and a market is directly across the street. I appreciated that you only have to walk up one step to get to the apartment as my partner has a back injury and can’t climb stairs. Multiple metro and bus stations are within a 5 minute walk and the neighborhood is very safe at night. I would definitely stay here again.
Much pretty and clean room.Happy is so kind and she has great hospitality.Two cats also very cute.Highly recommend to stay.
Very nice neighborhood, you can find almost everything you need around the area including a very nice baker shop. Parking spot is secure and easy to access.

The perfect place to stay in Paris. Walking distance to everything. The bars and shops just around the block are fabulous. Lots of stairs!! If your at all impaired you should know the apartments are down a few staircases. A few steps did just allowed for more fresh baked goods. 😂

Mariana was an awesome host who responded quickly when prompted and had a very cute little stylish apartment. The apartment is super close to the metro station, and had lots of fantastic restaurants/cafes nearby, perfectly situated. Would recommend staying here if you’re new to Paris or just in general
Amazing location! Julien is super nice, he helped us with our luggage and contacted a shuttle to the airport for us! His tips are amazing, really nice apartment! Fully recommended

Overall we enjoyed our stay and would recommend Georges’ lovely apartment. It was warm and bright, and there were a lot of personal touches throughout, including original art. The Nespresso machine, washing machine and spacious shower were all a benefit.

The apartment was really beautiful and the decoration was pretty. The neighborhood is perfect in every point (restaurants, shopping and nice streets to walk in). The only downside is the fact that there's only one toilet for the whole apartment. Other than that the stay was great, thanks!

All good. It is like the pictures. Only thing I didnt like was that the block wasnt nice and you have to enter through an alley that is dark and a little dirty with two homeless persons sleaping on the side. Wouldnt come back just for that but if you have no problem with that it works on the other areas.
Kathleen is a lovely person and she is always there to help you, I had a really good moment staying at her place.

Hannelore and her husband are fantastic hosts! We could not have asked for a better place to stay. We had a lovely breakfast of coffee, bread, jam, yogurt, and fruit ready for us every morning. Hannelore was great with offering suggestions, communicating, and being an overall great host. The location is very lovely. It's far enough away from the center of the city to enjoy some peace and quiet, but it's just a quick metro ride away from all the sights and museums. We would definitely stay here again!

A excellent place to stay. A very friendly host. The place is absolutely stunning. Kitchen got everything you need. Host also gave a guide for everything in the house when we arrived, just making everything very comfortable when we stay.

We had an amazing stay in Sandrine's apartment. It is in an awesome location, being a short walk to the Eiffel Tower, Beaugrenelle for shopping and the Javel Station. The apartment is in a secure complex and having the supermarket downstairs is so convenient. Totally recommend this apartment for a great stay in Paris.

We absolutely loved our stay! The apartment was in a perfect location, close to the metro and walking distance to Notre dam and plenty of great restaurants. The apartment itself is large, bright, and beautifully decorated. It was the perfect Parisian apartment. Anne was a wonderful host- she had fresh fruit, wine and chocolates for us on arrival, and went above and beyond to help us during our stay. She also had a cot, high chair, and plenty of toys for our 1 year old. We would highly recommend staying at Anne & Ulysse’s place!
Very nice and clean (but small!) place. Sébastien was super responsive and allowed me to move in a bit earlier.
The accommodation was great! Stylish and homely. Alive was very yuh easy to communicate with and made the stay very easy. Highly recommend.

The location is excellent with easy access to metro and bus services. Also the local area has many restaurants, specialty food stores and supermarkets making it very easy for all types of catering. Having the two apartments is great for family groups travelling together. We had a wonderful time staying here.

Denis' place is in an excellent location, many sights walkable, with many cafes and bars nearby. It's new and clean, and Denis was extremely responsive and gave us a lot of information regarding the transportation strike. Overall we had a great time, only thing to mind is that it's a 2nd floor walk up. We didn't mind though.
Wonderful value - perfect for the single traveller - Jordan was extremely helpful. The room was clean and perfectly situated near lots of amenities and very safe.
Very nice and clean space at a good location in Paris. Eleanor was very responsive to any query I had and the check in process was smooth.

This was one of the best places we have stayed at. It has such a modern and contemporary touch. Everything was clean and organized. We were very happy with our stay and the location is unbeatable. So so impressed. Thank you!

Here is a very good choice for Paris, it is cozy and clean. Julien and his wife prepared some food in the room. I lived in Paris for ten days and the room was in a very quiet neighborhood with local residents nearby. It is safe and convenient. You can go anywhere in Paris by public transport. I would recommend it here.

Apartment is located in a great location with many restaurants, bars, grocery stores, etc. Thomas was always available should there be any questions and greeted me personally to give a tour of the place. Would definitely recommend.

The perfect stay for in Paris!! Location, apartment and the owners made this stay an amazing and cozy place to stay! We really loved staying here and would love to come back to this amazing place!! XxRuth&Carlos
Absolutely magical home to stay in made the entire trip to Paris a dream. Would certainly stay again and recommend to anyone going to Paris. Without a doubt, best AirBnB experience ever.
Charming traditional French hotel room in a great location. I only wish the weather was better so I could have enjoyed the nice balcony. I would recommend to anyone. Great water pressure too!

This is an excellent fully furnished one bedroom apartment. I liked our location away from the majority of the major sites ( except catacombs). We believe this reduced the tourist crush and as a result the area seemed to have more of a neighborhood feel. The metro is a few short blocks and the RER from CDG was only three blocks away, making out trip upon arrival inexpensive and easy. Just around the corner one block away is a vibrant marketplace walking street with all sorts of useful open air food outlets, such as cheese, meat, fish, veggies, bread items, restaurants etc. If you like nature, don’t miss Parc Montsouris, a 15 minute walk away. In summary, we would be happy to stay at Mireille’s place again.

The host arrived late for key exchange, and only having one key available for our group was frustrating for entry and exit, considering we wanted to have our own plans going freely to and from the home base. However, the place was clean, had comfortable beds, and is in a safe area.
Much better than my expectations!!. Style, hospitality, and convenience are on top! I will definitely come back again and again

Lovely house and lovely host. Always here to help you if you have a problem with something and very welcoming. In a very nice place of Paris, near the famous Champs Elysées avenue and the Triumphal Arc.
The apartment is huge and overlooking paris , very close from everything , very elegant , i will definetly take the same place for next year
Its the personal Appartment of Alice. Too many rules, messages, calls because she was worried about her home.
Good location. Near by public transport. Clean apartment. The host is very nice.

Jacques' flat is lovely, it was super clean and had everything we needed and more. It is situated on a boulevard and popular area (which we knew and picked on purpose) but you don't hear a thing which is fantastic. Jacques was very helpful and accommodating both throughout the booking process and with regards to check-in and check-out. We will absolutely be using his flat again next time we visit Paris.

We had a wonderful stay at Anne’s beautiful apartment. Anne made us feel extremely welcome, and could not have done more to make sure we had a great time in Paris. The decor was stunning, the bed was comfortable and the location was perfect (less than a 10 minute walk to Notre Dam). I would highly recommend Anne’s apartment to anyone and I look forward to staying with her again in the future.
The apartment is beautiful. The location is great! However this is more like a hotel or a managed apartment. Not a Airbnb were you get to know the host or have personal experience.

The hosts are very friendly and nice. The room is also very cozy and clean. It is just a bit of walking from the bus or metro stations, but considering the price it is very reasonable. You also get your own toilet, but you might want to bring your own toothpaste, shampoo etc. But the hosts will let you borrow them if you ask.
Denka is a great host. We felt very comfortable in their wonderful apartment and will definitely choose this accommodation again on our next stay in Paris.

Great apartment, tastefully decorated. There are lovely touches i.e. sewing table, vinyl player with great record collection, art and photography books/ magazines etc. Alice's place is opposite a nice little local bar and in great area to discover real Paris! Belleville park and Pere Lachaise Cemetery are both within walking distance, as too are a number of decent bars and restaurants. We had a great stay and would definitely return sometime in the future. Thank you Alice for being a wonderful, understanding host!
You just feel welcome and like home in Sophies place. Perfect area full of small and nice cosy bars and restaurants. We can just highly recomend this beautiful place.
Great location for metro and sightseeing, excellent host, apartment exactly as described. Had a great trip.
We had a great experience in Paris with this lovely and comfortable flat! The house is located near the metro and there’re some markets which is so convenient!
We unfortunately only stayed one night, but we would definitely come back the next time we will be in Paris.

France was such a nice and welcoming host! The apartment was beautiful and in such an incredible location! (5 min walk from the Louvre) We had such a nice time and would recommend it to anyone visiting Paris!

If you want the perfect location for seeing Paris, this is the place. Central to everything and a short distance to the Metro, shopping, great dining, museums ...... It's a nice place, and if your like me, you wont need much time at home because there are so many things in Paris to keep you busy
Great location, great communication with the host. Everything as expected. We had a great stay.

If you want a charming and cosmopolitan neighborhood you should book this space. Lots of restaurants, groceries, cafes etc The place itself is very precisely, exactly like the photos. Confy bed, well equipment kitchen. Go ahead and book with no worries.

Joan’s apartment is located close to great transportation options and many excellent cafes - there are some great local recommendations available on an info sheet in the room. I didn’t find the traffic so loud as some other reviews mentioned, although Joan and Sophie have some young children who are lively at times in the morning, but bringing earplugs if you’re a light sleeper will make that no problem! The apartment is cute and clean and I wouldn’t change a thing. Thanks to Joan and his family for the hospitality!

We had a great stay at Jean-Daniel's place. The location is superb, close to the Metro and multiple boulangeries. Monmartre is only a short stroll away, with so many nice walks, and restaurants to choose from. Thank you Jean-Daniel.

Fantastic apartment in a great location. Lots of lovely cafes on the doorstep and very close to supermarket. Check in was very easy and communication was very good. Comfortable beds, stylish apartment with everything we needed for a weekends stay. Definitely recommend.

One of the best value places I have ever stayed in Paris. Perfect location if you love Belleville/the surrounding neighborhood. Lots of lovely streets and cafes to explore, Giovanni gives great recommendations as well. The room is perfect for two people, and the beds can be together or separate. It feels like a "Whole Place" rather than "Private Room" (Airbnb accommodation classifications), because there is a private entrance and kitchenette. The neighborhood is quiet, and feels safe. The price is also great value. I would definitely stay here again if I ever come back to Paris. Merci Giovanni!
Very much as advertised, and the location was perfect to get to the Effiel tower & very quick walk (practically around the corner) to the metro line we took almost everyday.
A room that is as stylish and functional as it seems on the pictures. Might come back a second time!

A beautiful, clean, immaculate apartment with very comfortable beds. It was very quiet too. Perfect location, walking distance to the Louvre & Notre Dame. The welcome pack provided a wonderful list of potential restaurants to try. We went to Brasserie Vivienne which was great. Instructions on how to access the apartment were very clear too, everything was as stated. Thank you.

Amazing location for an amazing place at a good price! I’ve visited Paris 6 times from Australia in the last 2 years and this was my favourite spot! Will definitely be staying here when I return in the future.
