The apartment is clean and a great size for four people. Jean-Luc was very communicative and helpful throughout our stay. We loved it and would 100% choose this place again.

Jean-Luc’s apartment is wonderfully located - close to the Louvre, walking distance to fabulous restaurants and a taxi stand nearby. Very clean and a quiet courtyard with everything you need inside. Fantastic shower and water pressure. Jean-Luc is a great host - very communicative and responds promptly. We would dry stay here again. Merci.

The accommodation is right on the spot. At the corner from the Sacre Coeur and Anvers metro station and only a 15 minute walk from Gare du Nord. The place has everything you need and is a real authentic Parisian studio! The windows into the courtyard keep the studio cool even during high temperatures in summer. Communicating with Yann was very quick and enjoyable! I will definitely stay here again!

Jean-Daniel was a well communicative host with an easy check in. The space is a quite spacious place suitable for a family or multiple people. We saw a few silverfish/spiders throughout the home, but overall had a good experience and would still recommend this booking.

Fernanda was so accommodating and even helped us with a late check-in. The place is clean, but pretty tiny. It’s a good spot if you’re just looking for a place that’s 10 minutes walking distance to sleep in!
The Appartement is very cute and has a perfect location. Sophie and Stephane are very friendly and we were in a good contact.

The apartment was well presented and very clean. It had everything we needed for our weekend stay. Paul communicated quickly and accommodated an early check in for us. We would certainly stay again next time we visit.

A super apartment decorated with character, with an amazing large terrace. Kitchen and bathroom well-equipped, everything clean and everything worked. Both the bed and the sofa bed were comfy. Hosts pleasant and prompt communicators. We really enjoyed our stay.
Beautiful and pittoresk place in Le Marais. It’s on walking distance from all the shops and restaurants. Excellent communication with the host, would definitely recommend!

Yoni is very helpful. We communicated very easily. We really enjoyed his flat. It’s quite spacious and the two big porches are really nice spaces for hanging out and rare for Paris. The flat is very clean, and the kitchen is well equipped. All shops and restaurants are nearby. The restored old railway track is a gem for taking a walk in a green quiet space. Tram, buses, Metro are all in walking distances, though one can use some caution walking back alone late at night. The place is very quiet for sleeping (also rare for Paris). I certainly highly recommend it to couples or families. - XR
Julien has been a great host, very kind and welcoming. The room was very nice and cozy. Perfect for solo travellers. Highly recommended.

The apartment is just as depicted in the photos. It has been renovated to a high standard and is very comfortable. They left lovely Aesop products and provided water in the fridge. We did have a small issue with the toilet being quite noisy while not in use but overall the apartment was very good and we could recommend it to others.

You really can’t beat the value of this place. It’s well kept and the location is great. It would be hard to find anything in this area that compares to this. The sofa bed could use some extra padding if used, but if you layer the extra blankets you can find in the closet, you’ll be fine. All n all… great host and great stay.
Location,location,location Beautiful view Walkable to many attractions Numerous restaurants nearby

Muriel's studio is absolutely great. Muriel met when we arrived to give us the keys, a rundown of the workings of the apartment, and a little overview of the neighborhood. All was as advertised, plus the addition of a nespresso machine. The location is the best with two metro stations within short walking distance to provide access to everywhere we wanted to go in Paris. And if you're into haunting cemeteries the Père Lachaise is right up the street. Thank you for sharing your lovely little studio with us Muriel
In one word: Awsome. I was so lucky to find this beautiful place and to know this lovely family. It made the whole paris experience much more enjoyable for me.
The location is great and within easy walking distance to restaurants and the Louvre. The apt is spacious, very clean, and easily accommodates two couples.

Tatiana’s home is wonderful, lively neighbourhood, very clean home with really good design and character. I stayed here for 8 days and it really felt like home the moment I step in. Check in and out process was also very simple, friendly and responsive ❤️❤️❤️

Clean place but be warned that there is no AC in this unit but there are fans and they were enough for us to have a comfortable stay. We kept the windows open. Plus is the washer and dryer. We were able to stay in Paris for an affordable price but would stay somewhere close to the city center next time. Having said this, if you are looking for an affordable, clean and safe place to stay in Paris, this is a good and clean space.

Very pleasant and good located apartment very close of metro, supermarkets and restaurants. Even being a low floor, there is no particular noise since it is not a busy street. It is well equipped so that you have everything you need for a family. Good choice!

This apartment is located in a lovely area on a quiet street close to some excellent restaurants and the Eiffel Tower is within easy walking distance. The modesty coverings on the street level windows provide coverage during the day time, but not so much in the evening when the lights in the apartment are on. The beds are large and comfortable and curtains in bedrooms provide excellent blackout. The concierge service offered by the host communicate speedily to any question any potential guests may have. I would recommend this comfortable apartment for a long weekend for 4 adults.
Best stay I have had with airbnb, very kind and help full. Beautiful appartment and very quiet. We Will defently Come back.

This is a great place to stay if exploring Paris. The location is ideal next to Opera & Quatre-Septembre metros. The apartment is fab too. It’s in a really quiet and safe building looking over a picturesque courtyard. Communication with Clarisse & Anna was so easy too. I’d highly recommend this apartment.
Incredible host and great accommodation! Room was extremely clean and Monique was very approachable to help with anything! Had a wonderful stay!!! Highly recommend

We had a great stay in Alex's flat. Alex was very flexible with the times for arrival and departure. The flat is close to a metro station and in a lively area with many bars and restaurants, at the same time the flat is very quiet and located in a green courtyard which you can enjoy from the balcony during breakfast.
Nicolas' place is great! It's comfortable, spacious, quiet and nicely located in Paris. Nicolas is also very accessible if you have a question or problem. A truly enjoyable experience.
Jean is an amazing host, and the apartment is super lovely! He gave me tips to see the city, and help me with any questions I had. Highly recommend his place.

We had a great stay in this spacious apartment. The apartment is clean, has air conditioning, is a little dim as it’s on the first floor, the communication was great and quick when we needed to ask a question. It’s a bit out of the way, but had easy access to the easy to use Metro system. Great for getting to Versailles, if you want to go to a PSG game, Musee Marmottan-all in the 16th. Just out the door to the right is a little square with a few restaurants, nice neighborhood feel and don’t forget to see a peek of the Eiffel Tower. Overall, highly recommend- we were two adults, but for a family this would be nice!
Walking distance to many places, clean & have complete equipment. Nearby parking spot. Welcomed with a snack & drink. Very nice stay

Jean-Daniel was the best host we have had in an AirBNB. He was very responsive and the house was perfectly accomodating to three groups. We had a very comfortable stay & would recommend this place to anyone! The apartment was very clean and quiet, the facilities in the house were also great.
Really liked the location it was about a 35 minute walk to the Eiffel and next to some nice restaurants and bars. The bed was comfortable and the room was clean upon arrival! Thank you!

I booked last minute with a toddler and all went smooth. Gilbert is very communicative and assures that all goes perfectly. He answered immediately my pre-booking inquiry that he has no equipment for toddlers but he welcomes them in case it is ok, which was fine for us. He gave us the keys earlier and we could leave our luggage there and same was arranged on our last day. Location is excellent, besides the room the other fully equipped premises were available for full use.
Great location, beautiful views of the Eiffel Tower just steps away on the bridge. Away from the tourist grind and very comfortable!
Hugues is very nice and kind. The house is close to the museum area and places to eat.

Guy was a great host, he met us in person for the check-in and was flexible with the time, the room is charming in a vintage look. We loved the stay and would advise it for anyone going to Paris for a few days, although it might feel a little tight for 2 people if you are staying longer.

Gilbert's place is very nice! Very nicely decorated and the room is clean, spacious and well-equiped. It is close by some nice neighbourhoods. Gilbert is very friendly and flexible. We could already arrive quite early. He also provided some breakfast in the morning :) We enjoyed our stay and would recommend it!

Love the location of Louise’s place, it was absolutely perfect for us. We enjoyed Luxembourg gardens and walked to the Orsay, Rodin’s + the lourve. There are also so many great restaurants we are at very close. It was perfect

Great location, lovely apartment with a beautiful view. Very confortable despite the 5 floor stairs. Check in and check out operations very easy and proactive. Mary very kind and ready to give feedback in a very short time.

Anne's apartment in Paris was perfect. It is so beautifully appointed and furnished that being there was as much a part of our enjoyment of Paris as being out in the beautiful city. Every piece of furniture, every gorgeous lamp and mirror contributed to the style yet homeliness of the apartment. Great position for getting out and about in Paris. Anne was helpful and welcoming every step of the way. I highly recommend and will definitely be back! Judy

This is a charming and spacious apartment in a nice part of town. And Mariana is a great host who goes the extra mile to make everything work well. There are just two things to be aware of. One is that it's on the fifth floor and there's no elevator, which Mariana makes a special point of noting in the listing. The other is that there is no air-conditioning, and the apartment is on a fairly busy street that gets noisy in the morning. I would recommend staying here during the cooler months so that it won't be necessary to leave the windows open at night. When we were there it was warm, so we left the windows open, and then the street noise woke us up early in the morning.

We had a nice stay in Paris at Sebastien’s apartment. It is in such a great location, with everything you could want very close by. There’s a big supermarket, lots of cafes and bars, and you can walk anywhere you need (or get the nearby metro). Thanks again!

Room is small, nice bed. As per picture. Great location. But since its hot we have to open the window to get air during the night. But as the room is right above the street, it is very noisy and we dont sleep too well since we can hear everything from the street if you open the window. Breakfast is great.

This is a great home in an exciting part of Paris! Yohann is extremely friendly and responsive, we could not have asked for a better host. We very much enjoyed our stay and would be thrilled to stay there again!

We really enjoyed the apartment We were a couple and three children, the communication with the host is easy and available and he responded to everything! The location of the apartment is perfect near the metro and a quiet street. The apartment was clean and well equipped The only drawback is that there are no windows, otherwise it is perfect
Nice family, well welcomed. The room was clean. Be careful if you are very tall you may not be as comfortable in the loft apartment
Great are near the Louvre. Clean place and very comfortable and the host was great and responsive.

We loved our stay. The apartment is a perfect location for the metro and is very centrally located. It felt like coming home at the end of a long and active day! Thanks for helping make our Paris experience even better! Loved the vibe of the apartment.

Nice apartment and really good location in Paris! It is a bit small, would really recomend if travelling alone or for a short time if travelling with someone. Really nice location and really nice guest! Would definitely come back!

We stayed for a week while traveling Paris. The apartment is in a great location in Monmart, close to many good restaurants and cafes and in walking distance of transportation alternatives. Chloe was very communicative and flexible with us. The place is lovely and well lit with a great balcony and very good wifi connection. We could easily work from the apartment. I’ll definitely recommend staying here;)
We had a great stay at the apartment. Easy communication and key pick-up. The apartment had everything we needed and we enjoyed the area around a lot. Would definitely come back again!
Agnes's home is conveniently located near a metro station, and the room was both quiet and clean.

Unfortunately our experience was not as pleasurable as the other reviews read. The room we were given was a complete misrepresentation from the Airbnb listing. It looked nothing like the photos. Our room was run down, dark, musky and located directly behind the reception desk which woke us up multiple times during the night with people in and out and loud conversations, not to mention zero privacy. It felt like a hostel. Only positive was that the staff were friendly and kept our bags ahead of checkin. I would recommend checking which room you’re getting before you book this hotel.
Very nice appartement perfectly located for a weekend trip to Paris! Fernanda is so friendly and the check in was great!

Loved it! Gorgeous street, handy location & lovely place to stay. Cedric was very welcoming. The room & bathroom are "compact" - as we would expect in Paris anyway - but perfectly suitable still. It had everything we needed, including a lovely shower. The breakfast was great for us - crossant, bread, jams, cheese & fresh fruit & various drinks.
wonderful apartment in the center of Paris, fast check-in, excellent communication, Jean was very kind and welcoming, clean and interesting interior in french style

I had a great stay at Josephine’s place. Her apartment is very centrally located, right by Chatelet Metro. I was a solo traveller for work and it worked well. There was noise till late, due to the crowds / bars below, but it did not bother me much. Josephine was very communicative and checked in on me during my stay. She was also gracious and allowed me to have a late checkout. There were some amenities missing but understandable for the nightly rate.
The flat was clean and nice, good wi fi and goor location. Please notice that the entrance is right on the street.

Catherine was the absolute best host, attentive and responsive to all questions I had and went above and beyond for my checkin and checkout needs. The place was also the most ideal location, very safe, close St.Germain and Marais as well as lots of metro stops. The apartment had an unbeatable view, lots of amenities, and well equipped. If you are looking for an apartment in Paris- this is it!!

Henry’s place is great! Clean, with a dishwasher and washing machine and dryer. The best part is being right underneath the Eiffel Tower and watching it light up. Henry and Bernard were the best Airbnb hosts we’ve ever had. They’re kind and available for whatever you need!
Fantastic location in Montmartre! Well appointed apartment on street level (no elevators to deal with) with a cozy feel.
Super clean but small. Price is expensive for what you are getting but that’s Paris I guess.
Great place, especially for a large group. Very clean and exactly what photos show. Close to Metro. Host answered all messages quickly. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend to stay here.
I'm not a "walker" yet I managed to average over 6 miles a day while in Paris. The apartment is within walking distance of many of the things that you should see while in Paris.

The room was very quiet except the one Friday night when inebriated persons got off on the wrong floor and started to try to open our door. It was nice to have a fridge, and while the shower controls were a bit confusing at first, the shower was nice and big. We enjoyed staying here!

Great apartment & location. Super clean. It was very easy to communicate with Nicolas. He is always there, is caring and flexible, and even provided nice amenities. Loved the experience and couldn’t recommend it more.

great apartment in the middle of a great location close to the metro and public bus transportations. we are more then recommend to sign this place and enjoy the Bastille area. a great location in paris for a stay!

Very nice and cozy apartment! Great location, super easy check-in instructions, responsive host, and listing looked just like the pictures! Only minor thing to note is the restaurant downstairs as they were sometimes making noise until around midnight. But thoroughly enjoyed my stay!
A really lovely location with a great view of Paris. Perfect for Sacre Coeur, perfect for Montmarte, perfect in every way.

The flat was pretty clean and it was easy to find and to the check in. The only thing we did not like was the small bedroom, the bed was so small we could not sleep there. The rest was fine. Nice house in a good location.

We had a really good time! Apartment is clean and tidy with all necessary amenities. Location is superb - plenty of restaurants, cafes and shops with excellent food just few steps away. Adrien is a very nice host and and responded very fast when we had a small question. Highly recommend !

We loved this place! It’s very cozy and well equipped. The location was perfect, so much going on around the area and so many places to see. Hugues was also so helpful in providing suggestions for things to do during our stay. We would definitely come back to this place:)

The Apartment is very well located in a nice part of Montmatre. Shops, restaurants and cozy bars are just down the street. It’s very comfy, quiet and clean. We had a nice stay and would come back to Anthony’s.
Great host, great location and the room is a great value with most everything supplied. Would love to come again. Nicolas is the perfect host. Returns communications fast and helps in ever way.
A great place to stay to the point where we even talked about if we came back we’d consider staying here again. Close to the metro, the entire city is easily accessible.

Fantastic apartment in a great location. Exactly as advertised and the perfect spot from which to explore Paris. Our host was extremely helpful and provided great guidance and assistance when requested. I hope to stay here again soon.
Very nice and clean studio in the heart of Paris. Really enjoyed our stay and Hugues was friendly and gave us good reccomandations.
The listing was just as advertised. Very clean and very convenient to walk most places or to the metro.
Great location and nice place for the price. We were worried about sleeping on the futon but it was more comfortable than we thought.

Anna's studio apartment was perfect for my solo trip! Perfect size for me and it was VERY clean! It is very conveniently located and an easy walk from public transportation. She was very communicative and the apartment was ready earlier than expected. Anna even gave me local recommendations for restaurants and a jazz club. There is a pharmacy just around the corner that was perfect for a few items I forgot to pack. Great host with a great apartment in a great city!

The pictures were accurate: this room has a view of the garden and very little room for activities. If you're only looking to sleep and maybe do a little bit of computer work done here, the space is adequate. The apartment is conveniently located by the Crimée metro station; a ~3 minute walk. The hostess was warm and friendly!
Alex's place is great! It was just as advertised, on a nice, quiet street in Monmartre. It's very close to the train and lots of shops/restaurants.

Great flat in the city and a wonderful host. Perfect for our 1 year old daughter and my wife. Central location, very comfortable beds and close to the train/metro for an easy ride home. I’ll look to book here again next time we visit Paris.
Stayed in green room. This place is good if you just need a place to sleep. 1 block from the metro. Functional above all.

Great apartment, really good location near to public transport and a lot of restaurant, Le Marais is a great place to stay. The apartment was very clean and renovated. My only complain is there is only one toilet for the hole apartment, can be a little bit chaotic when you had 6 people but at the end we managed it. Awesome stay.

We loved the apartment, clean, spacious and stylish. We loved the neighbourhood even more, great restaurants, independent shops and very close to the metro. Highly recommend staying here for a great trip to Paris

Excellent district and location, the apartment is less than 250 meters from the Eiffel Tower so within walking distance. David the host was amazing and I highly recommend this quaint place. Yojany Mathis.
Great apartment, homely and nice. Thomas is a friendly and helpful host. Everything was perfect!
A perfect place for couples to visit paris. Gilbert is a very nice person, he made us feel like home. Both check in and check out was flexible. I would recommend this place.
Thanks to Mike and May, I could have a very comfortable time. The panoramic view from the rooftop is spectacular. See you around.

Enjoyed my stay close to the centre of Paris. 20 minute walk from Gare de Lyon or there are bus and metro connections. Quiet, self-contained with microwave kettle and fridge. Plenty of restaurants, cafes etc nearby. Enjoyed coffee and conversation with hosts.
This stay was very convenient for my short 3 days in Paris. And suited my basic needs and felt very safe! Public transit is very close. Very pleasant and responsive hosts as well!
Apartment is beautiful, clean, and in a fantastic location. We enjoyed many great restaurants within walking distance.
The place was very clean and matched the description. I had somewhat of a hard time checking in. Everything else was perfect!

Incredibly beautiful apartment. Anne was so lovely when she came to greet us and show us around and even provided a cot for our 5 month old baby which was so helpful. So much care and attention to detail in every corner of the place, they have thought of everything. Such a memorable trip thanks to the wonderful hosts.

Julien’s place is amazing. It is larger than what it appears in photos. The balcony with a view of the Eiffel Tower is incredible and magical. You’re steps away from the moulin rouge and all the fun of Montmartre. There is an elevator which makes getting up to the 6th floor flat easy. Everything was great and I recommend staying here if you want to stay in Montmartre. I would definitely stay again and hope to when I come back to Paris!

Terrific apartment in a fun, lively location. The apartment is clean, well appointed and close to shops, restaurants, the metro and the Sacre Coeur. The host was very responsive and flexible with checking in and out. We really enjoyed our stay!

We had a fantastic stay at Hugues place while we were visiting Paris. It’s in a great location, in the heart of the city making sightseeing a breeze. It was super easy to get around and Hugues was really helpful during our whole trip. We highly recommend his place for an amazing time in Paris. Thanks again Hugues!

Jean-Daniel’s apartment was perfect location about a 5 minute walk from the Metro with close by conveniences. The beds were comfy and everything was a smooth check in and out process. Would recommend this place to anyone.

Five star plus accommodation. Lovely, quiet, and bright apartment in a very convenient location. The top-floor apartment has views of Paris rooftops, is very quiet, and is equipped with everything you could possibly need for your stay. Communication with the host was excellent, and the guide to the apartment was comprehensive. Highly recommended.

This is an amazing spot to stay in Paris. Centrally located, super clean and surprisingly spacious. We were comfortable with four adults and four teenagers. Communication was very quick and easy. Do not hesitate to book a stay here! We will be back.

This place is fabulous. Full of light, spacious, and well-equipped. Loved it! Perfect for a little Paris getaway. Justin's excellent communication and quick response when there was a question were appreciated. Definitely recommended and hope to come back soon!

We had a wonderful stay in Anne’s apartment. It’s in a fantastic location surrounded by great restaurants and a few minutes walk from Notre Dame. We were made to feel very welcome - highly recommended!
Hugues was very responsive to all of our questions and provided a clean, inviting space for our stay. We highly recommend this place and will likely stay there again when we head back to Paris.
Great location and close to a number of great places to eat and drink. Easy to get to places too. On our return list for sure
Great location for an Airbnb! The room had its own private and entrance and had a nice vibe. Rooms were modern and clean. Would recommend anyone to stay here.
This place I just like the photos. Very spacious and literally so quiet! You wouldn’t think you’re off a busy street with plenty of restaurants and a grocery store nearby. Check in/out was super easy
Great appartment, excellent location, stunning view. Comfortable and spacious. Aurelie is a very pleasant host.
Gorgeous flat! Great location and amazing views. It was just as advertised and Sandra was very accommodating. Can’t be beat!
Excellent apartment in great part of Paris. Close to many great shops, bistros and restaurants. Worth the five flights of stairs to get to the apartment!
It's wonderful place to stay in Paris. There are a kitchen with plates and utensils, bathroom. I am so satisfied. But there has no elevator to 8th floor. It's hard, however, it's worth to take.

Excelente Location. Stefan (owner) was flexible on early check in and late check out times. Appartment was confortable, very well equiped (everything you need you have). Neigborhood was super, close to every place, and safe.
Great stay. Location was awesome and close to a metro. Plenty of cafes and food options nearby.

A nice, basic and clean apartment in a very good location with excellent transportation to travel around Paris. Communication with Pierre and Aurelien very smooth, they respond very quickly. Reliable and quick to solve problem. Aurelien came down immediately to see thing and fixed it. We had a wonderful stayed.
Great location in Pigalle, clean and well-furnished rooms, communicative host. Would definitely recommend!
The hosts were kind, helpful and responsive. The location was very central and the apartment was open, airy, and perfect for our trip!
The decor does not disappoint..its beautiful with wonderful facilities. A bakery close by for breakfast and the metro is so close. Fabulously close to Sacre Couer. Highly recommend

The location was central to most tourist spots and close proximity to buses and metros. The room is fine and the bed comfortable. My only real complaint was there was a lot of noise from construction going on continually through the day. But that was not the host fault. Kat the host was very helpful and accommodating in any way she could be. The building seem to be in a safe area but dark at night …with several codes needed to enter into the building. ..your choice for getting to the third-floor we’re either stairs or an ancient but adorable elevator. The host has two lovable cats and a cute little puppy named Milo. They will be looking for cuddles!!

Cool apartment with fun views from the top floor! Be ready for the stairs, gives you a true Parisian feel. After being snubbed by another Airbnb during our trip, our check in could have been better. We were in communication with the cleaner who was letting us in but was making us nervous with the slow response (by slow I mean 10 minutes, again we had been snubbed so we were sensitive) she was very nice once we were up in the apartment and gave us the full run down. Only complaint was there were sheets hanging up to dry in the bedroom and living room and we thought they were our sheets drying at first to realize they were other guests sheets, just seemed odd to leave them up. But then again not sure where else they would hang to dry. The host gave good recommendations on where to eat and the restaurant right next door was delicious!!
Cristina’s apartment is wonderful and exactly as advertised. She was extremely communicative and flexible, and the place was so well located and incredibly cute. Highly recommend!

Wonderful, beautiful apartment and the location is great. Close walk to the Metro and there’s a lot of great shops, épicerie, and bistros in the area. There was a tiny problem with the toilet (that wasn’t a big deal) but Tatiana still gave us a complimentary discount, which says a lot. Overall 10/10 would highly recommend and definitely stay here again. P.s. There’s a lovely courtyard attached

The flat had cigarette smell and the shower was too small, everything else was nice. Good location, reasonable price, well-equipped kitchen, comfortable sofabed. Easy access to the flat, smooth communication with the host.

The apartment is spacious, comfortable, very well - equipped and conveniently located. Bruno is an excellent host and explained the details of his comfortable home. The address is extremely convenient, with the Metro and buses only 2 minutes away. The 11th is full of good restaurants and interesting shops. We look forward to anther visit some day.
This perfect place to stay in Paris as it is very well connected to all the attractions. Besides it very well equipped for a small family to stay.
Victoria’s apartment is stunning! Beautifully decorated, and Victoria was a very accommodating host, letting us check out later and being very helpful. Highly reccomend!

We had a great stay in Mariana’s beautiful apartment. The apartment is walking distance to main areas of the city with lots of bars and restaurants and close to a number of Metro stations. We had a very comfortable stay and would love to stay again!
The apartment in a great location that can access to many good restaurants and supermarket. The house is super clean and the view to the city is nice! We definitely want to come back again!
The house is really amazing, comfortable, very well designed, great location. Nicolas & Jean Yves were disponible to everything we needed. We will definitely come back next year!

Amazing apartment with a really nice location close to the metro and walking distance to a lot of attractions. It is small but perfect for a couple and it has everything you need and is very clean and modern. We had some problems with the key-box when we arrived, but the hosts were very helpful and came to the apartment within 30 minutes with a key for us. Very nice people.

A nice place with an incredible host, very receptive and always looking forward to assist us whem we needed. Breakfast were really good with a lot of variety so people can choose every day. Is it located in a quiet area, so you won´t hear anything during your sleep (something really good).

The apartment is beautifully furnished and the pictures do not do it justice. The small family touches really add to the homeliness of the apartment making you feel welcome and safe. There are loads of restaurants to try in the area ans everyone is incredibly friendly. 10/10 service from Georges and the building supervisor were so helpful through out our stay. I would gladly stay again!
Agnes is a very kind host. The room and location are as advertised. You get what you pay for. Overall good stay.
It’s a nice small studio in a great area. You hear the noise from the street but not at night. Having an old shop as apartment is really a nice idea - you just can not look out through the window ;)

Had an excellent stay. The check in and check out process was smooth. Apartment was clean and located within walking distance from 2 metro stations. Sandrine was an accomodating and responsive host. We were able to check in our luggage early too. Would recommend staying here.

We highly recommend Alexandra as a host and her apartment for your stay in Paris. The location is ideal and free from street noise - the apartment is very comfortable - Alexandra is a very responsive host.
This house was a fantastic location for our family with two young kids (ages 4 & 6). We were a 5-minute walk from the Eifel Tower and remarkable restaurants right around the corner.
We had a fantastic week in this beautiful apartment. Fantastic location with everything you need on the doorstep. Communication and check in etc was perfect. Hope to come back some day!

Location: absolutely top, hard to beat .. House itself: Great details - nice cutlery, comfortable beds/sheets, sound isolation, nice decoration Very centrally located, yet pretty quiet (didn't hear anything during the night). Would certainly come back

Nice cosy clean apartment. Close to the subway. Very nice for a short stay in Paris. Friendly hosts who react quickly to questions. Only disadvantage for me was the I could not open a window for fresh air.
We had a great stay at Tatiana's Airbnb. We highly recommend. The space is beautiful and spacious. Tatiana is super responsive and helpful!
This place was great! A really nice central location. The airbnb was beautifully decorated, and very comfortable, just as promised!

Excellent apartment in a great neighborhood with beautiful views. Very safe building and neighborhood with plenty of bakeries, restaurants and shops in walking distance. Comfortable bed, and plenty of amenities. I would stay again.

Don’t look anywhere else, this place has it all. Close to Eiffel Tower, food, pharmacy, fresh produce, everything!!! Check in was amazing and we were texted or emailed every day to make sure we had everything we needed.
Had a wonderful stay at Nicolas place. Clean and very convenient to the metro to see all the sites. Nicolas was also very helpful and attentive to any needs a guest may have
Beautiful apartment in a great neighborhood. Close to bakeries, cafes, wine shop and markets. Metro stop is a short stroll away. Had a lovely stay.
Cozy room with everything you need. Great location with easy access to all the landmarks. Hugues was a great host.
Nice and clean room. It was a pleasure to be here. The host was also very kind.

Our stay was absolutely perfect. Catherine was very accommodating, her place was cozy, very clean, with beautiful views. We loved the location and look forward to future stays and would love to continue to return to this spot.

We loved our stay at Jean Christophe’s appartment. The appartment is beautiful, spacious and well equipped. The location is perfect, situated in a calm private street in the heart of Batignolles. The owners welcomed us very warmly and made us feel at home.

Amazing Location!!! A quick walk to Champs Elysee. 24 hour food market across the street. Place is just as pictured. Check in and Checkout were quick and easy. Would stay here again as long as the weather is cool as there is no AC.

Its a good hostel, although it is too expensive for 200 a night. The towels had bloodstains in them but overall it was very clean. Like all the other reviews said, you can hear people on the hallway, we did not hear the bar that’s outside. People that come from towns, i would suggest another place but for city people or people that like some ambient sound, i really recommend this place. Has alot of nice restaurants around! I personally would recommend this though this will be my first and last stay.
Matt’s place was awesome! Everything went smoothly. Perfect location in St. Germain to get everywhere. Communications were perfect with very fast responses. Very highly recommend!
This is perfect apartment in a perfect location, you have absolutely everything you need in the apartment and the host is super kind and attentive

It is a great location and very helpful hosts Cindy. Very nice apartment that has everything you need, in very lovely area very close to several metro stations, groceries, Luxembourg gardens, great small cafes, wineries and restaurants - can recommend - La Gorgee, Le Bistrot des amis. Cindy is a very friendly and helpful host. With pleasure would stay there one more time.

The place was amazingly cute. Classic Paris building, well maintained, located in a very nice area of Paris (Saint-Germain). At a stone through of Notre Dame, Saint-Sépulcre, … We came with the car and we parked it in an underground car park 100 m away. The appartment was loaded with history and decorated in such a tasteful and beautiful way. Anne was very kind and helpful, English was perfect (which is seldom in France). We definitely keep her address for future trips to Paris, I wouldn’t go anywhere else.

Paul's apartment is perfect for a short stay in Paris. It is about a 15 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. The surrounding neighborhood is very quiet and we felt safe walking at night. There are several restaurants and bakeries very nearby.
Apartment is tiny but very good with all comforts except tv, it doesn't work. Hatch's team is very good in communications and self checkin is perfect.

The location is very central in one of the best areas of Paris (Marais) for bar, restaurants and shopping. Very well connected though Les Halles - Chatelet metro and RER stop. The apartment is at the ground floor in a quite building and street. One of the two rooms has a limitation in not having a window and the WC room space is really small.
Nice place in a great neighborhood ! Ilana was a pleasure to to deal with. Would recommend without any hesitations. 😎

This flat was perfect for my needs. Easy to navigate toward city centre, next door to grocery, and a quiet neighborhood. Francis was incredibly friendly and helpful. Would highly recommend for solo travelers!

Olivier is a great host, he was super nice and helpful but also respected our privacy. The room was very clean and had its own bathroom. The apartment is in a nice area and everything you need is in walking distance (metro, restaurants, grocery stores, …). Thankyou for the great stay, I’d definitely come back any time!
Very clean place in a great location. I would highly recommend it. Check in is very easy as well which is nice.
Best Air bnb experience I have had. Armand and his brother are super nice and inviting. The place is very well kept and great location for anything you want to see while visiting Paris. 10/10.

Wonderful location near tons of restaurants, cafes and markets. Communication and check in process was superior. Kitchen is well stocked and easy to cook in and we absolutely loved the balcony. I highly recommend this listing.
Great top floor apartment in fantastic location complete with both city and street views. close to metro and restaurants but away from hoards of tourists. The perfect mix

Great stay in a lively neighbourhood. Aurélien is a very welcoming and kind host and the apartment is great for 2. Well equipped, quiet at night. great location with lots of restaurants/cafes/bars within walking distance. His place was really clean and comfortable.
We had a wonderful stay at Olivia’s. Beautifully designed space in a conveniently located and charming building. Highly recommended!
Third time staying in Paris, and this was my favorite Airbnb yet. Great location, very comfortable, the three laundry machines in the basement are also a gamechanger! Would love to stay here again.

Vincent‘s place is highly recommended to stay in Paris, stylish and cosy. Vincent is very helpful and always responds in a timely fashion. We enjoyed our stay and hopefully we can visit here again soon!

We had a very good stay in Jean-Daniel’s appartement. We had all the facilities we need. The location is perfect. Nearby the quartier of Montmarte, grocery, bakery, metro next door. Perfect place to discover Paris and to have a spacious accomodation.
Wonderful, and I recommend this place- I would stay again! Close to everything you need.

This apartment is adorable and perfect for one person working or traveling by themselves. I was here to work remotely and the internet worked well. The rest of the apartment had everything I needed (small comfortable bed, desk, closet, dresser, shower, kitchen w fridge/stove/microwave). The location was very close to the arc de triomphe, eiffel tower, and metro stations. Jordan was a very helpful and gracious host and made sure I had everything I needed.

Monique and Jean-Noël were excellent hosts - thoughtful, welcoming and helpful. The room was light, bright, spacious and clean, the flat is very well-located in the 5th and it is excellent value for money. I was a little nervous about staying in a room in someone’s flat, but it was much more straightforward than I’d expected and I’d definitely choose to stay there again.

This was probably our best AirBnB booking ever! The apartment is incredibly cozy, bright and fully equipped. A new renovation has been made and the apartment is furnished with taste and style, from furniture to dishes. Very good internet. Quality appliances, even a washing machine with a drying mode. Julia is a wonderful personality and a great and helpful owner. The location is just perfect, you can see the Eiffel Tower from the window. Generally, don’t even think, just book - you will not regret it one bit!
Tasteful and light apartment on the sixt floor in a pleasant neighbourhood. We felt very much at home. Christina is a perfect host. A wonderful place for a great stay in Paris.

What a wonderful spot! The apartment is in a busy, lively neighborhood but tucked into a quiet courtyard so it really was best of both worlds. Well appointed, had everything we needed and spotlessly clean. Highly recommend!

A great view of the Eiffel Tour from the room in a quiet area of the city. Perfect apartment for 2. Julia was responsive and understanding of our late flight allowing us to stay later into the day. Would definitely recommend this and would love to come back and stay again!

Alex’s apartment is beautiful, even better than the pictures. The location is brilliant, just near to Pigelle metro stop but a lovely quiet road. Alex was always quick to get back to us if we had any questions and check-in and out was very smooth. Would highly recommend.

Marie’s stay is quaint and beautiful :) The place is very spacious as well! Marie is also a very responsive host as well, she has helped us with our taxi reservation making our stay a very stress free and with ease.

We loved staying at Tatiana's place - the flat is very beautiful, clean and well connected. The host responded very quickly to all of our questions and was very helpful, all in all we had a very smooth and lovely stay in Paris !
A fantastic space, unique, and in one of the best locations in Paris. I had a wonderful time.
We absolutely loved our experience at this AirBnb. Jean-Noel and his team were excellent and responsive. The place is absolutely gorgeous and centrally located in the heart of Saint Germain.
The room is perfect! Very clean & spacy. Great location with no stairs. The door is just right on the street. A lot of restaurant in walking distance.
She was super helpful in letting us check in early due to flight timing. Super straightforward and easy to get into the space! Beautiful and just like the photos.

Great stay for those that want an affordable accommodation with nice views and convenient facilities (eg. small kitchen, near several metro stations). For picky sleepers like myself, the sofa bed/mattress may not be the most comfortable, but doable for 2,3 nights. The host is great in communicating and very pro active. Despite the bed, can highly recommend.

The apartment is very nice, modern and in a great location and it offers all amenities one could need. It is rather small, which was fine for us, but I can imagine bigger people could feel a bit uncomfortable. Also the apartment is atypical with a lot of stairs so I wouldn´t recommend for those who have problems with walking the stairs. Anyway, we enjoyed our stay, the communication with Sébastien was smooth, he is responsive and helpful.

Olivier was a great host - friendly, helpful and discreet. The room is clean and comfortable, with plenty of storage for a four-day stay. Having an en-suite shower room is a big plus. Though small, it is impeccably clean, with plenty of (very) hot water. Olivier was very happy for me to use the kitchen and store milk and juice for breakfast in the fridge. He provided coffee and a machine to make it. The location is to the south-west of central Paris, a 10-minute walk from Convention Metro station. Guests with heavy baggage should note that the flat is on the third floor (there is no lift), and up a slope from the Metro, so easier on departure than arrival.
Aurelien is a great host. His place is really cozy and convenient ad the metro station is just 1 minute walk away from the entrance! Lots of food nearby too and grocery
Check in was easy, though the parking is à bit down the road. The house is very nice, but dark as the only windows are in the front. It worked very well for our group of six. We recommend it!

Our stay here it was lovely. Couldn’t have asked for a better neighbourhood to do all of our exploring of the city. The interior was spotless and super cute and comfortable. Loved it and would recommend to anybody in a group of 4-6.

We absolutely loved the apartment. The location is perfect - many famous places are within walking distance or short ride with metro. Flat has beautiful Parisian spirit and is really quiet. Alexandre was very friendly and helpful all the time. Thank you once again!

Everything was great and Virgile was so nice in communication. The apartment was clean, cheerful, and as described. I was very comfortable and would stay here again. I am used to this area, but the neighborhood may not be for the average tourist, though I never felt unsafe.
Gilbert is a lovely person and great host. always ready to help out, very flexible and fun to talk to.

This was an amazing place to be, the apartment is perfectly situated for a city trip Paris. The apartment has everything you need for your stay and is as beautiful as the pictures and very comfortable. We will recommend everyone to book this apartment for your stay in Paris. Many thanks Ju & Ch.
We enjoyed This apartment very much. Clean, comfortable beds and a great location. Would stay again !
Would stay at Irene's place everytime we visit Paris, Perfect location, Calm area and Lovely apartment

Great cozy place in a good location! Gilbert is very friendly, easy to communicate and always prompt with response. The room is super cozy with all things you might need. Love the paintings in the house. Also love the kitchen. Definitely will come back next time in Paris.

Satisfied with our stay. This apartment has everything that we need, kitchen that allows light cooking and a washing machine. The apartment is very near to Metro station , just 5mins walk. Highly recommend for small family to stay.

This place was closely located to the Eiffel Tower. You could walk to the tower or there were rentable scooters right outside of the air bnb. The place was nice and tidy and I would definitely stay there again. I only have two critiques about the place. The first was that the toilet seat was broken and moved a round a lot in the main bedroom. The second was that they had a housekeeper come in and clean up the place without us knowing. The hospitality was nice but a housekeeper was not on the listing and we had personal belongings in the place so the feeling that stuff could have been stolen did not feel good. Other than that, we loved the place, the host was very polite and responsive, and I highly recommend staying there.
Had a great stay at Sophie and Stephane's place. We loved the location. Would stay again!

Our stay was amazing and exactly what we thought when we booked. Hugues gave us very detailed directions from the airpot to the unit and with it being our first time in Paris we had no problem finding it. A wonderful stay!!

Nathalie was a great host. She was always responsive, greeted us when we arrived, and explained how everything worked which was extremely helpful since we were not fluent in French. The location was spectacular, just 100 meters from the Champs Elysees and the FDR Metro stop. You can walk to countless restaurants and shops on the most famous street in the world. In fifteen minutes you can be just about anywhere in Paris with no parking worries. We had a fantastic time, and Nathalie's central and comfortable flat was a critical to our wonderful Parisian adventure.

we were so happy there,great location, nice neighborhood, private,and the hostess were amazing...helpful,friendly and so kind with Us!!I highly recommend Corinne's place to a nice stay and memories from Paris!!!

We loved our stay at Hugues apartment. The flat is clean, beautifully decorated and quiet. Its great location makes it easy to explore paris, with lots of shops and restaurants near by. Hugues was a great host, we were delayed on the eurostar and he gave us very clear and detailed instruction on how to get to the apartment and get in. His communication was excellent throughout Next time we come to Paris we would love to stay at Hugues again and would absolutely recommend it to others.

Perfect location!!! Clean, great communication! Ceiling in loft does take some getting used to. But, we did! Restaurant made some noise a couple of nights but it did not bother us! Highly recommend!!! Would stay again!

Gorgeous newly renovated apartment in an amazing location! Marie's apartment is right on the street so you are certainly in the thick of it, but we never felt that security was an issue. There is a single step just inside the entry to the flat. 10 minutes walk to Sacre Coeur and 5 minutes to the metro, with heaps of surrounding amenity. Like others have mentioned, there is a school close-by and a staircase above the apartment, but the noise didn't bother us. I suspect a lot of accomodation in the heart of Paris would have similar noise levels. The flat is beautifully decorated with a comfy double bed, great shower, spotless bathoom, and large kitchen. There is not a lot of natural light, with only frosted windows at the front, but don't worry you will be too busy exploring Paris for this to be an issue!

Jean-Michel's place is very close to the bus/subway stations with easy access to a considerable part of Paris' highlights. In addition to that, the space is clean and comfortable. I had an excellent time in Jean-Michel's place and I recommend it.
Fantastic appartment. Well located. Very clean. There is everything you need in the appartment for a wonderful stay. I strongly recommend. I plan to be back.

This is the most dirty apartment I’ve ever seen. Officially! Everything covered by the dust and hair. You must to arm with a sanitizer before book it. And this is really pity, because it’s located very well
Enjoyed our stay in Paris! Apartment was a little squeezy for 4 pax, would be best for 2 pax. Very safe neighbourhood and clean!

There were 3 of us and the apartment was comfortable for us three. Great place to stay to visit some of the most famous attractions, just a short taxi or longer walk away. Public transit options are also great in the area. Lots of nearby options for dining or groceries. Apartment on first floor directly facing and close to the street so you notice foot and vehicular traffic but we were busy and on the move, not in the apartment during busiest hours, so it was fine.

Anthony was the best host, by far, I've ever had for an Airbnb. He was always responsive with us and accommodating, and he even helped us stay one extra night when we were in a pinch after our train was delayed due to strikes. Couldn't recommend this place more!

We had such a great time at Julien's place. The apartment is so well located - with not only lots of interesting bars and restaurants locally, but attractions like the Louvre, Pompidou Centre, Musee D'Orsay, The Marais and much more are just a walking distance away. The room was exactly what we needed for the two of us to stay for a long weekend. Julien was super responsive & check-in was easy. We loved it!
We had an amazing experience at Venus place. Even though it's small, it's well located and has easy transportation access. The Eiffel Tower is just a few minutes walk and was safe to walk at night
Great place in a beautiful location! Clean and had all the essentials for my short trip in Paris. Also located across the street from a large pharmacy which is perfect for any last minute needs.

Perfect location, lots of bars and restaurants nearby and accessible by metro. However, apartment has alot of furniture for its size which makes the movement very limited. There were stains all over the bedsheets, and we found a huge spider next to the bathroom door. We were 3 friends so we managed, but i would recommend for Thierry to rennovate at least the furniture to make it more modern, easier to use and move around.
This apartment is what AirBnB used to be and why I fell in love with it. Rosalia is the owner and she cares about your experience. I will definitely be staying here again!
Julien was very kind and helpful. He answered to every question and need. The apartment was in a strategic position to reach museums and attractions. Walk around Paris from here was amazing!
Jerome is a lovely host. He has a cool apartment in a really fun area. The apartment could use a deep clean. Just a heads up to other remote workers that the wifi isn’t secure. Would stay again.
only 2 beds, not 4 like the listing says! also took almost a month to respond leaving no time to rebook another stay with enough beds.
great location and a lovely place too stay. really made our Paris trip perfect. thank you ☺️

10 minuites walk to the Eiffel tower and Triumphal arch. What a safe and beautiful location! The flat was clean and spacious just like the picture. We really liked it! The house was fully furnished there was everything that I need so I didn’t have to buy one! Benjamine is such a polite and friendly host ever! He was willing to answer my questions and always replied me in 30 minutes. Once I had a problem with the tv and the coffee machine, he came to the house and showed me how to figure it out, which impressed me a lot. If there’s any chance to visit Paris again, I will definitely come to his house. Benjamine made my visit to Paris with mom more special, thanks to his help we were able to make wonderful memories! Thank you👍🏻

This was a great location, despite the fact it's tucked away and may not have the best view. It is close to three different metro lines. Lots of shops, patisseries, restaurants, and other shops. I was worried of noise because we're close to the hospital, but it was very quiet. There was some construction under us that we weren't expecting, but I spoke to John and he was able to help with it. I wish I could have stayed longer, but I lost my job and had to leave early. It was a very pleasant stay and I would definitely stay again.
Nice traditional Paris apartment we loved it, would definitely stay again. Location was perfect and check in was so easy!

A place I definitely want to go back to! The location is perfect, and the very spacious balcony is great (definitely the biggest one I've seen in any places I've stayed at in Paris! I was truly amazed 😮). There's everything you need in the flat, and Jean-Michel is extremely helpful. You can tell he cares a lot about visitors. Thank you again Jean-Michel for making our stay so easy and enjoyable.
Me and my daughter had a lovely stay at Nicolas appartment. Walkable distance to the Metro station and nice nighborhoods. Thank you Nicolas!

Emmanuel’s place is in a great location, right near rail lines but with plenty to do in the area. The apartment is great with a comfy bed and lovely patio and stocked with a tasty bottle of wine. Emmanuel had good suggestions and was really flexible with our check in. Would definitely stay here again.
Anne and Jean-Luc were great hosts, they were responsive and accommodating. The apartment is conveniently located and had everything we needed. If we find ourselves in Paris again, we will be back!
A wonderful apartment near the Louvre. You can walk to so many places from the apartment. Great restaurants in the area. Large living space and clean contemporary styling.

Great apartment in a central location. Super clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Close to metro locations, but also walking distance to the Louvre. Julien was super friendly and had a list of recommendations for restaurants, things to do, areas to walk, etc. Would definitely stay here again!
Good location, felt safe and peaceful. Apartment looks better than in pictures actually. Nicolas is very responsive host, gives helpful instructions, thanks:)

We travel a lot and we grew tired of staying at hotels. We are Airbnb hosts as well and we like a well designed, well equipped, and well located place that we can call home for a few days. Marion’s apartment is exactly that, even beyond. We felt immediately at home. The apartment is very well designed and thought of, nothing is missing, everything looks good and is comfortable. We absolutely loved it. Marion is very sweet, very flexible, responds super quickly, altogether an amazing host. And of course, le marais, is our favorite arrondissement in paris. Marions apartment is right in the heart of it…. So giving it a 5 star for everything… Probably one of the best stays in the last few years.
I highly recommend this place! Very clean and the location is perfect. Sophie and Joan are wonderful hosts, very attentive and quick to respond to your messages. 10/10 💚

Lovely modern apartment in the heart of Paris. Two nice bedrooms and large slerper sofa in the living area. Master has shower, sink, and toilet. A second seperate shower and seperate toilet are in the hall. Great kitchen with large refrigerator. Great restaurant (La CasseNoix) just down the street! You will not believe how great this location is!

Eric's place matched the description. It's well located close to everything you might need in Paris. I found it a bit pricey for the level of cleanliness (the plates were still dirty from the previous guest) but the great location was worth the $
We had a great stay. It was very clean and while hard to find at first it was our fault and not the instructions provided. Highly recommend for a group!

What a fantastic place! Thank you so much for the trust given to your guests and let us stay in such a unique apartment. Eric’s home nothing to do with regular Airbnb’s flats. Here everything is well designed but very personal at the same time. We particularly enjoyed being surrounded of many plants. And another big thanks to the host for his responsiveness and kindness. I hope we will have the chance to stay another time.
Phenomenal place in a perfect location 10/10 recommend and will stay the next time I come back!

We had a great stay in this apartment. Location was superb, within easy walking distance of the Lourve, cafes, supermarkets and boulangeries. Very close to RER A to travel to Disneyland Paris. Great coffee machine and two bathrooms helped to get us going each morning. Jean-Luc was a very helpful host, allowing us early access to the apartment and answering all our questions during our stay.

Wonderful stay with a wonderful host! Alexis was extremely proactive in offering local knowledge as to top restaurants and magical activities for the Family. Super cute and spacious loft flat, just across the street from the Louvre, walking distance to so many things - yet quiet and peaceful. The bed and the pull out couch bed both very comfortable. Much better than a hotel room. Would not hesitate to recommend . Thanks Alexis!
This is a great location and the host was very responsive to the few questions we had. We highly recommend it!
The house is in a good position, the appartament’s forniture is nice and modern but it lacked of cleaning; it was dusty we also found a hair.

Room was very quiet and clean. Hugues was very kind and everything was well answered whenever I had an inquiry. The place is very near to the Louvre and tourist spots. It is located between Sentier stn and Strasbourg Saint-Denis and I personally preferred the Sentier station side rather than the other station.
The location is amazing. The responsiveness was very good. The place is clean. It’s just too small for 4 adults. Excellent for a couple.
Loved loved loved Mandana’s apartment - location was amazing and the apartment just beautiful and very well laid out. Host was super helpful and made check-in and check out a breeze!

The perfect location for exploring Paris. Close to transportation and lots of nice restaurants, bakeries, and shops. Guillaume is a wonderful host and his apartment is comfortable and full of history and character. We’d definitely stay here again.

Alexis apartment is beautiful and the view from the balcony is great. The location is excellent close to shopping, good restaurants, and many tourist attractions. The communication with Alexis was very easy and helpful and he responded very quickly. I would stay his apartment again if I visit Paris.

Great location! We were able to walk to all major tourist attractions without even needing to take the metro. Apartment had everything we needed for an affordable price relative to hotels in the same location. Sofa bed was comfortable, shower was hot, Internet was a good speed, heater controls for the room were provided, tea and coffee were provided. The space is small, but it was comfortable for the 2 of us spending most of our time out and about. Team (and it really was a team!) operating the rental was super responsive and very helpful. We would be very happy to stay again.
The house was located near train station so it was easy to go anywhere from here. The host was really nice, helpful and responsive

My partner and I felt right at home and very comfortable in this Airbnb! It was clean and had beautiful art decorations. The location is very close to anything you need: metro stops, cafes, restaurants, and a grocery store. Cristina worked with our travel plans and accommodated our check-in time.

Florence and Antoine were great hosts very helpful and understanding. Place was walking distance to many beautiful places . And studio was just prefect size just to relax and sleep. Definitely will recommend this place. Thanks again for your hospitality.

The apartment was beautiful in amazing location. Gabriel was such a pleasant host to work with. The only difficulty was no hot water during our 4 nights day. Which made it very inconvenient. We hope to stay here again once that issue is fox because we love the ambiance.

Louise was absolutely fantastic! The space is in a perfect location with great restaurants right outside and the beautiful gardens at the end of the street. The space is great for 2 people and well equipped.

Henri’s apartment is in a fantastic location and within walking distance to amazing restaurants and shopping as well as many attractions. Metro is very close so it’s incredibly easy to get around. Great instructions from Henri at meeting and he also provided good tips to kick off our stay which was really helpful. The fold or sofa was very comfortable and he may just have the softest, fluffiest towels ever! I would definitely recommend - good value for money.
Delphine was very nice and friendly. She made me feel right at home. The location was also very easy to move around.
Very nice place, the host was fast to respond for a last minute reservation. Cheaper than most hotels in Paris and even better in quality! You won’t be disappointed!!

This quaint apartment is in a wonderful location. It is steps from the metro, walkable to the major site seeing wonders, awesome little shops to get lost in and delicious pubs and restaurants to enjoy the *chefs kiss* of yummy food! There is everything you need to rest your head before taking off and exploring Paris. Bonus ~ Jean Philippe is so communicative, accommodating, and helpful. You can tell he wants to make sure you enjoy your time.
Totally recommended for a solo trip! Katherin will make you feel at home, greet you with her awesome pets and even bake you a delicious cake. I would come back without hesitation
The listing was incredible, have no complaints and would def stay there again. The stairs were daunting lol only thing.

Beautiful, modern apartment in a lively area of Paris. Bedroom and facilities are great - comfortable bed and an amazing shower. Jean-Michel is a great host and was very helpful with any questions we had. Fantastic location, we loved walking around the city from this area but it’s very close to public transport as well. Would happily stay here on every visit to Paris.

We had a great stay at Jean-Daniel’s apartment. His communication was excellent before and during our stay and he provided clear instructions as well as arranging for his daughter to meet us at the apartment to give us a tour upon arrival. The property is exactly as described and the location is good with bakeries, cafes and a metro station all within a couple of hundred metres.

Really nice place. The location is very good, easy to go everywhere from there, metro station 2min away. Restaurants around and a nice area to stay in Paris. They were really quick to answer any doubt and very kind. Opera is 8min by walk. Great place

Had a fantastic stay as location is great, with the entrance tucked in a quiet spot with plenty of shops, cafes and restaurants steps away. Very responsive hosts with proactive and clear communication. Interior had everything we needed, comfortable and clean space, even the sofa bed! Would 100% return and recommend to friends.

The apartment was great. It was clean and there was plenty of space for the 3 of us. The location was perfect and only a couple of minutes walk to the metro. Brother’s Care were really helpful with instructions in getting to the apartment and were always quick to respond to any questions we had. Couldn’t ask for more really.
Thank you so much for loaning us your beautiful home for our stay in Paris. We definitely had a ball and will be back. Can’t recommend it highly enough. SUPERB

The apartment is in very good location, near metro station. The place itself is very french style, one night there was a party on the floor upstairs so was quite hard to fall asleep, but it’s all part of experience :)
Delphine was super nice and helpful. Here place looks exactly like it's offered. I felt right at home once I entered the apartment. Definitely recommend!
Very nice place in the city centre, all places of interest are within reach of a walk, overall pleasant and convenient accommodation. Thank you for having me!

We all read the reviews to check if the description meets reality. It does here completely. The compact appartement was exactly as described. Key words: attentive host, quiet, clean and fully equipped apartment, excellent neighborhood. All you need for a stay in Paris. As usual in Paris, there is no "outside" like a balcony or garden access. So if that is a key importance, look elsewhere. Otherwise no negatives at all.
A fantastic place to stay in Paris! Very quiet area but super close to all the action. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a modern, clean and comfortable apartment.
Very good and kind communication, easy access to public transport and a very comfortable stay in general. Will be happy to come back!

Stayed here with my wife on our honeymoon. Great location within walking distance to the metro station, as well as the Eiffel Tower and restaurants. The host was very responsive and helpful and the space was nice and clean!
I had to travel to Paris for a week for work and I didn’t really like any of the hotel options. Denka’s apartment was perfect. I wish I could’ve stayed longer.
Responsive host with clear instruction given during the stay. Good location where it is near the metro, restaurants and supermarket.

Pierre’s apartment was great to accomodate 2 couples. Location is great, near the Tour Eiffel, very close to the metro station and good bus connections to St Germain boulevard. The neighbourhood is quiet and safe, we had no trouble when walking home at night.

Chloe was fantastic! My wife and I loved the apartment and it was extremely close to everything you could want! Her place was clean, well stocked and in a great location. We will absolutely be using it again!

We would highly recommend Nicolas's bijou charming little place. it had everything we needed and more. Lovely welcoming touches. Nicolas was very responsive to a few questions before we arrived which we appreciated. The metro is 10 seconds from the front door , but the place is quiet and secure. 5;stars
A clean and peaceful studio in a lovely part of Paris. Easy walking to many places but also very close to good Metro station. Detailed directions were a great help as GMaps wasn’t!
Staying at Nadir's apartment felt like being at home, loved everything))) as a matter of fact, I rebooked another week in September as I checked in the first night)))

Nice apartment in very quite street. Close to Metro stations with easy access to all areas Paris. Close to supermarkets and shops and restaurants. Apartment has everything needed. Nice bathroom, hot water all time, well stocked kitchen.

Mandana's apartmwnt is greatly located and very cozy. I was there for three weeks and thoroughly enjoyed my stay. I highly recommend. It is exactly like the pictures. If you are ok with 6th floor no elevator that is the place for you!

This place is a great location have everything that you will need metro is a cross the street grocery store a cross the street Eiffel Tower 10 minutes walking - 3 bathrooms and plenty rooms. They all have their individual ac/heat it was great

Great location, just a block from Notre Dame, 10 minutes from latin quarters I went to Paris to work this time and I appreciate that there are many accessible public transportation services. RER is at 10 minutes walk. Uber also worked well. I recommend the Wri Wri restaurant that is literally next door.

Mao's apartment is a gem! The location is perfect, close to sights, museums, Metro, and restaurants and shops just steps away. And the view of Notre Dame is breathtaking. Mao is a wonderful, responsive, and very friendly host!
Well located close to Sacre Coeur, good communication, cozy flat, very authentic. Bit noisy, which is probably normal in that area. it's really like living at a friend's place.
Really nice Apartement! Stylish as in the pictures and very comfy! 10/10 ✨

The apartment is in a lovely location. It's comfortable and has a functional little kitchen and separate bedroom. It's much smaller than it looks in the photos, but is perfectly fine for 2 people. Keep in mind that the shower area is tiny, so might not work for everybody. Host was responsive when we booked, but didn't respond to questions about checkout procedure, so that was a little confusing, but it worked out!

Fantastic stay in a great location. Only surprise was the height of the ceiling in the upstairs. Absolutely manageable and did not affect our stay however you cannot stand up in the bedrooms so take care not to hit your head! Otherwise a lovely apartment in a great location. Would recommend
Very well located Adrien was extremely helpful There was works around so it was noisy and the outdoor areas were dirty Bedrooms are pretty big and clean

We wanted a place near the metro and the most visited sightseeings in paris. this apartment is perfect for that. A lot of metro stations were in walkable distances which was really convenient. The toilet was not part of the room, but we didn't mind because it was private.
Great place within commutable distance to the main city. the room was big compared to what we heard about paris javing small rooms.
It was all perfect! Nice place to stay for some nights in Paris. It was a pleasure!
great stay, perfect apartment, perfect location. Next to Metro, and close to everything, just get up those 7 flights of stairs :)
Gilbert is very friendly and has a great place,clean and peaceful. He is a great host and will recommend anyone to make use of his place.
Great facilities around the place. Bed was comfortable. Very near the metro. Well equipped apartment. Opposite the supermarket and very close to the cake and bread shop.
Absolutely 5 star experience, Justin was very helpful and responded fast. It was a pleasant stay at this apartment during our stay in Paris, thank you.

This apartment was one of the best Airbnb finds yet! I came with group of five women and we got to live out best Parisian lives. Incredible location, stunning interiors, amazing light, in a beautiful building. JN was extremely responsive and accommodated an early check in, for which we were very grateful. The apartment does have a few quirks, like a slow to drain shower, and guests are responsible for their own toilet paper, etc. But overall, the charm of the apartment outweighs these little things. You won’t be disappointed with your stay here!
Stayed 1 night at Gilbert's place. The room is even better than it looks in the pictures. From your room you can directly access the bathroom. Gilbert is very friendly and helpful.
Alex was a very responsive host that tried to assist with all of our enquires as much as possible.

Large space, friendly and attentive hostess. the sofa bed very comfortable. The only bad thing is that you can hear everything that happens outside but at night it is a quiet neighborhood so there were no problems sleeping
Super cute apartment. Very close to the 7th arrondissement which made it easy to go to classic tourist attractions as well as other ones throughout the city. Plenty of room for my partner and I.

Lovely apartment and fantastic area to explore Paris. Felt very safe and very easy to walk everywhere. Neighbourhood full of wonderful restaurants, bakeries and shops so everything nearby. Apartment was very well serviced with nice coffee machine and everything you need. Bed very comfortable and bathroom and shower excellent. Overall a really enjoyable stay. Only thing I was not aware of is that you need to pay a late fee in you arrive after 19.00 so worth reading the house rules carefully.

It was a great place. And host was very friendly and nice. When i have a questions about the house, he answered it very quickly and solved the problem. Thank you for that. It is conveniently located. I totally recommend this place.

The location was great for the event I was attending at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles - only one Metro stop away. It is a very nice neighborhood, with a street market several times per week, and a carousel at the Metro station (Convention). The apartment was very comfortable - I wish I could have spent more time enjoying its tranquility. Nice deep bathtub :)
Such a sweet place, and sweet people! We mainly kept to ourselves, but Monique and her husband were always nice and very responsive/open!

Location was great for the 4 of Us. Close to Metro, River, Notre Dame. Great local Restaurants. Flat was a little small for 4 Adults, but it was fine for 2 Adults and 2 Teenagers. I would book this again.
Alexis is a fantastic host - going above and beyond to make our stay phenomenal. I felt right at home and would recommend his beautiful apartment to anyone looking for an at-home and luxurious stay.
Great stay in Paris! Very walkable to so many attractions & restaurants. Awesome view as well. Get your workout going up those steps!

This is a really nice place. Location is very good. Safe neighborhood and quiet. It is near Champ Elysees. Room is very comfortable and clean. Catherleen (the owner) is very friendly and helpful (one example: She let me check-in early). I recommend this place.
Really happy with Katleen and her place. She’s a great host, replies quickly, makes you feel like home and the place is really quiet and the bed is comfortable.

Hélène and her husband are really helpful and kind. Their home is beautiful and well ubicated (is less than five minutes walking from the subway). The room is more than perfect, is clean and cozy. I love my stay ❤️
Everything was great, but I'm not sure if they mentioned that they have 2 bathrooms but only one toilet I think it's important to know that they have only one toilet
The apartment and its views were superb - a really great place to spend a few days exploring Paris.
Great location. Close to all the tourist spots. Train stations, needed for travel, are close by. Host is very responsive.
She responses quickly and she is so kind. Easy to Communicate. I know 18th arrondisment is not the best option in paris but wasn't that bad. havent had any problems.

This apartment is beautiful, spacious, clean, and in the center it all. It's flooded with natural light and comes with views of Paris that are stunning and picturesque — exactly what you want. The host could not have been more generous, accommodating, and responsive every step of the way. 10 out of 10 stars. I hope to stay here again next time I'm in the city.
Perfect place to be. Central and cozy. Clean and modern. Great hosts and service by Olga and her husband.

Great place! Olivier is a fantastic host, always responsive and ready to help. The place was very clean and cosy. The neighborhood is very quiet. I enjoyed my stay and would recommend it to everyone who is visiting Paris :)

David’s place was very clean and had a sliding section to give privacy between the two beds which was very nice. The place is close to public transportation and is also walkable to the arc and Eiffel. Had a great week and would recommend to stay here!

Yann’s apartment was really nice with everything you could need and at a very affordable price for the location. The Sacre Coeur was just 3mins away from the flat and there is a supermarket just next to the flat. The flat was tidy and nicely decorated. We had an incident with the key but Yann answered immediately to the messages and everything was solved within 30 mins. I will come back and I really recommend this studio.
