Alexis was a great host! He went above and beyond helping me out with a few things I was needing before my arrival. The property was immaculately clean and aesthetically amazing and very functional for our stay. We loved it!

Highly recommend. Great location. Very walkable to the Eiffel Tower, restaurants, shopping, a river, and several metro stations. The apartment was very clean and well stocked. The grocery store downstairs is very convenient. The location was very quiet and we felt safe there. We will stay there again on our next trip to Paris.

My wife and I stayed here for 4 days and 3 nights. We were welcomed to the apartment by Sheraaz mum who was lovely and showed us around. There was lots of welcoming snacks which was great 👍 after our flight. The apartment is small however you have everything you need for the stay, Sheraaz has thought of everything. Nice hot shower was great after a day of walking. Location is great with a supermarket close by, plenty of restaurants and the tram and Subway so close. The only one slight drawback was the sofa bed. We didn’t find it very comfortable however this may be personal preference due to having a firm bed at home. It definitely didn’t spoil our trip however a firmer mattress would have been perfect 👍

Enjoyed my stay at Lou’s. Great location within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower and close to the metro, yet peaceful. Note that there is a cat and as a result it makes a mess at times, but it’s tolerable if you’re used to pets.

Amazing host, great place with a lot of personality! Perfect for a quick business trip or short stay. Very close to restaurants, a supermarket, the train station, and more. Would recommend and stay again!
Lovely place, very nice restaurants close by. Parking close by as well if you are driving.

I stayed at David's with my sister. It was an amazing stay, in the private and luxurious 16th. The place matched the description and the host was beyond clear, proactive, and responsive when it came to communication. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay in. Very nice apartment in a beautiful Parisian building. Responsive and very accommodating host. The apartment is also very beautiful and well decorated, all amenities are there!

This apartment was PERFECT for my solo trip to Paris! Located in a wonderful neighbourhood, surrounded by cafés, grocery stores, restaurants, tourist attractions, and so much more. in the heart of Paris it felt so authentic and so much like HOME that I will definitely be choosing this listing again for my future stays in Paris! Thank you again!!
Perfect spot and a great location. Accommodations were so comfortable. Easy to access all sites in Paris. Definitely recommending to others.

Sophie is amazing host, super friendly and kind. Her apartment is one of the best I've ever stay in Paris. It's huge, extremely clean and very very French. Looks exactly the same like on the photos. I will definitely would love to come back!
Great location, super cute apartment. We enjoyed our stay a lot. Tony was very quick to respond and ver helpful.
I enjoyed my stay here. The lack of Wi-Fi was unfortunate, but the flat is otherwise lovely and well located.

I don’t know how helpful of a review this is because I actually didn’t end up sleeping there BUT the place was so easy to find, clean, perfect sized single room with everything you’d need, comfortable etc. The people working there were very kind and welcoming. I wish I had more time in Montmartre to explore but I was able to walk everywhere. Great location + right next to the moulin rouge! :) Hope to be back!

Miri is a fantastic proactive host who welcomed me personally. If there's a problem you can be sure she is working hard on a solution. The studio is indeed very small but the furnishing is very functional. The only issue for me was the insulation, which-even considering the low standards of Paris -is quite bad.....making me listen to the couple's next door conversation over the sound of my TV which is.... actually very thoughtful of Miri as a landlady in a house with many parties.... limited to a low volume. It is mentioned that all in all this is a nice place to study....well...the desk is a tiny outdoor/ balcony table .... so don't bring any books...other than that ... I liked my short stay!!!

Really great location near line 4 metro. There is a good pizza restaurant (La Calypsia) with friendly workers and free delivery just a block away. A pretty square with a very busy and fun bar/cafe is in front of the metro stop. We were able to find a street parking spot very close to the front door of the home. Very spacious home with plenty of room for our family of 4 children and mother in law. The home is old and full of character! We were there in the winter but can imagine the ivy and garden are very pretty in the spring and summer! A bit low quality and very worn furniture and finishings for the price but this is outweighed by the location close to the metro and large space of the home. Overall we thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

Overall, I had an amazing stay! It is in a great location and many of the must see spots in Paris are easily accessible. Brijid is an amazing host and is very responsive. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a cozy space in a great location.

My friends and I had a lovely stay in Ilana’s apartment. It is set in a great part of the city with a good selection of local spots for food and drink. The apartment is nicely finished, clean and very quiet. Ilana was a great host - responding to queries very promptly and being a very accommodating host. Thanks so much for a great stay and making our weekend in Paris a memorable one.

Beautiful apartment right at the heart of Paris. Easy to walk to anywhere and have amazing restaurants nearby. The whole place was well-decorated, clean, and had everything you need. You would be pleasantly surprised by the beautiful view from terrace. Alexis was a wonderful host, he gave us great local suggestions and this stay made a difference to our long weekend in Paris.
Venus and Magali are prompt to answer and super friendly, the place has everything you need as a foreigner:)

We had a wonderful time at this place. It's in the center of Paris! Right in front of Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris, surrounded by all kinds of exciting places, and in a walking distance for lots of Paris attractions.

Excellent stay! It was very close to great restaurants and we were in a central location. It was clean and the pictures matched the description!! The only thing that was missing was laundry detergent. We will be back!

I had a great time at Delphine’s. She was warm, welcoming, helpful and approachable, and her place is in an excellent location close to the 12 Metro Line. Would definitely stay again next time I am in Paris!
Great place for a few days stay in central Paris. Small, but has everything you need! Easy to find and instructions all clear. Joan and Sophie were very helpful.

Henry was very responsive and Bernard was extremely helpful. They were very accommodating with our travel plans and any changes that occurred, which made for a wonderful start to our trip as we had a flight change. The apartment is located within minutes of the Eiffel Tower and there were plenty of restaurants within short walking distance. We really enjoyed our stay, and the view doesn’t get old!

Delphine was an accommodating and supportive host, had a great stay; strongly recommended . situated in a rear building you do not have the noise from the street, you look into a friendly courtyard with industry-style lofts you would never expect there

Thanks for this apartment, it’s really good. All furniture are clear, including bathroom. And location is fine, I mean bakery, supermarket, metro station, some sightseeing all is near, just a few minutes from apartment. For sure, I will stay here again next time! Je recommande :)
We enjoyed our stay very much! Great location and cute apartment. Stephane was also very helpful.

One of the highlights of this trip to Paris was this apartment! Anne and Jean Luc were so thoughtful in filling their home with lots of goodies for us to use and making arrangements at a local restaurant for us! It was just a lovely stay!
very responsive host and great for local recommendations! the place was lovely and just as described in a very central location near lots of amenities ☺️

Host was very responsive and helpful. The apartment is the size of a hotel room and is not suitable for more than one person. If you are a light sleeper, I would bring something to block the noise as there is no TV. Altogether, a great place, right next door to the train station and 30 minute walk to just about everything in Paris.
Wonderful location, nice flat, comfortable for 2, max 3 people. Checkout was not very flexible and was quite confusing but otherwise it was a great stay

Helene is a wonderful host, along with Alaine I had a lovely stay and lots of great conversation to practice my French. Helene is a great communicator and is very accommodating offering ideas and helping out with planning activities. it was all around a delightful experience. The location is excellent, metro, restaurants and shops all very close. The accommodation is comfortable and has everything you need. I did really enjoy my few days there and would love to go back.

We had a wonderful stay as a family of four. We found the apartment very conveniently located and walkable. It was safe, clean, and updated. We liked having the two showers. We would absolutely stay again when we are in Paris. It was just perfect.
This apartment is wonderful to spend a short period of time. We had a great time watching the Tour Eiffel from the windows and the kitchen.

Great apartment in a perfect location! Pictures and description are 100%, the place was very clean and comfy. Very friendly host, it was a pleasure to visit this place. Check-in was easy and we could even arrive earlier than it was mentioned. Thanks Paul 👍!

The Nation area of Paris where this apt is located is a great area. The subway, bakeries, pubs, 24-hour grocery, and laundromat are all within a 5 minute walk of the building's front door. The downside is, the listing is not quite accurate in that the kitchen cooktop does not work, there is NO washer, and there is NO shower curtain to confine the water to the bath tub. There were NO wash cloths and the fan that was listed was unusable because the plug would not work in the France power system. We bought an adapter to make it usable. We did not call or email the host about these issues because they had already been discussed in some previous reviews, and as we were on a vacation, we tried to stay in a positive frame of mind.
I found Happy a very good host. I enjoyed my stay and felt we rubbed along well. I will definitely consider visiting again. Catherine Gilbertson

A very small place* that was perfect for our stay, halfway between where our son lives and the tourist parts of the city. Ben was very responsive when we once had a problem, and he’s a great concierge as well, with many recommendations for food, art, and architecture. Very heartily recommended. *(which gets larger when the Murphy bed is put up in the morning)

The ground floor-room is adjacent to the garbage room of the building. As a result, there is some noise when others throw their garbage away. The location is good if you need to work around Gare du Nord.

We had a lovely experience at the flat. The location is perfect, close to metro and bus stops and nice restaurants. The sofa bed is very comfortable and we slept very well each night. The apartment is quite small but very functional and great for a one person/two person short - weekend stay!
Paul's place is accessible and there's no stairs to the apartment which is great if you have heavy luggages. The apartment is also near a few metro stations.
Alex’s listening are great! This was my second time staying in one of his apartments and it never disappoints. If you enjoy walking, everything is walking distance.
Fantastic Air BnB if you’re looking to stay in Paris. The location is great for sight seeing. The apartment was spotless and the shower was sweet. Would highly recommend!

Location is everything! About a 15 min walk to the Eiffel Tower, restaurants right around the corner and metro across the street. Patrick was there to greet us and let us check in early. They are very responsive when I had questions. Mahalo for the good experience and will stay again next time!
Really nice place, 20 min walking to Eiffel Tower, a lot of restaurants around the area and Guy was just awesome! Definitely will come back, thank you Guy for your hospitality :)

The place was how it is shown. However the room got extremely cold at night, even under a big blanket I was shivering. The place was also not in a great side of town. I went to two restaurants nearby and the staff both warned me (a young female) to be careful as it “was not a great/safe side of the city”. However, the host Johnathan was great. Very responsive host.

Had an excellent stay while in Paris. The location and amenities were everything we needed and for the price, the space was so much better than staying in a hotel. Everyone in our group agreed that if/when we return to Paris we would certainly stay here again!
Had a lovely stay at Henry’s place. Bernard greeted us and was very friendly and helpful. The apartment is great… perfect for 2 people. Thank you for providing coffee !!!! Delicious!!

We had an incredible time at this lovely home. Ju was so responsive, kind and friendly. They had everything we needed, and in fact, this airbnb far exceeded our expectations. It is very large and the two bathrooms are wonderful. We all agreed that our family of four could easily live in the apartment. Thank you Ju and Ch.

It is a good place to stay, room is clean and the host is nice and helpful. Supermarket locates just in front of the room, metro station is very close by. Few things to mention: 1. The first day we have a very noisy neighbor having party until 2AM, the room is not soundproof enough so it is a bit disturbing. 2. Heading to airport or the main tourist attraction takes at least 40 mins
Really nice space and in a good spot, Sabine was really responsive and helpful. The water for the shower was hit or miss, sometimes hot and sometimes cold. I overall recommend it!

Our stay at Marianna’s place was amazing. The apparent looks just like in the pictures. The best part, besides the large windows, was the beautiful terrace. The communication with Marianna was also very good. I would highly recommend to stay here!
So enjoyed this spot. Christina was so helpful and the apartment was just lovely. A lovey retreat.

This place matched the description well and Kathleen is a very personable host! Great location that is 30min-1hr walk to most of the sites. The two cats and dog are super cute. Would not recommend planning to use high speed wifi while here (ex: emails, Teams calls) - but hopefully you’re visiting Paris to get out and about anyways!

Hugues’s place is an amazing value for the location and the comfort of the apartment. It’s amazing how a small space can be so functional! He also has great taste and the place is nicely decorated, making it feel warm and inviting. We were lucky to meet Hugues when we checked in and he was super friendly and welcoming. A very peaceful oasis off the bustling streets of Paris!
Charming and spacious place next to a beautiful park and vibrant neighborhood - would definitely stay here again!
Good apartment! Only have problems on the key box, cause the password need to change every time but didn’t even let us know
Nice place, very nice owner with a nice friendly smile that's all anyone could need from a host 👍

Brigid’s place was very comfortable for the three of us. The bed was comfortable and there was a fold out couch for our son. The flat was very clean and well maintained. There are shops and restaurants within walking distance, and a Metro stop was very close by. Brijid was very responsive to our questions and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay! Thank you Brijid.
Location in relation to sights of Paris is great. Lots of things to do and see within walking distance.

The apartment is very nice and clean, provided with towels, slippers (like in hotels), coffe and tools for cooking. the location is perfect to visit Paris, you can go everywhere walking. The area around the apartment is wonderful and full of restaurants and bars. Josephine and Nicolas are always helpful and kind. totally recommended!

We found Marie’s place as per the description and previous reviews. The noise from neighbours, the street, the school and even builders in the unit next door was not bothersome, in fact it was was extremely quiet at night. Well fitted out and comfortable.

I wish I could give this place more than 5 stars. The location was ideal, we walked to the Louvre, the d’Orsay, the Latin Quarter and the metro was also just a few steps away. Denis was a fantastic host, he treated us like family. He checked on us to make sure we didn’t have issues getting in, he made a video to show how to use the washing machine, he provided everything we could possibly need. The place was perfect for two people. We had a great time and I would love to visit again.
Jordan is a gracious and helpful host. He made my entire stay stress free. Perfect for a solo traveler and a fantastic location.

Studio is in a calm and safe neighbourhood with lots of bakaries to get a morning treat. The Eiffel tower is a short walk away - will be visible when walking around both in the evening and day. All the main objects are also in the walkable distance which is a big benefit. The studio is small as you can see from the pictures but very clean. Anna is very friendly and helpful!
It is a wonderful apartment in a great location. Walkable to many of Paris's attractions and close to the metro. Eric and Laure were responsive and flexible. I would stay here again.

Simple, nice apartments. Very quit and good price for what you get. Montmartre is a very nice neighbourhood with many Restaurants. Claude welcomed us very friendly and gave us many tips (and they are also documented so that we could always look them up). It was great that we could leave our luggage in the apartment already at 1pm.

We had a wonderful experience during our stay, Jean was an amazing host! This Airbnb is perfect for two. The location is great; you can easily catch the metro or bus, less than a block away. As soon as you walk out of the apartment complex, you have all kinds of cafes/restaurants to choose from. We had no issues getting in and out of the unit during our stay. It is pretty quiet building, and the neighbors we interacted with were extremely nice. Thank you for everything, Jean!

This place is a great location for exploring Paris. It is perfect because the metro is so close. It was very quiet at night and a great place to sleep after a long day sightseeing. I would absolutely book this place again for a sight seeing holiday where you are out and about because it is quite compact so not somewhere to spend all your time. Bed was comfy. There was a hair dryer and towels. Thomas came and met us at the start and was very helpful with helping us get settled in. We felt extremely safe and secure in the apartment building as we are a mum and daughter travelling around.
Very convenient location close to Paris attractions, the room is everything I needed for a short stay. Jordan was wonderful and helpful.

Great location, close to all the many attractions. The apartment was perfectly cleaned, I was surprised that we could not hear the neighbors. All the necessary household appliances for living with a small child are available, this was an important moment, since we arrived with a 5 month old baby. The owner was very quick to respond to our questions. Only positive and pleasant impressions remained.
Great location. Lots of stairs but we didn’t mind this. Loud nightlife but again we didn’t mind. No shower, just a bath.
Fantastic stay at Bruno’s place. Beautiful location and great view. Bruno was very responsive and gave clear instructions throughout our stay. Highly recommend!

The apartment is located in a quiet street, about 3 minutes walking distance is a metro-station, but also restaurants, shops, cafes. The apartment is super clean, got everything you need (even coffee and tea). Safe location, nice neighbours. 100% recommend.
Clean and convenient. Good location. Host is always available to help you. Parking space is right in front of the door. There was one suggestion to the host and the host corrected it immediately.

Outstanding: one small issue with towels on arrival (we had only been left 2 towels) but this was rectified within an hour so no problem at all. Really excellent customer service, incredible location and a real gem. We were 3 generations on a city break and it was just perfect. We also used the car service from the airport using the link provided and this was also first class. Thank you so much. Elizabeth
My family loved the apartment and location. The apartment is very well located and as beautiful as described. Dominique is lovely and very kind. I recommend her Apartment.

This Airbnb is in a prime location for exploring Paris. It's really close to a Metro stop and literally one block from the Seine river. The apartment itself is really cute, very clean and spacious. Highly recommend!

Great value, nice cosy room. Not much space but you don’t need more if you’re out all day exploring the city. Didn’t get the chance to use the kitchen/common area as we weren’t cooking anything. The instructions for check-in were very detailed. I totally recommend Agnes!

Convenient quirky place but quiet at bed time. So many restaurants around and a few supermarkets to choose from. The fishmonger at the end of the road is not to be missed. The kitchen is tiny but functions well. There was even a mini food processor!
Elsa was an amazing hostess!!! The place was spotless and well located, only 4 minutes walk to public transport, restaurants and supermarket.

Our family had a wonderful time staying here for a four day weekend. Great views from the floor to ceiling windows in the living room/dining room - really spectacular. Large apartment, very comfortable for our family of 4, huge master bath. Nice location as a central launch point for site seeing.

Guillaume was an excellent, communicative host. The apartment shows the wear and tear of someone’s own home, and could use some care, but it is very well equipped, extremely well located, and looks like in the photos. There is occasional noise from neighbors (upstairs and through the walls) but that’s urban living. Thanks, Guillaume, for a nice stay.
We had such a lovely stay at Phillipe and Marie’s apartment in Montmarte! Cannot recommend highly enough

Christophe was super attentive. He made sure we were clear on how to gain access and checked in after our arrival. Unit is lovely and sitting on the balcony overlooking Boulevard Raspail was a treat. We would definitely come back.

The apartment itself is very cute and was perfect for me as one person. It was clean and had everything needed. And Alex was a very good host, very fast with texting back, very friendly. Can really recommend! Best, Jannis

Absolutely beautiful apartment! Pascale is a most gracious host who lives in the property most of the time so it is well equipped with amazing decor. We were pleasantly suprised by the peaceful sunlit balcony, a great spot to eat breakfast. Overall, a great respite after long days in the city. The location is very close to the metro and a taxi stand with excellent restaurants all within walking distance. Only word of warning is there are many glass decorations so do not recommend this for families with young children.
It's the perfect place to stay in Paris, especially with family. Close to the subway stations and bus stops. A very clean bathroom and kitchen. We had a great time in this place. Thank you 😊

Anne is hands down the greatest hostess. We were warmly welcomed, in person, with open arms, champagne, fresh roses and macarons. Her apartment was super clean, airy, inviting and beautifully decorated. With the Maubert market and metro stop on the corner, the amazing Erik Kayser boulangerie around the corner, and the Pantheon up the street, the location can't be beat. My husband also loved the elevator. 😘 Thank you, Anne for the loveliest stay.
Frederic He is very friendly and helpful makes you feel extremly welcome His apartment is close to the action

Loved this location! Extremely easy to walk or grab a car to where we needed to go. Within walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and great restaurants. The hosts were super responsive and had great local recommendations, as well as instructions for how to get into the property. We were a group of 5 and the location comfortably fit us all both for sleeping arrangements and for hanging out during the day. Would recommend to anyone visiting Paris and wanting to stay in the heart of it all.
Delphine made me feel at home and was very responsive. I recommend that you stay here.
Liliana is a great host, very responsive and friendly! The apartment was nice and well equipped.

Staying at Elsa’s home was great! Very well located and easy to reach. The owner was super helpful and very friendly. We were there for 5 days with my family and it was super. I would recommend it even more if you are in a couple, very cosy and great also for home office. New refurbished home in a very historic area. 5* easily for the host and the house!

I love how close his place is to the metro, it was convenient for us to travel around the city. The apartment unit is a bit tight for 4 people but we make do with it. I love how modern the decor on the inside with clean kitchen and bathroom. Overall we had a great stay here.

Me and my family had a well-rested stay in Paris after coming from Brittany on our way back to Luxembourg. We especially enjoy Belleville for it being colourful, multicultural and kid-friendly. The host was lovely and super reactive. The flat itself a tad small with two kids but very, very clean.

I am incredibly happy with the apartment, it is really quiet, clean and comfortable and felt very secure. Small but perfectly formed - all the furniture is really good quality and nice linens! Excellent value and Ben, the host, is very friendly and helpful, responding very quickly with regards to check in etc. The area is good too with lots of restaurants, boulangeries, bars and excellent transport links too. I couldn't be happier with my choice to stay here.

If you're hoping for a quiet little place to call your own in the heart of Paris Catherine's apartment is just for you. Close to everything you could hope for the apartment has a great view of the river, metro access, and everything you would need inside of it. On top of that Catherine is incredibly kind and communicative throughout the whole process if you need anything. Highly recommend.

Brijid’s place was great for our sort getaway! Great location, beautiful restaurants and cafes in a walking distance, very close to the city center either by metro or by foot. Clean place with all the amenities we expected, very friendly and attentive stuff! We would totally stay again!! Thank you Brijid for the great stay!

We had a great stay! The apartment was perfect for my husband and I. We were able to walk all over Paris and see the sights we were most excited about. Anna was a great communicator. Should we return to Paris in the future we would definitely stay here again.
Perfect for a jaunt into Paris, two metro lines close by and wonderful security. Loved every minute here, thank you Katia!

Laurent was a very responsive host with clear instructions to get into the apartment. Apartment was clean and the location is very peaceful although close to city centre and Eiffel Tower. Easy access to city via metro or bus.

Great little spot in an exceptional area in Paris. Close to many cafes, boulangeries, and shops. If you hate taking the stairs, look elsewhere - but if you’re willing to do a little leg work, the view is worth it.

Stephane and Sophie were very helpful and quick to respond. Kitchen was very well equipped. Sofa bed was easy to operate and very comfortable. We would definitely book again if/when we return to Paris.

Overall my experience was great. Host was helpful and responsive. It was my first time in Paris and I felt very safe in the area. The place is a bit small, but it worked out fine for my friend and I. Lot of restaurants nearby and shopping was walking distance.
Irfaan’s place is an unbeatable value. It is as small as it looks, but not a problem for 2 people for a few days. Make showers speedy as hot water can run out rather quickly. Great location!

Nice area, good connected to the city center and to the many places that are worth to visit. The appartment has 3 floors, what could be inconvinient for some people. You need to be aware that the next day you will need to buy basic higiene staff. When we arrived there was only one toilette paper, one small shower gel (hotel size) that was enough for the shower of one of us. The kitchen had dishwasher anf also a washmaschine and tumble.

Flaviens flat is really nice and perfect for exploring the city. The metro station next to the flat makes the transportation really easy. Flavien was very helpful all the time and the flat was clean and in a good condition. We really recommend Flavien as a host.

Arnaud sent us a guest guide ahead of our stay and because of the key safe we could arrive and leave independently. Whilst we were in Paris Arnaud was super responsive, when we had a question. The beds are very comfortable and there was spare bedding for the sofa bed. I loved that there were 2 bathrooms, which is very unusual in Paris. It is a little bit strange that you can’t open a window but there is ventilation which ensures that the air doesn’t get stale. We absolutely loved the area. Restaurants and bistros around the corner and a lovely bakery with the best chocolatine in the road. Just a 10 minute walk from the arc de triumph and metro and bus less than 5 minutes walk away. I highly recommend Arnaud‘s apartment for a couples weekend.
Fabulous apartment in a central (but quiet) location in central Paris. Tugdual was a great host, attentive, friendly & helpful. I’d definitely recommend to others
Wonderful location and a very kind host! I traveled with my three year old so she was so happy to have a special room for her

I really enjoyed the Apartment. Everything was as described and Anna was very helpful with instructions. The place was clean and had a nice kitchenette as well as a Coffeemaker. The elevator and shower are very tiny, but that is also very Parisian. I can recommend the apartment.

A very cosy place for a family with a well equiped facilities. There is a metro station just right opposite of the building which is easy for tourist to travel to other places. Highly recommend for a family or a small group of people.
My family and I went to Paris and stay here. We loved it! Very comfortable, the neighborhood was great and near Eiffel Tower. I recommend it

Guillaume was a fantastic host. The apartment is quite unusual as a part of one of the oldest buildings in Paris. The bedrooms were completely comfortable downstairs amongst the old stone. The kitchen was modern and fully equipped. The location is unbeatable. Guillaume was super nice and asked if we were doing ok when we saw him in the neighborhood. I highly recommend Guillaume’s place - super easy communication and the best location.
Very clean, modern. Only exception was the toilet in a separate closet. More stairs than what I’m used to! 😂 Otherwise very beautiful and a great location.

This was our first stay in Paris and we found the apartment to be incredible! Exactly as described and easy to navigate. Eric was very responsive both before and during our stay. There are lots of great food choices and local food shops nearby. Metro is just up the street so it was easy to get around the city. I would recommend this flat to anyone traveling to Paris.

The sofa will kill your back. It’s the only aspect of this flat I would change, but would change urgently. The sofa is so hard it is impossible to sleep there. We had to leave 2 days before because we couldn’t rest well at all. And although I wasn’t expecting Sabrine to go and buy another one right away, when I wrote to her to let her know we could’t sleep well, she didn’t even say “I’m sorry to hear so”. She just replied “Ok”.
We enjoyed our late April 2023 stay. Location was perfect, near everything yet halfway down a very quite street. Will look to book again soon.
Clean and quiet. Perfect for a couple of nights. Perfect for the solo traveler. Centrally located and responsive host. Alex was very sweet. Great stay ✨

Elise, Sebastien and Jean are lovely friendly hosts. Their apartment is a stylish home from home in a great location. Always responsive and so many local recommendations. We absolutely loved Cafe Foufou, had the best breakfast and then we went back for coffee and cake several times. We couldn’t have asked for more, highly recommend staying here. Big thank you to you all.
A great stay at a great apartment! If you are looking for a super walkable and great for staying in apartment to share with another couple, this is it.

Venus was very communicative. The place is small…. But the pictures show that! We did not come to Paris to stay in an apartment, but to explore this beautiful city! It was exactly what we were looking for! The elevator was such a bonus after walking all day. Thank you!!!!!!
overall a clean place, quiet and good location. would prefer a later checkout or flexibility in storing luggages after check out given next check in only happens at 4pm.

Cedric is a great host who welcomes us like a relative of him. He offers ideal breakfast with daily fresh bread and croissant. He also provides unlimited tea ans coffee which are special products. We stay 5 nights and Cedric clean the room during our stay which is very nice to see at such accomodation. Cedric gives lots of information about Paris and environment that we need. He gives more than typical owner which makes our time goes in harmony.

We had an amazing time in the studio. The communication was very easy and open, his English is very good as well. The apartment is like in the pictures and the location is very nice. The neighborhood gives a local vibe with a lot of bakeries and butcheries. The view doesn’t disappoint and we were able to see a little of the lights of the Eifel tower at night. I can highly recommend our very nice host family and their beautiful apartment!
Aude’s place is very convenient and she is always reply our message very quickly. Great place for us three girls, and loving her Chinese decors!
We had a nice stay! The appartment was as described. Safe location and even if it is not in the center, there are several metro lines close! Ana is kind as she approved a late check out!

Staying with Pierre was great. Made me feel welcome from the firsts minutes. On top of the amenities and grocery shopping you can do to cook in the kitchen, the 360° view of Paris on the rooftop is stunning. The build of the appartement is neat and well arranged. Looking forward to another stay. Thanks Pierre !

Great stay right in the center of Paris at walking distance from the Louvre. Very private, safe and quiet apartment. It was clean and welcoming. Jean Luc was very helpful and responsive. The only negative was that if you wanted to cook for more than 2 people you were a little short in pans and ustensiles. If you eat out every night it is the perfect place to rent.

We loved staying at Ax’s place. We had a baby and a toddler with us and they loved playing with new (to them) toys. The apartment was beautiful and in a great location for walking around. It was quiet at night which was wonderful.
Mathilde was super sweet and helpful! The place was clean, cozy and near public transport. Was a great stay:)
Sophie and Joan are very approachable hosts. They were always ready to respond when I needed something. And the location is also spot on :)

Would recommend this apartment to anyone who would like to be in the heart of the action in Paris. The great thing about this apartment is that you are close to lots of bars and restaurants but it is very peaceful because the apartment itself is on the 4th floor away from the street so you can sleep soundly. The apartment itself is clean and matches it's description. As a host, Jean-Francois was very accomodating to us even with our late check-in. He was very friendly and personable and made me feel right at home. I'd definitely recommend this apartment to anyone looking to stay in Paris.
Tatiana was a great host! The airbnb is walkable and in a great area. When we did have to uber, everything was super close. Loved staying here and can’t wait to come back to Paris soon.

This was the perfect location for our short stay in Paris. We arrived by train from Annecy to Gare de Lyon and it was an easy walk to the flat. Elsa met us with the keys and to show us around. We accessed all the sites either by foot or the Metro wry easily. We had very tasty dinners at both Le Rusti (Italian) and Le Temps des Cerises (French). We would definitely recommended, especially if coming into Gare de Lyon.

We had a wonderful stay at Adrien’s apartment. It was a beautiful space with huge windows (and Greta blackout curtains), a very comfortable bed, nice small kitchen, and great living room with couch. The bathroom was spotless and everything looked brand new. We would absolutely stay here again. Location couldn’t be better! It was also very nice to have a lobby where we could wait for our Uber on the day we left after checking out. There was also a place to leave bags after checkout with was super convenient.
Everything was as in the photos, he even has coffee and basic things for me. LOVED IT
Amazing host! Very accommodating and a very clean place. Very comfortable and easy to navigate public transport nearby. Would definitely recommend!

Elsa's place was excellent!! very stylish and very comfortable. close to a great Boulangery and to the Metro. Felt very safe to walk around at any time, day or night. Elsa and Arnaud were very friendly and helpful. especially, although the building's central heating is turned of at April, they insisted and turned it back on for us Israelis who feel cold at 14°C (10th-13th of May). We would definitely come back!
Great studio apartment that was great for our stay in Paris. Had everything ready and was super clean. Absolutely would stay here again if we were to visit Paris again!

I booked at Jean-Michel's on behalf of my parents - I can only say, communicating with Jean-Michel via airbnb, that he is friendly, proactive and available! The rest of the feedback here below comes from my parents' comments. They were very happy and satisfied about their stay. They appreciated how clean the place was, how it reflected the descriptions and they felt very comfortable since they first arrived. They had complete privacy and the room/apt was in a very calm area. They very much liked the location as well: a few minutes walk from transportations and with all activities/shops one might need.
We had a really nice stay in the flat and enjoyed the centrality of the appartment and its neighbourhood. The kitchen is well equipped and everything was really clean. Loved it!
We really had a wonderful stay at Lisa’s apartment….We were very comfortable,it’s beautiful decorated and felt like we are in our own house…would highly recommend Lisa’s place for the stay in Paris

Had a lovely stay at Tony's apartment! It is probably the best location one can probably ever get in Paris. Right across from Notre Dame, mere steps from Shakespeare & Co. The apartment is so cozy and I loved the view from the window!
Kathleen is a warm and welcoming host. Her appartement is very central and a convenient walking distance to the Metro and all that Paris has to offer.
Marianna’s place is a well located and cosy apartment that was perfect for our visit to Paris. Recommended and would definitely visit again!

Great location, very close to the metro which unlocks the city of Paris. Caroline was very helpful and eager to be of assistance. very accommodating and gave greay recommendations. Honestly couldn't go wrong with any of the restaurants within walkin distances. Apt is on the 5tg floor, no elevator, but honestly wasn't a big deal. Did plenty of walking every day since there are a lot of things within walking distance. Felt very safe in the area at all hours.
It was perfect for a work trip of 4 colleagues. Everyone had a great bedroom. The living room was tidy and spacious. Would definitely go back!

Very small apartment. Would have been beneficial to have instructions on raising the outside window blinds ahead of time. Suggest a small wastebasket in each bedroom. Good location. Walls are quite this and could hear the other tenants quite easily.

We were two people in the apartment and for two people it's fine. It's small but you have the most important things. The best thing is the location. Montmatre is so beautiful! There are so many beautiful restaurants and cafes. Also the communication was easy and fast. the check in and checkout were flexible, we were lucky! All in all we enjoyed it very much!
We enjoyed staying at Dominique's place. Great location! Very elegant decoration! Everything is so thoughtful. It gave us a home feeling. I think the place looks even better than the pictures.

Just a 3 minute walk to the metro station Pasteur. Many surrounding restaurants, markets and cafes within 3-7 min walk. Eiffel Tower less than 30 minute walk. Apartment had 2 shower closets, one bathroom with shower/toilet/tub and additional closet with toilet. Everything was as pictured. Beds were made up per our requests. Quiet neighbors and neighborhood. Our gas stove was not working, single text to the owner went unanswered. There is an elevator in the building. Espresso capsules/pods were available to us. I would stay here again.

Our recent stay at Anne & Jean-Luc’s enchanting Airbnb in Paris's vibrant Latin Quarter surpassed all expectations. From the moment we arrived, our gracious host Anne ensured our experience was nothing short of perfect. Modern amenities enhanced our comfort and convenience. The well-equipped kitchen, including washer, dryer, and dishwasher, exceeded expectations. A living room TV with Netflix and reliable Wi-Fi catered to our entertainment needs. Anne's binder provided captivating insights into family history and the neighborhood. Anne's warm and attentive nature made our stay exceptional. Prompt communication exemplified her care. She greeted us with open arms, champagne, flowers, and delightful croissants, instantly making us feel at home. We look forward to a future visit and will definitely return to this delightful spot!

Location! Location! Location! This incredible place had it all, but most importantly, an absolutely breathtaking location! Our stay was beyond satisfying! We were a group of five ladies on a trip, and this Airbnb had everything we could possibly ask for. With three full bathrooms, three bedrooms, and five beds, it accommodated us perfectly. The living room was spacious, and the kitchen was huge, not to mention the additional living room in the lower area. We never had to worry about running out of hot water, and the temperature inside was always pleasantly cool. Everything about this place was simply flawless! Without a doubt, we will choose to stay here again when we return to Paris.

A nice place to stay for one person in Paris. The room was as described and the location was great. Only feedback is that the bathroom is very small as expected however it did the job well! Thanks again Jordan!

Great location with lots of lovely restaurants. However it was noisy at night. Lots of street noise and the upstairs flat had a party which went on until 4 am so I recommend ear plugs. The flat had been well cleaned, the beds were comfortable and the living room was spacious. The kitchen and bathroom are a bit dated and some of the electric sockets were damaged or loose so are in need of updating. Aurélie was a welcoming and friendly host.
Great apartment, everything is as shown in the listing. Close to many restaurants, bars, the metro and is a 20min walk to Le Marais. Would recommend!
This was a wonderful stay in a good neighborhood. The host was very communicative and the check-in went very easily. I would definitely stay here again.

Highly recommended. Francoise was really helpful and friendly and we appreciated how flexible she was with check in and check out times. She also greeted us with coffee and croissants - just a really nice touch. The apartment was superbly located, clean, and we had a private WC. She gave us many helpful tips on what to see and visit.

Comfortable place with a lovely terrace. One of the best coffee machines I’ve ever used. Flat is compact with everything I needed and the shops are right downstairs. But for me it was all about the terrace.

Henry’s colleague, Bernard, was an excellent host. Very responsive. He allowed us to drop off our luggage early. While he finished cleaning the apartment. Very impressed with his attention to detail. Everything was very clean. He left us a bottle of wine, juice and water. We had a comfortable stay.
Can’t beat the location, but felt it was overpriced for the unit. Toilet down the hall was inconvenient. But otherwise we enjoyed the apartment.

What a treasure this charming apartment is!!! my two adult children, and I absolutely had a blast with enough space for each of us to spread out. Easy access to metro! Great cafes all around as well as other fun little shops and a Monoprix 2 blocks away!! I can’t wait to go back!
The place is well located to reach famous spots around Paris. It's a perfect stay for a couple willing to explore the city.

Accurate to description. Very minimalist but fine. Right on the street, can be a bit noisy, but very close to the metro station and a grocery store. Alex was responding quickly to our messages and other than that we had a good time. Would recommend if you need a place to stay without anything special.
Fab modern flat, really easy to travel everywhere and Adrien is really helpful! Thanks so much again:)

Throughly enjoyed our stay, great location in a safe and quiet neighbourhood. Apartment was clean and exactly as described. Just a few minute walk to the nearest metro. Nice restaurants and wine bars nearby. The self check in was seamless and coded doors made it easy to access. Would recommend for a safe and central stay in Paris.
We had an amazing stay at Marie’s! Comfortable, convenient to everything, very stylishly decorated - we will certainly hope to stay again next time we are in Paris.
The apatment is lovely with green plants and beautiful sculptures. It has everything you need and it is close to a supermarket the metro and places to eat
Lovely big, clean apartment in a great location. Exactly as described and extremely helpful and friendly hosts.

The stay was lovely. Communication and check-in was very easy and the apartment had everything we needed. There were some great bakeries, restaurants and food stores near by & it was very easy to reach by Metro. All in all a good experience 🌱
Awesome location, a lot of places nearby to eat. The room and bathroom were perfect size also very confortable for our stay.
Recommendable for a stay in Paris. Small but cozy. Thank you Anna! We had a very nice stay:)
We loved our stay in Paris! Tony was extremely helpful and responsive, and the apartment was so cute, just as pictured! Loved the neighborhood, also!
I had a lovely stay at Benjamin's apartment. I was there for 45 days for a work trip, and everything was perfect.
We loved our stay here. It was centrally located yet not at all touristy. It was a fun area to explore and a safe place to come home to at night or throughout the day.

Ju & Ch’s place was available after we had to leave another airbnb because dust triggered an asthma attack. It was so nice to be in a lovely and dust free environment, and they were super helpful and responsive.
Great little apartment in a great location. Be aware that there is limited space and could be slightly cramped for 4 travelers with large bags, but overall a really nice space to spend a few days in.

First time in Paris. Bruno greeted me with traditional French pastries. Very thoughtful of him. His place is just perfect for me. The best of all, there is the Eiffel Tower view. Especially when just gets dark, the tower started its light with twinkle. Every night I had to watch its twinkles for a few minutes then enjoy the lights. His place is so walkable to everywhere restaurants, museums, parks, markets. I hope I can get Bruno’s studio again when I come back to Paris.

The apartment is charming and stylish! The fresh air, light, and views in the main living area made it a delightful place to spend a few days. Cristina was very responsive, and Bruno was very welcoming when we arrived.

From the moment we arrived in Paris we felt like guests of Marion. The communication was great. The location was great. The place was great. Our family of 4 really enjoyed our stay and created lasting lifelong memories. Thank you for opening your doors for us.

Wonderful spot - quiet retreat from Paris. Easy to bike and bus to lots of great spots. Check in was easy and Cedric allowed us to keep our bags at his place during the day after check out. Would recommend!

Amira’s place was very clean, modern and tidy! Its close-by to two train stations, which gives fantastic access into central Paris! We were missing a few amenities, but Amira was very helpful and provided them to us! Neighbourhood is quite safe and would recommend overall!

Everything was perfect. The best thing was the host chat response was beyond what you expect at a high end hotel Nothing to do with this place but if you have 2 kids above 2y, get a larger place (700sq ft instead of 400sq ft) if you can :)

The apartment welcomes you to Paris in the best way. The night life is electric and beckons you out. Keep the windows shut if you don't want to participate. Otherwise, enjoy Paris as it was meant to be lived.
Francis is very responsive and helpful host. Everything was as advertised and is presented honestly. Good value for money. Very clean room.
We were able to receive the key and leave the luggage earlier, Vitalina was already waiting for us. A very nice and easy person. We‘d love to come back.

We had a wonderful time. The apartment is well equipped, very clean, and has a fantastic view of Paris. Benoit is a wonderful host, very responsive and hospitable. I highly recommend this apartment, we will be back.
Great apartment, perfect location, with a lot of restaurants and bars nearby. Ideal for fee days in Paris
This was such a charming apartment! We had a wonderful stay and I would definitely stay again. The courtyard right outside was beautiful to wake up to. A lovely stay in Paris!

We loved this place! Highly recommend for couples traveling to Paris. The location is amazing. Host is very kind and responsive. The shower pressure was wonderful! And we felt right at home. 5 stars all the way though!

We stayed two nights in Giovannis place and enjoyed it very much! :) The host gave some recommendations on the area, which is a beautiful area, there is an amazing view on sacre coeur only few meters away from the apartment. Would definitely recommend this!

Our family of 4 had a wonderful stay at Jean-Luc's apartment. It was beautifully decorated, spacious and comfortable. The location was perfect for exploring Paris - just a short walk from the Louvre. We would definitely stay again, and highly recommend it. Thank you, Jean-Luc!

Francine’s apartment was lovely! The location was amazing and a short walk to the Eiffel Tower and many other attractions. She was extremely accommodating and we loved the outdoor space. Thanks again, Francine!
Julien was very charming and helpful. His restaurant recommendation were the best. Thanks again for letting us stay. À bientôt

It was my virst visit to the city. My wife & I stayed here for 3 days. Sophie was extremely friendly, very empathetic and complied to our requests. The kitchen was great, the room was spic and span. Eddy, the Dog, I absolutely grew to adore him, super friendly. Sophie also gave us a lot of recommendations, properly categorized. Couldnt have asked for a better host! 5 stars!

Absolutely awesome location, beautiful surroundings and amazing restaurants near by. Having the windows to open was my favorite part, my family and I just loved drinking wine and watching the city relaxing with the windows open. Check in was super easy as we had someone meet us there so there wasn’t a hint for keys and we absolutely loved how easy it was. We plan on visiting Paris yearly and we can’t wait to stay at loans place again!!

The apartment was very nice and clean. The apartment is on the ground floor and sometimes noisy because a couple of schools are in the neighbourhood. The host was always available for us. I can fully recommend this apartment.
A cute little apartment in a fantastic part of Paris. We would absolutely stay here again. Louise is a great host and communicator.

Everything was great! David and his wife were really kind to explain everything to us very clearly. The place is quite modern and has everything you need for your stay in Paris (washing machine, dryer, kitchen, toiletries, towels, etc.) The area is really near the Eiffel Tour and Champs Élysées (Arc de Triomphe) and it’s also near several metro stations (Iéna, Boissière) and bus stops. It was really enjoyable!

A short but sweet stay at Anne and Jean-Luc’s beautiful apartment. Communicative, friendly hosts; wonderfully located flat; fascinating information booklet. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and hope to return!

Lovely place with in walking distance of local shops and restaurants. The Eiffel Tower was close and other attractions were walkabale or the Metro could be used! Paul was great at responding to messages and made instructions really clear. Overall, a perfect couple of nights in Paris.

Laurent was a great host. He even went out of his way to help us with the washer dryer when we couldn’t figure it out. Easy to access via RER-C. His recommendation of Mathusalem for dinner was excellent!

We had a fantastic stay at Pascale's apartment. There was great communication with easy instructions and updates during our stay. It is a great apartment just as pictures show and in a perfect location as we were going to watch the tennis. Huge park nearby and lots to do in the area. Hope we can come back sometime.

Karine was a great host, very flexible and helpful. We felt fully at home in her beautiful house! Very big, super clean, cozy, great design, I very much enjoyed that it feels like you’re visiting friends at their place and at the same time there is room for our stuff and we can use the whole house. A real gem in the middle of Paris!

The location could not have been more perfect. Loved the area and can’t wait to come back. The flat was lovely with high ceiling, parquet flooring (squeaky but added to the charm), comfortable bed and really quiet considering it is in a lively area. Close to metro and walking distance to Montmartre and Gare du Nord. Loved it!
Superb location. Easy access to everything. Rita was a great host with clear and constant communication. Some great tips on local restaurants and places to visit.

The place is exactly as described - it is nice, comfortable and very up-to-date. The beds were very comfortable, as were the towels and linens. The kitchen is modern and had everything we needed. The location is a busy area, but it wasn't loud with the windows closed, and we appreciated the close proximity to the Metro. Henri met us upon arrival, showed us the apartment and answered questions. Where he really shined was when my daughter got sick and needed to see a doctor. He helped us get this set up through a 24/7 healthcare service, and we had a great experience with the doctor who came to the apartment that night. Henri is easy to communicate with.
İt was so beautiful house. Location was very good. İt was so clean. The host was very understanding and caring.
Great location with easy access to metro. Quiet neighborhood. Apartment was nice. Julia was very nice and responsive.

Location, location, location. You can't beat Tony's place if you want to be near the sites. The Latin Quarter is not the quietest location because it's right in the action, but it's very accessible and close to everything, including several metro stations. Tony was an excellent host and was always responsive to questions. We had a great time at Tony's apartment and we'd highly recommend this Airbnb.

Overall this stay was pleasant. Hughes is very communicative and has very good instructions on getting to the place. It is an inner studio so don’t actually get a true window. But this was a good place to lay our head at night when you are out and about all day and really close to two metro stations.

Cedric and his father made us feel very welcome. Great continental breakfast every morning, good size room with everything we needed and good space if we wanted to seat in the lounge or on the terrace. The option of 2 metro lines meant that we could easily get into central Paris in 25 minutes and no issues returning late at night. Highly recommend the place if you would like to experience non touristic area.
Irfaan was a lovely host! Was super flexible with our check in and very responsive - great area.

This place is worth it! Highly recommended. It’s just far enough that it’s peaceful, yet close enough that access to everything is easy. The apartment is well aquatinted and private. Elsa is an absolute doll. Our family felt right at home and we slept great! Thanks so much. Phil & Leisis

Was a great stay for my Wife and I. The apartment was near the Eiffel Tower and attractions nearby. For me, the apartment was also near Roland Garros for the French Open Tennis. The apartment was comfortable and fully equipped. Also, the internet was super fast.

Good location but would have preferred somewhere more quiet. The flat is very dark with not much ventilation, especially in the bathroom. Beds were okay but could have been more comfortable. No TV but that was not a problem. Expensive for what it is but would recommend to others.

Very comfortable and charming Parisian flat, kitchen very well equipped, great location for access to metro and buses and walk to the Tour Eiffel area and of course Champs Elisées. Only downside is there’s a bar next to the apartment that played loud music until half past midnight or so. Not a problem with the two great patio facing rooms, but a challenge for the room facing the street. Nathalie was a fantastic host, super responsive and caring. Overall I’d recommend it.

The location was ideal to be close to everything. Easy to get too and close to some great restaurants. Loved that when you walked to the corner you could see the top of the Eiffel Tower. Great airbnb!

This place is definitely quiet amongst all of the lively restaurants near by. Walking distance to the train, Louve museum and Seine River. We loved the location! The place was great, just wished we had more than one toilet. But having two showers was great. We didn’t realize there wasn’t a microwave but my husband was in love with the expresso machine. There is a air conditioner in the apartment but it also blows hot air from the back so the place never felt really cool. We managed with the windows open. Overall we had a great time in Paris and would recommend this place to all our friends.

Great apartment. Would like to stay here again. Everything was as expected. Location is quiet, private, and safe. Apartment is well-equipped. Loved the spotless, soft towels and linen. Kitchen facilities are great. Towel rail was a real plus. Mattress is comfortable. Only thing that could be improved are the pillows; would’ve been nice to have at least two each and for them to be softer. Also a sofa in the bedroom instead of two small armchairs would be preferred but we didn’t mind resting on the bed. Thanks for having us!

Beautiful apartment. Fantastic location close to metro, which we used to get there from Gard du Nord station on arrival and to travel to CDG airport on departure. Five of us. Very easy check in. Lovely linens and bedding. Extra comforters. Nice towels with extras. Kitchen small but had everything and we did cook at home several nights. Lovely dining area in front of window. Had an issue with very slow drain in shower and Mathieu was there with plumber next day. Very responsive and friendly. Great notebook with ALL information you could need including emergency numbers, popular sites, shopping, restaurants, transportation, area map. Air conditioning worked well as it started getting a bit warm. Overall felt very well cared for. Nespresso with coffee pods there was a nice touch. Would absolutely stay there again.
We had an awesome stay at Hanne’s place. Gorgeous interior, great location, and super quiet. Close to the park and amenities. Would definitely come back!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Josephine’s apartment! The location is amazing and the building is very secure. Love the triple glazed windows, you can’t hear any of the street noise.
This Airbnb is in a great location! It was a little smaller than we anticipated, but overall it was clean and enough space for a few nights!

Thank you Imen for sharing your beautiful apartment with us. The apartment is clean, it has everything you need for a few days stay. It's nice to rest in it after a day of walking around Paris. The belongings of the residents are well hidden, they do not disturb at all during your stay and there is a lot of space in the apartment. Close to shops, a good bakery and a metro station. Imen is a very helpful host.
this is a beautiful apt with great location!!! we was 7 people fit perfectly for my family.

This air bnb and the host are above and beyond the norm! The apartment is even more spacious than the pictures show, located perfectly for major attractions like the Eiffel Tower, Roland Garros (if you are a tennis fan) and the Boulogne-Billancourt if you enjoy nature and need an outdoor workout or a leisurely stroll! Perfectly placed and perfectly appointed!! The host (Pascale) took the time to personally greet me and ensure that I was familiar with the apartment, appliances and local restaurants and shops for basic amenities for my one-week stay. I was there for the French Open and it was a short and pleasant 5-10 minute walk depending on the entry gate. Pascale was warm, friendly, responsive and was very thoughtful in ensuring a pleasant stay. I have never written a review - but this apartment and the hospitality made me feel compelled to share my experience for future people. You won’t regret it.

Stop looking this is the place to book! Louise’s is incredibly warm and welcoming and great at communicating! The location is truly perfect especially if you are to young girls backpacking! The room is a perfect size for 2 and very sweet with great airflow and a comfortable bed I wouldn’t recommend for those who struggle climbing 🧗‍♂️ causes those steps are steep but make the beautiful loft so unique! Thank you again for such an amazing stay!
Walid is an amazing host, really responsive. Overall a great experience with a great price! Really nice and safe even if you are a woman. With a lots of things to do in the surroundings.
Delphine is delightful and her place is clean and tastefully decorated . From right outside Delphine's street door there are plenty of transport options to get to most parts of Paris.

The apartment is super comfortable for a family of four and in a spectacular location. It is a really cool space with lots of character. Everything you need is steps from the door and Guillaume was wonderfully easy to deal with and responded quickly to communications. The beds are comfortable and the kitchen is well stocked. Would go back for sure!

Amazing apartment in a perfect location. Check in was very easy, and the flat was in pristine condition. It was very hot in Paris and the air conditioning in the apartment was fantastic! Communication with the host was outstanding. Although we only stayed 2 nights, the flat was professionally cleaned on our second day. Will definitely stay here again, and would recommend this flat to any of my friends or family. Thanks again for the fantastic accommodations in Paris!
Clean space, looks exactly like photos. Super convenient location with shops around and super responsive and helpful host!

Rassarin is very easy going. My plane was delayed on arrival into Paris but Rassarin was very accommodating. This AirBNB is in a fabulous location close to trains for easy travel plans around Paris. Simple facilities but everything was there that I needed to make my stay pleasant. Thank you Rassarin for your hospitality during my stay. Donna

Highly recommended Airbnb with incredibly friendly hosts who made me feel right at home. The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and had all the necessary amenities. Their thoughtful gestures and genuine kindness made the stay very nice.

Nice location - close to restaurants but not too noisy. It was easy for us to find a nearby cafe for breakfast and the flat is a 5 minute walk from Abbesses metro. Initially, I couldn’t figure out how to retrieve the key from the lock box so I called and left a message. Jacques called back within 5 minutes and helped out.
Great location, great host and easy to find. Located in the 10th arrondissement, near many boulangeries, restaurants and cafes. Easy metro access too. Wonderful all around.
We had a wonderful stay at Sophie’s place. Excellent location. Sophie met us at check in and was very responsive to questions.

This is a lovely apartment and we loved the location in a quiet courtyard on the ground floor: perfect for a stroll in the Marais and along the banks of the Seine. Host Elsa was exceptionally responsive.

A gorgeous apartment, beautifully decorated and very spacious. Perfectly located with easy access to a number of metro stations on different lines, but also a lovely part of Paris to walk to and from.

Location,location! Gabrielle’s apartment is beautiful and is walkable to anywhere. Close to the Louve, Norte Dame and the metro station. Awesome apartment. The 2 bedrooms and 2 baths were perfect for 2 couples. Bridgette was great at meeting us and showing us everything. The security of the building is very reassuring and safe. We read over some of Gabrielle’s recommendations. We ate at Au Pied Du Cochon and took in a concert at Saint Chapelle. Both were wonderful. I highly recommend Gabrielle’s apartment and look forward to returning soon!

Lovely place to stay in Paris. Julia and Charles responded to all questions and concerns promptly and professionally. Check-in and check-out were very easy. The apartment was in a perfect location and is in walking distance to great restaurants and sites. The apartment was very clean and spacious. The ceilings in the bedrooms are low but weren’t a major issue. Overall this is a great place to stay when visiting Paris. I would definitely stay again and recommend to anyone looking to stay in Paris.
It was an enjoyable stay in Mai's place, in a vibrant neighbourhood. We loved walking to the boulangerie to grab breakfast every morning. We will book Mai's place again if we go back to Paris!
Oliver is very friendly and helpful. The room was excellent and clean. I can highly recommend it.

This place was excellent located 5 min walk to the Effeil tower, near the train and the place was cleaned. However we went middle June which was very very hot there was No AC and the fans are small to fresh the house. We couldn’t get the Wiffi to work either.
The apartment is in a really great location, the wifi worked the whole time I was there and Mao was great with communicating for check in and check out.

This space has everything you need for a bright, comfortable stay in a wonderful neighborhood of Paris. I liked the big windows. I appreciated how clean the space was. There were enough surfaces for my belongings. The kitchen had everything you could need. Host was responsive when I had a question.

Just a great location in Paris! It is very close walking distance to so many places in Paris. Plenty of great restaurants literally right on your doorstep. The apartment itself is very spacious with plenty of space to spread out. The hosts were responsive and organized. Only point I would make is that it is so well located, that it can get a little loud during warmer evenings, particularly on Friday and Saturday nights. The hosts have done their best job to block street noise as much as possible, so it is not too bad. Just a little something to be aware of. Overall this is just a great place to stay in Paris! My wife and I had a wonderful stay with our young daughter. Thank you once again!

We loved our stay at Sidonie’s Parisian loft - just steps away from the Arc De Triomphe. Very centrally located with an excellent train station with good access to the rest of Paris. A little bit of noise late at night on the weekends, but that’s to be expected given how central it is. It’s a very compact loft but it has everything that you need! Sidonie is a fantastic host. Easy to reach, helpful and kind! Would definitely recommend if you wish to have a true Parisian experience.
Great apartment Vibrant area, but apartment was quiet due to double glazing and on 4th storey. Douglas and Flore extremely responsive and helpful

This was a fabulous place to stay. It was between the Lourve and the Opera which made it easy to access everything. The place was in a lovely courtyard, well cared for, clean and comfortable. Would highly recommend.

Not only were Maria, Alain and their apartment everything you'd hope for in an Air BnB (clean, well appointed, fabulous location, quiet with attentive hosts), on our last night in Paris they became our hero when we suddenly realized we'd left our phone on the tour bus from Versailles! Alain manage all communication with the bus company and then he personally went to retrieve our phone from the company and brought it to us at the apartment and refused our attempts to reimburse him for his efforts. Our last evening on vacation went from being a nightmare to a wonderful cap to our time in France. THANK YOU Maria and Alain!!!
Stay was very pleasant 😇 Beatrice was very helpful. Apartament is really equipped - hair dryer, iron, that was very helpfull

Great stay in Manar's place. Everything was as described, and Manar was welcoming and helpful. Air conditioning would be a nice addition, but it wasn't necessary since I could get a decent breeze in the room by opening the window.

Would definitely recommend to stay here. Jean was nothing short of welcoming and always checked in to see if everything was okay. The place was clean, spacious and was also very accessible via the metro. Thank you so much Jean!
The host was really friendly and solved our problems quickly. The place was near the museums and convenient to transport.

Excellent location with 3 mins to Porte d'Orléans metro station, Nice neighborhood and surrounded by many restaurants and convenient stores. Host was extremely nice and informative. Their traditional French breakfast was served on time with the best quality of hot drinks and croissants.

Beautiful clean and very convenient apartment. We have everything we need for the night. The co-host was so nice as she let us check in early because we have kids after a long flight to Paris. Communication was great, so fast and effective. The beds are very comfortable and clean. It was amazing after a long flight. We would highly recommend the place ❤️
Great place. We would definitely stay again. Good location with easy access to restaurants, stores and metro stations.

What a gorgeous house with garden and greenery all around in the heart of Montmartre! So peaceful yet you step our your door and your in all the action! Just perfect! Jeanne was an amazing host! Greeted us in person, flexible check in and check out, super responsive and helpful! She gave us lovely recommendations too! Merci beaucoup Jeanne!

This is a very comfortable apartment in a great area -- quiet on the street but walkable and with nearby access to the metro, restaurants, cafes, bakeries, etc. It is not touristy at all, so you can feel almost like you're living as a Parisian. The apartment easily accommodates two people. We appreciated the coffee maker and the washer and dryer, as well as the comfortable bed and reliable wifi. There is no a/c, but with a fan and large windows, it is cool enough. For most of our stay, the elevator in the building was not working -- so be prepared to walk up to the 3rd floor. Check-in by retrieving the keys from a locker at a nearby grocery store took some figuring out, but it did allow for a flexible arrival, and Nicholas was very attentive. Thank you for a great stay!
Lovely stay right in the centre of Paris! Maria was helpful with setting the apartment up and was flexible with dropping our luggage in earlier than check in. Would stay again!

Pascale was a wonderful host, and her apartment is exceptionally charming and has everything you need. Very clean. There were 4 of us - 2 adults and 2 teens, and we had plenty of space... only one shower, but toilet is in a separate place from the shower, so you weren't stuck waiting to go to toilet when someone was using the shower. One note - the description says A/C, but there is no actual air-conditioning unit. We discovered that when we got there. However, the windows create a terrific breeze and we were very comfortable (sometimes even chilly) at night. Pascale also has two dyson fans available for use. We were not around during the day, as we did lots of site seeing, so I am not sure if no A/C during the day might be too hot. We stayed for almost a full week in mid- June.

My stay was great at Salvatore's apartment. I really enjoyed that the apartment was not in the middle of all tourist attractions, which made it more relaxing! Salvatore was extremely responsive and helpful with checkin, a guide for places to visit, and checkout. Highly recommend a stay here!

The apartment is very modern and clean. Location is amazing, easy to get to many major sightseeing spots. There are many bars, amazing restaurants and gelato shops around. The sound proofing of the apartment is extraordinary good, we can have a very good sleep. Security of the building is good, requires a code with digital key, very safe. The owner is really kind and he is very fast in response and very helpful and always gave us very detail instructions. We had a delay in the train journey to the apartment, we can still keep a close communication and update with each other for the arrival time and check-in process for every half an hour and the owner also kept update us about the latest arrangement. We had a wonderful holiday in Paris, lots of good food and beautiful buildings. A highly recommended place for everyone to stay in Paris for holidays.
Lisa is a wonderful host that would give you tons of information to make your stay enjoyable. Her recommendations were right on point!

My husband and I and our 12 year old granddaughter had a wonderful experience at the beautiful chic apartment. The location just can’t be better for visiting all the museums, parks, shopping and restaurants. We had a great experience booking this as our host Gabrielle was very responsive to all questions. Would definitely book this again and again! .

Laurent’s place was close to different metro stations and few stops from major attractions. Laurent was very responsive to every message sent and willing to help. Laurent also help us finding good restaurants and breakfast placed around the area. The apartment has 2 shower bathrooms but these doesn’t have a toilet. There is only 1 toilet in the apartment. For 6 adults and 2 kids, this was a stretch. I explained to Laurent about an incident with the cleaning personnel and he immediately took care of it. Overall, I will definitely recommend staying at Laurent apartment because of the proximity to major attractions and cost of accommodation in Paris for many people.
We had a beautiful stay at Chloe’s place, it was even better than the photos and the location was amazing :)) would stay again
Lovely apartment in a great location with a very friendly and responsive host! Would definitely recommend.

Beautifully appointed flat and felt like home from home. It's on a peaceful square, and it's got all that you need. It's close to Gare du Nord and easy walking distance to central Paris. Great windows for watching life on the square outside. The hosts were super helpful, very accommodating and responsive. We received very clear instructions on how to find and access the apartment.

Really nice host, replying quickly with good advices. Very hot in the apartment (June) but we had access to a fan keeping the heat down. Room lies towards a garden so there is no issue with car noise but some neighbors were a bit noisy (slammed doors). A bit long walk to the Metro. Overall, a very nice apartment for two and I can highly recommend it!
Karine is welcoming host and her home is a lovely space to enjoy the city. Clean and fully equipped.

Our family of 5 enjoyed our stay. The apartment was big enough for us and the air conditioning was wonderful during the heat wave. Mathieu was quick to respond and bring a few items that were missing. The apartment was very clean. Location to the metro was close- only a block away.
Fantastic stay at Alex’s. He was very proactive with providing instructions and checking whether we needed anything. Lovely location and would stay again.
Brilliant stay ! Clean, modern apartment close to metro. Places very near to shop for essentials and restaurants close by. Small, but perfect for 2 people.
Amazing apartment in walking distance to the Eiffel Tower. Restaurants and shops closely. Would definitely come back again !

We enjoyed the airy and lovely decorated apartment with interesting art and lots of books. We read about small bath so weren’t surprised. I believe an elderly person might have difficulty stepping over and into tub. Close to metro so very convenient to get around. Nice bakeries and Monoprix nearby. I would stay there again

We had a wonderful experience from start to finish! The apartment is located on a quieter street but so close to all of the action, cafes and more. We walked everywhere and came “home” to a comfortable and cool (hooray for AC!) apartment at the end of the day. Brijid was so helpful and quick to respond to any questions we had and her instructions were clear and easy to follow. It was absolutely perfect for our family of four!

We loved our stay in Paris and would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a place to stay in Montmarte. The space was tidy and clean and Younes was very helpful with sending instructions and providing recommendations. Would stay here again!
Wonderful stay and location! Room was great, location was great. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a peaceful Paris stay.
