Good location. The host's response is kind and polite. The room and shower room are small, but this is the center of Paris. It's right next to the Champs Elysées. there is a music bar downstairs so it was really noisy and loud until late at night every day….
Delphine’s place was homely and interesting. The location is nice - a block away from the canal and approximately 25mins walk to place de La Republique.

I think it is one of the most beautiful places I have been in the world, waking up and falling asleep with the view of the Eiffel tower transports you to a dream, Bruno was so gential, polite and helpful from the first moment, I can't wait to return to this wonderful home 😊💙

We could enjoy the wonderful days in Paris and understand the daily life of Parisians. There are many shops including supermarkets, bakeries, cafes and restaurants. The morning markets are very interesting and there many good foods.

Staying at Tatiana’s house is highlight of our stay in Paris. A lot of pleasant surprises in the house which is even beyond our expectations and better than the photos. Would love to come back next time in Paris 🫶

Great location to discover Marais and Latin Quarter, 10 minutes walk to Notre Dame. Clean and cozy apartment was great for two of us. Elsa is a great host. She was very attentive and helpful. She had not problem to check us in after midnight. Would stay again.
Thoroughly enjoyed the area and the ease of getting around. The apartment is perfectly located with all amenities near by. Loved our time there.

Fabulous location in the fun, bustling Marais - quiet street with very secure double entrance. Easily walkable to bars, coffee shops, restaurants and shopping. Apartment is very clean and nicely appointed. It is how we very small and really only appropriate for two people if you want to have a little space to move around. Loved having a shower for each bedroom but would be extremely tight for two adults using the bathroom at the same time. Toilet is in a TINY room in the sitting area . This is a door but it doesn’t feel really private - all fine though as long as you are traveling with close friends or family! I would definitely recommend and rent it again. A couple suggestions: A full length mirror is greatly needed as is a trash can in each bathroom… only one bath had a trash can.

Theo was a great communicator from the start and sent very clear and helpful instructions for our stay. He checked in on us too, just to make sure everything was ok. His apartment was really cool and funky and was very homely too. It was clean and comfortable. It was right in the middle of some great restaurants and bars and easy to get to main tourist attractions too (whether walking or metro). We’d definitely stay here again!

Check in was easy and flexible with the building concierge, who was very friendly and helpful. Location was very walkable to convenient shops and metro stations. We loved having a kitchen to cook our own meals and do some laundry. It was also quiet at night, as it is set back from the street. Also, having an elevator was a major plus! John has a perfect apartment from which to head out and explore the city each day!
Nice Airbnb location. Close to the train and so close to the Eiffel Tower. Host was super responsive. House was clean and looked like the pictures.
Perfect, tidy little apartment in Paris including a lovely balcony! We had a really nice stay. Pauline is very friendly, we had an easy check in and very flexible check out. Definitely recommend!
Recommend this place! The location is superb and also we felt safe all the time we stay here. Highly recommend.
We had a great stay here, thank you to Gilbert for being so helpful and welcoming. The place was spotless and had everything we needed. Would definitely book again.
Great place to stay, beautiful apartment in a central location with the metro, shops and restaurants all nearby

I had a great stay at this Airbnb. The place was beautiful, the interior was stylish and well-maintained, and the location was perfect for exploring the area. I thoroughly enjoyed my time here and would definitely recommend it to others.

Pros: The apartment was spacious in a nice neighborhood. Jardin du Ranaleigh is a quick walk with playgrounds and great to take little children. And Antoine was quick to respond with questions during our stay. Cons: The toilet seat was broken, and the bed frame in Bedroom 2 was broken so you have to sleep at an angle which was not very comfortable. I'd recommend confirming the bed is fixed before you book.
Excellent stay at Honore apartment. Lovely apartment. Well fitted out and organised. Super clean and very well equipped. Loved staying here and totally would again!
It was a great stay and the location was perfect. We went for the rugby World Cup and it was walking distance to lots of great bars.

Marianne’s apartment was a perfect place for me to stay during my first trip to Paris. Conveniently located and very accessible with a subway half a block away. A grocery store and a bakery downstairs were a nice bonus. The apartment itself is well appointed, bright, had everything I needed, and most importantly was very quiet. Oh yeah, it has great water pressure in the shower despite being on the top floor! 👍 Also, Marianne was a very responsive host when we needed to communicate. Thank you!

Tony’s home was absolutely perfect! We felt right at home and loved the location. The windows kept out street sound very well and we loved the layout of the apartment. Tony was quick to respond and always helpful. We hope to stay here in the future!

My first time in Paris! This location was in a beautiful place around the city near a lot of entertainment. The host was very responsive. The location was easy to fine. The place was huge! Definitely will book again.
Great place, very spacious and homely. Easy to find and great location for travelling around Paris. Terrace is a great added bonus and the views are amazing! Definitely recommend!

A lovely bright modern apartment in a beautiful quiet courtyard setting in a super location. Nicolas was responsive and provided great information prior to arrival, which made arrival easy. Some slight issues with the key to the front door - which is a little sticky - but Nicolas was available to help and was able to guide alternative use of the back door. There was a unforeseeable issue with the boiler, but again Nicolas was very helpful and ensured we got the right help from AirBnB. Would definitely recommend.

The perfect place to stay for our short city break! Lots of great places to eat nearby, very well connected, Marianna was super responsive and the apartment was exactly as described and very comfortable.
Regina was very responsive, kind and helpful throughout my family's stay in her lovely apartment. We also appreciated her flexibility with check-in time on the weekend. Highly recommend!

Had a great stay at Julie's place, and we stayed twice during our trip to France. The place was very neat, well decorated, and just as advertised. We were able to take the metro to get to all all our destinations and there are also buses available close by. Overall, we enjoyed our time at Julie's place and would stay again.
Luke’s place is a lovely little getaway to access all of the sights of Paris! It is a small space but perfect for a short visit and exactly as pictured. Very easy access to Paris via metro or Bus!
Thanks Alex, Really enjoyed my stay. Great location and lovely apartment. Clean and free from bed bugs which was greatly appreciated. Definitely would stay again and recommend to others.

Fabulous location in arguably the best part of the city! Grocery store below, wine shop across the street, restaurant and bars in every direction. Walkable distance of Sacre-Coeur. Metro stops walkable in either direction. Rentable bikes around the corner. On and on... can't go wrong with this one!

Cindy is a really nice host that she always answered my questions quickly. The house is clean and location is good. Just the soundproofing is not that good so we can hear neighbors talking or opening/closing doors at the night.

Charles's apartment exceeded our expectations. It is very charming, clean and receives beautiful, natural light. Charles is such a generous host. He gave us a complimentary bottle of very fine wine and left a six back of beer in the fridge. He was very communicative and beyond helpful in checking us in and out of the apartment. We were traveling with our four year old and seven month old and the apartment accommodated our family very comfortably. I would stay here again and again and again.

LOVE LOVE LOVED! This place is better than the photos. We felt like we were in a truly Parisian apartment. So spacious so cozy so clean and so well appointed. Definitely recommend! We booked another place in Paris for a friend for the same price and the entire apartment was the size of Eric and Laure’s kitchen! For any US guest please note that the 1.5bath is one full bath by US opinion. The bathroom in the bedroom is a sink and tub with a handheld shower and the toilet is off the living room with a second sink. That being said we did not want to leave this lovely home!
The location was close to the metro and easy to find. The place was very clean and had all the amenities we needed. Julie and Charles were very responsive. Thank you for a great stay.

We loved our week-long stay at Vincent's apartment! Being based in the gorgeous neighborhood was an idyllic Parisian experience. We ate at lots of incredible restaurants within a 2-3 minute walk of the building. We walked easily to the Seine, Louvre, Notre Dame, Montmartre, Montparnasse. It was so nice to grab sandwiches from a boulangerie and eat them in the very nearby Jardin du Luxembourg! The apartment itself is full of charm, with cozy seating, a very comfortable bed, and a lovely view of the tower at night. We cooked at home a couple of nights and found the kitchen stocked with everything we needed. It was a huge plus to be able to do laundry during our long visit. Vincent was friendly and communicative throughout our stay. What a pleasure to spend time in his art and light-filled space! We recommend it with enthusiasm!

Had a very enjoyable stay. Loan was very responsive and helpful with the check-in process. Photos match exactly - super clean and very neat. The APT is on a busy street, so the evenings are a bit noisy, but worth being in the heart of Paris.

Great location within walking distance to several restaurants and markets and close to the metro. Very clean apartment with everything you may need for your trip to Paris. Very response host with local recommendations and always available to answer any questions. Highly recommended!

Beautiful place with beautiful people. 10/10 would recommend this stay. Hannelore and her husband were so amazing and their place is super cute and has everything you need. They even provided us breakfast, and we had a little afternoon snack with them. Location is close to the metro, cute cafe across the road, and a park. One of the best stays we've had.

Mireille met us at the apartment, was gracious, friendly and encouraged us to contact her with any questions or issues. The apartment was lovely and felt comfortable. The neighborhood is excellent with many popular restaurants and shops and near a metro stop. Thank you Mireille for sharing your home with us.

Pierre and Irene are nice fellas, sharing some space of their flat to whom are wishing to enjoy a family feeling and at the same time being in located in a central location of Paris with al sorts of services and amenities available. And there's the terrace... I won't spend words on it, pictures can speak out loud by themselves.

The apartment and its view really was beautiful, we chose to eat breakfast at home everyday just to enjoy it. Sandra greeted us as we arrived and gave us quick and clear instructions. Everything was clean and the apartment had everything you might need: a washing machine, tub, coffee maker, TV, dishwasher, etc. We were a little worried about bed bugs, since we had read several reports on it being an outbreak in Paris. However, we couldn't find any traces of it in this apartment! Its location is also perfect, located right next to the Sacre Cœur and with several bars & cafés in every direction. There are also several metro lines to choose from within walking distance. Would recommend this to anyone who is staying in Paris!
Theo was wonderful and very easy to communicate with. His flat is in a great location with a lot of cafes and bars nearby. Unfortunately, the flat was no very clean despite its potential.
Chloe’s place is perfectly located and affordable for Paris. It was surprisingly big as well! Highly recommend!

With the exception of the 99 steps to get to the room (it’s an authentic French pied de terre) and the washing machine not working, it was beyond what I was expecting. Great location!! Lots of stuff to see, places to shop and eat all within walking distance. Close to the metro at Rambuteau or Hôtel de Ville or even Les Halles. Enjoyed it very much. Felt close to true Parisians for a week.
Top class place. Brilliant location and lovely apartment. Ed was great for communication and check-in was a breeze. We will definitely stay there again.
We felt very at home in Antoine’s place for our stay (9 days.) Loved getting to know his area of Montmartre, maybe as much as the rest of Paris!
I really enjoyed my stay in Paris. Guillaume’s place is so comfy and it’s in a brilliant location. Guillaume was very helpful and responsive. Highly recommend!

Arthur is a fantastic host. Incredibly responsive and helpful. The flat is well situated in Paris and quiet for being in the middle of the city. We were 3 people and had enough room so we weren't on top of each other. Great value for a well-appointed flat in the city.
Nice apartment located right on the Seine and in the Le Marais district. Communication was quick and helpful. Would stay again!

Tatiana’s space was nothing short of beautiful! So comfortable, with everything needed. And on top of that an incredible location with lots of bars and restaurants steps away. Cannot wait to stay here again!

We had a wonderful stay. Great for a family with small kids ours were 5. Might be tight with older kids or if you need privacy with your roommates. Everything was clean and easy. Newly refurbished. Shower was big. Has a microwave, 2 burner stove, and small fridge. Not much of a view but very functional, very convenient, and provided what we needed. Everything was straightforward and we didn’t need to contact the hosts at all. If you like spicy 🌶️ food, check out the Schizun restaurant across the street. Would gladly stay again.
Lovely place to stay. Cedric was very hospitable and helpful. Myself and my husband really enjoyed staying there. Definitely recommend 👍

The title "Super Host" exists for people like Sophie! She was the most responsive host I have ever interacted with and was very flexible with our needs and went out of her way to help us get settled into her amazing apartment. The descriptions, pictures, etc. are very accurate and the area is very walkable and filled with some great restaurants, bars, etc. I would highly recommend staying here and hope to visit it again!
Had a wonderful stay, Manar was really helpful, kind and responsive. Definitely deserves 5/5.
Lovely apartment in a great area. Very responsive and helpful hosts. I really enjoyed my stay there. Thank you Laure and Eric!
Your apartment is beautiful and perfectly located in a beautiful part of Paris. We loved our experience. If I’m lucky enough to return to Paris, I would stay here again.
Great stay, a bit small for more than two people in my opinion but definitely worth it if it’s for a couple . The hostess was super attentive and caring, made us feel very comfortable

I stayed at Sebastian’s place with my 9 year old daughter. It is a small apartment and it was perfect for us. We are vegetarian and like to make food instead of eating out all the time so it was very convenient for us to have a small clean kitchen and a very nice supermarket nearby. We could walk to Nortre Dame snd Louvre museum. We could take the bus easily to ho other places. Overall we had s good experience.
The place was perfect for our stay in Paris - Thomas was a very responsive and problem solving host - highly recommend.

Alice's apartment is very bright, decorated with an artistic touch, lots of flower pots. Close to connections for public transport. Surrounding is nice with bars and restaurants and of course with boulangeries! We enjoyed our stay here!
Great location with lots to do surrounding Airbnb and easily walkable to public transit, beautiful balcony, and large kitchen. Check in went smoothly and was very accommodating to check out time

When we first came Sophie greeted us and showed us around. She sent us a lot of recommendations (restaurants, supermarkets, places to visit). Our room was very clean and looked even better in person. Her place is a few minutes walk from the metro and is really close to Arc de Triomphe. The neighbourhood is really nice and quiet. The dog Eddy is the sweetest dog ever, he played with us all the time. Overall Sophie is an amazing host and I’m definitely coming back!

My friends and I had a lovely stay at Karine’s place! It’s located in a real nice and hip neighbourhood, but still calm and relaxed. It had all the facilities we needed and we loved the style of interior. Definitely a place to come back to!
Sssh don’t tell anyone! Great find, brilliant location, super clean with lovely air fresheners, exactly as described. Typical Parisian apartment in one of the best areas in the City.

This was by far the nicest Air b n b I have ever stayed in for a city break. It was very centrally located, great area - walkable to all our favourite places. Finally, the interiors are absolutely beautiful - excellent taste!!!
Helena was a friendly and helpful host. She was very responsive to any questions we had and has her place clean and tidy. Thank you again for our stay ☺️
Great location - so close to all restaurants and main stations. Apartment is well equipped. Only a few stairs to walk up with bags then there is a lift.
Great location, apartment good, but heavy noise of construction in nearby property. Not the fault of the owner, but did detract a little. Still had a great time.

Hanne’s apartment is very lovely, and nicely located next to the beautiful Parc Butte Chaumont. Hanne is a helpful host who makes sure everything runs smoothly. We asked for restaurant recommendations and had a great meal thanks to her. Would definitely recommend staying here :)

We had a fabulous stay at Linda's. The apartment is 3 minute walk to Luxembourg RER and also close to various metros so getting around the city either on foot or by public transport was easy. Linda was easy to communicate with and friendly, even helping us with our luggage by allowing early access to drop bags off before check in.
Julie was responsive and warm with hospitality. A kind and generous spirit, I am very thankful.

We had a good stay and loved the neighborhood, with many restaurants, parks, supermarkets and a good distance from public transport. Very local and family-friendly, it's a great place to really get to know how Parisians live. The apartment is old, like the traditional ones in the city. We felt it was a little cluttered and poorly lit, but nothing that would get in the way. The only thing that surprised us was that although we were "sharing" the apartment, we didn't meet the owner at any time. But despite this, Sofia was always present via message

Apartment was just right for 2 couples. Easy walk to The Louvre and Notre Dame, plus many other amazing sites to visit. Very secure building and very quiet. Jean Luc was very responsive before and during our visit. He was also very accommodating in the timing of our check-in, so we could drop our luggage and go explore after our overnight flight from the US. Would definitely stay here again!

Perfect stay! A bit on the pricey side but it’s Paris. Antoine was super helpful anytime we reached out to him. The apartment suited all our needs, grocery store and laundromat were nearby, the metro was super close and the area was pretty. We enjoyed our stay here

Had a lovely short stay in Alex's place whilst photographing a wedding. The apartment was situated perfectly, walking distance to lots of cafes and restaurants, and close to the main attractions of Paris. The apartment looked like the photos and was very clean. I had a lovely nights sleep, no noise, and no bites! ☺️

We really enjoyed our stay here. The area feels safe and easy to get around. The bed is extremely comfortable, however, the upper level is very low down. We didn’t mind bending whilst up there but some may if there have back problems etc… It was nice to have a tv with Netflix for a longer stay and a full fridge and kitchen. The only downside for us was that there really wasn’t a lot of hot water. The first night one of us had a normal shower, not too long and hot enough to warm us up after the freezing day we had, but the second person ran out of hot water very quickly and had to have a cold shower. We ended up having to have lukewarm showers the entire time to avoid running out of warm water. This wasn’t exactly ideal for the cold weather but it also wasn’t the end of the world. We did have a problem with the washer and Sebastien was very quick to help! We would recommend this Airbnb!
The room was perfectly nice. Very cosy, seperated bathroom, well-cleaned, nice area. Olivier was very kind. Highly recommend this place!

Anne was amazing she made sure she was available during my check in to help with my luggage as I was a solo traveler, she is accommodating and very responsive you can always count on her to respond to any questions immediately. Her apartment is so beautiful and cozy. As this my second stay there always felt like my little getaway in Paris. Apartment was clean and charming. Walking distance from grocery store, shopping stores and more. I will definitely be visiting her beautiful apartment again.

Sonia is very kind and the bed was clean and comfortable.Nice neighbourhood. unfortunately we couldn't finish our stay due to the cigarette smell and smoking in the building. . Washroom desperately needs renovation
Great location near metro. Lots of Local restaurants and by the time we left we knew some locals at restaurants. Place accommodated 4 adults. Thank you sharing your place. Pamela

Joy was a great host, always responsive and helpful for a seamless check-in and check-out. Great location for any visiting point in Paris thanks to the underground hub Nation which is 5 minutes away by foot.
We loved staying at Vitalina's place and highly recommend it. You will enjoy the apartment and the neighborhood! Vitalina is a great and responsive host...enjoy!
Great place in a great location, with a very responsive and accomodating host. Thank you!

Helene and Alain are the most lovely hosts, with a great sense of humour and thoughtful travel tips. They were helpful, friendly and accommodating. I appreciated being able to store my luggage before and after check-in. The room is so pretty and quiet. The location is excellent and I was able to easily get around to all of Paris using the metro and buses. This is an ideal place to stay for a solo traveller.

Alex's flat Is amazing to enjoy Paris from the perspective of an extremely nice neighbourhood. It Is cozy, clean, practical. Easy to reach, also thanks to the precise informations given by the host himself. I recommend It!

Team kept us well informed. Great location close to lots of good shopping and restaurants and private. I would describe it as being in 9th rather than Opera although Opera is only a 10-15 minute walk. Sofa bed very comfortable. Some parts could do with a refresh.
Amazing place in a great and vibrant vibrant neighborhood. Charles was a perfect host! Will definitely go back to Charles’s place when in Paris!!

It is a small but perfectly formed space with easy connections across Paris using the RER/Metro and walking distance to many bars and restaurants and several popular attractions such as the Louvre. It was clean tidy and had everything that we needed and expected. Tony is an attentive host, in regular contact and proactively offered up useful information regarding travel and visitor attractions.

From the moment you checked in, you'll feel right at home. Thanks to Denka and Celia (the concierge) for a warm and beautiful home. The house is clean and had all the amenities needed for a great stay. This is a loft so the sleeping area is on the upper level. The staircase is a little steep but we had no issue with it. Location wise, you just can't fault it - close to metro and all the actions Paris has to offer. Overall, a great stay in a great location. Thank you Denka and Celia!!

I can't recommend Josephine's space enough - not only was she incredibly kind and responsive, but the location was absolutely divine. Great restaurants nearby, completely walkable, and very safe. The unit itself had everything my wife and I needed to explore the city, comfortable bed & bedding, perfect kitchen amenities and just an absolute dream home to explore Paris. This will be my first stop whenever we return.

We loved staying in Montmartre. Quiet street. Lots of shops within a couple blocks. We loved being able to hang out on the rooftop patio in the evening, if it wasn't raining! Thanks for sharing Christophe!

The apartment was very well located and Peggy was a very nice host. The check-in was very easy. Unfortunately, the downstairs bedroom smelled of mold, but the rest of the apartment was clean and nice. The facilities were very good.
Amazing stay with Sophie! She gave us wonderful recommendations and was such a joy to converse with. We also loved that sweet dog of hers. Highly recommend this place.

Denis’ place was at a great central location and very easy to walk around or take public transport. Denis was very responsive and we enjoyed dining at some of his recommended restaurants. A wonderful place to enjoy the heart of Paris!
Sandrine was a great host, very helpful and accomodating. The apartment had everything we needed and was in a great location for transport, restaurants, bars and shopping Thank you

Location, Location, Location We chose the apartment for its pictures showing bright room and the location. It's a 10 on 10 on location. Right at the heart of city. Close proximity to all the major attractions...we walked all the way up to Eiffel too. Bus, Metros all within 2 mins walking distance too. Room was quite bright. The Sofa bed was comfy too. Will recommend to small families...
I really liked the location. Please don’t accept room 121 on the first floor, I was unable to sleep due to noise , I guess from the stairs.

We were the 1st to stay in this amazing accommodation. Very stylish, clean and spacious as we are a family of 5 every need was meet. The location was spot on, close to metro great coffee shops and restaurants. Joffrey was always at hand and helped when ever he could when needed. I highly recommend this apartment.

This place was great for what we needed. The bed was comfortable, the kitchen was clean and good for cooking! Be mindful if you have mobility issues as the bedroom is a loft and had steep stairs. This place is really homely and we felt really comfortable and safe.

Honestly the space was easy to find surrounding was gorgeous. Host answers quickly and has positive vibes. The space is just right for one person and would recommend if it’s your first time in Paris. Though the bathroom is outside there’s minimal interaction with neighbors but overall people are nice.
Nice little apartment in a good location. Host was super responsive to all requests and let us check in early.
Great apartment with functional kitchen, fridge and freezer. Easy walk to large metro station with 3 lines. Patisserie located on ground floor is a bonus

Laurent’s Airbnb was superb! Great location and spacious for 5 guests. Kitchen is well-stocked with pots, pans, and dishes. Elevator can only fit 3 people maximum or 2 people with luggage. But it is quick, so not a problem. The street noise is loud, but we slept through it. Wonderful experience!!!
The space was even bigger than visualized in the images. Communication with Jordan was smooth. Location was perfect walking distance to the Metro. Many restaurants nearby.

Julien’s place has everything you need and is located with plenty of Metros around. Simply buy a metro pass and explore Paris! The bed is very comfortable and the shower is great (awesome water pressure). Functional kitchenette so you can whip up some meals as needed as well.
Lovely, friendly host and great apartment. Spotless and comfortable. Good location with the metro, supermarket and bakery nearby. We had a great holiday.

We had a great stay at Adrien’s apartment! The location is good, the flat is pretty, the communication with Adrien was really friendly and uncomplicated and we enjoyed our time there a lot! Thanks for having us :)

4 min walk to Michel Bizot station, 10 min walk to 2 other stations. This is located in a really nice safe neighborhood with tons of supermarkets and restaurants near by. And it's not far from the city center. The price is really good too! Please keep in mind that this is a live in home, so just make sure that you are organized. Aside from that, I recommend it!
Hanne’s apartment is lovely. Great spot and easy access to the metro. Good communication. Would definitely stay again!

Great location, very comfortable stay and the listing was as described. The hosts communicated well and were kind enough to wait for me to arrive which I greatly appreciated. Thank you Julien and Bénédict.

Amazing stay in the perfect location. Yohann graciously accepted an early check in (perfect for a group of four who flew in on a red eye and had a limited time in Paris) - the welcome manual was so detailed so we had ample time to prepare for what to expect. Great communication throughout. Merci!

I loved staying in Virgile's apartment. He accommodated my request last minute, communicated clearly, and met me personally at the apartment. The apartment is located in one of my favorite areas of the city, not the classic tourist spots, but actually even better. It's minutes walk from Buttes Chaumont park, metro Belleville, with lots of amazing food options around. I highly recommend Virgile's apartment.
Great stay - very responsive host! Only point is that there are several sets of stairs and if you have big bags this could be problematic.
He’s one of the best hosts. He made my stay in Paris very comfortable! I recommend his place.
Delphine was awesome and made me feel at home from day 1! I could not recommend her more as she was very helpful and inviting throughout my stay!
We had a great stay at Arianne’s place. The location is perfect and we had everything we needed at our doorstep. The apartment was clean, spacious and comfortable. Arianne was a very attentive host.

I am glad that we found this place for our 1st family vacation in Paris , perfect for family vacation.We had a blast, and it's walkable distance to Eiffel tower.Everything was clean and nice as we entered the house.We will definitely come back again.Highly recommend. Hsiao Lin has been a great host, very responsive 😊

The perfect flat to stay to explore Paris ! It’s small but very cozy and clean. It’s a walking distance to the Metro, restaurants, bakeries and etc! About a 10 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower! Patrick is an excellent hostess who communicated very well. Will definitely book again.

Absolutely incredible apartment in a great location. Center of everything you’d want to do while visiting Paris. Extremely quiet location - if you’re looking for peace and rest, this is perfect. Communicative host, and even allowed for some flexibility in early checkin. Would absolutely recommend to family/friends.
Convenient studio apartment. Very small but had what was needed for a couple of nights stay. Very near the metro.
This is a very good and well decorated house in a very nice territory. It is both good for short and long term visits. The host is very nice and easy to communicate. I reccommend this house.
She is amazing! She is very communicative and helped us while we stayed there. The place was very cozy and very well located. I totally recommend.

Nice place. Clean. Comfortable. Good location across the street from the best croissants in the 16th arrondissement (at La Grande Epicerie) and near great shopping on the rue de Passy. I wouldn’t describe it as “luxurious,” but we had a perfectly pleasant stay.
The rooms were really nice and polite for us!! They explain plenty information to support when in trouble. The room was clean and the bed was really comfortable and made us sleep well:))

Highly recommended. Etienne was super communicative, kind and helpful. Apartment was extremely clean and exactly as the photos depicted. Super beautiful light poured in. I would gladly stay there again and happy to recommend it to friends or family. Thanks Etienne!
This airbnb has been my favorite because of the location and how nice it is, & Jordan is a great host :)

This apartment was wonderful! It was so great, in fact, that we extended the length of our stay. The host was very helpful, communicated quickly, and was thoughtful about making our stay as positive as possible. The apartment is very large compared to others we've booked in Paris. It is spacious, clean, and comfortable. Beyond that, the location is perfect. There are plentiful places to eat and easy access to two Metro stations nearby. We look forward to booking this listing again during our next stay in Paris.

Victorine's place was perfect! It had everything we needed, perfect amount of space. The location is so perfect for getting around, lots of amazing restaurants and bars are just a walk away. It was fantastic and made the trip so great!

Had a wonderful time at Adrien’s apartment. It is beautifully furnished and has everything you need. It is located in a charming neighborhood near lots of interesting attractions. Adrien was very friendly and very quick to reply to messages. I would definitely stay here again

We had a really nice stay at her apartment. She is a really nice and lovely person. We had everything we needed and the Location of the airbnb was perfect. If we had questions about anything we were always able to text or call her. We would totally recommend this airbnb for a stay in Paris. :)
Had an amazing stay here ! Laurent was very responsive and helpful, the flat was much better than expected.

Great host, super friendly, and amicable! The neighborhood is great too. Keep in mind the gates have a closing time so you will have to coordinate in advance with Agnes to enter or leave during closing hours. She is very helpful so it was not a problem.
Very well located apartment with a highly communicative host. The person who lives in the apartment can be a bit loud very late at night so would recommend ear plugs. Good for a brief stay in Paris!

We had a wonderful experience with Élise and Sebastian. The communication was great, location is perfect, and the place is clean and comfortable. The only thing I hadn’t realized was that there is only one toilet and 2 showers, but we made it work. Would definitely recommend.
Very happy with our stay. Fabulous location. Gorgeous apartment building. Super quiet and very well presented. Would recommend.
Was a great place and fantastic location with a great selection of restaurants and supermarkets all with a few minutes walk.

We could not be more pleased with the accommodations. The place itself is well located, bright, clean, and possessing everything one needs for a good stay in Paris. The attention given to the aesthetics of this lovely dwelling should not go unnoticed or unremarked. Clearly, a lot of thought was given to the design and execution of a place that seems much larger than the square footage might suggest. In addition, it was well equipped and thoughtfully appointed. Five stars is an easy call for this place.
Great place to stay ! Very best to Eiffel Tower and other locations, close to numerous restaurants and metro. Vanessa always replied immediately and was super helpful.

Three of us stayed here in November and really liked it. The street is quiet but there are busier streets with restaurants, etc. nearby and a metro station half a block away. We walked to most places and felt safe walking around the neighborhood at night. The kitchen had everything we needed and the bathroom was small but modern and very clean. Sandrine was great at communicating with us and kindly accommodated an earlier check-in. I would definitely recommend!
Alexis was a fantastic host. The home was perfect our stay. Location cannot be beat and he was super helpful with local recommendations. Will definitely rent again next time we are in Paris.
Everything was ok, too bad elevator was not working with such a small staircase to 4th floor
Fun place to stay in Paris! Yohann was a great host, quickly responding to any questions our group had. He was also flexible in providing us with an early check in.

Fantastic stay, and Marie was an excellent host with clear and helpful communication. Very close to all amenities and transportation. Really interesting and creative interior design that we loved. Thanks
It was a nice stay. The place is very small, not possible for two people but it is a great option for a short stay.

Best AirBnB experience I had in years! Benjamin is an outstanding host (friendly, flexible, responsive). The apartment is super clean, beautifully furnished, well equipped, and perfectly organised. The area is quite, easily accessible, and full of nice restaurants just around the corner. I would return anytime. Most highly recommended.
Lovely, cozy apartment and very convenient location. All exactly as described with lovely details to make us feel welcome. Would stay again.

Hosts responded promptly with questions we had prior to our arrival. Great location, walking distance to Norte Dame, Louve and many great restaurants. Apartment seemed dark because there were no windows except for the outside window facing the street. I would not recommend for families with small children or people with disabilities because of the steep aluminum stairs to the upstairs bedroom and steep steps going down to downstairs bedroom. Overall we enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend apartment to others.

It’s was great dealing with Eleanor and staying at her lovely apartment I’ll definitely come back and definitely recommend it to other people to stay here. Neighborhood is also amazing and in one of the best parts of town .
This location was exactly what we were looking for. Perfect location with restaurants, transportation, and grocery stores all closely located. Pull out couch and beds were comfortable, no complaints!

This apartment was clean, quiet and worked well for our family. The location was great- central and easy access to many areas of the city so I would especially recommend it for first time visitors to Paris.
Most comfortable bed I’ve slept in in a very long time. Very quiet and peaceful. Waking up to the smell of freshly baked croissants was a delight.
Great place and fantastic location! It’s certainly an Airbnb that we will use again when we go back to Paris. The location is superb, indeed.
Happy is super nice, flexible and responsive. The place is super cozy, room is warm at night. it's close to the center and the area seems safe and quiet. Would definitely recommend it!

Pierre and Irene’s place is in a great location. The metro is right outside, supermarket and a few restaurants in walking distance. Really nice view from the apartment and it was clean. They were also very responsive and knowledgeable. I would come back again if I find myself in Paris again.
Very good experience in Cindy’s apartment. The place is very cozy and excellently located. I would recommend with no reservations
The pictures do not fully demonstrate the beautiful flat. Very spacious and elegant. Host is very helpful and friendly.
Had a very lovely stay. The house and the small backyard was very cozy and perfect for our trip. JF helped us out with what we needed and responded quickly. Very recommended:-)

The apartment was really beautiful, with a great quality finish and facilities and the beds were super clean and comfortable too. Marc and the management team were really helpful and kept me informed throughout the process. Vincent, who met us for a late checkin was brilliant too, with good tips and recommendations for things to do.

Nice and convenient apartment very well located with boulangeries, a grocery store and restaurants next door. Bed was just ok though (there was a broken wooden slat on my side) and there was no pasta drainer.

The apartment feels like home with all of the necessary comforts and the added bonus of an absolutely stunning terrace and view of Sacre Coeur. The location is also accessible to several metro lines as well as walking distance to some cool neighborhoods. Thomas was a responsive and friendly host.
The apertmen is great comfortable and quiet,but it would be better if it had safer door.Host was very nice and professional.Metro station is nearby. We recommend it.🤩🤩
A really great location in Paris! Tomaso was a great host and very helpful. The place is very clean, spacious and the view from the balcony is beautiful. Highly recommend.

The flat is a beautiful large 1bd right on the corner of Bois de Boulogne. Super clean, fast wifi, and well stocked. Pascale responds quickly and was very accommodating. The park is wonderful to walk in. There is lots of good shopping just a little north (about halfway up the park, still in the 16th arr). The restaurants and bakery nearby were very good too. This neighborhood is ideal if you want a break from the touristyness of the 1-5th arr.s and want a more local feel. Nearly everyone around you will be speaking French not English. I was very happy with my stay and would stay here again! Thanks Pascale.
We had a great stay at Benoit’s place. The listing was accurate, the location was perfect, and the apartment was charming. Benoit was a very attentive and generous host. It really was perfect for us.

Thanks to the kind host, I stayed comfortable. The location of the accommodation was so good, and there was no inconvenience when moving to other tourist destinations. If I visit Paris again next time, I will choose her house.

The place is small, just like in the photos. It has plenty of light. The neighborhood is really interesting, and there are a number of different metro lines that go through it, which makes it really accessible.

the location is good, and the. studio is small but has everything you need. It was very unfortunate when we were staying there , there was construction ongoing and there were things blocking our house entry. it's not Hugues's fault, he did his best to help us.

Pascal's place is all you may need for a short stay in Paris. Small and cozy, his apartment sits very close to the metro station Gambetta, where you can transport to wherever you want. Apartment was clean, tidy and new, and Pascal was helpful. I would 100% recommend his place.

We enjoyed our stay very much as the apartment was super cute, comfortable and cozy with great amenities. It was private and quiet, and we had no trouble getting around with restaurants, pastry shops, and a metro station 2 blocks away. We were only there at night and early in the morning but it was perfect for our needs.

Hélène was a wonderful host - so responsive and kind. The room was lovely and private with everything you need. I really enjoyed speaking to her and her partner, they are personable and great characters. Just be careful not to hit your head as the room is on the roof and there are some diagonal beams and doorframes. Overall, a brilliant stay and I would love to come again!
James’ place is so wonderful! It is cozy with an amazing view of Paris, tucked in an incredible neighborhood. We were sad to leave! Highly recommend it.

We had a great stay, the apartment is very spacious and great for groups. The location is top, easy to navigate and right in the heart of Le Marais close to shops, boutiques and restaurants. There was so much to explore and everything you need is there! I would definitely stay here again and would recommend this apartment to other travelers.

Just a great location within walking distance to many restaurants, bars, and many of the sites in Paris. It’s also very convenient to multiple metro lines, which makes everything super accessible. The hosts weee super communicative prior to and during our stay.

Amazing view on the Effel Tower. Several metro stations are nearby. Very easy to go anywhere - to city centre, airport or outside the city. There is elevator and good bars / restaurants around and opposite the building. Nicolas even offered me late check out due to my flight time without any fee. Fully recommend!

We thoroughly enjoyed Anne and Jean-Luc's historical home in the quieter part of the Latin Quarter. The AirBnB was just as pictured and kept tidy and clean. The location was ideal for nearby essential stores (food markets, baker, etc...), for neighborhood restaurants (hosts' recommendations), and for interesting sites (Pantheon, stunning churches). Thank you for allowing us to stay!
A very quiet and comfortable room in the center of Paris. Hélène was very welcoming and friendly. I enjoyed my stay in the Airbnb and can recommend it.
Very nice apartment, very clean, had everything we needed. Had a great stay and definitely recommend it to everyone. 5 out of 5 for me!

Excellent choice for staying in Paris! Convenient to great cafe’s, shops, restaurants, and the metro. Trendy locale with multiple walkable places for dining. Felt very safe with multiple Levels of security upon entry into apartment. Decor was very modern. Spotless rooms and bathrooms with daily cleaning! Host very responsive to all of our questions. Highly recommend!
very cozy and modern place, close to all landmarks and Vanessa is awesome. There is a grocery store 2 minutes from the place, good WiFi, washer works very good. definetely would stay there again

It's the best place ever ! Ann was super friendly and the flat was so clean and nice. We stayed with 11 months baby, and Ann had prepared all the baby items, so we stayed without any inconvenience. Flat was really clean, which I was concerned a lot before we arrived. I would love to visit Paris again and I will definitely choose Ann's place again!

Cindy’s apartment is very well located. There are lots of great restaurants and brasseries nearby. The apartment is very cosy and clean with everything we needed. Cindy was very responsive to our questions. Highly recommended.

Othelie was very responsive and tgere was excellent communication throughout my daughter’s stay. Othelie was welcoming and checkin and out was smooth. The apartment was very comfortable and clean and a home from home experience. Thank you Othelie for your great hosting and assistance.

Our stay at this perfect Parisian retreat was truly delightful. The location was ideal, offering easy access to key attractions and short distance from the metro. The added bonus of a delicious breakfast provided a wonderful start to each day. I highly recommend this spot for anyone seeking a comfortable and centrally located stay in Paris.

I had a wonderful time in Paris. Marie’s place was the icing on the cake. Lovely apartment, easy to get around as it is close to multiple metro stations. There’s some really cute restaurants nearby and also a Carrefour on the same street. The place was clean and cared for with great attention to detail. I’d highly recommend this place! It’s so cute and inspiring. Enjoy!

Perfect place in the center of Paris. Probably the cleanest and tidiest flat I have ever rented. The host was really nice and communication was easy. Definitely suggested if you are a group and are looking for a place to stay

It’s in a very convenient area for traveling, many scenarios are in walking distance. But the bed sheet is not thoroughly cleaned , there is sweaty smell and cannot be ignored when you sleep. Also the place is in 5th floor and the stairs are steep and narrow. It’s hard for girls to get our luggage on. Also people outside may drink, talk and laugh till midnight.
Cedric was lovely and super helpful and quick to respond. Neighborhood is a sweet little treasure in town. House and room are cute and comfortable.

One of my priority list during travel was staying in stylish and feasible to go hot places easily and this place was perfect choice🩵 This cozy & clean place will give positive energy to travel and enjoy Paris well Also, warm welcome and quick response from host were another point to recommend

This apartment is fabulous!!! Extremely well decorated and well maintained, and the space was very comfortable for 5 of us in the three bedrooms. The hosts were always extremely responsive and helpful whenever we contacted them with questions. Further, the location is spectacular - across the street from La Samaritaine. We would stay here again in an instant. Fantastic find!
The apartment is very nice, quiet and well located. It is exactly as described, easy walking distance to boulangeries, restaurants and shopping. Everything was good. Thank you for hosting us.
Great place, very central. Could be great with allowable early check in and late check out even at a cost. Otherwise great quite place
Such a beautiful home and a beautiful host. Always helpful and lightning fast responses to messages. She gave me very detailed and clear instructions. i really enjoyed staying here.
Alexandra's place was an absolute dream. I felt like I actually lived in Paris for my entire stay. The decor provides a perfect homey atmosphere!

Loved the stay, the decor is beautiful and colorful. The apartment is located walking distance to many shops and sites. The lockers in the building were very useful to drop off bags before check in, overall a great stay.
Very clear communication and instructions. The doors are a little old and hard to get in but the place is lovely and nice! 😀
Merci Didier for an amazing time in Paris. We felt so at home and it is such a wonderful neighborhood for families. We hope to return soon

This apartment was just phenomenal. Beautiful space with a breathtaking view, a quiet but central location and excellent hosts. Ygal and John answered my questions quickly and were in contact with me frequently before, during and after my stay, and were all around fantastic hosts. 5/5 stars, I would stay here every visit to Paris if I could.
Erwan was ever present to deal with queries and very helpful. Spotless and perfectly located apartment which was perfect for a Christmas break. I will definitely stay again

As a family of 6 - 4 children, this was perfect. Great location, clean, serviced every day. Seamless checkin and departure. Bedrooms not massive but perfectly appointed. I would def stay at another highstay apartment.

Super easy check in and easy to coordinate with. Space is a little smaller than in pictures, but it was cozy and provided all my needs. Neighborhood is close to metro stations and very quiet/safe, but only a few minutes away from restaurants. Will definitely stay here again!

Very helpful and accommodating host. Nice house - accurate description in listing. Really great location, 5-minute walk to the Metro and easy access to every where in central Paris. Montrouge is a terrific little town too. Overall a very positive experience.
Great hosts, super responsive and no fuss. Place was as describe and super comfortable. Would recommend.

Turkan is an extremely gentle lady who was very responsive in answering all of my questions before my arrival. She met me at the apartment and showed me around and that was greatly appreciated. Thank you for everything, Tarkan!

Pierre and Irene are friendly host. It is easy to get to their place using the Metro. The place also seems incredibly safe. It is easy to get to majority of the attractions and you could see the eiffel tower from the room. The guests have their shared bathroom but not much problem to that.
Very well located, with a responsive host and met all our basic needs. Room and toilet are small but if you are organized like my wife and I, you’ll have no problems. Highly recommended!!!

stayed xmas / new year period. Was able to have xmas lunch with all family and new year celebrations, all with views from balcony toward Eiffel tower fireworks NY was special didn't meet Julie, who had already left for her holiday, but check-in worked fine and was flexible with timing. family home, so we treated it as such , all amenities just like home. we were 6 adults and were quite comfortable. very happy being out of central Paris, Montmartre village nearby, and only 6 metro stops to most tourist spots. supermarkets and boulangerie within a 2 minute walk. thanks for allowing us to experience Paris as a "local"
The place was close to champs elysees and the Eiffel Tower. There was the best bakery I've ever tried 2min walk away. Benjamin was very friendly and helpful. Definitely the best location.
Pierre and Irene are a lovely couple. I also love the cats and sweet rabbit. Thank you both for everything.

Amazing location, apartment is comfortable and well laid out, worked great for our extended family of 6. Arianne is very responsive and friendly, and she reached out to make sure we had everything we needed for our stay. We would definitely return!
This house is “the french” house, full of french stuffs which we really were enjoying. Very convinient location and host are very accommodative. Strong recommend!
Thank you Lafkir, you were super responsive, and your place very clean and worked out perfect for our family

Yohann was a terrific host to work with. He was a clear and timely communicator and had everything ready for us when we arrived. The apartment was perfect for our family. The neighborhood was very walkable and we lived the Boulangerie right outside the front door. I would recommend this place to any family coming to spend a few walkable days in Paris.
An absolute amazing “home” to experience Paris Benoit was super helpful and responsive I can’t even begin to describe the view!
Great place for our family trip. Walking distance to a lot of restaurants, department stores, etc. will definitely come back again.

Excellent accommodation with friendly, helpful but unobtrusive hostess. Her living onsite is great asset; no problem gaining access on arrival, was there to sort out any issues should they have arisen (none did). A 10 / 15 minute walk to the nearest Metro stations, but through a pleasant district.

The host was friendly, very responsive and the apartment was clean and fit well with the description and pictures. Cosy, comfortable and overall quiet, whilst in the middle of an attractive neighbourhood in Paris. The building itself is unimpressive, but once in the flat, you feel right at home. The dinner table being set up when we arrived and bottled water in each room were extra perks that were appreciated and not commonly found in Airbnb. To provide a fair review, we initially had issues with the heating system in the master bedroom (unknown to the owner, the bedroom controller wasn't functioning). The host was helpful throughout the process and promptly provided extra heaters that made us feel right at home. the host very kindly offered some chocolates at the end of our trip.
We loved the appartment! We felt like home - we had everything what we needed! The location is brilliant. We will for sure come back! Merci mille fois Sebastian!
Lovely space and a very comfortable bed! Well situated and away from the main road so it was peaceful at night. Victorine is responsive and communicative. Would recommend!

Thanks so much. We had a great time. Sabine’s apartment is in a great location, and we loved all of the natural light. It was very comfortable and we had everything we needed. Easy check in/out. Highly recommend!
Elegantly decorated and cosy apartment in fantastic St Germain area of Paris! And the hostess is amazing - every time I come to the apartment I feel I came home !

We booked very last minute - Joy was incredibly quick to respond and provide all check in details. The apartment has incredible views and is right next to the Avron metro stop, Blue line. Incredibly convenient location to reach main Paris attractions. Thank you so much, Joy!
Was a pleasure staying at Ben’s place, everything was exactly as listed and his communication was fantastic. He made the stay easy and comfortable, would definitely stay again

Lovely little place, great location and has all the things you would need, despite the room being quite small in size. Walls are quite thin, so you can sometimes hear loud neighbours but otherwise was a lovely place with nearby shops and restaurants and good transport links.

A lovely flat in a gentle and comfortable neighborhood. Easy access to subway to see all of Paris. Stylish and relaxing space. Lift was very functional but too small for larger people. Tub has handheld shower, everything is neat and efficient, place was warm even in early January. Nathalie was the perfect hostess and we appreciated her kindness from start to finish. It was the perfect place for the 2 of us!

I really liked staying at this place. It was in a central location, the room was comfortable, and it had all the services that were announced. Bathroom had heating which I really loved. I would stay there again.

This place is stunning. A beautifully located b&b with a delicious breakfast we had served in our room each morning. Very clean and comfortable bedding with stylish decor, high ceilings, gorgeous floor. We had a slight issue with checkin when we had to wait 45 minutes in the corridor before someone arrived but it was all resolved quickly. Honestly, heartily recommend. We will be back. Thank you for making my anniversary trip so magical and memorable. ☺

The apartment was spacious, clean and in an ideal location. It was just a few minutes walk to the Eiffel Tower, grocery store, metro, wonderful Boulangeries and great restaurants. It is well equipped. We were pleased that it was a ground floor unit, it made it so easy to bring our luggages in and out. Vanessa was a pleasure to communicate with. We look forward to staying in the future.

This place is a gem. Nestled right in a superb neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and shops right in the vicinity. The unit is cozy and set up perfectly for a comfortable stay with everything you need right there for your convenience. The orientation of the apartment is well thought out and you certainly get your money's worth. I enjoyed it thoroughly.
Our group of four really enjoyed the stay. Very close to lots of cafes and the metro station. We thought the one toilet was a little odd, but it wasn’t really a problem
Fun area to stay! Instructions made it easy to find. The hosts were very helpful and always there to answer any questions.

Beautiful little apartment! everything is brand new and clean and superbly designed. Walkable distance to many shops and restaurants. Cindy was an excellent host, and her house manual is incredible - you can find absolutely all the information you need in it. Highly recommend this place to other travelers.

This is a beautiful apartment in one of the most dynamic and centrally located neighborhoods in Paris. And it’s worth from marking upon how truly beautiful and well equipped the apartment is — you ieverything you need at your finger and it’s well designed and really just spectacular. We absolutely loved it and would love to come back to this exact apartment. Our hosts were so helpful and kind. They met us upon arrival and explained everything in the apartment and then also gave us some wonderful tips about the neighborhood.

The place is modern, comfortable, and clean. A great location near the metro and many of the main attractions are within an 20 minute walk. Elsa was lovely and very responsive. I would absolutely rent this place or another place of Elsa’s again.

Elsa’s place was extremely clean and exactly as described. It’s located right by the Seine river in a very safe & secure area. As a host she not only would respond right away making sure my needs are met but also reached out periodically to make sure everything is in good order. Would definitely stay again if I’m ever in Paris.

Hélène and Alain are very friendly and lovely hosts. Gave me great recommendations on what to do, assisting with my travels for the whole duration of my stay. The space is clean and in a great location too.

Marie's place was beautiful, perfect for what I needed from an airbnb. The place was clean, and had hot water, full kitchen, clean towels, and on ground level which was amazing. I had actually gotten my necklace stolen off the metro coming back from a club. The only issue was that I had put the key to the airbnb around my neck and they stole it too. I had messaged Marie around 5am and she responded and let me go to another airbnb location near the one I booked until she came and put another key in the lockbox for me. I was able to get in around 8am and get everything together and packed before my train took off at 10am.
Absolutely incredible Airbnb; beautiful inside and out, perfect central location, amazingly responsive hosts. Super spacious and full of character. Would definitely stay again!
Clara’s place is clean, decorated well, safe and near to tourists sight. Clara is very responsive! Thanks very much for such a great place.
I would absolutely stay here again. It was the perfect location, in a busy neighborhood but tucked away and quiet.

Peggy's flat was super convenient and well located for experiencing all of the main tourist attractions in Paris. Being a stones throw from the Brochant Metro was awesome, but it is also on many convenient bus lines, which was helpful for our older relatives when the stairs in the Metro became too much. The flat itself was beautiful and has loads of character. Peggy was also an excellent communicator and made it easy to stay there. We would highly recommend her flat for anyone adventuring to Paris!

The location is incredible, and the closest metro stop is right in front of the building. It was great for me as single person who spent most of their time out and about, but might be a bit cozy for a couple (especially if they have slightly different sleep schedules since the bed takes up a lot of space when it isn't folded away). There's a shelf above the heater that warms up quite a bit, which makes it a nice spot to put your coffee but not a chocolate bar :) Stephane was super helpful and responsive, which was really nice. I'd stay again if the opportunity came up!

Justin's place is beautiful, very convenient and in a great location. Shower is great and works perfectly, bed is comfortable, large and spacious living room and well equipped kitchen. I would happily return here in my frequent visits to Paris. Thank you Justin!

The host was extremely kind, helpful and proactive! He was very welcoming and friendly! The air bnb was one of the best we’ve stayed at! Thank you Richard, and we know we will back the next time we come to Paris!

We had a lovely stay at Mandana’s place! It was the perfect apartment for our time in Paris. Great location in Bastille. Mandana was very helpful and always checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. Would highly recommend her apartment if you want to feel right at home 🙂

That was ok but the smell of the apartment was so bad!!! The flat needs a better cleaning!!! The neighborhood is safe and full of local friendly people. The host had a so well organized home book and gave us on time all the information needed.

An amazing place to stay, the coziness, and view I experienced was nothing less than a luxurious 5 star hotel…Totally recommend it, thank you Ygal, and Levy for making are stay an unforgettable moment.
I really had the best time here. The owner responds straight away to all of your questions. The position is awesome, I managed to reach all of the important places by feet. I would recommend it 100%
Clemence was wonderful and so helpful! the apartment is gorgeous, in a lovely neighborhood, and in pristine condition. I would 100% recommend anyone stay here

For one night in Paris was perfect! Definitely only for one person, but very clean and everything I needed. The stairs were a bit exhausting (6 flights), but that is extremely common in Paris. 5 minutes to trocadero and trains to the rest of the city, so very accessible. Beverly was so helpful. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.
We spent a wonderful stay at Monique’s apartment. The view is breathtaking and the location perfect. Everything went smoothly and we felt very confortable. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful stay at Yan's house. We particularly loved his accommodating attitude and quick communication (even with his sister) and the easy check-in procedure. The house is well located, in the heart of Montmartre, and is near two metro station and many restaurants.
Great location and a wonderful apartment for family or/and close friends to be together in such a cold season in Paris!

Incredible stay at this apartment! Alexandre was very helpful, communicative and gave great recommendations. The apartment was tidy, comfortable and better than the photos. The neighbourhood was lively and a little less touristy with lots of great restaurants, cafes and grocery stores nearby, and it was close to many galleries and attractions. I would definitely stay again!

Beautiful place and very comfortable. It is directly on a busy street so a little noisy but very convenient to restaurants and shops. The neighborhood is a little sketchy in the evenings. Marie was an excellent host with great communication.

Good location, but that’s about it. It was a bait and switch. The listing had pictures of then upper floor and gave me a different apartment on the 2nd floor and refused to change apartments. The bathroom had a sewage smell and the sink was clogged. Terrible

Absolutely loved staying here. Amazing location, lots of light, a great place to come home to every day, and it felt like home. Mao is incredibly friendly, helpful, and communicative. I would love to stay here again during a future trip.

Perfect little place on a very good location in Paris. Has a lot of charm! Aurelien is a very good and friendly host and made us feel very welcome. Perfect place to stay as a couple or like us, with a baby :)

Perfect place for 2 in Paris! The neighborhood felt very safe to walk around even at night. The metro is a very short distance away too! Definitely looked a bit bigger in pictures but the space was cozy enough for me and my friend. Cindy was easy to reach and overall a great host and great experience here!

We loved staying at Edgar’s place. I had to travel quite a bit for work so the closeness to the metro was perfect - I could be on the train in 2 minutes. The location is also a very close walk along the river where you get a beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower at night. The local supermarkets and restaurants were also great. The apartment was very homely and easy to function. It is a modern space with lovely interiors and all of the amenities you could need. I hope to stay at Edgar’s again when I come to Paris. He was a very attentive and generous host.
Great place, great decoration and super practical location. Quite noisy at night as there are lot of bars around.

Wonderful stay at Monique's place, really great location in Latin Quarter, Monique and her husband are very friendly and nice people. The room very clean with stunning view of outside Paris. Would definitely love to come back!

Very centrally located, well furnished appartment. Typical Parisian flat which was quite spacious for the city (for 3 adults and 2 kids). Many restaurants, pharmacy and shops within walking distance including Les Halles (Châtelet). Small elevator was useful for larger suitcases and young kids who don’t want to walk the 4 floors. Hosts were responsive for any questions.

Such a fantastic stay, one of if not the favourite place I have stayed. Super kind and responsive host, the friendliest pets and a beautiful home. Close to several metro lines and an even closer bus stop. Painless check in with detailed instructions. Would absolutely recommend and stay again.
Great flat for a family of five. We walked to most of the sights and loved the location - everything we needed was literally on our doorstep.

A great stay at this place. Check in was easy and flexible with good responses from the host. The studio itself was clean and exactly as described. Loads of local amenities, including restaurants, cafes, bakery and fast food. The host recommended some great places to eat and party. The surrounding area of the flat is very secure in a quiet area.
Denka is an incredibly friendly and amenable host. Her apartment was exactly as described and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We would definitely return. Thank you so much for your hospitality.

The view of the Eiffel is absolutely magnificent. The location is safe and convenient. Check-in and check-out were flexible and comfortable. Furniture and kitchenware were also delicately prepared. I'm sure it's a better than a picture. It was an impeccable stay. I hope to visiting again.

It was a very clean apartment, easy to locate and near metro stations. It was very spacious and well decorated. But no coffees or teas. It was an amazing place regardless for our first stay in Paris!!!

A perfect location to explore Paris: you can walk in any direction and come to one of the main attractions in 30 minutes max: Eiffel tower to the west, Luxembourg garden to the east, Orsay, Notre-Dam and Louvre to the north... And the whole neighborhood is very cozy and walkable with great restaurants in a great price range. The subway station is in a few minutes walk which makes everything even more accessible! However, there is definitely wide lens magic taking place with the photos: the apartment is much smaller than it appears, beware 😅 So even though it can accomodate up to 4 people, I wouldn't recommend getting it for more than 2 people and using the mezzanine bed: it gets quite stuffy up there. Entirely possble though, especially if you plan on only using it to sleep at nights and spend most of your time out in the city

The apartment is actually a lot bigger in person than what’s shown on the listing. It has 3 bedrooms 2 bathrooms and q toilet. It overlooks an internal courtyard. The place is nice, clean, and provide all the amenities needed for our stay. The location is great, and there are a lot of cute boutique shops around. The host was very responsive and very accomodating for our request of early check in. The place has a lift, which is super handy, and rare to find in Paris in my personal opinion. Checking in and out were both really easy as well.
The location is 10/10. A walk to the eiffel tower took 25 minutes, the metro station is 2 minutes away. The place is very clean, just like the pictures

Checking in was easy. Paul met us at the door and gave us a quick tour of our room. It was private and Paul left us be but was always there when we would need him. Just drop him a message and he would answer pretty quickly. Location was perfect, plenty of cafes and places to eat and about 20 min walk to the Eiffel Tower. If you love Italian food, I would 100% recommend Firmine which is right by the Eiffel Tower. Probably the best ragu bolognese I have ever had.
Beautiful place to stay. As described and felt extremely safe - perfect place if you’re going to moulin rouge. Thank you
Vanessa i s a great guy, and we enjoyed our stay. It's quiet and clean. It is convenient to shop nearby, very close to the subway station. I will recommend it to my friends.

Christophe’s place was exactly what we wanted and needed for our Paris stay. We loved the quiet, the view, the tranquility offered at night with the blackout blinds. We had a great visit and Christophe was very kind and helpful from checkin to checkout. Thanks!

Incredibly beautiful home. The room is literally gorgeous and spacious. The bed is super comfy and the breakfast cart feels like a movie. Everything within the room feels very updated. Would stay here 100x again. Such a marvelous experience
This is an excellent place to stay in Paris. Happy is very accommodating, gracious and her apartment homey and easily accessible. I will definitely plan to return. The pets were an added asset.

I had a great time with my family at this apartment in Paris. Perfect for 3-4 travelers., close to the metro and lots to do in the area. We did have a little trouble with the lockbox for self check in but Brothers Care was very responsive and quick to solve the problem. Thank you for all your help and being so quick to answer any questions. I would definitely recommend the apartment here in Paris 18e. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

This was the most amazing experience. I feel so lucky to have experienced Paris for the first time through this apartment and neighborhood. We found the restaurants to be excellent and loved that it was less touristy but you could easily hop on the metro and get anywhere in 20 minutes. We had everything we needed in the apartment. The beds were comfy. The views are beyond belief. I just loved it and would love to return.

Delphine is a gracious host and one of the best I have had over the years of being on AirBNB. Easy to reach and always helpful. if you want to feel at home and like you are a real Persian and not just a tourist then you found the right place. I am looking forward to returning to Paris and hopefully get to stay with her again.
The place is next to the train stop and there’s noise and a lot of people and traffic due to that . The good thing is you are close to the Eiffel Tower and restaurants on the area

Overall it was a good four nights, the location is very good, a short walk to the Louvre, the room was very clean and the kitchen facilities are new! The only thing that could be improved was that the temperature of the bath water couldn't stay stable for a long time.

Very very noisy flat as the door opens directly onto the building entrance. From 5am there is a steady stream of banging and voices. Also the balcony appears to be part of the flat but actually it’s not.
Beautiful loft surrounded by hidden neighborhood gems! Lively street nearby but actual building is quiet and residential. Felt comfortable and safe, and overall really enjoyed our stay!

Great location. Great layout. Tiphaine was a very nice host and was flexible on our check-in time. We had small kids with us and it was a perfect location. Great WiFi. The greatest recommendation is staying at the same place again. We would without hesitation.
Beautiful space! Was spotless, had very comfy beds, and in such a great area. Had everything we needed and more! Marine has great replies and was so helpful. Couldn’t recommend more
Elsa was very nice , apartment is exactly as described. Excellent location. Hope to be back soon. Thank you

Anne was a very kind and friendly host. She was very responsive and helpful and made me feel very welcome. She gave great tips and clear instructions. The apartment is beautifully decorated, quiet, and clean. I will definitely stay here again next time I am in Paris.
Good place but need some improvements for the tv and light remote. This apartment was very clean and accessible.

We loved our stay at Georges and Sylvie's apartment! The location can't be beat and is a short walk away from lots of great bakeries, cafes, and restaurants. The apartment was also very well stocked and laid out, and Dimitri was extremely helpful in checking us in and making sure that we had everything we needed. Would love to stay again the next time we're in Paris.

Amazing area the metro is very close to get around the Emily in Paris restaurant & fountain is literally down the street it feels very safe even at night the building has a code which feels extremely safe the only downside I had was no WiFi & having to share restrooms but that is listed so I can’t complain would stay again the area is extremely nice in my opinion would recommend if you do not mind not having the things I listed

We stayed at Marc's place with 6 adults and a baby. The purpose of our visit was primarily to spend time with family, and secondarily to tour Paris. As such Marcs place was wonderful. Located in a quite, less touristy neighborhood of Paris, close to the Gare du Nord train station (which we used to get to Amsterdam after our visit), we felt right at home. The house is as described, and as appears in the photos. To begin we were greated by his assistant Nathalie who speaks fluent english and helped us check in and familiarize ourselves. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook. The washing machined worked well. The house is supplied with shampoo and body wash. The living room is spacious. The beds have good quality cushions and sheets. In all the place is great and highly recommended.

We had an amazing time at Paul’s place. Everything about his place was as described. Location is super close to the Eiffel Tower and the neighborhood is peaceful to stroll through. I would definitely recommend staying here if you’re planning a trip to Paris.
It was clean and cosy studio ... Small but good for me as solo traveler... safe neighborhood and surrounded by many supermarkets and restaurants and shops ... Train station is in walkable distance...
Gorgeous space situated in a fabulous neighbourhood of Paris. Very closed to everything, yet wasn’t too noisy. Haiyan was corporative and very helpful, will stay there again.

This stay was excellent. Beautiful unit with everything you would need for a comfortable stay, spacious and really well designed. Everything was clean and in good condition. Tatiana was very responsive and made the stay seamless, highly recommend!

The apartment is situated close to the Louvre and close to two metro stations, which made accessing attractions across Paris very easy. Check-in and accessing the apartment was very easy with clear instructions. The apartment is well-furnished, modern and completely renovated, spacious, and well-appointed. Well worth the money and the stay. I highly recommend. Thank you for a great stay!

Clémence's apartment is the perfect stay in Paris. I hope the next time in Paris I can stay here again, she was so great to communicate with and I had such an amazing time in this apartment on a work trip. This is an ideal stay and perfectly described apartment. 10/10

Very nice place with a great accommodation. Everything is close and you can walk to see all the attraction :) The apartment is very small but well organized, it’s enough for 2people if you mostly want to be outside. I truly recommend this place.
I had such a great time in Paris. The location was a short walk from the station. I would highly recommend!
Met by friend of Mao at access. Place was very clean, some road noise but location overrid this.
I stayed with Frederique again, and as always she was so sweet and her place so pretty! I would recommend always to stay with her!
