Seamus was also extremely communicative whenever we had questions and gave us lots of great recommendations. We'd definitely come back.

Alexis was a fantastic host from start to finish. Very responsive and attentive to our needs. The apartment was pristine, in a fantastic location,a really great find and superb base to explore Paris. Would highly recommend!

My new favorite place to stay in the Marais with our two small children. A beautiful couple hosting their beautiful home. Much thought and consideration has gone into this place. Recent, very modern, and sensible renovations while retaining the soul and integrity of emblematic hausmann architecture. Close to everything - the best boulangeries, bistros, museums, and restaurants. Perfect. Home away from home.

I had a fantastic stay at Erwan's flat and was one of the best Airbnb experiences I've had. Erwan's apartment is in a great location with many restaurants, bars and places to shop yet the flat itself was very quiet and peaceful. The flat was very clean, beautifully decorated and matches the photos completely. Erwan was an extremely friendly and communicative host both via the app and text and even left a bottle of wine as a welcome gift. Instructions on how to get into the apartment were very clear and he was nice enough to offer me a late check out without me even asking. I would 100% recommend staying at Erwin's flat during your next trip to Paris - I know it won't be my last time staying there 🙂.

Bruno has such a fabulous apartment! On the fourth floor but can get to it with an elevator! Close to the metro station and many dinner spots! Bruno also let us check out late since our flight was late and that was so amazing and kind! Would recommend!!
Beautiful view and perfect for our plans in Paris this time! Comfortable and easy to get around the area. Would definitely stay again!

Loved it! Great location (slightly away from the tourist areas in a REAL Paris neighborhood), with a subway stop (Place de la Republique) that is extremely well-connected (five different lines) to all of the Paris. Comfortable and modern furnishings, bedrooms aren’t that big but the living room / kitchen / dining areas is large and airy, with windows onto a chic and typical Parisian street. Close (less than 10 minute walk) to tons of restaurants/ grocery stores / shops / parks / other cool stuff. Good value, would definitely stay there again!

We loved how quiet the apartment was at night. The garden helped insulate city noise. Great shops and cafes, bakeries, just a short walk up the street behind the apartment. Everything you need to stock the apartment is very close.
Great location! Walking distance to most major tourist locations. plenty of restaurants around. Our family had a great time here
Great location. Very central. Easy to get anywhere quickly in the city from this home base. Fourth floor walk-up is a little tough with suitcases but once in, it is spacious and comfortable.
Great place to stay in Paris! Easy check-in and the apartment was very clean. Also great communication by the host when we had some small issues with the kitchen. Would stay here again!
Josephine is a good host. The apartment has a great location in the middle of a busy and lively area, right next to a central station. Highly recommend!

Sophie’s place was exactly what we needed! This was the perfect spot for us as a duo returning to Paris who were not planning to be home often. Great location in the 17th that feels very safe and quiet but is still close to both the metro and RER. Easy to find restaurants nearby and Sophie has plenty of recommendations. Would absolutely come back!

Overall we enjoyed our stay at Georges apartment and it was as pictured. The beds were comfortable and our every need was attended to. The apartment is very well supplied - it seems like the owner lives there part of the year as it is fully stocked and there are lots of family photos around. Having the bedrooms off the courtyard gave us a quiet environment for sleeping which was appreciated. The not as good - the wood flooring as it is very rough and my daughter got an enormous splinter in her foot even through her sock. The walk to the Metro was a bit longer than we expected (15 minutes) and the surrounding neighborhood was not as clean as we would have hoped.
I had a great stay at Pierre’s apartment! It had a great little kitchen and spacious living room. I would definitely go back!

Really a pleasant place for a short stay in Paris, easy to reach almost all famous spots in Paris. Ling is super friendly and provides support before and during our stay. Will definitely recommend this place.

The location was perfect for my family of 4 (two teens) for our 3 night stay. We walked everywhere and Metro was super convenient. The Pompidou is visible from the balcony and so many dining options within a short walk. The front bedroom was louder than the rear, but to be expected on a major street in Paris. Although we didn't spend much time there, the balcony was just what we were looking for and was used every moment we were in the apt. The photos are accurate and beds were great. The Wifi was as struggle but David and even the apt owner jumped in to help trouble shoot with us. We had a wonderful time in Paris and likely due to the convenient location of the apartment.

Had a great stay at Daniel's place in Paris! Lovely and spacious apartment, contains everything you need (incl. all supplies as promised were there, e.g. shampoo, shower gel, towels, kitchen utensils) and great location as well! Nice neighbourhood with lots of cute places to eat and drink. Daniel is an awesome host, very friendly, always clear and quick communication, can answer all your questions and he's very flexible! He even spontaneously offered us a late check-out on our last day :) In short, great apartment with everything there as mentioned on the website, central location and great reliable host! Recommended!

We had the best stay at this apartment! The location was absolutely perfect, super central, right in the heart of Paris. The flat was really cute, very clean and comfortable and Maroussia was friendly and gave us great recommendations of things to do in Paris. Thank you so much, we will definitely be back!
A little smaller than expected and no windows so it gets a little musty but overall good for the price and in a decent location away from most of the crowded areas.
Supercute place with great location. Nice and clean. We really enjoyed Pauline’s place and would love to stay there again.
We had an amazing stay here. Great location in a peaceful neighborhood with lots of food nearby. Beautiful views from the private room. I recommend!

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in the 15th arrondissement of Paris. The apartment was incredibly calm, clean, and safe, providing a perfect retreat after a day of exploring the city. Its location is excellent, just a 5-minute walk to the Metro Line 10, making it easy to get around. The Eiffel Tower is a pleasant 20-minute walk away, ideal for evening strolls. We appreciated the convenience of having an Auchan supermarket right below the apartment, which made grocery shopping a breeze. Highly recommend this place for a comfortable and convenient stay in Paris!

We had a great 6 night stay, a great space, convenient location to restaurants, bakeries, Basilique du Sacré-Cœur and train stations. The shower had great water pressure, it was fabulous to have the grocery store downstairs, an elevator and multiple secure doors to access the building. We also greatly appreciated having access to a washing machine/drier. We would stay here again! Merci!
Cute and nice studio. Lovely and very helpful host. Great neighborhood, supermarket, public transportation and a park within walking distance. Definitely a good spot to stay when in Paris!

Our stay at this Airbnb was fantastic! The apartment looked exactly like the photos – stylish and spotless. Didier was incredible. He welcomed us with a nice bottle of wine and was super friendly and responsive throughout our stay. It really felt like staying at a friend's place. The apartment had such a cozy vibe; it felt like a home away from home. Plus, the location was perfect – just a short walk to the metro, and there was a supermarket and bakery downstairs for everything we needed. Overall, we had an amazing time here. We would definitely recommend it and would love to stay again next time we're in Paris. Huge thanks to Didier for making our trip so enjoyable!
Overall, we had a great stay here. Very clean space and a great location. I would recommend!
Great location and Aude was a pleasure to work with. The apartment was lovely with great light and a balcony over looking local neighborhood. We will definitely stay here again.
Bruno’s place is wonderful and it is filled with amazing views! You will not be disappointed.
It is a great spot to discover Paris! The bikes where super handy. The hosts reacted super fast and are friendly and helpful.
Lafkir was friendly and very responsive. The location was easy walking distance to Eiffel tower and many other great spots.

Absolutely loved this Airbnb for our family of 5 that visited. It was perfect! And makes us want to come back again and again in Paris. Stunning apartment and great service and super responsive team. Great location. One of the highlights of our trip was staying at this place! Also booked roundtrip airport transport and it was so so easy! Thanks again for a wonderful time!

At the heart of Paris, Leo’s apartment is the ideal place to visit the city. It’s very close to subway and train stations so it’s very easy to find and commute. The elevator is really helpful when you have to carry the luggage. Very clean and very cosy, exactly as shown in the pictures. However, it was rather small for a family of four. It’s ideal for a couple.
This was a great place to stay. So close to the train. We could get anywhere quickly. Lots of great food options nearby and obviously, the Eiffel Tower is just a block away.
Great location. Denis was very helpful & easy to get a hold of. Perfect for a couple, would probably be cramped for more than 2 people but I'm sure most places in Paris would be.

We loved our stay at Yang’s apartment! It’s not huge but it was the perfect size for two people and in an amazing location. Yang was very responsive and a super helpful host, with lots of great neighborhood recommendations. Would definitely stay again!

A great place to stay for our Paris vacation. The Metro station is literally right across the street giving us easy access to get around the city. Spacious updated home and very comfortable sleeping arrangements. Would come back again!

Thanks Jean-Luc, my wife and I and our two teenagers very much enjoyed our stay. The flexibility of having two bedrooms and a sofa bed in the lounge was perfect for the four of us. Your place was clean, secure, private and quiet. Blade fans in every room meant that the warmer weather was no big deal. Not having physical keys meant we could easily come and go whether as a group or individually. We liked the area of Les Halles and access to everything on the doorstep. Jean-Luc was very responsive and I felt like if we had any issues (which we didn’t) they would have been resolved quickly and easily. Would stay again. Phil.

The place was awesome and Catherine was the perfect host. The apartment was in a very walkable neighborhood. Close several different metro stops and delicious bistros and cafes. The Seine was lively each night and was a nice spot to have a drink and/or picnic. The apartment was quiet and the A/C was nice to have after a long day. Highly recommend. Thank you for everything Catherine!

Kaza Bella is a brand new renovation. As this is the case it is spotless and exactly as the photos show. Often properties are exaggerated or misleading however this unit is perhaps better than is shown through the pictures. Location is steps away from Le Marais, the metro, cafes, bars etc. However, it is on a side street which gives it a sense of tranquility. Given the size of the space over two levels, the amenities included and location, you will definitely find value for your stay compared to any hotel or Airbnb in the same location and category. Again, the space is brand new, this is an opportunity not to be missed. Book this unit.
this is a great place to stay, you can walk to the eiffel tower from there, you have supermarkets and restaurants close to the place
Perfect Location. Great furniture and the space is huge for Paris…. Right now the common areas are in renovation…

Hélène’s place is very cute and located near small shops and restaurants. It is very easy to access the metro and get around all of Paris as well! The room is very clean, artistic and you basically get your own floor of the home with a private bathroom. Would recommend:)

The apartment matches the pictures. Venessa is a great host. I’m really grateful to her. As others have mentioned there is a strong and unpleasant drain smell in the apartment. But it has everything you need

Great location, very quiet apartment, safe and secure. Short Uber ride or walk to all the attractions. Great cafes and restaurants all in walking distance, grocery store close by also. Kevin was very communicative and clear and concise with check-in, a great host. A place where you live like the Parisian’s.

A perfect location in the heart of the Marais! Yohann was there waiting for us when we arrived and we loved the place. Walking distance from many sites and easy access to the metro for the rest. Would stay again. Highly recommend!

10/10 location. A great neighborhood in Paris & the unit is centrally located. Close to many metro and bus stops to go anywhere in Paris. Comfortable unit(s) that are well equipped. Very helpful & responsive host. Perfect for two small families or a larger group. Merci

Saying the location of this apartment is amazing would be an understatement. It is very walkable and plenty to do in the area. Lively restaurants steps from the apartment, and just a short walk away from the Seine River. The apartment is more spacious and pleasant than the pictures look. A full bath upstairs with the two bedrooms and a half bath downstairs in the common area. It is a 2 floor apartment that takes up the two top floors of the building. We loved our stay and would recommend highly if you're looking for walkability.

I love this neighborhood of Paris, and being so close to Place des Vosges was very special. Staying in this humble apartment felt very true to the neighborhood. Nothing artificial. Excellent communication and flexibility.

The apartment is very nice! It was exceptionally clean when we arrived. It is a small apartment, but it is very efficiently and delicate furnished. All important remedies are present. Even if it is located right by the street, there was not much noise from outside. The area is very nice also with a small grocery store, pharmacy and restaurants right outside. I will recommend Marie's place to others 😊

My family and I loved our stay at Claire’s flat on rue Montorguil. The flat is clean and well stocked with fresh towels and linens. All the amenities were in great working order. The location is amazing, with attractions, restaurants and shops all within short walking or close metro distances. I wish we could have stayed longer and I would recommend this place to anyone else!
Very responsive and helpful hosts. Nice place was comfortable even for 4 adults. Very beautiful and modern
We had a great long weekend at the flat - it’s a great location to explore Paris and we enjoyed walking to lots of different food and drink spots. Thank you Aurélien!
Great place for our family of 5! Close to Metro, very clean, responsive hosts! Would definitely recommend!

What a wonderful, centrally located apartment. We really enjoyed our stay, wished we could stay longer, and would stay here again. The Metro was steps away and thus all Paris has to offer was right outside the door. Our stay flew by as we explored the area and took in the sights and Yang's place proved perfect for recharging for another day's wandering.
Great, comfortable stay at the apartment. It’s huge and has everything you need including a washer! Thanks Haiyan for being a great, responsive host

The Marais neighborhood is my favourite place to stay in Paris, great vibe and stylish, easily walk to everywhere and full of restaurants, cool shops etc. Vincent’s apartment is very quiet, new, and comfortable for a large family. I highly recommend the place!!!

We loved staying here! It was a great area for us, as it was walkable to so many things. Metro was literally right there as well. It was enough space and bathrooms for our family of 6 (4 kids ages 8-15), although the stairs would be very difficult for young children or older adults. We liked that quality shampoo/conditioner etc was provided, as well as Nespresso pods. We loved the Boulangerie nearby for an easy quick breakfast. Will miss staying in this area! Great place, felt safe and right in the mix of Paris!
Super historical apartment in an amazing part of Paris. Guillaume was great and made some suggestions for us while in Paris. Our family of 4 loved it. If I return to Paris I will stay there again.
Mostly excellent, but was very noisy from the Metro underneath and not enough hot water. But still a great place to stay

A gem in Paris. Benoit’s apartment is one of the best places I’ve been to. Quirky, cute, fun, superb location. It is on the 7th floor, in the attic (with a lift) with five windows looking at the Sacré-Cœur. The perfect Parisian cliché that’s actually works as a home. Absolutely brilliant.
Perfect spot in a beautiful neighborhood. We loved this quiet flat, tucked away over a courtyard. Great location close to cafes and small shops. We highly recommend for a family.

This place was the epitome of a French apartment in neighborhood whose French charm knew no bounds. If you have wondered after watching a romantic French movie if places like that exist, this is prove they do. With it comes the expense. This is not the cheapest area yet which apartment 5 minutes away from a natural monument and tourist icon would be. In this case that being the Effiel Tower which towered over us displaying it majestic beauty daily as we ate dinner at one of many restaurants to choose from. The only issues we had was the WiFi did not work, and there was 1 roll of toilet paper for 2 bathrooms for a 3 day visit. Lastly, our host agent did not meet us for check in, however they were very responsive when I called and got that rectified immediately. Overall, this apartment and neighborhood is lthe setting to live a romantic French dream.
Excellent location to explore Paris. 100 m to Metro and many good eateries and bakeries.
Loved staying here. Anne was so responsive and the apartment has so many great toys for my 16 month old daughter. Charming and will definitely stay here again.
Sofia’s place was great choice for my daughter and I. Close to Metro and just few stops away from the major attractions! Wonderful host and we had a great time in Paris! Thank you!

Katia and Thomas were wonderful hosts. Location was superb! Lots of great restaurants and cafes we could walk to. We were able to even take a stroll to the Louvre! Apartment was spacious and beautiful - made lots of great memories with family hanging out on the oversized balcony!! When our flight got cancelled, Katia and Thomas were so flexible and let us extend our stay for one night which reduced our stress levels trying to rebook flights. I can’t say enough good things about our stay - we are so blessed. We were able to make lifelong memories and can’t wait to come back to Paris! Thank you Katia and Thomas - you and your place are Fabulous!!
Great place, great location, great host - will be using for all our Paris trips going forwards!

Sandra’s place was very comfortable and in an excellent location. It is on the upper floor and has incredible views throughout the apartment and it is located in a very walkable neighborhood that has great food and activities around. It is also just a quick walk to the metro. It is not self check in, so make sure to communicate with Sandra about when you will be arriving at the apartment so she can meet you. Overall, it is a great apartment to stay in while in Paris!

Jean-Christophe was the perfect host. We loved our stay with him and can't wait to return to Paris to visit again. He was so friendly and welcoming - it felt like we were staying with a friend. Such an interesting guy with a very interesting home! The place was very beautiful and the location was good too. Only negative was the bed wasn't so comfy, but everything else was great so we wouldn't hesitate to come back. Merci Jean-Christophe!

We had a wonderful stay at this charming and spacious apartment! We had everything we needed and loved our evenings on the Terrasse. The neighborhood is great with easy metro, train and bus connections and is a lovely 15 minute walk from Notre Dame. We thoroughly enjoyed the excellent restaurants and cafes nearby. Nadir was simply wonderful and always responsive. Thanks again for making us feel like locals while in Paris!

Monique and Jean Noel’s place is perfect for a trip to Paris – close to everything by foot, very clean and comfy. Being next to Rue Mouffetard means great bakeries and bistros whenever you need them. They are excellent hosts – very welcoming and helpful with any requests we had. Highly recommend!

Loved the place! The hosts were very responsive and helpful. The place is very nice and perfect for two people. Sleek wall mirrors were a great touch, and we liked the decor. The bedrooms got quite warm, but the overhead fans were a great relief. I'd only say the toilet was a little bit loose, but other than that, a really nice stay for a weekend. Would recommend!

Self check in was smooth! This place was a 20 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower which was very convenient. The view is amazing! However, the space being small was not the problem , it was more that the place had a slightly unclean feel and felt mildly unsanitary the time we stayed there.
Helena and her husband are very friendly and kind. The room is exactly as shown on the website.
Loved my stay at Ines! Just fyi this is a top floor walk up so be prepared. Besides that loved it!!

Me and my three young ones (10, 9, 5) stayed here on our first trip to Paris. The location is unmatched. Walkable to everything and after walking the city for five days I’m not sure I would have wanted to be located anywhere else. Catherine is a very responsive and helpful host and I would certainly stay with her again.
Beautiful home in a great neighborhood! It could be a little loud since the windows are street facing and it's a heavy tourist area but overall it was wonderful.

This is a beautiful apartment. Anne met us there when we arrived and even had some toys for my children to play with, which was unexpected and a big hit with my girls. The location is very walkable and despite being in the heart of everything we had no issues with noise from the neighborhood bothering us while we were sleeping. I would happily stay here again!

Pascal’s place was one of the most beautiful Airbnb’s we have ever stayed in! The view alone is worth every penny we paid, and location and the beautiful home is just an added bonus! Pascal was so friendly and helpful. Definitely the kind of Airbnb host you want. I truly had a hard time leaving this Airbnb when it was time to check out, I cannot emphasize how amazing it was to spend the mornings and evenings out on the terrace overlooking the beautiful city of Paris. The home is very close to the metro station which will take you to the center of Paris easily. as mentioned in the description, there are a good amount of stairs to climb to reach the home, which is something to note. I hope to return one day and spend even more time in this home, if you are reading this look no further and book now.

If you love shopping, this location is for you! It is close to Printemps Haussmann. Also walking distance to Palais Garnier. Many restaurants and metro around. There was still construction when we stayed here and if you are not a morning person, definitely think about booking this or make sure if it is finished already. They start around 8 am. Another thing to point out is there’s only 1 toilet- very small space and would not work if you are claustrophobic or heavy/tall. Overall, we had a wonderful stay. The beds/pillow are comfortable.. kitchen has basic needs.. Michael was responsive.. will probably stay again if we come back.
Perfect for a few days in Paris! Alex and Pablo were extremely communicative and helpful! Would recommend their place to anyone visiting.

Our stay at Paris was marvelous! We were traveling abroad for the first time in a while, we had a mixed group of adults and children and we had lots of plans to see as much of Paris as possible. This home is beautifully designed, spacious, comfortable and fit us all very well...and just wait until you see the terrace for yourself...we ate almost every meal out there! Simply divine. If you want to make your own meals there are two different markets just minutes away but the surrounding restaurants are all fabulous if you want to enjoy meals out. This location and the hosts, Katia and Thomas, definitely created a 5-star experience from start to finish!
Sandrine was very responsive and helpful. Location was close to the metro, RER and a lot of attractions including the Eiffel Tower. Would definitely recommend.
Bruno is an amazing host, he helped us do the laundry even! And the room is cute, clean and surrounded with lots of great restaurants, highly recommend visitors come to stay here!
Great apartment just what we needed, excellent location - charming place perfect size and nice outdoor balcony. Will stay again!
Very solid stay for a couple nights, got the job done. Also in a nice location nearby active areas.
Location was great. Near to shops and metro stations within a few minutes. The apartment is small but cosy, clean and smells nice.

Cozy apartment with a unique feel to it. Instead of the typical empty airBNB, you feel like you’re staying at a friend’s. The rooms are spacious, nicely decorated and well equipped with all the necessities. We definitely enjoyed our stay, merci!
We had a wonderful time, the apartment was awesome and perfectly located. The host, Sophie, was really friendly and easy to contact.

Karine’s home is lovely. My family of four was comfortable and content, didnt want to leave and cant wait to return. We loved the smell of jasmine, the decor, the quiet, and the location. Thank you, Karine!

Excellent location (lots of shopping and restaurants, close to Seine and Notre Dame Cathedral). Area was always pleasantly lively but not too crowded. Place was clean with tons of light. We were very comfortable (5 of us stayed in the 3 bedrooms). Building was extremely quiet. You never heard any noise from the other flats/apartments. Also very secure.

The apartment is the same as the photos, there is nothing that is not in the specifications, everything is perfect, good price and very well located, 3 minutes from the metro and you can walk to the Eiffel Tower. Francis was very kind at all times, he gave us many useful instructions and it was very pleasant to talk to him, everything was very good

This place is awesome! We never had any difficulty getting around Paris because the train station is just nearby, making it easy to connect to many places. Taxis are always available and visible in the area as well. There are many great places to dine in, and the neighborhood is perfect for walking and strolling around. Highly recommend!
Francois was very responsive when we had questions and made sure he was there for our check in. Also made sure instructions for using all appliances were printed for us. Great place to stay!

This is a beautiful apartment in Paris. We did have a couple of issues but they were addressed extremely quickly. The metro noise didn't bother us at all. The apartment was very clean and easily accessible. I would stay here again.

The apartment is much nicer than in the pictures! Very cool interior desing and lighting especially in the evening. The viewes are just extraordinary. We spent every evening on the roof top terrace! Pascal was very polite and helpfull host. He gave us many good restaurant recommendations and tips how to travel by metro. Everything during our visit went smoothly and Pascal was flexible regarding our staying in his apartment. We even took one extra night because price-quality of this apartment is the best.

The beautiful apartment definitely made our stay in Paris a memorable vacation! Marais was quite lovely and the location is perfect. Rita was very kind to let us check in early and showed us around the apartment. The walk up four floors gave us a bit of exercise; however, it is very doable. We hope to be back soon!
This is a beautiful apartment with great style in a wonderful location. We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend it.

Fantastic location in a quintessential Parisian street with beautiful park and local restaurant areas - super easy to walk to vibey bistros and bars. The street was super quiet and easy to find. The apartment was spacious and tastefully decorated. The separate toilets and showers were helpful with multiple guests. Only consideration for future guests is multi step check in and key location is a fair walk from apartment so head there first! Thanks for a great stay!

Was a great stay, excellent location, great for families and loved the little extras like games, puzzle, books for both adults and kids. Linda was super responsive and gave clear instructions for check in!

We would definitely recommend staying here. The host was communicative and responsive. It’s a great apartment in a wonderful neighborhood, and close to transportation to get you elsewhere in Paris. We had two adults staying in the bedroom and two kids (ages 4 and 8) staying on the couches in the living room. Everyone was comfortable and happy. We feel really grateful to have booked this Airbnb. We had a wonderful time.

Had a lovely stay at Franck’s place. Close to a subway line, small but it got almost all it need (small note on this, a microwave or small oven could be really convenient). I liked the early checking and I sleep well at the place. I can recommend

Happy's apartment was exceptional, the room, the common areas, everything was done to make my stay great. She was not there but the communication via phone was the best as well as with the housekeeper. For the arrival, the check in was super fast and understandable. The apartment is very centrally located and very close to the Metro lines which makes it perfect for different outings. I was so pleased with my stay that I hope to return to Paris and stay here.

A gem in a fantastic neighborhood! We loved walking around Paris but especially enjoyed the neighborhood - it had everything we needed - grocery, cafes, bakeries, pharmacy, people watching… easy distance over the bridge to the major sights. Claire met us upon arrival, was very friendly & helped us carry bags up the stairs. There are steps to climb, but don’t let that be a deterrent. The building is full of charm & character! We especially enjoyed the AC on the very hot & humid days we were there.
I had a wonderful week hosted by Daniel. The place was clean, organized, and comfortable. Daniel was truly helpful ❤️ I highly recommend him.

Great place to stay in Paris. Felt super safe! Nicholas was super helpful and responsive. He was flexible with my check-in too! The place was tidy and had everything I needed. I enjoyed my stay and will definitely recommend!

We loved our stay at Stan's. The place was exactly as described, so charming. It's on a lively street - yet the place remains extra quiet as to allow a peaceful night's sleep. Stan was very communicative throughout our stay. We look forward to visiting again and staying at Stan's place.
Loved it! Host was kind, everything was just as described, and the location was perfect!

Our stay with Morgane was great, super responsive and helpful even when we arrived before check in and helped us plan a trip out of the city. The apartment was clean and comfortable and exactly as described, kitchen was well equipped and we had everything we needed. Location was amazing 2 metro stops with 5 mins walk, it was off a main road but despite this there was noise in the apartment and was really peaceful. Minutes away from the champs eleyse and arc de triumphe. Really secure with 2 codes and a key so we felt really safe. All round great

We had a lovely stay. Hugo was very responsive and helpful and the flat is a typical Parisian experience, full of character under the roof. The area has nice restaurants, including an Italian over the road, nice coffee shops and is very convinient for the Metro.
Fabulously located apartment- walking distance to many of Paris’ famous attractions. Spotlessly clean and tidy. Very easy check-in- although an “after-hours” check-in would have been handy.

Christian was an excellent host and very friendly and accommodating. He made sure we had everything we needed. The Airbnb itself was gorgeous and clean. Don’t worry about hot days, because having the fans and windows open kept it very cool and comfortable. Our favorite thing about this location was the beautiful park right across the street. Good for a morning stroll or have a picnic in the afternoon.

Nice apartment close to the downtown. lot of restaurants, bars as coffee shops, also wine shops. Well connected with public transportation. Sophie was always responsive, willing to provide options and flexible with the check-in and check-out
We had a wonderful stay. Location to metro is very convenient. Easy communication. Everything at the flat was as advertised. We only wish we had more time to stay and enjoy Paris.

Amazing location, excellent interiors and a very nice host. This is definitely amongst our best stays in Paris. Close to everything but still in a very calm and a very Parisian area. It has the best of Paris in all positive aspects. Shall highly recommend and shall definitely stay here again.
Was a good place to stay - within zone 1 of public transport and easy to get around. Expect a lot of walking though 😊. Thanks for having me 😊

Everything was perfect! Communication with host was 10/10 and location was great! They have 3 beautiful pets and the cats are definitely people friendly. Check in was a breeze and it felt right at home. Would recommend 10/10! Thanks again :)

This was the perfect home away from home! The place was cozy and inviting with all the necessary amenities. Aurélien was responsive to any questions or concerns. The location is hard to beat. Steps away from the metro and a local outdoor market with PLENTY of dining options nearby. Don’t hesitate to book this place if it’s available! Highly recommend.

As a solo female traveller I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. the neighbourhood is safe and lively, yet also private because you are on the top floor. I really enjoyed the bath as well! Ines is incredibly kind, responsive and helpful. would certainly return!
Great spot to stay, despite being on a main road. It was quiet at night and felt very private. We would definitely stay here again.
Cindy was a very good host. The apartment is in the ideal location. Climbing the stairs to the loft requires nimble coordination. Very clean and nice place and a great location.

The residence is extraordinary. Great location, Great room decoration and space. It more than enough space for 2 people to stay, full size bed, full size kitchen with all stuff needed also have a table with 2 chairs in the room while remain space for more than 2 luggage to open. Bathroom also clear and very good. The room is on ground floor which keeps sound very well. Moreover, Location of the residence is very good. We can walk to the Eiffel Tower less than half an hours and surrounding with great restaurant (Especially pizza in opposite of residence). In additional, there are 3 carrefour city that we can walk to buy stuff which close to the residence. Lastly, very recommend if you want to have a very good place to stay in Paris!!
This place is perfect. Comfortable bed, close to restaurants, train stations, and cafes. All that I needed. 100% recommended!

The penthouse is as described with great location and fantastic view. It was spacious for us family of 3 and the co-host John is responsive and given a clear instructions. We surely will come back to stay here for our next Paris visit. Thank you for hosting us.
Fantastic apartment in a city like environment. Clear and easy communication. Great apartment for a large family.
My stay here was perfect! The room was clean and well furnished, the bathroom was lovely also! The only thing I will say is that the room gets quite hot during the night during summer

Denka’s place was exactly as shown in the photos and as she described. It was a little cramped for three people but still a lovely stay! Would definitely recommend the area. She was also so friendly and responsive!

Laurence was a fantastic host - lots of communication in advance and attentive when we arrived. The room and facilities look better in real life than the photos (as they were when we booked). The apartment is well located, with lots of public transport links. There is a beautiful park nearby with lots of bakeries nearby and plenty of places to eat in the evenings. It can be a bit loud in the evening if you have the window open - but otherwise its a lovely room and well worth the money to have such easy access to the rest of Paris. I would absolutely stay again.

We had a great time in Paris, the apartment is located near the Place de la Nation. Lots of options to eat and you can take the metro to go anywhere. You have to take to set of stairs to go to the second level, so might not be convenient if you have limited mobility. The kitchen was fully equipped and we had a care package with snacks and herbal tea. And coffee pods.

We visited Axel’s apartment to attend Paris Olympic. It is located very safe surrounded area, beautiful, and less than 20mins walkable to the stadiums that we attended. His home was very stylish, trendy, and even clean very much. We could see how he is considerate and generous for his guests thru his work done in the place. We enjoyed staying so much and we will be back to his home next time for sure!
Perfect location and great to have a kitchen! Host met us upon arrival and walked us through everything, helpful!

It was a pleasure to stay in this stylish, cute apartment for our weekend at the olympics. It’s clean, has lots of amenities and perfectly located to explore Paris. Would love to stay again when I get the chance to.
Had a lovely stay at Agnes's place. Nice area of Paris and located close to public transport for easy travel.
Lovely appartement located in a great location. Close to transport links and major attractions. Private location with beautiful decorations. Would recommend as a great base to see Paris

Camille was an amazing host and her apartment is perfect. I visited with my family (husband and 2 boys) for 4 days at the start of the Olympic Games. The apartment is in a great location, there are so many fabulous shops and restaurants nearby. We had a few days ticking off all of the key Paris spots (so easy to get to) and then a day at the Stade de France. We loved every single second of it. Camille gave us great advice in advance of the stay and was super responsive during the trip. We couldn’t have asked for more. Highly recommend.
Nice apartment, comfortable and very accessible via metro. Zafer was a great host, very helpful and responsive. Would definitely stay again!

Beautiful home in nice and convenient neighborhood. My family stayed here for four nights. Cynthia and Bilal were extremely accommodating with check in. Throughout our stay, they remained in touch whenever we had questions or sought recommendations for things to do. The house was clean and well-laid out and the perfect place for our family. We would definitely visit again!
Although it was easy to find and was quite close to the places we wanted to be, the toilet had a bad odour, was leaking and bedsheets had stains.
Lovely stay at this beautiful apartment. Great location and responsive and friendly host. Spacious and comfortable. Would recommend to absolutely anyone

Wonderful host that really makes you feel welcome to Paris. Perfect for anyone visiting Paris valuing authentic ambience, privacy and security; Pascale’s apartment in Auteuil is a short walk to metros 9 and 10, and delicious brasseries, boulangerie, and grocery stores are a street away. The apartment itself is located in a beautiful art deco building with all the charm to match. Pascale’s apartment is spacious modern and graciously included with every amenity you could ever need for your stay. Mérci boucoup Pascale!

Corentine is a very accomodating host. My friend and I were getting to the Airbnb around 8pm at night, and she still met us at the Airbnb to give us a tour of the place, and the key. She was incredibly friendly and would go out of her way to help us. Her place is a bit petit, but it does the job and then some. Highly recommend you check out her place!

Hannelore and her husband were great hosts. My flight arrived earlier than expected, and they were willing to let me check-in early. Also, I was running a bit late, so they let me check-out later than normal. They even provided breakfast and lunch for me! They are very kind and accommodating hosts. And, the baby grand piano is a nice addition!
Enjoyed our stay. Great location and lovely area. We were able to trabel to all the main attractions without any issues or too much traveling. The stairs kept me fit 😊.

I had a fantastic stay at Thibaut's place in Paris. Thibaut was accurate about check-in and check-out times and was very responsive throughout my stay. He provided excellent recommendations for local attractions and dining abd he would answer any questions I had. The house was exactly as described, offering a comfortable private room with a private bathroom and toilet. Additionally, I had access to other facilities, which made my stay even more convenient. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Paris!
Our only issue was that the door code was incorrect which left us waiting for a while to access. Otherwise the apartment was wonderful and just what we needed for the Olympics.
We had a great stay here for the Olympics. Would definitely recommend - easy location for travel into the centre of Paris and lots of nice places to eat nearby.

The location is so incredible. The property itself is cute and has what you need for a week stay. Easy access to all of Paris. Some minor things (a few items need some tlc and building noise e.g., new restaurant opening next door under construction), but it’s Paris in an A+ location and attentive and communicative hosts.
Our group of 7 adults came to Paris for the Olympics, and Douglas’s place served us very well. He is a very helpful host!

Very spacious and overall neat accommodation. 2 females should be enough. Fluffy bed, sofa. Netflix and YouTube TV are attractive. I can walk from Gare du Nord station. The narrow, steep fifth-floor staircase is very difficult, but as you already know, it was fine. The only drawback is that it was very hot under the sunlight. A fan in your bedroom was not enough to withstand the 30 degrees Celsius of Paris. If you come in the summer, be careful!
Gorgeous spot in Belleville, super close to the Metro. Beautiful views as well. Pascal was very responsive and helpful.

We had a great stay. The area is very lively with lots of restaurants and is close to lots of great attractions. The train station is super close and made getting into the heart of the city super convenient.

Brilliant hosts who really went out of their way to help us- even stocking the fridge with delicious treats. The apartment is in a super location, just a short walk to Sacre Coeur and metro. The neighbourhood is very safe and full of nice bars and cafes.
Georges apartment was clean and spacious and close to transport,restaurants and supermarkets. Georges was helpful and friendly and a very good communicator. Highly recommended !

Amazing location! The apartment was perfect for our family of three. The doorman was lovely and very welcoming. The bottle of bubbles waiting in the fridge was a nice touch and one we appreciated after a long day. Air conditioning units make loud noises and we had some trouble with the washing machine. We later found someone else’s chewed up sock which had been causing the problem.
Filiberto was a great & very responsive host. The location is nearby metros and was very walkable to the Olympics places. Amazing view from the 9th floor especially after a long day!

Great place - the AC was particularly nice. It is a clean, newly remodeled location that is centrally located. As noted with the other reviews, the elevator did not work when we arrived. The property manager was able to get someone out to fix it, but not for a couple of days.

Catherine’s apartment is in a fabulous location, and within easy walking distance of several metro stations. It feels very safe. There are good restaurants bakeries and bars close by. The apartment is beautifully organised and decorated and you have all you need but note this is not for anyone with mobility issues - think steep steps and low ceilings and a sit down shower. Catherine is a great host and when we had an unforeseen issue she sorted it immediately.
It was a great stay! Irune is very friendly and helpful. The apartment is really nice too

We really enjoyed our stay at Mathilde's Apartment. It is located in a lovely neighborhood, with nice boutiques, coffeeshops and restaurants at your doorstep. We didn't meet Mathilde personally, but she was always very responsive and made it possible to check in early and check out later. Thank you very much Mathilde!

Very charming and comfortable apartment - appreciated air con during sweltering weather. Excellent location, peaceful but just steps away from bustling cafes and bars. Great transport links made Olympic venues easy to reach. Thanks for fab Parisian stay.

We came to Paris for the Olympics and a few tourist attractions and spent a fantastic 11 days in France. This house was just perfect for our needs. Being 4 adults and 1 child it was great to have the many bedrooms and bathrooms across the different floors. The location was great for local shops, including a supermarket really close and the public transport links were close to hand. Axelle and her husband were fantastic at communication about the house and local area before we arrived and both check in and out went smoothly. Highly recommend!

My boyfriend and I absolutely loved staying at Manon’s place. We felt like we were locals. It is an amazing location- so close to Sacré-Cœur. There are amazing restaurants and shops all in walking distance. The apartment is well equipped with anything you may need to cook or just to feel at home. Manon is incredibly responsive and gave us great recommendations. I would highly suggest staying here if you are visiting Paris. It was truly a dream.

We really enjoyed our stay at Ugo’s place. The area was new to me, having visited Paris many times, and was very up and coming. The shower could have been a bit more reliable, but this didn’t affect our stay.
Very grateful for the host allowing us to stay at their place as they were very responsive and welcoming. The location was great.
Stunning apartment in a great location - Michelle was great to communicate with and we had a wonderful time - thank you

Five stars. Clean and good location. Great communication. Review the description carefully and you won’t be disappointed. This is a very very small studio space with loft bed. Everything you need is in the studio, with great use of space, including a/c and heating.
A very well situated appartment with a very accessible and friendly host. Perfect for a weekend exploring the city.
Flavien is an excellent host, the apartment is as described and we were very comfortable despite the 35C temperatures outside. Thank you!

The location of Philippe’s was ideal on a low traffic side street but close to everything…restaurants, pasteries, groceries and metro. The apartment was clean and comfortable. The upstairs loft bedroom and tv area with open air windows was cozy but maybe not good for people who have trouble with small spaces. We had arranged pick up from the airport through the host. So the driver notified the host of our arrival time. The pleasant host met us at the apartment with the key and instructions. We would definitely stay there again.
We had a fantastic stay at Irune’s. A great space which felt very secure and had everything we needed. Irune was easily contactable and couldn’t have been friendlier. Thank you!

We loved our stay at this Airbnb, excellent location. The host was excellent with his communication, always messaged back immediately. The flat was very clean and tidy. Our first experience of an Airbnb, and will definitely be returning.

Hugo’s place has lovely character and everything you need for a comfortable stay. The location is ideal, with the metro station only a 2 minute walk away. Lots of delicious breakfast options close by too. Thank you for a great stay!

The apartment was in a central location. However, if you are over 50 and have a large suitcase, I would not recommend this place. There is no elevator in the apartment, the stairs are narrow and spiral. Even though it was the 4th floor, it felt like we went up 8 floors.

We were 6 adults - the flat is better suited for a family with younger children ( one of us on a mattress on the floor) but we were aware of the sleeping arrangements & were very comfortable . There were plenty of bathrooms & it was very spacious for us all to relax. We were out all day at the Olympics & enjoyed the quiet haven, away from the crowds, on our return. The area was well suited for accessing all the public transport to the venues, with atmospheric local restaurants & cafes & the host was extremely helpful in the lead up to our stay. It was very hot in Paris & we thought we might need fans but the rooms were cool at night. It was an expensive stay but it was in keeping with prices in Paris over the Olympic period & well worth it for the experience. The flat is stylish, clean and welcoming. The host was extremely helpful and communication was 5* was start to finish. Would definitely recommend.
Very courteous host, clean, great value for what we paid. Nice and quiet area but still with lots of restaurants. Highly recommended! No issues with sharing living quarters with host.

We loved our stay in this large and quiet apartment located in the heart of the 7th arrondissement of Paris. The spaciousness of the apartment, with its 2 bedroom wings, was perfect for our family. The location couldn't have been better, as the apartment was just a couple of blocks away from the Invalides and within a 10-minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. Additionally, the convenience of having the Tour-Maubourg metro station only 1.5 blocks away made it easy for us to explore other parts of Paris. We recommend this home for anyone looking for a comfortable and well-located place to stay in Paris.
with a minor hiccup on check in, her place was wonderful. Especially considering it was during the Olympics. Thank you Hannelore!
Great stay! The room was as shown in the pictures. Agnes was very helpful and kind!
Very convenient location while quiet inside,clean and have everything you need at home. Air condition works well in the summer Paris, sleeping very well. Will come again.

We stayed at Francois’ place during a partial time of the Olympics. We thought it was pricey but perhaps it was due to the Olympics. However he was very kind and responsive. He allowed us to leave our luggage when we arrived too early as well as during check out. The air conditioner is only on the floor of the bedrooms and you must leave both bedroom doors open for the AC to cool both rooms as much as possible. The location is wonderful and very centrally located. We enjoyed our stay!
Llana’s condo was perfect for our group of 5. Great restaurants and close to the Metro. Perfect for our trip to Paris and communication was excellent! Would recommend!!

This was a great stay. The host was extremely accommodating and helpful upon check-in and throughout the stay! I had no issues at all with this booking and would definitely recommend. Location is perfect and walkable to Champs-Élysées.
I highly recommend Naila’s apartment to anyone visiting Paris. He is very kind and the property was exactly like it was listed and in a great location close to metro and mall. Will definitely be back

We booked this apartment in Montmarte as we were visiting Paris for the Olympics! Firstly, Arthur, the host, was amazing. He was responsive and very easy to deal with! The apartment itself is located near a metro station and very close to the main strip of montmarte, amazing location! The apartment itself is beautiful! Very clean and modern amenities paired with a classic French interior! We had 3 people staying here with more than enough room. We fell in love with the space and would recommend it to anyone staying in Paris!
Very nice location with walking distance to many of the areas you want to see in Paris. Simple studio, with the toilet in a separate room in the hallway. Ok and cheap place for a short stay!
Perfect location and the kids room was amazing for our young son. Christina was lovely and accommodating and patient with my terrible French.
Alex’s apartment was really nice and in a good location. He was very responsive and kind all the time. I recommend his apartment.
Great stay again. Do check how many stairs before booking as it's a long way up but lovely when up there and great location.

Betty provided us with a great place to live in the past 10 days. The whole place was stunning and clean, and the location was superb as well. The only problem was the refrigerator, it was not freezing properly (very minor issue!). Well highly recommended. Thanks Betty.
Great place to stay when visiting Paris, the metro is super close and there are a lot of restaurants there.

We stayed in Peggy’s appartement during the Olympics and we had a fantastic stay. Great appartement on a good location. Due to the lack of airconditioning it can be hot during the night, but the rest was fine.
Great appartment in a nice area of Paris. We found everything as expected and advertised. Communication with Jerome was easy and fast.

This was a gem in a wonderful and convenient location in Paris, 3 minute walk from the Odeon Metro stop, 2 minutes from a fabulous boulangerie/patisserie that we frequented daily, and 4 minutes from a lovely local small grocery store. The space was perfect for our family of three and it was ideal that my 8 year old son had his own room which we could close off after he was in bed. We were delighted to not only have effective air conditioning in the heat of Paris in the summer, but also a dishwasher and washer/dryer which we utilized multiple times during our 2.5 week stay. Despite its location “in the heart of things,” the apartment was located on a quieter side street. It was well stocked with adequate paper products, dishwasher soap, and laundry detergent for our stay; we bought only some trash bags in the way of necessities. I cannot recommend this apartment highly enough!
Amazing Flat located in the City Center of Paris. Huge living room with a build-in kitchen, great furniture and loads of big windows for great lightning 🫶 Def recommend this place. Best, Markus

We loved our stay at Theo’s place. Yes very welcoming and quick to reply. The apartment is lovely and very relaxing. He has a great kitchen which is perfect for cooking. It’s a very welcoming easy place to stay and we’d definitely stay again. The neighbourhood is fantastic full of restaurants and bars. Highly recommend!

Lin was very responsive. The location was great for my family of four. My kids had plenty of room with the twin bed and trundle bed. I asked for an extra fan and it made a big difference in August. We were able to leave the windows open and it was quiet. We would stay again, very close to transportation, good restaurants, and groceries at Monoprix.
The location is great. Near Eiffel Tower. The bedroom is cozy. The bathroom is a little bit small and leaking water when doing shower. The overall is good!

Very nice and clean place .. even better in person. was extremely clean . laundry area was a plus. everything we needed was in walking distance. metro station is very close by . Thanks for hosting us.
Thanks Aurelien very thoughtful, we had great stay. Is close the south Arena, very convenient for us walking around. Safe place and near by have restaurants and cafe.:)

Our stay was absolutely amazing. The space was lovely and very walkable to metro and restaurants. Felt very safe walking around the area even late at night. Host was very responsive, kind, and helped make us feel right at home. Also the two cats at the apartment are so sweet. Would recommend to all.

This is a great apartment on one of the best areas of Paris. The location is perfect and very central, the surrounding is so beautiful, vivid and cozy. The apartment itself is comfortable and clean. We were a group of 6 people and it was spacious enough for us. Good communication with the host. We had a problem with wi fi connection , however it was solved on the second day.
Great communication, great location, great surroundings, apartments are small, but with everything you need. Sometimes a little noisy but all in all I we had a more than perfect stay! Recommend!
I had a wonderful stay at Noemie’s home. 10/10, I hope to one day stay again!
Oliver is very friendly and tells you everything you need to know about the house and location wise its only 10-15 minute walk to metro so everything was perfect
Laurence is a very nice and reliable host, communicates very well and helps with useful information about transport and access to sights.
Ariane was extremely friendly and communicative, and their place is in a phenomenal location. We had a GREAT stay and I would highly recommend!

I have been booking airbnbs for years all over the world. I will say this stay was great. The host is very accommodating, very clean room and bathroom, great location, and the value for the space and host is worth it

Great place we had 8 adults and 1 kid, it was clean and pleasant. The stove is a bit tricky. It’s close to metro, shops, bakery and many restaurants. Plus just a walk away from the Eiffel Tower. Easy to get to other tourist attractions. Would definitely recommend and stay again.
this place was exactly as described. clean,safe,great location for bars cafes and restaurants, close to 3 Metro lines. Julian was a perfect host. would certainly stay there again

Decent place, clean, very responsive host, full scale kitchen, close to Metro and Restaurants, place as described. Bedroom too small, Ok-ish street, linen can be better and more suitable for summers, two fans are must as Paris can be hot in summers.

Hello. Thank you very much for the house. Very comfortable, very charming, suitable location, nice welcome, especially Corolina from the Chateau was very helpful in every way. Thank you. Goodbye until the next meetings 🤝
It is a really nice apartment with good accessibility by the underground. It has 4 bedrooms, which was great for us. Communication with Jennifer was always without a problem. Thanks

It was extremely great location, loads of choices for restaurants, cafes and patisseries.Flat had warm ambiance and lovely atmosphere. Interior decor was spot on, minimal and exactly what you need to leave in one place. No junk , no clutter , all plain clean lines and was very modern and sophisticated. If you like walking like us and don’t mind walking you can walk all iconic landmarks. Literally we parked car for 3 days and walked everywhere. Come back in the afternoon rest and left again. It was great experience in heart of Paris. Kevin was very responsive and kind , easy to communicate,it made a lot easier for us from beginning till end for whole experience. Thank you Kevin and hopefully some point we will come back .

Very nice place, near metro, in a nice area. Modern design and everything in the apartment was in a very good condition and the amenities were more than adequate. Denka is an amazing host. If I had to mention disadvantages I would point out that air conditioning is missing, fact which is very common in Paris and that beds where in loft of low height which makes things a little bit difficult when you get up and going in to bed. All them were clearly described in the listing, so it up to the customer to decide.Generally it is perfect choice.

I have stayed here several times. Perfect! Within walking distance from Gare du Nord. Lots of restaurants and stores. There is a very good bakery just around the corner. Jonathan replies quicky. Very good host. Thank you Jonathan
A great stay with lovely hosts! Mind you the room is right under the roof and it was quite hot during burning summer in Paris. Otherwise a fantastic stay!
beautiful room, spacious and cozy. more than expected. outside is not really quiet but comfortable surroundings with some shops and restaurants.

My partner and I were more than lucky to have the opportunity to stay at Sophie’s beautiful home, and to meet her. Her friendliness and vast knowledge of Paris made our trip so much better, with plenty of amazing recommendations. Being only a short walk to the metro in a really lovely area i can’t recommend staying with her enough! As well as this , she has the cutest dog, Eddy, who is so playful and sweet.
For a solo traveler this was a great room. Spotlessly clean and cosy. Bed was comfy. I really appreciated having the air conditioner. Very very close to the Metro!

We truly enjoyed our stay here! The apartment was spacious, clean and comfortable, and conveniently walkable to restaurants. We had to collect and return the key at another location about 5min drive away, so plan accordingly for the extra stop (it was easy with Uber). The host was very responsive! We would absolutely return!
Great stay in a very comfortable flat in Paris- we enjoyed the extra touches and the board games. many thanks for a lovely stay

From the moment you walk through the main entrance into the courtyard, you can tell you are somewhere very special. And then once you enter Adrienne’s apartment on the 4th floor you realize what a magical little slice of Paris this place is. From the beautiful furnishings and decor to the comfortable bedding- this place was perfect for our group of 7. The location is great too- central but still feels quaint and peaceful. Adrienne was an amazing host and was always available for questions and recommendations. We can’t wait to come back!

Arianne and Christian are excellent. I got a quick response everytime I sent a message. The apartment is exactly as described. When you walk outside there are countless restaurants, shops, bakeries and also markets for groceries. Also a short walk to churches. About a 10 minute walk to the Notre Dame and maybe a little further to the Louvre. Most of the other famous places in Paris are within a cheap Uber ride or via train. I highly recommend this place.

Awesome stay! The guidebook was great and well detailed! The stay was perfect and clean ! Like that there are some fans because it does get warm ! Very cute place walking distance to train and so much

We stayed for 3 nights at Miguel and Emilien’s apartment. It is extremely convenient and an easy 10min walk from Gare du Nord (we parked our car at Charles de Gaulle airport) and 10mins to the foot of the steps to the Sacre Coeur. We walked everywhere so the comfortable beds were extremely welcome! The apartment was perfect for our needs - clean and well-equipped. We didn’t find it too noisy and slept with windows open, just the usual morning bustle of a capital city. We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it.
Great location and beautiful space. Easy to access public transportation and parks. The flat itself is nicely decorated with a good layout. Kind and responsive hosts. Enjoyed my stay here.

Absolutely perfect - i wish i could stay longer! It’s the perfect mix of Parisian charm and character. The windows… the plants.. the beautiful touches. I am in awe! Everything you would ever need in the kitchen, too. And the bed was SO comfy - i could sleep forever. I am very picky so for me to give a 5 star review means a lot 🥹
Excellent place. Antoine was always responsive and took care of our questions and requests. They had no problem with letting us checking-in earlier.

Great place in le marais! Wonderful little bar downstairs and extremely walkable to all the neighborhood has to offer. Metro stop nearby. All amenities for baby - high chair and pack and play! Elevator is very small but super helpful to get luggage up and down the 3 flights of stairs. The terrace was a nice place to hang. Beds very comfortable and AC was super nice to have after long days exploring Paris in August. Would stay again!

Styled like a Californian skaters dream loft, the apartment did not disappoint. And being a rock’s throw from Canal Saint Martin, Amélie would definitely love the location! Vincent was a great and communicative host….would return for another stay in the future!
Excellent location with a view of the Tower from outside the building. Photos matched the flat exactly. Excellent, friendly and responsive host.

We stayed in Sophie's wonderful apartment, a beautiful and real Parisian apartment, will put you right into the magical atmosphere of Paris!! Sophie is a great host, a smart and kind-hearted woman who helped us and responded to every request. She has a lovely and quiet dog that is an integral part of the experience of staying in the apartment! The apartment is located in a quiet and pleasant street about 5 minutes walk from the metro and about 25-30 minutes by public transport almost anywhere Thanks you sophie❤️
Best location. Everything was a short walk or you could hop on a train very easily. The apartment was clean and very comfortable for a family of 4. Would definitely stay here agin.
Super well connected to the metro network! Very clean and easy to just have a place to crash, when you want to enjoy Paris! Thank you!

perfect quiet studio in a nice and safe neighbourhood. I stayed with a friend and we had a lovely time. the room is very bright and clean with beautiful wooden floors. Ana is a very kind and nice host. entrance was easy. would love to come back!

Great location with a lovely courtyard and walking distance to Marché Monge. The apartment was clean, but there was no dining space for four people and had minimal cooking utensils. Otherwise, enjoyed our stay very much!
Adrienne was an amazing host! My family felt right at home and we had everything we needed! Adrienne went above and beyond during our stay. We’ll be back!
Great appartement for flaneurs of the 14th. Right by rue daguerre and Montparnasse. Appartment had a cracking garden, lovely and spacious. Antoine is lovely as well. Highly recommend

Hugues had great communication and provided helpful details for check in! Also very friendly :) the location of the apartment was also great however the studio did have a musty smell that could be due to the lack of ventilation. We could not sleep unless the window was open.

This was a great place to stay! Right around the corner from the Eiffel Tower. A pharmacie and Boulangerie right on the corner. Restaurants in walking distance. There were 5 of us that stayed and it was plenty of room.
Charming apartment with great location. Apartment had a small leak that caused some stress with slow response times from owner.
We have a really good time here! Very close to Eiffel Tower. Facilities in house are good . Toilet and bathroom are separated which is nice and clean.

Pros: Host allowed us to use the place three hours earlier than check in time Location is actually 10 mins walking distance from Eiffel. Cons: Oddly built Main bathroom door doesn’t close or lock so there is zero privacy. The rooms trap the heat in. No aircon. Awful for summer time. Must use fans provided except the fans are very dust and you don’t want to turn them on because of what you will inhale. Have to keep all doors open to get air circulation. Towels were old and super small One very tiny soap bar provided. The place was so dirty we didn’t feel very good sleeping in it.

Great location and very close to metro station, supermarket and lots of awesome restaurants! The room is much smaller than anticipated but it’s Paris, and we don’t spent a lot of time inside, so it’s manageable.
Very welcoming host. We didn’t have any hassle to get in. Got good advice on how to travel within Paris. A perfect French guy .

Spacious and bright apartment. Great location - close to main attractions but private and quiet. Host was incredibly responsive and always available. Good amenities and equipment made the stay feel very homely. Thank you Kevin

This apartment was perfect for my husband and I. The home was decorated beautifully and everything was clean. The location was perfect and several main attractions were close walking distance such as the Louvre. We also had easy and close access to lovely cafes and restaurants. Eléonore was so friendly, accommodating and quick to respond. Given the chance, we would absolutely stay here again next time we’re in Paris.

Our family of four loved this beautifully decorated apartment in Montmartre. Even my 11-year-old declared it the best Airbnb ever! Arthur was incredibly helpful with local tips, and the apartment stayed cool despite the summer heat. It's the perfect spot for a family vacation in Paris.

We enjoyed our stay in Paris and the studio is very near of everything. I would definitely rebook it next time we will visit Paris. It is in a nice quarter very peaceful. Host is very responsive. Highly recommended.

In the center of 5eme Paris, where you can enjoy local life rather than stuck with a full of tourist. There're full of nice restaurants nearby as well as several metro stations. Very neat and clean apartment.
Pretty decent Airbnb for a short stay in Paris. The city center is a bit far from the place but metro is nearby (about 8 mins walk). The location seemed safe.

Such a beautiful place to stay. The view is amazing and the apartment is really lovely. Sandra was a great host. We had a fantastic stay and I’d highly recommend. Great location as well but bear in mind you have to climb lots of steps to get there (it’s worth it for the view).

Beautiful spacious apartment in great location. Clean, friendly host, great tips for what to see. Walking distance to arc de triomphe. The only thing to be aware of is that there is a lift but it doesn’t serve the flat itself - there are about 15 steps up to the apartment for those with mobility issues.

Great place and easy to find. The location is good that nearly Metro and Train station. Restaurants, supermarkets are around. Feel safe and comfortable. This is my choice as I come to France next time.

We absolutely loved our stay at Alexis’ amazing apartment! Everything was just as beautiful as described and the location does not get better than this! Communication with Alexis was great and he was super helpful. We will definitely want to stay here again and we would recommend it to everyone.
Our second time staying here, and was great to be back. Perfect location. The space is small but has everything you need. Excellent a/c and balcony are huge pluses.
Highly recommended this place to stay in Paris. It is in the heart of Paris. I will go back here again if I come back!
Great stay, lovely apartment. Location was great, nice to walk around Montmartre. Close to metro.
Beautiful apartment that worked well for our family. Kevin was very responsive and provided baby crib and high chair for our 1 year old. We would definitely return!

We had a wonderful stay here. The location was perfect - tucked away in a quiet street, but right around the corner from one of the districts in Paris. The bedrooms were very nice and having 3 bathrooms was a nice bonus as well. The cleaners came every day to tidy up. The door code and wifi worked perfectly. Very cool design living room and a big beautiful terrace to hang out on. Would strongly recommend this bnb to everyone! Merci beaucoup!
Excellent location and a great place to stay in the centre of Paris! We enjoyed every moment! Thank you Sophie!

Great host and lovely apartment! I spent 5 nights in Paris and it was a fantastic place to stay, right in the center of the city, on a side street with plenty of coffee, noodle, and cafe options. It's also a couple of blocks from most trains so it was easy to get around. Rigo was friendly, everything was ready (and clean) for me when I arrived...and her cat is very cute! I'd definitely stay there again!
Lovely stay in Paris in a great location for Montmartre. A fabulous flat with lovely decor and located within easy reach of the metro as well as local amenities and nightlife. All in all... perfect!

Linda's surprisingly spacious and well appointed apartment is located on the southern edge of the Latin Quarter within easy walking distance of Luxembourg Gardens and the Parthenon, and less than 20 minutes away from Notre Dame. The neighborhood is very energetic, but the apartment is on a small street that affords a modest degree of privacy. The interior is, if anything, larger than her photos suggest, and seems to have been remodeled not long ago using the highest quality finishes. Throughout our stay, Linda was extraordinarily responsive to our questions and requests. Our only problem came at the beginning when trying to gain access. Entry requires a physical key, not an entry code, and locating the holder of the key was more challenging and counterintuitive than expected, leading to a certain amount of panic. Once inside, we were very happy campers, and we would be very happy to stay there again should we return one day. Again, Linda could not have been nicer or more responsive.
Had a fantastic stay here! Great location, clean, and safe. Highly recommend. Sandrine was also very kind and responsive to any questions!
Our stay exceeded our expectations. This area of Paris is safe, clean, and had everything we wanted. Rita & James are ideal hosts. We hope to return soon!
Really amazing place very clean and the ppl there very hospitable and welcoming I would recommend to everyone
Incredible stay with Gilbert! The place is as close to the park as you could imagine and Gilbert took very good care of everything 🙌

We stayed here with our 2 kids. Extremely clean, well laid out, beautiful design and had everything we needed for our week stay. We would lightly recommend staying here and look forward to booking again when we come back to Paris.

We had a lovely stay at Elsa’s place. It’s in a peaceful location and we managed to walk to most of the main attractions and also could walk to the Bercy Arena from the apartment. Elsa and her husband were very accommodating with my daughter’s wheelchair and supporting us to access the property! Thank you so much.
This Place was in a great location. The A/C is an amazing as I am so use to it being from the US. The place was awesome.
Delphine is an amazing host! Great communication at all times. Her place is near the metro and close to coffee shops, restaurants and shops. Will definitely stay again when I'm back in Paris!

We had a wonderful stay at Erwan’s place. Erwan was so helpful with providing detailed instructions on how to get to get to the apartment. He also gave some great recommendations for restaurants in the area and was so thoughtful in leaving wine for us when we arrived. The space itself was clean and comfortable, with many helpful amenities. It’s in a great area with so many food options within a short walking distance. We would absolutely love to stay at Erwan’s place the next time we are in Paris.
Not bad place. Just very plain, up a smoky stairwell that is dark. The place smelled like bad cleaning products. No washcloths or sheets. One small window. Location kind of cool. Very busy.
It was a week long stay, the room looks exactly what the page describes, perfect for one person. Nothing to complain!
A nice and quite roomy apartment in a very good location. Navas was a good host. Really nice bars and cafés right outside the door. EasyPark to reach if you arrive by train. Good value!

We had a nice stay, although admittedly we were not in the apartment much. The apartment was comfortable, well situated and suited us for our needs. I really like the location - quiet neighborhood next to a wonderful park and walking distance from busier areas.

Monique was an incredible host. She and her husband are a delightful, pleasant couple who made us feel at home with their warm greeting. Her house was spotless, and the description was correct. It's an excellent place to unwind after a busy day exploring the city. She also provided us helpful advice on the city and transport, which spared us a lot of stress. I highly recommend staying at her place.

Marina was very helpful especially as she waited for us when we arrived as our flight got delayed. The place was exactly as advertised, clean and in a very good and safe area (close to the Metro station, supermarket and Parc des Princes). Definitely recommend 👍
Great place to stay. Lots of fabulous places nearby to wander about. Flat was well laid out and quiet for being so central. Would not hesitate to come back.

I had a great stay at the beautiful flat of Manon and Jean-Jacques. The check in was flexible and personal as there are some things to be explained - especially when being in Paris for the first time. The district is very nice and there are a lot of nice restaurants right around the corner. Right in front is the national museum with a beautiful botanical garden! My highlight was the small coffeeshop right next to the entrance - very nice specialty coffee! The flat was very clean and so special. Everything in there has a personal and artsy touch to it and I am totally going to come to Paris again and try to stay in this airbnb again and for longer. Thanks for everything & see you soon :)

Lovely studio which is exactly as described. Easy self check in and Astrid gave clear instructions. The only negative was that there was a smoke / cigarette smell. Not a big problem I just opened the window to air the room out.
Oliver is the best host one can find in Paris. He’s a very warm person. I really enjoyed staying at his place. Best wishes.

We had a wonderful time in Anne and Jean-Luc’s beautiful apartment. It was comfortable and spacious for 3. Anne made us feel at home and gave us lots of pertinent information and advice on the neighborhood. Make sure you have the croissants around the corner!
Great host and beautiful place! Vincent was very professional and always available on the phone! Definitely coming back. Thanks a lot Victoria
The location is great. The apartment is a bit hot and can be a bit loud at times. Overall it is adequate.
