I called to ask for extra instructions on how to get in and instead of instructions she insults me on the phone and I ended up finding the place without her help. After I left and followed the drop off key instructions as the instructions said, I get another rude message later how I didn't do something I was supposed to that wasn't specified in the instructions. She should not be hosting an Airbnb!
Adam was a helpful host. He was very flexible regarding our arrival time. The place has a great location!!! Enjoy!
Great location, close to Metro stop and was exactly as described. Definitely would stay here again while in Paris.
Everything is perfect. It would be my luck to be in this place. If you see any vacancy here, you have to get the chance like me.

Gilbert is very friendly and flexible. When i said last minute I would arrive earlier that was not a problem. As there where no guests the day after us, Gilbert let us stay during the day to be able to take a shower after the marathon. Merci Gilbert!
Very clean and nice studio, with nice equipments and handy facilities & supplies. We enjoyed the Eiffel tour view, every diner became a festival!

THE VIEW, the view, the view. This place has an awesome view, is breath taking. Words can't describe the view of the tower blinking at night. It is very close to the metro about one block. Stores and restaurants right around the corner. Bus stop right on the corner. Very safe and quiet. comfortable bed.

The apartment was charming, spacious and updated with modern appliances and fixtures. The bathroom was heavenly with a large walk-in shower. The bedroom was quiet for a good night's rest. The living room was filled with light with the sun shining in most of the day. Finally the Internet was super-fast. I would highly recommend the apartment to anyone.

Very speedy, accurate communication. Location is very close to Trocadero. Wonderful well equipped kitchen with nice view of the tip of the Eiffel Tower. Very modern commercial grade plumbing with two WCs - rare in France. Good mattress and bedding. Bedroom faces street - not especially busy, but this is the centre of Paris so earplugs recommended.

We loved this apartment. I wish all our vacation rentals were this beautifully appointed. The location is so close many of Paris historic landmarks, excellent dining, and Metro stops! Made for a lot of time enjoying our vacation and not wasting it in transit.

The house was well located, we loved being in the 20th as we were out of the touristy part of Paris. The apartment is close to good public transport which got us into the center of Paris very quickly. The house was clean and had everything we needed. We enjoyed our stay.
A beautiful and charming house, hidden quietly in Montmartre. Unbelievable that it is right in the middle of Paris. Jeanne was very helpful and friendly, was a lovely, relaxing vacation.
Agnes is very nice and warm, the internet didn't work that day, but everything is great!
Great location and wonderful flat that is close to lots of amenities and transit stations. We enjoyed our trip and will look to come back to the same place the next time we are in Paris
Great host, everything well taken care of. Lively area with restaurants and supermarket, short walk to notre dame and the centre in general.
Natsumi was super friendly, easy to deal with and the apartment was great. Would definitely stay here again next time I'm in Paris.

The apartment is very tastefully done and with great intelligence: in a relatively small space the living area is spacious, the bed-loft is ample, and the bathing area below feels like a spa. The neighbourhood is wonderfully central and very Parisian without being overtaken by tourists; the street is lined with wonderful small shops though a handy supermarket is also nearby. Really great place, grab it if it's available.
great location and nice place....too bad the one room did not have 2 twin beds, would have made sleeping arrangements easier. also needed a few more towels

Perfect location. A whole street of bars, cafes and restaurants just in 4 min of walk + 2 subway stations nearby 👍🏻 Hosts are very friendly and kind. Really liked the electric stove - super fast)) The apartment is equipped with everything you might need during your stay.

This place was prefect for what we needed, just wanted a place To leave our stuff and spend the night. We were given a key to the room so we could come and go and lock up our stuff. Everyone was very nice and the place was super close to the train.
Thanks Vincent for allowing us to stay at his beautiful apartment! He was very helpful and suggested real good restaurants and other hidden gems in Paris

Didn't actually stay at this studio but another of Veriko's flats. The studio needed work and I was upgraded to a larger apartment, which was beautiful and very comfortable. Lucas was very helpful upon check in and check out. Would recommend to any friend.

Location is great, close to everything. Apartment was beautiful, clean and felt very safe. Adrien & Luka were very responsive and flexible with all of our requests, they were great to work with. Highly recommend this apartment.
Had a nice stay for one night at Alexis' studio. Nice and quiet neighborhood with little balcony that oversees Eiffel Tower. Hosts were responsive and very flexible with check-in/out times.

Excellent location. Excellent apartment. Excellent host. The experience is on par and even better than how it is advertised. It is a stylish apartment in a very central location. Alexis, the host, was helpful at every stage of the stay. Can not recommend highly enough.
Agnes is a very good host. She had communicated all the necessary information before my travel and was also helpful when I reached her home. Recommended for travellers.

This apartment was perfect for our short stay in Paris. The view of the Eiffel Tower is breathtaking and the location is perfect to walk to all of the major tourist destinations. This apartment comfortably fits two people and has everything you need for your stay. Alexis is a fantastic host who made sure we had everything we needed and even offered to arrange parking for us!

The apartment is true to the pictures and it is literally steps from everything you need! It is however very noisy ALL night, a problem for my husband and me but not for our 25 year old daughter, so it really depends on what your preferences are. Jean and Bernadette were lovely hosts waiting for us when we arrived to show us all of the particulars of the apartment. Metro and RER 1 block away, but you can walk to the Louvre and Notre Dame in 10 minutes! This was our first air bnb but it will not be our last!
Had a great stay with Agnes! She was great at communicating and helping us get where we needed to go. The apartment is also right by a metro station so we could be anywhere very fast. Wonderful stay!

Loved our stay here! Absolutely phenomenal Eiffel Tower view and we just loved the location with fresh baked croissants nearby and quick access to the Metro. The unit is small but exactly as portrayed in photos and was perfect for my wife and I. Check-in instructions were clear and WolfWolf did everything they could to accommodate our arrival and departure times. Highly recommend this lovely flat.

Muriel's place is amazing , exactly how it is described on the listing. It's bright, extremely clean and the view from the balcony is very special. We had a wonderful time and felt very comfortable. The area was perfect for us, walking distance from the vibrant rue Oberkampf with a lot of great restaurants. Muriel is wonderful and one of the best host I ever met and she made sure we had everything we needed. She truly loves the Airbnb experience :) We hope to come back soon!

This is truly a perfect Parisian space. Stay here if you can. It's been designed with careful attention to the detail of what it means to travel in comfort & elegance. And satisfyingly the apartment is maintained and the roof-terrace garden tended to its original purpose.

This place was amazing and I highly recommend anyone travelling to Paris to book this apartment! Really quite yet located in the best part of Paris. Close to everything. Very secure and just beautifully decorated. We were so comfortable and absolutely loved staying there.

My stay at Oliver's place was very pleasant. He went out of his way to be helpful and orient me about the area. The bedroom and new bathroom were spotless. Mattress was comfortable. WIFI was strong and there was even a nice TV in the room. Definitely exceeded my expectations. Highly recommended!

If you're looking for the perfect Paris pad, this amazing apartment won't disappoint. It is immaculately appointed, with modern furnishings, appliances and a balcony with a gorgeous view - we felt right at home from the get go. Check in/out was a total breeze. Stephane was kind enough to help us settle in and answer all the questions we had. Plus, everything you need is just a stone's throw away, with various public transport options available and a grocery store just across the road. Thank you, Stephane and Sophie. Your hospitality made our trip truly unforgettable.

The entire experience was fantastic. Justin was a great help and kept in contact from the day before our arrival until we left. We were greeted and shown through the apartment which was beautiful and fully equipt with everything we could have needed. The apartment was spacious and unique, and gave us a wonderful space to relax in when we didn't want to go out. The neighborhood was great, filled with restaurants, bars and shops and was easy to walk around and access taxis and public transport. Would highly recommend this property for anyone visiting Paris.

Nathalie's place is in a great position in Paris, easy for travelers to get around and a lovely vibe to the area. Comfortable with a relaxing environment all you need to enjoy Paris in a truly Parisienne way. Loved it

We arrived in Paris quite late and Adam was super nice which constantly checked on our status. The Apartment is as described and is located really close to one of the metros. This eases our travelling plan. I definitely recommend it.!!!

The location is perfect. You're right in the middle of everything. Isabelle is very personable and called to make sure I could get to her place alright. Her two sons are very polite and helpful. Would stay again!

I enjoyed my stay here, lovely view! But, the bed was not my favorite. The home was pretty central, good for a solo traveler. I appreciated the wide-range for check in/out times. However, I wish it was more set in stone as I would have made plans ahead of time if I knew exact times in advance. Wolfwolf was lovely to communicate with, thank you!
Very clean. Close to subway. The building is a little hard to find but Agnes provided many direcions

This place is lovely. My family of 4 stayed for 2 nights as we speed visited Paris. It is very close to the train stop, near the Louvre, and situated in the quaintest building. So many cafes and restaurants around. Would absolutely stay here again!

Great place in a great location. The attention of the owner is great, you wont be disappointed. She welcome us with delicius bread and wine. Two minute walk to luxemburg gardens... A great place, just for young couples because of the stairs, but it wasn´t a deal for us.
Ana was a great host - her flat is the right size (not too big not too small for two / three adults), clean and at a very convenient location! We had a pleasant stay !
Yann's place is in a great location, on a quiet street, a stone's throw away from Sacre Coeur. Lots of great shops and restaurants close by to chose from as well.
Was a lovely staying in Muriel apartment. Comfort apartment near to public transport. I would recommend to everyone. Perfect for couples without kids.
Would recommend to anyone staying in Paris , very secure & safe , well equipped , great amenities , close to all attractions
We always enjoy staying at Mireille's apartment. It's very convenient, clean, and near shops, restaurants, and transportation.
Gilbert's place is great. The room is as described and the bed is comfortable. Gilbert is very friendly and helpful. The neighbourhood is lovely also.
Perfect location, super close to Montmartre and to metro stations. Is a really cozy place and everything looks like in the pictures.

The room is great, the private shower and exclusive bathroom are awesome features, and so is the refrigerator with drinks and the snacks provided. Julien is a great host, he even agreed to allow me to check it at midnight. Totally recommended.
Nice place to stay a short period whit your family, Ana was very nice and she try to help you whit ever question that you have

The flat is in an excellent location. You really can't do much better if you like the shopping offered on Saint Germain, plus an easy 20 mi mute walk to Notre Dame and the Louvre. The host was a very timely and accurate communicator which isn't always the case with other hosts I've dealt with in the past so that's a big plus. The only reason this isn't a 5 star review is that the apartment did tended to hear up a bit and it was noisy enough on the street that opening the window got a bit noisy. But I would certainly stay here again.
It is very homey apartment, near to public transport, shops and cafe. You will feel Paris in it, I recomьend to stay here.
Place was nice, just as described. We would stay there again. Chokri recommended local places for us. Steve

Gilbert was a great host, greeted us at door with a smile even though it was midnight when we arrived. Provided us with all that was needed and was very accommodating. House is very clean and organized, room is comfortable, with black out blinds and ensuite shares bathroom. Gilbert is very respectful, feels like you are alone in the apartment; however he is always available if needed. Location is close to metro and a beautiful park for picnics. Gilbert also provided us with light breakfast for our convenience. Highly recommended!

Hannelore and Gerhart were very kind and thoughtful hosts. Their place was comfortable and within walking range of the metro. Breakfast was amazing and the bed, shower, and room was very nice. The flowers on the balcony were so gorgeous! I highly recommend their adorable flat. Thank you for the lovely stay!

The apartment is quite large- we are a family of four adults and there was plenty of room. It is very upscale and the location is ideal. One can walk easily to Notre Dame or the Louvre. The metro is quite close. There are many restaurants close by as well as a grocery store. Don't hesitate to stay here!

The apartment was fabulous! The location could not have been better! You walk out and there are lots of restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, local people walking through the streets, even live music on some corners. We had everything we needed in the apartment, is was clean, well kept, the communication with the owner was very good and there was even a manual with instructions about the property and the surrounding area. We had a great vacation!

Christine's place is in a great location! Near main attractions in Paris, grocery stores, and good places to eat! It was great to have a washer and a nice kitchen to cook in as well :-) My only suggestion is be careful climbing up to top bunk, ladder is unstable and slips easily!

Emmanuel is an exceptional host and welcomes you into his lovely home, which is perfectly located in the hip 10er. The apartment was extremely comfortable and perfect for our stay in Paris. Would definitely stay here again

This was our first Airbnb ever and we were very happy with our experience. Communication with the owner was easy and prompt. The location was wonderful in the 7th arrondissement within easy walking to metro and restaurants. The people we experienced were friendly and helpful. The apartment was as advertised. We stayed with 2 kids (aged 12 & 9) and they easily fit on the convertible sleeper. The fold down bed was comfortable and clean. We felt at ease and comfortable the entire time in the apartment. The air conditioning was an exceptional bonus as our entire time in Paris was during a heat wave. I would highly recommend this rental to anyone.

Very good location. The small studio is in a quiet part of the street, quite close to everything. The kind host very good with communication and answering questions. The bed is not the most comfortable, but ok for a short stay.
We enjoyed s comfortable stay here. The apartment was well equipped and close to Gare du Nord and even closer to Poissoniere Metro stop. Vitalina was a pleasant an accommodating host.
Arthur's place was great, nice location next to the metro and easily accessed via an elevator.

Thomas is your dream host. Apartment is very clean, cozy and have everything you need. The area has a big variety of restaurants, cafes, little shops. The communication with Thomas was very easy. Highly recommending his place and will come back again!

Alexandre's apartment is perfectly located in a roaring area. We arrived at Gare de l'Est, which is only a few minutes walk away. The neighborhood is quite lively, there are lots of bars, restaurants and down the street you can find a tiny supermarket where you can buy everything you need at almost every time of day or night. As soon as you're in the apartment you don't hear anything that's going on on the streets. Although the place is very small itself, we didn't miss anything. The existing space is used optimally and well appointed with tasteful furnishings. Everything was perfectly clean and Alexandre himself was a great host. He welcomed us warmly, recommended us wonderful places to go and even explained us where to find the next Vélib station to rent bicycles - which is the best way to discover the city. We'd love to come back whenever we visit Paris!

We would highly recommend Mai's beautiful apartment. Situated in a quiet street off Rue Mouffetard (a gorgeous market street in Paris filled with artisan food and wine stalls), the apartment is a convenient, light filled, quiet place to rest and explore Paris from. The location seems to offer a feel of the "real" Paris and is also incredibly central, making it easy to visit Jardin du Luxembourg and many a wonderful bar, restaurant or cafe! The metro is a 2 minute walk away and connects to convenient lines for both the right and left banks. We had a fantastic stay here and would happily visit again (hopefully soon)!

Alexis was so hospitable and thoughtful. He always answered texts/emails and checked up on our well being during our stay. Besides that he had everything you need including a binder with what to see and do in the city. The apartment could not be better located. My only regret is that our stay was far too short!
Beautiful property - very well maintained. The location is perfect; near the subway, trains, monoprix (massive supermarket), Sacre Couer and lots of restaurants.

Amazing house, our family(6 adults and 1 kid)all loved the house, 2 mins walking to metro line 9, even located in the centre(close to Bastille), the house is quiet and clean. Nicole is a nice host and always ready to help. We will come back for sure.
Great place. Amazing location to bars and beautiful restaurants. Cute space. Would recommend if you want something that's walkable to main attractions but also a bit out of the touristy areas

Julien is very kind and friendly that he introduce every detail about his place for us. The room is very clean and tidy. The location is very close to the central and different metro station. There are many restaurants nearby as well. We had a good time in Julien' place:)

Cute little quaint place in very sought after St-Germain Des Pres. Location, location, location. Beware of no A/C and street can be loud at night with the windows open Otherwise has all the necessities
Beautiful apartment! Gilbert is the sweetest! The park is one of the prettiest I've been to. I would absolutely stay here again. We slept so peacefully! We didn't want to leave!

We had a wonderful stay here. There is a great market close by and restaurants. The Metro is down the street and made getting around Paris so very easy. Vitalina helped us arrive and get situated making our arrival so easy. The apartment was a great fit for our family of four and we would stay here again if we return to Paris.

Our family of 5 just stayed at Christine's apt. She was a wonderful host, she helped me and the little girls get into the apt with all our luggage because my husband had to keep going and return our car. The place was big enough for all of us and it had exactly what we needed. The kids loved the top bunk and the games. I loved the location, it is very central with a bakery right next door and walking distance to Sainte Chapelle and the other sites near by. It was great for our first visit to Paris.
Stephan is a great person, very kind and warm...he´s apartment is wonderful, well decorated and ubicated in a very nice neiborghood, near the principal points of interest in Paris.

We love the place and the location its close to restaurants and metro stations. It's kinda tight for a family of 5 grown adults but was manageable and and it worked for us. It was our first time to use airbnb and I can say that we had a very pleasant experience adding to that having Thierry as our host.

Such tremendous accommodations near absolutely everything. The apartment was even better than described and all of the main attractions are within walking distance. As well as your choice of bakery. Merci Chachou for a wonderful experience!

The view of the Eiffel Tower is worth every penny! The apartment is a little east of the tourist attractions, but there is a metro station close by with cafes and bakeries just around the corner! We didn't have any trouble getting to where we wanted to go. And did I mention the view was worth it?! The aparement is clean and comfortable. I would highly recommend staying here.

Yohann was great to deal with, he always responded straight away and actually bought a portable cot for my 8 month old son which was really nice. The apartment is fantastic, very spacious and in a great location. Highly recommended staying here.
What a wonderful location in a wonderful part of town. The metro station was just around the corner and the best food in the city surrounds the apartment. I hope to make it back again someday.

Stephane was an excellent host who went above and beyond. The apartment is very nice, clean and comfortable, matching photos on the app. We definitely hope to stay here again in the future. Couldn't be more convenient for attractions, cafes, restaurants and shopping.

Christine is very nice and will show you around her place/how to use everything. There were plenty of places to sleep. There is no A/C, but with the windows open at night it does cool down quite a bit. There is a very good small bakery down the street. There was an issue with a pipe and the water on our last day, but Christine communicated with us well and even offered to treat us to some cocktails. Overall it was a great place to stay.

Great location and great host. Perfect for two people. Excellent coffee machine, lovely view of Eiffel Tower, metro & grocery nearby. Shower is a bit small, but otherwise it's great. Would stay again.

Yann's place is a small but nice and cozy apartment. The location is great, pretty neighbourhood and very close to the metros and also to the stairway that leads you to Montmartre and Sacre Coeur. In general, a great stay for a couple in Paris.
Value for money. Private room with attached terrace garden.Spacious bathroom. Host's English is not good ,however he make sure we don't faca any problem. Overall great stay..
A quaint apartment in a great location. François was very hospitable and helpful with advice on our arrival. Great place.

We gave Mai and her apartment a five star rating in all categories. For both of us, it was just the perfect apartment in Paris. Just a little heads up: the apartment has three floors (basement, ground and upstairs), if you are not good in taking stairs, then this might not be the right choice for you. Otherwise, this is the place to be.

The accommodation is very clean and almost everything is provided just like the hotel. Communication is excellent. Location is central and easy access to metro and the city by just walking. Plenty of good bistros and bars nearby for dining. A must try is The Clown Bar, Le Grand Bain, Septime, Au Pasage and Clamato. Highly recommended Jerome's place.
Marie was very easy to communicate and the apartment was in excellent distance to a subway station. Very clean and convenient apartment.

5 stars for the location. restaurants, bars, boulangeries and groceries are about a block away. metro stops are within a 10 minute walk. we rented both units for 6 people. the space is not large but comfortably fit all of us. the units are in separate courtyards and connected by a short set of stairs. travel time between both = about 15 seconds (according to my 7-year old). the nespresso machine was a bonus. be careful not to lock yourself out. there are signs posted in both units saying don't leave the keys in the doors. the signs should also say always bring your keys with you or leave them in the lock boxes. the doors to both auto-lock and can't be opened from the outside without keys. the locksmith cost for us was 150 euros.
I had to cancel, but she was easy to communicate with and was helpful, so I think it'd be a good place to stay.
Excellent location for Jardin de Luxembourg and Louise is a very responsive and helpful communicator. No lift in the building but I like the exercise. Enjoyed the visit.

This is a charming apartment in a shabby chic style with a wonderful view of the St. Ambrose church towers. The chime of the bells will be a memory my college age children and I will cherish. There is a very good boulangerie near and also a supermarket. It is easy to get to the Metro and to bus lines. In particular the line 69 that goes directly to most attractions. We cannot wait to stay again.

Chokri's place is a perfect location for Le Marais and enjoying actually living in Paris. The apartment is well equipped, clean and comfortable and the small terrace provides a perfect extension to the living space - great to enjoy croissant and coffee over breakfast. The area is thriving with small boutiques, shops, restaurants and cafes which makes it easy to chill out and enjoy a relaxed City break. The metro is very close, so if site seeing is your thing it's also easy to get about. Chokri was great, in touch and met us at the apartment to make sure everything was ok. A good choice and highly recommended.
Right in the heart of le Marais. Great place to stay short term (which I did) might be too small for a long time. I would stay again.

Everything was perfect! The flat is huge, much bigger than in pictures. I lived 14years in paris so inknow quite well the city and the area is very nice, Close to everything. Super nice welcome by kamel who brought us breakfast for our 2days. I will book again for sure!

Great location for the beautiful streets and sights of Montmarte. The apartment is lovely and the host was excellent at communicating and allowed us to leave our luggage later than we agreed to check out. Would definitely stay there again.

My family and I just returned from an amazing week-long stay in Alexis' apartment. I can not write enough about how perfect the location is. We walked every where-- Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, Saint Germain des Pres, the Opera House, etc. The apartment was quite quaint with its three balconies and its beautiful views of the Louvre and the Gardens. It was a surreal experience having my morning coffee out there. A real Parisian treasure. We look forward to our return.

This spot was absolutely amazing!!! We loved every second of our stay here and would recommend it to anyone. The view is amazing!!! Walking distance to so much that Paris has to offer. Host is amazing and makes everything very easy. Thank you again!

It was a perfect place to stay. First of all there was a great communication between us and the hosts. The apartment had the perfect location and made us feel close to everything. Everything was clean and nice, as on the pictures shown. So overall a perfect stay!

Chachou's place is very clean and has a great bathroom and kitchen. It has air conditioning which is also a plus. We arrived a little earlier than we planned and so they were still cleaning the apartment when we got there but they allowed us to leave our bags and go walk around for a little bit. The only downside is that the apartment is not as close to the monuments, museums, and restaurants as we would have thought so we ended up walking pretty far to get to those. Overall, great stay!

An airy and bright apartment just off Boulevard St Germain. It was always cool inside despite some quite warm days during our stay. There are lovely boulangeries, butchers, cheese shops etc within a stones throw and the centre of Paris is just a short walk away. The host was easy to communicate with and very helpful and flexible. My two children & I enjoyed staying there and found it comfortable and easy to connect with local transport
Great host. Quick response to our needs. Great location in Paris. Perfect so long as the temperature outside doesn't get too high.
Alexandre is a great host! The apartment is really lovely. Great location for the metro and local shops and bars. We would definitely recommend Alexandre and his home :)

Chokri's place was perfect for our needs in Paris. It's even better in person and the view from the patio is great! He was very fast with responding to questions and showed us around the apartment in person upon our arrival. It's good for one or two people. It's on the 5th floor so lots of stairs but we didn't mind at all. Be sure to enjoy charcuterie and wine on the patio which has beautiful plants and a fantastic view.

Arthur's place is very pretty and quite large. The apartment was quiet and had a great view of the courtyard and surrounding buildings. The only negative was the apartment was lacking in some items that we ended up having to buy -- laundry detergent, dish soap, paper towels. Additionally there were only two towels in the whole apartment that we could find, which was fine as there were only two of us staying but if you wanted a clean towel during that time you'd have to use the washing machine and, as I noted, we had to buy laundry detergent to do so. Other than that, everything was great.

Agne's place is clean and convenient, 2 or 3 minutes walk to metro, supermarket, bakeries and restaurants. Communication with her was super easy. She responded to my questions fast, which was very important for me because my cell phone was stolen earlier on this trip. Her apartment is actually very easy to find but you NEED to read her instruction very carefully and remember the code to open the gate on the right side of postoffice if you plan to return to the apartment after 9 pm. . I enjoyed my stay there.
It was a great stay! Location wise and suggestions for places was amazing as well. Wish we would have had more time at his place!
Ana was incredibly friendly and accommodating. Had a great stay and will look for this place again next time I'm in Paris. Highly recommend!
Had a little miscommunication at first but the apartment is really nice so it didn't matter. Very charming apartment. Very good job Gilbert I am impressed. Hope to come back
Good apartment at nice location. Neighbourhood is not too touristic and has nice restaurants, bars, bakeries and cafe's at walking distance. Apartment has a rustic feel and was nice and quiet.

Gilbert as a host was really nice and friendly. Breakfast was always nice and set from the previous night. The room was cozy, and Gilbert even provided us with a radiator. The place is located in a quiet and nice area. There are three supermarkets nearby and two bakeries. The metro is close enough to the flat. I would definitely recommend Gilbert's place.

We loved our stay at Francine's place, the apartment has a lot of character and the terrace is serene. She was an amazing host, we had a smooth check in and check out. Would love to stay a her place on our next visit to Paris :)

Excellent choice and excellent host! Five of five stars. The flat is as described and with the big windows even a bit prettier than in the pictures. Everything is there, great location, very clean and all but one of the best things was that Yann really took his time and always responded promptly and helped us out with our questions before we arrived and after, which made check-in/-out and our stay a breeze. Great! Merci beaucoup, Yann!

Colette's beautiful home is the most perfect Parisian home in the heart of Bastille, just a few minutes stroll from the Seine and Notre Dame. She made us feel right at home and we were so comfortable and happy every day of our stay. We fell in love with Paris but the best part was coming home to our cosy room every night to rest our tired feet and greeting Colette with bonjour every morning and receiving the best insider tips to enjoying Paris ❤️

Adam was very accommodating when out flights got changed meaning a rather late arrival time. The apartment is very well appointed in an extremely handy location. There are cafes, metro stations, and a small supermarket close by. It's also conveniently placed as far as tourist attractions are concerned. A great find.
Value for money. Everything was great couldn’t ask for more for spending a few days in Paris.

We had a wonderful stay at these apartments for our group of 8. Check in was extremely smooth and easy, especially given our late arrival. Great location, tons of food options and transportation everywhere. Communication was easy with the hosts. The apartments were clean and comfortable, good Wi-Fi, but a little worn. We loved our stay!

I had a great stay at Arthurs Belleville apartment. It is exactly as it looks in the photos. It's a nice, secure building with a beautiful communal courtyard. The apartment is Light, Clean and nicely furnished. I found the location convenient and discovered lots of great food and coffee options.

The house is clean, nice and cozy, even if small. The area well served, we really enjoyed strolling in the neighborhood. No problem occured during our staying, so it was perfect. I would definitely come back to Julien's house.
Such a well clean place. Apartment was very nice, just like the pictures! Very close to restaurants and metro stations.

It's very close by to the eiffel tower and near really good cafes. The host is really helpful and considerate and will give great advice on visiting all the sites. The room is very clean and private. I would definitely come back and stay with her again.

Great location and lovely apartment that is nicely decorated like in the picture. The bed was also VERY comfortable. I had some check-in issues and was given the wrong access code which Arthur wasn’t aware had changed but luckily someone provided the correct information so my boyfriend and I weren’t locked out. This place was very convenient and the workers in the bars and restaurants nearby were very friendly.

Fantastic apartment for our family, close to everything, great shops and café nearby. Apartment had everything we needed and more. Bruno was very friendly and helpful, welcoming us and providing useful tips. Would recommend this place to everyone

Great location with easy access to public transport, great amenities, loved all the restaurants at the bottom of the hill, a quiet retreat at the end of a busy sightseeing day and overall a true 'home away from home'. Check in with Laurant was easy and any questions were quickly answered. The information provided about both the apartment and the facilities provided were in both French and English, which was a great help Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my time and the apartment was wonderful and I'd have no hesitation in recommending it to anyone visiting Paris.

This is my second time I'm staying at the Thomas place and everything was as great as the first time. Very cute,clean and cozy place. Also Nespresso coffee machine is a very nice treat! :) Highly recommending and definitely would stay there again!
Ana was incredibly welcoming and hospitable, we enjoyed meeting her. The home is well-located between two metro stations and offers convenient parking too.

A very horrible stay it was. The pictures are taken in a way to make it look like a 2 bedroom flat but it’s a studio flat with three portable beds nearly sticking to each other. The place smells of piss. Their was hair everywhere on the bed. I wouldn’t recommend this place at all if you are looking for a 2 bedroom flat to enjoy tor stay in Paris

A perfect apartment for a perfect weekend! We loved our stay at Jean-Francois. Our original Airbnb canceled on us last second and Jean-Francois was there to save the day. We had a late flight but he waited for us and was there to help us get settled and provide helpful recommendations for the weekend. This was the perfect size for three people even four if need be. The location is a fun part of Paris-- you walk out the door and Moulin Rouge is to your right! (this was also a perfect marker to find our way home each day) The metro is also just down the street. Overall, could not have asked for a better stay in Paris.

This place is amazing. The main floor is, as you can see, a beautiful white washed photo studio area with great furnishings, including a couch that turns into a nice little bed. A small dining room with an ajoining kitchenis a all very neat and has the essentials to cook and enjoy meals in the apartment. The bedroom in the loft is very private, and there is lots of light in the little office area that accompanies it up there Jerome was great at communicating, tracked our flight so he could meet us at the place and see us in! Will certainly be staying here again!

Despite the fact that Gilbert speaks only french, he was doin his best to understand english. Thumbs up for his effort! He was friendly and kind always with a smile. It was a great stay in a nice location.
Adrian and Lucas apartment is up-to-date and clean. It has two bathrooms, and only one toilet. The location is quiet but Central, and everything in the apartment works well.

Sophie's place is conveniently located in a residential and wonderful part of the city. There are 4 wonderful bakeries, an incredible market, restaurants, specialty food stores and convenient access to transportation all within 3 blocks of this family oriented neighborhood, two Metro lines are within 5 blocks or so. This beautiful apartment is very clean and had everything we needed during our stay, including fast reliable WiFi. When we had any questions Sophie was always quick to reply and friendly. My wife and I have been to Paris numerous times for long stays and this apartment in this location and with Sophie as a host, is our top choice.
Loved the flat and the Latin Quarter of Paris. Felt very safe. Mai was wonderful. Accommodations were perfect for my adult son and me. Highly recommend!

Clean, fresh apartment in a well connected neighbourhood. It was nice to be in a residential area where children were playing on the footpath. The apartment is quiet and peaceful, not huge but it has everything you need. One note is that the "shower" is just a hand held attachment in the bath - can be tricky.

Ana's place is tiny but very comfortable. And it was incredibly clean, smelling so good! It's also well located, close to public transportation, very easy to reach. Ana is sweet, helpful, quick to reply. Super recommend!

Great place in a great neighborhood. Nice, modern apartment with everything you would need. Comfortable bed, quiet street as there are no restaurants on this street but so close to so many great restaurants and 2 of Paris' best bakeries. Everything about this place was easy. Definitely recommend.

Great host, fabulous stay! The house and the decor is as described at the profile. Neighborhood is perfect; want to cook? Supermarket is just across the street; metro is just around the corner; have a drink? Several bars just around. Want to do some jogging? The promenade plantee near by. The Perfect place, thanks Nicolas!
Everything was very fine! Ana ist a very nice and helpful host. The apartment was very clean and you felt like at home :-). If I visit Paris the next time I would check again at Ana's apartment.

I've stayed with Clara twice, booked once the smaller studio and once this larger space. Both are lovely, the location is perfect: fast transport from both airports, great restaurants around and access to metro and RER ... Clara was helpful and kind, the places both clean and I had everything I needed. Merci beaucoup!
Gilbert was such a nice host! He was very kind and friendly. The bedroom, kitchen and bathroom were clean and well equipped. Thank you so much!

Great Airbnb experience. I liked having my own space and checking with Joan was a breeze. The area is served well by public transit. The room and bedroom were very clean. Might be noisy for people not used to large cities but I slept like a baby.
Very well located, many metro stations around in walk distance. The room is quiet, clean and everything is there. The instructions were all clear and all organized. I totally recommend the place.
Amazing location. The apartment is perfect for a couple. It was well-maintained, clean and comfortable. The apartment building was safe and quiet. We enjoyed the experience.
Great place, had an awesome bed and the park next to the house is really cool. Gilbert was very accommodating even for our 1 night stay. Highly recommend 😁

Stayed at the amazing apartment for a week in November with 7 friends! Was initially nervous about the size, but we were pleasantly surprised by how spacious it was! Apartment looks as nice as it does in the photos (literally identical). Bathrooms are well thought out with the showers and toilet in separate rooms. JP was easy to work with through the entire process, location is in close proximity to metro lines 3 and 11, great restaurants nearby and great bakeries. Will definitely keep this in my favorites for my next visit to Paris.
Wonderful! Unique, charming and clean. The neighborhood could not be better for a visit to Paris. We would love to come back. We were greeted promptly and shown around with no problems.

Awesome host, wonderful commendations and excellent location! My daughter and I stayed with Gilbert for 5 nights. We were amazed by the design of his home and appreciated the safe & convenient neighborhood. Thank you for offering you home to us.
We have a lovely stay, Emmanuel was the perfect host and made us feel very welcome, even with a later check-in! I would thoroughly recommend.

This apartment is truly beautiful, furnished with great taste and equipped with all the amenities. The location is even better, just minutes away from shops, restaurants and bars, but located in an internal court away from noise. Communication was fast and the check in was easy. We were there with our 2 sons and a new born, a cot was made available to us. We didn’t meet with Adrien or Luka but their friend who met us was very helpful and accomodating. I would recommend this apartment to families with older children, couples and people on business.

Muriel was so wonderful! So many suggestions and offered to help whenever we asked. The place was a great location and she gave us great nearby restaurant locations. Place was comfortable and the bed too. We hope we can come back and stay with her on our next trip!

Great apartment. Two blocks away from the subway and walking distance (20 min walking max) of many attractions....the area was great also...Eiffel tower 5 min away, supermarkets and restaurants nearby... Chachou was very attentive and responded super quickly. Definitely recommended!!!
Gilbert is a very polite host, always smiling and flexible. The apartment is BEAUTIFUL and the bedroom is big and perfectly decorated. Some extra points for the breakfast :D Thank you Gilbert!

I cannot say enough good things about this airbnb and Catherine! From the initial booking process through our time in Paris, Catherine was responsive, helpful and just lovely all around. She made sure to give us an overview of the apt when we arrived, helped organize transportation from the airport to the apt and gave us wonderful local tips. The apartment was the perfect size for myself and my husband. The kitchen is equipped with all the basic necessities for us to make coffee, breakfast and even a few dinners. The bathroom was great (shower size and water pressure were perfect) and the bed was large and comfortable. The location is wonderful to explore Montmartre. There are local markets for stocking up on water and basic needs. There are great restaurants and shops nearby as well. Closeness to the metro was wonderful and convenient. Overall we had an absolutely fantastic time in Paris and loved our stay at Catherine's apartment!
Lovely little apartment, right in next to a metro so is a perfect location. Emanuel was more then accommodating and extremely helpful. Would definitely reccomend!

Ana communication was great from the beginning, she was very attentive and helpful during our stay in Paris. The place is absolutely nice and well equipped, very well located. It is clean and bright! I recommend it to anyone who visits Paris!
Highly recommended. Beautiful warm apartment and very convenient. Quite, Even though it's on the Main Street. Looks exactly like in the pictures.

What an amazing location for exploring Paris. The apartment is very large by local standards. Communication was quick and checking into the apartment was easy. We would love to stay here again one day. Thank you for everything!
Benoit was a great host and his place was wonderful. It is centrally located, very clean and spacious and has great views of Paris! Defiinitely would stay here again!
Great location, close to Metro. Perfect place to base yourself for Paris adventure, especially for small family. Mezzanine bedroom good for kids. Nice small kitchen for breakfast and snacks. Enjoy.

What a wonderful apartment with great decor. An amazing host. In the heart of Paris and close to every amenity you may need. The apartment fits a family of four with no issue. Trains, Taxis and buses are all right outside the front door. I would bring my family back here in a heartbeat. Thank you to a wonderful host for an excellent stay.

All in all I can recommend Francis apartment even though it's really small (but ok for a short period of time ) and a bit dirty. However Francis hospitality as well as the excellent location can outweigh these negative aspects
Good size apartment in great location (close to subway & bus). Denis was welcoming and responsive. We would definitely stay there again.

The B&B was great! Excellent location, friendly guests; Cedric's father was incredibly helpful and welcoming. We really enjoyed the local area as there is ample street art in the Buttes-aux-Cailles area of the 13th. I would highly recommend staying.

Wonderful apartment, the decoration of the apartment is lovely and the host put great attention to details. The apartment itself is very well equiped, it was spotless clean and very well maintained. Location-wise is great, close to restaurants, bars, shops, and metro. The host was quick to answer all questions too. Ohhh, and I really loved the bathtub too! I just wished I could stay longer!
Loved the apartment, in a great neighbour hood close to many restaurants and metro lines. Sophie was great to communicate with, would highly recommend.

The apartment is close to an underground station, grocery shops and a pharmacy. The room we stayed in was pretty small, but it’s a great space to rest your head which is really all we wanted to do. The bathroom is lovely and clean, and the house is really warm (which was great to come back to during the winter).
You’ll be happy if you rent this place. It’s small, even so, it has all the room you need.

First class stay all the way! Like a first class hotel room but with a kitchen and a deep bath tub. Very comfortable king size bed and the neighborhood is outstanding. Near the metro. You can go anywhere to paris from here. The stairs is not really that tiring. The balcony offers outstanding view . What more can you ask for? Everything is here, in this flat.

The place is located very nicely - great view of the Eiffel Tower from the balcony. The room had all necessary amenities and was very comfortable. You will find a good set of sheets, towels, plug adapters, cutlery, etc. Minor downsides - The bed could have been a bit more stable and the washroom and kitchen areas seemed a tad smaller. But nothing bad about them

One of my favourite rooms I have stayed in while in Paris! Great if you are someone who appreciates the privacy and your own space. Everything is clean and nicely decorated. I would 500% reccomend this place :)

Great place to stay with the nicest hostess, very patient and kind. The place is very clean and everything is thought out for the guest. Location is perfect, only a few minutes from the metro and or bar/ cafe. Recommend this place to anyone looking for convenience and prefers a nice place to stay while visiting Paris.
Very nice Landlord！Helped me with my serious problem；）Told us how to travel Paris clearly and warmly.
Gilbert's place is greatly located, a very nice apartment an he is a great person. I totally recommend it.
I stayed with 3 friends and we had a wonderful stay. There was plenty of space, only the single bed is quite small when you’re a large person. Valentina was a great hosts and responded quickly!
Great location and fantastic place. The whole process of booking and checking in was perfect. Thank you!

Kathleen is a wonderful host. The room is in a central, safe and at the same time, very quiet neighboorhood. The place is actually nicer than the pictures. Although it is a shared apartment, the room has its own entrance, bathroom and toilet, and I had all the privacy I needed during my one-week stay. Transport to all Paris has to offer was very convenient, with many metro and bus stops close by. I also enjoyed the proximity of the lovely Parc Monceau. I would definitely choose Kathleen's place for my next trip to Paris.
This place was as beautiful as it looked in the photos! Lots of nice touches. Great location. Easy check-in.

This is probably the best airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. The place is beautiful, spotless, very organized, and more than big enough for 4 people, with a couple of extra mattresses if needed. It’s a 3 minute walk to the subway and 10-15min to the eiffel tower with an incredible view when you walk across the bridge. We truly had a wonderful time, and everything was easy to coordinate. We got the key from the janitor who is lovely and very helpful, and gave it back to her when we left. Guy is very quick to respond to messages if you have any questions, and he is very thoughtful. He left us bar soap and chocolates with clean sheets and towels, coffee, and milk in the fridge. I would 100% recommend this place to anyone. The only shame is that I never got to meet Guy because I would have loved to thank him in person!

An absolutely great apartment with everything you may ever need. Very bright and with a really quiet bedroom. Location is totally perfect as well as metro station, groceries, banks are just around the corner. Highly recommended!
Great location, wonderful host and clean. This is a great spot if you are in need of two bedrooms.

Yann was an awesome host! Place was clean and tidy, very central and great access to public transport! Was a small place, but is perfect for those who are out all day and want to come back to relax. Highly recommend especially value for money wise!
Wolfwolf was a delight to deal with and the apartment is super convenient and the view is a postcard.

Irene is the best honest I have met before,she is waiting for me when I arrived even the flight is delayed.her house has everything I need.just like home.I love All the rooms and details.the room is very quiet.and Irene is so nice person.location and the building are perfect.subway just around the corner.I will definitely book again next time.take care and see you soon.
Ana's place was a quick ride to all the main sites on the transit right around the corner. She was easy to communicate with and was helpful with any questions we had!

The location is wonderful, the apartment is spacious. Centrally located to the Lourve and Markets! But there was a leak, and they didn't fix it when asked. We had to spend out limit resources to ensure the entire bathroom wasn't flooded. If I come back to Paris, this will not likely be my choice of accommodation again

If you have the opportunity to rent Alexandra’s apartment in the Marais, seize it! It’s beautiful, cozy, super quiet, secure, and lovely. My only regret is that we didn’t spend more time exploring the neighborhood. Alexandra was very communicative and responsive.
Gilbert was very accommodating and his house was everything we expected it to be and at a good price. Definitely recommend!

My second time to stay and for sure there will be a third, my home from home in Paris, conveniently located in the beautiful 17th arrondissement, Julien & his family provide you with a warm welcome and a very comfortable and private place to stay. Thank you!

We have found the best apartment in Paris, hands down! Yohann’s place was super clean, well appointed, comfortable and even better - in an incredible, walkable, classic Paris neighborhood. The communication was super smooth and very quick, and we enjoyed the quiet of the apartment while also benefiting from being walking distance from so many great restaurants and shops. The added bonus was the second bedroom full of kids toys, games and books. Our daughter was thrilled to have plenty to play with and explore and it was super nice to have many new things to enjoy without us having to pack too much. Thank you for your hospitality!

Hannelore and Gerard were wonderful hosts. They were always eager to help and had great advice about Paris. The room was cozy and although the space is shared they were diligent in providing privacy. The location is close to all needed amenities including the bus and metro into the downtown.

Me and my sister had a really good time at Majid apartment. The location is great, very quite neighbourhood with supermarkets nearby and well connected and close to the centre. Majid is very kind and always available if you need anything. I would highly recomment it!

Amazing apartment, fully equipped with all you need for a perfect stay. You will not find someones clothes and other belongings like many other airbnb places. It is simple, stylish and extremely (!!) clean which was very important for me. Lovely neighborhood around with many nice small caffes and restaurants. I would definitely recommend this place and stay here myself again and again. Thank you Thomas!

Location, location, location. And a great apartment close to all the things you need and want. Check in and out was a breeze and the apartment was fantastic for our family of five. We will return when next coming to Paris!!!

We had a fantastic stay in Georges and Sylvie’s apartment. The location is perfect for seeing the tourist attractions. The neighbourhood is lively with lots of bars and restaurants nearby. The street and apartment block are quiet. Communication and check- in was absolutely perfect. The apartment was immaculate and stylish. The bed is very comfortable. We had everything we needed to make ourselves at home and there were lovely extra touches like coffee and toiletries. One of our best ever Airbnb experiences. Thank you Georges and Sylvie.
Jean Francois's place is exactly as per the photos. Very stylish and we'll located. And he is a very warm and responsive host. Recommend!

Amazing place in the Heart of the Marais. Very romantic with a balcony view. This is by far the best air bnb we have stayed in Paris. Now, as everyone else mentioned, there are 98 stairs (not that we counted) or 6 flights of stairs. This might deter some people but it is worth the climb. Our host was very helpful and the bottle of wine was a nice touch. The rain shower was also amazing. Can’t say enough about how much we enjoyed the flat. Will stay here again and again if we get the chance
We had a wonderful time, there were 4 of us and the space was perfect for us. A nice 20 min walk to the eiffel tower and local bus and metro close by!

Gilbert was an outstanding host. He was there to greet us, he showed us around and recommended different areas to see. Although he did not speak much English, he was easy to understand and used google translator to assist him. He was a very easy going, light hearted man. The room was spectacular; extremely clean with a comfortable bed. The bathroom was clean and attached to the room. He had breakfast out for us in the morning and went out of his way to make us a morning coffee. It was in a great location, very close to the train and central to Paris. We couldn't be more thrilled with our stay. Gilbert made it easy to feel at home. We would strongly recommend Gilbert's beautiful home.

Jean-Francois was a brilliant host! He replied to my messages very quickly and the apartment has everything you need. It’s in a brilliant location - perfect! Very quiet in the apartment but only a few steps away from the hustle and bustle. Lots of great restaurants and bars around. I would definitely stay again! Thank you for having us!
self check-in is difficult when the key box is hard to find and see, and the flat door entry is complicated. wonderful location.
Aurelie’s place is wonderful and superbly located to explore Paris. The apartment is beautiful and full of character. We would highly recommend.

This place is such a great deal in Paris with a caring and helpful host. Located in a cool neighborhood, close to pretty much everything. Alexandre is for sure one of the most thoughtful hosts I've ever met. Helped me with a big concern when we arrived, and made sure our trip was perfect. Once again - thank you Alexandre.

The apartment was nice, as expected- warm, very well organized and equipped; very well located; but Vincent was more than nice - he went some extra mile to assist us on our stay - beginning from the very late check-in throughout the visit. So - thanks Vincent.

Mathieu was a great and very accommodating host. He was readily available and very accessible upon arrival. Great communication, once we arrived. The apartment is well appointed and well located within a block of grocery stores, restaurants and the metro. It’s location in the middle of a side street made for a quiet atmosphere inside the apartment.

Really nice apartment, small but great usage of the space. We liked that it has a washing machine and it’s really nicely furnished in general - we didn’t miss a thing while staying here! Only minus is that it’s a bit noisy, the walls are kind of thin and you can hear the neighbors occasionally. The location is great, we spend four days in Paris without even considering to get a metro pass because everything’s so close.
Great Location and view of the Eiffel tower both day and night. Nicely located close to 2 Metro locations making it easy to get around the city and Gare de Nord.
Lovely stay and a lovely host. Françoise helped us with everything that we needed and made us feel at home :)

This apartment was exactly as advertised, quiet location but close to everything you need. Check in was really easy and communication during the booking process was clear and prompt It is a short walk to Notre Dame and there are plenty of good places to eat close by. There are two small supermarkets within 2 mins if you need to stock up on supplies. St Michel station is 5 mins away for the RER and there is a metro station just around the corner which made things easy A really good find!
Louise was very hospitable. The space was small but stylish and the amenities were great. Location is fantastic! Would definitely stay there again.
Perfect location for the Eiffel Tower. Only a few blocks away. Great bakery close buy! Beautiful newly renovated apt, very modern. Would highly recommend. A great place to spend your Birthday.

First, Nicolas & Jean-Yves’s place is exactly what the pictures and description depict - there are no surprises except that it is even nicer than it looks on line. We found everything clean and in working order and the house is incredibly well-equipped. It is also beautiful. The neighborhood is absolutely perfect because, as others have said, everything you need is within a block’s walking distance including a full grocery store and pharmacy but more important a patisserie, a boulangerie, charcuterie and tons of restaurants. If you want to cook at the house or go out it is all within a moments walk. Also, the Voltaire metro station is less than a city block away. We loved exploring the city and then returning “home” to a very comfortable place to hang out together and to have privacy from each other too. The whole thing was perfection. Communication with Nicholas was also very easy and he could not have been nicer.

My wife and I are now retired and had not been back to Paris in many years although we have stayed in many other international apartments. We chose Alexandra’s apartment based on the great location and many positive reviews. It was perfect for us. We agree with other reviews that this large apartment is quite wonderful, well equipped, away from the street and very secure. Both beds were very comfortable. At our age, the reliable new elevator was very helpful in this historic building. A noisy band mentioned as a lively ‘party’ in another review appeared to be a pop-up night club that was noisy for two nights but closed by the police as we were checking out. We would love to be Alexandra’s guests here again when we return to Paris.
Gilbert was extremely kind throughout our whole trip! His home was beautiful and made for a great stay. Would definitely recommend staying here :)

This is a great place to stay. I was there for two weeks and wouldn't have wanted to be anywhere else! The location is perfect--a short walk to the Efile tower and right next to the metro/monoprix. I felt safe coming back late at night because the 16th district is very nice. Suzie is delightful! She's helpful and kind and makes you feel at home in her place. Would definitely recommend this to anyone!

Location is amazing! 2 blocks from the metro (line 8), walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and Invalides. It's a studio apartment but good size for 2 people and really nice. It can be a little bit noisy during the night as it is in the first floor but not terribly noisy.
Loved staying at Parc Royal. Location excellent. Apartment dark but lovely... very tasteful decor. Comfortable and practical space. I would definitely stay here again.

Amazing apartment near the Luxembourg gardens. Great spot with heaps to eat around, well connected with the metro lines and the apartment was everything we expected and more. Louise was an amazing host, warm and helpful and the check in and checkout went smoothly.
Julien is a very well organized host, the house is very comfortable, clean and near to Metrò.

We stayed at Adrian and Luka’s place for 4 nights. The apartment was very spacious and clean. The location was excellent, within walking distance to the Louvre, public transit, a small supermarket and restaurants. We received a welcome kit prior to our arrival which was very helpful. We would definitely stay here again if we ever return to Paris and highly recommend Adrian and Luka’s place!

Gilbert house is extremely clean and is way better in reality than the Airbnb pictures! He’s an extremely warm host, our flight got delayed and we reached late night, but he warmly welcomed us! Location is great as well with good eateries nearby. He was thoughtful enough to put up a breakfast spread for us too! Would definitely recommend his place to everyone :) Thank you Gilbert

The apartment is located perfectly, 10 min walk to the Eiffel Tower. The apartment has everything, it is completed as for myself. I really liked the sink for two. Separately, I would like to note the fresh repair, a good mattress on the bed, excellent bed linen, beautiful dishes. There is a coffee machine, washing machine, microwave, hairdryer, iron. There are three beds 2 + 1, so the apartment is suitable for everyone: singles, couples, couples with a child, two friends. The house has a clean entrance and a cozy patio. David is a very hospitable host, I want to return here again.

This place is everything it says it will be. It’s in a super hip area with lots of shopping and restaurants around. Metro and bus are all very close and convenient to get to all the major tour areas. Denis is a wonderful host and he even called the restaurant for us to make a reservation because neither one of us speak fluent French. He has a lot of nice touches like providing us with breakfast and bottled water and a blow dryer. The bathroom is a good size - especially when other places are not. Highly recommended!
The apartment is as described! Markets, restaurant, bars and different metros entrances are within minutes of walking. The area is safe and lively We had a perfect time in Sophie’s place

This was our first Airbnb experience and it could not have gone better! Vincent was truly a remarkable host from the time we made the reservation to the time we returned home following our vacation. The location was ideal and so very Parisian! My husband and I brought our 5 month old and it was so nice to have the space of the apartment as well as the washer/dryer. While the apartment was on the 3rd floor, we did not consider this a negative; just extra exercise. Vincent also provided a lock for our stroller so we didn't need to bring it up and down everyday. He truly thought of all the little details to make our stay comfortable. We give both Vincent and the apartment 5 stars!

Looking for a place near the Eiffel Tower? This should be it. Great view, close walk, and comfortable stay. Bed is a fouton, so could be better, but is a very comfortable apartment all in all. Highly recommend this

Wonderful apartment. Just the right size and very comfortable and clean. Host was most accomadating and responsive. Very clean, everything we could have needed and more than we expected in every way. Thanks for a great stay Stephane and Sophie.
Wolfwolf was such a nice host! The view of the Eiffel Tower from bed was about the best as it gets! Great and chic neighborhood was plenty local shops.

Mireille’s place is cute, clean, safe and the perfect space for 2 people. The location is perfect! You can walk to the subway or to the metro. A block away is a pedestrian street full of food markets, bakeries, restaurants and bars. There’s also a grocery store a block away. All the tourist stops are only 20-30 min away by train. We would stay at Mireille’s the next time we are in Paris for sure! She is a great host and very accommodating!

Christine is a very kind, flexible and thoughtful host. She was always in touch with us to make sure everything was ok. The apartment is big and cozy, perfectly located, very close to the metro and city touristic places, restaurants and bars, couldn’t really ask for a better area to easily move around Paris.

Suzie's apartment is a dream! It is in the perfect location - just a few minutes walk to the Eiffel Tower, the metro, restaurants, and markets. The room was small but had all of the essentials. Suzie was very welcoming and accommodating as well!

Beautifully designed place in the Parisian rooftops. Alexandre is so helpful at providing tips and helping with what to do. There was a train strike on when we stayed and Alexandre kept us fully up to date on all trains for our journey back. The location is great, very cool little area about a 20 min walk to the right bank. Highly recommend!
Brilliant space, close to public transport, supermarkets & historic land marks. Would definitely stay here again.

Emmanuel's apartment is exactly what you expect from the photos and reviews. The photos don't actually live up to the space... tons of natural light, nice open floor plan, big bathroom. Great neighborhood as well... if you don't have plans for restaurants elsewhere, the neighborhood is filled with tons of great options, so you don't actually need to go very far.

Every stellar review I read about Hannelore’s place is true. She is a lovely lady. I only wish we had visited with her and her husband more, but we all tended to be out and about most of the time. The apartment is very nice, well decorated, and is kept extremely clean and is within a few blocks of the metro stop. The mattress on the bed is extremely comfortable, but as one other reviewer wrote, the top of the mattress is low to the ground which can make getting out of bed a greater challenge than usual. I whole-heartedly recommend this place and I hope I get a chance to stay there again! P.S. - About a half block before you reach the apartment from the metro on the other side of the street is a place to buy pastries. Try the almond covered one.
Ana's place is conviently located to many metro lines and is in a quiet, residential street. Ana was a wonderful host and very communicative during check in/out.

What a great Air BnB. Brad's communication was excellent. It is perfect for one or two. The apartment is quiet, well situated and is comfortable with everything you need. The location is fantastic because you are close enough to walk all around Sacre Coeur and explore the area but you are living on a street where everyone knows each other and it feels like a village. I went every day to Le Dauphin and was welcomed like a regular. It is also great exercise walking up all the staircases to Montmartre. It is really close to the metro. I would happily return.
Jean was great...very helpful, easy going and accompanying. Place was in a central location and easily accessible. Would come back again.

Maria is a kind and hospitable lady. She cooked dinner for me on my first night, offered lunch the next day. She provided clean linens throughout my stay and was a good conversationalist despite the language barrier between my poor french and her poor english we got along splendid. One evening she played the piano and it was quite relaxing to listen to. Only complaints would be the noisy (sqeaky) floors, the uncomfortability of the bed and the shower with its difficult door.

Sophie’s place was adorable and conveniently close to markets, restaurants, the metro, and a short uber ride to everything we wanted to see and experience during our trip in Paris. It is in a nice and quiet area. She responds to messages quickly and was super helpful. I would definitely stay here again and recommend to all!

This is a terrific apartment in a great location -- spacious and beautifully maintained. For our group of four it was ideal with two nicely-sized bedrooms and great public spaces. Communication was excellent with hosts who seem to have thought of everything to enhance the comfort of their guests.
This place is in a great location near the metro. The host is attentive and responded promptly to all our questions. The gardens in the backyard are lovely.

Isabelle and her family are the most superb hosts in the whole world! She is so nice friendly, thoughtful and caring, made me feel at home. I had a wonderful time in her house. First the location is superb, you can have shops downstairs, cinema and shopping street nearby. Secondly, the traffic is very convenient. Thirdly, Isabelle made the room so comfortable, you can find the decorations are well-detailed. Isabelle is so cool and kind, I wish I can stay in Paris longer. Love her so much and strongly recommend this place!

Gilbert was very friendly, the room was spacious and there's a nice terrace connected to it, where you can drink your morning coffee. Even though you share the bathroom and toilet, you get the sense of privacy; Gilbert is helpful, but not intrusive. The neighborhood is beautiful and cozy and not as touristic as other parts of Paris. Other arrondissements are easily reachable per metro. Would definitely stay here again. Merci Gilbert!
Fantastic location, which also means it can be a bit noisy if you like to sleep with the windows open! It’s a huge apartment for Paris, and we enjoyed the space!
Overall, this was a great place to stay in Paris. Location is excellent, and studio is clean. Communication was also easy. The only con was the bathroom was really tiny, but it was overall worth it

Emmanuel and Beatrice are one of the most friendly hosts we ever had. Always a good advice to support us. We felt warm welcomed. The flat was very well equipped and ideal for a city trip. Would be our prefered accommodation at our next travel to Paris. Irina & Jürgen

This is a nice clean studio apartment in the 19th arr. of Paris, which is a great local area with almost no tourists. Beautiful park nearby, organic store around the corner (Naturalia), larger grocery store down the block, Metro 5 minutes walking, and just a few metro stops from all the downtown Paris touristy things. Highly recommend

We thoroughly enjoyed our short stay at Mai's flat in Paris. The Mouffetard area was a perfect base for our visit with all of the shops and restaurants so nearby. We were able to walk or take the metro to all area's of interest including a day at Roland Garros for the open. The apartment was exactly as described and the check-in /check-out was quick and easy. Mai contacted us immediately when she found a necklace that we had left behind and had in the mail back to us that same day!

Very nice apartment. The location is excellent. Right next to the metro. Best view of the Eiffel Tower with only 5 minutes walk. The interior design is quite stylish. Francine is really nice & sweet. She welcomed us in person & offer lots of great advise.
Very comfortable, spacious and beautifully laid out. Lots of storage and all the appliances worked well. Vitalina was available via messaging whenever we needed her.

Bruno’s apartment is in a great location; close to supermarket, bakery, chemist, cafes, bars, restaurants and Metro. We were a party of 4 adults requiring three bedrooms and this suited us perfectly. The living area is quite large and the apartment is a large one by French standards. The kitchen and amenities were more than adequate. This is Bruno’s home and has homely touches and everything you need. Bruno was there to welcome us and show us how to use the amenities. He is a good communicator and I would recommend this accomodation..

Lovely flat as described. When I booked there was not an elevator, however one is being installed. Wonderful recommendations from Louise for dining. We loved Georgette’s right across the street. Delicious!!! Lots of shopping nearby and close to public transportation. Great location. WiFi worked excellently. We would stay with Louise again!

Cedtic is very hospitable and positive， we talked a lot , he showed us how to take bus or metro , he made the best breakfast for us, it's fresh and tasted great .the room is clean and tidy , the neighborhood is very quite , we really enjoyed the night . Thank you so much ,Cedric, wish you happy life !

Alice's flat looked incredible on the picture, and it's even better for real ! She has a great eye for design, and every touch was awesome ! Volumes and lights are impressive, and the mezzanine is very comfy : a real nest under parisian roofs ! Alice is very nice, responsive and cheerful ! Bonuses : last floor with elevator, the open view, the bath tub, and the over equipped kitchen with everything you need and more ! I would definitely stay there again.
David was quick to respond when needed. Apartment was great, comfortable. Great location for train & especially walking to the Eiffel Tower. Very safe environment.

I had a lovely 6 days in Paris largely due to this perfectly located room! A quick walk away from an assortment of trains, I was near every site I wanted to visit in 30 minutes or less. Exceptionally clean and secure, I couldn't have chosen a better place to stay. Just note that you will hear street noise, but as a native New Yorker I was more than used to this. For the more sensitive ears, bring earplugs :)
A perfect place when taking family to Paris. The 4 of us were very comfortable. She even provided toys for the baby.
Great place but you should know that it is above a very popular bar that stays open late. They get loud in Paris in the evenings. Cheers

Clementine's place is full of character and it turned out to be just what we needed for our little getaway in Paris. Both my partner and me had all the time the thought that if we lived in Paris ... it would be nice to live in a place like this. Thanks to the character(istics) of the place, during our brief stay we felt like at home and part of the great city that Paris is . As an added value, our host was very attentive and flawless in all the welcoming details and with communication. It was great!

Seb’s place was absolutely terrific. His house looks just as they do in the photos and was impeccably clean and well appointed. The location is perfectly situated between 2 metro stations, with grocery stores, eateries, and so much more! We also loved coming home to his place, as it was comfortable and inviting and just all around perfect. We couldn’t have asked for a better place in Paris. (PS. the bed is extremely comfy and Seb is so very kind and sweet!!)

This is a charming, comfortable room in a 19th century apartment located very close to the Champs Elysée. Travel to anywhere in Paris was easy and quick. Happy was a kind, flexible, and knowledgeable hostess, and speaks English like a native. I felt at home and always welcome. I would never stay anywhere else in Paris!
A wonderful stay. Ana is a charming host who was available at all times, luckily we didn't need her!

I stayed at this lovely studio for 4 days and found everything to be fantastic; from the space to the location to the host! David, Martin's son, was my primary contact. He was incredibly responsive and attentive throughout my stay. The studio itself was lovelier than I expected. The design was quite sleek and modern. The studio is situated along a quiet residential street with several shops and cafes close by. It is also within a short walking distance to gorgeous Parc des Buttes Chaumont (a revelation!), and is a 20 to 25 minute Metro ride from the City Centre. From space to location to host, you will not go wrong with this studio!
Mai's flat was cozy and in a great little neighborhood. We would definitely stay there again.

The apartment is cosy and clean, and the location is good. Charming neighborhood, many restaurants and shops nearby. Catherine is a great host, very friendly and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment.

I would highly recommend Clarisse's apartment for your stay in Paris. The apartment was exactly as it was described. I was traveling with my two adult sons and we each needed our own space. Because of the layout of the apartment we each had our own room with a door. Clarisse is very welcoming and makes you feel right at home. Whenever I contacted her, Clarisse got back to me right away.
