Just a great location in Paris! It is very close walking distance to so many places in Paris. Plenty of great restaurants literally right on your doorstep. The apartment itself is very spacious with plenty of space to spread out. The hosts were responsive and organized. Only point I would make is that it is so well located, that it can get a little loud during warmer evenings, particularly on Friday and Saturday nights. The hosts have done their best job to block street noise as much as possible, so it is not too bad. Just a little something to be aware of. Overall this is just a great place to stay in Paris! My wife and I had a wonderful stay with our young daughter. Thank you once again!

We loved our stay at Sidonie’s Parisian loft - just steps away from the Arc De Triomphe. Very centrally located with an excellent train station with good access to the rest of Paris. A little bit of noise late at night on the weekends, but that’s to be expected given how central it is. It’s a very compact loft but it has everything that you need! Sidonie is a fantastic host. Easy to reach, helpful and kind! Would definitely recommend if you wish to have a true Parisian experience.
Great apartment Vibrant area, but apartment was quiet due to double glazing and on 4th storey. Douglas and Flore extremely responsive and helpful

This was a fabulous place to stay. It was between the Lourve and the Opera which made it easy to access everything. The place was in a lovely courtyard, well cared for, clean and comfortable. Would highly recommend.

Not only were Maria, Alain and their apartment everything you'd hope for in an Air BnB (clean, well appointed, fabulous location, quiet with attentive hosts), on our last night in Paris they became our hero when we suddenly realized we'd left our phone on the tour bus from Versailles! Alain manage all communication with the bus company and then he personally went to retrieve our phone from the company and brought it to us at the apartment and refused our attempts to reimburse him for his efforts. Our last evening on vacation went from being a nightmare to a wonderful cap to our time in France. THANK YOU Maria and Alain!!!
Stay was very pleasant 😇 Beatrice was very helpful. Apartament is really equipped - hair dryer, iron, that was very helpfull

Great stay in Manar's place. Everything was as described, and Manar was welcoming and helpful. Air conditioning would be a nice addition, but it wasn't necessary since I could get a decent breeze in the room by opening the window.

Would definitely recommend to stay here. Jean was nothing short of welcoming and always checked in to see if everything was okay. The place was clean, spacious and was also very accessible via the metro. Thank you so much Jean!
The host was really friendly and solved our problems quickly. The place was near the museums and convenient to transport.

Excellent location with 3 mins to Porte d'Orléans metro station, Nice neighborhood and surrounded by many restaurants and convenient stores. Host was extremely nice and informative. Their traditional French breakfast was served on time with the best quality of hot drinks and croissants.

Beautiful clean and very convenient apartment. We have everything we need for the night. The co-host was so nice as she let us check in early because we have kids after a long flight to Paris. Communication was great, so fast and effective. The beds are very comfortable and clean. It was amazing after a long flight. We would highly recommend the place ❤️
Great place. We would definitely stay again. Good location with easy access to restaurants, stores and metro stations.

What a gorgeous house with garden and greenery all around in the heart of Montmartre! So peaceful yet you step our your door and your in all the action! Just perfect! Jeanne was an amazing host! Greeted us in person, flexible check in and check out, super responsive and helpful! She gave us lovely recommendations too! Merci beaucoup Jeanne!

This is a very comfortable apartment in a great area -- quiet on the street but walkable and with nearby access to the metro, restaurants, cafes, bakeries, etc. It is not touristy at all, so you can feel almost like you're living as a Parisian. The apartment easily accommodates two people. We appreciated the coffee maker and the washer and dryer, as well as the comfortable bed and reliable wifi. There is no a/c, but with a fan and large windows, it is cool enough. For most of our stay, the elevator in the building was not working -- so be prepared to walk up to the 3rd floor. Check-in by retrieving the keys from a locker at a nearby grocery store took some figuring out, but it did allow for a flexible arrival, and Nicholas was very attentive. Thank you for a great stay!
Lovely stay right in the centre of Paris! Maria was helpful with setting the apartment up and was flexible with dropping our luggage in earlier than check in. Would stay again!

Pascale was a wonderful host, and her apartment is exceptionally charming and has everything you need. Very clean. There were 4 of us - 2 adults and 2 teens, and we had plenty of space... only one shower, but toilet is in a separate place from the shower, so you weren't stuck waiting to go to toilet when someone was using the shower. One note - the description says A/C, but there is no actual air-conditioning unit. We discovered that when we got there. However, the windows create a terrific breeze and we were very comfortable (sometimes even chilly) at night. Pascale also has two dyson fans available for use. We were not around during the day, as we did lots of site seeing, so I am not sure if no A/C during the day might be too hot. We stayed for almost a full week in mid- June.

My stay was great at Salvatore's apartment. I really enjoyed that the apartment was not in the middle of all tourist attractions, which made it more relaxing! Salvatore was extremely responsive and helpful with checkin, a guide for places to visit, and checkout. Highly recommend a stay here!

The apartment is very modern and clean. Location is amazing, easy to get to many major sightseeing spots. There are many bars, amazing restaurants and gelato shops around. The sound proofing of the apartment is extraordinary good, we can have a very good sleep. Security of the building is good, requires a code with digital key, very safe. The owner is really kind and he is very fast in response and very helpful and always gave us very detail instructions. We had a delay in the train journey to the apartment, we can still keep a close communication and update with each other for the arrival time and check-in process for every half an hour and the owner also kept update us about the latest arrangement. We had a wonderful holiday in Paris, lots of good food and beautiful buildings. A highly recommended place for everyone to stay in Paris for holidays.
Lisa is a wonderful host that would give you tons of information to make your stay enjoyable. Her recommendations were right on point!

My husband and I and our 12 year old granddaughter had a wonderful experience at the beautiful chic apartment. The location just can’t be better for visiting all the museums, parks, shopping and restaurants. We had a great experience booking this as our host Gabrielle was very responsive to all questions. Would definitely book this again and again! .

Laurent’s place was close to different metro stations and few stops from major attractions. Laurent was very responsive to every message sent and willing to help. Laurent also help us finding good restaurants and breakfast placed around the area. The apartment has 2 shower bathrooms but these doesn’t have a toilet. There is only 1 toilet in the apartment. For 6 adults and 2 kids, this was a stretch. I explained to Laurent about an incident with the cleaning personnel and he immediately took care of it. Overall, I will definitely recommend staying at Laurent apartment because of the proximity to major attractions and cost of accommodation in Paris for many people.
We had a beautiful stay at Chloe’s place, it was even better than the photos and the location was amazing :)) would stay again
Lovely apartment in a great location with a very friendly and responsive host! Would definitely recommend.

Beautifully appointed flat and felt like home from home. It's on a peaceful square, and it's got all that you need. It's close to Gare du Nord and easy walking distance to central Paris. Great windows for watching life on the square outside. The hosts were super helpful, very accommodating and responsive. We received very clear instructions on how to find and access the apartment.

Really nice host, replying quickly with good advices. Very hot in the apartment (June) but we had access to a fan keeping the heat down. Room lies towards a garden so there is no issue with car noise but some neighbors were a bit noisy (slammed doors). A bit long walk to the Metro. Overall, a very nice apartment for two and I can highly recommend it!
Karine is welcoming host and her home is a lovely space to enjoy the city. Clean and fully equipped.

Our family of 5 enjoyed our stay. The apartment was big enough for us and the air conditioning was wonderful during the heat wave. Mathieu was quick to respond and bring a few items that were missing. The apartment was very clean. Location to the metro was close- only a block away.
Fantastic stay at Alex’s. He was very proactive with providing instructions and checking whether we needed anything. Lovely location and would stay again.
Brilliant stay ! Clean, modern apartment close to metro. Places very near to shop for essentials and restaurants close by. Small, but perfect for 2 people.
Amazing apartment in walking distance to the Eiffel Tower. Restaurants and shops closely. Would definitely come back again !

We enjoyed the airy and lovely decorated apartment with interesting art and lots of books. We read about small bath so weren’t surprised. I believe an elderly person might have difficulty stepping over and into tub. Close to metro so very convenient to get around. Nice bakeries and Monoprix nearby. I would stay there again

We had a wonderful experience from start to finish! The apartment is located on a quieter street but so close to all of the action, cafes and more. We walked everywhere and came “home” to a comfortable and cool (hooray for AC!) apartment at the end of the day. Brijid was so helpful and quick to respond to any questions we had and her instructions were clear and easy to follow. It was absolutely perfect for our family of four!

We loved our stay in Paris and would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a place to stay in Montmarte. The space was tidy and clean and Younes was very helpful with sending instructions and providing recommendations. Would stay here again!
Wonderful stay and location! Room was great, location was great. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a peaceful Paris stay.

Great place to stay for our family of 6. Plenty of beds and space. Having the metro and two good bakeries across the street made the stay extra nice and very easy in the mornings for breakfast and take the metro to anywhere we wanted to go. Nathalie was very friendly, helpful and provided the right amount of information. We will certainly recommend Santos’s place!
Christine’s place was lovely and in a perfect location. It’s spacious, clean, quiet, and the patio was very refreshing.

Overall we really enjoyed the space in this Airbnb. We do feel like it was very apparent this was a rental unit, things just weren’t as clean as we would have hoped and many outlets were inoperable. Location was convenient to a metro station but further away from the city center than we would have liked. Would stay here again and overall had a good experience!

Anne was very friendly welcoming and flexible, she was very understanding and supportive when I had to do some changes in my stay and extremely responsive to all my questions. The apartment looks even better in real life very cozy and charming immediately felt like home, very well organized and all necessities were available. You feel in Paris when living in this charming apartment. I thank Anne for all the things she done to make my stay comfortable and for being an amazing host. I will definitely be back.

This apartment was better than the pictures! It was in the best location- was like a home and just perfect. It was exactly what I wanted for my first trip to France from the US. The owners were fantastic. I simply loved this place.
A nice place to stay in Paris, the host is welcoming, and also serve a nice breakfast! The apartment is close to public transportation and in a calm area.

Abel was a super-responsive host. The apartment was quaint and met the description. We enjoyed the challenge of walking up/down 7 flights of stairs a couple times a day, and the view from the top was worth it! My only suggestion would be to have a wifi connection, as that would have been helpful to have. Highly recommend Abel as a host!
Very responsive and welcoming hosts, flexible with a last-minute check in! Sent a lot of great local recommendations.
We had a very nice stay in Le Marais! Apartment was clean and as advertised. Catherine was very responsive to all of our needs. Great host, great apartment!
Nicolas was a great host and the room is in a great location! It is small but if you're going to be out all day touring Paris it is a perfect place :)

Gilbert was an amazing host. He was so friendly and made us feel at home from the beginning. The room was beautiful and the kitchen and bathroom were always clean. He gave us breads and jams for breakfast. There was coffee and tea and even croissants the one morning. He always made sure we were good and made an effort to communicate. The park is extremely beautiful and it’s right by the apartment. It’s a peaceful area will cute cafes and shops walking distance. We would defneitly stay with Gilbert in the future. Thank you!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the location was great! Bus stations and the metro was right outside and a range of shops and cafes were a walkable distance. Victoria was very helpful and always replied quickly, this place is definitely recommended!

Vitalina was a fantastic and responsive host- even staying up until midnight to let us in after a flight from Australia. House was clean and tidy. East walking distance to lots of restaurants and the metro station. Vitalina provided a map and info on how to get to the main sights. Would throughly recommend as a place to stay
Great stay for Paris. We walked to all the sights from this place. It was super clean and away from the loud busy streets! We enjoyed our stay!

This neighborhood is so fun and cool. Felt to me like the “Brooklyn of Paris”. Top, not fussy, festive restaurants right around the corner. Location made me feel like a local. Loved that the apartment had a nice gym in the basement and powerful a/c in every room. Highly recommend. I’ll go back!

The apartment was a great place to stay, close to 2 different Metro lines so very convenient. A couple of great bakeries and Bistros within a block or two. Comfortable and quiet apartment, fit 2 adults and 2 kids nicely. Look forward to returning one day!
Vincent was a brilliant host and his place was a superbly located pleasure. Perfect place Tom which to enjoy Paris.

This is a great apartment in my favourite area of Paris. Tucked away in a courtyard , it is quiet and yet so close to Montparnasse Boulevard. Anne was very kind and helpful. The apartment was so comfortable and well looked after. A perfect stay for my wife and I, plus our two children (12&15). We would definitely highly recommend and want to return.

We were so impressed with Justin’s place! There was plenty of space for our family of four, the architecture of the space is so cool and the apartment was spotlessly cleaned. The large windows and fans cool the apartment off quickly and nicely when there is a breeze. The kitchen is very well-stocked for cooking. The neighborhood isn’t close to any of the major sites, but it is 2 minutes from one metro stop and 8 minutes from another, so it’s very easy to get around the city. We really enjoyed our stay and Justin’s hospitality!
Street was a little messy and was noisy even at night. The apartment was nice, clean and matched the description.

My friend and I had an excellent stay at Thomas’ airbnb. Check-in was super easy and Thomas was very accomodating as our train was running quite late to meet him. The apartment had all necessary amenities, and was a great size. The Airbnb is located close to Rue Oberkampf which had lots of nice restaurants and bars and there was good accessibility to surrounding areas and tourist sites with lots of metro stations close by. Would definitely stay here again, merci Thomas!
Family of 4 enjoyed our 5 night stay here! The place was perfectly represented in the description. We loved the location and that it was quiet at night.
Thank Liliana… your place is in a great location. We live Paris and hope to come back and visit more places.

Spotlessly clean apartment located right on the doorstep of a lovely neighbourhood in Paris. Marie is a great host and communication was very useful and clear, we were 3 friends and it may have been slightly on the smaller side for us but has everything you need for a city break, ideally close to Gare Du Nord too! The space has been beautifully decorated too

Vitalina was very helpful throughout the check in process and it was easy and flexible! Location was lovely, walking distance to lots of great restaurants and supermarket and the apartment itself was lovely 👍🏻would thoroughly reccomend
perfect ground floor accomadations. felt very secure, private and quiet area, close to eiffel tower with easy access elsewhere via metro. would stay again

Wonderful neighbourhood. Lots of cafe´s short walk away, cornershop with necessities just outside the building. Building is lovely, very quiet even for a ground floor flat. Host superb, great communication. Would book again.
Emmanuel’s place was really wonderful, tastefully designed and decorated, great balcony, good light, well appointed, etc.
Loved where we stayed, neighborhood seems to be up and coming. Apartment was clean & large. No air conditioning but they did have 3 fans provided which was lovely!

Simply a perfect place! Beautiful Neighborhood, very well located, high quality building with high quality apartment. Loved the 70's style decoration. You can't ask more. We were party of 4 very comfy in the 2 queen sized beds.

Living in Monmarte for our holiday experience was magical. Ideal holiday location, providing true ‘Paris’ experience yet very quiet and peaceful. Thanks for opening your home Jeanne for others to experience’life in Paris’
The place was nice, very quiet, close to subway, supermarket, boulangery, etc Benoit was cery kind and accommodating with check in and check out time. All in all, a nice place to stay in Paris!
Absolutely loved our stay! Sylvie and Leena were super helpful and made our time in Paris super comfortable :) can’t wait to rebook!
Sophie was magical! Ideal Airbnb host<3 You always felt welcomed and free. If i come back I’ll definitely stay with her.
We enjoyed our stay very much. Great location. Easy check in. Rahim was great to meet us and to make wonderful recommendations for things to do in Paris. We will be back.
Matt’s place was very comfortable, squeaky clean and we had a lovely stay. I recommend it to anyone who wants to discover this beautiful and fun area of Paris: classy, cultured and great cafes!
Delphine's flat was a fantastic stay, located right next to the metro and easy walking distance to montmatre. Would stay again!

Apartment is even nicer than the photos and a wonderful location. Some noise from other apartments if you are really sensitive to noise but not a bother for us, and very quiet with the windows closed. Clean and in a great location, heaps of restaurants. Julien was a great host and self check in was easy. Even left a great book of Paris tips and local recommendations. Highly recommend.

My wife and I enjoyed our stay. We especially enjoyed the neighborhood and the proximity to the metro. Remi was very helpful and even called to check on us near the middle of our stay. Our stay at Remi's was memorable, and we would stay there again.

We definitely enjoyed our stay as a family of five… the flat and location are right in the middle of great restaurants and it has easy access to many shops, bakery etc., will definitely come back again!
the location was near Eiffel tower, near metro station. Great for large groups ( we were 8) Laurent was great, responded all message no matter what hours, very very helpful and nice
This flat is impeccable and the host was helpful and always responsive. We wish we stayed here longer!

I had the pleasure of staying at this Airbnb apartment in Paris, and it was an absolutely delightful experience. The apartment was cozy, with a tasteful decor that beautifully captured the quintessential Parisian charm. It was a home away from home. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and equipped with all the necessary amenities. The host was also extremely helpful and made sure that my stay was comfortable. Every corner of the apartment was thoughtfully designed, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. In summary, this Airbnb apartment in Paris exceeded my expectations in every way. It was not just a place to stay, but a significant part of my Parisian experience. I highly recommend it to anyone planning a trip to Paris.
Alex’s place was fabulous. Great location, super clean and easy to check in. We would highly recommend.

Overall, it was a really nice apartment - very clean and tidy. The local area had a really good restaurant (Le Jaurès) with a great ambience. We had dinner and breakfast there. The local area by the canal is very lively. Overall we had a great check-in stay and check-out. The hosts were extremely responsive irrespective of time of day. Great apartment and facilities:-)

Nice little place that was perfect for my solo trip. It’s probably too small for more than one person, and the shower is small enough that I don’t think a taller/bigger person would be comfortable- I’m petite and still struggled a bit. But, the place was great for me, easy to walk where I wanted to go. Having laundry in the unit (washer, no dryer) was awesome. And I was surprised with how comfortable the sofa bed was.

We had a great time! It is pretty small but it’s soooo worth it for the location! Walking distance from the Eiffel Tower and MANY restaurants! The area felt very safe and the apartment was very secure. Venus was super helpful and even took us to the roof of the building and it was a magical experience!! 10/10 recommend for small groups!

Sophie is a delight. Very kind helpful and attentive. Her dog Eddie is the friendliest dog in all of Paris. The room was just as shown and the bed was comfortable. We enjoyed our time of 4 days there and Sophie gave us plenty of recommendations! Thank you again:)

Elsa was indeed a super host. She met us in-person. Walked us through the apartment and shared the nearby places for breakfast and dining. The location was peaceful and convenient. The apartment was clean and newly remodeled. I highly recommend Elsa’s place if you happen to stay stop in Paris.

Our stay was great! Monique and her husband were so lovely and welcoming. They gave us recommendations to check out during the day and made it feel like home whilst we were there. Would definitely try to book with them again if we are ever in Paris.
Our stay was good - no problems - plenty of room for 4 people - I would recommend it for others visiting Paris

Olivier was very kind as a superhost. The accommodation was also comfortable. The location of the accommodation is in a quiet and safe place, and the accommodation was very comfortable. I also liked the fact that there was a private bathroom. I think it is a cost-effective accommodation and I recommend it. Merci, olivier 😊

Good spot for exploring Paris, there was the 8 metro right outside of the front door, which made it easy to get to different parts of the city. There were also plenty of good restaurants within a 10 minute walk. Kitchenette was nice to have for making some eggs and coffee in the morning. Apartment can get hot in the summer but we had good luck with opening all of the windows and turning on the fan that was provided, especially at night.
Clean and spacious for a family of six. Stair case to fifth floor was not fun as there isn’t an elevator. Stair well smelled horrible. Would recommend for a large family.

I cannot recommend a place more! It’s not a long walk or bus ride to central Paris, and the space is very clean and comfortable. Monique and Jean-Noel were absolutely wonderful hosts, and I wish I had more time to get to know them. I had some travel complications due to a delayed flight, and they was incredibly understanding and kind about the whole thing! Thank you so much :)

This place was great and we will definitely try to stay again next time. Centrally located in a quiet neighborhood, roomy, clean and instructions were excellent. The bathtub in the bedroom took some getting used to, but it all worked out. Very responsive hosts, with a beautiful apartment, nicely kept and comfortable.
Small cozy apartment good for our family of 3, might be a bit tight for 4. Good location and accessible to metro with nearby grocery and restaurants

Julie was amazing! She was super responsive whenever we needed her. As Americans we are used to air conditioning which is hard to find in most air BnBs in Paris. When we reached out to Julie about the heat she got us fans within 24 hours - one for each room. This was above and beyond in our opinion! I cannot recommend this place enough. For Bastille Day the balcony was such an amazing view and there was a firehouse one block away which held an awesome party. Everything was perfect. Highly recommend!

Awesome location and a great host. It is very small, but the listing is pretty upfront about that fact. And the neighborhood is so walkable with cafe’s everywhere that you don’t need to spend much time in the room. Transit options are less than 10 minutes away as well. Awesome location.

Great apartment in a terrific location. Very convenient neighborhood, everything within walking distance and easy access to buses and the Metro for sightseeing in the rest of the city. I would stay there again and would definitely recommend.

Lafkir’s unit is perfect. It was better than originally envisioned when I started looking for a place to stay in Paris. The view from the balcony is unforgettable and I could have spent a lifetime sitting, watching the city streets, and looking at the Eiffel Tower. There is not a better place to stay. Lafkir was very responsive, reasonable, and helpful. Highly recommend this stay.

We had a great stay in a great neighborhood, with awesome food choices and super easy access to the metro! Lionel was very responsive to our needs and the place was very quiet. We slept with all the windows open and were never disturbed with noise or insects. It was 85° Fahrenheit while we were there, and we felt very safe in the neighborhood. If I had young children (0-5) I would have worried about the stairs, but older children would be ok.
Central location that’s very walkable and accessible to many places that we wanted to visit. The home was indeed quiet and cozy. Seb was a great host.
Absolutely gorgeous apartment in the center of Paris! Great location, and even better host! Would happily stay again!

We absolutely loved Nathalie’s place. It was beautiful and spacious, and filled with all the comforts of home. We had everything we needed and more. The location was wonderful and we were able to enjoy Paris like a local, with wonderful bakeries and restaurants within walking distance. We would highly recommend Nathalie and her place. Nathalie was a wonderful host.

The view was phenomenal and we really love the clean and modern but homey style of the apartment. So great to be close to the canal and there is a little park at the end of the street. This apartment is not that close to main attractions but is close to train stations and there are many nice restaurants and bakeries just a few blocks away.
Very great host. Very helpful. The location is very good, so near to the metro (3mins walk). Very central location. Quiet place.
easy access to the subway lines on a relatively quiet 1 way street. cafes, supermarket and restaurants are within a few minutes walk. great space!
Very well decorated and clean apartments, well situated near all central attractions in Paris. Responsive hosts. Many thanks for hosting!

We loved staying in Idalina’s beautiful apartment. It had everything we needed for a family of 4 with two youngsters under 6 years. Two metro stations on the doorstep and surrounded by restaurants and groceries stores made our stay very easy gave us a taste of non-touristy Parisian life whilst feeling easily connected to all the sights we wanted to visit. Idalina was super responsive when we had a question and they were even there on entry to help us up the stairs with our luggage! Couldn’t ask for more and would definitely stay again.
As the inaugural guest at this apartment I was treated to all brand new things. It is a lovely quiet building with a large outdoor terrace overlooking the courtyard.

Our hosts were very responsive and easy to work with. We had no problems finding it or during our stay. It was a great location in a quiet neighborhood in 10 minute walking distance to Opera Garnier and Galeries Lafayette. There are also 3 different metro lines around the apartment which made transportation super easy.

For a family of five this was perfect. It was close to the metro, close to grocery stores, and close to Restaurants. It was an easy train ride to all the sites, space was very clean and spacious. Anne was a pleasant host. Would definitely book again.
Super clean and well decorated spot! Great location for shopping in le marais. Very responsive host as well.

The flat was perfect for my family. It was stylish, clean, and free of clutter. The host, Linda, was super in her communication as well as adding some hospitable details that made the stay excellent. The location was great! Thank you, Linda!
Wow!!! This apartment was fantastic. It was extremely clean, centrally located and was perfect for our little family of 4. I would highly recommend. And additional bonus was daily housekeeping.

We could not have been more impressed with Jean’s apartment and his hospitality!! Located in the most beautiful, private, cobblestone street, we felt so safe and at home. The house was authentic and beautifully decorated, and the garden / courtyard was so lovely. Upon our arrival Jean met us (before the designated check in time so we wouldn’t have to wait!) and showed us to the apartment. His wife was so sweet and welcoming too. We felt very looked after and will definitely be back, next time for longer!!
Apartment was a great place to stay whilst exploring Paris for a few days. Very close to the Eiffel Tower and other famous landmarks. Great, responsive hosts.
I am wordless about the place, it is very good , looks like historical building with modern style inside. We loved the place , we definitely will stay again next time
Very attentive and responsive host and an overall great stay! Clean and well-stocked flat, and you can’t beat the location. Highly recommended!
Perfect location. Paul was extremelly professional and resolutive. I totally recommend. Only problem: kind of many many stairs, but if that is not a problem for u, the rest is great!

Super friendly staff, They allowed us to check-in WAY before 3PM, kindly upgraded our room and were just in general extremely nice and welcoming. The room was clean, it matched the pictures, and the hotel was close to a metro station taking us everywhere in 30 mins. Loved it. Absolutely recommend it.

What a great place to stay in Paris. I have done many AirBnB'S in Paris and I think that this may have been the nicest total "package" I have stayed in. It's a perfectly cute apartment with everything you need: a well layed out living space, functional kitchen area, great shower and an incredibly comfortable bed. Another upside was the ability to open windows on both sides of the apartment to get a nice cross breeze. The location is convenient to explore Montmartre by foot, as well as the rest of Paris by metro. Ariane was a wonderful host who was very accommodating and informative. I would easily stay here again!

This flat was in a great location. It was a 10 min walk from the Eiffel Tower. It was close but a really calm area. It's super busy by the tower but within minutes, as you walk back, it's quiet again. The flat was really great. It fit my husband and I plus our 13 year old son stayed on the sofa bed. Flat had nice high ceilings and very bright and airy. We really liked the area. It's close to the river. There is a little shop on the corner with fresh fruit and a nice shopkeeper. We'd definitely stay again. If you want to go to the Louvre, I'd rent scooters or ebikes. Download Tier or Lime. There are bike lanes everywhere.
Gorgeous room, spacious and clean, down pillows, cute bathroom attached. Double pane windows keeps noise out. Lovely breakfast.

Well appointed apartment, few steps away from two supermarkets, and the metro. There was everything one would need for an extended stay in Paris. The neighourbood was very quiet and friendly, yet a few minutes walk away from the more bustling areas of Bastille and Marais. Would book it again, without any hesitation.

Anne was incredibly responsive and helpful. Her place is in an amazing location, easily accessible by the metro and so walkable. Near so many great sites and tons of food options. Her flat is super cute and comfortable.

The place was perfect for my first solo trip to Europe. The kitchen was very convenient when I wanted to save money and eat in. Jean was a great host, very responsive, and give clear instructions. The balcony was a great to sit on and read and have a cup of coffee, tip bring mosquito spray lol. The neighbors were very friendly and I felt extremely safe in the area walking around at night. I highly recommend Bo & Mie down the street for great coffee and pastries in the morning.

We loved staying here! The balcony was beautiful, the metro was close, the street and apartment felt very safe, and there were delicious bakeries down the street! We will definitely stay here again when visiting Paris!

The place was perfect for a long stay in Paris! The apartment has everything you need and is walkable from 2 major metro lines. Plus the parc nearby was beautiful as well. Antoine was very responsive and flexible for check and and check out. I would recommend this stay to others!
I’m so happy with choosing this hotel. Super friendly staff. Nice room and breakfast. Very close to train station but still a calm street. Would recommend this hotel to my friends
great spot with easy walking access to many attractions. all beds confortable including the sofa mattress and the balcony and windows provide nice fresh air.

The wife and I had a fantastic one week stay at Sylvie's apartment. Her place is HUGE (for Paris), newly renovated, beautifully decorated and very clean. Since Sylvie was on holiday we were met at the front door by her lovely friend Leena who showed us everything we needed to know about the flat. Very small elevator (two people) but it beats going up six flights of stairs everyday. Small view of the top of the Eiffel tower from the living room and a reservoir view from the bedroom. Very peaceful! Comfortable king size bed. Fully stocked kitchen. Great neighborhood. Lots of places to eat and a nice boulangerie down the street for your morning croissant. Two metro lines closy by so getting anywhere in Paris is very easy. Highly recommend this Sylvie's place!
Great place. Very central and lively location. Noisy street so have to keep windows closed during the night. Very well maintained and practical. We had a great stay!
The home is as described. Very quiet for being in downtown Paris. Perfect for our family of 4. The host was very responsive and communication was great.
Nice flat well located near lots of shops restaurants and supermarkets open till very late. Near metro and place de la Nation Very alive part of Paris

Lovely apartment Great location Very responsive host Really helpful to have few things eg toilet paper and washing up liquid etc left for us! Just needs instructions re the air con units and if we needed to do anything with the bins /recycling on leaving the apartment (even better if we did not have to do anything!) Thanks

Wonderful end to our Paris trip. This apartment is perfect! Spent many nights on the balcony, watching the lights of the Eiffel Tower, drinking wine and listening to the sounds of the city. Pure bliss ♥️ Thank you, Sophie and Stephane for this perfect end to a perfect trip!
great stay for a short trip to Paris. the space was situated in a beautiful area in the 5th arr.

Very close to metro which gave us access to all areas of Paris , and very walkable within 13 minutes to the main Le Marais shopping area. Unit is 3 stories and the light is very nice on the top 2 floors, but bottom floor is definitely a basement space without windows or fresh air, so we did not use except to do laundry. 4 of us fit perfectly in the space and it was beautifully decorated as the pictures showed accurately. Charles was very responsive and friendly! Thank you

Max was super responsive and very helpful with clear instructions. He came to help us get in, gave a walk through, and also helped park our car in the garage. His place is central and almost all must see places are walkable or reachable through metro. We truly enjoyed our stay.
Great little spot at the end of a closed road. Johan was super helpful and the very responsive.

Denka’s place was exactly as described and looked just like the photos. This apartment was absolutely perfect for my wife and I and our 11 year old daughter’s visit to Paris. This is an amazing location with extremely convenient Metro, train and bus access, which made it super easy to head out and explore anywhere in Paris. Great restaurants, shopping and cafes just outside the building and neighborhood, yet completely quiet and peaceful for much needed rest after walking all day. Beds were very comfortable and we had everything we needed. We had the best time in Paris and we couldn’t have been more happy with our stay at Denka’s. Thank you!

Beautiful apartment in a wonderful arrondissement, with close proximity to the Marais and lots of great restaurants and bars. Sephora was a very friendly and responsive host. I would highly recommend staying at Sephora's apartment

Nathalie's beautiful apartment was delightful--very well designed, comfortable, and equipped with everything needed. It was quiet, with large windows that offered a wonderful breeze. Nathalie was clear in communications and accommodating and friendly. It helped that she had excellent English and offered first-hand instructions. We had a lovely time there and will hope to go back sometime.
I highly recommend Tony’s place for anyone visiting Paris and wanting to stay in a central location. It is a beautiful clean apartment and great value. Thanks again

Excellent location, great restaurants and bars in the area, easy to get around on foot. Great communication with Alex who gave some excellent recommendations. The only thing was that the bed was a little small for us.

I had the best stay at Isa's beautiful home. She and her family made me feel at home and were helpful and generous. It was so easy to communicate with Isa - before arriving and during my stay. The room had lots of storage options, which makes it feel bigger than what it is, and it is private and quiet and very comfortable. The location is simply incredible, so close to everything a visitor to Paris needs - restaurants, cafes, stores, metro etc. I highly recommend!
It was a great stay. Especially if you have a daughter, this place can be a best option for you.
Clean , spacious, well-equipped, beautiful . Located in a very good place. Many good restaurants are just near by and easy to get to metro and shopping places. Highly recommend!

Nicolas’s Airbnb was very cute and equipt with everything someone would need for a short stay. It’s quaint but for the price you pay it’s worth it as you would typically spend time outside anyways. We both enjoyed our stay :)
Great location and easy to get inside! Unit was super clean and had everything we needed - thank you!!
Very responsive and friendly host…..great location and very clean. One drawback for us was verticality of unit and a bit small for 6 well sized adults.

We spent a week at this cozy apartment. It is modern, clean and comfortable. The balcony and Eiffel Tower view are spectacular! The neighborhood is walkable and near a metro station. Henry gave us excellent recommendations for restaurants near the apartment. We wished we could have stayed for another week!

Lovely flat, everything was beautiful yet child-friendly. Quiet, pleasant area, with a lovely park nearby and some nice places to eat - the recommendations Alexis left were reliable! When we couldn't figure out how to get the projector to work Alexis and Marie very kindly talked us through it on a videocall - and once it was working the kids loved it. Easy to get into the centre of Paris by metro.
Monique and Jean-Noel were great hosts! They were so friendly and we felt right at home! There place was very cute and have a great view from their terrace.

We had a great stay, and the place was exactly as described. Our hosts reached out several times to ensure things were going well. Getting in was easy, with clear instructions. We would definitely stay again if we were to visit Paris.
Great location for us located near family. Arnaud was very responsive and easy to communicate with.

We had a fantastic 3 night stay at Mai’s place. Ideal for the Latin quarter, Notre Dame and walks along the Seine. A chilled part of Paris with a really good vibe The accommodation met all our expectations being clean and good amenities Thank you

Cute little studio apartment with great light and nice views. Couldn't have been happier with the location - the Métro stop is right at the door and it's an easy walk/connection to the RER to get to the airport.
Great local restaurants and convienent to take public transportation. Apartment was a bit small for 4 guests--perfect for 2.

Really really great spot. Tasteful and well-appointed apartment. Very cute! Host was awesome and accommodated my late check in. Wifi worked great and everything was comfortable and clean. Only regret is I couldn’t stay longer!
The space is amazing and you can’t beat the location. The only odd part is that they’re very stingy with the basic amenities (toilet paper, etc), but other than that our stay was great!

Fred was very responsive and helpful. The apartment is spacious and cozy, very tasteful decor and books. The location was excellent, there was so much to do within only 20 minutes walking in any direction. The building was quiet and easy to get in to and felt very safe. I got to try several of his recommendations and they were all very good. Would definitely recommend staying here.

Sandra's apartment in Montmartre is fantastic. The location is the best part: you will be in a charming old building in a wonderful neighborhood in Paris, unique and beautiful, close to a number of landmarks like Sacre Coeur and Moulin Rouge, but not directly in a busy touristic area. You are on a small, quiet, local street with a number of excellent cafes and restaurants just down the block. Sandra is a very nice, responsive host, and the apartment is very clean, cozy and homey. This is a great place to stay!

We had a great time at Ethel's wonderful apartment. It was clean, comfortable and exactly as the photos. The location is fantastic for exploring Paris, right in the middle of the Marais, very easy to walk anywhere or to get the metro or bus. There is a lot of nightlife in Rue des Archives and around, which we enjoyed but if you are looking for a quiet location you might want to look elsewhere. Also there are quite a few steps to the second floor and no lift, so not for anyone with reduced mobility.
It was a great stay and we enjoyed it. One thing I would recommend is to have more towels and make sure all basic amenities like hand washing soap do exist.

The flat is just one minute walk from metro and bus station, with a big supermarket, great bakery store, Chinese takeaway and fruit store nearby. The flat itself is good size, nice and clean, we will definitely visit again!
Absolutely stunning place! It really felt like home and the view is spectacular. Thank you so much.
Vanessas flat was perfect.. close to the tower and very walkable to everything else..we stay again..
A remarkable building and an unusual apartment in a great location. it was so clean, it felt new. Francine was very helpful and super flexible.

Mao was very helpful with check-in. He met us at the apartment, carried one of our bags up to the apartment and showed us the apartment. He said to contact him with any questions or concerns and again met us the morning of checkout and carried a bag down for us.

Clara was a wonderful host, she was very welcoming and gave helpful advice of how to get to the apartment from the airport, she also offered help if ever needed. Her apartment was very homely, we look forward to my next visit.

We enjoyed two nights at Venus’s place. She met us upon our arrival and gave a great tour. Amazing location, exactly as described. Walking distance to shops, Eiffel towel, great cafes. Would stay again for sure!
The place was fantastic. Paul however did not respond which caused me to call him. We checked in well after the 3pm checkin time which was frustrating and caused us to miss our evening plans.

Marie responded to all queries immediately and the appartment was beautifully decorated. The use of space was very clever as we never felt cramped. The location was perfect as it was near a lovely park, Chaumont-Buttes, as well as many amenities.

Claire’s place is impeccable, one of the best airbnbs I’ve ever stayed at. Catherine, the manager, was super welcoming and absolutely great. She met us at the flat, helped us carry the suitcases up, treated to some orange juice and got us some sparkling water. I’ve never seen such Airbnb service in my life. Same with check out seeing us all the way to Uber. The place is fully equipped with anything you want. I traveled with my family, and we were able to cook, sleep comfortably, take nice walks, enjoy the restaurants in the area and enjoy the privacy and quietness of the flat. Highly recommend. We will definitely be back!
It was a very pleasent stay. We booked the apartment a couple of hours before arrival and it worked perfect - chokers was very flexible
We had a wonderful stay at Jean-Luc's place, it was in a great area and everything was easily accessible. Would certainly recommend! Asante Sana!

Amazing place!! Walked to the end of the block to watch the tower sparkle each night. Very special. An amazing bakery down the road. The location felt very safe. Easy checkin and Patrick, who helped us check in, was very nice!
Exactly as in the description. Cozy and functional place for a couple. Communication with Stephane was easy and accessible, and there are detailed check-in instructions.
Fabulous apartment. Bruno is super-responsive and generous. No AC, but a few fans to beat the August heat. Highest recommendation.

Nice and clean place. Responsive hosts. Conveniently located to restaurants and train station. Everyday we were out until late night and felt safe to catch the train and walk back to Ju & Ch’s place. Thanks for being good hosts!
My 2 friends and I had a great stay here! Such a great location. The apartment is tiny, but it was perfect for 3 people.

Heavy smell in the apt, Floors with stains, disgusting smell in the garbage bin, Clealrly not dumped for a while. No ac, Hard to sleep, opened windows to get some fresh air but then got stung by mosquitoes cuz no screen on windows. Unpleasant stay.

We were two ladies in our sixties and seventies and two youngsters. We all felt very much at home. The flat is charming, smart and very clean. Plenty of shops and resturants nearby and it is close to rail and metro. Checkin and all comunication with host was very quick and smooth. Good resturant recommendations.

Stephan's location was perfect. It was accessible to tourist sites but did not feel touristy. He was very communicative and great with tips about the neighborhood. The place was as described, and the small nook overseeing the street was great. Highly recommend it.
Thank you for a very memorable stay. The apartment was perfect and so well situated, close to the tube stations and restaurants, shops and sites.

Friendly reception staff, nicely decorated rooms but not much was open in terms of bars and restaurants in the near surrounding area so had to walk a bit further to find them. It was a shame about the scaffolding on the outside of the building and workman walking past the window in the morning.

My girls loved your "bojo" taste. The apartment is small but well laid out and very stylish. I think that if it had been hotter then there might have been an issue with a lack of ventilation - but we managed with all 3 fans going and thankfully the temperature only just went into the 30s. You responded very quickly and helpfully. Thank you for letting us use your apartment. Also great to have a flat without a "digicode" but a real key - if we had known this before hand we might have stayed there for the Jewish shabbat.

This was our 3rd stay at Rue Chanez so see previous reviews. This is a very nice 2 bedroom in a great location. Very well maintained and equipped. Charlotte is wonderful to arrange arrival and departure.
This is a great, secure apartment with a competitive price for its location. We checked in quite late hit that wasn’t a problem for Elsa. It was quiet.
Located in the heart of Montmarte, great place to live in Paris like in a Postcard.

Our stay at Edgar Suites was one of the best Airbnb in Europe so far. The apartment was squeaky clean and felt like home. the check-in process was really simple just enter the code and you get in. The laundry area was really spacious and the dryer was a life saver. The kitchenette was really purpose built and had everything stove, dishwasher,oven fridge. the dining table was very big easily seated 6 people. The bathroom was grand which I didn't expect in Paris. Both the rooms were spacious and mattresses were really comfortable. The view of the outdoor patio was very amazing and gave a soothing effect. Overall our stay at Edgar Suites was just like we were at home. On our next trip to Paris this is our first and only chose. keep it up!

Louise's property is conveniently situated near key attractions like the Eiffel Tower and offers basic amenities. However, our stay was far from enjoyable. Upon our arrival, we discovered the kitchen roll was nearly depleted. Louise being out of town and unable to provide a replacement, this issue was not resolved. Our time in Paris coincided with an exceptionally hot day. While the property listing did indicate the absence of air conditioning, we anticipated at least a basic fan (which was not listed as an exclusion). Regrettably, no fans were provided, and there was inadequate airflow in and out of the unit. Consequently, I had to spend 100 Euros to acquire two pedestal fans as my children struggled to sleep on the first night due to the heat. Think twice unless you are willing to endure stifling conditions with little to no ventilation during humid and high-temperature weather.
Fantastic location for this stay! Place is tiny but for the price it is as good as you will get in Paris. Clean and funtional.

A wonderful apartment in Le Marais! This is such a fun, vibrant area with everything you could possibly need within walking distance. We walked or biked all over Paris from Johann’s apartment. It was very hot when we were in Paris and we were very grateful for all the fans in the rooms since there was no AC. The apartment is quite roomy and was surprisingly quiet considering the area. We thoroughly enjoyed our time there!

My first time in Paris, and it was such wonderful… I love my room, love this arrondissement, love walking Eddy, love talking art with Sophie. Thanks for all your suggestions of museums, and all the moments I had in these ten days, which will last forever in my mind! Hope to see you again soon, I’m already missing Paris…

We had a lovely stay and would definitely recommend this listing! My husband, our 2 year old son, and I loved being walking distance to a large, beautiful park as well as cafes and transportation. The kids room had everything you could need and our son absolutely loved the toys and kept himself busy. Communications were fast and helpful and the space was just right and well decorated. The only challenge was that the wifi was pretty spotty, I had to work for a few days and ended up hotspotting. One thing I do wish I had was a fan since the days were very warm during our stay. Other than that, we had an exceptional time and would stay again!
We had a great stay at this property and felt very much at home. Thanks for having us!
Excellent apartment, it was very clean and 10-15 minute walk from Eiffel Tower. Would highly recommend this air bnb.
Brilliant location and a lovely flat. Right by the canal which is lovely to walk along. Nice restaurants near by and felt like a safe area. Would definitely book again if I come back to Paris.

Nice enough place. Not as big and bright as the pics make it look, and it had scaffolding up the whole front of the building (including right across our window) for our whole stay. Reception also asks for you to leave your access key with them each time you go out, and we had to wait outside for 10 mins one night when there was noone at reception to let us back in.
The perfect air bnb for a solo traveler in the beautiful (and fun) neighborhood of Bastille. Stephane’s place was tidy and had everything you could need. Would stay here again! Merci Stephane!

We stayed with our 2-year old for 4 nights. The neighbourhood is great if you look for a family-friendly area with lots of restaurant and shopping options and great access to the Metro. The apartment is cute and tidy, and offers everything you need with a small child.

We had the most wonderful time at this airbnb. It was in a fantastic location that really let us soak in the city during our first visit to Paris. Leah was a great host and her place was amazing during the summertime heat. It stayed nice, cool, and comfortable in her stylish place. I really enjoyed our time there and hope others will do the same.
Fernanda was polite and friendly. Even though there was a language barrier she tried her best to communicate. She ensured everything was ok
This incredible Paris apartment is in a perfect location, has beautiful and thoughtful design. The hosts were responsive and wonderful to communicate with. Highly recommend and hope to return.

The apartment was beautiful and exactly like the photos. Tugdual provided very clear instructions for a self check-in, which we appreciated since we were arriving later in the day. The place was spotless and nicely decorated. It was in a convenient location with a neighborhood feel. There is a supermarket, patisserie, charcuterie just down the street and within a few minutes walk from various restaurants and the metro station. It was lovely to pack a picnic at the apartment and walk to the Eiffel Tower for an afternoon lunch. We also enjoyed the nice cross breeze through the apartment with the balcony doors open. There is also a small elevator and a washer/dryer. The apartment has everything you need for a delightful stay in Paris!

Great place to stay, I would recommend his airbnb to everyone looking for a peaceful place in Paris. It is a 10 minute walk from the bus/metro station 'Convection'. He was hardly at home so there was a lot of privacy. His neighbour Nicolas was very friendly and helpful.
Really nice place in a peaceful part of Paris. Only let down was that the hotel itself was pretty loud and we got woken up by building work at 8am two days in a row.
Great place to stay. Quite close to metro, with sightseeing close by. Excellent amenities and very quiet. All in all a very enjoyable place to stay.

The host was really nice and the apartment is really good for a couple. the kitchen was good and everything worked perfectly the only downside is that there is no elevator. (the host made sure we knew ahead of time)
Elsa was a great host. She is very responsive and pleasant. The place is very convenient and nice. I will definitely stay in her place next time I travel to Paris. Overall I had a great experience.
We stayed at Louis' place for three nights and it was great! the location is amazing, lots or stuff to do and see nearby. awesome view from the apartment! definitely recommend

The place was just as described but better the bathrooms was beautiful...the only 2 things i.suggest is putting a full length mirror on the main floor and having more detailed on how to operate the washing machine and tvs and in English for people like me that doesn't know nothing in French

Perfect place for restaurants, bars, and central location to the Louvre, Les Halles, patisseries and pretty much everything we wanted to do. Had a blast in the neighborhood, with great wine bars, restos, and monuments. Highly recommended for a couple to explore the district. It was exactly what my husband and I needed for a great Paris experience.
Good location. Near to the station. No outside window in second bedroom but great flat in good location.
Great clean comfortable place in a very nice location. Close to metro and easy to get around. Very pleased and would come again!

The place was fine to stay for one night, had good amenities to cook your own meal/heat up food if needed. My room was directly across from the reception so I could hear every interaction from inside my room. Staff were friendly and kindly held my luggage after check out as I had a later check in somewhere else.
Great location, exactly what you pay for, good for short stay. Rassarin was easy going

This apartment is a little French GEM. The location, the vibe and the view of the Eiffel Tower were awesome.The studio is very small(as are most Parisian Studios) but totally adequate for a short stay. The apartment and its amenities are exactly as described, it was clean ,tidy, peaceful and secure. The host was very kind, friendly, responsive and helpful, the pastries which I was greeted with, upon my arrival was such a lovely touch. I would definitely would stay here again and highly recommend this apartment. Merci Beaucoup!

Great small apartment for a quick stay in London with my husband and two kids. Turned the living room couch into the second bed which was easy and comfy. Stocked with coffee pods and small fridge for milk and other necessities. Comfy beds and pillows, quiet and dark with electronic shades on windows. Location is great. Delicious bakery around the corner. Great place!
Very nice place to stay and a good base from which to explore the wonderful city of Paris. Also, the hosts are really responsive and helpful. We could definitely come back.

Nicolas’ place was perfect for our night in Paris! It was a super close walk to the Eiffel Tower and so many restaurants and shops all around! We didn’t even move our car once! Nicolas was very responsive and flexible, and made sure we were well informed on our stay!
Perfect spot for a solo trip to Paris. Would have been fine with two or three total as well. Great layout

This apartment is incredible. Definitely one of the best airbnbs I have ever stayed in! The unit is amazing with tons of natural light and space. On top of that, the location couldn’t be better for a couple wanting to use the metro to get around and explore Paris. I really can’t recommend this spot enough and will definitely come back!
Great place to stay in Paris. Clean, comfortable and close to the metro stations. Wonderful restaurants within walking distance. I would definitely recommend others to book here.
Cross the street and you can see the Eiffel Tower! Small place but perfect for a couple, great price and location is brilliant.

Henry was a pleasure to work with, rapid response. Bernard was also amazing, he went above and beyond helping us with dropping our luggage early and keeping them late on our last day. Such a pleasure. The place is right next to the Eiffel Tower.

Beautiful apartment close to the Paris metro and many good restaurants. Stylishly renovated apartment with impeccable taste, contemporary and elegant, but still preserving the original details, moulding and tiles. Helena was easy to communicate with and gave us clear instructions on how to get to her apartment. There was even coffee and mineral water for the morning. Highly recommend this apartment. Much Gratitude to this kind and helpful host!

Paul is an excellent and extremely responsive host. The AirBnB was very conveniently located and easy to get around from. The place was cozy and had everything we needed. Check-in and check-out is straightforward and simple. Highly recommended!

Nice small apartment! It is very close to a metro station and had the basics that I needed. I also found it very pleasant that you don't hear any noise from the street. The check-in and the communication with Alex went very smoothly.
Really enjoyed our stay even though France was experiencing a heatwave. The location of this rental can't be beat. Close to lots of restaurants and many "famous" landmarks.

The unit is located within a complex that has stairs and elevators that’s helpful for moving in and out. The unit is nicely decorated and the views of the Eiffel Tower from the deck and inside the bedrooms are amazing! The unit was a good fit for our family (4 adults) although it could be a bit tight for others. We mainly used it as a place to sleep and was out and about most of the time. We used the kitchen and the clothes iron but didn’t get around to the washing machine. The unit is located close to two Metro stations and a bus station is right outside. Lafkir was responsive and professional throughout the process. Thank you!
Great location, perfect apartment with everything you need. Natsumi is also a very kind host who communicated everything really well.

Chokri's place was a great place to stay in Paris, it was an excellent location and Chokri was a brilliant host. The only issue was that the door between the bathroom and living area was very flimsy and thin. Everything else was great.

Georges’s apartment is absolutely stunning! It’s very spacious and feels like home. My daughter loved playing with all the children’s toys and books as well. Georges was a great host and very responsive. He was also kind enough to let us check in very early (before 8am) as our flight landed at dawn in Paris. There is an elevator in the building which makes life much easier as the apartment is on the 5th floor. Overall we had a great stay.
Sophia's place was warm and welcoming. Plenty of toys for children to play with. Very thoughtful host and always responsive. The flat is beautiful.
Max was an excellent host, checking in was easy and our stay couldn’t have been more enjoyable.

We really enjoyed our stay, and Eliza’s hospitality. Elza made us feel very welcomed, and personally greeted us upon arrival. She did a quick live orientation of nearby attractions, including local bakery, bike store restaurants. She has been extremely responsive, and very thoughtful. The place is compact, yet comfortable. It is centrally located, near river, walkable to main attractions, and near metro line (if you prefer to save some energy). Thank you Elza for the stay!
Brijid was an amazing host. Squeaky clean apartment and so close to everything! Metro, restaurants, supermarkets, etc. We had an amazing day! Will definitely book again in the future! Thanks Brijid!
This was a great spot for our 3 day stay in the Montmartre area. Lots of great things to do in a 20 minute walk radius plus easy access to the Metro.

Rassarin’s listing was just as described. It was easy to find. The location is great and not far from most of the tourist attractions. There is a supermarket and a cafe few meters from the apartment as well.

The flat is in an amazing location with everything you could want for in the street below. Fantastic rotisserie, cheese and wine shop all next door. Tugdual was great to deal with, pragmatic, clear communication and kind enough to let us check out late due to our late train out of Paris

Great location : close to metro ,walk only 3 minutes . Easy to reach Opera area and Montmartre . Normally i talk with Josh , who responds all . He reply quick , give well advice. Nice place and feel like home

Juliette was incredibly friendly, was ready to hand over keys at our arrival and even had tips for good bars and restaurants. Her flat is lovely and stylish and located in an area ideal for a short stay in Paris. Thank you!

Great place to stay, good location close to restaurants and metros, this made it very easy to get around and see sites that weren’t as close. Apartment was a good size for my partner and I. Would recommend to others and would stay there again.
The apartment was perfectly located. We walked everywhere with no problem. Cindy responded quickly with any questions I had. Although Paris had a heat wave, the apartment stayed cool.

This is a wonderful apartment and Guillaume is a fantastic host. The location is great (not exactly a quiet street, but it quiets down at night) with lots of shops and restaurants in the area. The place is well decorated and has a lovely little balcony. The provided recommendations were helpful. We would happily stay here again.
The place is very clean and in cosy neighbourhood. Helena always responded quickly. The lock on the toilet door was a bit broken, but everything else was perfect! Would recommend.

Suite was much smaller than we expected, safety hazard as landing is lower than floor, broken stools, broken door knobs, broken ventilation fan, one wine glass for 5 people, no washer soap , no tea towels, no broom, dangerous knobs on closet door - ended with a huge scratch on arm, not suitable for seniors

Quirky bohemian decor with vintage cartoon art. Well stocked with everything we wanted. Stayed cool in the heat wave! The location was amazing - less than six minutes to multiple busses , several metro lines and the RER C. Safe. Lots of good restaurants. The hosts were wonderful to us - very helpful - wanted to make sure we were having a good time. Highly recommend them
Francine was friendly, responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Her place is in a great location, close to restaurants, various train stations and places of attractions.
An easy, comfortable stay at a great location. Guillaume was a wonderful, accommodating host and I wouldn't hesitate to book his apartment for future trips to Paris.
Lovely flat! Pull out is very comfortable and the location is amazing! Very clean. Awesome responsive hosts. Walking distance to montremarte and mall. Would def recommend !

Lovely stay in Paris. I absolutely adore this area and always come back to it. The accommodation was clean and cosy and perfect for 2 people. Also great only needing a code to get into the accommodation. Would definitely recommend this stay.
Thank you Marie for the lovely short stay! Will definitely look at your properties for the next trip.

Jean-Pierre was a great host - very flexible and communicative and helpful! We had a rough journey getting to Paris and Jean-Pierre was adaptable to our ever-changing plans. Would definitely recommend!
Absolutely wonderful Paris apartment, better than shown in the pictures. Fabulous location. Would definitely stay here again next time in Paris

It’s hard to capture the elegance and quality of this space in photos. There is such a lovely attention to detail any creative person will appreciate the level of taste and restraint. But there is also attention to detail in all the comforts of home at your fingertips. Lots of space with an authenticity that is intrinsically French delivering the total experience. The location is so special we did everything from a miam miam sandwiches and the best croissants to vintage to high end streetwear shopping for my daughter. I would only ask if someday Tiphaine would share her color palette with me. She made it very simple to have a great time. We would jump at a chance to stay again.
Denis was very kind, flexible, and communicated well with us. We felt very comfortable in his place for the week we stayed.
Amazing and comfortable stay. The apartment is as described and Delphine is always available to answer any questions.

We had a great time staying here. Plenty of places to eat around. Perfect location and just a few minutes walk from the metro. Check in was super, Jean - Francois let us check out later than states which was so helpful because of our flight time. We were delayed going so we were later than expected but again Jean - Francois was very patient with us. The place was clean with everything you need to have a comfortable stay. The area is lively at night but the apartment is pretty sound proof so our sleep was not disturbed. I would highly recommend staying here for sure !

This apartment could not have been a more perfect way to experience Paris. We loved berthing about it from the beautiful interiors, thoughtful design, and exceptional location. The hosts were gracious and accommodating and all expectations were exceeded for our stay. We will most certainly book again on our next trip to Paris!
Great duplex to stay in Paris. The neighborhood is vibrant, many places to eat and have a drink around. We loved the design of the apartment, everything is well-thought and convenient to use.

Great stay in Paris. Sophie is very nice and helpful, could help you with the travel plans and will always answer to your questions. Apartment is clean and nice, even with shared spaces there were no problems and we did not hear or see anyone. Sophie’s dog Eddy is adorable. Planning already to be back to explore more.
We had the best time in Tony’s apartment. It was charming and in the area we love most. We will stay here again and again.

This is a great spot right in the heart of a fun area in Paris. In the evenings with the windows open you can hear the excitement outside - live music and people in the streets. With the windows closed, the apartment was absolutely quiet, for a peaceful evening. We were two couples, sharing two showers and one toilet. The bedrooms were a little tight with the suitcases, but this is expected in Paris, and the location was very convenient. The apartment was decorated very nicely, and had all the amenities we needed for a comfortable stay. The host was extremely responsive and helpful.
Great location, right near the metro. Apartment looked exactly like the photos and was very clean. Host responded very quickly to messages and was very helpful. Would definitely recommend!

Clean, fresh and with a super comfortable bed! Just what we needed after long days walking around Paris! Location is great, most of the main spots are within walking distance but there is also a metro station around the corner. Smooth check-in and check-out. The shower drain is the only thing not working perfectly, with water spreading too much across the bathroom floor, but we found it to be only a minor inconvenience. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Charles was kind, responsive and accommodating. Unfortunately we had problem with the bathroom. The toilet door became moldy due to water ingress, and the musty smell got worse that we have to move away the 4th night. Charles stepped in to help make the move to other hotel easy. So we are fine without complain.

We had a lovely stay at Anne & Jean-Luc’s apartment, and Anne was so proactive and responsive as our host. The location in the Latin Quarter is basically perfect, and it felt like we were locals. Only wish was that our stay was a little longer.

Very nice apartment, small as described but suited our family of four for a four day break. 25 minutes walk to the Eiffel Tower, close to the metro and food shops/cafe's close by. Quiet location-lovely!

Thank You Kathleen very much for Your warm welcome to your beautiful and authentiq Parisian home. I enjoyed my stay and the lovely & charming pets. Thank You again for your kindness and hospitality. Warmly recommend! 😊

Best neighborhood in Paris. Would stay again. Overall the place has everything one needs, though the size is quite intimate (be aware). Thankful to Chokri for easy coordination and for listing this spot.
We loved our stay in Paris. This accommodation was perfect for our needs. Very clean and comfortable. Thank you to the hosts who keep a lovely accommodation 👍✨

Lovely location close to the metro and 40 min walk to Effial Tower. Lovely view and Sheraaz’s mum was very welcoming. Welcoming snacks and drinks were a lovely touch. However, the room was incredibly small. The pull out sofa wasn’t the comfiest Had to live out of suitcase and the toilet was in a wardrobe.. I was shocked this was mentioned in the previous reviews. Couldn’t stay longer than 3 days but it was tidy and great location.

Great location. Just a few blocks from the Eifel Tower. There is a grocery store just a few doors down. Good restaurants in walking distance. Apartment was nice but as with any big city apartment the rooms are on the smaller side. We used the living room to store our luggage. If you plan on using the pull out sofa in the living room I think it would be pretty cramped if you also have a lot of luggage. The housekeeper was still cleaning at check-in time so we got in later than expected but overall we enjoyed our stay. There is a washer/dryer combo in the apartment but we had to do a lot of research to try and figure it out. I wish there was an easy step-by-step guide for guests. I’m sure it would have been easy if we spoke French.

Space is small and definitely for one person and really just serves as a place to crash, but the location is perfect. The communication and attentiveness is great. Everything I needed was provided. It was easy to get in. Have absolutely no complaints! Would stay again if I was just looking for a place to sleep in Paris.
We absolutely loved this place! A true bed and breakfast in the heart of Paris. The staff was friendly and helpful, the breakfast was delicious, and the room was nice. Great location!!

This flat has a amazing location in the heart of montmatre on a quiet street. The rooftop is great in warm weather, with deck chairs, and 2 tables. Beds were comfy and the lounge a nice chill out space with some of Chris's gorgeous photography. I highly recommend this flat, though it does have steep stairs between floors (there is a bathroom on each floor though). It was really nice to meet Chris on arrival too. Merci!
This flat is absolutely gorgeous. Spotlessly clean, with all the amenities you need. Steps from The Louvre, great shopping, the metro and restaurants.
I enjoyed my visit. Tatiana's apartment was well appointed and comfortable. I would stay again in the future, and recommend the space to others. Thank you. W

This apartment is fantastically located right in thick of the Latin Quarter which is full of restaurants and bars. You walk out of the front door and the Seine and Notre Dame are right on your doorstep. The one negative was the noise from the bars below and deliveries in the morning made it difficult to have a good nights sleep. Tony was an excellent host and very communicative.
Comfortable place with all appliances you may need. Located near metro which makes it easy to get to main amenities.

Elsa was very friendly and courteous on instruction and suggestions about good restaurants. She checked on me next day and answered all my questions quickly. We loved her place. Great location. Very safe. We will visit the place again! Thank you Elsa
David was very responsive, his place was clean and in walkable distance from a lot of things things.

The place is perfectly located - everything is right nearby, but it’s quiet and peaceful at night. Everything in the apartment is new and functional and I have thoroughly enjoyed my stay there. Brijid is a great host and responds very quickly.

The location was perfect, absolutely lovely neighborhood, quiet and peaceful passage, very easy to get around on foot or with the Metro. Karine was very sweet and helpful, always available for questions, and had prepared a list of recommendations. Beds were comfortable, and having a bathtub to soak tired legs in after walking around Paris all day was the icing on the cake.

Our family of five adults felt extremely safe in this neighborhood, quite at night, well lit and groceries close. The apartment was comfortable, clean and Arnaud provided us with enough liens and amenities for our entire stay. I definitely would recommend 44 Rue Rennequin.
Wonderful location and lovely apartment. Stairs may be a challenge for some as others have commented. Comfortable bed useful kitchen and great location! Enjoyed our stay.
Great apartment 15 minutes away from the Eiffel tower. The apartment was very spacious, clean and a great place overall!

Peggy was an excellent host, very helpful and checked to see everything was to our satisfaction. The downstairs bedroom had a damp smell, but did air out after a day or so. The rest of the rooms are nice and clean. A well stocked kitchen which looks new and very clean.

I had a wonderful 3-day stay at this Airbnb in Paris. The location was fantastic, with easy access to major attractions and public transportation. The apartment was clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything we needed. The host was responsive and provided helpful local tips. Overall, it made our Paris experience truly memorable.
Cosy apartment close to the metro station, supermarkets and nice restaurants and bakeries. It has everything you need and the host is very helpful :D

Loved the location of this place! Super cute, safe, had all the amenities for us to feel at home. Hosts were great and super responsive. Will definitely stay here again esp it’s in the heart of downtown and the Lourve is like 2 blocks away!

Place charged three times what its worth. Bedroom was smaller with no outlets and dirty . Didnt mention it was right next to the train station which keeps making noise every time a train departs impeding a good night’s sleep. Bathroom was beyond disgusting and dirty. There’s even no curtain so the water makes a mess when taking a shower in the tub. Staff was unfriendly and uncooperative except for the reception desk. Would not recommend.
Great little find, enjoyed staying here, not great for light sleepers as the building is noisy. But a great location and a great price.
John’s apartment is perfectly situated for exploring the 10th arrondissement, especially all the cafes and stores along the canal.
