Great flat for a family of five. We walked to most of the sights and loved the location - everything we needed was literally on our doorstep.

A great stay at this place. Check in was easy and flexible with good responses from the host. The studio itself was clean and exactly as described. Loads of local amenities, including restaurants, cafes, bakery and fast food. The host recommended some great places to eat and party. The surrounding area of the flat is very secure in a quiet area.
Denka is an incredibly friendly and amenable host. Her apartment was exactly as described and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We would definitely return. Thank you so much for your hospitality.

The view of the Eiffel is absolutely magnificent. The location is safe and convenient. Check-in and check-out were flexible and comfortable. Furniture and kitchenware were also delicately prepared. I'm sure it's a better than a picture. It was an impeccable stay. I hope to visiting again.

It was a very clean apartment, easy to locate and near metro stations. It was very spacious and well decorated. But no coffees or teas. It was an amazing place regardless for our first stay in Paris!!!

A perfect location to explore Paris: you can walk in any direction and come to one of the main attractions in 30 minutes max: Eiffel tower to the west, Luxembourg garden to the east, Orsay, Notre-Dam and Louvre to the north... And the whole neighborhood is very cozy and walkable with great restaurants in a great price range. The subway station is in a few minutes walk which makes everything even more accessible! However, there is definitely wide lens magic taking place with the photos: the apartment is much smaller than it appears, beware 😅 So even though it can accomodate up to 4 people, I wouldn't recommend getting it for more than 2 people and using the mezzanine bed: it gets quite stuffy up there. Entirely possble though, especially if you plan on only using it to sleep at nights and spend most of your time out in the city

The apartment is actually a lot bigger in person than what’s shown on the listing. It has 3 bedrooms 2 bathrooms and q toilet. It overlooks an internal courtyard. The place is nice, clean, and provide all the amenities needed for our stay. The location is great, and there are a lot of cute boutique shops around. The host was very responsive and very accomodating for our request of early check in. The place has a lift, which is super handy, and rare to find in Paris in my personal opinion. Checking in and out were both really easy as well.
The location is 10/10. A walk to the eiffel tower took 25 minutes, the metro station is 2 minutes away. The place is very clean, just like the pictures

Checking in was easy. Paul met us at the door and gave us a quick tour of our room. It was private and Paul left us be but was always there when we would need him. Just drop him a message and he would answer pretty quickly. Location was perfect, plenty of cafes and places to eat and about 20 min walk to the Eiffel Tower. If you love Italian food, I would 100% recommend Firmine which is right by the Eiffel Tower. Probably the best ragu bolognese I have ever had.
Beautiful place to stay. As described and felt extremely safe - perfect place if you’re going to moulin rouge. Thank you
Vanessa i s a great guy, and we enjoyed our stay. It's quiet and clean. It is convenient to shop nearby, very close to the subway station. I will recommend it to my friends.

Christophe’s place was exactly what we wanted and needed for our Paris stay. We loved the quiet, the view, the tranquility offered at night with the blackout blinds. We had a great visit and Christophe was very kind and helpful from checkin to checkout. Thanks!

Incredibly beautiful home. The room is literally gorgeous and spacious. The bed is super comfy and the breakfast cart feels like a movie. Everything within the room feels very updated. Would stay here 100x again. Such a marvelous experience
This is an excellent place to stay in Paris. Happy is very accommodating, gracious and her apartment homey and easily accessible. I will definitely plan to return. The pets were an added asset.

I had a great time with my family at this apartment in Paris. Perfect for 3-4 travelers., close to the metro and lots to do in the area. We did have a little trouble with the lockbox for self check in but Brothers Care was very responsive and quick to solve the problem. Thank you for all your help and being so quick to answer any questions. I would definitely recommend the apartment here in Paris 18e. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

This was the most amazing experience. I feel so lucky to have experienced Paris for the first time through this apartment and neighborhood. We found the restaurants to be excellent and loved that it was less touristy but you could easily hop on the metro and get anywhere in 20 minutes. We had everything we needed in the apartment. The beds were comfy. The views are beyond belief. I just loved it and would love to return.

Delphine is a gracious host and one of the best I have had over the years of being on AirBNB. Easy to reach and always helpful. if you want to feel at home and like you are a real Persian and not just a tourist then you found the right place. I am looking forward to returning to Paris and hopefully get to stay with her again.
The place is next to the train stop and there’s noise and a lot of people and traffic due to that . The good thing is you are close to the Eiffel Tower and restaurants on the area

Overall it was a good four nights, the location is very good, a short walk to the Louvre, the room was very clean and the kitchen facilities are new! The only thing that could be improved was that the temperature of the bath water couldn't stay stable for a long time.

Very very noisy flat as the door opens directly onto the building entrance. From 5am there is a steady stream of banging and voices. Also the balcony appears to be part of the flat but actually it’s not.
Beautiful loft surrounded by hidden neighborhood gems! Lively street nearby but actual building is quiet and residential. Felt comfortable and safe, and overall really enjoyed our stay!

Great location. Great layout. Tiphaine was a very nice host and was flexible on our check-in time. We had small kids with us and it was a perfect location. Great WiFi. The greatest recommendation is staying at the same place again. We would without hesitation.
Beautiful space! Was spotless, had very comfy beds, and in such a great area. Had everything we needed and more! Marine has great replies and was so helpful. Couldn’t recommend more
Elsa was very nice , apartment is exactly as described. Excellent location. Hope to be back soon. Thank you

Anne was a very kind and friendly host. She was very responsive and helpful and made me feel very welcome. She gave great tips and clear instructions. The apartment is beautifully decorated, quiet, and clean. I will definitely stay here again next time I am in Paris.
Good place but need some improvements for the tv and light remote. This apartment was very clean and accessible.

We loved our stay at Georges and Sylvie's apartment! The location can't be beat and is a short walk away from lots of great bakeries, cafes, and restaurants. The apartment was also very well stocked and laid out, and Dimitri was extremely helpful in checking us in and making sure that we had everything we needed. Would love to stay again the next time we're in Paris.

Amazing area the metro is very close to get around the Emily in Paris restaurant & fountain is literally down the street it feels very safe even at night the building has a code which feels extremely safe the only downside I had was no WiFi & having to share restrooms but that is listed so I can’t complain would stay again the area is extremely nice in my opinion would recommend if you do not mind not having the things I listed

We stayed at Marc's place with 6 adults and a baby. The purpose of our visit was primarily to spend time with family, and secondarily to tour Paris. As such Marcs place was wonderful. Located in a quite, less touristy neighborhood of Paris, close to the Gare du Nord train station (which we used to get to Amsterdam after our visit), we felt right at home. The house is as described, and as appears in the photos. To begin we were greated by his assistant Nathalie who speaks fluent english and helped us check in and familiarize ourselves. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook. The washing machined worked well. The house is supplied with shampoo and body wash. The living room is spacious. The beds have good quality cushions and sheets. In all the place is great and highly recommended.

We had an amazing time at Paul’s place. Everything about his place was as described. Location is super close to the Eiffel Tower and the neighborhood is peaceful to stroll through. I would definitely recommend staying here if you’re planning a trip to Paris.
It was clean and cosy studio ... Small but good for me as solo traveler... safe neighborhood and surrounded by many supermarkets and restaurants and shops ... Train station is in walkable distance...
Gorgeous space situated in a fabulous neighbourhood of Paris. Very closed to everything, yet wasn’t too noisy. Haiyan was corporative and very helpful, will stay there again.

This stay was excellent. Beautiful unit with everything you would need for a comfortable stay, spacious and really well designed. Everything was clean and in good condition. Tatiana was very responsive and made the stay seamless, highly recommend!

The apartment is situated close to the Louvre and close to two metro stations, which made accessing attractions across Paris very easy. Check-in and accessing the apartment was very easy with clear instructions. The apartment is well-furnished, modern and completely renovated, spacious, and well-appointed. Well worth the money and the stay. I highly recommend. Thank you for a great stay!

Clémence's apartment is the perfect stay in Paris. I hope the next time in Paris I can stay here again, she was so great to communicate with and I had such an amazing time in this apartment on a work trip. This is an ideal stay and perfectly described apartment. 10/10

Very nice place with a great accommodation. Everything is close and you can walk to see all the attraction :) The apartment is very small but well organized, it’s enough for 2people if you mostly want to be outside. I truly recommend this place.
I had such a great time in Paris. The location was a short walk from the station. I would highly recommend!
Met by friend of Mao at access. Place was very clean, some road noise but location overrid this.
I stayed with Frederique again, and as always she was so sweet and her place so pretty! I would recommend always to stay with her!
Fantastic location! Easy to get everywhere. The daily cleaning service was a great addition. Great communication from the host at all times as well. We would definitely stay here again.
We loved the location - easy access to metro, restaurants and sites. The apartment was clean and spacious. We look forward to returning! Thank you!
Good place in Paris. Small, but clean room. Good location near Opera The only negative is poor sound insulation

Clarisse was a wonderful host, very helpful when we had a last minute change in travel plans. Her airbnb is lovely and the view from the little balcony made the first cup of morning coffee taste that much better! It was also really close to the metro station which made seeing Paris so much easier. Overall, an amazing experience!
It was super clean, had everything we needed and despite being near quite a busy road it was very peaceful in the apartment. Would highly recommend

Great place to stay in Paris. Few minutes walk to Eiffel Tower and lots of nearby restaurants, supermarket and train station. Hsiao Lin is very responsive and the description of the apartment is very accurate and more so, exceed our expectations! Definitely recommended specially on big group like us (7 adults plus kids)
In short extreme convient location and super comfortable bed. For an old building with lots of apartments it was surprisingly quiet at night. A definite recommendation!
Place was cheap and small. Which is what we were looking for. Bathroom smelled like sewer which I guess is normal in Paris. Good place to stay if you want somewhere cheap
The place is very well located. The apartment itself is tiny but sufficient for 1-2 persons.

The apartment is cozy and well maintained. The location is perfect, is close to the metro station, bus station, and RER station, just 3-5 minutes walking! Loved it! Is the second time when I come and I will in the furure. Thank you Anna!
This cozy apartment was perfect for our short stay in Montmarte. The apartment is uniquely decorated. We felt right at home.

Wonderful place for our group of four to explore Paris. Great quiet neighborhood, loved walking around here. Close to RER station and Metro. Check in and out was easy and Nadir helpful and quick to respond. Thank You!!

Very little but confortable apartment next to Bastille. Very quiet, easy to access and perfect for a short stay in Paris. Stephane is an excellent host, the communication was precise and reactive. Very recommended.
Nicolas is an extremely good host and very responsive/gives very detailed instructions! I would recommend a stay here to anyone visiting Paris!
Scaffolding on entire building, entry and bedroom windows, very loud Good location Bathrooms ok, bit dated, shower curtains ect Bedroom TV did not work

This place is great, it may seem far from all the sights to see but it is steps away from a metro station that will take you to all the Paris staples. It’s also conveniently located directly across from a fine grocery store and next to a very good bakery. Overall it is a great spot

The location was great and the space very comfortable. Some small challenges with communication - incorrect information for the lockbox code and the wifi network did not work for the two days of my stay.

It was a beautiful little space, perfect for what we needed. Close enough to walk to Eiffel Tower, grocery store across the street and a few minutes from 2 metro stations made for easy access to the rest of the city.
The place was great, easy access to metro and local places. Paul was very kind and accommodating! Would recommend to anyone!

Vanessa's apartment in Paris was a delightful retreat. Her prompt and accommodating communication made booking effortless. The apartment's proximity to the Eiffel Tower was a highlight, offering breathtaking views just a short walk away. The space itself was tastefully decorated and impeccably clean, providing a cozy haven after exploring the city. Vanessa's warm hospitality made our stay truly memorable; she went above and beyond to ensure our comfort and satisfaction. Overall, our experience exceeded expectations, and we highly recommend Vanessa's apartment for an unforgettable Parisian getaway.

We loved the location of the apartment. It was very central with great access to public transportation. Denka is a fantastic host and very responsive to any of your questions or needs. The only reason this review did not get a 5/5 was the lack of hot water availability. We found there was not enough hot water for even one person to shower. But that was the only issue. Everything else was perfect and we really enjoyed Paris and this location.

We really enjoyed our time in Paris, the location we really liked, short walk to major attractions and to the metro. Shops and cafes extremely close. The apartment had everything we needed and was basically what we expected. Bathroom is small. Overall a great budget option.

Nice small apartment with everything you need for a couple of days in Paris! We were there Thursday - Sunday and it was a bit loud at night but we slept ok. Otherwise the location is great, well located near the subway and in a cool neighborhood.

We loved the apartment! It was so close to everywhere we wanted to go, and the animals were so sweet! Kathleen was a great host and the beautiful accommodations in the heart of Paris greatly contributed to our wonderful experience!
Great place. Spacious enough, both rooms were quite big. Very effective for a weekend in Paris.
amazing location, central and walkable distance to a lot of main attractions and metro stations. Great amenities for a home-like stay in the heart of Paris. Would happily recommend to anyone
Cozy, Clean, and Convenient. I would stay here again for my next solo trip in Paris and will also recommend this place to all my friends.
Everything went great. Good location. The place looks even better in person. I will always book the place whenever I’m in Paris

This was a great location, very close to the major sights, and lots of good restaurants nearby. The property was private, safe, clean, spacious, and met our needs. Jean-Luc was a wonderful host, who was very responsive and provided clear instructions.

We had such a great stay at Inès’s! The apartment was very clean and unique, the view onto the Paris rooftops was beautiful and Ines was the sweetest host! The location couldn’t have been more perfect, so close to everything. We might just have to come back here next time! 😉

The location was close to attractions and our Uber drivers had no trouble finding us for pick ups and drop offs. The apartment is on the third floor with secure codes (three) to access both the building and the apartment. It was well-appointed, quiet and a good deal for the money.

I had a wonderful stay at Sophie's, and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking to book one in Paris. Sophie is an excellent host - she is extremely friendly and I'm happy to have met her. The apartment is gorgeous and you will feel right at home. Thank you Sophie for your help in making our stay in Paris the best!

This was a Parisian dream. Beautiful decor and such a comfy bed! Exactly what we needed for our trip to Paris! Breakfast was delicious and the hosts were very accommodating and kind! We hope to be back!!

The location was great and close to the metro to make it easy to get to all areas of the city. Being able to wake up and go to sleep with the Eiffel Tower in the window was magical. We still had some construction and scaffolding when we visited, but it didn’t take away much from the experience or the stay. We would definitely recommend the apartment and host!
Amazing location close to all the main landmarks and close to the metro ! super clean and comfortable place would definitely go back :)
The pullout sofabed was very comfortable. The location was great — very walkable to everything. The apartment was very clean and clutter free. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay again.
It was a small but nice place. Like some of the other reviews said the bathroom does have an odor. Location was pretty good too.
Amazing apartment, super clean, looks just like in the pictures..host very responsive. Felt like home, will def stay again! Great location too.

The apartment matched the pictures and was very clean. We met the kind manager briefly , other than that, all communication was via messages, which wasn't a problem. The kitchen was very well equiped. All four of us were really happy to stay there and had a great time.
Location was great, there was chocolates on the table when we arrived. Place was tidy. ✨

If you're planning to be out and about for most of the time, this cosy studio flat is great. It's close to all the main metro stations, 25min walk to the Eiffel Tower, it's surrounded by amazing and highly rated bakeries and restaurants! The host was super helpful and responsive, and the flat had all the main amenities that you may need.
The locatuon was amazing ! The host was really helpful when we have a problem or a question. the place was clean and tidy. Definitely stay in this place if you have a chance !

The apartment is in a very good location close to the train station and attractions. Check in was simple, and apartment looked just like the photos. It can get noisy during the night, and shower wasn’t draining well during our stay. Otherwise, it was an enjoyable stay.
A home from home in Paris Very comfortable flat for 4 people in good accessible location if you are comfortable with the metro Great balconies and views Handy kitchen and seating area
Clean, convenient apartment that worked well for a family of six. Plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby and easy access to the Metro. We love Paris and would definitely stay in this apartment again.
Lovely stay! Wonderful hosts, made check in super convenient and very cute house in a good neighbourhood.

Jean-Francois is a most amenable guy. Could not be more helpful and is full of good recommendations. The apartment was as described and was clean and had all the contingencies you would need for a short stay. You do need to be reasonably fit however as the stairs are quite demanding but the pay off is worth it. Highly recommended

Tatiana's place was fabulous. It is a beautiful space, with everything you could need. The location is great - close to everything and in a vibrant neighbourhood that really comes alive at night. We loved it.
We had a fantastic stay at Yohann’s apartment. Location is great, unit was clean and comfortable, just as it appears in the listing. Would definitely stay there again
Aude is great - very proactive with clear instructions and very responsive to any queries. The apartment is really lovely and exactly as advertised. Merci, Aude!
Very stylish apartment and can cater for young families (we have two small children). Park is extremely close which is lovely too.

The apartment was very clean, very comfortable and very stylish. I hadn’t realised that there was no natural light but it didn’t bother us too much as we were out most of the time. The beds were very comfortable, even the sofa bed. Everything was to a very high standard. The apartment is only two stops away from the Gare du Nord which was very convenient for us.

This is a beautiful home in a fantastic location. Rated 4/5 stars related to description as the post says 2 bath and it has only one toilet, but this was not a problem for our family of four and everything else is 5/5. Very responsive hosts and we highly recommend this wonderful home. Thank you!

The place is wonderful! Great location, very beautiful apartment - spacious and bright, views from the windows are very Parisian. Loved every second of my stay. Didn’t mind the noise from the street, as it is what the center of Paris is like.

Newly renovated nice little apartment, great area super close to the Metro and all amenities. Only thing to watch out for is read the description above….There are six flights of stairs, which is very difficult to navigate with luggage.

We stayed five nights in this lovely apartment. We were greeted and showed around by Valèrie and felt at home at once. We had expected some traffic noise but the apartment is very quiet. Would definitely recommend.
Great place to stay! The staff was very friendly und helpful. We really appreciated the luggage room.
Walid was super sweet, great communication and especially helpful when it comes to my questions in booking. Really recommend !

Amazing location - in a lively neighborhood, but on a quiet street, easy walking to many popular spots, public transportation close. Very clean. Comfortable beds. Easy access and instructions. Was perfect for our family of 5 staying for a week, definitely would stay again.

John’s place is really great not only because it was very clean and everything a person could need was provided, but also because of its location. It’s close to multiple different metro stations which can take you into the centre of Paris in 10 min. It also has two different Supermarkets right by it, lots of different bistros (a great one to try is Brasserie Au Comptoir) and of course boulangeries! And it’s close to canal St. Martin. John is also a great host as his response time is very quick and friendly. I would definitely recommend this place if you ever visit Paris whether as a solo traveller or with another person.
Mao is a kind, helpful, responsive host with a beautiful, well-placed apartment. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay.
The apartment is beautiful and even nicer than the photos. It is very well refurbished and getting there was smooth.

It’s was my first time in Paris, and it was amazing to stay in Sophie’houses I felt in my home, it’s so comfort, so safe, there is everything you need, Sophie it’s so kind and wonderful, I’m sure that the next time I will be stay again in the same house! Perfect!
Although there are some problems in the equipment of the house, Adrien is very responsible to solve the problem and gave us some remedial action.
This is a wonderful property and great location. The host couldn’t be nicer and very responsive to all communication.

We thoroughly enjoyed living in this stunning apartment which was in a Haussman building of over 100 years old! That said, it is equipped with elavator and modern air conditioning (with heating), which is very important for us with large suitcases. The apartment had everything we needed and more, and big enough for two people. Especially love the balcony and waking up to see the skyline of Paris :) The building is just next to the metro station, about 10 minutes walk from the RER station, and very centrally located so we seldom need to travel for more than 15 minutes. The area is surrounded with restaurants, cafes and grocery stores. Very convenient for getting daily essentials. Thanks to Jean-philippe, it is a home away from home after one week.

I liked everything except the mattress was too soft, the blankets were too hot and heavy and the water pressure was poor. Otherwise, the location is opposite the main attractions, restaurants within walking distance. The room was clean and the neighbours were quiet.
Great location! We loved everything being so walkable. House is a bit smaller than the pics suggest. But overall a wonderful spot. Would rent again!
Excellent service. The place was very nice. Great space for a big family. Close to Bastille and a lot of shops.
Anne is very responsive and reacted to all our additional requests. We found all we expected and more!

Paul and Estelle were terrific hosts. They were very friendly, responsive, and helpful. The apartment is lovely and spacious. It is very conveniently located with easy access to the metro and major train stations. Staying there made our time in Paris wonderful!

I was worried about the place if it is same as in pictures even I've seen a lot of good reviews. Check-in went smoothly, there was a lady who welcomed me and showed everything to know about the apartment and the place is very beautiful that it would be a shame not to take care of it as if it were your own🥹 thank you Salvatore, and definitely I will be back❤️
Nicolás Is a great guess, the place is near to everything, very comfortable and easy to find.

Charles and Emma are nice hosts who really want their guests to be comfortable. Their place is well located—very central. Had a little trouble using the lock box code to get the key. Charles and Emma were always responsive, and even sent their cleaner to make my bed with softer sheets one day. Would encourage them to replace the kitchen table with a smaller one, provide Nespresso capsules, and replace the hot tub area with a fourth bedroom.

Louise’s apartment was lovely and perfect for our family of 3. Louise also made an effort to leave out items that would be useful for us given we were traveling with a baby. We loved the neighborhood - lots of great restaurants and shops in walking distance but still very quiet in the apartment itself. Would stay again!
Great apartment. Very neat and clean and near the Metro station. Paul was very responsive and helpful. The area was also very central.

I loved the quirkiness of this place, I love staying in these kind of places that are just different, it is a lot of fun. I like opening the front door and feeling like I live there and then just walking down the street to go on an adventure.
Apartment had all the essentials, clean, good location and amazing host, happy we found it and could stay there!

A great place for our family. Vanessa took care of our needs and helped in all ways. 5 minute walk to trains to get you anywhere. A great location that served our needs. Vanessa’s apartment made our trip to Paris special! Thank you!!!!

Leah was extremely responsive and helpful during our stay. She addressed any minor issue that came up. The location was excellent and had easy access to the Metro. We had a great stay and would definitely stay there again.

This place is in a perfect location for visiting Paris. It’s in walking distance to the major museums, Notre Dame, the Metro, shops and cafes. It’s small but had everything we needed and more. It’s an attractively decorated space with great light. It’s in a busy area but quiet inside.

Very clean, very stylish, as described and just like in the photos. A quiet house in the middle of the city! Very close to Bastille. Suitable for business travel as well as touristic visits... They were really proactive and helped me. Definitely worth the stay, would come again.

Charles met us at check-in and showed us around, offered recommendations, and even checked in to make sure our trip was going well. His home is gorgeous and close to multiple metro stops. We had an amazing trip and staying in such a comfortable home was the cherry on top!
The place could have been more clean and there were some dishes/cups missing for more than 3 people but overall it was superb and I can recommend.
Perfect space for parents with an adult child. Cute decor and lovely cats in the building. Has everything you need for a stay in Paris would highly recommend staying here!

Hélène and her husband were very helpful and friendly the full time I was there. Did everything they could to make my stay as enjoyable as possible. Very easy for transport to all main attractions also.
Joan and Sophie were extremely accommodating. The apartment was clean and matched the description. It is close to the metro station, making it easy to move around Paris from their address.

The apartment is a small garden level unit, with windows and door to central courtyard. We knew we were compromising a view and space/size to stay within our budget, but the function of the apartment was perfect. Our family of three kids and two adults fit fine and had no issues with the amenities. It is great to have a second toilet/sink. The kitchen was great. While initially uncertain about the location, it proved wonderful. There were other hotels and tourists in the area, and there were plenty of restaurants, convenience stores, and bakeries in walkable distance. We felt safe walking with our children at 10:30 at night. The metro worked fine. Taxis/Ubers found the location just fine. Access to the courtyard requires a separate key or passcode, in addition to the apartment door, so security is good.

My recent Airbnb experience exceeded all expectations, thanks to a remarkable host. Despite unconventional filming requirements, she was incredibly accommodating, making the entire process smooth and stress-free. I highly recommend her property for a hassle-free stay.
Very nice for a short stay in the middle of the city centre - communication and check-in were extremly easy and Irfaan was very helpful providing all the necessary information very quickly

Great apartment located in a beautiful neighborhood, local grocery shop and bakery available close to the apartment together with great restaurants. Metro station is also available in a walkable distance. Highly recommend this place.

Fantastic penthouse near the Grand Palais. The views are amazing and it is very large for Europe. There are two sitting areas amd two full bathrooms. You can also see nearly every site in Paris including the Eiffel Tower from the couch. Everything in the house is dated and could use a fresh coat of paint, but it didn’t bother me because of the location and the view. I highly recommend this apartment.
Aviva was a gracious host and we loved the Montmartre neighborhood as a base to explore Paris.
Loved this place. Eiffel Tower was just around the corner with a view from the window. Everything else is walkable with the metro down the street.

Cozy and chic airbnb in great location. Host was super flexible and helpfull. Room airy and bright, comfy bed. For Paris standarts room is well proportioned and the flat itself is huge. Lovely cats and a dog that we enjoyed having around. Would love to come back sometime!
Had a great stay. Easy check in, location was good. Space is literally 2 sofa beds, a bathroom and a bedroom so don’t expect much, but it does the job

Great place to stay! The apartment is super cute, close to a lot of the major sites and the owner was very flexible on letting us drop off our bags before check-in due to our early flight times. We would absolutely stay again.
Abel’s place is in a great location to see Paris, he is very friendly, responsive and helpful, and of course the view is amazing! I look forward to returning to Paris and this excellent flat!

,to be honest we were a little surprised at the size of the Flat.Wewere tired when we arrived,it was raining and we did not have good comunication →that was not her fault. After we settled in,we found the studio apartment was very nice.Yes it was small but close to everything.Walking distance to everything. If we had to do it again, I would not hesitate to rent again from Fernanda. -
It is a bit small but it absolutely perfect of a place if your are looking for a good location and a place to rest your head.

Jonathan’s place is only for a single. It’s in an excellent location near Gard du Nord. Easy access to metro Poissoniere station which is on the Louvre line. The cake store near it is fabulous! I felt safe there. No TV but the internet is good and the hot water is hot. I enjoyed my stay here

Excellent location Spacious apartment with good sized rooms, by European standard A word of caution! Global warming necessitates Airconditioners in April in Paris too Very good area with excellent and many many restaurants and bars within walking distance Strongly recommend this Air BNB Keep it up Laurent and Paula Never met Laurent, but Paula made our checkin and stay very comfortable She was good and proactive in communicating Zero complaints
Had a great time at Marie’s place, good location! It’s very cute and has everything you’ll need. Marie was very communicative and helped a lot. Would recommend

Francine was an excellent host. She communicates well and always responds to queries. She met us upon check-in and explained the apartment amenities. The apartment was exactly as advertised. It is very functional, the kitchen is beautiful and the king-sized bed is comfortable. The location is excellent. Walking distance to the Eiffel Tour, the Seine tourist attractions, and the train and metro stations. A bit farther, but still walkable, to get to the Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysees. The Passy neighborhood is vibrant, very nice and has many restaurants and shops within easy walking distance. Would highly recommend this apartment and Francine as a host.
Great place! Louvre is in walking distance, lots of places to eat around and not noisy at all. Maria and Alain are great hosts, recommended a nice coffee spot nearby.
Thank you for you hosting 🩷 Monique and her husband Jean-Noël are very friendly to us 😊
Lovely place. Clean, luxurious, quiet, comfortable, with nice amenities and in a stellar location. Couldn’t dream of anything better. Staff was very flexible and responsive too.

The apartment exactly matches the photo and description. Perfect for a family of 3. Great location, everything is within walking distance. Check-in instructions are very clear and understandable. Thank you, we will definitely come back.

Laurent was a fantastic host with great communication. He was very kind. The apartment was clean and spacious. He left coffee, Tea and cookies. The location is close to restaurants, and transportation. Definitely a great place to stay when visiting Paris!

We were really happy with our stay. Julien was an excellent host, who was responsive and provided us with great recommendations in a house manual and when he greeted us for check-in. He was always available too. The location was great — not loud but in close proximity to shops, eateries, and bars. The bed was very comfortable, and the bathroom was lovely. We would definitely recommend, and revisit.

Elsa’s place was exactly how it showed in the pictures. The place was fully renovated with modern furniture and decoration. The sofa bed was very comfortable unlike other sofa beds. Elsa was very prompt in responding to our questions and giving us recommendations (Chez Margot, So Hotel, bakery) We would definitely recommend this place.
Very nice place in a very central location yet very quiet and private . Spacious and practical . The host is very responsive and flexible . Highly recommended.

We absolutely loved the location. We were close to the metro, local sights and lots of restaurants. We also had enough space to spread out comfortably, which is unheard of in Paris. We had everything we needed and more, and we would absolutely stay here again.
Tony's small apartment was great. Wonderful location with lots of restaurants, bars, shops and 2 minute access to the nearest metro stop.
We had a lovely time in the apartment. It’s located in a popular area however the apartment is located a bit away from the street so you don’t hear any noise. We would come back again.

The apartment is in an outstanding location. It is a very small studio and the bathroom is tiny but we found it perfect for 3 nights. Astrid's instructions were very detailed and it was easy to find and get in. Would recommend for a short stay in Paris.
Catherine and Jean-Pascal's apartment was very comfortable and offered every amenity a person could need.

Very pleased with our stay at Adrien's place. Adrien was communicative and provided us with very clear instruction on how to find the apartment, how to use the amenities and best places in the vicinity of the apartment.

A spacious apartment in an old building with an elevator and added bonus. All amenities available and functional. How ever shower hand held rose secured with string. The apartment was very close to metro which made moving around Paris so easy! The local area had easily accessible food markets and restaurants! A little out of Paris but a great place to stay! Mireille was very communicative and welcoming. We enjoyed our stay and loved Paris! Merci beaucoup Mireille!!

I stayed in the studio with two others and we were very happy with the setup. It is a small space but the location is very central and was in a safe area (we were three women), making it perfect for our 2 night trip to Paris. Vénus was a fantastic host, she was very accommodating and responsive!

The place is great, nice location and the view. Abel was a kind host - responsive, helped me with my suitcase. The apartment is small, but has everything you might need. Only thing to keep in mind that the apartment is on the 7th floor with no elevator and toilet is in the hall. Overall, thanks very much!
We had a very pleasant stay at Elsa’s. As everyone commented, Elsa was always responsive and friendly. Everything worked out great 👍😊
A tiny little spot placed within good distance to the Louvre and Notre Dame. It can be quite loud through the night but that’s to be expected.

I couldn’t be happier with the place. A beautiful apartment carefully decorated. The sofa bed was as comfortable as a regular bed. The connectivity is awesome, close to several metro lines. Cindy was super responsive and helpful. It was the perfect place to stay in a beautiful city
Linda was a wonderful host and was very responsive. The apartment was very clean and roomy and in a great location. Highly recommend it!

We had a lovely stay at Monique‘s place. Lovely area and walkable with nice restaurants, bakeries and more in near distance. The check-in was very flexible and our host was responding frequent. We had an amazing stay and can only recommend staying in this great place.
Nice apartment close to metro to get to places throughout the city. Apartment looked like the listing. Would recommend as a nice place to stay when in Paris.

Kevin's place is excellent, strategically located, spacious, and luxurious. I'll definitely come back here since my parents loved the accommodation, plus its strategic location allows easy access to many places.
It was the cleanest accommodation I've ever been to in Paris. He also communicated well!! It's a cozy space😃
we had a lovely time at sophie‘s airbnb, would recommend it but to anyone who is planning a short visit in paris and wants the parisian feeling.

Surprisingly spacious and private place that is steps away from bustling part of the city. Place itself was clean and tastefully renovated with all listed appliances. The flat is located in the ground floor. Getting keys to check in is little bit challenging with luggages because it requires some walk. I just had my taxi waiting for me outside while I was picking up the key from other location. Other than that, it was an amazing the stay.
The place was exactly as described. Great for our family with 3 teenage boys. Thanks Charles!

Had an amazing experience, the metro station is 10 steps away. The host was responsive and had clear instructions. Place was very clean, enough towels and toiletries for a group of 8. Overall I will definitely recommend this airbnb.

We enjoyed our stay! In a quieter part of Paris, at least while we were there. The location mmediate access to transit, to get to other parts of Paris, and Elsa recommended a great bistro! Felt safe and secure.

Would be five stars if we had some suggestions on the neighborhood restaurants etc. Really this is a great area for restaurants but we weren’t given any information in that sense. The location is great since there is easy access to several metro lines. Very clean, well organized with well equipped kitchen. I would recommend it if you don’t the fourth floor walk up. Tony was very responsive and communicated quickly 👍🏽👍🏽

Beautiful, huge for Paris standards with tons of light. One of the best Airbnb’s I’ve ever been to and I’ve been to a lot of Airbnbs. Very classy yet comfortable. No shoer just huge bathtub with hand held shower fitting. Highly recommended.
The apartment and area was Fantastic. View of tower breathtaking. Bernard was attentive and a pleasure to deal with. Will definitely be back again. Giacomo and Jerome

Dear Corrine, It's been a fantastic stay at your lovely cosy apartment. Everything was as described by the Airbnb profile. Security in the apartment building is immense. The furniture and all accessories were very tasteful. The little personal touches stood out, specially the 🐓. The area is safe and secure and close to all needed services. Now I know, I have a permanent home (when available) in Paris everytime I visit it! Much love from Bangladesh!! Regards, Ziad
My group of 4 had a wonderful stay at this perfectly situated flat. Modern amenities with comfortable beds, this property was a great place for relaxing and sleeping while exploring Paris.
Very nice place and very convenient location!! It was definitely a nice experience to stay in a parisian apartment

Everything about the stay was wonderful. Tony was communicative, flexible, and extremely helpful. He went above and beyond any expectations In short, he is the ideal host. The apartment is exactly as described: positively charming, clean and in perfect condition, and ideally located. We couldn’t have been happier with this stay!
Amazing place, very unique street in Paris. impossible to get more of a local Paris feeling than here. Apartment perfect for 4. Jean is very friendly.

It was a perfect place for my wife and me. The bed was a queen and very comfortable! At first we were worried about the window not being able to shut out the light, but there is an electric shade to make it dark. The kitchen was all we needed, we mostly eat salads and ate out. It’s a very welcoming place with plants and a great balcony! Very safe place with security gates and courtyard. We would definitely stay here again as it is close to a son and grandchildren who live in Paris. Fantastic place!!!

The apartment was small but very efficient. The building is beautiful and quiet. It's close to a couple of Metro stations so getting into center city was a snap. It's perfect for one person who simply needs a place to stay at night. I'd stay here again on my next visit to Paris, no problem.

Stay was amazing, perfectly located within walking and view distance of the Eiffel Tower as well as train/bus transportation to go anywhere in the city right outside the door. Perfect place for people looking to explore Paris
We had a great time at Elise’s studio. Very tidy, in a cute private area. We had some minor issues with a lock & some other questions & Elise was always responsive.

Sophie was a great host, very easy to communicate with and friendly. The location couldn't have gotten any better too! Easy walk to many cafes ans restaurants as well as metro/RER stops. Would love to come back here in the future, thank you for being a superhost!

Vincent's flat was beautiful, clean, and in a great location walkable to many restaurants, shops, and public transit. The bedding was incredibly soft and welcoming, too. Would highly recommend this as a place to stay in Paris.

Highly recommend staying. One of the best Airbnb experiences I have ever had. Location, host, and value all exceeded expectations. Centrally located, the apartment is walking distance to the Eiffel Tower. Will stay again the next time I am in Paris!!
Pierre & Irene are perfect host. easy to communicate and friendly. They have also lots of ideas which are helpful to explore Paris. I stongly recommend their place! Merci Pierre et Irene!

Communication with host was a breeze! She was very friendly and helpful. The apartment was great. So cute and cozy and great location. The stairs were not a problem for us but be warned if you have any mobility issues, it will be a problem. Some people at the bistro downstairs got a little feisty one night so I used some earplugs. Problem solved. I recommend this property.

Easy access to the metro and in a local neighborhood. We had an issue with the sofa bed being unclean and wifi not working, but didn’t disrupt our stay since we were in the city all day. Great vibes overall!

We have stayed in Jean-Luc’s apartment over a couple of nights - it is very clean, comfy, looks exactly like pictures. The inner courtyard is beautiful. Although the place is a couple minutes walking from Louvre it is very quiet. Highly recommend!
Jean-Francois was a fantastic host. Very helpful, incredibly responsive, and offered great recommendations. We loved our time there!

Great location - within 30 min by metro to a lot of the museums and in a residential area where there’s lots of good cafes, bakeries, and grocery stores. The interior was beautifully designed and well maintained. Highly recommend walking along the Ave Daumesnil!

Very well located. We enjoyed our stay. The place is very easily accessible via transit. Also conviently located to restaurants and groceries. There was enough space for the 5 of us to stay comfortablly. Merci Anne!

My stay at Kathleens apartment was utterly wonderful! I was greeted instantly by Nero the black cat as I came through the front door. Which felt like immediatley being welcomed home. Then Milo the adorable dog came to say hello too. Kathleen let me drop off my bags early as a got into the city early, which was ideal as I headed out for a day exploring. Loved how easy it was a to navigate from the apartment too. Allowed me to feel like a local in a city I love. Kathleen was super helpful with recommendations too and I very much hope to stay here again soon.
A very quintessential flat for Paris! Located in a great location with easy access to the metro. Sebastian was very easy to communicate with!
This stay was perfect for our family of 5. The apartment was in an excellent location, close to Metro and very walkable.
Kathleen was a great host! The room is in a great location at great price. Very clean and beautiful neighbourhood. Highly recommended.
We enjoy our stay at this cute place. The location is great. Close to metro station and lots of good restaurants.

If Elsa's place is available, pick it. Location, location, location - this is the place to be in Paris, just inside the confines of the Marais, our favorite neighborhood in Paris. Excellent restaurants are nearby and walkable, a Metro stop is 3 minutes away, and the apartment is also close to the Bastille, Ille St Louis, Jardine de Plante, etc. Elsa is very responsive and helpful. Minor drawbacks are thin walls - you'll hear voices and water - and the kitchen has a bare minimum of utensils - but these are more than compensated by the highlights.

Jordan was lovely! So responsive and friendly. The apartment was small but exactly as pictured. Was in an excellent location and worked well for my needs. If I come back to Paris again as a solo traveler I will definitely be booking here again.

Overall, everything was pretty good. The location is very convenient, right next to the metro station. It was clean. However, the soundproofing was very poor, and we could hear every word, even whispers, from the neighbors.

Gorgeous, really special Airbnb! The inside is really unique and has been furnished very thoughtfully. I think it used to be a store or restaurant that was converted into a living space. Patrick and Nathalie were very communicative and kind. Had a great experience. Note: there is one toilet upstairs and a shower downstairs, and the 2 beds are downstairs. Some people may find that a little inconvenient, but I think it’s just how the space is laid out and part of the charm.

Superbly positioned and met all expectations Hosts wee extremely helpful Had one night of we quite a lot of noise from the normally quiet but not unusual when you are in the middle of the city. Would stay agsin

Mel's place was located a stones throw from the Eiffel Tower but far enough it is not crowded with tourists! Many great restaurants in the neighborhood. Mel was very communicative and friendly! Would love to stay with them again!

We enjoyed our stay! It was easy to get around the city from the place and everything was as advertised. The tub was clean but worn and the toilet seat was broken, however the hosts were very responsive and answered questions quickly, always within an hour or less. We were very happy with the place and really enjoyed our stay!

One of my best experiences with Airbnb apartments and the hosts. The apartment is gorgeous, very spacious with everything you need. I found my room exactly as it was described. Kathleen was very welcoming and very helpful throughout my stay despite the fact that we missed each other. The cats are friendly and lovely and make you feel at home. 10/10 would recommend and stay again

We loved our stay here with Anne in Paris. The location was super convenient with just a quick walk to the nearest metro station / nord station. Lovely flat, very well equipped and comfortable. Definitely recommended!

A great charming apartment in the heart of the Saint Germain neighborhood. Easy access to the metro station, restaurants, shopping, and sites all while feeling like part of a neighborhood. The building and the apartment were clean and well maintained. The check in and out process was very thorough and easy to follow. Matt & residents were responsive with every question we had. We spent a week here - it was nice to have a little space (vs a hotel) and the amenities to make some meals at home. I would highly recommend staying here to others and would stay here again when in Paris.

We had an enjoyable few days at this apartment! It was as shown in the photos, clean and organized. The location is amazing…lots of great cafes, restaurants, attractions and metro stops all within close walking distance! Kevin was an excellent communicator and always available when needed.

We were looking for two nights near Gare Montparnasse, as we had to catch a train from that station. Benjamin's apartment was the perfect spot. It is away from the most touristy areas and in a neighbourhood mostly frequented by locals, which appealed to us. Metro stations were easy to reach, taxis were plentiful and there were plenty of cafes and restaurants in the area. We particularly enjoyed exploring the Rue Daguerre markets and patisseries. Benjamin was quick to respond to our needs and provided a lovely place for a stay in Paris, at a very reasonable rate. Would stay there again.

Great for a short stay, the location was amazing, it felt safe, not that touristy and the Luxembourg gardens were very close - perfect for walks and breakfast! The accommodation was small, but clean and the host would always respond right away, we could even check in a few hours earlier. :) Would definitely recommend, if you are planning to walk all day and only need a place to sleep.

I loved staying here! It was so comfortable, I felt like I was visiting a friend. Julia was so fast and helpful in her communication. I am already thinking of when I can go back. Location was great for walking to the Eiffel Tower and seeing lots of other sights!

We had a fabulous time, the apartment was perfect, very much what we imagined a Parisian apartment to be. Spotlessly clean, super location, great hosts who were easy to get hold of and welcomed us on arrival. Situated close to a supermarket, patisserie, metro etc and a pleasant walk through Le Marais to the centre of the city. What more could you possibly want! It is up four flights of stairs so a bit of a workout too ;)

Great place, perfect location, walking distance to Louvre and great restaurants in the area. At the apartment we felt like a home from very beginning. Clean and comfortable, cozy sleeping room gave a us good sleep. Thank you for the experience 😊
We had an amazing time in Paris. Everything was perfect, with good windows that let us have breakfast with the sun. Thank you!

We are a family of 7 that came in for Taylor Swift … this apartment was perfect. Exactly as described. Very clean and new. The windows and surrounding buildings really made us know we are in Paris. Quick walk to Montmartre area and you are immersed in the culture. Great cafes in the area and markets on every corner if you want to eat in. The 2 queen beds were comfortable for adults and the two singles were ideal for 2 more adults. The pull out sofa bed in the living room was the most comfortable we’ve ever slept on! Coffee maker, kettle, stove, oven and full size refrigerator makes this flat perfect for longer stays. The only negative was we had to plan our showers strategically as we ran out of hot water if we tried to have more than 2 or 3 in the morning. We will definitely be back. Loved it!

We had a very typical Parisian experience which is what we were looking for. The apartment was high enough off the street that noise was not an issue and felt secure with 2 doors to get through to access the common stairway. Apartment was clean. You cannot get any closer that a 1 block walk to central metro station and bus to the main center of the city.
We had a great stay! Fantastic location in the 11th arrondissement with great restaurants nearby. The apartment is very cute and private.
Charles is a wonderful host - the definition of why Airbnb exists - cares for his home for himself and sets it up perfectly for his guests . wonderful weekend in Paris :)

We loved our stay in Paris. The flat is in a secure building and in a great location. Its easy to walk to most places and there is close access to the Metro for further destinations. Also lots of great restaurants with in blocks of the residence. Kevin was very responsive to any issue we had. Check in and out was extremely easy. I would stay here again. Thank you to Kevin and his team!
Good place to stay while in Paris. Located close to metro stations and a walk away from the Eiffel Tower.
Loved how safe it was and how clean the property was. Definitely saving this Airbnb to revisit next time! So cozy and the bathroom is so nice. This host was so responsive and kind!
Great area to stay in Paris. conveniently located. Very clean! We were greeted at check in without any wait. 1 flight of steps to the apartment. We love our stay in this modern, quiet apartment.
A lovely apartment which was absolutely perfect for our weekend in Paris. The apartment was spacious, clean, and very homely. We would definitely stay again :)
great place, nice neighborhood, conveniently close to the metro station and a bakery as well. would recommend! Peggy was very nice and communicative
We loved our stay here. Perfect space for three couples and everything you could need for an extended stay. We would happily stay here again!
It was a great stay in Paris, Anissa is very nice, the flat is also beautiful. I would definitely recommend it.

The apartment was super clean and very quiet. There is a small park just outside the window and we could hear the birds in the morning. Everything was as described. It is great for two people. Concerning the location, on foot takes about 10 minutes on food to the Alesia subway station and about 15 minutes to Denfert-Rochereau. There are plenty of rental bikes in the vicinity, which is a very convenient way to get around.

I highly recommend staying here. It is a great location with lots of restaurants, shopping, and tourist attractions within walking distance. We had a small issue with the lock (our fault) and Paul was very responsive and quick to help us out.

Happy is very friendly, kind, helpful, responsible and reliable person. I enjoyed spending time with her, her lovely cats & dog at spacious apartment. Easy to access different metro lines and very convenient too. The cleaning lady Donna is also very friendly, kind and helpful. Next time when I visit Paris, I will definitely stay at Happy’s apartment. Thank you very much, Happy, Donna, cats & dog :)

Françoise is so so nice and gave me a lot of advice about traveling in Paris. She was very considerate, and during the trip, when I suddenly had an allergic reaction, she offered me a lot of help and care. Her house is beautiful and spacious, full of vintage charm, and conveniently located. Super pleasant experience!

He was a great host. I loved the book with recommendations. It was clean, cozy, and very easy to get it. There were great instructions and directions giving. I would definitely stay here again. We had a flight cancellation and we had to leave earlier. The host was very responsive and helpful. He even offered and gave a refund, for something that wasn't his fault. Wonderful person, and Awesome host!

I found this apartment in the center of Paris by chance when I was looking for accommodation just to stay for one night on a transit. The apartment was very pretty , the bed was very comfortable. & the metro station was just a 2 min walk. I was very fortunate & happy to have found such a nice apartment by chance 🍀❤️ Next time I’ll come back for a longer stay !!!

We loved our stay in Paris at Bruno’s airbnb! As soon as you arrive and look outside the window you see the beautiful Eiffel Tower!! Bruno was very helpful and always responsive, he even left us pastries when our flight was delayed! The studio was small (as to be expected in Paris) but we still managed to move around with 2 big suitcases and lots of shopping - also made having an elevator to the 6th floor a dream! Would 100% stay here again!

We had an incredible week at Vincent’s place! We traveled with my whole family - mom, dad, sister, husband, and 18 month old - and the set up allowed us to enjoy each others company while having privacy when we wanted. We appreciated the little details that some Airbnbs lack: super comfortable beds, nice bathroom products, coffee pods, enough laundry detergent and dishwasher pods for the whole stay… it was thoughtful and saved us a few grocery trips. The neighborhood is perfect. A quiet section of a bustling area with a million things to do. We found it easy to get around with a baby and rarely even took the metro. Overall we had a fantastic time and felt that Vincent’s place was perfect for us! Highly recommended.

The welcome binder had amazing recommendations, it was a quick walk to the metro that will take you right to wherever you wanted to go. Delicious pizza next door, and a beautiful and peaceful apartment! We will definitely recommend this space for whoever is going to Paris!
Great apartment in quiet place wifi was great apartment feels very safe and short walk to metro also there’s easy check in and Helena was a perfect host
I felt right like home in this beautiful studio full of light and with a view on a garden. Unlike many places this one has a soul thanks to the nice hostess!

We really enjoyed our stay. Check-in and communication with the host was very quick and efficient. There are lots of restaurants and shops located nearby and the suite was very clean and as shown in the photos/described.
Easy check in and pretty good location that made most things we wanted to do in a walkable distance

An ideal pied à terre in the Latin quarter! Vincent was super friendly and flexible, and his place has so much character. It was a comfy and atmospheric place to start and end each day. Would definitely recommend!
We had a fabulous time at Ugo‘s place. Great apartment, fantastic location. Everything is 100%. We will visit again!
Great apartment in a convenient location in Paris. Some small imperfections throughout the space, but hosts gave helpful recommendations.

Honestly this was one of our best Airbnb experiences. Erwan’s place is very quiet even in a busy neighborhood. We loved the neighborhood and Erwan is a very gracious host and gave good recommendations! The bed is also very comfortable and the bathroom spacious. Highly recommend!
My friends and I enjoyed staying at Ana's place. It was perfect for our time in Paris, Ana was always friendly and open with us.

Great area and check in and checkout process easy. I appreciated the flexible check in time. The place was a bit more run down than it appeared in pictures but overall clean and had all amenities as advertised.

We enjoyed our stay very much. The suite was close to restaurants, shops and easily walkable to all of our favourite sites. We found it to be clean, quiet and the beds were very comfortable. Would definitely visit again on my next trip to Paris. The host was very responsive to my questions with prompt replies.
We had a really great stay at Stéphane's place! We enjoyed it very much and would surely recommend to any couple planning on visiting Paris!

Fernanda was a wonderful host and was very happy to be of help with whatever we needed however I must say that I was shocked by how small the unit was and that we had a shared toilet in the passageway. Per square metre of space I found the unit very expensive but I suppose this is to be expected with public transport and the Eiffel Tower being so close.
The view of the eiffel tower every morning and evening was the best part! Lakfir was an incredible host and was extremely responsive. We loved this apartment and it made our trip 10 times better!
Max is a friendly host and his place is extremely well located. There is a strain station just in front and that makes everything easier. The place is very nice and fits perfectly for 3 persons.
The place was lovely. Ai Tran was very responsive and helpful. I would highly recommend this place.

Thanks to kind Grandpa Olivier, I have great memories of Paris. I stayed in a cute and cozy room. He kindly explained everything I needed during my stay, and the house had a lovely scent :) The neighborhood was pleasant, and there was a park nearby which was perfect for morning walks. If I go back to Paris, I’d love to stay there again!
Great apartment it was nice and private, quiet off the street. All amenities were clean and super handy.

Léo’s apartment was a nice and cosy space with all the listed amenities. He was very informative and gave clear instructions on how to enter the apartment. The apartment was very secure and in a fantastic location with many shops and restaurants nearby and close to the subway and buses

Great location and great little appartment! Sebastian thought of every question one could have upon check-in and answered it in a video-link he would share PRIOR to checking-in. again, it's tiny but it's got everything one would need. things important to me: queen size bed, firm pillows, good water pressure, very clean and safe. Chapeau, monsieur!
Very nice stay, excellent location and very kind host, I was there for a two days business trip but will certainly comme back for a family weekend. Thank you Patrick for your responsiveness.

We are a lovely stay for two nights. Co-host Maria was very responsive and even met us at the apartment to give us the keys when our flight arrived late. The location is great—walking distance to Montmartre, 10 minutes to Gare l’Est, and right next to a metro station. The apartment was spotless and very quiet.

The house was so beautiful and clean. It felt like a luxurious boutique hotel, not just an Airbnb. There is a mart right in front of house and there are many things to enjoy, such as restaurants and bakeries, so it was convenient throughout my stay. And there is a bus stop right nearby, so it was nice to go to tourist attractions. There is the Seine River about 5 minutes away from my accommodation, so it was nice to enjoy jogging while looking at the Eiffel Tower. Axel responded so kindly and quickly, and flexibly adjusted check-in and check-out. If I come to Paris, I want to stay again.
This was the perfect location in Paris! So close to great bars and restaurants. Ines was super responsive and helpful as well, really made everything a breeze!

We really enjoyed our stay at David et Warrens apartment as a family of 5. everything what was needed was available and the check in/out was very easy having clear instructions. The location was great. It was a quite street , but close to restaurants and supermarkets and to the metro. We would definitely stay there again.

Ethel is wonderful, and we loved her space and the location. We had dinner the first night a Ju just downstairs and easily walked to the Louvre, Big Bus for hop on and hop off and more! We loved the towel warmer, espresso machine, and the comfy beds/pillows :) you’ll have a great stay!

Safe area, very close to public transportation and at a walking distance to restaurants and bars and to the Trocadero (for the best view of the Eiffel tower!). The studio is perfect for a single person or for a couple on a short visit to Paris, with a small kitchen and fridge for a quick meal. Also perfect if attending meetings at the OECD headquarters, just around the corner. I would definitely recommend it!

A lovely stay. The place was exactly as described in the listing, and very clean and well-kept. Denka was such a great host and always so responsive. Readily accommodated my request for a later check-in due to a last minute delay! Highly recommend!

The place is beautiful, clean and as shown in photos. Less than a block to the metro. Close to Boulanger & brasserie, as well as supermarket. Beautiful outlook over courtyard. Peaceful neighbourhood away from the chaos and noise of the city. An ideal location to stay in this beautiful city.
The apartment was nice and clean, and Chloe was very welcoming. There was a problem with the lock, but if this will be changed - everything else was perfect.

Cindy was an amazing host! She was very responsive before and during our stay and made sure we felt right at home. I loved the location of this air bnb and was completely charmed by the neighbourhood. Would defs recommend the area to any friend going to Paris.

For those who love Montmartre, this is an excellent place to stay. It is close to a good bakery just around the corner and only a 10-minute walk to the Super U supermarket where you can get everything you need. This apartment is in district 18, which some online sources advise against, but my experience was positive. As it was my first visit to Paris, I was initially concerned after booking it, but it turned out to be quite fine. The apartment is within a few minutes' walk to the metro and 15 minutes to the Basilica. Overall, the apartment is clean, with all the amenities as described, and communication was excellent with great flexibility. Vincent greeted us warmly and provided helpful instructions, allowing us to check in early, which was greatly appreciated. Overall, I enjoyed my stay here and I would love to come back.
Kitchen small, not well equiped. Bad shower not useful Floors badly uneven Pillows were missing / old 5 story walk-up, steps were uneven

Lovely apartment with a great host. Looks just like the photos and everything is in great shape. The bed could be more comfortable, perhaps a change of mattress is in order? But other than that, the stay was absolutely perfect. Great location and very responsive host! Reccomend!

We visited to attend Roland Garros. The apartment was well equipped and close to public transport links, supermarket and easy to get into key locations in Paris. Claire was an attentive host and accommodated all requests.
Peaceful Stay And host was responsive - Recommendation to add Either A/C or cooler on the top floor. It’s hot in the morning

We loved staying in the beautiful Airbnb. It is on a quiet brick lined street that is close to transportation and many restaurants. Our host was helpful explaining the neighborhood and alerting us to which metro line would be closed on Saturday.
The host is very friendly and welcoming! The place is cozy and feels right at home. Would definitely recommend this place

We loved staying at Erwan’s flat! It was spacious and comfortable in a great location. Walking distance to lots of great coffee and food options as well as public transit. Erwan was a super responsive and welcoming host with lots of recommendations for the neighborhood!

Really nice loft in a great location. The area is peaceful and within walkable distance to many Paris attractions. The flat is pretty small but has more than enough space for 2 people for a few days. It is very efficiently designed and pretty charming. Bear in mind it is on the 6th floor. We didn’t mind a bit of exercise after indulging in the local cuisine, but it might be difficult for some people.
Small but nicely arranged and very clean studio with all modern amenities you need. Responsive guest. Very quiet and peaceful area but good location to visit Paris from.
we had a really comfortable stay. very clean apartment. very nice staff. ready to assist.

Apartment was very nice and 5 of us adults had plenty of space. The check-in instructions were very clear. It was nice to find apartment in Paris with elevator. There were restaurants nearby, Franprix only 3 minutes away and subway 4 minutes. There was one full bathroom with sink, toilet and bathtub. Then one room with just toilet. Then two rooms with just a shower. Also one bedroom had a sink.
Great apartment, in the heart of an eclectic part of Paris and close to the Metro. Three really good sized bedrooms and lots of space to hang out.
The location is great! Nathalie was easy to talk to and we had no problems checking in or out! Thanks Nathalie for sharing your place!
Fantastic location on a fairly quiet block but just a half block from cafes. The bedrooms are at the back with no street noise and very comfortable beds.

It was a good experience living in this apartment. Not far away from the attractions in Paris. There were many possibilities for public transport to easily get to main places in the city. The location was perfect and it was easy to communicate with the host. Would book it again for our trip to Paris next time

The apartment was spacious, well located, clean and surprisingly quiet given it is in a main road. Easy access to the Metro, supermarket and plenty of restaurants. We travelled as three couples and we all found the king size beds very comfortable.
While one of the rooms had a very powerful mold smell, everything else was ok. I was satisfied by my two day stay here.
Sophies apartment was perfect for our family of 4. It had everything we needed for our short stay. It is located in an ideal central location. Sophie was a pleasant host. Thankyou

The neighborhood is very quiet and close to many cafes, restaurants, the metro and more. The apartment was large enough to comfortably accommodate our family of 4. The couch is very wide and soft and the kids had no complaints.

We had a great stay at Bruno’s lovely airy apartment. It’s spacious and comfortable.The location is good, close to the metro and bus services. Lots of places to eat and drink in nearby streets. Bruno was very accommodating and friendly.
The room is spacious and clean, very convenient to the local metro station and nearby restaurants/bakeries. Only down side was that it can get very noisy during the morning due to nearby school.
Great stay. Very friendly and accommodating host. Easy to communicate. Made our stay with our 1-year-old baby super easy! Flat had everything for a baby. Location is ideal. Highly recommend it!
Francois has gone overboard with his hospitality. He was very eager to help and took his time to explain everything. Would 100% book with him again.

Fantastic stay! It had everything we needed for a few days and was comfortable for 2 people! The neighborhood is well connected to transportation and walking with lots of cute cafes, bars & restaurants. We loved coming back here after visiting all the busier areas of Paris, def a more chill local area. Highly recommend and would def stay again!

Venus is an excellent and very reaponsive host!! We made a very last minute reservation and Venus responded almost immediately. We were able to check in immediately that afternoon. The studio was complete as listed and extremely cozy. Everything was clean and tidy when we checked in. Instructions were very clear. Venus even made the extra effort of dropping by to help us with the sofabed, explaining how things work, recommending nearby food places etc. Venus made us feel v comfortable welcomed and we had a v good stay. Location wise, it is a very short walk to Ecole Militaire metro station and perhaps a 10min walk to Effiel Tower. Good value and highly recommended!! PS. Do try to check out nearby Kozy Bosquet and Bagelstein for your food options.
Very nice apartment, conveniently located near Gare du Nord and a metro station. Supermarkets nearby. Good amenities. Would definitely stay here again

I had a wonderful time exploring France and the cosy flat proved a great hub to rest after long days. Not as a complaint but more of a suggestion the kitchen could do with some cereal bowls, a chef knife and a chopping board to make it perfectly usable. Many thanks may use again the next time I am in Paris
We had such a great trip to Paris, this place is in a perfect spot, lots of places to eat and close to the metro. Also had an awesome rooftop deck as advertised!
We loved our stay! The flat was beautifully appointed, the view was drop dead gorgeous, and our hosts were wonderfully responsive. We would recommend it highly and hope to stay there again.

Perfect location for walking distance of central sites. Kathleen’s home has a special touch of “Paris”, and her gorgeous pets made our stay so special. Easy to access with everything you need for your stay. Couldn’t recommend Kathleen’s more!
The location of the apartment is great each access to shopping and the metro. Had some complications with the wi fi but host was very responsive.
Very clean apartment with a location that is only a metro ride away from many museums and amazing restaurants. Would definitely stay here again!
We had a great time at Emmanuel’s apartment in Paris! It was spacious and in a great location for the metro. It was clean and had a terrific shower. We would definitely stay here again!!

Our family enjoyed our stay - this is a unique apartment in a great location near many restaurants, patisseries and shopping. Our kids thought the downstairs area of the apartment was very cool! Patrick and Nathalie were great hosts - very communicative and helpful with a lot of great information. We had a wonderful, memorable visit.

We stayed at Alexis's lovely home with our 2 1/2 year old. The apartment was as described - clean and welcoming. The brilliant neighbourhood was so easy to get to from the Gare du Nord. We enjoyed lots of the independent shops, including the wonderful toyshop.
Beautiful apartment with all necessary amenities. The location was good for exploring the local neighborhood, and metro stops were near to easily get to other parts of Paris.
This apartment was perfect for getting in and out of the city with no problem. It was cozy, but comfortable and had everything we needed!
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment- it was in the perfect location- we were able to walk to everything we wanted to see!
Pauline & Julien’s place is wonderful. Very convenient location, quiet neighborhood. It’s very cosy and spacious. Julien is very responsive and helpful. Highly recommended.
Real authentic french apartment. Felt really spacious yet cosy. Lots of character, really happy with our choice!
A great apartment in a lovely neighbourhood. Very close to the Metro, very clean and in a quiet area.

Chloe’s apartment was very conveniently located. Close to a metro stop that we used daily. There are quite a few restaurants close by and a great patisserie on the corner. We had everything we needed while we were there. The street can be a little loud at night so if you’re sensitive to that keep it in mind. We slept okay though since we were exhausted daily. Overall a great stay.

My husband and I spent two nights at John’s place and had a great time. He was very accommodating when we arrived much later than expected, which we greatly appreciated. We walked everywhere - the Louvre, Notre Dame, etc - long walks but if you don’t mind walking you can get around on foot just fine. There were lots of nearby restaurants as well.
Great neighborhood and great host. The balcony space is very nice although it does get noisy with the scooters going by.

Great location! Metro and great restaurants right around corner. Can comfortably fit four people. Does require you to climb steep steps to access loft. Water temp in shower needs to be managed but understandable for Europe.

Overall great stay! Easy/flexible check-in where we were greeted in person & great location in the Marais close to the Seine. Bright with big windows, clean, and has all the appliances needed. Only notes—can hear upstairs neighbours puttering around & pull out couch is noisy and not the most comfortable.

The studio has an excellent location however if you are planning to stay more than 2 nights or planning to cook, I don't recommend it. The kitchen doesn't have supplies.
