There was a few things that were broken like the bar stool and a shelf in the bedroom. You could smell the sewer anytime you used the water (bathroom/shower). Overall, good location next to the Eiffel and restaurants!

The host has been very helpful, responsive, understandable, supportive and respectful of all our requests and inquiries. The apartment is more than adequate for my family of nine. The area has a lot of nice restaurants to pick from. We couldn’t ask for a better weather. Our experience is vet memorable and plan to rerun in the future. I highly recommend this place. Thank you so much for everything!!!!
We had a fantastic stay. The communication was great, perfect location and we were well accommodated for with our 7 month old baby. I would certainly stay here again.
beautiful apartment in a quiet location, it's close to public transportation and variety of different resturants.

This is a beautifully appointed apartment. It really was gorgeous, as well as spacious and practical. The host was always responsive and accommodating. It really was a lovely stay. It has a very central location but is in a busy, commercial area — not nestled among charming streets. We knew this going in and didn’t mind for this short trip. I would consider it perfect other than the location and the fact that the living room doesn’t have windows.

We loved our stay at this cute apartment! The location is excellent-in the heart of the Marais yet a close walk to Notre Dame, with easy metro access (St Paul) and bus routes which are fun for sightseeing. The apartment is delightful-a typical Parisian pied a terre Daphne is a thoughtful host and lovely person. Communication was excellent. We felt very at home and would definitely stay again on a return trip to Paris. Merci Daphne!

Beverly's place was a great stay! I had a little trouble getting into the place, getting the door open, but Beverly was incredibly responsive and proactive in helping me. After that, I had no trouble. The stairs are quite narrow and steep, so if you have large suitcases, it may be a bit more challenging to get them up. Although, the area is great. It's close distance to metro stops and easily walkable to other areas of Paris, but still quiet at night. As a solo, female traveler I felt completely safe, which is really important to me. The apartment was small, but perfect for one person and exactly as pictured/described. Everything was very clean and put together. I would definitely recommend Beverly's place.

We loved our stay in this cosy apartment. Perfect location and all we needed for 2 nights in Paris. Beautiful area and walkable to so many great food and drink spots etc. The only comment would be the apartment felt a little tired and in need of an update, and the cleanliness wasn’t amazing. Other than that, would highly recommend and stay again!

Small accommodation but very well organized and clean. Exactly as described. The location is very good. Excellent bistro on the corner of the street!! I am grateful to the owner for making flexible my check-in and check-out times.
Our stay was great. beautiful flat and great location. very friendly and responsive hosts. Thanks for everything definitely staying again on my next trip to Paris.
This place was perfect for the 2 of us. It was walkable near 2 metro stations and had a small kitchen we could use also. Shower is very small if you are used to an American shower but it works great.
Beautiful apartment in a fantastic location, very quiet but very close to a buzzing choice of bars, restaurants and bakeries.

We stayed for a long weekend, and it was perfect! Enough space for 4 people, a lot of bakeries and restaurants close by. Not too far away from Paris center, close to metro and city bikes right outside👐🏼

I was disappointed in the offerings it didn't match the description of a separate bedroom. When the bed was folded out it occupied nearly the entrie living space and needed to be climbed over to access any of the other amenities. As well; the équiped kitchen, did not have a stove or hot plate to cook with.

a beautifully unique apartment. Great location for bagpackers and on-the-go travellers who need a central location to stay while hitting the highlights of Paris. The host,Sebastian, is also proactive in preparing videos and how-to guides on getting into the apartment and a small guide on the surrounding and usage of applicance in the home.

Our recent stay in Paris was glorious. I have always stayed in a hotel in Le Marais but decided to try this magnificent Airbnb. It was perfectly situated and allowed my husband and me the extra space and ability to deal with our rather strange sleep habits….especially for Paris. I was able to get up every morning at 5 am , make some wonderful coffee and enjoy just being the magnificent setting. At 6:30 I headed out for long walks which always included a stop at a wonderful boulangerie. Walking in le Marais before the buzz begins is always a delight. We started out day early…..but often settled back to our apartment by 8 pm…..to relax, unwind and get ready for our next full day! I would highly recommend this location and this particular Airbnb to anyone that feels sometimes a bit confined in a hotel setting. Ironically my biggest concern was not having a hotel concierge to advise me…..but somehow I figured it out!

Thanks to Damien’s apartment I was at the perfect location to spend a few great days in Paris. Metro stations are really close by and you can explore montmartre by foot. It was small but cozy and clean and Damien gave me really good instructions so the check in was quite easy. I would come again - Thank you!

Amazing location! Very easy to take the metro from this place. We were also able to walk to places like the Louvre. The place was perfect for 2 people. I appreciate how clean it was. Couldn’t have asked for more.

We had a lovely stay at Harry’s place. The apartment was well appointed with all the things you can need in the kitchen. Traveling from the US it took us some time to get adjusted to time zone so I appreciated the black out curtains in the bedroom. Great location overall in La Marais close to shops, restaurants and several metro lines. We enjoyed our time as everything was walkable from the apartment. I would definitely stay here again.

Our family of 5 enjoyed our one week stay at Karine’s place. There was plenty of room to hang out and relax after busy days visiting the sites around Paris. It was nice to come home to a peaceful space. The courtyard/ walkway was lovely. Karine was very helpful and friendly. Her directions for getting there and into the house were easy to follow. The metro was very convenient and easy to use. We enjoyed several wonderful local restaurants, cafes, and boulangeries. We definitely would recommend Karine’s place!
The appartment is located in a good and vibrant neighborhood. Lots of cool places to explore, boutiques as well as food establishments. My daughters and I had great time in David’s apartment.

Absolutely loved staying here for a week. So accessible by walking or the metro but not too loud and busy. Great restaurant options in the area and the space was perfect for what we needed. Highly recommend!
Loved our stay at Anne and Jean-Luc's. Their place was warm and inviting and a great location for exploring Paris. We loved the markets, bakery and cafe at the end of the block as well.

While I did not have the chance to meet Ben in person, he was attentive and communicative. He made sure I had everything I needed to get into the apartment and checked in with me during the stay. The apartment is good for a budget-friendly, short stay. The amenities are basic but comfortable, and everything went smoothly. Thanks Ben!

Host Bertrand was very friendly and accommodated my family very well. It was a last minute booking and one of the best place I’ve stay in. Location was also great, close to attractions and food places. I will recommend this place to any one travelling to Paris! Thank you Bertrand!
the location was perfect, there i metro 2-3 minutes from house, there are many groceries and nice cafe-restaurants nearby. the house was very clean, there is everything what you need at home
The stay was perfect! We enjoyed it a lot. Emarald was super responsive and helpful.
Excellent Host!! It was so nice to see meet such an incredible host. Olivier was extremely attentive and helpful. 100% will stay with him the next time in Paris :)

Lovely appartement in a great location. Bright, with nice open views on a courtyard with trees. Nice design with modern furniture. Appreciated the small touches like a universal plug converter next to the bed, or an electrical cord extender connected to the iron. Host proactively checked that I was able to enter, which was easy (elevator and key box with code) Highly recommended. PS: I had seen some negative review mentioning that it was a room inside someone else’s apartment. This is not the case. This is your own studio apartment.

really wonderful stay here！everything is perfect！the Pierre’s family are so kind，the breakfast so considerate, the house so nice and clean, also so easy transportation! I definely would like to come back again if having chance in the future!

This is an incredibly unique apartment in a perfect location. Guillaume is a wonderful host - attentive and responsive. We definitely want to come back! There's not much privacy for the bathroom, so be aware if traveling with friends.

We had a great stay—everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect, and check-in was smooth. The only small issues were that the hot water ran out quickly and we would’ve appreciated a few more towels, but neither was a big deal. Overall, we loved our time here and would absolutely stay again!

The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos, felt very cosy and was a great base after a day out. There is a metro nearby and it's a nice area to take a stroll by the canal. The host was friendly and even left us a sweet little gift. All the instructions were clear so getting in was easy, we also really appreciated the suggestions for nearby restaurants! The only issues were less responsiveness at first and water slightly leaking on the floor during showering, but this could be managed with a towel and paled in comparison to all the good things :)

Amazing place to stay in Paris Quite neighborhood with many restaurants and cafe, close to Eiffel tour (15-20 minutes walk) The place is spotless, everything is new and looks exactly as on the pictures. Elena is great host, agreed to store our luggage and suggested help
We had a wonderful stay at Anna’s place. It’s great located, quiet place for good sleep, clean and nice.

Amazing location and a truly unique house, built in the best spirit of Le Corbusier. Everything was well organized — clear instructions, a bright and cozy room, and spotless cleanliness. I would definitely recommend staying here!

The Apartment was first class, very spacious and in a very safe area of Paris, it was walking distance to the Eiffel Tower...great traditional Parisian bistros all close by, we will definitely use this apartment again, thank you Kevin and the team.
had issues with water heating near midnight and could not take a shower for one night, but was refunded appropriately for the inconvenience.
We had a lovely time at Mariana's. The apartment was as described, the communication was fast and easy, and the location was perfect. We hope to be back one day.
Great location. Fourth floor apartment with malfunctioning elevator was the issue. The listing did indicate “elevator out of service” but it didn’t mention that the property was on the fourth floor.

The apartment was very private, well maintained and in a very secure location, especially for women travelers. Loved the location in Les Marais; very convenient for walking and to access other forms of city transportation.
Easy access to transit, lots of restaurants and shops close by, clean and comfortable. Only complaint would be the walls are very thin and there is lots of noise from street and neighbourhood.

Sylvie's apartment surpassed all our expectations - probably the best AirBnb we have stayed in! We stayed as a family of four with twin 12 year olds. The photos don't do justice to how beautiful the apartment is, in a classic Parisian style. The neighbourhood is fantastic with lots of amazing bars, restaurants, patisseries and shops. The beds were comfortable and the bathroom was spacious with two sinks and a decent shower. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend the apartment to anyone visiting Paris.
Incredible stay with Quentin: Location, convenience, clean and safe apartment, everything was 10/10. We will be back!!
Beautiful home close to lots of wonderful cafes and just a short trip to all the shops and sights we wanted to visit while there. Very clean and comfortable space.

While it was hard to locate at first, (just be sure to tell the taxi that it is Poissoniere with an E….not Poissoniern-) once there it was an ideal location and close to shops, sights and restaurants. Julien was responsive to our questions.

Such a nice place! The owner responds to messages and any needs in a timely manner. The bathroom and the whole apartment is very tidy and organized. Perfect site, different restaurants and shopping mall around the area, walking distance. Highly recommended for those who travel to Paris!

The flat was perfect! It has a lift, lovely shower space with rounded windows, clean floor and furniture and the stunning view!!!! And Corto was also sooo kind. I would definitely recommen and stay again soon at next visit to Paris. Merci :)

Perfect stay! Lorraine was easy to communicate with and picking up the keys was no problem. The apartment is beautifully located in the 11th arrondissement which is a lovely area and has very easy access to public transport to explore other parts of Paris. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Nice and clean apartment in a quiet and safe place close to the Eiffel Tower. 5 minutes walk from Metro and RER. Very easy and fast communication with the hostess. We can warmly recommend this place for a stay in Paris.

Very nice comfortable apartment in a great location. You are right in the centre of Le Marais a short walk to many attractions. The bedroom is wonderfully quiet. This is traditional Airbnb - it is the hosts home and you are surrounded by their personal things. The host was very kind and friendly. I would stay there again .

We loved our stay here,fantastic transportation on bus lines ( highly recommend as you see Paris on the way to your destination)and metro all a block or two away. The neighbourhood has wonderful boulangeries,pâtisseries ,cheese store,fish monger,butchers,and a street market on Tuesday ,all outside the front door!I cooked dinner everynight ,the kitchen is very well equipped . Laurent is a kind,thoughtful host,and made sure we were settled into the apartment. The apartment is chic and light filled,you can see the Eiffel Tower sparkle on the hour from the living room window! It is quiet for peaceful comfortable sleeps.All in all …Perfect! Thank you Laurent💗
Beautiful and Cosy space and an excellent base from which to explore the city. I would recommend highly :)
Perfect location, very kind and responsive host. Don't worry about any noise, despite a busy location it was very comfortable and quite to sleep.

after the first night I send Lionel a message that I believe he needs to stay himself a night and see if he likes the bed and the shower that was broke. the sofa sleeper is terrible to lay on. it broke my back. it's super hard and the iron structure popped through the mattress I weight 85kg. the shower head was dangling on the side and the temperature switched for out of nowhere to extremely hot. it's very small and too cosy, I was cheaper out with a hotelroom and a bed then in this airbnb. Lionel responded that the sleep sofa was very expensive and the shower was fixed. so he found my complaint not correct. I added pictures and I don't think the reviews are correct either.

Victoria’s apartment is lovely and in the perfect location to stay for a few nights in Paris, we really enjoyed our time. Check in is easy and the apartment was clean and comfortable.highly recommend!

Two of my friends and I stayed here for a Parisian girl’s trip. We loved the apartment. It was styled beautifully and Alexis and Elodie made us feel welcome upon arrival with a bottle of champagne and homemade Madeleines. The views from our rooms were stunning - the beautiful Butte Chaumont park on one side and the Sacre Coeur on the other. We enjoyed having breakfast each morning on the terrace and walking in the park. We would absolutely recommend this place for anyone who wants more space and wonderful views in Paris! The hosts were also very responsive and easy going.
This place was chic, but comfortable. Looked just like the photos. The host was responsive and helpful. We’ll stay here again next time we’re in Paris!

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as described and looked just like the pictures. The hosts were incredibly accommodating, allowing us to check in at a time that suited us, which we greatly appreciated. The location was perfect, and the amenities provided made our stay comfortable and enjoyable. Highly recommend!

A real oasis in the heart of Paris. Location is amazing, walkable to many places and only a short distance to the metro. Lots of cafes, restaurants and supermarket very close by. The apartment itself is spacious, clean, comfortable and has everything needed for a family vacation. Nathalie was very communicative, helpful and available before and throughout our stay. We highly recommend this Airbnb and definitely hope to visit again sometime.

Ygal’s space was great for our 4 day stay with my family. The view was spectacular, the garden overview and the Eiffel Tower as well. The space invited lots of sunlight with large windows, furniture matched the whole vibe of the place so well, and the elevator was a huge plus. The beds were comfortable, showers were clean and spacious, and the living room was very spacious and home-y. It’s very close to lots of main attractions, great to take walks as the neighborhood is safe, and restaurants and Boulanger everywhere as well. I would definitely recommend this place to others.

Extremely Beautiful Place!! The beds were very comfortable!! Everything we could need was provided. The instructions to enter and operate appliances were given and easy to follow. Great communication! I wish we had more time to stay there. Definitely a 5 star place to stay!!!
Clemence was a great host, very responsive and kind. Her apartment is quite nice and very organised. Would definitely stay again
Excellent welcome, the apartment is a gem. Interesting quartier. Cafe immediately downstairs is somewhat noisy, though not intolerably so, and closes late.
Very nice location with a nice rooftop view and walking distance to most tourist spots. The communication with Victoria was great and we really enjoyed our stay at her place!

We had a wonderful stay chez Monique and Jean-Noël. They were absolutely lovely hosts, very helpful and proactive, caring, and great to chat to. Nothing was too much trouble and they were easy to share a space with. The room was also very comfortable, especially the bed. Highly recommend this stay!

We were very satisfied with our stay in the apartment, which had good standards and allowed us to cook our own meals. It was great to have both a dishwasher and a washing machine, which made everyday life easier. Bed linen and towels were included, and it felt welcoming to have the beds already made upon our arrival. The apartment is well located, within walking distance of bakeries, restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacies, and several of the city's famous attractions. The area is calm, safe, and quiet during the nights. The host was very helpful and quick to respond to all our questions. An additional bonus was that the host arranged a private driver who was very friendly and drove us safely to and from the airport. We warmly recommend this apartment and would gladly return.

The apartment is beautiful and the service is great! The Lander is very communicative and helpful! The furnishings in the apartment were the comforts of home. We were grateful to call this our home away from home in Paris!

Lisa's apartment was absolutely perfect for our trip. It is exactly as described and in a fantastic location, close to everything. Everything is well maintained. Lisa sent us great reccommendations well in advance of our trip, and made it easy for us to plan our trip. She even provided 2 pack & plays for our toddlers to sleep in. We highly recommend this apartment!

My friends and I loved Paula’s apartment! She was very friendly and responsive and we felt right at home. It was clean and comfortable. The location was central and easy to get around. I highly recommend Paula’s place!
Nice location easy to find a lot to do in the neighborhood. Calm and pleasant stay Feel like home Beautiful decoration
We had a great weekend at Ines place. Everything was perfect! We met her shortly and she was so nice. The location is great we could walk everywhere and there are nice cafes and restaurants around.

Catherine was super-duper responsive. Responses are normally a few hours and she was normally just a few minutes. She is definitely five star on her responsiveness and attention to detail. I can’t say enough about how detailed and responsive she is. The place was a little smaller than I expected, but it was totally functional and well located. You should be ready for 120 steps up and steps down, so it became a great workout by the time the week ended. Overall, it was a five star experience.
What a great spot, close to everything but just off the main streets so very quiet. Nice and bright, simply decorated, everything was even better than I'd expected.
Very nice and quiet location. Laure was very accommodating and friendly. We recommend this place without hesitation !
Alexandre was an extremely gracious and accommodating host. His home is lovely and in a really convenient location - I loved my time there!
The accommodation was a bit hard to find at the beginning. However, the place was very nice, spacious and well located. It was overall a pleasant experience.

Mandana’s place was perfect for our week-long stay in Paris! She was proactive with communication, was accommodating to our arrival/departure times, and was overall very communicative. We loved the ease of the space; it felt just like home. The 6 floors were worth it! Thank you! Would love to stay again.

This was a lovely and comfortable place and you can't beat the fantastic location. We walked to just about everything. There are also lots of shops and restaurants - including a grocery store - within a five-minute walk. There were three of us (husband, teenage daughter, and myself) and we had sufficient room for a 6 night stay. Mary was in great contact and check in and check out were incredibly easy. There are a LOT of stairs to get up to the apartment, but this is very clear in the description, so no surprises. Overall, we had a great stay and would recommend!

The location was excellent!!! Corto was very friendly, answered all of our questions. Felt at home in this great space. Cozy, and comfy. Was exactly what we needed to enjoy our time in Paris. Looking forward to staying there again on our next trip. Thank you Corto
We loved this apartment!! Gorgeous, clean, wonderful location!! Vincent was always helpful with any questions and anticipated our needs!! Will stay again when we return to Paris.

The property was beautiful and modern with a Parisian charm. Initially I was worried it wouldn’t be comfortable for 4 adult women but we all had enough space and freedom and felt right at home. Amenities such as a nespresso machine, iron and a vacuum was provided and when asked we were also provided fresh towels mid stay. However, the only issue we encountered was with the door and the handle, it was very hard to open and close, but when we got assistance from one of the locals we figured it out. Thank you Anthony for this lovely stay, hoping you are available to host us again.
Philippe was extremely helpful, responsive and kind. His place was very charming and clean. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay there. Highly recommended!

Chachou's place is located idlely. Very easy to reached and almost walkable to the signature attractions in Paris. Added point is eiffel tower is just a short walk about 15minutes. The amenities and furniture is as described. Moreover, Patrick is a very responsive and helpful host. He even help us to booked the taxi to airport, quick reply when we have encounter any problems.

The apartment was in a perfect location. We love Le Marais and it was so convenient to walk almost anywhere. Public transit to many places was also convenient. The apartment itself was perfect for our needs. The only negative, is if you need to sleep with windows open, it may be noisy outside (we had cool nights, so could close them up). Ethel was more than responsive and she made staying at her place simple and stress free!

We loved our stay! It was an absolutely amazing and safe location. We are so happy with it! It is a 10 minute walk from amazing effiel tower views and a very safe stay for young or old! The apartment is large and has a very comfortable beds and a washer. Our new destination apartment in Paris!
Anissa is wonderful and helpful. It's great to be near 2 metro lines (8 & 10) . Spacious living room and bedroom.
Great apartment, convenient location. The host is always in touch and helps. Easy check-in and check-out. Thank you for our great week in Paris !
Thank you, Didier for a lovely stay at your appartement! We enjoyed your place a lot with our two kids and can recommend it to everybody intending to spend some time in Paris.
What a great location, next to delicious bakeries, two metro stops, and in a desirable and safe part of Paris. We plan to stay here again. Highly recommend!

Eléonore, we truly appreciated all the thoughtful touches and how welcoming you were throughout our stay. It was the perfect home base for exploring the city and made our trip even more special. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend your place to anyone visiting Paris. Merci beaucoup!
Fouad’s place was great for our one night in Paris and was exactly as described. Clean and in a convenient location with lots of good cafes and bars nearby.

We enjoyed our stay at Benoit's so much that we were sad to leave! The apartment was exactly as described, and the view even better than expected, and Benoit was always so helpful and responsive. We loved everything about our stay, and will treasure the memories made there forever!

We loved our stay at Tiphaine’s. The flat was very comfortable and the small elevator helpful for the luggage. Tiphaine was an excellent host and communicator. The location is excellent: incredible neighborhood, close to restaurants, shops, the Seine, and famous sites. You can walk to everything. Wonderful all around!

This is the second time we have stayed at Ax’s home. We love it. It was me and my wife, our two young kids, and my parents. There was enough room for everyone to be comfortable. Our boys love playing with Ax’s kids’ toys. The neighborhood is lovely, extremely walkable, very close to the train, and quiet at night. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.
Anitha communicated with us through the entire time from checking in to check out. An excellent hostess I highly recommend her place. Thank you I Anitha for the wine 🍷

Perfect weeklong stay in Marion’s apartment with my nieces. Loved the location and the local vibes of the area. Adored the aesthetic of the apartment and it made me wake up everyday happy. Thank you Marion for opening your home to us. Both my nieces and I had a fabulous time in Paris.

We stayed at Patrick and Nathalie's apartment this spring. It was the perfect home base for our first trip to Paris and is an incredible find. Not only is Patrick extremely responsive, but his recommendations and suggestions made our stay that much more memorable. The apartment is comfortable and perfectly situated to restaurants, public transit and a delightful Parisian neighborhood. 5 stars for both the apartment and owners. Merci for a wonderful stay in Paris!

David’s place is perfect for a trip to Paris! Location is super walkable and safe, close to metro stations that make it easy to get around the city. Also has shops and restaurants close by for convenience!
The place is amazing. Both to get into from the airport and around the city. The street it is on is amazing.

A great place to stay with kids - even though it is on the ground floor, the area is so calm and not at all noisy at night. Pascal sent us lots of great recommendations and was super responsive. A wonderful location for a city trip with a family of four!
We had a fabulous time in Paris and Didier parisian apartment was the perfect base for our trip! Thank you so much!

Great place and perfect location. host is highly responsive through the stay. we had a water leak issue and they had a handyman come the next day. main bedroom wall has water damage (probably needs to be repaired and painted). otherwise a great stay and experience!
Excellent flat to stay with kids, the environment was extremely welcoming for our daughter. She had an awesome time!
Pierre was a great, kind host. The house’s place is great, right across the metro and bus station. There are lovely restaurants and bakeries nearby. Definitely recommend!!

Very friendly hosts who make you feel welcome right away, you can have nice chats and privacy at the same time, we absolutely recommend :-) Laurence responded very quick and the location is great for a big city like Paris, feels safe and has a nice boulevard with bars & restaurants close by.
spartan and well-placed. perfect for crashing after a long day in the city.

Perfect small apartment for a short stay in Paris. The house was very clean, and well equipped. The location is excellent and well connected with the city and surrounding areas with buses and the metro. The host was very friendly and responsive. Definitely recommend it.
Amazing location!!!!! It’s in a really central part of Le Marais but the apartment itself is quiet & peaceful. Highly recommend

We had a great time in Giovanni’s lovely studio. Super close to the city centre, but in a nice and calm area. Giovanni was super nice and communicated clearly. Already looking forward to come back some day!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Marais! It was in a great location with many places to eat nearby. The apartment was beautiful and comfortable. Tiphaine met us at check-in and left us some lovely pastries. We would definitely return for another stay in Tiphaine’s apartment!

Our most favorite Airbnb we’ve stayed in! Sebastian was a lovely host. His instructions to get in were very very helpful, he has a YouTube video showing you how to get in. The apartment itself was amazing so peaceful and quiet. It was wonderfully located next to wonderful restaurants, sight seeing and the metro. It was a perfect place to spend our honeymoon! Definitely will be back!

Nicely appointed apartment in a great area of Paris, easy to get to major points of interest with a quick train ride or a 20min walk. The pictures match the accommodations and all the necessary amenities are available. Great views of the neighborhood out of the many windows. The only drawback is the stairs, be prepared for a hike up to the 3rd floor, might not be good for those with mobility limitations. Overall though a comfortable place and a positive experience. Thanks!

This is simply the most stunning, beautiful, comfortable and peaceful apartment in Paris, with so many personal touches and the warmest welcome. Huge thanks to Anne for sharing such a truly special place. We loved finding out about the family history and the travel souvenirs that give this home a precious soul. Perfect location for people who love the Latin Quarter but away from the busiest parts. We will try to come back with our daughters as our visit was too short.

In many ways, this apartment in the middle of Saint-Germain Street was wonderful. It was quiet, even though it was on a street, and it was comfortable like home. Pierre and all his family were welcoming and helped me while I stayed. If I visit Paris again, I’d love to stay this apartment.

We loved the location, right in the middle of St. Germain. One of the hosts helped us a lot because as Americans we were unfamiliar with some of the appliances. We would have liked a folder of helpful notes.

Fantastic accommodation in a vibrant location. Great local restaurants and cafes. It is walking distance from great areas and also has great Metro links. It really gives you the full Parisian experience! Amazing host immediate responses to all queries. Would definitely book again.
I booked this apartment for the second time. Everything is great as before.👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
Great stay in my favourite part of the city. Felt right at home, great deal for the price paid. Would love to return
We had a great stay and the host was very responsive to questions and our needs. We can highly recommend this great location with access to everything that Paris has to offer.

The apartment is really nice as well as the whole building. Also the location is really convenient, close by a lot of different restaurant/ breakfast places and well connected as well. We had a small issue with hot water immediately fixed by the owner. I would improve apartment’s cleanliness for a better experience for the guests.
Lovely place at a lively yet non-touristy area of Paris. Easy to reach from the centre and from the CDG airport. Highly recommended.
In a perfect location and close to the metro. The beds are really comfortable. It was a true Parisian experience. I would definitely stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay and the location was perfect for us as a family. Our son, of 7 and 6 months 6-month-old dog, enjoyed the Park 5 minutes away. My husband and I enjoyed as well coming back to space that reminds us of our own home. I would recommend this amazing accommodation. Looking forward to making the return.
Victorine's place has been perfect for our stay. Such a lovely home on a gorgeous little street in a great neighbourhood. Thank you so much for making it available to us!
Amazing place! Metro and train a walking distance. The store downstairs. The tower close, same the river. The place felt safe and had everything we needed

Great location — central but quiet. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Quentin was very helpful and let us leave our bags after check-out. Very flexible and kind. We recommend this place!

Hanounou's place was fantastic, walking distance to the metro station with direct links to the city centre! The home is also close by to various bakeries and restaurants too. The room was exactly like the pictures and has all the essentials you need. Would recommend to any solo travellers!

I really enjoyed my stay at Suzie's place. The apartment is beautiful and full of charm. The room looks exactly like the photos, and the neighborhood is quiet and secure. It's also very close to Passy metro station, which is super convenient. I’ll definitely book the same place again when I return to Paris.

Michael is a very hospitable host, he's always responsive to any inquiry. The flat is in a very nice location, nearby many public transportations. The surrounding area has all the necessities (Supermarket, pharmacy, boulangerie...) The flat is cozy and clean.

Beautiful apt. V spacious. Very secure. Easy to find and access. We booked about 10 mins before we arrived but he'd already sent the cleaners to prepare it and they were v friendly and did a lovely job. Two big bedrooms with a sofa bed if needed. Big dining living area. All excellent.
Jana's place was really nice, with a great location. It looked just like the pictures, would recommend for a short stay in Paris!

It’s a pleasant experience, Kathleen shows warmly host, makes me feel like home. I leave early in the morning and back at night, the room is clean and quiet, which is very nice for me. kitty Nero comes to see me everyday when I come back, she is so cute. Highly recommend ❤️
We loved this Airbnb!! Really lovely apartment in a trendy area and really well connected to the centre. Couldn’t fault it!
Loved everything about this place! Perfect location, host was great and responsive, bed was comfortable.

nice apartment, great location. close to the metro and a supermarket. bathroom - the toilet is a bit too close to the sink , and the shower head is hung too low, but there is always hot water. host was very responsive at first, but when we had an issue that required action, it was poorly handled.

Nestor's listing is exactly as described. It is a comfortable apartment that is centrally located to many of the major attractions. It was enjoyable to look outside every morning with a cup of nespresso, watching the green space with locals jogging and walking their pets. But the real value in Nestor's listing is the host. Nestor takes extra efforts to make us feel welcome, helping us navigate language barriers and making great suggestions. Keep in mind, you are in the middle of Paris in an older building so there are creaks and tight spaces but overall Nestor's place is a great value.
This place is a lovely, modern, well-stocked apartment. It’s centrally located in the 1st arrondissement. It’s a 15-20 min walk to Notre Dame. Highly recommend to others!
Cute apartment in a friendly neighborhood, there are cafes, bakery, pastries and shops all within a couple of minutes walks
The apartment is nice bright and spacious. Located near the tower, there are good restaurants the area is quieter compared to the center.
The apartment was clean and beautiful. Nice stay! We all had a great time in Paris. Thank you!
Loved our stay in this little studio. Was quiet but still right in the heart of Paris. We had a great time

Looking for a calm, breathtaking, central apartment in Paris ? Pascal’s apartment’s the best place for that. I had to take my USMLE exam in Paris and that place provided me with all the peace of mind I needed. The view is better than in all photos by the way. Great stay !! Thank you Pascal

I can't imagine a better place to escape the tourist crowds and immerse yourself in the true Parisian lifestyle. Erwan's apartment is well off the street and so quiet it was amazing to think we were in a busy city. It's a perfect size for a couple and the patio makes it feel much bigger than it is. We were able to cook several meals at home, but with great cafes, brasseries, and restaurants all around us (a few to each block), as well as boulangeries, patisseries, and fromageries, it was easy to go out and grab a bite at the end of a long day of wondering different neighborhoods. We could walk to anywhere we wanted to go, but also enjoyed having the Metro a few blocks away. I look forward to being able to stay here again when I return to Paris!

Helpful and insightful communication with Corentine made this stay special. I didn't only get local recommendations but also received help during the stay. The apartment is simple but it's location is amazing, from bakeries to bistros and shops.

The apartment has a great location, you can easily get to absolutely all the sights. The apartment is cozy in the French style, there is everything you need even for a long stay, including a washing machine, iron and hair dryer. Thanks for the prompt support 24/7 and clear instructions.
A fantastic stay! Spotless accommodation, excellent location and friendly, responsive host! Would stay here again, happily!

Haiyan communicated beautifully with us, requesting that we notify her an hour before our anticipated arrival so that we could receive the key to the apartment. The location was superb…with the Arch de Triumphe only a 5-minute walk from the apartment. We tried a different Boulangerie every morning-all close by. In addition to the great location, I should mention that a grocery store and laundromat were just 2-minute walk away. And even though the apartment is in the very heart of Paris, the nights were very quiet. I highly recommend a stay here!
Everything was absolutely perfect. Lovely hosts, cozy room, great breakfasts. It was a pleasure to spend a week here. We would love to come back again sometime.

Words cannot describe just how fabulous this place is. The camera doesn’t quite capture how magnificent Sacre Coeur looks. The four windows which let in so much light are like four perfect paintings of Paris . In the first the buildings are large and in close up and by the fourth the buildings are tiny as the vast landscape of Paris has opened up. We love Abbesses and Monmartre and adored being here in this dreamy, artistic home in the sky. Merci Benoit. You were such a fabulous host and I’m sure we’ll be back!
Rudy and his team were responsive, patient and kind. The apartment was stylish and comfortable in a beautiful neighbourhood- we would absolutely stay here again.
Yoni is an amazing host and the location of his apartment is incredible. Accessible by two really close by stations with lots of varying restaurants nearby. Thanks Yoni.

Our stay was fantastic! The location is in a practical area with a lot of restaurants and close to the city center, the Seine and the Notre Dame. The terrace offered a beautiful view over the city, the Sacré Cœur and the Tour Eiffel. It was very clean, and it had a well equipped kitchen. It was worth the four flights of steep and narrow stairs! :)

Vincent was an organized, thoughtful and kind host who we got to meet upon our arrival after a long day of travel. His home was well appointed and everything we could need was available. The area was hopping with restaurants a grocery store and all sorts of shops to select fresh cheese wine bakery items, jams. Was so convenient to bus and metro. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Vincent’s home and his personal reflections on suggested places to go eat and be entertained were appreciated. Would go back. Thank you Vincent!

Location for us as a family with a toddler and pregnant mama was 10/10. We had everything we needed from a beautiful park to great food options, grocery store, shopping, pharmacy, metro and more! The space was great, a little dusty but that could be the area and being on the top floor? We brought up a few things and the host did his best to take care of it. We needed a crib as well and that was provided for, we were really grateful!

The place was very nice in itself, but the area is not the best during the night. However, I fully recommend this place if you come back at night accompanied :) Very clean and Pauline was extremely nice!
We really liked our stay in Paris. Vibrant neighborhood and nice restaurants. Apartment was as described and very nice decorated. Thank you for a lovely stay!

The apartment is very beautiful with hand picked out furniture and very central. Bruno and Vanessa were very quick in their communication, offering a flexible check-in and check-outs and proactive offering help. We had the perfect days in Paris are 100% recommending this beautiful apartment of Bruno and Vanessa. Thank you so much for this exceptionally, perfect time in Paris!

This place is such a gem! Manon and Jules were so welcoming and kind. They left a bottle of wine for us upon arrival. Super responsive and warm, flexible check in and check out. Highly recommend their apartment. Overlooking a beautiful section of Monmarte right on the corner overlooking bistros, trees, and sacre coeur. I can’t wait to return.

I had a great 3-day stay in this charming little studio! The place is beautifully decorated, very clean, and had everything I needed. It’s well located, near to the metro station . The host was friendly and helpful.

My friend and I really enjoyed our stay. The flat is a great find, thoughtfully furnished and the area itself is fantastic, close enough to many interesting parts of Paris but still quiet at night for a restful night’s sleep. We liked all the streets close by for the simple joy of browsing and soaking up the atmosphere of being in Paris and then got Ubers to particular places of interest as we were short of time and wanted to squeeze in as much as possible. It’s an excellent location for this sort of trip as it’s so central. The place is very well equipped and we would return without hesitation and may well do just that at some point! Thank you Theo and Camille for a lovely stay.

Had a wonderful stay at Ariana’s comfy apartment. It felt very homey and welcoming. Very close to multiple metro lines for getting around the city. Loved being so close to Sacre-Coeur. Everything we wanted Paris to be for our first time.
We had a great weekend! Lovely appartment and we really appreciated the bikes, which were available to us for the entire weekend. Thank you Bruno!

Marlene’s place was cozy and functional. It was a five minute walk to Gare de Lyon and a 15-minute walk to the Seine. Local restaurants nearby and everyone was always friendly. Recommend this space! Charlene and June

We had a good, long stay! The location is incredible. A very short walk to the metro, restaurants, etc. The neighborhood is quiet, safe, and, as a woman, I appreciated the multiple locked doors that you had to pass through to get to the apartment. Checkin was easy, even had a baby crib, clean, not cluttered. Was the perfect size apartment. I appreciated that everything was there to cook full meals and laundry. Only things to note, my mother did comment on the very low bed and steep stairs that gave her some issues. And, although we were fine, I definitely wouldn't stay in the summer, as it got stuffy in the apartment and there are no fans. Good for shoulder season, though!

The lack of a TV was completely unexpected for me. But I could perfectly live without it. For somebody it could be a reason to refuse this property. One advise from me, you have a bluetooth speaker at your kitchen, which I wasn't able to connect to my phone and it has only few French speaking radio stations preset. Replace it with Amazon Alexa, without TV people are going to have more choices in music and news.

We loved our stay at Denka’s. Perfect location, felt safe, close to the station, lots of good restaurants around. We were offered an early check in as well as storage to keep our bags. We’ll definitely stay here again if we come back to Paris.

Awesome apartment in a great location. Balcony was a huge plus! Enough space for our family. Love that every room was bright with large windows, was such a nice place to return to after long days. On a Main Street but that didn’t bother us as we had earplugs and slept great. Highly recommend.

We very much enjoyed our stay at Didier’s home. Our favorite aspect was the location, right in the middle of a wonderful neighborhood, filled with quant little cafes, bakeries, shops, and local families too. It was so special to see how real Parisian’s live and we feel blessed to have found this place. We also appreciated Didier’s clear communication.

The place is beautiful, and the neighborhood is great. The location alone makes it worth its price point. Additionally, the place has a couple of security codes and a key, so it’s safe for tourists and people who arent familiar with the area. What a great find!
We had a great time, the bedrooms had block out curtains which helped us get a restful sleep! Great location, was able to walk to almost everywhere we wanted to visit.

We loved the apartment and the location was perfect! Could drink coffee outside while looking at the Eiffel Tower plus at night it was amazing. The apartment was very clean and spacious and perfect for the 3 of us. Bernard was so kind and helpful at check in and provided recommendations as well for us. You can’t go wrong with this apartment and I highly recommend it!!
The airbnb is honestly in a great neighbourhood the only issue was the shower who was terribly small and had issues with the drain. It was impossible to shower without having the shower overflowing.

Perfect spot for my friend and I couple nights in paris. The location was excellent and it had all we needed to get back to from a busy paris days . Denka was very responsive and everything was attended to promptly . Comfy mezzanine for sleeping and cozy place .

this place is so close to the iffel tower and restaurants all around it as well as a little supermarket juat a few steps away!! the place was clean and convenient. the host was very responsive and answer all my questions and always offered help when needed i will recommend 💯 %

This was our third stay in three years. The apartment is quiet and private with an airy feel and a well-equipped kitchen for our basic needs. Laurel, the Caretaker, was especially helpful and friendly. The location is in a lovely neighborhood with an easy walk to two Metro stops.

You can’t beat the location! Linda was super responsive & gave great check in directions. As many have noted, it is on the 3rd floor w/ no elevator so be mindful if you have large luggage or mobility issues.
Great residential location, close to RER C and metro lines connecting to the main tourist spots. Great place to stay!

The room was exactly as advertised – it looks just like the photos! This made for a very smooth and comfortable stay. Jean-Michel has been quite flexible on check-in and check-out and I really appreciate it!

This is a beautiful apartment in a perfect area of Paris! We felt like everything was walkable and if you're not up to that, several metro stations are close by. The decor is lovely and looks even better than the photos (love the Flowerpot pendants). Beds were comfy and the air conditioning was a great benefit on a couple of hot days. The third floor climb didn't bother us as the stairs are nice and wide. We'd love to return!

I stayed two nights with Delphine. Her home was very nice and once inside the courtyard doors it was extremely peaceful. Sadly I didn't see much of Delphine as she had just returned from holiday and had work commitments. But everything was well explained on arrival. A great stay. Thank you Delphine.
very spacious. nice internet. very central on a main street but not too loud so not an issue if you think so. merci!

Can’t fault this apartment. Fantastic location, apartment itself was very lovely and beautifully designed, and exceptionally clean. Vincent is a super host, great communication, and very fast responses to questions. No hesitation in recommending this place!

Very reliable company. We got another flat: bigger and in a much better neighborhood when they realized there is something wrong with the one that we booked initially. All went very well, easy to communicate and I totally recommend it.

A great stay in a lovely apartment, everything was just like in the pictures. We had an issue with water drainage, which we had read had happened before. Because of that, the rating is 4, even though everything else was fantastic. The location, cleanliness, bed comfort, amenities – all excellent, and a great starting point for exploring Paris!

The apartment is in a good location about a 10 minute walk to Notre Dame and the lively Latin quarter. Just be aware that the steps are long and steep into the apartment , some to the loft. Living are is small so a bit difficult with suitcases if you don’t want to carry them to the loft. Overall, we enjoyed our first stay in Paris.

Very accurately described apartment however the entry to the only digital and we had problems entering the front door on several occasions However Sweet available in the chat within minutes and came with a solution after a few dialogues.

Beautifully decorated apartment in a great location. The description is confusing, especially if you are from the United States. It states "2 en-suite bathrooms" - however there is only a sink and a shower for each bedroom, not a toilet. There is only one toilet for the entire apartment, located separately next to the living room. I wish they would state this more clearly on their listing, because it was inconvenient for two couples traveling together and lacked privacy.
We had a fantastic stay in Kathleen’s beautiful home. The room was great and the house and the neighbourhood were perfect. Kathleen is a terrific host and we would love to make a return visit!
Great location! Very walkable and safe area. Loads of restaurants around and the metro was down the street. Perfect stay for us in Paris.
Amazing stay - perfect for our family and toddler. Secure and private - near tons of great places.
Really responsive host, easy to bag drop early. Clean and as described. Great showers. Great location. Recommended

We had such a wonderful stay in the apartment; it was perfect! The apartment was just as described, David and Marie were extremely responsive, helpful and friendly, and the location was perfect for our needs. Lots of amazing sights and restaurants within walking distance. Thank you!

The apartment was cozy and nicely arranged, it had everything my partner and I needed for our stay in Paris. Hugues was a great host and good at communicating how to find the aprtment. Our experiences was great and I would recommend this stay for other travelers!
Thank you Pauline for a stay in your place in Paris: impeccably clean and conveniently located for Gare du Nord/L’Est

Beautiful apartment in spotless condition. Really peaceful and quiet whilst also being so close to the Arc de Triomphe. Really good value, we had a wonderful stay. I also left something behind which Haiyan kindly arranged for it to be available for collection a few days later. Can’t recommend enough!
Nice place to stay, very loud in the night time- kids was waking up, but the apartment itself had great location.
Great place and great area. Check in and check out super easy - loved the place would definitely stay again. Thank you for having us!

If you enjoy an oldfashioned cosy french feel to furnishings and decor paired with good hot water and heating, this place is for you. The lift is very useful, nearby shops and restaurants galore and several Metro Stations to choose from. My friend and I stayed for a week and felt really at home.
Great space with lots of room especially for Paris. Amazing location with so many great bars and restaurants in walking distance. Apart from the lift being under construction it was great!
My family and I had a great time at Pascal's place. Great location with everything you need.
I was really happy with my stay. Hanounou is very friendly and accommodating. The place is very clean and near metro and any necessary amenities. Would recommend or stay there again, thank you!

We had a lovely stay at Franck's place. The studio is small but has everything we needed. Parc de Buttes Chamont is beautiful and very close by. Franck had some suggestions for us for places to eat and visit nearby. He was very responsive to our requests.

Great apartment, well equipped and clean. Very quiet and close to both bus and metro. Just 10 min. walk up to Sacre Ceur and Montmartre. The host responded quickly to our questions and the apartment had a great list of helpful information. We were a party of six and the apartment had plenty of space for us.

Loved the location. The apartment is located on the first floor of a courtyard. That is very quiet. It has a private entrance and feels very safe. It is located on a fun street with lots of restaurants and shopping. So it was fun to be out and about, and then enter into quiet, safe courtyard to the apartment. It is in a very walkable area. I felt like all the shopkeepers and restaurant owners were very friendly. The hosts of the Airbnb were extremely responsive and have good suggestions for places to eat and visit. I would definitely stay there again.
Perfect apartment if you have to travel for work as there is a office space and this is quite spacious. Location super convenient close to food stores with la Grande Epicerie right across the street.

This charming apartment was the perfect home base for our stay in Paris! It was conveniently located to the station when we needed to take the train and close to many restaurant and shopping options. The space was comfortable and quiet in the evenings.
Great padition,and Romain was great with communication☺️ lovely living space overlooking the street☺️
Nice &compact apartment closed to metro and nice restaurants. Milan is supper helpful too. Very recommend.

Overall a beautiful apartment with lots of natural light and an amazing view - the only thing was there was some hair around the floor when we checked in, but otherwise the apartment was clean and well kept.

The place was very clean and cozy. Eloide was incredibly responsive and friendly—always quick to help and genuinely lovely to communicate with. The location is excellent, with everything you need nearby and the station just a short walk away. I’m very grateful to Eloise for making the stay so comfortable and pleasant.
Sophie has a wonderful place for a single person or couple traveling. The neighborhood was really nice and her dog, Eddy was super sweet. I felt very comfortable and would stay there again.

Patrick was incredibly helpful is getting us settled into the apartment, even going above and beyond by arranging transportation to and from the airport. The location was great-right in a great area of Paris with easy access to everything we needed. While the apartment was a bit smaller than we expected, it was clean and had everything we needed, overall a great place to stay. Would definitely recommend!
Great location and a wonderful apartment! Anne has been very helpful throughout. Will definitely book again when back in Paris!
Lovely location, in walking distance of the metro, restaurants, and supermarkets. The apartment was tidy and cozy. Helena was communicative and kind.

It was like staying in own home. It is a well lived space and we got the feeling of a beautiful Parisian apartment. The neighbours are also friendly. Fatima - the Super of the building - is a great person. She is always available to help us with any queries. Every equipment required for a good stay is provided. A great place for a long stay - we stayed for an idyllic 11 days. The apartment is ideally located near Metropolitan station and many number of buses. Dominique was also available for any requirements over phone and messages. Great place. Great people.

Staying at ’s Madam Maï-Ly place was truly a delightful experience. From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed with warmth, kindness, and a genuine sense of hospitality. The home was spotless, beautifully decorated, and equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Her attention to detail and thoughtful touches made me feel right at home. She was always available if I needed anything, yet gave me complete privacy. I highly recommend staying here to anyone looking for a peaceful and pleasant visit. Thank you for making my trip so memorable! ^_^
Thank you for a great stay. We loved the apartment. A great location in Paris. Highly recommend.
Great spot in the Marais near some of the best dining in Paris. Host was very friendly and accommodating. Wonderful stay!
Beautiful place, very comfortable, looked just like the photos and was very clean. Great location! Jean-Luc was very accommodating!
The apartment was clean, and it was convenient for major tourist stops in Paris as well as the metro!
Lovely stay at this fabulous apartment. It is very close to the Eiffel Tower only a few minutes walk. Would definitely recommend staying here.

Great apartment larger than expected. Everything you want is there. Like a home away from home. George and Dimitri were charming and very responsive. Apartment is close to numerous Metros and you can walk to landmarks such as the Louvre, Notre Dame, Latin quarter. It was a great stay.

We had a great stay! The apartment was super comfortable, in a great location, and just like the photos. Jean- Francoi’s was amazing, really friendly, helpful, and full of great tips for restaurants and things to do in Paris. It made a big difference to our trip! We’d definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
We had a great stay at Denka’s place. It was quiet, clean and central, everything I ask for 🌟

We recently stayed a long weekend, the view did not disappoint and the location was fantastic for the tower and river cruise etc. Also the hop on hop off bus was very local, the apartment was fantastic and the local restaurants were great.
Cozy apartment with many cafes and restaurants nearby. Very convenient - the metro which is 5mins walk and takes you everywhere. Highly recommended
Great place if you wanna stay at the Champs Elysees area. Building itself is very posh. Would definitely stay here again

We truly enjoyed our stay at Sophie&Stephane’s Airbnb. We were welcomed by Stephane who gave us incredible recommendations and made us feel right at home. The central location is unbeatable - walkable to almost all big attractions throughout the city. We absolutely loved spending time on the balcony and people watching. Highly recommend staying here!

Nicolas’ place is a delight and full of character. Well located but in a peaceful and quiet building, the flat gives you the opportunity to explore Paris day and night. Nicolas is friendly and always available. I highly recommend this place.

Fantastic stay. The space was fantastic for what we needed it for - exactly as shown in the photos. Clemence was very friendly and a great host for us. We would return and would recommend. Lots of great restaurants and walking in the area and right near the metro.
We had a great stay at Avihay's apartment. Spacious and well located, with lots of restaurants nearby. Comfortable beds and very well sound-proofed despite the main road location.
Great location. Yes, it’s cosy, and can be noisy but it’s city centre Paris so to be expected! Elsa’s instructions were really helpful & she checked in to see everything was ok.
Spacious and clean. You could easly stay here more than a few days and be comfortable. Restaurants around are great. Not touristy area, felt very parisian.

We had a perfect stay for a week and would definitely recommend this apartment. It is located on a more quiet and private street that is right next to the restaurants and grocery stores. Metro very close by. It was clean and had all the necessary stuff. Would love to come back :)

Perfect for our family of 6. The location was great. We walked out to a great restaurant on the corner called Chez Emelie and a view of the Eiffel Tower. The flat had everything we needed to have a great stay.

Oniri's place was exactly as described and exceeded our expectations, it was wonderful! We also very much enjoyed the daily housekeeping, it made it better than any hotel experience I think we could've had. We'll definitely be staying here again and recommending to our friends and family.

Beautiful space, we were 2 adults and a toddler(2year old) and the crib was perfect size for him. We read the reviews so we knew what to expect with the narrow staircase which you are probably only going to ride them once a day. Apart from that perfect spot.

This place has a really interesting way of hotel and it’s completely great because you have your own privacy, but at the same time feels like sharing services. I liked the location which was great and the instructions were clear. Thanks for having this service for the people getting to Paris.

A gem of a place. Accommodation was great and spacious. The local facilities are great and we spent many an evening going around the local bars and restaurants. All on your doorstop. We will definitely be going back and tell family and friends about this great find

The loft is very conveniently located, the interior of the loft is as described, I can tell the owner has invested a lot of time and effort to keep the place tidy and homey. The check in was smooth and easy. I would totally recommend everyone to book this place!
Great apartment in a fantastic neighborhood in Paris. Great location in the very nice Oberkampf neighborhood. The apartment and listing are exactly as pictured and described in the listing.

Laurent is an amazing host and very kindly met us during the early check-in to explain everything. The studio is well located in one of the coolest areas of Paris - Canal Saint Martin! Lots of good places to eat and explore and close to the metro stations. The place is as the photos depict. Neat, clean and just enough space for solo travellers or couples specially if you travel light :)
Jean-Christophe and his flat were great! He was extremely friendly and flexible and offered lovely recommendations!

Beautiful and spacious and clean apartment in the city Central area. Walking distance to many attractions and amazing museums. The Oprah house is only a few blocks behind this building. And the apartment is very clean and modern and comfortable for four people . The kitchen is great and the two bathrooms are all very clean. We stayed for eight nights and love to come back. Many thanks to the host !🍷

Went on a mother daughter trip for 5 days and stayed at Irune's apartment. My mom would say the five flights was a struggle, I appreciated the extra exercise and after a few glasses of wine 5 flights feels like 2! We had a little difficulty getting in the apartment but found that pushing the door in while unlocking and making sure it's fully turned to the right did the trick. Overall great stay, clean, comfortable bed, quiet neighborhood and Irune was very friendly and accommodating.
Place is very small to fit 6 persons. Apartment is not spacious. Should be maximum 4 persons.

A fine, spacious apartment in a great location. Safe and walkable. No air conditioning, but it was not needed for this trip. The washer / dryer worked better than most european evaporative dryers that I have encountered. The apartment does not get very dark for sleeping as the curtains to not cover the windows well. I'm a good sleeper and it didn't matter much, but others should know. This apartment had a LOT of clutter. In an Airbnb or hotel room, I want clear surfaces to put my things. It isn't helpful to have the beside tables and living room tables full of books, etc.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The property itself is quiet and peaceful, and we loved it was on the ground floor with a view out the windows of the courtyard. The host was very responsive, at one point we requested more coffee pods and they responded within an hour and had stocked them by the time we made it back. We had SO MANY towels available, we only used a few but we were very impressed. The washer also worked great when we used it.

Very nice and clean space—would stay here again. But be aware that it is on the ground floor right next to the entrance/exit door of the building, so we always heard people coming in and out and people on the street.

We had a great time at Patrick and Nathalie's! loved the apartment. there were plenty of restaurants in the area and a lovely bakery a block or so down the way. the sentier metro was a 5 minute walk which made connecting to the rest of the city very easy!
Amazing, comfortable space full of treasures to fit our family of four adults perfectly. Lots to see, drink and eat within walking distance. Thank you for having us!

We had a pleasant stay at this cozy and well-arranged apartment. It had ample space, making it comfortable for a short stay. The check-in and out process was smooth and quick, which we really appreciated. A great spot for Paris visit!

The apartment is very well located in the 9th arrondissement of Paris, close to the metro and surrounded by great cafes and restaurants. The place itself was clean, comfortable, and perfect for two people. A lovely spot to enjoy Paris—highly recommended!
I can recommend this Airbnb. It has everything you need. Noemie always responds very quickly for any questions you have and is very helpful.

Cedric was a great host! He was very responsive and the welcome basket was a nice touch. This was exactly the type of place we needed for our quick stay in Paris. Many things to do within walking distance. Thank you Cedric!
We had a lovey holiday, the flat was very well located and Nathalie and her colleague were very helpful. Would highly recommend.
Was a perfect option for what we needed, clean, everything we needed and very handy to transport. A great place.

We stayed for 9 nights. The beds were comfortable and the shower was nice. The kitchen was well equipped with a large dining room and living room. We felt close to the metro and bus lines so that we could go places easily. The elevator in the building was useful to transport luggage to the first floor. The boulangerie close by was a plus! Thank you for a pleasant stay!

Just as the name says it is a luxury apartment with all the features and amenities you need to get comfortable. Location is amazing and restaurants and bakeries just around the corners. Amazing host, very responsive with great communication skills. We were a group of 8 and everyone enjoyed staying here. Will highly recommend this apartment.
Good accommodation near the Eiffel Tower and steps away from subway station which was very convenient for us as we explored the city.
We loved Didier's place! It was very clean and had everything we needed. The location was perfect - lots of shops and restaurants just around the corner. We would love to come back again sometime!

Our family of four truly enjoyed our stay in Ethel’s apartment. It was just the right size to be comfortable for all of us. We loved the surrounding neighborhood and felt like we were getting an authentic slice of Parisian life any time we were in and around the apartment. The bathroom was large and kitchen was well appointed - you could tell that this was a space meant to be lived in, not just visited. The apartment listing exactly matched what we found when we got there with one exception: we found the view of the Eiffel Tower to be much more impressive in person than the photos make it appear. You can only see the tower from one window in the flat, but my wife and I watched it sparkle every evening while we were in Paris. We hope to have the opportunity to stay here again someday in the not-too-distant future.
Nice and cozy for a stay in Paris! Convenient to have the kitchen, and in a walkable part of the city.
Amazing host incredibly kind. The flat was located in such a great area. We had a great time thank you

Theo’s place was very nice it’s like a home away from home.. Theo and his staff were very responsive and nice. It’s exactly like the pictures very modern and had a lot of stuff to cook with since we did that a couple of nights. There are a lot of grocery stores in the area to walk to I loved that.. Right outside the Airbnb doors to your right is a very nice butcher place we went a lot the guy is really nice bakeries and cafes in walking distance. Metro is also in walking distance as well. I also loved the area I felt safe and comfortable at the location. I truly enjoyed Paris it was amazing and after a long day of walking that hot shower was everything. Thank you Theo!!your place was great.
Cozy and beautiful apartment that looks like the pictures. Close to several metro lines but on the quiet side of the neighborhood. Made for a perfect week in Paris!

Would definitely stay again at Delphine's. Very close walk to Montmarte, and being close to the RER B (train) and the 38 bus makes it very easy to get to the heart or south of Paris without too much trouble at all. They bed was more than comfortable and the stay was good.

The place is well located, right in front of a metro station which makes easy to move around. Stephane was very helpful and respectful. The apartment is very quietly and has a lot to do on the around.

Host; Clear and quick responses from the moment of booking. Location; walking distance to RER, metro, Eiffel, shops, groceries downstairs, restaurants, cafes. Size; perfect for Paris. Adult and 2 children (9,6). Plenty of storage. Kitchen & Laundry; everything you need particularly as a family. We would stay here again.

The team at Studio Prestige was great with communication before arrival, and the apartment was clean and in a fantastic location, exactly what I was looking for. However, I was really disappointed with the washer and dryer setup. The video instructions for the dryer were completely off, and it felt like the owner had never actually used the machine. I ended up wasting hours trying to figure it out and had to look up the manual on my own. The sofa bed was another challenge, there were no instructions or help provided, and it was extremely difficult to open. These issues made the stay more frustrating than it should have been, which was really unfortunate given how promising everything else was.

Beautiful apartment in the most perfect location. Quiet and serene environment with beautiful design details. Felt right at home. Our host was very responsive and checked in with us several times to ensure we had all we needed. 10/10 experience. Will come again. Highly recommend.
10 out of 5 stars! If you can book this place do it! So clean, charming and close to the Siene. Axel was a great communicator and made sure we were comfortable.

Our stay at Sarah's Parisian villa was absolutely delightful! It's truly a hidden gem – a wonderfully private place that feels both small and spacious, perfect for a small family break. We were impressed by how well-equipped it was; it genuinely had all the amenities you need and more, making our stay incredibly comfortable. As we were on a biking holiday, we especially appreciated the added security. Being part of a group of homes with secure gates made us feel very safe, which was a huge plus for storing our bikes and enjoying peace of mind. Sarah herself was an exceptional host. She was very responsive to all our needs and gave us some truly excellent recommendations that enhanced our trip. We give 5 stars to Sarah and her wonderful place in Paris! We highly recommend it for anyone looking for a private, well-equipped, and safe base for exploring the city.
Great location and amazing views from the apartment. Catherine and Zoe were very accommodating at check in and throughout the visit.
convenient location especially if your on shopping trip, only drawback is no lift and tight stairwell but that's out of hosts control

Great location!!! Easily walkable to the sites we wanted to visit. Fairly quiet-especially for being in a busy area. Was very happy we could drop off bags before check in time. The host was very friendly and helpful. I didn't think the apartment was as big or nice as it looked in the photos but it was perfectly acceptable. Bedding could have been nicer and could have used more towels.
The location of the place was perfect. Very quiet area and it was really easy to get to places for sightseeing. Would recommend to book!

Anne & Jean-Luc were among the best hosts we've had on Airbnb. Very friendly, responsive and proactive. They let us store our luggage for several hours before checkin, and they happily tolerated the few schedule changes we threw at them before checkin. Overall, we highly recommend this apartment and host. You can't go wrong here.

Amazing stay in a lovely studio; excellent cultural centre with amazing transport links. Marie's place is super comfortable and very private. Would recommend to anyone looking to stay in Paris, no matter what they wanted to do.

We had a great stay at Anne-Laure’s place. She was very helpful and responsive when we arrived. The place looks exactly like the photos. It is remarkably quiet at night, considering how close it is to everything. Great shower and updated bathroom. So nice to be so close to the Luxembourg garden. We hope to stay there again!

Nice apartment in center of Paris. You can walk to Louvre, Notre-Dame and other famous places. Many restaurants and cafés around. The apartment had all we needed for comfortable stay. Host was very kind and checked if everything is okay during our time there. Also, good price for this location.

Thank you for an incredible stay at this gem of an apartment! It is extremely well located in a beautiful building. We loved the local area; walked everyday and used the metro. We loved Paris so much and I know that the convenience of this beautiful apartment contributed to that. Merci!!!

The location was brilliant - a safe, clean area a short walk from the Eiffel tower. The apartment is huge but a bit tired - we didn’t mind, except the flight of stairs was a pain with our bags and little children with the lift stopped working… all in all, we had a lovely stay and would book here again.

This place is well located. It doesn’t have AC or fans . Also I didn’t like that the window in one of the rooms faced the trash bin so we were hot and didn’t want to open it because flies will get in the apartment. We were a family of 7 and is 2 bedroom and 2 sofa beds in the living room where the kids slept. Other wise we had a good stay here.

Lovely apartment with lots of cute knick knacks to make it feel like home. The second bedroom is tiny and only has room for a double bed and nothing else. Great location, check in was easy and Catherine (the host) was super responsive.

Agnes' place was very convenient, the metro station was within a 5 min walk from the gates. It was clean and tidy. The coded gates made me feel safer as the area was a little sketch late at night. lots of food options around. You are gonna be sharing the space with a few others so be mindful of that, in terms of noise and cleanliness.
Great location. Very secure building. Quiet apartment in a busy city. Quentin was very responsive.

We had an excellent stay at Louise’ place in Pigalle - it was extremely well located with multiple metro stops nearby and wonderful local restaurants, cafes , boulangeries etc nearby ! Louise was a very responsive host and her place was well set up for us with a little baby given the existing nursery amenities , which made for easy first time travels as a young family of 3 !

Beautiful apartment with lots of extra towels and linens. Great area with lots of cafes and bistros close by. Had one of the best meals we had in Paris at a restaurant recommended by our host. Spotlessly clean and enjoyed relaxing in the apartment with a nice glass of wine after a busy day of exploring Paris. Would definitely recommend. Quiet neighborhood with lots to do and amenities close at hand

This apartment was quiet and spacious. It was the perfect end to a European tour containing a string of small hotel rooms. There was no A/C in the unit but there was no direct sunlight either. Just by opening the windows/doors helped easily cool down the space. The host responded quickly to my questions and I felt safe in the space. I would definitely book again.
I loved having a spotless quiet place all to myself, away from the noise and crowds outside. It is a small space but thoughtfully arranged. Location is very convenient.
