This apartment was in a perfect location to explore the city. Close to restaurants, sites, public transportation and a grocery. It was a very comfortable place for group and Doug and his wife were great hosts! Highly recommend this apartment.

We had an amazing stay at Erwan’s apartment! The place was spotless, beautifully maintained, and every little detail was thoughtfully arranged to make our stay comfortable and easy. The location is absolutely perfect — close to everything yet quiet and relaxing. We truly enjoyed our time here and can’t recommend this place highly enough. Thank you, Erwan, for a wonderful experience!

Had such a great time in Paris! This apartment was super helpful – the location couldn’t be better, which is pretty close to those spots of views. And I really appreciated all Yang’s help. He was always responsive and gave a lot of great recommendations on restaurants. Tried a few and loved them! Thanks so much :) BTW, if you love croissants, then this place would be perfect for you since it was pretty to the best croissant in Paris.

Charming little apparment in a quiet neighbourhood, with all you need. Its close to a food store and a few restaurants. It is also close to the trainstation if you want to go to Disneyland, or a 30 min walk by the river to Notre-Dame. The owner answered quick and gave us clear instructions. I would stay here again.

Wonderful Stay; if you’re trying to visit Paris and not feel like a foreign tourist, this Airbnb helps immerse you into the city of light. Very close to everything you want to see, but far enough away to escape when you’ve had enough.
Great spot to stay! Everything was taken care of and the place was super clean! Sebastian was very clear on check in instructions and responded quickly.
Awesome location! Quiet but very close to major attractions. Clean and tidy appartement. A bit small with our family of 5 but the location made up for it.

Fantastic location and a beautiful Parisian apartment! The host was flexible with check-in time which was greatly appreciated!! The only thing to be mindful of is having to take your luggage up four flights of stairs.

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We loved everything about the home, especially how peaceful and secure it was. Albert went above and beyond, providing us with critical safety information during the unexpected events of the final football game. Beautiful parks, restaurants, cafes, shopping, significant sites, public transportation and grocery stores nearby. Highly recommend Albert's rental property.

Karine’s place was so unique, charming, eclectic and homey. Karine was very communicative and informative and kind to let us check in early. While the rental is away from the usual touristy spots, we enjoyed the quieter neighborhood with less crowds, great restaurants and short walking distance to the metro. We enjoyed our stay very much!
Stay Was good.....location is great....Just down the apartment has many good resturant. All train stations are in walking distance. Overall a good exprecince.

The place is lovely and located in a great area, making it convenient to reach most of the major landmarks in Paris. Victorine was very friendly and allowed us to check in early. She also recommended many local restaurants, which was really helpful.

This place is worth it! Great location, easy to get into (only a few stairs up to the apartment), and very thoughtful touches in the place (like a ton of outlets/chargers in convenient spots!). Such a great stay in Paris, highly recommend :)
Staying ar Sofia’s was a pleasure. The location was perfect, the home was clean, the bed was sooo big and cozy and Sofia was always available to answer my questions. Highly recommended!

The apartment is OK, but it does not look like the photos. The parquetry floor has been replaced by cheap grey vinyl planks, the decor is not as nice as the pics (different curtains, no rug, too much purple, different lounge) and it badly needs a repaint. Its looking very tired. There were lots of empty containers eg laundry detergent etc. There are no bikes available - which the photo titled "personal bikes" leads you to believe. On the positive, it is pretty quiet, very close to Javel metro station, which is on the 10 line. The supermarket at the bottom of the complex is very convenient. For some reason there is no chopping board in the kitchen. For me that's an essential but apparently not for the host.
Fantastic stay, Béatrice is a great host and this is a good spot in a great neighbourhood, perfect if you are out sightseeing.

We loved staying in this sweet Paris apartment far above the river with a lovely view of the city and Seine. Storage was plentiful, the shower was great, having access to the washer dryer combo was very convenient. Catherine was a helpful, friendly, and attentive host but honestly so much was supplied we didn’t need to contact her during the week. The apartment and the building are charming and the neighbors we met were kind. Ile Saint Louis can’t be beat for location. Be sure you can cope with many stairs - it’s worth it if you can! Merci beaucoup Catherine!

Our stay was lovely. The apartment was better than the pictures, very stylish and tastefully decorated. Located in a quiet part of town and well connected to the rest of the city. Etienne was responsive and accomodating offering us an early check in. Definitely among my favorite AirBNBs I have stayed at & would stay again.
Laurent was really helpful and was there to welcome us! great location and lovely neighborhood. thanks again for the hospitality!
This is a fantastic place to stay. Irune was absolutely fantastic from start to finish. A perfect weekend.

We had a fabulous stay, Jean Francois and Marie were perfect hosts, responded immediately to any questions we had, recommended some wonderful restaurants and cafes. The apartment is beautiful ideal for my daughter and me or for 3 people, perfect location in beautiful Montemartre right by the Moulin Rouge ( which is a must!!) We had the best time and recommend very highly, see you again Paris❤️
Great place in amazing location! Host was very easy to communicate with. Check in and out were a breeze!
It was the best, really! Manar was very friendly, the House was clean with everything you need. It was a pleasure! 😁

Helena’s place was perfect for our friend group of 4. The apartment was beautiful, quiet, clean, and had all the amenities you could need. Check-in instructions were super easy to follow, and Helena was very helpful and responsive. She also gave us some amazing recommendations for food and bakeries nearby that we loved! The location is in a beautiful, safe and clean neighbourhood only a 3min walk from the metro. Helena suggested us use a transit app for the metro and it made navigating the metro super easy (highly recommend!!). Overall, we had a great stay and owe our thanks to Helena and her amazing place!

The apartment is well-equipped, super comfortable, and really clean. The location is great — close to the city center but in a quiet area, with shops and the metro just a short walk away. Frederic was a really kind and responsive host, always happy to help with any questions or requests. I’ve been to Paris a few times before, and I’d 100% recommend this place. Had a wonderful stay. Thanks for everything, Frederic!

We had a great time at Jean Christophe’s apartment! It’s the perfect space and location for us, spacious, easy connection with metro! Would definitely come back again and recommend to anyone who’s coming to Paris.

Amazing stay with an amazing view! We enjoyed baked goods from the nearby bakeries with a view of Sacre Coeur. The apartment had everything we needed and the hosts were flexible and very considerate of our schedule. We'd definitely stay here again! Can highly recommend this apartment!

We enjoyed our stay overall, the flat was clean and location is good, but we were charged €40 extra for a travel cot that wasn’t set up or properly provided — no bedding. I requested a refund of the extra fee and followed up multiple times over two weeks, but the host never responded. Disappointing communication that really affected the experience.
Mariela was a great host! Her place was really clean, perfect location and very very beautiful! Thank you Mariela for being part of our unforgettable trip to Paris !!!

Julien and Bénédicte were amazing hosts. The room was exactly what I expected. They were also very proactive in coming up with solutions for travel/timing issues. I am definitely going to remember this trip for the rest of my life. Highly recommend!

Beatrice is a nice host. She welcome us one time and always response to us promptly. The house is in good location, walking distance to metros and easy access to shops. The house match the description. We had a good experience with this B&B

The apartment is in a great, quiet location, but we were very disappointed to find a huge amount of ants all over the floor, especially in the bedrooms and bathroom. The host sent someone to clean, but they entered the apartment without our permission while we were not there, which is completely unacceptable. When we returned, there were still ants in the apartment. Overall, this was not a pleasant experience, and it really affected our stay.
The location is amazing, perfect stay for a weelend for 2 people! The apartment is on the 4th floor, it was clean and surprisingly spacious.
Very nice, clean 2 bedroom apt. Easy to check in and check out. Very calm in the evening / night. We stayed here with our 2 daughters of 7 and 9 and would definitely recommend it!
We had a great stay in Paris! The apartment was just as described, in a very central, very calm area. We always felt very safe there. We would be happy to come back!
The apartment worked great for our family of 6 adults. It was close to many attractions in Paris and restaurants. Charles and Emma were very helpful. We had a great stay!
Tara’s place was great; convenient and accurately depicted in the pictures. The neighborhood is quiet and well connected to with the Metro. Would stay here again.

Great cozy apartment in a great peaceful location. close to several metros and bike share services making it easy to get anywhere in the city. Paul was very responsive and easy to work with. Highly recommend!

Great location. Easy to checkin. Would’ve been nice if they provided pods for the excellent coffee machine, and daily fresh towels. Interior courtyard window didn’t provide any fresh air. Overall 8/10.

We really enjoyed our stay at Yan’s apartment. It was nice and clean, and in a good location in Montmarte very close to the Sacre Coeur. It was convenient for the metro station and buses, and also walkable from and to Gare De Nord station if you don’t have too much luggage; it’s about a 20 minute walk.

Fred is an absolutely great host and one of the nicest people you will ever meet! He was extremely responsive and kept in touch to make sure that we had everything we needed. The place is small but comfortable enough for a week's stay for two people. We like the 14th -- it's where the people live, and there are lots of good restaurants and shops in the neighborhood.
This was an absolutely perfect location in Paris! The apartment was cozy & clean, and the courtyard was beautiful. I would definitely stay here again!
Great location. Lots of space. Stan is super responsive and helpful. Will def stay again as we loved this area and felt safe and at home.
We booked this apartment last minute as the place we were booked to stay at had issues. Julien was very responsive. The apartment was clean and spacious. Location was near many restaurants and cafes.

We had a wonderful time at Denis's place in Le Marais. We felt at home right away. The instructions were clear and Denis was proactive in making sure everything was going well for us. The neighbourhood has loads of things to do and places to explore, mostly walkable, but the metro and buses were easy to use as well. The bed and lounge suite were comfortable, the first to sleep in and the latter to relax on. We had everything we needed at the flat and there were plenty of food shops nearby.

Host was very communicative and accommodating. Great value with two metro stops in easy walking distance that provide access to all areas of Paris as well as the RER. Plenty of cafes, grocery, fresh fruit and vegetable stands, and wine/liquor stores nearby. Daily construction, except for weekends, is ongoing next door but should be finished by the end of June. While it has bunk beds and a living area sofa bed, it is more comfortable with only 3 adults or a family with non-adult kids would be fine. Overall, it was a very quiet place to stay, and it worked very well for us.

Julien's place was perfect for our family of three. The space was exactly what we expected and we appreciated how safe it felt with the multiple locked entries. The area is beautiful and so close to the Louvre and gardens where we spent a lot of time. Julien was great to work with. He had someone waiting to greet us and allowed us a slightly later checkout which was very helpful.

Perfect apartment for a solo traveler or couple on a lovely quiet block. Near major train and bus lines to easily travel anywhere in the city. Tasteful and elegant apartment with all that you need including a very well arranged kitchen.
A bnb with great in-house design, but some marks deducted from the hygiene (not in a serious manner)

Location was sensational, so close to everything metro wise and the market nearby and restaurants and patisseries were sensational. The place was good, small and cosy, great balcony, just felt a lot smaller than it was as there were lots of the owners belongings everywhere so cupboards and shelves etc were already occupied which made it hard to find places to put stuff.

The view of Eiffel tower is phenomenal! You can walk to alot of places especially near the tower, lots of restaurants etc. My family thoroughly enjoyed our stay! The elevator is a little tricky but when you can get it to work its much easier since the place is on the 5th floor

Excellent, excellent, excellent! Wonderfully appointed home had everything one would need for a lovely stay! The hosts were incredibly gracious and responsive. Safe, ultra-convenient location that had us feeling like locals. We would happily stay again if ever in Paris! Our family of four highly recommends this home!
stayed here with 5 people (3 adults and 2 kids). great location and close to everything plus it is very quiet at night! would recommend!

We enjoyed our stay. The apartment is small but definitely has enough space for a solo traveller or couple. The size of the shower and hot water tank were a definite plus! The neighbourhood has plenty of boulangeries, grocery stores, and restaurants/food options close by. Definitely recommend if you don’t mind using the metro or exploring Paris by foot to get to some of the iconic sites.
What really stood out were the detailed check in and check out instructions. also, there were absolutely no problems or concerns.
Wonderfully inviting apartment in a fantastic area with a very helpful and inviting host. Would definitely stay there again.
Catherine was extremely kind, accommodating, and helpful! She went above and beyond for us and I would highly recommend staying at the beautifully lit and spacious apartment in the heart of Paris!

I stayed at Yang's apartment for my first solo trip to Paris and felt right at home! The apartment is equipped with a huge Marshall speaker, a well-stocked kitchen, and any other appliance you might need. The house is situated right opposite a university, so it remains lively throughout the day and night! Super safe and centrally located. A short walk away from Notre Dame and the canals as well. There's an atm, a patisserie, and a grocery store within 100 m. Can not recommend it more!!! Will be back

Apartment was nice and roomy and overall nice location. The access was an issue as the main entrance doors are not accessible on Sun or Mon or at night and the crossover door was always locked, so accessing 3rd floor was a dark spiral staircase and was never in elevator that only hold 2 people when you could access it.

This Airbnb matched the description perfectly. It’s conveniently located near the metro, and most major attractions are just a 15–20 minute taxi ride away, which was very manageable. The neighborhood is filled with great restaurants, and the apartment itself is cozy—ideal for one or two people. Paul was very responsive, and check-in was a breeze. I’d definitely recommend this spot to anyone visiting Paris for a short stay.

Marlene’s place is wonderful. The home has lots of space, is clean and close to the stations. The street is picturesque and peaceful. There is a market around the corner as well as cafes and bakeries. Marlene is a responsive and kind host.

Vincent was a great host. the apartment was a little tricky getting in. 5 doors with 4 codes but once we figured it out it was easy. we had 1 small issue that Vincent resolved quickly. the area is residential with some restaurants, coffee shops and supermarket nearby. the apartment is not air conditioned and it was quite warm in paris during our stay. there are ceiling fans in each room.
Loved this place! Irune was wonderful and friendly. She was very flexible and helpful whenever we had questions. I would like to have her come decorate my own house!
We had a lovely stay in unique home in Paris! it was really special and modern and quiet.

This is really a great place and I would recommend it to everyone visiting Paris. I really cannot find a fault. There is enough space for 2 people and all amenities that you need. It is sufficiently quiet and this is one of the reasons that we've chosen it. It is appropriate for light sleepers or people who prefer peace and quiet. At the same time, it is close to some bustling locations.
Our family of four just left Highstay and had a wonderful time! Beautiful and comfortable unit and appreciated the amenities and servicing of the apartment. Would recommend and stay again!

What a great place. Spotlessly clean. Perfect location to jump on metro and get everywhere we wanted. Tons of restaurants within easy walk. Washer/dryer was key for us. Though, it is small and takes several cycles to get through family of 4's clothes. Also note that it is wash/dry combo, definitely have to hang dry afterwards, even after machine dry. But. there's a huge rack for that. No complaints, just pointing it out. Beds/pillows were fine. Air Conditioning absolutely necessary when in the 90's). Very happy the bedrooms were equipped. Loved standing on the balcony, drinking coffee in the morning. Besides street noise, building is very quiet.

Very nice modern apartment in a very safe and vibrant community located perfectly for easy access to most Parisian sights and activities! Emerald was a helpful host and kept a very clean apartment with brand new appliances and bathroom.

A great stay!! Super good location, close to the Eiffel Tower, good shopping, quiet, and safe. The apartment was clean and perfect for our weekend stay. The only problem we had was figuring out the shower but that was just user error!
A beautiful apartment in an ideal location to explore the best that Paris has to offer. We couldn't have asked for anything better.

This place was SO cool. The thought that went into this place and the layout - was amazing. We stayed here with our two little boys and had a great time. It was private and easy to get too, not loud. The sauna and the hot tub were so amazing to relax in each night.

We really enjoyed our stay here in Paris. The apartment is bright and beautifully decorated, with all the kitchen equipment you would need to cook basic meals if you want to. The location was fantastic, close to the metro but also within waking distance to museums and restaurants. Very cool part of Paris which feels more local.

The apartment was clean and generally matched the photos, but overall, the experience fell short of expectations. The location was decent within walking distance to some attractions and public transport but not particularly central or charming. The biggest downside was the lack of natural light, which made the space feel dark and a bit claustrophobic. The apartment itself was very small, awith no real charm or personality nd the bathroom was especially challenging there wasn’t enough space for an average-sized adult to stand or move comfortably. Amenities were minimal and felt quite cheap, with no thoughtful touches like a welcome bottle of water or wine, which are common in many Paris rentals. Overall, it felt more like a budget crash pad than a welcoming home base for a stay in the city. With some basic upgrades and a bit more hospitality, this could be a much better experience.
This was a wonderful space with lots to do around the area. Cindy was very responsive with recommendations and accommodations. The space was very clean and we had a great time!
Our family loved the apartment and the location is wonderful, very walkable and the streets below has a lot of great restaurants and coffee shops.

Sidonie was an amazing host, we stayed a week and felt right at home. Sidonie was so welcoming and went above and beyond to make us cosy. Location was very central, easy to get around via walking/subway. Secure building access, but located on top of a bar, so could get a little noisy on occasion, but nothing that bothered us. We loved our stay.

We had a magical stay in this whimsical and beautifully clean apartment in Saint Germain des Prés. The living space is dreamy and spacious, with charming touches throughout—and the skylight over the bed truly adds a touch of wonder, especially at night. The outdoor patio was a highlight, offering a fantastic view that made every morning coffee and evening cheese and bread feel special. The kitchen was well-appointed and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Like many classic Parisian buildings, it’s a 4th floor walk-up, so we were glad we packed light! All in all, a lovely, memorable place to stay in one of the most charming neighborhoods in Paris. Highly recommend.

We had a lovely stay here for 3 nights, Corentine was very helpful and quick to reply with any queries. Great location in a quiet street close to lots of good restaurants and wine bars. Highly recommend!

Perfect for one person exploring since it was near several metro stations. Despite the heat wave during my stay, the large window on the room made it more manageable than being outside Isabel was so welcoming and helped me fashion a strap for my broken luggage handle in preparation for the next leg of my vacation. I’d definitely come back the next time I’m in Paris solo.

We had a comfortable stay at Hanne’s place. It was clean and very convenient to the 7 bis metro which enabled us to connect with many other lines to easily get around Paris! Hanne was also so responsive and helpful with providing many recommendations while we were planning our stay! We always felt safe and appreciated the great value Hanne’s place afforded us!

It was the perfect place for our honeymoon! We had everything we needed for a full week filled with sightseeing. Everything was within walking distance or a short ride on the metro that was a 2 minute walk from the front door. The big soaking tub was amazing after a long day of walking. Overall 10 out of 10 place to stay!
The location is excellent, 10 mins walk to Notre-Dame, lots of beautiful cafes and restaurants. The apartment is peaceful and quiet, has everything you need, including washer/dryer.
We had a wonderful stay in Paris at Cristina’s place - the location was great and extremely accessible!

We had a fantastic stay at Karine's. She was very helpful and communicative before and during our stay. Great house to share on a lovely private alleyway. Easy to get around the city via the local metro stops. Would recommend!
Lola is such a responsive and friendly host, the house is stylishly decorated with dreamy lighting and tropical plants. I would recommend this place for those who love interior design.

Me and my partner loved our stay at Lucile’s apartment. Lovely space that looks exactly like the photos and in a fantastic location - a minute walk to Place de Clichy metro and a 10-15 minute walk to Montmartre. You can even see the Le Sacre Couer from the windows. Lovely supermarket and patisserie next door. Perfect apartment for a short stay in Paris. Only downside was pet hair throughout the apartment, including on the bedding. This did not bother us, but it might for others.

The apartment was a good size for two adults and two children. The peaceful view of the treetops was lovely and the apartment is in all very nice. All communication with Virginie was perfect and she left us good recommendations for the area. We are very pleased.

We had a wonderful stay in Paris and Jean-Francois' apartment! Our Mother had stayed previously, loved it so much, and insisted we stay too - we were so glad we did. The location is fantastic, within walking distance to the metro and surrounded by charming cafes and great restaurants. Jean-Francois was incredibly kind, welcoming and full of helpful tips which made our visit even better. Highly recommend!

A quiet retreat and great place to walk all over the city from. Even with younger kids, we still just walked everywhere. Wonderful neighborhood feel. Compact but adequate accommodations for a family of four assuming all are traveling light.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the apartment. Great location - close to cafes, walkable to many of the city’s attractions as well as Metro station nearby. Host was responsive and very helpful. Would recommend.

The accommodations were clean, comfortable, spacious and the decor was very appealing. We loved being close to Luxembourg Gardens and walking around the neighborhood. The bakery and neighborhood restaurant on our street were both quite good. We would love to return!

My stay was lovely! Delphine was so kind and gave clear instructions. She also greeted me upon arrival and my room was comfortable and matched the pictures and description. The location has easy access to the Metro as well!
Great place to stay. Walkable to 2 metro lines, lots of cafes and bakeries in the neighborhood to start your day. Short walk to Sacre Coeur. Laundry on site was great for our longer stay.

I rent apartments very often. A host like Pascal is very rare. He heard all our little requests. The apartment was very clean. Pascal was quick to respond to our messages and provided feedback. This is also very rare. Wonderful accommodation and host!!!!
My wife and I and our two children loved our stay— the area is beautiful with great restaurants, bakeries, and pastry shops all close by.

Had a great stay at Julien’s place. The room was small but very clean and well-organized – perfect for a short stay. The area is beautiful, with lots of small shops and great food options. Communication with Julien was quick and easy. I really appreciated the responsiveness and smooth process. Would definitely recommend!

Anne-Charlotte’s Airbnb was the perfect stay for our Paris trip! The location is very walkable to various restaurants, local shops, and boulangeries, and was a short walk to the metro to get into the city. Everything was just as pictured, clean, and very cute inside.
It was like home experience. Danielle was the best host we had ever met. The place was near the metro, supermarket, and pharmacy.
Great place for cheap at a fantastic location. Faces a calm courtyard on floor 1 that is nonetheless loud in the early morning when the neighboring store opens

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is beautiful and perfectly situated by the canal. The host was exceptionally responsive and helpful throughout. I’ll definitely be recommending this place to friends and family.

A comfortable, if bare bones room with access to the rest of a small, charming apartment. The main attraction for me was that I had business at the US embassy and it was a very affordable overnight option in the third arrondissement. Navas was extremely helpful with information and assistance, e.g., arranging for an Uber.

I would 1000% stay at Kaza Bella again. It’s location was perfect . We checked out so many nice local spots in the neighborhood that were walking distance. The home itself is luxurious and modern. A nice sanctuary in the city. The hosts were exceptional and clearly very experienced in property management and cultivating guest experiences. They even offered complimentary cleaning and refreshment of the amenities during our stay which I thought was a standout offering compared to other hosts. It’ll be hard to unsee this level of comfort in the next space I travel to!

The Montparnasse area was new to us, and we were so happy and surprised to see how energetic it is. A short 2 minute walk from the metro and restaurants everywhere. That being said, it was an extremely private and quiet location to stay in. This location had everything we needed for a cozy and comfortable stay. We loved it and will be back!

Lovely little quaint apartment in the middle of an assortment of eateries and near the Basilica Sacre Coeur! Host was very nice and everything was as described and pictured. It was very warm when we visited in June. The fans are helpful.

The apartment was in a nice quiet neighborhood but close to the metro and restaurants and markets. The place was very clean and the host was very communicative in the check in process. He even provided air conditioning units without asking during our stay.

Stayed here for 3 days. The stay was absolutely delightful, Cedric was the best host that we have stayed with by far. Apart from the obvious things of being clean and resourceful, beautiful home and accessible metro station, Cedric goes out every day at 7:30 am and gets wonderful croissants for each one of his guests, sets up a wonderful breakfast table and is right there to just give you enough company while you have your breakfast!! Makes you feel so welcomed! Highly recommend

We had such a lovely stay at Guillaume's place. The apartment itself is super charming, and got a lovely breeze that kept us cool, even on hot summer days. The neighborhood is very charming, with cute restaurants and cafes on every block. We felt so at home here, and wouldn't hesitate to come back if the opportunity arises!

Max was very efficient with texting whenever I had a question. The only downside was I thought we had a Queen bed and in reality, it was a sofa mattress. My hubby is 6' 5" and every time he moved, the springs squeeked. I loved the fridge. Every other place we stayed out for 9 other days in Paris did not have one. It was soooo hot, we needed to keep beverages cold. The bathroom was big, nice size. Location great for walking around and being near the canal. Thanks for your hospitality Max!!
Excellent location near the Louvre and Notre Dame, as well as many other great resources. Nice accommodations. It was a great stay!

Perfect location to see the Eiffel Tower sparkle at night then easily walk to this place. Easy to get around the city from here. Wonderful bakery down the street. Small shower was an experience! Two couples comfortable here. Wonderful help from the neighbor.

We were caught in Paris after my husband required hospitalisation. After 2 weeks in hospital he was very weak and ill. Clements property gave us exactly what we needed. A lift, lovely spaces, high ceilings, a divine outlook. It was the perfect sanctuary to recover in. Clement was the best host ever - and thats a big call. Many thanks for the support and service.
Beware:The building is hosted in an old building with mold, and dust. The apartment smelled of mold. I immediately checked out upon arrival due to these findings.

a cosy apartment with all y need. it is well arranged. oil, vinaiger, salt .... was also available. close to metro station (crimèe -300m). lidl at 9mn walking. space can mutch 2 guests. the building looks old, but apart is moderne.
Needed a place to sleep for a night before a flight out and came across this. Was a good bang for the buck and Arthur was super flexible with my check in time. Definitely recommend!

Very well appointed accommodation in a good neighbourhood, lots of bars / pubs and restaurants open till late. Near to Grands Boulevards metro station as well. Apartment is very well-renovated with everything you need from showering to cooking. Lovely place for our kids to stay and there was more than enough space in the apartment.

I absolutely loved staying at this beautiful home. It’s small but mighty - expertly designed and beautifully decorated. The area also felt very vibrant, yet safe. The streets and restaurants were often full of people enjoying the summer evening.

I really enjoyed our stay at Pauline’s, the place was comfortable for two people and had everything you would need. We even made friends with an alley cat! Definitely recommend staying here, public transport is very accessible and not bothersome throughout the night.
Great place, clean and conveniently close to Nation train station for easy access to main tourist sites. Milan was helpful too.
The location is good. Nearby to tram And Metro. The area is quiet and beautiful. Our host is super friendly.

Thankyou to Lisa for hosting us. This apartment has everything you need for a travelling family. It’s a great location close to everything. It’s quiet and has cooling. Lisa’s communication was excellent highly recommend.
Nice place very close to the Eiffel Tower - just 10min walk. Many restaurants and convenience stores within walking distance. Enjoyed the convenience of proximity to the main attractions in Paris!

The apartment is modern and very clean. The bed was comfortable and the TV options very good. Pascal was very informative with local restaurants and updated Notre Dame information. He was very responsive. Unfortunately, we did not sleep well any night due to how hot it was and only one small fan available for 4 people. We had to alternate nightly between the room and the family room. We opened the windows but the wind did not blow at all and it was very noisy early in the morning. We would stay again but definitely not in the summer!

Had an amazing stay at Anne’s studio. It is in an ideal location in the Marais district — very walkable and only a short walk from metro stops to travel to anywhere in Paris. Anne and the entire Sésame Conciergerie were very helpful and responsive. I highly recommend staying at this studio!
We loved our stay in Elsa’s apartment. It is in a very beautiful location, walking distance to the amazing cafes, bars and restaurants of the isles and of course, Notre Dame. Thanks Elsa!
Everything was wonderful, apartment clean and cozy. Only think i have to say that the bed was not that comfortable, very squeaky. Other then that it was very good ! 😊
Stylish, comfortable and a perfect location to explore the marais. We had a great stay.
We really enjoyed our stay at Eleanor’s place. The location was great with lots to do around and lots of nice food spots. Would recommend!

This Airbnb was very cozy! It had a ton of space and a beautiful open floor plan. All the little thought out details made our stay so perfect! Would definitely recommend a stay here and would definitely come back in the future!

Cute, quirky apartment with lots of space! Very secure and safe. Clementine is extremely responsive and helpful. About 1 min’s walk to a metro, great location. It does get quite warm during the summer so just something to be mindful of. The pillows are quite hard for sleeping on, more like a hard cushion but that’s just a personal preference. Would highly recommend this Airbnb!
It was a great space right on the edge of the more lively part of montmarre. It was close to the metro, shops, and restaurants. The perfect space for a group of 5 to 6 ppl!

The location is great was easy to get to. Did feel like they threw as many bedrooms together as possible in order to get more people in as you walk into the b&b your greeted to a bed which felt weird. Also be careful of the stairs downstairs we fell down and one person did seriously hurt their back so watch out in socks but overall a great place

Beautiful & bright accommodation that is in a perfect location of Paris. Very short walk to the Garu De Nord station and many great cafes nearby. Aldric made the check-in process extremely smooth and simplistic.
Great stay, located in a nice safe area, very homely and welcoming space! Thank you Elodie
Great place to stay! exactly as advertised and great communication from the hosts thanks again for the nice place to stay

Jana's apartment is one of the best I've ever stayed in, it's well located, in a quiet neighborhood, close to the subway station, it was tidy and well looked after, as in the photos and about Jana, she was an excellent and proactive host, in addition to helping me facilitate my checkout, I definitely recommend it and would come back.
It is a nice quiet residential location, close to the metro and the city centre. The apartment was nice and tidy. The host was very welcoming and offered help and advice regularly

Elsa was great as host. The weather was hot and being on the ground floor, we never could get enough ventilation. And it was humid with musty smell. Location perfect! Very beautiful in mornings to walk across street to have coffee along the Seine.
Nathalie was the perfect host and the apartment was a dream come true. She was always accessible and very friendly, and we loved the apartment’s charm, amenities and location.

NO AC AND VERY HOT!! The apartment did what it needed to do, but there were a few negatives. We had 4 guests, and only 2 of the towels were full size. The other two were too small to fit around an adult. The 2 very small fans provided were of no help with the no AC situation. The area was pretty noisy which was weird considering there was nothing to do around there. The Airbnb owner did not check in once with us throughout our stay. Not even a welcome, thank you, or ask if we were okay. Very disappointed considering the price for this place.
This rental was very conveniently located with plenty of restaurants and groceries available. Antoine was friendly and helpful and responded to our questions promptly.
Hughes was a wonderful host and very responsive. He was flexible with my check in time was made my stay pleasant.

Great location. Was kind of surprised when we saw the infamous Emily in Paris restaurant right on the doorstep. Very vibrant area, the place itself was giving typical Parisian vibes and gave us a very unique experience. Daniel was very prompt with his responses and made our stay effortless.
Right in the middle of everything g we wanted to see. It was nice being in a family friendly neighborhood. Would definitely stay there again!
Very easy getting in and out. Only complaint was street noise but this is probably common in Paris. Because of no AC wanted to leave windows open, but pretty noisy.
The host is very welcoming, apartment itself has everything for a comfortable staying, location wise it’s beautiful, with groceries and cafeterias nearby. Recommended!

Thanking you for renting us your beautiful home. I looked at so many places and yours stood out as an authentic Parisian apartment. And it did not disappoint. In fact, it was so much more. The decor mixed with old and new, the art, the elevator(!), and the amazing location made our trip a delight!!!!
Giovanni was so helpful, and had great recommendations for restaurants in the area. I highly recommend his place!

We had a lovely stay in Natsumi's beautiful apartment. The location is amazing: close to several metro stations, shops, restaurants, bars, it's just perfect. Natsumi and Dexter were really helpful, there was great communication and nothing was too much trouble. We stayed here two years ago and are always happy to return ❤️

Alexandra was a great host! The apartment looks exactly as listed and was a great place to spend 3 days in. The check-in was a little challenging as the lock box broke but we managed. The bed was very comfortable! The flat was spotless except the floors, which were a bit dirty.
Our stay at Marlène’s place was absolutely perfect! Marlène was so helpful and friendly, the location was perfect and we loved the space!
great location and great host, rooms quite small but your getting what you pay for in the heart of Paris

The recommendations to leave the key inside the apartment for checkout would have been welcome earlier as the walk with luggage to keynest drop off was a battle. The apartment itself is cute with Parisian charm in a fairly easy area. Metro nearby.

We enjoyed our stay at Gaetan‘s beautiful place. It was exactly as described. The metro, restaurants, coffee shops, and grocery store are a very short walk away. Communication with Gaetan was great. We will recommend his place to our family and friends and already looking forward to return.

Fantastic location and easy to walk to restaurants, cafes and shops as well as a market on the corner. Close to metro and easy to get taxi. Julien was very patient (was traveling with older family) and explained everything clearly. Communication was excellent. He provided bottles of water and basics to ensure we were comfortable at check in. Thank you.

This apartment was perfect for our Paris stay. Loved the quiet, walkable neighborhood and the proximity to the metro and RER. Check-in and out was easy and quick, the apartment was exactly as advertised, and we slept great in the beds. A perfect home-base for our explorations of the city!
Great location and beautiful home. Lots of room and great for our family of five. Only negative was the lack of kitchen utensils and amenities. The kitchen was not setup for easy use for a guest.

Isabelle’s place was very near metro stations so no need to worry if you want to roam around Paris. The place is also near restaurants and cafes so if you like the night life, book this place. Also, the flat has a lift which is very uncommon in Paris so no need to struggle with stairs with your heavy bags. Isabelle is super friendly, she made me feel at home from the moment I checked in. Definitely recommend this place!
Great location! Jeremie was a great host, let us check in early for free and met us at the apartment for check in. Definitely recommend.
Location ok, 10min to metro No iron, even in the presentation sent it says that it is iron and iron board No fan, was extremely hot The bed creaked, 🥴🥴 The bathroom door wouldn t close 👎🏽

The stay at this unit was overall nice. The apartment is extremely spacious and well laid out. The only drawback is that there's no AC. It was extremely hot during the week we stayed. I would recommend stronger fans.

Lovely place in Paris, very spacious, very generous and great area. Would definitely stay again. There was a slight misunderstanding with the host, where something was damaged on arrival and was charged against us. But after clarifying, the issue was resolved right away. Will recommend in the future!
Great and clean apartment with good location. Just a little bit noisy in the night because it is close to the road.
This is a comfortable place in a great neighborhood. The apartment is spacious with nice amenities. A great AirBnB experience.
Perfect stay! Amazing location and such great value for money - would highly recommend and will very likely stay again :)

This is a beautiful, comfortable apartment in a very vibrant neighborhood. The beds were comfortable, the kitchen was fully modern and building is very elegant. We walked everywhere - to the Louvre, Ile de la Cite, Marais and more and there are many wonderful restaurants and boulangeries nearby. We were there during a heat-wave, and although the listing only promises fans (which were there and quite effective), they also provided a mobile A/C unit was was incredibly helpful. We stayed with our 8-year old and all loved it and would happily go back.
My family and myself loved 🥰 the apartment and views of the balcony and was central to everywhere we wanted to go👍😃😃
A wonderful time in a beautiful home. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and very well-appointed.

Thank you so much Irune for all your help and communication with our delayed train. The apartment was beautiful and well located. We enjoyed walking along the canal at night and the many restaurants in the area. The steps were difficult with all our luggage but we knew in advance. The locks made us feel very safe ;)
Flavien had amazing communication and a beautiful apartment. Was great for a short stay in Paris.

Fantastic spot in Le Marais! I stayed with my family and it was a great fit for 2 adults and 2 kids. Walkable to the Seine and other attractions in Paris: Notre Dame, Pompidou. Located above a few lively restaurants and we enjoyed being in the middle of the action. I will definitely return!
have stayed here before and everything was great. This time there were dirty towels and the bed hadn’t been made

This house was an amazing find—so much space, beautiful and quiet street, and a great neighborhood with tons of restaurants. One of the nicest airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in. I definitely hope to stay there again. Thank you, Karine, for sharing your beautiful home with us!

We didn’t have power supply until next day, due to hardware malfunction, no WiFi and illumination. Agent didn’t have the proper solution for the issue nor landlord responded to us. A little disappointed.

Really nice place, located in a backyard that takes some of the city noise (its paris). The neighbourhood is very cozy and nice, i've lived in Paris but never came here and i really like this area. Can reccomend!
We had a lovely stay at Anaïs place! It was super quick but the location is lovely and very walkable.

Been to paris many times, but this was by far the most amazing, comfortable and magical stay. The appartement is situated in a super cosy neighborhood that feels like a separate village within the big city. Hauguel was a kind host that made us feel super at home. The bed is comfortable and the room is stylish as well. We will definitely be back, and we highky recommend this place. Thank you so much!

We had such a wonderful stay at ! The apartment was , charming, exactly as pictured and incredibly comfortable. We especially appreciated [mention something specific you liked, the great location and the easy check-in process.

The stay was very nice. It was walking distance from everywhere I had to be and comfortable enough for going back home at night. Hope to come by again if I have to be in Paris. Thank you for everything Ben and Ilan.

great location. Good space for 2 couples. Host v helpful. It can be noisy early in the morning with dustcarts, especially if you leave windows open. A minor quibble, the kitchen would benefit from better equipped, more mugs and a spatula for cooking.

Patrick was amazing with his instructions and very helpful. Cedric was a great driver too. Fuse blew in kitchen when I tried to wash clothes and cook in oven and hob but solved that problem by eating out. 😆
Felt right at home, makes me want to rent again when I come to Paris. Theo the best!

Sophie's place was truly great--well appointed, just like the pictures. And, of course the balcony is really a huge bonus. The view cannot be beat. The host was incredibly responsive and met me at check-in and check-out. And, when my work schedule changed and I had to leave a day early they did not hesitate to accommodate my request. I was there during an extreme heat wave and while it was hard to stay cool (for anyone in Paris--most apartments do not have AC) it was great to have a fan and shutters to keep the apartment shaded during the day. I would happily stay at Sophie's next time I am in Paris.
Our second stay at Parc Royal. The apartment is great, the location is lovely. We had a fantastic experience

We spent a month at Sylvie's place with our two young children and had such a wonderful time, we would have gladly stayed in her apartment forever! As antique lovers and avid readers, we felt right at home surrounded by Sylvie's beautiful furniture, rows and rows of leather bound books, and lovely little paintings tucked everywhere. Our daughters loved their kids' room and enjoyed combing through the books to learn french numbers, colors, and phrases. The location could not have been better- with delicious boulangeries, cafes, and little markets just outside our door and proximity to some truly stunning parks, we didn't have to leave our neighborhood for the essentials. Museums, river walks, and plenty of other sites were a nice walk away, and we had plenty of accessible trains to choose from as well. We'd love to plan more long stays in Paris, and we'd happily return to Sylvie's place again and again!

Great space for the 6 of us as a home base during our 3 days in Paris. We were super happy that there was air conditioning as the temps were hot out when we were there. The teens enjoyed having the TV to chill out after a long day touring. Was nice to have a washing machine. No dryer so must hang dry clothes. Not a big deal just keep in mind for drying time. Locations was fine- was about 30 minutes walking and metro to most tourist spots, but Paris is a big city.
Tatianna was a graciously accommodating host and facilitated a wonderful stay at her beautiful apartment. Highly recommend. Thank you!
We stayed at this air bnb for only 1 night and we were grateful for the opportunity. It is in a great location very close to Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées.
We loved our stay. Such a great location, central enough to walk everywhere but also nice and quiet for sleeping. It was very chic and welcoming, we would love to stay again!

Location is great. The terrace is a highlight. We enjoyed drinks before dinner or just to chill out for a while. Very close to most places. Plenty of cafes, markets, groceries and restaurants across the street
We had a lovely stay in Paris on Ile St. Louis! Even in the heat of summer, the apartment in the middle of the Seine was cool in the evening, and the location was perfect!

Beyond the issue with the delay in check-in, a number of the electric outlets didn’t work, which was a problem given how hot it was, and we needed to plug in fans. It would also have been useful to have a manual for the laundry machine since it was complicated to figure out. Otherwise, it was an excellent apartment that matched the description and the pictures on the site and we were very happy to be there. We love the proximity to the metro and the location. The host was extremely responsive.

What a great part of Paris to call home for a few days! Fantastic cafes, restaurants and shops. Easy access to everything on foot or via public transport. Everything you need in and around this compact apartment for a great stay.

Follow the host’s instructions on checkin exactly. The entry door to the compound is deceiving but once you find the intercom box, it was easy. The unit is located near a metro stop and an easy walk. It was very quiet and comfortable unit. The host was great and very responsive to our questions before and during our stay.

As a solo traveler I really liked the locations felt safe. The apartment was the right size for me and decorated beautifully Jesse was amazing with excellent communication and support when needed. I would’ve loved the apartment to be a little more cleaner as there was hairs on the floor but apart from that loved my stay

Good spot for a night's accommodation, the loft was clean when we arrived, had everything we needed, plus some great views to boot. Just be aware of the negatives that arise as inevitabilities of a property like this. For example, I'm 6'3", so the ceilings of this Parisian loft definitely weren't the most comfortable for me, but they were just fine for my 5'5" girlfriend! The stairs can also be an annoyance after a long day of walking around, especially since they can be uneven at times. Again, these are all unavoidable issues that are inherent to this type of property, not shortcomings to this specific listing. The only thing I would ask to be improved is the shower curtain, which is effectively useless since water can splash right through. We ended up with a pretty significant water puddle as a result. Otherwise, the listing was great and served our purposes well, thanks!
Julia was indeed a superhost!!! She was responsive and clear on directions. Her place was perfect and the location truly made Paris feel like home.

My wife and I had a fantastic stay at Fabrices apartment. The space was clean, comfortable and well maintained. Our train to Paris was delayed and our check in host Alex was very patient and understanding about the timing of our arrival. He gave us a comprehensive overview of the flat and restaurant recommendations nearby. We stayed during an extreme heat wave but the flat was well equipped with AC and fan that made it more relaxing after a long day of exploring. It is a walk up apartment so there are stairs to contend with but it was worth it in the end to have a comfortable space to relax. Thank you to the team for the excellent service and sharing your home. All the best!

The flat was perfect for what we were looking for. The location is amazing! Everything is walkable and there are a bunch of great cafes all around. The host was incredibly friendly and helpful (especially when we locked ourselves out)! Thank you for the great stay!

⸻ Philippe is a great host. The apartment is spacious, functional, and very well located in a charming Parisian neighborhood. It was clean, tidy, and had all the amenities we needed for a comfortable stay. We truly appreciated the welcome chocolates — such a thoughtful touch! The apartment is also strategically located, with easy access to several metro lines, making it simple to get around the city. Philippe was always attentive to our needs and gave us great advice for making the most of our time in Paris. We highly recommend staying here!

The perfect location to attractions, transportation, bakery & restaurants and shops. The air conditioning really saved us during heat wave (40C) and we just stayed indoor for the afternoon after we have visited attractions in the morning, and before we go out again in the evening. The washing & drying machine worked perfectly and it finished washing & drying while we were out for attractions. The host is friendly & helpful. The powder room is a bit small but functional.
Really enjoyed our stay there. Michel, Cedric’s dad was really nice and the room is clean and perfectly located. Highly recommend.

It’s a very cozy Parisian apartment, equipped with everything you need. The room is very spacious and charming, it’s light and sunny inside. There are a lot of interesting decorative things and details, I suppose it reflects the creative spirit of the host. The neighbourhood is great, there are 3 metro stations, TER station, several cafes, supermarkets and pharmacies nearby. Thank you for the opportunity to stay there, Sofia! Hope we’ll come back again.

We had an unforgettable stay in this charming apartment on Île Saint-Louis. The location is absolutely ideal—peaceful and picturesque, yet within easy walking distance of the Louvre, the Paris Opera, and countless world-class restaurants, including several Michelin-starred gems. The apartment itself was perfect for our visit. The bedroom air conditioning was a lifesaver during an unexpected heatwave and made sleeping comfortable every night. Having in-unit laundry was another huge plus, especially after long summer days of exploring the city. We appreciated the thoughtful touches and the authentic Parisian feel of the space, which added to the immersive experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy the best of Paris in comfort and style.

This was an absolutely perfect stay! I only stayed one night but I would absolutely come back for more. I actually think the room is cuter than the photos, breakfast was plentiful with fruits, croissants, plenty of cheeses and jams, tea, coffee. The room was perfectly clean and tastefully decorated, and the bathroom was small but very clean and well supplied. Can’t wait to come back here for my next Paris stay.
Thank you Marc for a great stay in your beautiful place! We were a family of 5, very spacious & walkable!
Beautiful location and beautiful apartment. There was AC which was phenomenal as we arrived during a significant heat wave. The apartment is delightful and very spacious.

We had a wonderful stay -- the location was amazing and within walking distance to so many amazing cafes and shops. The apartment was very comfortable and easily accommodated our family of six. Charles was a wonderful host -- very quick to respond and accommodate. We would be happy return to Paris and stay here again.

there was a heat wave in Paris during our stay, and the apartment got very hot. ventilation was not great, and with no air conditioning or even a fan to move the air around, it was unbearable. The host was unable to improve the situation ( we requested for a fan, but apparently they were sold out). Given how frequent heatwaves are in Europe, the host should provide a fan.

This place was perfect for my girlfriend and me for our week-long stay in Paris. It’s a few minutes from several metro stops and it’s in an area with many restaurants and several grocery stores. Very safe, peaceful and culturally diverse neighborhood. The apartment itself is just as shown and described in the listing. It has everything you’d need to be comfortable. We messed up and didn’t follow the check-in instructions so we ended up at the wrong building, but Benoit was very understanding and came to pick us up by car. We also locked the keys in the apartment by accident one day, and Benoit arranged to have us let back in within an hour. I highly recommend this place if you’re planning a stay near Nation in Paris.

It was a lovely airbnb. The bed was comfortable and the place was clean. It was all we needed. The only problem was it was a heatwave in Paris and there was no AC. There was a fan that was working hard. It did get very hot in the unit and took awhile to cool down with the heatwave so if you are sensitive to heat just be prepared.
Had a lovely stay with Delphine. She was friendly and helpful and the room was perfect. The flat was lovely also, very clean with nice decor

this was a nice easy stay for me and my girlfriend during our time in Paris! It was a bit hot inside with no A/C, but we also were there on the hottest day of the year. otherwise everything was great. easy walk ability to Montmartre

Great location, very close to train station, Eiffel tower and Trocadéro. The apartment itself was very comfortable as well and in the Summer it provided AC. A massive plus when you spend the whole day out with few cool places with AC. The perfect spot to recharge for more Paris exploration. Thank you!
Excellent location and apartment. Check in and check out flexibility & communication was amazing as we were traveling from/to the US. Highly recommend.

The sweetest little Parisian apartment in the Passy neighbourhood of Paris - walking distance to the Eiffel Tower! It is surrounded by charming shops and restaurants and is about a 10-minute walk to the metro. We loved everything about it. We were there in July during a very intense heat wave (and no AC!) It was challenging but we managed with cold showers, cold drinks, and laughter. We would not hesitate to stay here again. Merci, Julie!
That was one of the best apartments I had, since I started with Airbnb. Olivier hit my taste very well. I like to have the feeling to live amongst locals :-).
Maria’s place was great. Close to all the main museums, attractions and to the transportation system. We really enjoyed our time there! Thank you!

Pascal's place was a lovely little 1-bedroom in a great location. Central, not too busy, safe and easy walking distance to many options for food, drink, metro, parks and attractions. The only downside was that it was on the ground floor with no air conditioning, and we were there during the early July heatwave. Even with fans - which were MUCH appreciated! - it was difficult to set up a wind-tunnel through the apartment as the bedroom windows open into a garbage area. So it was tough to sleep, but that's pretty standard for Paris flats. Pascal was very responsive and helpful with tips for restaurants, shops, bakeries, etc. in the neighborhood. Great host and a super solid, clean and useful apartment. Highly recommend!
An incredible place to stay! We walked everywhere during out 4 days and didn't need to even take the metro once. So much great food around and very walkable. Beautiful apartment.
Place was great. Check in easy, balcony was beautiful and there is a bakery just down the road! Great area highly walkable.
Very good place in a nice sector. It’s safe, peaceful, and cozy. Mila made sure we had everything we needed from check-in to check-out. I recommend staying here.

Cons: Mildly inconvenient check-in process, drain was clogged so we had to give back the keys for a day (seems they’re working with only one set of keys for the place…?), wasn’t 100% clean. Pros: Cute playful kitten in the super cute atmospheric courtyard, good location, responsive and helpful host.

Fuchong’s place was exactly as described and he was very communicative and accommodating during our stay. We had some difficulties with initially finding the space, however it was quickly resolved with his quick communication. Note: one of the rooms is directly above a busy street so it can be slightly bothersome for a very light sleeper. It is also in the best location making it great to travel to various parts of Paris. Overall, we had a great stay!

Monique and her husband were wonderful host. I really appreciated for their help during my journey. The house is amazing, located in the center of city, very safe, and the room is quiet and tidy, also with a good view. The restaurants and shops nearby are also good, I can get whatever I want. I had a good week here. :)
What a wonderful place, hosts and location. What all other great reviews said are accurate. Would love to come back!
Wonderful location, extremely good value for money. I had absolutely everything I needed, perfect for a solo visit. It was easy to check in. Thank you!

Erwin’s place was great! We visited Paris during a huge heatwave with temps reaching 104 degrees Fahrenheit. Despite the lack of air conditioning, Erwan’s place stayed cool, and we especially appreciated the Dyson fan! Easy access to transit and many great restaurants and bars nearby. We’d absolutely stay in this apartment again.

Vincent’s place was great! He was very helpful with our every need and checked in on us and the kids during the week. We absolutely love this neighborhood and will definitely stay again when we’re back :)

Great location for our family of 6. Even with 6’7” kids, the twin beds were comfortable and long enough. Walked to the Eiffel Tower each day and watched the lights at night. Great restaurant recommendations and space was clean and well stocked.

Second time staying at Kathleen’s place and it was nothing short of great! As a female solo traveller, I always feel safe staying here. The location is perfect & Kathleen is a very welcoming host. Will deffo be coming back soon☺️

This was the ideal spot to spend two weeks in Paris. The location is perfect to walk everywhere & then also close to a multiple metro lines if you don't have the energy. JM was a super proactive host, even bringing extra fans during a heatwave without us even asking. would hope to stay here again the next time we're in town.

Beautiful, stylish and clean property in a really lovely and interesting youthful part of Paris. Montmarte very walkable, and bus/metro options to the city centre are convenient. Property is very well equipped for self catering. Just one note there are approximately 20 steps to get into the property. All in all a lovely stay in a fantastic city. Tara also provided excellent local knowledge. Thank you!

Our stay in Sofia’s place was nothing but wonderful. The room was very spacious and the bed was really comfortable. There is even a small balcony to feel the fresh air. The metro station is close by for easy transport, along with many restaurants and shops right outside the door.
Great location, as described the building is undergoing renovations, but the flat was great. Noise wasn't an issue and the view was amazing!
Great location, very noisy in the night and morning with rubbish bins and plates being stacked by the restaurants below.

We had a wonderful stay in Paris! The location was perfect — close to everything, yet quiet and comfortable. The apartment looks recently renovated, with a great kitchen and modern bathrooms. When we asked for an extra chair, the hosts went above and beyond by getting two brand-new ones for us. They were always friendly and quick to respond to any questions. The only minor downside was that the pillows and mattresses could have been a bit more comfortable. Overall, a great experience — we would definitely stay here again!
Incredible location! Quiet, clean, safe, and surrounded by beautiful architecture and amazing restaurants. Would 100% stay here again. Nothing bad to say about it.
Monique was very friendly and accommodating, she had great suggestions for restaurants and stuff to do. i felt very comfortable with the space and the area her home is located.
This is a perfect little hideaway in the middle of Paris. It is a typical, attic-floor space and feels very traditional. The view is amazing - you will not get better.

We enjoyed our stay. The location was so close to the metro train station as well as being close to lots of restaurants. We struggled a little with the stairs because we are unfit, but apart from that, the bed was comfortable and bathroom was gorgeous. Thank you for having us.

Fabulous location. Close to the metro and walking distance to plenty of amenities. Perfect for 4 of us to stay. A great base in Paris! Lisa sends lots of helpful information prior to arrival, which is great!
Great place to stay for a few days, nice area with supermarket and bakeries, close to the metro station too
This apartment is in a great location and very quiet. It has all the amenities we needed and the host was very responsive. It is a tiny apartment and would best suit a single person.

This apartment exceeded all expectations for us botanists visiting the Museum at Jardin des Plantes. We loved all the original historical features maintained in this modern conversion, the space (four good bedrooms each with a double bed, plus a sofa bed in a further massive living/dining room) the great views over the boulevard and its weekly market, the proximity to numerous, tourist free, reasonably priced local restaurants. It was clean, comfortable, good basic kitchen (we did not use), very secure. Will be looking to book again next year.

We had a great stay at C&J’s place! The apartment was very convenient and we loved the neighborhood. The space itself was tidy, clean, and comfortable. We enjoyed exploring the shops nearby and walking around. You were never far from a metro, and the area felt lively and safe. C&J communicated with us very well, and we were able to get questions answered quickly throughout our stay. Would definitely recommend and would opt to stay again in the future!

Beautiful place, great location. We had some difficulty getting in, and then even locking the door when we left. But Joffrey was a good and quick communicator to help problem-solve. A/C wasn't blowing cold air initially, but I raised the issue and Joffrey had someone come by to fix it. Then, it was too cold - but, better than the alternative! Overall, it was great and we'd stay here again.

Amazing location & very clean unit. Easy access to multiple subway lines & neighbourhoods. Sophie is a very friendly and responsive host which made the process and experience very pleasant. Would highly recommend this accommodation to anybody looking for a clean, safe and central location. Lovely balcony as well to enjoy a glass of wine and people watch!

As much as I would want to give this place a five stars, the value for money was just not there, it's on the sixth floor with no elevator and has no paper towels, shampoo or general amenities in the Airbnb so it's lacking a few things, however the place was clean and the host was very polite and responsive. I would recommend!
The apartment was really clean and close to the city center! Our family had a wonderful experience staying here!

My friend and I had a wonderful stay with Eloïse and Sashimi! The apartment is lovely and in a great location for the metro to get to attractions and explore the city. Eloïse was a wonderful host and very hospitable and responsive.

We had an amazing stay. The apparent was comfortable, spacious and inviting. Beds were very comfortable. The host is very responsive! I made the mistake of locking myself out if the apartment and did not realize it until I got back at 12am. I messaged the host and they replied within 5 mins with additional instructions. There were lots of coffee and pastry shops around. The apartment is a 10 minute walk to the shopping area and 20 minute walk to the louvre. The value for the price is great! This was my first air bnb experience and it was perfect!
We loved our short stay in Irunes lovely apartment. We found the place to be well equipped, clean, quiet and in a great location. Irune was a wonderful host. Thank you again for having us stay!

Overall, this was a very nice apartment and I would definitely stay again. The washer worked well and included detergent, the bed was comfortable, and the sheets were clean. The location was great—very close to the metro and less than 30 minutes by train to major tourist spots. The only downsides were that the fridge, while spotless, had a strange smell, and there was mold on the shower caulk. Aside from that, everything else was excellent and I’d happily return.
Our stay here was perfect the place was so nice and quiet with a bakery downstairs for our morning croissant and quiche. Mathieu the host was always quick to respond.

I had a great stay at this apartment right on the Champs-Élysées! The location is absolutely unbeatable and despite being in the heart of the city, the apartment was peaceful, and very comfortable. The air conditioning was a life saver for the Parisian heat! Eliav was super responsive, and welcoming from the moment I booked.

Well located near busy Montparnasse station. Very good security. Close to good supermarkets & restaurants. Clean & neat with a friendly responsive host. Traffic & klaxon noise well muted if double glazed windows closed.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment! The location was perfect—central and close to everything but still quiet at night. You have several options as restaurant around. The place was clean and stylish. The host was welcoming and easy to communicate with. I’d definitely stay here again on my next trip to Paris!

This apartment is so much more beautiful than the photos convey. The island is equally as special. Not only is it close to everything, but it has so many amazing places to explore. Of all the places I’ve stayed in Paris, I think this is my new favorite.
We had a wonderful stay at Catherine’s flat. It’s beautiful and has everything we needed. Highly recommended!

This is the 5th time I have rented a place in Paris on Airbnb and this was our favorite! Right in the center of great restaurants and shopping . This was the most comfortable space, two actual bedrooms, big living room,with tons of light and great balcony. This will be my first choice when I am back in Paris!

I had a wonderful 4 day stay at Julien’s. The place was tidy, calm, and in a lovely area. Happy about the fridge and private shower in the room! A perfect place to discover Paris from, and Julien was welcoming and accessible as a host 😊

Very nice walkable apartment with comfortable beds (including sofa bed),good air conditioning, clean facilities and all required amenities. Host was also flexible and met us early when we needed to enter an hour early to drop bags.

I love staying for a short break in Giovannis beautifully designed apartment - secluded, peaceful and well connected: a perfect base. A special place which I’d definitely book again. Giovanni was responsive & friendly without being intrusive at all - for me, perfection!

Astrid’s place was absolutely wonderful; peaceful, spotless, and spacious. It was perfect for our family, especially with two little ones. They thoughtfully left out a ton of toys, which our kids were thrilled about! Astrid and Donatien were incredibly friendly and responsive. They kindly let us check in early after a long flight and shared plenty of great local recommendations for family friendly activities. We truly loved our stay and would be thrilled to come back!
the place is near to metro abnd snt Champ's Elyse street , the bad point internet is very week and checkin is at 4 pm

A bijou of an apartment in a charming neighbourhood with a wide selection of eateries, artisan bakeries and outlets offering fresh, quality produce. The accommodation is both comfortable & quiet with every amenity at hand for a relaxing stay. Its location is perfect - Montmartre is easily accessible on foot & Moulin Rouge is just a 10 mins walk away - with excellent transport links for wider sightseeing opportunities in the city and beyond. The host, Anne, is prompt and precise in her communications and her welcoming touch is just lovely. Thank you for a delightful stay 🙂

Marie was incredibly accommodating as I gave her very little notice of my pending arrival in Paris and she pulled out all stops to make her place available to me. Well located and very Parisienne being small but a great use of space.I very much enjoyed my 4 days in Paris staying there.
This place was so cozy and such a good location. The host was so lovely and gave me a recommendation upon my request. Definitely recommend staying here!

We loved Helenas apartment, felt home in Paris. The 12 arrodissiment it's a wonderful place with all you need after the touristic crowed area's. We thank Helena, she is a great host, and would love to come back.

Cedric was absolutely delightful to deal with from the get go. He was helpful in every respect and I can’t wait to stay at his place again, it ticked all of my boxes. His apartment is in a fabulous location, great restaurants only minutes away, lots of public transport options and iconic landmarks within 10 minutes walk.
I had a lovely stay at Philippe and Antonie's charming flat! It's is in a wonderful location. Checking in and out was easy. And they are communicative and responsive hosts.

Great location with an amazing bakery right in front of the building – you can literally smell the fresh croissants through the window! The apartment is on the 6th floor and only accessible by stairs, so keep that in mind. It’s quite small, but perfectly adequate for a comfortable stay. The only downside was the bathroom ventilation, which occasionally brought in an unpleasant smell (like garlic and drainage). It might be worth checking. Other than that, it’s a fantastic spot and I’d stay here again!

Our family of 4 absolutely loved this apartment and the surrounding neighborhood!! The apartment was exactly as described with a full kitchen, cold Air Conditioning (which was key during our 90 degree heat wave), and private bedrooms. Communication with the host was superb. They were quick to respond and very friendly. We highly recommend this apartment!!
Highly recommend this place clean, stocked, and host was very friendly. The eiffel tower view was amazing.
Located near the Metro, very easy to find. Was a great place to stay while in Paris. The street was quite. Would recommend and hope to stay again next time I'm in Paris.
Very nice and clean. The apartment was sparse in items but it was nice and clean. Good location and walkable to shopping, restaurants and an express supermarket.
Stayed here with my wife and 2 kids… Great location! Lots of restaurants near! Clean apartment, it’s Small … but thats Paris! Just need to be ready for the stairs… it’s located on the top floor.

Brahim was very responsive. When we needed something he was right there to help. The location was perfect, safe and in a good neighborhood. The metro was very close to the apartment and the apartment was close to all the attractions. The bed was so comfortable and we slept very well. It had a nice fan to keep us cool. It is near a lot of great restaurants. We will stay here again when we come next time!!

The Passy neighborhood was great. Everything was in walking distance; grocery, wine, cafes, Metro, coffee shop. Living area was comfortable, bedrooms spacious and kitchen well stocked. Overall a great stay.
Excellent stay overall. The host is very involved, which can be construed as overbearing, but she is always helpful, kind, and responsive. I would wholeheartedly recommend this Airbnb.

The most lovely stay in Paris! Neighborhood was delightful and it was the perfect place to watch fireworks for the 14th without having to go anywhere--we just stood out front and headed right to bed afterwards. Home is just lovely and we will miss it!
Great stay. Vitalina was very good to deal with. And the apartment in walking distance from Gare du Nord. Thank you Vitalina.

We were a family of 4, and enjoyed Claire’s place a lot. It is located in a private and peaceful neighbourhood with some embassies around, and close to Bois de Boulogne park. Claire was there to meet us at pur arrival, and provised some food and water in the fridge. 10/10

Arianne is by far the most responsive and helpful host I've had in all my Airbnb stays. Thank you, Arianne, for the recommendations, the help, and most of all - the top notch hospitality and kindness as we explored Paris. Arianne's home indeed feels like a away from home as every detail and amenity is thought through from entryway to kitchen to bedrooms to bathrooms. The use of space is commendable for it's comfort and decorated with gorgeous, unique art. Arianne's home is very close to a myriad of shops, cafes, restaurants, and metro stops. The Notre Dame is mere blocks away. You cannot go wrong with this home or location for a stress-free and cosmopolitan stay in Paris.
Very Nice appartment and nice host easy to communicate with her she is super reactive appartment very clean will be back

this place was great for us, it is centrally located and walkable to many restaurants and breweries and coffee shops. the host was very responsive and the place was super clean. we had a great time. thank you for sharing your place with us. we recommend this place to anyone visiting Paris. hope to be back soon.
Absolutely adorable apartment. We felt right at home. Peggy was always responsive to our needs, helpful and accommodating. A wonderful experience for our first Airbnb stay
Amazing gem to call home base in Paris. My wife and our two kids really loved the neighborhood. Apartment is clean, just like the photos and beats a cramped hotel room. Would definitely stay again!
This airbnb is a romantic and beautiful place for a Paris getaway! Beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower and everything is within walking distance, if its not, the metro is closeby!
