Had a great stay here. The host was very responsive and provided us with everything we needed and responded quick. Location is nice. Plenty of restaurants and shops nearby. No ac so the place was hot when we would go in after a long day but they did provide lots of fans in replacement.

Helene and her husband were very kind and hospitable. My luggage was heavy, but they thoughtfully helped me carry it upstairs. I really enjoyed the time spent talking with them. The room wasn’t big, but it was very clean and tidy, with plenty of light and a small indoor garden. Since it was the blooming season, it looked very lovely. Thank you for taking such good care of me — I hope we have the chance to meet again.

It was an amazing Airbnb stay for six people! It’s so close to many restaurants, bars, and shops! There’s even a grocery market with a 2 min walk. The area is always busy and we were prepared with the late night loudness thanks to the reviews. This Airbnb looked just as described. It’s very clean and feels very homey. I would recommend for anyone coming to visit!

Great location for sure! Very clean, has all you need. Safe option for a short stay. The downside is that only a living room has a real window to the outside, the two bedrooms have “windows” to the living room.

We had a great stay at Fouad’s apartment for one night! It is very small, so good for a couple for a short stay, but had everything we needed! The location is wonderful, easy to walk or catch the metro anywhere. It’s in a quiet courtyard which was really nice. The pull out couch was actually quite comfortable. We even were able to leave our bags for a few hours after checkout. Overall a great stay and would stay again.

Luxurious place in the heart of the Marais! Vincent was very responsive throughout our stay. The place was immaculate and the beddings were extremely comfortable. Wish we could have stayed for longer!
This place is in a great location. The host is very responsive. We had an issue and it was addressed immediately.
really enjoyed our stay! perfect location to see the most popular sights, either by walking or the nearby Metro, and great shops and restaurants nearby.
Amazing central location. Fast wifi, easy check-in. Was very quiet when we were there even though next to bars etc
Lovely little apartment in a beautiful surrounding. Perfect for a few days in Paris 🇫🇷

Beautiful apartment just a few mins away from a metro station, but still with lots greenery all around. Nicely furnished apartment with a good view. Close to a beautiful park and some good places to eat.

Highly recommend! But please pay attention to the apartments being on 6th floor - it’s mentioned in description and Marie also made sure that I know about it before booking. Apartments were great, very clean, had everything needed. Located closely to bus/metro station, neighborhood itself is also very walkable.

We had a lovely stay at this apartment. It is a wonderful location, walking to Le Marais and the sites along the river and a bike lane for easy riding elsewhere. Plenty of room for us and our three kids. Easy to find and access and as others have said excellent bakery right downstairs.
Great apartment near lots of restaurants and 2 different metro lines. Balcony over looking park was beautiful and apartment was very spacious. Would definitely stay here again!
Benjamin is super helpful in getting us checked in with detailed instructions. The place is cute and cozy with a great location - close to a lot of restaurants and many things to explore

For 6 people, this was a very comfortable and open living space. The bathrooms were clean, and the shower pressure was amazing! The area was big enough to house 6 people, including luggage & souvenirs! I recommend this AirB&B!!!
Pierre is a very polite and responsive host. The location was superb and the house clean, with all the amenities available.
This apartment is in a lovely neighborhood in Paris with lots of restaurants. It is clean and quiet. We had a great stay and would recommend it.
Amazing place. We had a great time. Everything is clean and new. And the host took great care of us. Thank you

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was spotlessly clean, very comfortable, and in a fantastic location — surrounded by shops, restaurants, and everything you could need. The coffee was great, and we really appreciated how easy everything was, from check-in to check-out. Communication with the host was smooth and helpful throughout. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Paris! Joaquin A.

Such a great place to stay! Did not get to meet Anthony in-person, but he provided clear instructions and kept in touch throughout our stay. The apartment had everything we neded and so much more! Cosy and functional; well-conected by buses and metro, but also walkable. Really enjoyed the neighbourhood. Thank you for having us; we'd love to come back!

Absolutely wonderful stay at Francois and Judith’s home! From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by this friendly and helpful couple. They were always available if we had questions, but also gave us plenty of space to relax and enjoy our time. The location was peaceful and convenient—close to everything we needed. The house was spotless, well-maintained, and very comfortable. The beds were especially cozy, and the entire space felt like a true home-away-from-home. A major highlight for the kids was the fantastic selection of books and games—they were entertained for hours! We stayed for four days and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Francois and Judith were flexible, thoughtful, and made our stay seamless. Highly recommend!
We had a wonderful stay at Charles place. The location was awesome. The apartment was as presented in the pictures. Definitely a recommended location for Paris.
The place has everything you need. It is close to metro in a quiet neighborhood. Nicolas is a really great host and it is really easy to communicate with him.

Evangelos is fantastic! Very accommodating! Professional but friendly, open-minded and easygoing. He was extremely hospitable and I felt right at home. The building architecture is gorgeous and the suite and bathroom are private. The neighborhood (16th arrondissement) is pleasant and walking distance to great restaurants for all budgets, parks and the river. At the river there is a huge boat that has a luxury fitness center with rooftop pool, nearby tennis courts and entertainment!

The apartment was nice, as well clean. We were out and about most of the time so mostly there just at nite. We were not given (that i know of) the code to get in the building. Someone that lived there was nice enough to give us theirs, so i didnt bother to reach out to Daniel. Daniel was always very responsive to my questions. He had someone there when we arrived to let us in. all in all it was a nice place to stay and lots of local restaurants and bakeries. once we figured out the metro we got around easily. Thank you Daniel.

We were touched by the trust that the host and his children placed in us by opening their home while they were away, including all their incredible toys and books which kept our kids entertained for hours. The location is stunning overlooking the park. It's a quiet neighbourhood away from the tourist centres, but with excellent bus and metro links. It was a perfect base for us for our short stay in Paris and we would happily stay here again if we could.

The apartment was close to several subway lines so perfect for what we needed, it was basically 20 minutes by public transport anywhere in the centre of Paris. If you're into micro apartments, this is for you. If you prefer a bit more space to lounge around, you might want to look elsewhere.

Fantastic stay in Paris! The apartment was clean, stylish, and perfectly located near Tour Eiffel . Domus was friendly and responsive, and check-in was super easy. I’d definitely stay here again — highly recommended!

This place is accurately described and provides a place to crash while exploring Paris. It's nothing extravagant and is rather small, about the size of a hotel suite. But the space has everything provided that is necessary, and it was clean. It's right next to Gare de Lyon, which is super convenient.

We had a very nice stay. Chokris small apartment is centrally located among small shops and stores. Communication was quick and friendly, and we were even allowed to check out an hour or two later, which was very helpful. We can only recommend this apartment.

Fantastic place to stay ! Great for walking exploring Paris , great location , easy to get to , Metro right out front , taxis , restaurants, cafes, a much more neighborhood feel to Paris , away form the main tourist attractions but close enough to have easy access if you want to go check them out. A perfect way to experience the city !

Alice was a great host, very friendly and flexible with our check in and check out which was extremely helpful on our last day so I really appreciated that! The apartment had everything you could need and was very comfortable and homely. The area is well connected and safe! We had a lovely stay thank you so much Alice!

The room at Pierre is perfectly located in the center of Paris. 10min walk to Notre Dame, 50min to the Eiffel Tower, and 30min to Louvre. Pierre was an excellent host, very friendly and always helpful. We enjoyed our stay so much!
Wi-Fi did not work for two of the days on our trip, which was frustrating. They are only provide one key, which doesn’t allow for much flexibility when traveling with a family.
Was much smaller than expected, the shower was leaking all over the floor, apart from pots and pans, no cooking essentials like advertised and floor was a bit dirty

Beautiful luxury apartment in a great location. It was very clean and comfortable for our family of four. The host was great and the service was excellent. We recommend and would definitely stay again.

Good quality, good location. Fast communication. Each move needs to be accompanied with the forms filling. The biggest amount of any kind of confirmations in my life. I don’t know why one should verify all his docs when he already did it in Airbnb several times. But the quality of the apartment was very good. Won’t do it one more time, but it was good.
Really nice place, very close to the subway and with an incredible host! Pierre is really helpful whenever you need it!! I really recommend this place if you’re staying in Paris

Good place for 1, location, cleaniness are both good. The host is fairly responsive. The problem with the place is that the bathroom fan makes loud noises and runs 24:7 and will turn itself on 10 minutes after you turn it off, which made my sleep less pleasant. Other than that, it’s a good place. 4/5.
the flat is in a great location and has everything you need! Alex wa Avery flexible with checking and check out times which we were very grateful for!

Absolutely lovely stay! The apartment was spacious, clean, and very well maintained. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the bathtub was a perfect way to relax after a long day of walking around Paris. The living room was tastefully decorated, and the couch was so plush and cozy. The location couldn’t be better, wonderfully walkable with tons of great food options and charming brasseries nearby. Highly recommend checking out “Big Black Cook” an amazing, underrated spot just around the corner. Truly a 10/10 experience. Would definitely stay here again!

Julia was a phenomenal host and her apartment is in a wonderful location. She was very responsive to our messages, which made the process of staying with her seamless. Her apartment was clean and set up well for our visit. I would gladly stay in her apartment the next time I'm in Paris!

We had a mixed experience during our stay. The location is fantastic, quiet, safe, and super convenient for getting around. The unit itself was very clean overall, except for one towel that had stains and holes when we arrived. Thankfully, the host was responsive and brought a replacement right away. The rooms are quite small and got very hot at night. We initially thought there was AC in the bedrooms but found out later, after asking the host, that there are only fans available. It would have been helpful to know that ahead of time. The beds were not very comfortable, which made it hard to get a good night’s sleep. The WiFi also stopped working our last evening and unfortunately was never fixed. The shower was functional but not well-contained. Water would spill onto the bathroom floor, which made things a bit messy. Overall, the space is clean and in a great location, but a few comfort and commun
Great place! Clean, great neighborhood, everything worked and was easy to navigate, and Miguel was polite and responsive.

Place was amazing and is close to metro. It’s very walkable and had a cute courtyard. The remodeling is definitely visible and made for a good stay. The spoons and dishes were a bit unclean with some gunk stuck on it but that was easily washable with the Dishwasher. There was an issue about AC unit being in the description but not available but the host and Airbnb cleared it up for us. It was mostly due to bad translation. The unit doesn’t have AC but it does have mosquito nets and a very very powerful fan.

We (2 adults, 2 older kids) had a great stay in this apartment. If felt more like a hotel stay than an AirBnB. It has a sofa bed and a bed. Loved the little table, fridge and microwave for our baguette and croissant breakfasts. The location is great. We chose it because it is an easy walk from the train from CdG (Les Halles station), so no need for metro once you've arrived with your luggage if you can do a 10 minute walk. The street is quiet, the lobby is welcoming with someone there to. We walked everywhere and it is close to two main metro lines. We especially enjoyed rue Montorgeuil that had endless food choices, cafés and people watching. Brijid sent us recommendations, clear instructions and when I had a question, she answered instantly. I hope to return one day.

My stay was excellent. The apartment was spotless and located in an amazing area full of life, with plenty of places to eat and walk around. The host was kind and super responsive. Anytime I had a question, she replied immediately.

Nice location. 4 adults 2 kids very comfortable stayed. Easy to reach main touristic points by metro 9. House was so clean and host was so responsive. The grocery shop owner at the gate is extremely friendly and helpful. House utensils were so clean and the mirror in the living room shows you slimmer than you are which was a nice motivation to start the day after tasting all the great French food :-) Worths the money you pay for the house.

We loved our stay at Corinne’s place! It was spotless, well stocked, and in a great neighborhood. Walkable to several boulangeries, nice restaurants, and a well connected metro stop. Beds were comfortable (including the Murphy bed). We would definitely stay again!
Great host. very responsive. the place was spotless and steps away from great cafés and boulangeries. also close by is Gare de Lyon which has trains to most places.
This was a great place to stay, super clean and safe, this place is located next to a lot of restaurants where you can walk pretty much safe.
Amazing place! Beautiful inside! I felt like I was living in a French dream. Clean! And a Dyson hair dryer!!!! I would highly recommend! The area is great. Totally worth it! Thank you!
Loved staying here! The location was great. Many restaurants all around, and walking distance to many places we wanted to go to. If we couldn’t walk there, the train was in walking distance.
Nice place overall. Pretty area. Elevator was helpful. Nice large bedroom. Sofa bed was difficult to pull. Place was not super clean unfortunately.

We had a great stay! The accommodation was spotless and had everything we needed. While it was a bit further out from the main attractions, the nearby train station made it super easy to get into central Paris and Disneyland. Joy was also friendly and responsive throughout our stay.
Had a wonderful time with my mother and daughter! The place was perfect and in a great location for sight seeing.

Linda’s place was small but matched the listing. It had a full washer and dryer, unusual in small Paris apartments. And it was just fine for me and 2 kids. Would probably feel small for 3 adults. The location is convenient, near Chatelet/Les Halles and its many RER and subway lines. Only unexpected downside is that the building is a bit rundown and that a couple of times a (harmless) homeless person was seen sleeping inside the building, past the main entry door. The host’s instructions to enter and use the apartment were very clear and she was very responsive.

Wonderful stay at Monique’s home! My sister and I were greeted and taken care of. She was very friendly and accommodating. Our room was perfect and comfortable. We slept so well. Her home is in walking distance to so many amazing restaurants and attractions. Wonderful stay!

Marlene's is a wonderful place to stay in Paris, on such a beautiful street. Very close to multiple metro stops, and a short walk to fantastic restaurants and parks. The apartment is exactly as seen in the photos and felt quite spacious for both of us for the week. Cannot wait to return
Great place to stay in the district - very central to Montmartre. Place was small, but we'll organized.
Good tiny apartment with great community around! A lot good restaurant and very nice and friendly Parisians!

Ines’ place is in a great location in Paris, close to metro stations to get to all the keys spots. As other reviews have mentioned, there are a lot of stairs to get up to the top floor so be warned if you’re bringing lots of luggage.
Lovely apartment in great location. Walkable to all main attractions, close to shops and restaurants. Clean and tidy with all listed amenities.
Nice room in a extremely good location. Patrick was very responsive and helpful. I would recommend to stay here for a few days in Paris
Great little apartment for solo traveler’s. The stairs are to be reckoned with if you have a lot of luggage but overall place was clean, modern and in an amazing location

We had a truly wonderful stay at Marie’s beautiful apartment on Rue Custine in Paris 💫 From the moment we stepped in, we were charmed by the elegant and artistic design — the rich tones, vintage touches, and mural wall gave the space such a cozy, Parisian flair. It felt like a boutique hideaway tucked right into the heart of the city! The location couldn’t have been better, just a short stroll from Montmartre and Sacré-Cœur, with cafés, bakeries, and metro stations all nearby. It was the perfect base to explore the city, but also a peaceful retreat to come back to after a long day of wandering. Every detail was thoughtfully curated, and Marie was a fantastic host.. responsive, warm, and helpful. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for an authentic and stylish Paris experience 🇫🇷🖤✨

Went to Paris to as my niece’s graduation gift, and had a wonderful time. We arrived early, and met with Adonis for key turnover. He was very sweet, nice and gave very clear instructions! (He also was very patient & encouraging when speaking French with my niece. Others in Paris were not so.) Elise was also very kind & communicated throughout our stay to make sure all was well. Place is super cute, area was easy to navigate. Beds were so comfy! You can hear the underground metro a tiny bit at night, but we are from big cities and it feels relaxing. (Like having a sound machine:) I would stay again… and again. Thank you Elise, Sébastien and Adonis!! We loved our stay!!

We stayed at this lovely apartment for three beautiful nights and couldn’t have been happier. Cedric was the perfect host, super responsive and helpful. The location was better than we could have imagined, with everything we needed within a few steps from the apartment. When (not if) we are back in Paris, we will 100% stay in the same place. It now feels a little like home to us. Thank you, Cedric!!!

This was probably one of the best apartments I’ve ever stayed in! Both Hermine and Sarah were incredibly nice and helpful! A whole stay was marvellous and felt like me and my wife have appeared in a fairytale. We would definitely want to come back next time we travel to Paris!
Fantastic stay! The room was very clean, well-furnished, and had everything we needed. The location was excellent — close to everything but still quiet and comfortable. Highly recommended!

It is in a fantastic location, easily accessible by public transport. There are lots of restaurants, supermarkets close by. The airbnb itself is clean, and the perfect amount of space for 2. I will definitely return next time i am in Paris!

Absolutely amazing Airbnb!! One of my favorites ever! The location was perfect. It was on a quiet side street, so we slept well, but it was still just steps to everything! We could easily walk to so many fun and historic things (including the Eiffel Tower and Champ de Mars), and there were countless restaurants just down the street. The apartment is on the ground floor, so getting our luggage inside was easy. The apartment is inside a secure entryway with double doors, but the area feels safe. Our host, Patrick, greeted us and helped us inside, ensuring we had everything we needed. He also arranged our airport transportation for us, and the car service was super nice. The space itself was clean and well-stocked. The beds were comfortable, the bathroom was spacious, and it was nice to be able to do laundry. Thank you to Patrick for this awesome experience. Cannot wait to return!!
Great place and very well connected to most places. And the best part is the place is just a 10mins walk from the river!

I stayed here with my two young children for the summer, and the location couldn’t have been better. It’s just a short walk to Place de la Concorde and the Tuileries Garden, and getting to the Grand Palais and the Louvre was incredibly easy. The host was proactive and thoughtful—he even offered to store our luggage before check-in and after check-out if needed. We didn’t end up needing it, but really appreciated the kind gesture.
loved the place and location, extreamely easy to get around some places that work till late to grab a snack

Our family of 5 our stay! Place was clean and comfortable. It was a huge bonus to have the delicious coffee machine every morning and also the free washers and dryers. We would definitely stay here again!! Thank you!

I took my mom to paris for both our first times and knew i needed to get us a place with the view of the Eiffel tower. They were supper responsive. The space was beautiful and perfect for 2 people. It included a full bathroom, kitchen and a little living space. The view was incredible. The elevator was down so it made for a fun check in. Be careful of the gates and doors as they are very heavy, we caught our fingers in it a few times. We walked the surrounding area and there was plenty of things to do and places to eat at. Overall we had an amazing stay and would highly recommend staying here. during your trip to paris.

Unbeatable Location & Great Hosts! Able to walk to all the sites within 15-20 minutes and located near the Metro. Many bustling restaurants on the street with multiple markets. The layout enabled great privacy between the two bedrooms..
Fabulous stay. Vincent is the most communicative host I have ever had. Excellent location, excellent apartment, excellent service.
It was amazing stay , house is well equipped and ideal for family or group stay , it is central location easy acsess of metro atation which is in front.

This place served us well for a group of 4, it had enough sleeping space with the bed + sofa bed. The bathroom is a bit small, but has everything needed. The location is really good, we did most things by walking but we always had good public transport options to get the to the main places of the city.

Amazing location in a peaceful, yet vibrant area of the city. We felt we could have added another day on in Paris so that we could have explored the area more. We would definitely book again. We loved that this was someone’s home, as opposed to an Airbnb business. As such, expect to find clothes, toys, full cupboards etc. on your arrival. Not a problem for us at all and we would recommend the apartment to anyone. Thanks for great communication throughout too.

Our family of 4 had a great stay. Very central location, walkable to many sightseeing options. Washer/dryer in unit was very helpful. Lots of eateries right outside the door. We encountered an unpleasant situation with a car rental on our check out day and the host was very flexible and understanding.

We had a wonderful stay here! The place had everything that we needed, the entire process from check-in to check-out went smoothly. Highly recommend this place if you're looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay in Paris.

I’ve never had a more pleasant stay at an airbnb. Host is incredibly responsive and very helpful. My room was clean, comfortable, and very cute! Because this spot is very close to everything it can be a little noisy but I had absolutely no issues. Breakfast was great, the location is great, and I felt very safe here as a solo traveller. The perfect place to stay for first time visitors!

Marie's apartment was amazing! It was roomy, comfortable, and had all necessary amenities. We were able to comfortably make her apartment our second home while our family was in Paris. The location is perfect- quite but conveniently located to several iconic sites, grocery stores, outstanding bakeries, and lovely restaurants. Marie's communication was outstanding and she was available to answer any questions we had and provided wonderful recommendations. This apartment will be our first choice on our next visit to Paris.

David and Marie's place was clean, spacious, and well-located. David was proactive with communication, was quick to respond to queries, and allowed us to check-in much earlier than the official time. Loved that the bathroom was separate from the toilet. Loved the high-end appliances (although it did make me feel a bit anxious about breaking things, but that's on me, it's clear from the pictures what was being provided). Loved the location, too; quiet but close to tourist attractions and surrounded by stores (my family really enjoyed the Passy Plaza and the big Monoprix inside). Thank you, David and Marie, for sharing your home with us!

Our family of four had a wonderful stay at Bruno's apartment, which was in a wonderful, walkable neighbor full of shops, parks, cafes, and restaurants. The space was roomy and as described. There is a strong use of incense/fragrances which may not bother some, but if you are sensitive to strong smells it's worth checking with the host before arrival. It was a wonderful stay in Paris, Bruno and Sacha were helpful and kind (and able to orient us in English), and we'd recommend it to others and happily stay again.

I wish I could attach a video showing this amazing home. It was beyond our expectations! The view and location is spectacular! The first night we opened the large window and watched on the hour, the Eiffel tower sparkle for five minutes. Three generations….granddaughter, daughter and mom…amazing memories 🩷. Walking to the Eiffel Tower, strolling along the Seine. Our amazing adventure…Seine River cruise, Eiffel Tower tour, Disneyland, Bouillon Pigalle, Montmarte tour, Versailles and the Louvre. Thank you for opening your home to us to enjoy Paris
Checkmyguest sent detailed instructions with photos to get to the place. They were very responsive when we asked for early check in. The place was spotless and clean.

Pascal’s place was perfect as a place to explore Paris from! The neighborhood is so beautiful and walkable (full of great shops and markets and restaurants). Pascal had lots of great recommendations and was so helpful and responsive. We will definitely try to stay here again the next time we are in Paris!
clean and well maintained apartment in an excellent location. Very close to Gare de Lyon for easy transit to anywhere in Paris. Marlène was a excellent host who with great communication.

Stayed at Chloe's apartment for a second year in a row which is a testament to how much we like it here! Great communication and easy check-in instructions from Chloe, apartment suits our set-up and is easy walking distance from Gare du Nord (as we arrived by Eurostar). Really enjoyed our stay - the canal at the end of the road is delightful and we even managed to find a couple of running routes nearby. Recommend.
Excellent stay! Plenty to eat and do around the accommodation. Peaceful locale, stayed with 2 adults and a 9 and 6 year old. Thank you!

This is the best apartment I have ever stayed in. Amazing location, and the building itself is fascinating — a former industrial space with incredibly high ceilings and beautiful architecture. The interior is stunning: designer furniture, perfect finishes, top-quality appliances and kitchenware. Everything is beautiful, convenient, and thoughtfully arranged. The hosts were extremely kind and accommodating. Absolutely exceptional in every way!
The apartment is in a great walkable location to many attractions. It had everything we needed. And Cedric is a great host - proactive communicator and friendly. We had a wonderful time!
Very good customer service, very clean rooms, very good location, train up the road and buses, good restaurants and convenience store everywhere. very close to sacre cour too
Had a great stay here. Ideal for what we were looking for. Things are a bit sketchy around the train stations, but avoiding going past them, not a bad location

Beautiful apartment! Squeaky clean, and all essentials provided. The bed and the pillows were very comfortable. Fantastic location in The Marais area of Paris. Restaurants, cafes and good shopping all around. The metro a 5 minute walk from the apartment. Honestly a great place to stay!
The view, the location, and the amenities were key to a great home base while we stayed in Paris for 10 days. We would want to stay at this same place every time we visit Paris if it was possible!
We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was beautiful and just what we were looking for. We would absolutely return again.
Paul was an amazing host and very helpful. The place was amazing with good lighting and secure. Very easy to move around the neighborhood.

This is a fantastic apartment in a great location. So central but also very peaceful at night. It was incredibly comfortable to sleep here and just relax after a busy day. Super easy to find and access and Raphael was extremely responsive and helpful throughout our stay. I highly recommend and we would definitely stay again.
Very nice place and recommended. Corentine is friendly and communicated well. Overall, an easy stay in Paris!
No mirror in apartment Very small apartment hard to place baggage in a room Check in very late
What a wonderful appartement in front of the Eiffel Tower. Very professional and reactive host. Perfect for our city trip with our children and our dog

Great apartment in a great location. Ac was huge as it was quite hot while we were there. Traveled with our two kids and one slept in the bed and the other happily used the pull out couch. Host gave clear instructions on airport transfer. Tons of great restaurants nearby and easy walk (25 min) to notre dame. We even walked to the Eiffel Tower though my kids were miserable about it. Stopping at carrette for hot chocolate and cream made up for it a bit. There was no laundry detergent and we had banked on doing a load when we arrived. We offered to get the detergent and they could reimburse us. They declined. Wasn’t worth a fight over 3 euro detergent and we otherwise had a good experience. Black out curtains and fans

A real treat to stay in such an elegant Paris apartment. Highly recommended. It was not just a centrally located place to stay but part of the Paris experience spending time in such a beautiful home. Everything is as described. The only negative is such a classic building doesn’t have AC, and the list of do’s and dont’s is a little oppressive. But would return in a heartbeat
Patrick is very responsive and friendly. He helped us with everything in the checkin. The location is good.
Loved our stay! Place was comfortable and spacious. Showers and AC worked great! Super smooth check in and host was proactive and responsive. Good restaurants and bakeries just a few steps away.

Thomas is a very nice and responsive host. The apartment is very close to metro, feels safe and quiet. Nice and clean inside, the bed on the stairs is a bit challenging for people with mobility problems. Overall, we loved this place and would recommend this to others.

The apartment is as advertised in a great location for sightseeing and visiting all that Paris has to offer. The apartment was clean and perfect for 3 people. The fans were a life saver in the summer heat.

Fantastic area and apartment. The fully stocked kitchen is the highlight. We had a very responsive agency/concierge who remained available for questions around the clock, even on Sundays. We appreciated the responsiveness very much. Apartment looks just like the pictures.

Ana‘s apartment is in a great location, 5 minutes on foot to the metro. The place was sparkling clean, looked like in the fotos. It would have been nice to have a second fan, as it was 35 degrees but other than that it was perfect. Ana was responsive and kind. I can recommend her place warmly.

Sophie was more than accomodating! She was kind! My luggage zipper broke and she found two nearby luggage shops in the neighborhood where I could go look for a replacement! Will always try to stay with her when I visit Paris again.

Our second trip to this amazing apartment. It is such a great place, with the little balcony overlooking the area, close to the subways etc. But not the overcrowded place that Paris can be. The hosts was great and very helpful. We will come again.

The place was exactly like the photos, and the apartment is all on the ground floor. It was easy to check into and find using Anne’s instructions. The kitchen/living room was well stocked, clean and comfortable. The bedrooms were both spacious with a good amount of room for your luggage. The hoover and washing machine were easy to use, just remember to bring some detergent. It’s helpful that the toilet is separate to the shower room allowing four of you to get ready at the same time. All in all it was a wonderful stay and I would look to stay there again. PS: Thank you for the madeleine’s :)
always there to help out and very responsive. excellent location close to the metro and restaurants and to Sacre coeur. I would come back for sure.
Very good location. It's quiet in the nighttime that I can sleep very well. I love it. They're very nice and responsible. Highly recommend.

Everything was perfect. The apartment was great. Antoine was always available for any question we had with a prompt answer and very good tips. It was a great stay and we would love come back next time in Paris. Thanks Antoine
A very cozy apartment within walking distance from many attractions in the city. Would highly recommend staying here and will seek it out next time I visit!

A lovely location and accomodation to use as a base to explore Paris. Fantastic instructions from the hosts pre and during the visit that made our trip even better. Beautiful apartment in a very secure location. Taxi and Uber easy to catch and just 5 mins walk from a Metro. Local bars as well if you need. Would totally recommend for a couples or 2 couples stay in Paris. A la Prochaine!

Wonderful stay the location is excellent. It was perfect for our group of 4. Host was helpful and responsive. No problems and we had a great stay. It was hot when we were there and no air so something to be aware of if going in the summer.

The apartment was fabulous and in a great location. It was spotlessly clean and beautifully furnished. The local bakery was divine and there were lots of places to eat and drink close by and some more great places further up the canal! Vincent was a great host and gave us some great recommendations for our stay. We would definitely stay here again.

We loved staying at Didier’s apartment. It is beautiful and well furnished. The bathroom is newly updated and nice. The beds are comfortable and the rooms are a good size. It is located on a pedestrian street with everything one could want in Paris (bakeries, butchers, restaurants, etc.) and 5 minutes from the beautiful Parc Monceau. I would recommend staying at Didier’s apartment.

Amazing, unbeatable location! You can walk out and find lots of places to eat and walk around. The place was clean, convenient and comfortable. Host was easy to communicate with, and we all enjoyed our stay here.
We had a wonderful stay. The weather was much warmer then we expected and we requested extra fans and they were delivered that same day.

This apartment was a great find! Three people fit here comfortably and everything was just as pictured. Marie is a very attentive host as she communicated frequently and always offered any assistance, as well as great recommendations in Paris.

This apartment is simply the most beautiful, peaceful place I've ever stayed in Paris. The high ceilings, comfortable bedding and tasteful decor in this high end apartment makes Paris even more magical. Everything was great from start to finish. I hope to stay there again in the future.

Nice, small, cozy, and charming place in a great location (just 2 minutes to various metro stations), with restaurants and shops nearby. Perfect spot for exploring Paris, and the flat also has a true Parisian feel — more like visiting someone’s characterful home than staying in a random, impersonal Airbnb with Ikea furniture. I felt very happy staying here.

It was located right in the heart of the City but we surprised by how quiet it was once you were inside the gates. Despite being a serious heatwave, Yohann had provided a number of fans which meant that we all slept well. Great choice for staying a few days with the family including a 4 year old and a baby.

Very neat and clean tiny appartment in nice neighbourhood. The appartment is at the back of the building so it’s nice and quiet, while there’s plenty restaurants, supermarkets, a park and a cute vintage book market at walking distance - as well as easy access to the public transport to go to the heart of the city. Eric was responsive and I also got the informations of one of the neighbours in case I needed to communicate about the booking.
It was clean, spacious, great location and hosts were accommodating. 5/5 Would definitely book again! 🌟

Julien was a great host. He was responsive, respectful and helped when we needed it. The apartment is in an excellent location for easy travel. Lots to do and see close by and quiet considering the noisy streets below.
Beautiful apartment and great host, the air conditioning was a life saver in the heatwave ! Would definitely recommend!

We loved our stay at Aude’s place. Travelling with a baby we wanted a bit of space. Best location, nice and spacious and beautiful breeze and place to chill on a summers evening. Aude was great on the communication. Sad to leave!

The place was overall ok. The elevator didn’t work during our stay, so we always had to use the stairs. There were some damp spots on the walls, and the air conditioning was leaking (at least while we were there, not sure if it continued afterward). On the positive side, it was close to all the main tourist attractions, the terrace is really spacious, and the kitchen is well equipped. Overall, I think I would stay here again.

Great hosts! So patient and helpful, even though we arrived a little late we were able to check in, someone was waiting for us. Apartment was as described, comfortable, clean and had everything we needed. Would highly recommend!

Walkable distance from metro Republique and apartment is easy to locate it. Lots of restaurants around and a canal behind to chill. Max is very responsive and provides all the require instruction which makes smooth to access to the room. The room is spotless and fresh. What stands out for me was the mini kitchen. Well curated with a minimalist touch and the utensil brands is something I closely associated with, makes me feel more home.
Beautiful apartment in a lovely location. Great hosts, made our short stay just what we were after.

The room was very nice, spacious main living area, and had everything we needed from soap to dishes. We also loved the location - good restaurant options immediately downstairs and walkable to lots of main attractions in Paris.

Nice apartment in a great location and easy to get to all our destinations. Very tidy with clean linen and towels. Very quiet give how central the location is, so a good night's sleep was had. The hosts were quick to respond to any questions. The only issue for us during our stay was the WiFi not working, but they did their best to help fix the problem.

We had a lovely stay at this Airbnb in Paris! The location was fantastic, and the apartment was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. It had everything we needed for a pleasant visit. Our only small complaint was that they were painting the front door during our stay, which was a bit inconvenient and unexpected. Also, it would have been nice to have a few basic amenities like coffee and tea provided, especially for the first morning. Other than that, everything was great—we really enjoyed our time and would definitely consider staying here again!

Fantastic host - very responsive and attentive. The space is beautiful. Everything is brand new and sparkling. Had a wonderful time - the area is very trendy and in a great location. Thank you for having us!

The host was friendly, approachable, and helpful. I had an issue and she was responsive to my needs. Good location near the Metro station. The sofa bed isn't very comfortable, so for 4 adults and a longer stay it might not be suitable. However, it's decent enough.

my 1 week was great in this nice apartment 😍😍😍❤️❤️❤️very clean, very comfortable everything in flat, have petite elevator but its was nice👌 owners are perfect, attention and support me🙏🙏❤️❤️❤️😍😍😍area its fantastic port maillot , if i will be back in paris only here🥰🌟my 100 stars you and thank you so much, merci bien
We found the hotel at the last minute and were very happy with our choice. It was comfortable and clean, and the staff were also very friendly.

Jean-Luc’s place was great. The location was ideal and perfect for walking to the local sites. The square that the apartment was located was quiet and tucked away which was ideal. Highly recommend for families. Would definitely stay again!

We absolutely loved our stay at this apartment - great location, check in and check out extremely easy, communication with the team was always quick and they offered great tips and places to go if needed. The Marais is such a great part of Paris - lots of restaurants and bars within 10/15 minute walking distance, we felt safe wherever we went. Yes there is no lift but if you want to stay in an authentic-feeling Parisian apartment that’s just life. Also BTW air con was fine for us! It was very cool inside the bedrooms. Thanks for having us!

We had a great stay at the apartment. We were a group of 8 adults and 1 toddler and found it specious enough for all of us. the kitchen was well stocked and there was a fan in each room (in lieu of AC). welcome drink for everyone upon arrival which was a nice surprise. the centre room was really stuffy but all the other rooms were fine. It's in a central location so it can get quite loud in the front rooms on Friday and Saturday nights. It's a couple of blocks from some really nice neighbourhoods with delicious coffee and pastry options. However, it's on the main street close to sex shops and such, so might not be appropriate for young families. Not and issue for us but there are only stairs only and there are steps throughout the flat. would stay again with a big group. thanks for having us!

Very nice and convenient stay. Space was clean and had all necessities. The only downside would be that the elevator still wasn’t working and since the apartment was situated in an office building, the lights in the stairwell were turned off (and unable to turn on) during evenings and weekends.
He gave very detailed instructions on everything. Its small but perfect for two. Very close to lots of restaurants and the metro. Highly recommend!
It’s very small for 4 adults (we were 4) but for 2 adults, it is fine. The bathroom is very tiny. The location is decent. Close to metros and able to walk to bakeries nearby to buy breakfast.

We had a wonderful stay at Didier’s place – we were so lucky to find it! The apartment itself is really spacious (especially by Paris standards) and stylishly decorated – it was perfect for us and our young son. We found it to be a great base from which to explore Paris, with the nearest metro station only a two minute walk away. There was also a bus stop moments from the front door with frequent bus services taking you to the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower etc. The neighbourhood is lovely, the apartment itself is on a pedestrianised street with a supermarket right next door. There are also lots of lovely restaurants and bars within easy walking distance. Didier was great at communicating with us in the lead up to our stay and the apartment has everything you need. We would wholeheartedly recommend staying here and can only hope it is available next time we come to Paris! Thank you Didier 😊

The flat was lovely and spacious. We had a couple of hot days so could’ve done with some A/C but it didn’t spoil our stay and is clear on the description that it’s not A/C. Good value for the size. Close to metro. Responsive host who let us access the property early to drop off luggage which was super helpful. Would recommend the property.
We stay at Romain’s apartment for 4 nights. It s such a well decorated space. 5 mins walk away from the subway station. Easy to travel around Paris city. We had a great experience there.
We had a great stay, the space was unique and perfectly located for us. I would stay again and highly recommend if you want an original space. Sallae Restaurant next door is excellent.

Great place to stay for a few nights! Was a bit further than expected from main attractions but the metro was right down the street and made traveling around easy. Great host with great recommendations!

Excellent location and exactly what I wanted for my stay in Paris! I was met at the door and shown how to get into the building and access the lift, and had help with my bags which was so lovely. Was an easy check in and check out process. Thank you very much!
beautiful appointment with all the amenities you need. washer is a plus. close to metro, supermarket and bakery. 20 to 30 min in metro to any touristic place.

Astrid’s place was exactly as described in the listing. Very clean and nice. We had some issues beyond her control with check in, but she was very responsive and had the problems resolved quickly. The apartment is conveniently located near the trains which was great for getting around the city.

Great location in Paris. Lots of restaurants nearby and easy access to public transportation. Just understand that this apartment and bathroom are very small and you will have to climb two flights of stairs to access the apartment. This is a good spot for a solo traveler, but would be tight even for two people.

We had a great stay. The hosts communicated very well the check in instructions and were very flexible with the check out time, which is greatly appreciated as we had a flight late at night. However, few things to point out: there wasn’t space in the rooms for clothing and bags, only a little bit in the lounge but being 4 people we were very cramped. The kitchen wasn’t well equipped, there wasn’t a microwave and no pots for cooking and also no space for groceries. The taps in the one bedroom and kitchen were loose and the shower and basin blocked. The hairdryer didn’t work, the one fan’s plug was broken and another one very noisy that we couldn’t use it as we weren’t able to sleep with such a noisy fan. Didn’t have proper pillows in the beds. Location was great and quite.
Everything I needed - quiet, comfortable and close to the station! Pauline was very communicative and helpful
This is a very cool, uniquely furnished apartment. It’s very clean, well appointed and feels very secure. It’s in a great location, near the metro with a number of nice bars and cafes nearby.

Raphael’s place was perfect for us and we will definitely stay there again on our next visit to Paris. The location is excellent, the high ceilings are great, and the apartment reminded us of our home in New York City. A truly wonderful stay!
Great experience and lovely apartment in Marais. Outdoor patio was why we chose the place and didn’t disappoint! Will definitely stay here again on next visit!

I do not even know where to begin! Traveled solo and it was perfect! The views was beautiful to wake up to and get ready in front of. Will definitely come back in the future. Cannot recommend it enough!! Also everything is walkable distance from there!

The place was as described. The outdoor area is nice to have with views of the Eiffel Tower, the river, and Montmartre. Location could not be better. It is tight getting up the 5 flights of stairs with luggage and watch the low ceilings in the bedroom loft, but would recommend and stay again.
The location was great. It was easily accessible to everything Many restaurants and cafes The host was responsive and took care of anything we needed
We really enjoyed our stay in this lovely apartment, and it's easy to get to more central areas by metro and bus.
Anais was very responsive, and her place is a true gem with its proximity to major tourist spots. The Eiffel Tower is just a 10-minute walk away. We had a wonderful stay in her beautiful home!

Everything about this place was perfect! It's one of those rare holiday stays where you feel like you could have been friends with the hosts in another life - the home felt so homely to us and infused with good vibes. There's actual philosophy in the toilet, a guitar on the wall, and a cocktail bar in the piano! The host was super responsive and helpful, the location amazing, and all the important stuff like that :) Truly a haven within the bustling Parisian chaos.

Would highly recommend Fouad’s place. He was very helpful and responsive, had an unbelievably efficient use of space (how does this place also have a washer??) and very close to the metro and the main attractions of Paris.

We are so lucky to have found Bruno’s place in Paris! We truly enjoyed staying there and Bruno was always so helpful and accommodating to us. He was proactive and very kind. We loved that the apartment was close to the Eiffel Tower and central in the city in general. I definitely recommend booking with Bruno if given the opportunity. We hope to be back soon!

This beautiful, bright and charming apartment is perfect for a Paris getaway! We felt right at home and enjoyed our stay very much. The location was also great, with the Metro, bakeries, restaurants and shops all within walking distance. Yet the apartment was quiet because it faces the backyard. I would definitely recommend it.

Great location near restaurants, shopping and more - you step in from a very busy area to a peaceful courtyard building- up a flight of stairs to a nice unit. We were lucky that we did not need air conditioning the fans worked fine. Close to many metro stops but one thing to note, due to the location taxi and UBERS do drop off or pick up at the front door - you have to walk a blocks. Overall a great stay!

Apartment was well appointed, and as described - particularly liked the view of the park! We really enjoyed the neighbourhood and our overall stay The only reason I am leaving 4 stars is because there was major construction going on every morning from 8am in the building next door. We appreciate that Antoine did reach out to find out more about it, but unfortunately the noise significantly affected our sleep throughout our visit
Excellent communication and location. Felt safe and has a small convenience store and excellent restaurants across the street including chinese and vegan
Best location, as long as you don't mind climbing 100 steps. Would definitely book again if available for my next trip to Paris. Great host and very helpful.

We had a fantastic stay at Francine’s apartment in Passy. It is in a wonderful neighborhood near the Eiffel Tower, with nice shopping and restaurants. The apartment was clean, well stocked, and artistically furnished. Everything worked and was as described. The private garden was a wonderful touch. Francine was a very welcoming and responsive host.
Amazing stay and looking forward to coming back. I would recommend this place to anyone! So good!

Great location in Montmartre with lots of restaurants, supermarkets and a metro nearby. Jean-François helped us locate a luggage storage nearby as we had an evening flight. We felt at home and would stay again

The location was perfect. The space clean and just as described. Louise met me to show me how everything worked and had fresh croissants awaiting me after a night of travel. Truly appreciated.! You will not be disappointed.
It's a real gem. Not only amazingly beautiful, but comfortable as well. The flat is very quiet, located in a good spot, 6–7 minutes from the metro. It is ideal for a couple.

Daniel is a superb host. The apartment is located in a nice neighborhood and there are lots of restaurants and bars around. And Daniel was always available in case we had any questions. The check-in was also very easy. We will love to return.

The apartment was great and very spacious - we felt right at home and were very happy to find all amenities imaginable. It was especially nice to be able to reach a contact quite late at night when we had a small problem retrieving the keys. Thank you for the stay, we would definitely love to come again!

Jean-Daniel's place was great for our party of 6, having only one toilet worked out well since it was its own separate room, but having two bathing rooms with a sink was very helpful. I gave only 4 stars on cleanliness because the living room chairs had some stains not seen in the original photos. The linens however were crisp and clean. The cleaning of bathrooms was also acceptable. Plenty of dishes available for eating inside and several useful appliances. There was plenty of comfortable seating for us. A wonderful book was put together for recommendations on places to visit and places to eat. Jean was very responsive, and he and his wife were very welcoming and kind.
Great location! Yes there are stairs, pack light! So much to see and do around the area and then great access to the rest of Paris.
The location was perfect, right in the center, making it easy to explore everything on foot. The host was very responsive and quick to answer any questions we had, which made our stay even smoother.
Virginie is a great host and was very welcoming to our family. A lovely part of Paris, very picturesque with amenities close by. Would highly recommend the apartment and would love to go again!
Great stay, very clean, great view and great location. Better than the photos and the AC works very well. Kitchen was well stocked and the hosts were friendly and helpful.

It was a pleasure staying in Noemie’s apartment! It is cozy, a small balcony and in a quiet and very beautiful area of Paris. It’s easy to take bus of metro to all the sights and there is also beautiful walks close by. Noemie was very helpful and everything went perfectly! Perfect for a trip to Paris!

awesome apartment in top notch location ! close to everything. loved that the Eiffel Tower was the first and last thing i saw every day. Bernard was very informative and made our say great. if we every return to Paris, this will be our go to air bnb.

We had such a wonderful time at Jean-Charles’ apartment. It’s so quaint and typically Parisian with all the amenities you need. Jean-Charles was very accommodating before the trip providing us with some recommendations of where to eat in Paris. If you’re looking for a beautiful location not immediately in the tourist traps, stay here and experience how Parisians live!
We stayed for 4 days, this was a perfect spot for us. We managed to walk a lot and be a 40min walk to the Effiel tower. This place is in the perfect spot and would definitely stay again
We had a wonderful stay it was very comfortable very clean and we couldn't have wanted any more.

As this was our first trip to Paris, we wanted to be located in an area where we could walk to as many attractions as possible. Elise’s quaint accommodation was perfect for our stay. It didn’t take long to walk to the Louvre and the Eiffel Tower and there were plenty of shopping opportunities with feet of our front door. We enjoyed the security of the premises and the finishing touches that she provided in her space.

Wonderful stay! The apartment is in a perfect location, in a beautiful and safe neighborhood. Very quiet in the courtyard, clean, and overall just a really pleasant place. A great find—I’d be excited to come back next month.

The studio is in a great location near to metro and bus stops. There are loads of cafes, bars shops and restaurants within walking distance. Pere lachaise cemetery is very close and it’s really easy to get to all the main areas with the metro. Comfy bed, good big towels and good quality linen. The area is safe and the apartment is very secure. There are English and European channels on the TV and the WiFi is excellent. We would stay here again
Yuna’s place was comfy, great location in Montmartre. It was quiet, peaceful and the apt spacious. The Staff were very friendly and we loved the place! Will be back!
It was amazing time at this apartment, everything was perfect, the flat is really like in the picture, everything I was needed they were really available Everything was perfect
